title: Event Content and Programming Producer
description:
This role is based in our New York, or Orlando office.

The Event Content & Programming Producer develops and delivers engaging in-person programming across an assigned portfolio of FAN EXPO HQ shows in the United States. The role independently manages assigned shows, builds and maintains community and industry partnerships, and coordinates closely with Show Management, Operations, Marketing, other Content Producers, and the role's dedicated cross-functional micro-team. The Content Producer reports to the Senior Manager, Events and Programming.

This position focuses on live event content and programming. Digital and social media content creation is led by the Marketing team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently manage assigned shows within the Content Producer's portfolio, from planning through on-site execution, while escalating material risks and decisions to the Senior Manager, Events and Programming.
  • Research, develop, schedule, and deliver engaging programming across a range of pop culture genres.
  • Build and maintain programming schedules; assign rooms and show-floor locations; document operational requirements; and coordinate move-in, access, and on-site instructions.
  • Proactively identify and pursue new community, industry, and other partnership opportunities that can strengthen programming and on-site content activations.
  • Serve as the primary contact for assigned partners and exhibitors, maintaining clear and consistent communication to support seamless execution of programming and on-site content activations.
  • Develop and execute collaborative community and fan programming, including partner allocations, schedules, and related show-floor requirements.
  • Coordinate with the Sales team and relevant internal stakeholders to deliver sponsor or client programming commitments for assigned shows.
  • Provide regular updates to other Content Producers and the dedicated micro-team, including Show Management, Operations, and Marketing; identify and communicate potential issues early; and contribute creative ideas and practical solutions.
  • Foster teamwork, transparency, and constructive collaboration in support of strong execution and team morale.
  • Research competitor events, monitor audience and industry trends, and remain current across relevant pop culture communities.
  • Travel to at least 25% of FAN EXPO HQ shows annually; provide on-site support for MEGACON Orlando, FAN EXPO Canada, and at least three additional shows each year beyond those in the assigned portfolio.
  • Minimum of two years of experience in comic conventions, live events, entertainment, or a related industry, with responsibility for content, programming, events, and/or community outreach.
  • Demonstrated interest in and knowledge of pop culture genres, which may include comics, anime, horror, gaming, cosplay, science fiction, and fantasy.
  • College or university degree in communications, media, arts, or a related field is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and substantial administrative responsibilities during show preparation periods.
  • Clear, consistent, and proactive written and verbal communication with internal teams, partners, and exhibitors.
  • A collaborative working style and the ability to contribute effectively within a cross-functional team environment.
  • Creativity, attention to detail, sound judgment, and adaptability in a fast-moving live event environment.
  • Availability to travel within the United States and Canada and to work the extended or non-standard hours required for live event delivery.

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at an Informa event – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

We work hard to make sure Life at Informa is rewarding, supportive and enjoyable for everyone. Here’s some of what you can expect when you join us. But don’t just take our word for it – see what our colleagues have to say at

Our benefits include:

  • Great community: a welcoming culture with in-person and online social events, our fantastic Walk the World charity day and active colleague groups and networks promoting a positive, supportive, and collaborative work environment
  • Broader impact: take up to four days per year to volunteer, with charity match funding available too
  • Career opportunity: the opportunity to develop your career with bespoke training and learning, mentoring platforms and on-demand access to thousands of courses on LinkedIn Learning. When it’s time for the next step, we encourage and support internal job moves
  • Time out: 15 days PTO rising to 20 after three years and 25 after six years, plus 10 national holidays, a birthday leave day and the chance to work from (almost!) anywhere for up to four weeks a year
  • Competitive benefits, including a 401k match, health, vision and dental insurance, parental leave and an ESPP offering company shares at a minimum 15% discount
  • Strong wellbeing support through EAP assistance, mental health first aiders, free access to a wellness app and more
  • Recognition for great work, with global awards and kudos programs
  • As an international company, the chance to collaborate with teams around the world

The salary range for this role is $52,000- $62,000 based on experience.

This posting will automatically expire on 14th December 2026

We’re not solely focused on a checklist of skills. We champion energy and ambition and look for colleagues who will roll their sleeves up, join in and help make things happen. If it sounds like a match and you have most – although not all – of the skills and experience listed, we welcome your application.

If you would like to request reasonable adjustments or accommodations to assist your participation in the hiring process and, or in the advertised position, please inform the appropriate Talent Acquisition Partner for the role once they have been in touch. Your request will be reviewed and considered in confidence. At Informa, you'll find inclusive experiences and environments where all perspectives and backgrounds are welcomed. As part of this approach and our diversity and inclusion commitments, we are also formally an Equal Opportunities Employer. This means we base decisions on relevant qualifications and merit and do not discriminate on the basis of key characteristics and statuses, including all of those protected by law. Guest Experience Ambassador Job Summary:

The Sever/Guest Experience Ambassador reports to the Director of Dining Services and is responsible for providing a best-in-class dining experience to the residents, colleagues, and guests we serve by ensuring all are provided with exemplary service.


Essential Functions and Key Tasks:

  • Cascade a spirit of Hospitality in all dealings with residents, colleagues and guests.
  • Leads service of food or beverages to residents and prepares or serve specialty diets and dishes as required.
  • Engages with residents to obtain desired orders for food or beverages while possessing the ability to fully articulate the daily menu offerings.
  • Explain how various menu items are prepared, describing ingredients and cooking methods.
  • Ensure residents are satisfied with all aspects of service. Communicate with direct supervisor on any customer service issues.
  • Check residents' diets, likes & dislikes to ensure that such requirements are satisfied.
  • Assist with set-up/breakdown of all scheduled meal periods.
  • Stock service areas with supplies such as coffee, food, tableware, and linens as needed.
  • Perform cleaning duties as assigned, including but not limited to, sweeping and mopping floors, tidying up service station, clearing tables and taking out trash.
  • May wash pots, pans, dishes, utensils, or other cooking equipment.
  • May assist in supporting culinary staff at numerous stations as directed.
  • Provide excellent customer service to include being attentive, approachable, greeting and thanking customers.
  • May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Work Environment:

The Guest Experience Ambassador operates in a kitchen environment whereby employees may be exposed to and/or required to operate equipment, including but not limited to, an oven, stove, dishwasher, slicer, coffee machine, steamer, mixer and chef’s knives. The team member is frequently exposed to heat, steam, fire and noise.


Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee may be required to sit, reach, bend, kneel, stoop, climb, and push, pull & lift items weighing 40 pounds or less. Employee may be required to stand for long periods of time. The position requires manual dexterity; auditory and visual skills; and the ability to follow written and oral instructions and procedures.


Required Education and Experience:

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Previous experience in food service

• Previous customer service experience

description:

Manage an existing, growing, Global Operations Team supporting and enhancing our clients’ operational use of the Charles River IMS (CR IMS) systems. The role requires strong management, communication, and leadership skills as well as “hands-on” client issue management, production support, product enhancements, client relations, and staff hiring/development.


Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of Charles River Development (or CRD), that became a part of State Street in 2018. CRD helps create enterprise investment management software solutions for large institutions in the areas of institutional investment, wealth management, and hedge funds. Together we have created the first open front-to-back platform - State Street Alpha, that was launched in 2019.

Join us if delivering next generation infrastructure, using emerging technologies like AI and Blockchain sounds like a challenge you are up for.


What you will be responsible for


As a Global Operations EMEA Team Lead you will:

  • Identify opportunities to improve the service and delivery model and work with staff, peers, and management to improve and enhance the services.
  • Act as an Escalation point for GOC Team members on client or internal operational issues
  • Support and enhance Clients’ ROI from CR IMS
  • Support and facilitate Charles River’s business objectives

Operations

  • Escalate issues to Senior Management using sound judgement
  • Troubleshooting and issue resolution
  • Hands-on management of key clients
  • Monitoring of queue to ensure accuracy, completeness, timely, and proper progress
  • Mentoring junior team members through issues and major processes
  • Oversight of issue resolution and support for team members
  • Daily operational monitoring, support and resolution for regional Clients as well as other Clients as part of the global team and follow-the-sun support model
  • Accountable for ensuring defined processes are followed
  • Identification of issues in existing processes
  • Occasional off hours / weekend support
  • Service Partner communications and coordination
  • Clear and accountable reporting to Senior Management
  • Manage team to provide reliable mission critical software-based operations and support
  • Provide day-to-day performance management and support for subordinates
  • Work with CRD colleagues to smoothly transition new Clients to production operation through the onboarding process.
  • Work with vendors as partners to deliver a tightly integrated, seamless service to Charles River Clients.

What we value

  • Hands on capability to undertake basic investigative activities on RDBMS such as writing and running queries and data investigations, basic performance diagnosis, basic administration functions
  • Familiarity with common technology platforms and the ability to guide and check technical approaches and issues resolution. Platforms used include RDBMS, Windows, ETL, MQ, PL/Transact SQL, Web Admin and Web Services.
  • Facilitate and manage Issue diagnosis and resolution
  • Oversee technology management and issue resolution

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred

  • 3+ years’ experience managing and supporting mission critical production software applications.
  • 3+ years’ experience in a management/leadership role.
  • 2+ years of database software or IT technical experience.
  • Experience or familiarity with servers and networks is preferred.
  • Experience with the following is preferred: databases, server operating systems, servers, networks, job scheduling software, system monitoring software
  • Track record of leadership in high-growth, mission critical software-based operations and support environment.
  • Ability to manage staff through multiple projects and tasks with changing deadlines.
  • Excellent Customer Service skills, expectation management
  • Project and staff management and mentoring skills
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Partner liaison (internal and external)

From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. title: Fleet Technician B (Aransas Pass, TX)
description:
Job Posting End Date

10-23-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date

Job Summary

Perform maintenance/repairs on sedans, light/medium/heavy trucks, trailers and heavy work equipment and any attached equipment, and/or auxiliary equipment, which is part of the specialized vehicles, operated by the Company. The following list sets forth the principal duties required for the job. This list is not intended to limit assignment of work or the degree of supervision under all operating conditions. Employee may perform miscellaneous, related, and incidental work in addition to that specifically outlined below.

Job Description


What You'll Do:

  • Service and repair boom/pedestal assemblies of the Company’s specialized equipment including troubleshooting equipment; inspect cables, chains and rods; inspect sheave liners; inspect and repair monitoring system; inspect fiberglass components; inspect turntable; remove and replace reduction gearboxes; inspect pins, bushings and bearings; and load test boom assemblies.
  • Service and repair hydraulic systems including troubleshooting the hydraulic system; inspect, remove and replace hydraulic pumps, motors, valves, cylinders and the accumulator; and remove and replace swivel collector block.
  • Service and repair heating and ventilation systems including diagnose A/C unit problems; conduct pressure test on A/C unit; check for leaks using appropriate devices; check internal system controls; replace compressor; service A/C clutch assembly; and replace compressor seals, refrigerant hose, condenser assembly, receiver dryer, and evaporator core.
  • Troubleshoot and repair winch assemblies.
  • Service and repair the steering system of Company vehicles including repair power steering pump and manual steering gearbox
  • Service and repair the air brake systems of Company vehicles including air compressors, air brake chambers, and air control valves
  • Service and repair hydraulic and electric braking systems including inspect and repair master cylinder; test power unit and vacuum supply; inspect power boost system; repair power brake system; and service and repair antilock brake system
  • Inspect and service differentials and power dividers and transmission assemblies of Company vehicles including manual clutch, manual transmissions and transfer cases, transaxles (front-wheel-drive), and automatic transmissions
  • Service and repair the fuel and exhaust systems including computer control system; test and repair diesel fuel pump; inspect and service intake and turbo system; service and repair fuel injection system (gas/diesel); and inspect and service governors
  • Assist others in the diagnosis of more complex problems.
  • Operate Company vehicles and associated equipment and perform duties incidental to the operation of such equipment.
  • Maintain tools, equipment and work area in a clean and orderly condition.
  • Maintain records and submit reports as required.
  • Attend and participate in training as assigned and assist in the training of other employees.
  • Perform less skilled work as assigned.
  • Report irregularities and abnormal conditions.
  • Assist employees of equal or higher classification.
  • Direct the work of employees assigned to assist.

What You'll Have:


Education: High school graduate or GED required.


Experience: At least 2 years of strong automotive mechanical diagnosis with hydraulic and diesel repair experience. Graduation from an automotive trade school with diesel engine experience is highly desirable.


Licenses/Certifications: Must possess and maintain a valid state driver's license. Must obtain Class A CDL within 12 months of entry date into the Fleet Technician B classification or vacate the job classification.Must obtain Fluid Power Society Certification and two (2) applicable ASE certifications within 24 months of entry date or vacate the current job classification.


OTHER REQUIREMENTS:


These are additional expectations for the job and could include specific work experience, license / certifications, preemployment testing, expectations about travel, shift work, etc.


1) Must qualify through demonstration, examination and/or performance appraisal as determined by the Company.


2) Must exhibit competency and aptitude in the fundamentals and mechanics of vehicle maintenance and repairs.


3) Must become familiar with and have the ability to operate the computer systems utilized by the Fleet Services organization.


4) Must acquire within such time frame as determined by the company, the qualifications necessary to perform the duties of the Fleet Technician A, or vacate the current job classification.


5) Successful completion of the Tuff Tech pre-employment placement test is required for this position.


6) For Fleet Techs that support Transmission, travel of 80% – 100% may be required.


7) Shift work may be required


PHYSICAL DEMANDS:


List any physical demands required for this job


1. Work at heights – climbing ladders and on/in large trucks and equipment


2. Frequent use of hand tools including various heavy equipment for repairs, ability to grasp, push, pull


3. Ability to lift up to 100 pounds, working in awkward positions, working overhead


4. Frequent walking, standing on concrete and occasionally in rough terrain


5. Ability to operate trucks and heavy equipment

Compensation Data

Compensation Grade:

N024-V07

Compensation Range:

$35.12 - $36.50

title: Engineer II - Manufacturing
description:
By living according to a common set of values, we create a culture that unifies, embraces the uniqueness we all bring to the company, and positions Integer for long-term success.

At Integer, our values are embedded in everything we do.

Customer

We focus on our customers’ success

Innovation

We create better solutions

Collaboration

We create success together

Inclusion

We always interact with others respectfully

Candor

We are open and honest with one another

Integrity

We do the right things and do things right




Who are we?

Integer Holdings Corporation (NYSE: ITGR) is one of the largest medical device contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) in the world, serving the cardio and vascular, neuromodulation, and cardiac rhythm management markets. As a strategic partner of choice, we advance the goals of our medical device customers through industry-leading engineering and manufacturing, with a relentless commitment to quality, service, and innovation. The company's brands include Greatbatch Medical® and Lake Region Medical®.


What you’ll do in this role:

The primary purpose of this position is to perform work which involves general engineering methods and tools; but you may also utilize more advanced technologies and engineering concepts while you are developing in your role as an engineer in the medical device industry. In this role, you will ensure that Integer’s internal and external customer expectations are met or exceeded with occasional direction, instruction and guidance from more experienced engineers and managers in your organization.

  • You adhere to Integer’s Values and all safety, environmental, security and quality requirements including, but not limited to: Quality Management Systems (QMS), Safety, Environmental and Security Management Systems, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, company policies and operating procedures, and other regulatory requirements.
  • You will generally work independently with occasional guidance from supervisors or mentors to evaluate, select and apply standard engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria, using judgment in making minor adaptations and modifications to existing specifications, procedures, and work instructions.
  • You will review procedures and plans prior to implementation as well as evaluate existing products, processes and materials for failure analysis and potential improvements.
  • You will participate in projects that require you to investigate, develop, document and implement new product and process technologies of moderate complexity and scope.
  • While often you may be responding to situations presented to you by others, you will also be able to demonstrate proactive insight into technical challenges and mitigates potential issues or incorporates improvements.
  • You will plan, schedule and execute the engineering work in a part of a major project; or you may lead a smaller scope project.
  • You will perform work on technical projects where you will follow Integer’s standard quality management and production system methodologies to investigate opportunities for product and process improvements.
  • You will apply standard data analysis practices and techniques to establish root cause for product and process failures or to support the justification for improvements to products and processes.
  • You will be required to observe products and processes to recognize discrepancies in results and follow operations throughout a series of detailed steps or processes to establish root cause of the discrepancies.
  • You are expected to collaborate with others in the exchange of information, ask questions and regularly check for understanding in support of your development as an engineer.
  • You embed Quality within the Engineering discipline – “I own Quality.” You are a standard bearer for Quality in everything we do at Integer, by assuring adherence to our Quality Management System (QMS), facilitating and/or contributing to corrective and preventive actions, and contributing to the successful attainment of our quality KPI’s and journey to 5 Sigma.
  • You may perform other duties as needed and as directed by your line of supervision.

Provide support of Integer’s Manufacturing Excellence and Market Focused Innovation Strategies

  • You champion the development of and deployment of the systems and tools to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
  • You embrace the Manufacturing Excellence culture based on the Integer Production System and its five focus areas:
    • Strategy Alignment through Site Hoshin Plans, the regular cadence of Sales, Inventory, and Operations’ Planning (SiOP) meetings, and regular updates to the value stream maps.
    • Leadership of Sustained Change by ensuring production monitoring & improvement activities and deployment of Leader Standard Work.
    • Standardization through workplace organization & visual controls (5S), Manufacturing Standard Work, and robust training & certification programs.
    • Associate Engagement promoted through the adoption of standardized problem solving. methodologies, behavior-based safety programs, and improvement idea and suggestion systems.
    • Systems & Process Optimization through adoption of principles of built in quality, optimized scheduling & material system designs, work cell design, and total productive maintenance.

How you will be measured:

The specific measures listed below may be subject to change and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list

  • Safety is our highest priority; you will be an active supporter of the Integer Environmental Health & Safety programs.
  • Quality – Achievement of site Quality KPI’s
  • You will have defined Goals and Objectives specifying key projects and expected milestones to achieve.
  • Given your capabilities and experience, you will identify ways to shorten the project durations and make changes to current processes and procedures that enable greater efficiencies.
  • Innovation and ideation are critical aspects of your role and you will be expected to generate continuous improvement suggestions and support the implementation of them.


What sets you apart:

  • You earned, as a minimum, a bachelor’s degree in an engineering or related technical field; and have at least three years of relevant experience.
  • Candidates who do not meet the education requirement may be considered with 7+ years of relevant experience.
  • While you will have occasional support and guidance from more experienced engineers, supervisors or managers, you will demonstrate the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with other associates and cross functional teams.
  • You demonstrate a solid technical aptitude with the ability to be an effective contributor to a team or produce results of a technical nature as an individual.
  • You have a functional understanding of the Integer Quality Management Systems and are able to complete required Quality System documentation tasks with little or no direction from others.
  • You demonstrate competency in both written and oral communications.
  • You maintain a calm demeanor that transcends the high energy, constantly changing production environment.
  • You possess a positive, can-do attitude with an underlying belief that failure is not an option.

Manufacturing Engineer II Salary: $71,250- $104,500





Our total rewards program is designed to attract, retain, and motivate associates to contribute to Integer’s success. Our compensation program includes base salary and a cash-based incentive program supporting our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide a comprehensive benefits package with immediate eligibility including medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and adoption benefits. Parental leave is available after one year. Optional employee-paid programs include supplemental life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity and accident insurance. Employees are immediately eligible to participate in the 401(k) plan with company matching contributions. We provide 80 hours (10 days) of company designated holidays per year plus an annual allotment of paid time off.

title: Teknisk Produktägare  Operational Planning
description:
Teknisk Produktägare – Operational Planning

Göteborg eller Stockholm, på plats

Företaget är ett börsnoterat fastighetsbolag som äger, förvaltar och utvecklar bostäder, kommersiella fastigheter och hotell i Sverige, Danmark, Finland, Tyskland, Storbritannien och Norge. Rollen sitter i DITA (digitalisering, IT och affärsutveckling), mitt i en flerårig transformation med nytt ERP, ny dataplattform och masterdata.

Om rollen

Du äger roadmap, backlog och prioriteringar för företagets plattformar och verktyg inom operational planning: prognos, verksamhetsstyrning och uppföljning samt projektplanering och projektuppföljning. Du driver tekniska vägval, säkerställer integrationer till och från verktygen och balanserar standardfunktionalitet mot anpassningar. Du är länken mellan verksamhet, processägare, Project Delivery Office, IT och externa partners.

Varför rollen är unik

Området byggs i princip från start och breddas i takt med företagets digitaliseringsresa. Du får skapa struktur, transparens och datadrivna beslut i en verksamhet med många parallella projekt – och se effekten i hur bolaget planerar och prioriterar.

Vad du kommer att göra

  • Äga roadmap, backlog och prioriteringar för Operational Planning
  • Äga och vidareutveckla plattformar, system och verktyg inom området
  • Driva utveckling av processer för planering, prognos och uppföljning
  • Definiera, prioritera och förankra krav tillsammans med verksamheten
  • Driva tekniska vägval och säkerställa integrationer
  • Identifiera och driva automation, effektivisering och datadrivet arbetssätt
  • Bygga governance, struktur och arbetssätt som skalar

Vad vi söker (Skall-krav)

  • Erfarenhet av planerings-, projekt-, prognos- eller verksamhetsstyrningssystem
  • Tekniskt produktägarskap, plattformsansvar eller liknande roll
  • God förståelse för verksamhetsstyrning, operativa processer och uppföljning
  • Teknisk förståelse för systemarkitektur, integrationer och plattformstänk
  • Erfarenhet av att leda process- och förändringsarbete
  • Stark prioriteringsförmåga och vana att arbeta tvärfunktionellt
  • Flytande i svenska och engelska


Vem vi söker

Företaget söker en kreativ, entreprenöriell person med utvecklar- eller teknisk bakgrund, som framgångsrikt har drivit projekt i mål och tagit ägarskap för resultatet.

  • Har infört eller utvecklat planerings- eller uppföljningsverktyg och drivit dem till faktisk användning
  • Tar initiativ utan att vänta på färdiga ramar
  • Pratar affär med controllers och arkitektur med IT
  • Analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad
  • Trivs när mandat och arbetssätt fortfarande formas


Meriterande

  • Fastighetsbranschen och/eller projektintensiva verksamheter (bygg, entreprenad, konsult)
  • Teknisk bakgrund från utvecklar- eller BI-/datasidan


Praktiska detaljer

  • Plats: Göteborg eller Stockholm, på plats 5 dagar/vecka
  • Anställning: tillsvidare med inledande provanställning
  • Språk: svenska och engelska

title: SIU Field Investigator
description:
Are you the kind of investigator who can't walk away from unanswered questions? Do you have an eye for detail, a passion for uncovering facts, and the experience to separate assumptions from evidence? Lemieux & Associates is seeking a part-time, on-call SIU Field Investigator in Pittsburgh, PA, who is ready to put their investigative expertise to work in a rewarding role where every case presents a new challenge. If you're looking for flexible field work with meaningful impact, don't let this opportunity pass you by. Apply today!


Why Investigators Choose Lemieux & Associates

At Lemieux & Associates, we know talented investigators are the foundation of our success. That's why we offer competitive pay of $25-$32 per hour, the flexibility of an on-call, part-time schedule, and the opportunity to work on engaging investigations that put your skills to the test. Beyond the work itself, you'll join a company that values communication, integrity, loyalty, and professional growth.


If you're ready to make an impact while enjoying flexibility and professional support, we encourage you to submit your application now!


WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT OUR DEDICATED TEAM?

As a national leader in investigative services, Lemieux & Associates is dedicated to delivering professional SIU/DIU, surveillance, and medical canvassing services clients can rely on. Our employees are our greatest asset, and our company culture revolves around maintaining a communicative, loyal, ethical, passionate, impactful, and benevolent environment. With a leadership team boasting over 25 years of field experience, we are committed to unlocking the potential of our employees and creating a supportive, tight-knit community.


DO YOU MEET THESE QUALIFICATIONS?

  • SIU/Claims investigation experience as a Private Investigator or Fraud Investigator
  • Must reside in the Pittsburgh area
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Resume and questionnaire required for consideration

Preferred Qualifications:

  • While no license is required, a Notary License is strongly preferred
  • Bilingual abilities and/or a degree in Criminal Justice or a related field

WHAT WILL YOU DO AS A SIU FIELD INVESTIGATOR?

As our SIU Field Investigator, no two days will look exactly the same. One day, you'll arrive at an accident scene to carefully document conditions and capture critical photographic evidence. Another day, you'll be meeting with individuals to obtain written or recorded statements that help bring clarity to a claim. Throughout each investigation, you'll gather facts, assess evidence, connect important details, and compile comprehensive reports that provide clients with accurate and reliable information. Your ability to observe, document, and communicate findings will play a vital role in helping uncover the truth behind every case.


Flexible Work That Fits Your Lifestyle

This position offers a part-time, on-call schedule. Work assignments will vary based on case needs and investigative demand within the Pittsburgh area. Ideal candidates will appreciate the flexibility of field-based investigative work while maintaining the professionalism and responsiveness needed to support client requests.


READY TO APPLY AND ADVANCE YOUR CAREER?

If you're ready to put your SIU experience to work with a respected national investigative firm, we want to hear from you. Our application process is quick, easy, and mobile-friendly, making it simple to take the next step in your career. Apply today and discover where your investigative expertise can take you.

title: Rektor till Nynäshamns Gymnasium
description:
Nynäshamns gymnasium befinner sig i ett dynamiskt utvecklingsskede präglat av kreativitet och nytänkande. Vi har nyligen utvecklat fler profiler till vårt programutbud som vi är övertygade kommer att vara efterfrågade för elever och för arbetsmarknadens behov.

Vill du vara med och driva Nynäshamns gymnasium framåt och säkerställa att våra elever får de allra bästa förutsättningar efter avslutas gymnasieexamen? Då behöver vi dig!

Arbetsuppgifter

Som rektor är du direkt underställd skolchef. Du har ekonomi-, personal- och arbetsmiljöansvar och leder det dagliga arbetet för verksamheten och dess medarbetare. Tillsammans med skolchef och biträdande rektor ansvarar du för det pedagogiska utvecklingsarbetet samt det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet, med fokus på att skapa goda förutsättningar för elevers lärande och utveckling.

Uppdraget innebär att leda och utveckla verksamheten med särskilt fokus på hög måluppfyllelse, förbättrade kunskapsresultat, trygghet och studiero samt en tillgänglig och inkluderande lärmiljö. Du arbetar strategiskt för att fler elever ska fullfölja sin gymnasieutbildning och nå sina individuella mål.

Arbetsgruppen omfattar skolans medarbetare inom undervisning, elevhälsa, studie- och yrkesvägledning samt administration. Rektor arbetar nära biträdande rektor och skolchef. Viktiga interna samverkansparter är bland annat HR, ekonomi, socialförvaltningen och andra stödfunktioner. Externt sker samverkan med vårdnadshavare, fackliga organisationer, andra huvudmän och skolor samt lokalt näringsliv och andra aktörer kopplade till utbildning och arbetsliv.

Rollen ställer höga krav på förmågan att leda förändring och pedagogisk utveckling samtidigt som verksamhetens ekonomi, bemanning och programutbud behöver anpassas till elevunderlag och framtida behov. Du säkerställer en rättssäker verksamhet, driver ett systematiskt kvalitetsarbete och skapar förutsättningar för medarbetarna att lyckas i sina uppdrag. Genom ett tydligt ledarskap bidrar du till verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling ur ett helhetsperspektiv.

Om arbetsplatsen

Näringslivs- och arbetsmarknadsförvaltningens uppdrag är att stärka Nynäshamns kommun som en attraktiv plats för företagare. Vi tillgodoser behovet av kompetens genom att erbjuda unga och vuxna utbildningar på Nynäshamns gymnasium och Campus Nynäshamn. Vi arbetar också för att öka möjligheterna för personer som står långt från arbetsmarknaden att etablera sig, eller återkomma till, arbetslivet. Därutöver arbetar vi för att främja tillgången till kultur- och fritidsaktiviteter för alla invånare.

Nynäshamns gymnasium innefattar kommunens gymnasieskola, med ett samlat erbjudande av utbildningsprogram som leder såväl till efterfrågade yrkesroller som till förberedelse för vidare studier till högskola eller yrkeshögskola. Vi är stolta över att erbjuda flera idrottsprofiler, entreprenörskap, vård- och omsorgsprogrammet och kriminologi.

Det här söker vi hos dig

För att lyckas i rollen har du:

  • Lärarexamen eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren finner relevant
  • Påbörjat eller genomfört rektorsprogrammet/statlig rektorsutbildning eller motsvarande
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda andra samt erfarenhet av personal-, ekonomi- och arbetsmiljöansvar
  • Erfarenhet från gymnasieskola eller annan relevant skolform
  • Erfarenhet av pedagogiskt ledarskap/systematiskt kvalitetsarbete
  • Kunskap om skolans styrdokument och relevant lagstiftning
  • Mycket goda svenska kunskaper i tal och skrift.
  • God administrativ och digital förmåga.
  • Du har en förmåga att arbeta med verksamhetsdata, ekonomisk uppföljning och digitala verksamhetssystem.

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • Tidigare erfarenhet som rektor eller biträdande rektor
  • Erfarenhet av förändringsledning, arbete med gymnasieskolans programutbud och resursstyrning
  • Erfarenhet av samverkan med fackliga organisationer och externa aktörer
  • Det är meriterande med erfarenhet av digital lärplattform och kommunala verksamhetssystem så som Vklass, Heroma, Proceedo och Hypergene.

Personliga egenskaper vi letar efter

Du har en hög personlig mognad och integritet samt agerar utifrån välgrundade värderingar och ett professionellt förhållningssätt. Du är trygg i dig själv, har mod att fatta beslut och kan agera självständigt även i komplexa situationer. Som person är du initiativrik och självgående, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och driver arbetet framåt med fokus på resultat. Du har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar och ser möjligheter där andra ser hinder. Rollen kräver också att du är stabil och behåller lugnet under press, samtidigt som du är mål- och resultatorienterad med förmåga att omsätta ambitioner till konkreta resultat. Du har en stark drivkraft, ett högt engagemang och energi att leda och utveckla verksamheten mot uppsatta mål.

Det här erbjuder vi dig

  • Hos oss får du göra skillnad i människors liv. Här har du nära till din chef och dina kollegor, påverkan och beslut.

  • Nynäshamn är en lugn och trygg kommun. Tryggheten finns även i våra team – vi är prestigelösa, uppmuntrar och backar upp varandra när det behövs.

  • Nynäshamns kommun är en del av Sveriges starkaste tillväxtregion. Vår resa ger dig möjlighet till utmaningar och varierande arbetsuppgifter.

  • Vi erbjuder tillgång till gym. Du får även friskvårdstimme eller friskvårdsbidrag.

  • Du har möjlighet till semester- och pensionsväxling.

  • Vi har en aktiv personalförening där du kan hyra stugor i fjällen och i skärgården. Du kan också delta i olika aktiviteter som till exempel padel, kajak och ridning.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och använder en kompetensbaserad rekryteringsmetod för en rättvis och objektiv bedömning. Mångfald är en tillgång, och vi välkomnar alla sökande. Nynäshamns kommun har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet och ersatt det med urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Svaren i urvalsfrågorna och CV ligger till grund för om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i processen.

Vissa tjänster kan kräva utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

title: Snowmaker
description:
Nighttime Snowmaker Job Summary

Operate and maintain snow guns, hoses, hydrants, and pumps to create manufactured snow from pressurized water sources. Night-time Snowmakers with experience are preferred.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Produce quality snow through the use of both air/water and fan equipment.
  • Relocate snow guns and hoses as needed to various areas around the mountain.
  • Adjust snow guns to maintain snowmaking efficiency; keep hoses on top of the snow.
  • Perform upkeep and repair of snow guns, pumps, snow machines and ATVs.
  • Remove snow around snowmaking equipment and other areas at the resort.
  • Assist installing snowmaking pipelines, hydrants, towers, and snow-guns.
  • Work safely near heavy equipment, high voltage, and high water pressure systems.
  • Perform other duties as assigned while waiting for snowmaking conditions.
  • Keep the workshop a clean and functional working environment.
  • Organize and maintain shop tools, and keep shop equipment in good repair.
  • Report and record any service work needed or performed on equipment.
  • Drive ATVs or snowmobiles on the ski hill as necessary, following proper driving protocols.
  • Drive snow machines to move snow guns with owner or manager approval.
  • Perform other tasks for Maintenance or Lift Operations, or as assigned by a manager.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, Abilities)

  • On-site training for snowmaking operations provided. Must be eager to learn and willing to follow instructions.
  • Prior mechanical/technological experience preferred.
  • Able to work independently with little to no supervision.
  • Willing and able to follow company procedures for risk mitigation in the workplace.
  • Able to communicate clearly in-person and using 2-way radios.
  • Has reliable transportation, and can work nights.

Core Competencies

  • Adaptability: Adapts well to changing work priorities and team needs.
  • Teamwork: Able to interact with team members effectively to complete snow making goals.
  • Decision Making: Use sound judgment to make good decisions. Respectfully asks clarifying questions to increase understanding and reduce risk.
  • Reliability: consistently arrives on time, prepared, and as scheduled.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to regulate body temperature and keep warm in winter weather and adverse conditions.
  • Must be physically fit and able to lift up to 100 lbs.
  • Must be able to work in an environment that is occasionally very loud.
  • Must be agile and able to climb on and off towers and vehicles frequently.
  • Must be able to use hands and fingers to manipulate frozen machinery.
  • Must be able to hike on steep snow and ice covered terrain.
  • Must be able to stand, bend, climb, lift, reach, push and pull repetitively.
  • Must be mentally attentive and focused at all times.
  • Should enjoy beautiful, starry nights and hiking around an amazing place while performing meaningful work.

Requirements

Shift Requirements:

  • Hours may be long with frequent 12 hour shifts.
  • Shifts are sometimes 7 days a week during peak snowmaking season.
  • Expect to work overnight shifts.
  • Expect to work weekend and holiday shifts as needed.

Age Requirements:

  • Applicants must be at least age 18.

Other Requirements:

  • Applicants must have a valid driver's license to operate ATVs, snowmobiles, or other vehicles.
  • Snow machines operators require prior training & expert level experience.

title: Principal FPGA/Prototype Design engineer
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

We are seeking a Principal FPGA/Prototype Design engineer to work in conjunction with the Design Validation team to ensure our ASIC designs are fully validated. You partner with design, verification, and software teams to accelerate software development, enable early hardware integration, and support post-silicon bring up. Your work directly supports Blue Origin's mission of enabling millions of people to live and work in space for the benefit of Earth.


Key Responsibilities:


• Develop and maintain ASIC to FPGA retargeting flows, including resource constraints, clock rate reductions, and memory retargeting.

• Deliver FPGA prototype platforms covering multiple design configurations, top levels, and release qualification.

• Qualify commercial emulation platforms for release and assess test case compatibility and coverage partitioning against simulation.

• Reproduce and debug prototype and emulation failures with design and verification teams through resolution.

• Build portable platform environments spanning block and top level, RTL and gate, pre-silicon and silicon.

• Support post-silicon bring up using shared pre-silicon bench and simulation platforms.

• Accelerate software development and early hardware integration through prototype releases and documented feature limitations.

• Support internal platform users through triage, documentation, and direct technical assistance.


Basic Qualifications:


• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• 10+ years of experience in FPGA prototyping, emulation, or digital design verification.

• Experience with FPGA implementation tools and flows, including synthesis, constraints, and timing closure.

• Experience developing and debugging production RTL in System Verilog or Verilog authored by others.

• Experience defining FPGA prototype or emulation flows, including build automation and release management.


Preferred Qualifications:


• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Experience with emulation platforms supporting large scale SoC validation and release.

• Background in space-based communications, wireless communications, modem, baseband, or DSP hardware.

• Experience verifying LDPC, FEC, framing, or beamforming logic using bit-accurate reference models.

• Experience with interconnect or NoC verification covering performance, bandwidth, QoS, and deadlock analysis.

• Experience verifying fault tolerance features such as ECC, redundancy schemes, or fault injection.

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Candidates may be subject to verification and BGS screening as per applicable law.

title: Director of Applied AI Engineering
description:
Director of Applied AI Engineering

North - Remote (US)


Let’s go North, together.


Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. From credit card processing to back-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions.


Job Summary:

The Director of Applied AI Engineering will build and lead North's Applied AI team: a hands-on group that takes AI capabilities from prototype to production inside real business workflows. This is a delivery role, not a research role, measured by systems that are live, adopted, and safe to run in a regulated financial services environment. This will require an individual with strong software engineering fundamentals, judgment about where large language models and machine learning outperform conventional automation, attention to detail, and the capacity to rapidly develop and act upon in-depth knowledge of our business, products, customers, and regulatory obligations.


This position will partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Risk to improve current business processes, and will work with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Information Security to ensure AI systems are explainable, auditable, and safely governed. This role is responsible for providing updates to leadership on the team's impact through clear reporting and KPIs, and for establishing the long-term strategy, technical architecture, and responsible-AI guardrails as well as the short-term scope and sequencing that gets value into production quickly.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Build and lead a high-performing Applied AI engineering team, defining the practice's operating model, engagement strategy, and technical standards from the ground up.
  • Partner with Product, customers, and business stakeholders to observe workflows and turn operational challenges into effective AI solutions.
  • Drive rapid discovery, prototyping, and seamless transition of AI capabilities to production across concurrent enterprise projects.
  • Architect, deploy, and maintain production AI solutions, including agentic workflows, chatbots, copilots, agent-assist tools, and traditional ML models.
  • Establish modular, reusable integrations for AI agents to securely access internal systems and enterprise data with least-privilege controls.
  • Own the AI evaluation lifecycle, incorporating offline/online evals, benchmark datasets, human-in-the-loop validation, and production readiness criteria.
  • Manage production operations alongside Cloud and Data engineering, overseeing CI/CD, monitoring, incident response, latency, and inference cost optimization.

What We Need From You:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning, or a related domain, including time in a customer-facing or business-embedded engineering capacity (ex. forward deployed, solutions, or professional services engineering)
  • 2+ years building and shipping production systems on top of large language models (LLMs), including at least one agentic or conversational system live with real users
  • 4+ years of hands-on management experience with a track record of hiring and growing teams as well as providing coaching and mentoring
  • Exceptional leadership skills, and proven ability to operate in a fast-moving environment
  • Hands-on approach to closing gaps in technical execution, able to personally debug a misbehaving agent in production

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Demonstrated problem-solving and executive-level communication skills, bridging technical teams and leadership seamlessly.
  • Hands-on expertise in code-level AI SDKs and agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, AWS Strands Agents), selecting optimal tools rather than relying on no-code builders.
  • Knowledge of core building blocks of production AI applications: tool/function calling, RAG, vector search, structured outputs, conversation and state management, and the judgment to favor deterministic workflows when appropriate.
  • Cloud engineering skills (preferably AWS), including deploying agents on managed services (e.g., Bedrock AgentCore), containers, IAM, networking, and cost optimization.
  • Track record deploying and maintaining production AI systems, driving robust CI/CD, tracing, incident response, and latency/cost controls.
  • Experience making evaluation part of the build cycle, including test sets, regression testing, human review, and measuring quality once systems are live
  • Grasp of AI security and guardrails (prompt injection defense, least-privilege access, audit trails, and human-in-the-loop design) aligned with financial regulations (Model Risk Management, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA).

What we offer:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a life well lived, both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include:

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 401(k) + Match
  • Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program
  • Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Education Assistance
  • Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account

Salary Range: $207,000-290,000 USD

Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.


Please note: North is a US-based company and no sponsorship is available for this position at this time.


Who we are:

North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award-winning, hands-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else.


Let’s go North, together! Our most important resource is our people. Join our diverse team of innovators and do-ers and make your mark on the future of payments technology. We're proud to offer benefits that help our team members further their overall well-being through unique initiatives that are both personally and professionally fulfilling.


At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal opportunity employer.

As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated professional with hands-on experience in Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and Adobe Campaign Classic v8 (ACC v8) to support customer engagement and marketing campaign operations. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical skills, a solid understanding of data structures, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and high-quality campaigns.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, test, and execute campaigns using Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and Adobe Campaign Classic v8 (ACC v8).
  • Understand campaign requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Work closely with Marketing, Product, Audience, Analytics, QA, and Development teams to ensure successful campaign delivery.
  • Analyze and validate data sources, audience segments, schemas, and data structures before campaign execution.
  • Review and validate database tables, relationships, joins, and customer attributes to ensure data accuracy.
  • Troubleshoot campaign, audience, and workflow-related issues and coordinate with multiple teams for resolution.
  • Perform end-to-end validation of campaigns, customer journeys, audiences, personalization logic, and delivery results.
  • Monitor campaign performance and identify areas for process improvement and automation.
  • Ensure compliance with campaign governance, data quality standards, and operational best practices.
  • Participate in requirement discussions, stakeholder meetings, and project planning activities.

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO).
  • Experience working with Adobe Campaign Classic v8 (ACC v8).
  • Good understanding of customer journeys, campaign workflows, and audience management.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases and SQL queries.
  • Ability to understand and validate data models, schemas, tables, keys, and data relationships.
  • Experience troubleshooting campaign execution, audience qualification, and delivery issues.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) is an added advantage.
  • Knowledge of campaign testing, QA processes, and validation methodologies.

Functional Skills

  • Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into technical solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple cross-functional teams and manage dependencies.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced campaign operations environment.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in Marketing Technology, Campaign Operations, CRM, or Customer Engagement Platforms.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP).
  • Exposure to customer data platforms and audience activation.
  • Understanding of Email, Push Notification, SMS, and Omni-channel campaign execution.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies and project collaboration tools.

Key Competencies

  • Campaign Execution
  • Data Validation & Analysis
  • Stakeholder Coordination
  • Problem Solving
  • Communication Skills
  • Customer Journey Management
  • Attention to Detail

title: Technical Specialist
description:
About Us

ACSI is a trusted cyber resilience partner helping organizations prevent, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats. As Taiwan's first publicly listed MSSP and a member of the Acer Group, we bring over two decades of expertise in cybersecurity services, security operations, digital forensics, cloud security, OT security, and compliance management.

With a mission to secure digital transformation and build lasting cyber resilience, ACSI empowers businesses across government, finance, healthcare, manufacturing, and critical infrastructure sectors. Join us to help shape the future of cybersecurity and create real impact in a rapidly evolving digital world.


About the Role

At ACSI, a managed cybersecurity services vendor, you're the technical face of the partnerships we build with customers. As a Technical Specialist, you'll work alongside our sales team to understand each customer's security challenges, bring our solutions to life through demos and hands-on delivery, and help make sure every engagement ends in real, lasting value for the client. This role is built for someone ready to manage their own tasks and projects with confidence, keep learning, and grow into a technical representative our customers can count on.


Key Responsibility

  • Own and manage assigned products, technologies, and solutions, becoming the technical expert and primary point of contact.

  • Work closely with the Sales team and business partners to develop technical strategies, provide technical consultation, and proactively drive opportunities that help win new business.

  • Understand customer business and technical requirements, identify their challenges, and recommend the most suitable solutions to address their needs.

  • Design solution architecture and prepare technical proposals, solution designs, and implementation plans.

  • Plan and conduct product demonstrations, Proof of Concept (PoC), and technical presentations that address customer pain points, validate the proposed solution, and increase the likelihood of winning the project.

  • Manage and coordinate solution delivery to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and meet customer expectations.

  • Prepare and provide technical support for customers after project delivery, including troubleshooting, issue resolution, and technical consultation.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, implementation guides, standard procedures, and best practices for assigned solutions whenever documentation is required to support the project and operations.

  • Deliver technical training and knowledge sharing for internal teams, partners, and customers.

  • Monitor technology trends and competitor solutions, and recommend improvements to strengthen our products and solutions.

  • Work closely with vendors and headquarters on technical issues, product updates, and product roadmaps, while maintaining strong technical relationships with customers and business partners.

  • Stay current with cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, and vendor/product updates

  • Travel as required to support customers, partners, and project activities across assigned regions.


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in pre-sales consulting, project management, IT Infrastructure and/or Cybersecurity field. With Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Vulnerability Assessment (VA), and Security Log Review and Analysis is a plus.

  • Experience of Root-cause Analysis and Complex Problem Solving in IT System and Security.

  • Knowledge operation of End-point Security, Network Security, System Administration (Windows and Liunx), and enterprise system such as Active Directory.

  • Knowledge concept of Business Intelligence, Computer Programming, Virtualization Technology, High-Availability, and Backup/Restore.

  • B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent, Security Profession Certification is a plus.

  • Fluent English communication

title: Svejser til MIG og MAG i København SV
description:
Vil du have firmabil, bonusordning og godt socialt sammenhold?

Vi mangler en svejser til erhvervsopgaver i København SV.

Du lander i et større setup, hvor svejsearbejdet ligger på erhvervssiden. Rollen er selvstændig, så du skal kunne tage ansvar for dine egne opgaver og sige til, hvis noget ikke stemmer. Der er firmabil med i pakken, og kulturen læner sig op ad et enkelt princip: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Det her er for dig, der kan lide at arbejde roligt og ordentligt, uden at nogen står og kigger dig over skulderen hele dagen. Du får frihed i hverdagen, men også et socialt sammenhold omkring dig, når arbejdsdagen samler folk igen. Bonusordningen gør også, at en god indsats kan mærkes.

Det får du

Løn: 200-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: København SV og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Sveisning, erhvervsopgaver og selvstændigt ansvar

Din hverdag

Du får svejseopgaverne udleveret og arbejder dig igennem dem med ro, orden og faglighed. Når en opgave kræver ekstra afklaring, siger du til, før du går videre. Det vigtigste er, at arbejdet bliver lavet ordentligt første gang.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • MIG, MAG og MMA svejsning
  • Svejsning i sort stål eller rustfrit
  • Svejsning efter tegning eller aftalt opgave
  • Tilpasning og samling af emner
  • Kontrol af dit eget svejsearbejde

Mottoet her er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Stemningen skal være ordentlig, og du bliver en del af et sted, hvor godt socialt sammenhold ikke bare er noget man skriver i et opslag.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Vi forventer ikke at du har lavet det hele før. Men du skal kunne se en opgave og tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som svejser
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og holde styr på dine opgaver
  • Har styr på MIG, MAG eller MMA svejsning
  • Møder stabilt og holder dine aftaler
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med erhvervsopgaver før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan levere ordentligt svejsearbejde og trives med frihed i hverdagen.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en svejser mere i København SV, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

title: Associate Director, Business Execution  Lead
description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

The Team

The Chief Client Office engages customers and key stakeholders to drive commercial growth and create measurable value for S&P Global, strengthening client relationships and the overall client experience across the enterprise. The Chief Client Officer also serves as Co Head of Market Intelligence, with a mandate spanning Client Coverage, Enterprise Marketing, Commercial Strategy & Partnerships, Kensho Data & Platforms, and functions including Legal, COO, and Client Experience (CX) with alignment across enterprise Technology.

The Impact

The Business Execution Lead keeps the Office's recurring work moving — gathering inputs and packaging the Weekly Briefing Pack and Analytics packs for the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence, coordinating executive readiness for meetings and events, and responding to ad hoc requests and priority initiatives. This hands-on role gives the Chief of Staff reliable, high-quality execution support and helps the Office run smoothly in a fast-paced, complex environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the Weekly Briefing Pack and the Chief Client Office and Market Intelligence Weekly Analytics packs end-to-end — gathering inputs, compiling and quality controlling materials, and driving continuous improvement.

• Build a clear, forward-looking view of the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence's week — meetings, objectives, context, and preparation needs.

• Translate priorities into clear work plans, milestones, and timelines, driving multiple workstreams simultaneously and building trusted working relationships across the Chief Client Office, Market Intelligence, Kensho Data & Platforms, and other stakeholders — setting clear expectations for quality, timing, and follow-through, and escalating early with clear context, options, and a recommended path forward on matters requiring strategic judgment or sensitive stakeholder management.

• Coordinate readiness for client meetings, speaking engagements, conferences, and leadership events wherever the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence is working or traveling — including London, New York, and other locations — partnering with local offices, the Executive Assistant, and relevant business and functional teams to ensure briefing materials clearly set out context, objectives, stakeholders, decisions required, and expected outcomes.

• Own the Office Stakeholder Matrix and maintain Office calendars, action trackers, and decision logs, giving stakeholders clear visibility into priorities, status, and outstanding requirements.

• Support Chief of Staff-led OpCo meetings, leadership forums, and offsites as requested — including readiness, materials, and action tracking — with increasing ownership as experience grows.

• Continuously improve recurring deliverables and office workflows, building repeatable processes and templates that reduce manual effort and improve consistency and scalability.

• Use AI and automation tools approved by S&P Global to support information gathering, summarization, content development, and quality checking, maintaining sound judgment, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable S&P Global requirements.

• Respond to ad hoc executive requests and support selected cross-functional priority initiatives.

What We're Looking For

• Experience in financial services is strongly preferred, ideally in a client-facing role involving significant interaction with institutional clients and senior stakeholders.

• Proven experience driving execution in an executive office, Chief of Staff organization, PMO, business operations team, or similarly complex environment, with a demonstrated ability to navigate across functions, businesses, geographies, and levels of seniority to build alignment and get things done.

• Demonstrated ability to own recurring executive deliverables end-to-end and produce complete, accurate, executive-ready materials.

• Strong ability to assimilate information, synthesize key themes, identify gaps, and translate fragmented inputs into clear materials.

• Excellent project coordination, organization, written communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, work through ambiguity, meet tight timelines, and maintain attention to detail.

• Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information and executive level matters.

• Comfortable navigating sensitive or difficult topics with stakeholders at all levels, exercising tact, diplomacy, and sound judgment while maintaining trust and confidentiality.

• Experience with Microsoft 365 and AI productivity and workflow automation tools.

• A continuous-improvement mindset, strong personal accountability, and a commitment to proactive communication and follow-through.

• Expected to be in the office whenever the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence is in the office and to comply with the applicable S&P Global in-office attendance policy.

What Success Looks Like

• Executive deliverables are complete, accurate, timely, forward-looking, and ready for use.

• Stakeholders are engaged, routine issues are resolved promptly, and strategic matters are escalated early with clear recommendations.

• Executive engagements and events are consistently well prepared across London, New York, and other locations where the Chief Client Officer & Co-Head of Market Intelligence is working or traveling.

• Commitments, deadlines, dependencies, decisions, and risks remain visible and are followed through to completion.

• Approved technology and AI tools reduce manual effort and improve consistency without compromising judgment, confidentiality, or accuracy.

What’s In It For You?

Our Mission:

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

Our People:

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Our Values:
Integrity, Discovery, Partnership


Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

Benefits:

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.

Our benefits include:

  • Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.

  • Flexible Downtime: Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.

  • Continuous Learning: Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.

  • Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.

  • Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.

  • Beyond the Basics: From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.
