title: CNC-operatør til maskinopsætning i Sønderborg
description:
Er du CNC-operatør og vil du have frihed under ansvar og ordnede forhold?

Her får du fast arbejde i Sønderborg med alsidige opgaver i produktionen.

Du lander i en større produktionsvirksomhed, hvor der bliver lavet tekniske løsninger til industriel materialehåndtering. Arbejdet foregår i Sønderborg, så du har en fast ramme omkring dagen. Produktionen hænger tæt sammen med teknisk design og engineering, og det stiller krav til præcision ved maskinen. Folk bliver hængende her, så du lander i et hold der kender hinanden.

Rollen passer til dig, der kan arbejde selvstændigt og holde hovedet koldt, når maskinen skal stilles om eller driften skal følges. Du får ansvar for at holde øje med kvaliteten undervejs, ikke først når emnet er færdigt. Det er et job for dig, der kan lide produktion med struktur, men stadig vil have variation i hverdagen.

Det får du

Løn: 200-230 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Sønderborg og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: CNC-drift, opsætning og kvalitetskontrol

Din hverdag

Dagen veksler mellem at starte maskiner op, følge driften og lave målinger undervejs. Når en maskine skal omstilles, tager du fat i opsætningen og sørger for, at produktionen kører videre på et ordentligt grundlag. Du har frihed under ansvar, men kvaliteten skal kunne holde hele vejen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Overvåger drift og reagerer, hvis noget ikke kører som det skal
  • Sætter maskiner op og starter produktionen sikkert op
  • Måler emner og laver kvalitetskontrol undervejs
  • Omstiller maskiner og håndterer materialer i produktionen

Her handler det ikke om at løbe stærkest, men om at arbejde stabilt og grundigt. Hvis en måling ikke passer, siger du til med det samme, så fejlen bliver taget, før den bliver dyr.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for det du sætter i gang.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring med CNC-drift eller maskinbetjening
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt ved maskinen
  • Er grundig med måling og kvalitetskontrol
  • Møder stabilt og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet maskinopsætning, opstart eller omstilling før. Men det vigtigste er, at du tager produktionen seriøst og afleverer noget der kan bruges.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en CNC-operatør mere i Sønderborg, og det kunne sagtens være dig.



Drift og overvågning, Maskinopsætning og opstart, Måling og kvalitetskontrol, Omstilling og materialehåndtering

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Toronto)
description:
LumApps is now more than just an Employee Experience Platform — it is an AI-powered Employee Hub that supports companies in their digital transformation of communication, collaboration, and engagement with their customers, partners, and above all their employees.

Our platform is a proven leader in this dynamic market with a truly unique vision and product. It has been deployed by Fortune 500 clients around the world and is delivering meaningful business benefits. LumApps is identified as a leader in Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Intranet Packaged Solutions as well as in Intranets Forrester Wave, and regularly selected for the French Tech Next40/120 program.

✨ In 2025, LumApps strengthened its leadership position by partnering with Beekeeper, a pioneer in frontline employee experience solutions. This strategic collaboration expands our reach and impact across all types of workers — from HQ to the frontline.

Our mission: To make people feel that they belong and have a purpose.

To create an environment where all employees are engaged and work together towards the same goal. Over 700 leading companies trust our solution to:

🎯 Improve the productivity of their teams with our AI-powered Collaborative Experience Platform integrated with both Google and Microsoft collaborative suites,

🎯 Transform employees into real ambassadors of their company,

🎯 Make employees more efficient and better connected to their peers and relevant information, regardless of their location, with the tools and information they need at their fingertips,

🎯 Help companies reduce turnover, accelerate employee onboarding, better collaborate and share knowledge, and even improve their customer experiences.

With a team of over 600 Lumies spread across 11 offices (Lyon, Paris, Lille, Sophia Antipolis, London, Barcelona, Hamburg, Austin, Tokyo, Zurich, Krakow), we support large enterprises all around the world. Over the past year, we have been driving an ambitious phase in our journey under the impulse of our new shareholder Bridgepoint, aimed at propelling us to become the clear leader in our market and shine worldwide in our industry. We are looking for individuals who are excited to actively participate in this transformation.

If these core values sound like you: "be bold, do amazing things", "say what you mean, do what you say", "one team, same mission", "always be evolving": apply now!

*The Enterprise AI Challenge*

While the market focuses on Generative AI prototypes, the true challenge for global enterprises lies in production and scale. Generic AI models often fail because they lack context and cannot securely access siloed enterprise data like ERPs, HRIS, or legacy systems.

LumApps AI is a high-velocity initiative focused on solving this "Last Mile Integration" problem. We are the bridge between our core platform and customer value. We don’t just license a platform; we deploy top engineering talent to the front lines to ensure AI becomes a secure, deeply integrated, and scalable force multiplier for the modern workforce.

*The Role*

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are the "tip of the spear" for our most strategic initiative. You will solve hard technical truths on the ground, accelerating the adoption of our core AI technologies: Micro-Apps and Agents.

You will sit at the intersection of engineering and customer impact, navigating technical constraints to deploy live, ROI-generating AI Agents within rapid cycles. This is a rare opportunity to accelerate your career by working with senior leadership and opening doors toward future roles as an architect, tech lead, or product manager.

Candidates must be located in the Greater Toronto Area to be considered. The salary range associated with this position is $160K - $190K CAD.

*Missions*

  • Strategic Co-Innovation: Embed with customers to map complex data environments and identify high-friction business workflows, such as HR onboarding or IT support.

  • Rapid Prototyping & Delivery: Build proof-of-concept AI Agents and integrations using APIs, webhooks, and LLMs that plan, decide, and act within the LumApps ecosystem.

  • Enterprise Integration: Architect the middleware and custom connectors required to bridge LumApps with systems like SAP, Workday, or ServiceNow.

  • Field Feedback Loop: Act as the trailblazer for our Core R&D team. You will identify systemic integration patterns in the field and contribute code to harden and evolve our core platform, as well as abstract your custom solutions into scalable, repeatable "Industry Vertical Packs."

*Skills*

  • Bring 6+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, with demonstrated excellence in analytical thinking and software development.

  • Get-it-done Mindset: A strong bias for action and the ability to self-prioritize in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

  • Full-Stack Fluency: Proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, Java or Python. You should be comfortable with frontend frameworks like React and backend API design.

  • Innovation Curiosity: A passion for emerging tech, specifically Generative AI, RAG architecture, AI Frameworks and Agentic workflows.

  • Communication: Full professional proficiency in English to communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customers.

  • Availability to Travel: Willingness to travel for regular on-site workshops with customers across North America.

*Bonus Skills*

  • Consultant Mindset: Experience working directly with customers, understanding their needs and designing high-value solutions to fulfill their expectations

  • Agile Experience: Experience working in Scrum environments.

  • Security Knowledge: Understanding of enterprise identity frameworks like OICD, OAuth 2.0 or SAML.

  • Professional Fluency: Bilingual in English and French.

💡 Why You’ll Love Working at LumApps

At LumApps, we believe in fostering an environment where every team member feels valued, supported, and empowered to thrive. Here's a glimpse of what we offer:

🏖️ Generous Paid Leave – 25 vacation days (prorated based on hire date), 9 sick days, 10 paid holidays, plus 2 floating holidays

🏥 Health Insurance – United Healthcare, 100% employer-paid benefits from day 1

💰 401k Retirement Plan – We match 100% of your contribution up to 4%

👶 Family-Friendly Policy – Inclusive maternity & paternity leave

🎉 Team Celebrations & Seasonal Events – Because culture matters

💻 Equipment of Your Choice – We provide you with a laptop

Vi söker dig som trivs med både självständigt arbete och samarbete med kollegor. Du är strukturerad, noggrann och har ett starkt kvalitetsfokus. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och bidrar med ett positivt och serviceinriktat förhållningssätt.

Our two major business lines are as a Medical Device Outsourcer (including the businesses of Cardiac & Vascular, Cardiac Rhythm Management & Neuromodulation, and Power Solutions) and a provider of high-end, niche batteries (the business of Electrochem) for specialized applications in the energy, military, and environmental markets. We are guided by our six values, including Customer, Innovation, Collaboration, Inclusion, Candor, and Integrity. Working at Integer means you are part of a team passionately pursuing excellence in all that we do and always reaching for the next great achievement.

What you will do in this role:

The primary purpose of this role is to provide support to the manufacturing team in achieving its production goals and customer quality requirements. This includes monitoring and escalating any issues to the production supervisor, engaging the team, helping drive to continuous improvement within the area, and performing supporting tasks to allow the operators to focus on their main tasks.

  • Adhere to Integer’s Values and all safety, environmental, security and quality requirements including, but not limited to: Quality Management Systems (QMS), Safety, Environmental and Security Management Systems, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, company policies and operating procedures, and other regulatory requirements.

  • Act as a liaison between team members and the production supervisor to align resources and support associates in the most efficient and effective manner to achieve Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and Inventory, and People performance goals.

  • Perform audits including 5S, Safety, Quality, and Standardized Work to ensure associates adhere to Integer policies and procedures.

  • Support the team by walking the floor, addressing questions, resolving issues, and escalating concerns to the Supervisor or appropriate support team member.

  • Participate in workshops focused on continuous improvement of current processes and new product development programs.

  • Leading morning huddles and communicates with associates.

  • Actively listen and seek opportunities to engage team members in structured problem solving to identify countermeasures, resolve issues, and make improvements in the area.

  • Have working knowledge of jobs and equipment to step-in for emergencies and implement countermeasures.

  • Coordinate cross-training plans for associates.

  • Promote an environment of diversity, inclusion, open communication and trust.

  • Coordinate shift change discussions; identifies resource needs and alignment; collects data for production boards.

  • Participate in daily production board meetings, explains area performance results, and identifies causes of misses. Creates shift summaries/logs for next shift to ensure smooth transition.

  • Work in conjunction with Supervisor and production planning to follow production schedules and assign staff to jobs based on training and experience.

  • Performs other duties as required.

How you will be measured:

  • Assist the manufacturing team in achieving its annual goals for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and inventory

  • People – Supports engagement initiatives of the team. Communicates with tact and diplomacy to exchange ideas.

What sets you apart:

  • High School diploma or equivalent (e.g. GED)

  • Associate degree in a Technical or Business-related field, preferred

Minimum Experience:

  • Experience and proven capability in performing all the jobs in the area being supported

Specialized Knowledge & Special Skills:

  • Ability to motivate others

  • Possess the spirit of teamwork and cooperation and the desire to lead

  • Passion for excellence

  • Action orientation

  • Possess good written and oral communication skills

  • Experience and comfort using computers.




Salary $23.80- $34.90




Our total rewards program is designed to attract, retain, and motivate associates to contribute to Integer’s success. Our compensation program includes base wages, a cash-based incentive program supporting our pay-for-performance philosophy, overtime pay, shift differentials, and call-in pay, when applicable. We provide a comprehensive benefits package with immediate eligibility including medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and adoption benefits. Parental leave is available after one year. Optional employee-paid programs include supplemental life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity and accident insurance. Employees are immediately eligible to participate in the 401(k) plan with company matching contributions. We provide 80 hours (10 days) of company designated holidays per year plus an annual allotment of paid time off.

title: Leasing Professional - The 305
location: The 305, A Broadstone Community, Waltham, MA
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.


Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

#LI-SD1

The hourly range for this position is $23.00 - $25.00.


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

title: Software Engineer - Colorado Springs, CO
description:
Davidson is distinguished in the aerospace and missile defense industry, in part, because of its excellence in hiring exceptional experts, engineers and software developers dedicated to delivering advanced, intelligent technology solutions in defense of our nation.

Davidson is seeking a Software Engineer in Colorado Springs, CO.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, integrate, test, debug, and maintain software supporting modeling and simulation applications.
  • Develop high-quality software using C++, Python, Java, C#, or other appropriate programming languages.
  • Analyze technical requirements and translate them into maintainable software designs and implementation plans.
  • Support the development and integration of high-fidelity modeling and simulation capabilities.
  • Develop software components used to model threat systems, missile trajectories, sensors, engagements, and related mission scenarios.
  • Perform software verification and validation activities, including unit, integration, regression, and system-level testing.
  • Develop automated test scripts and tools to improve software quality and development efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot complex software issues and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to software development standards and best practices.
  • Work with Linux-based development environments and modern software development toolchains.
  • Utilize Git-based version control and contribute to automated build, test, and deployment processes.
  • Support Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and automated software testing.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, software designs, test documentation, and user documentation.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate closely with systems engineers, test engineers, modeling and simulation engineers, analysts, and government customers.
  • Support requirements analysis, traceability, verification, and validation activities as needed.
  • Analyze simulation results and assist in identifying discrepancies, performance issues, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support software integration activities across multiple development teams and simulation components.
  • Provide technical recommendations and contribute to architecture and design decisions.
  • Assist with deployment, configuration, maintenance, and sustainment of software in both development and operational environments.
  • Support customer demonstrations, technical briefings, and program reviews when required.
  • Work effectively with minimal supervision while maintaining schedule, quality, and technical objectives.

Support other software engineering and program activities as assigned:

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Software Engineering.
  • 4+ years of relevant software development experience
  • Experience with C++, C#, and Python programming.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum, Kanban or SAFe environment
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Ability to collaboratively work on product requirements.

Desired Competencies:

  • Experience with military modeling and simulation (M&S) applications.
  • Experience supporting Missile Defense Agency (MDA), Space Force, Air Force, Army, Navy, or other DoD programs.
  • Experience with missile defense, missile warning, command and control, sensor systems, or related defense technologies.
  • Experience with high-fidelity simulation environments or discrete-event simulation frameworks.
  • Experience with Python scripting and automation for data processing, testing, or analysis.
  • Experience with MATLAB or other engineering analysis tools.
  • Experience developing or integrating REST APIs, microservices, or distributed applications.
  • Experience working within a classified development environment.

Clearance Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain an active DoD Secret Clearance.

title: Lantbruksdjursrådgivare inom nöt och mjölk
description:
Vill du arbeta nära lantbrukare och bidra till utvecklingen av hållbar nöt- och mjölkproduktion? Nu söker vi en engagerad rådgivare till vårt team.

Hos oss får du en varierad rådgivarroll där produktion, djurvälfärd och affärsutveckling möts. Du arbetar nära kunderna i frågor som rör nöt- och mjölkproduktion och blir en del av ett engagerat team med bred kompetens inom lantbruk. Ditt geografiska arbetsområde kommer främst att vara i mellan- och norra Skåne. Här får du möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad i lantbrukets vardag tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och företagare i regionen.

Om oss

HIR Skåne är ett oberoende rådgivningsföretag. Hos oss finns samlad kompetens inom lantbruk och hortikultur, med flerårig erfarenhet av att arbeta nära företagare och deras verkliga förutsättningar.

Vår verksamhet bygger på personlig rådgivning och affärsnära dialoger där målet är att bidra till långsiktigt lönsamma företag. Som kunskapsorganisation har vi ett tydligt fokus på att omsätta kunskap till praktisk nytta och utveckla svenskt lantbruk genom rådgivning som gör skillnad i vardagen.

Om rollen

Som lantbruksdjursrådgivare hos oss får du en varierad och utvecklande roll med nära kontakt med lantbruksföretagare. Du arbetar främst med rådgivning inom nöt- och mjölkproduktion och hjälper kunder att utveckla hållbara och lönsamma verksamheter.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • arbeta med produktionsrådgivning inom nöt- och mjölkproduktion
  • stötta kunder inom management, djurvälfärd och stallmiljö
  • analysera och följa upp produktionsresultat
  • bidra med rådgivning kring foder, produktion och utvecklingsarbete
  • bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och bidra till affärsutveckling
  • medverka vid kundträffar, utbildningar och andra aktiviteter
  • samarbeta med kollegor inom exempelvis ekonomi, växtodling och företagsrådgivning

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har utbildning inom animalieproduktion och trivs i en rådgivande roll med nära kundkontakt. Du har ett intresse för nöt- och mjölkproduktion och gillar att arbeta lösningsorienterat tillsammans med lantbrukare.

Kvalifikationer:

  • husdjursagronomexamen eller annan relevant akademisk utbildning med inriktning mot animalieproduktion
  • erfarenhet av arbete inom animalieområdet, exempelvis rådgivning, utvecklingsarbete eller försäljning
  • god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska
  • B-kört och tillgång till bil

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

  • rådgivande arbete inom lantbruk
  • mjölk- eller nötköttsproduktion
  • projektledning eller affärsutveckling inom lantbruk

Som person är du engagerad, självgående och har lätt för att skapa förtroende. Du trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra och uppskattar en varierad arbetsvardag med både kundbesök och kontorsarbete.

Förmåner

• Tjänstepension och villkor enligt kollektivavtal.

• Friskvårdsbidrag och företagshälsovård.

• Trivselaktiviteter och gemensam frukost.

Praktisk information

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning

Omfattning: 100%

Placeringsort: Skepparslöv. Vi har även kontor i Borgeby, Hörby, Borrby och Munka Ljungby, där du kommer att vara ibland.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Låter det som din nästa utmaning? Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast den 1 november.

title: VVS-montør til service og spjæld i Vordingborg
description:
Er du VVS-montør og vil du have firmabil og frihed under ansvar?

Vi mangler en VVS-montør til spjæld og service i Vordingborg.

Du bliver en del af et VVS-hold på cirka 10 ansatte, hvor service og spjæld fylder hverdagen. Kunderne er både private og erhverv, så du møder alt fra planlagte eftersyn til opgaver der skal løses hurtigt. Pladserne ligger i Vordingborg og omegn, og du kører selv ud til kunderne.

Rollen passer til dig, der gerne vil have styring over din egen dag. Du får frihed under ansvar, firmabil og en løn der ligger på 240-255 kr. i timen. Det er servicearbejde, hvor erfaring og ro i kroppen betyder mere end at nogen står og kigger dig over skulderen.

Det får du

Løn: 240-255 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Vordingborg og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 10 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Service, spjæld og selvstændig planlægning

Din hverdag

Opgaverne er service- og spjældopgaver, hvor du lægger rækkefølgen ud fra aftaler og hastesager. Firmabilen er en del af setup'et, og du bruger din erfaring til at vurdere om en opgave kan klares med det samme eller skal meldes videre.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Løser spjæld og service hos private og erhvervskunder
  • Fejlfinder på VVS-installationer
  • Servicerer varmeinstallationer
  • Monterer sanitet og mindre VVS-løsninger
  • Tager mindre afløbsopgaver

Aftaler skal holde, og kunden skal vide hvad der sker før arbejdet går i gang. Hvis noget ændrer sig, melder du det videre i stedet for at lade kunden gætte.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 4 års erfaring som VVS-montør
  • Har kørekort og kan køre selv ud til kunderne
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt uden at miste overblikket
  • Møder stabilt og holder dine aftaler
  • Taler ordentligt med både private og erhvervskunder

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med service, spjæld, varme eller sanitet før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide en hverdag, hvor du selv tager styringen.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

title: Project Mgr
description:
GROW YOUR CAREER WITH US
At Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH), we know our future success depends on our ability to attract and retain the very best talent. Our brands deliver vacations of a lifetime with innovative product offerings, a high level of service and unique guest experiences aboard each vessel and we’re continually seeking applicants who are passionate about hospitality and committed to being their personal best. As you learn more about our company, we think you will agree that there is no better time than now to become a member of the NCLH family!

APPLY ONLINE
If you’re interested to be considered for this position, please click the blue APPLY button at the top of the page to get started. All candidates must complete an on-line application to be considered.

JOB SUMMARY

The Project Manager, Product Engineering is accountable for the delivery outcome of assigned initiatives within the GTO Product Engineering PMO. This role partners closely with Product Engineering leadership to drive the successful delivery of prioritized initiatives across key platforms, including web, mobile, reservation systems, CRM, data warehouse, and marketing technology. This is an execution-facing role: drive predictable delivery, clear roadblocks personally, and push projects across the finish line rather than document project history. Initiatives are frequently delivered across multiple brands, including Norwegian Cruise Line, Oceania Cruises, and Regent Seven Seas Cruises.

Reporting to the Director of the Product Engineering PMO, this position operates within the standards, governance, and reporting frameworks established by the GTO Center of Excellence, including the L-gate lifecycle, capital approval process, and Portfolio Operations Review cadence. The Project Manager leads cross-functional teams through influence rather than direct reporting authority, treats the PMO as an enablement function, and is personally accountable for the accuracy and candor of the project's reported position.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and manage projects supporting Product Engineering initiatives across multiple technology domains, owning the delivery outcome end to end from intake through planning, execution, testing, deployment, hypercare, and closure. Accountability is for the result, not the status trail.
  • Partner with Product Engineering leadership on planning, prioritization, and execution of product roadmaps and enhancements, and build and maintain the project plan covering scope, schedule, milestones, resourcing, dependencies, and critical path through the GTO L-gate lifecycle.
  • When a milestone slips or a dependency is blocked, secure a firm commitment directly from the owner by phone or targeted working session, then use writing to document the agreement rather than to request it.
  • Interrogate status rather than accept it: understand the technical footprint of the work, test estimates and schedule buffers, and dig into dependencies, environments, and infrastructure until any blocker can be explained without relying on someone else's summary.
  • Act on risks, requirement changes, and unmapped dependencies the day they surface rather than deferring to the next standup or status meeting.
  • Close every meeting with a documented action matrix of owner, deliverable, and due date, and follow up ahead of each due date to surface friction early.
  • Manage scope through formal change control, and own the risk, issue, dependency, action, and decision logs, escalating promptly with a recommended path when resolution stalls.
  • Report health with high fidelity and without narrative padding: what is blocked, what is impacted, what corrective action is underway, and what decision or escalation is required. Never present a red condition as yellow.
  • Own project financials, including capital and operating expense forecasting, actuals and accruals, variance analysis, and reforecast with Finance, and track requisitions, purchase orders, and vendor spend against approved funding.
  • Hold vendors and systems integrators to their commitments, including deliverable acceptance, statement of work adherence, and timely escalation of performance issues.
  • Partner with business analysts and process owners to confirm requirements, designs, and acceptance criteria are validated before build, and coordinate test planning, defect triage, user acceptance testing, and go / no-go readiness.
  • Plan and execute deployment and cutover, including readiness checks, rollback planning, communications, and handover to operational support.
  • Serve business partners, delivery teams, and vendors as an enablement function: anticipate constraints, shield them from unnecessary process noise, and keep delivery mapped to strategic priorities, partnering with change management on the engagement, training, and adoption needed to realize benefits.
  • Produce accurate, on-time Portfolio Operations Review reporting and maintain project data in the GTO portfolio tools of record so portfolio and executive reporting is accurate without rework.
  • Close projects cleanly with support transition, benefits baseline, and lessons learned, applying and reinforcing PMO and Center of Excellence standards throughout.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Information Technology, Business Administration, Hotel/Hospitality Management, or related field of study, or an equivalent combination of experience and skills.

EXPERIENCE

  • 5-8 years of project management experience delivering technology projects end to end using waterfall, Agile, and hybrid methodologies, with a significant portion supporting product engineering or technology delivery organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering projects involving web, mobile, reservation systems, CRM, data warehouse, and marketing technology is required.
  • Experience delivering within a structured PMO and stage-gate governance environment, with technical fluency sufficient to challenge estimates, understand dependency and environment constraints, and explain a roadblock to a non-technical audience.
  • Experience owning project financials, including capital and operating expense forecasting, actuals tracking, and variance reporting in partnership with Finance.
  • Experience managing software vendors, implementation partners, or systems integrators against contracted scope and deliverables, and communicating delivery risk directly to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience delivering across more than one technology domain and across multiple brands or business units preferred; travel, hospitality, or cruise industry experience preferred.

COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset: pursues commitments through direct conversation rather than written follow-up alone.
  • Investigative rigor: challenges surface-level status, understands the mechanics behind an estimate or blocker, and asks the difficult question before reporting upward.
  • Bias to action: addresses a risk, requirement change, or new dependency the day it appears.
  • Disciplined follow-up, including documented owner and due-date matrices out of every meeting and proactive check-ins before deadlines arrive.
  • Direct, high-fidelity upward communication: leads with the data, keeps it short, and is willing to call a track red when it is red.
  • Service orientation toward business partners, engineering teams, and vendors, with the instinct to anticipate constraints and remove friction.
  • Financial literacy sufficient to own a project forecast and explain variance and reforecast credibly to Finance and PMO leadership.
  • Strong planning, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects under deadline pressure and create clarity from ambiguity through structure and persistent follow-through.
  • Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Clarity, MS Project, LucidChart, and Microsoft Office Suite, with adaptability across delivery domains.

CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) preferred.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe, or other Agile certification (a plus).
  • Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) (a plus).

ABOUT NCLH
Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) is a leading global cruise company which operates the Norwegian Cruise Line®, Oceania Cruises® and Regent Seven Seas Cruises® brands. The combined brands currently operate 32 ships, employ over 35,000 shipboard crew from more than 110 different countries and visit approximately 700 different port destination each year.

title: Software Engineering & Development, VP
description:
Job Description

Who we are looking for:

The ideal candidate is an experienced technology delivery leader with a strong background in data platforms, reporting applications, cloud technologies, and business intelligence solutions. This individual will serve as the IT Delivery Manager for the Agency Lending Data & Reporting technology portfolio and will lead the delivery of strategic initiatives across data, reporting, analytics, application modernization, and business intelligence.

The successful candidate will have experience delivering enterprise data solutions, cloud migration initiatives, API integrations, and reporting platforms. Experience with Databricks, Oracle data warehouse technologies, AWS and/or Azure, enterprise data warehousing, and business intelligence tools such as Cognos and Power BI is highly desirable.

Why this role is important to us:

Agency Lending is modernizing its data, reporting, and analytics platforms to improve scalability, data quality, operational efficiency, and self-service reporting capabilities. As part of this transformation, State Street is investing in modern cloud-based technologies, enterprise data platforms, and business intelligence solutions to better support client reporting, operational reporting, analytics, and regulatory requirements.

The Agency Lending Data & Reporting team is responsible for delivering trusted data and reporting solutions that support business users, clients, regulators, and downstream applications. Key initiatives include modernizing legacy reporting and Oracle data warehouse platforms, expanding the use of Databricks as the strategic data platform, enabling new business intelligence capabilities, and implementing scalable integration frameworks using APIs and modern data delivery patterns.

The IT Delivery Manager will play a critical role in defining and executing the technology roadmap for Agency Lending data and reporting applications. This role will work in close partnership with the Business leads and SMEs to translate business priorities into actionable technology initiatives, drive delivery execution, and ensure strategic objectives are achieved. The successful candidate will primarily partner with engineering, architecture, data engineering, quality assurance, infrastructure, and technology teams while maintaining alignment with business stakeholders and leadership.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Lead delivery of Agency Lending data, reporting, analytics, and technology initiatives from planning through implementation and production support.
  • Manage project scope, budgets, timelines, resource planning, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
  • Serve as the primary technology delivery lead for the Agency Lending Data & Reporting application portfolio.
  • Prioritize initiatives, align technology investments, manage delivery commitments, and execute the Agency Lending Data & Reporting portfolio strategy.
  • Define and execute the Agency Lending Data & Reporting technology roadmap.
  • Coordinate and lead delivery activities across architecture, engineering, data engineering, QA, infrastructure, cybersecurity, production support, and operations teams.
  • Drive modernization initiatives involving Oracle-based data warehouse solutions, Databricks, reporting platforms, cloud technologies, and enterprise data solutions.
  • Partner with architects and engineers to design scalable data and reporting solutions that support current and future business needs.
  • Support the development of a common reporting framework that enables Cognos, Power BI, and other business intelligence platforms to consume consistent, governed data from Databricks.
  • Lead API integration initiatives between Agency Lending applications and upstream and downstream enterprise platforms.
  • Ensure compliance with State Street technology standards, SDLC processes, operational controls, security requirements, and audit standards.
  • Provide executive-level reporting on program status, risks, milestones, and delivery outcomes.
  • Build, lead, and manage a global team of onshore and offshore technology professionals supporting Agency Lending data and reporting applications.
  • Participate in recruiting, hiring, onboarding, performance management, coaching, and career development activities for technology team members.
  • Establish a high-performing team culture focused on accountability, collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop staffing strategies, resource plans, and organizational capabilities to support current and future business priorities.
  • Partner with vendors and offshore teams to ensure delivery commitments, service levels, and quality standards are consistently achieved.

What we value:

  • Strong technology delivery and program management skills.
  • Experience managing complex initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and globally distributed teams.
  • Ability to establish clear delivery plans and execute against strategic business objectives.
  • Experience delivering enterprise data and reporting solutions.

title: Specialist podpore kupcem
description:
Job Summary

Ali vas veseli usklajevanje naročil, logistike in komunikacije s kupci v mednarodnem okolju, kjer je natančnost ključ do uspeha?

IFF je globalni vodja na področju arom, dišav, živilskih sestavin ter zdravja in bioloških znanosti. Ponašamo se s trajnostnimi inovacijami, ki izboljšujejo vsakodnevne izdelke.


V Global Operations zagotavljamo odličnost pri izvajanju procesov, od nabave do dobavne verige, ter skrbimo za kakovost, varnost, učinkovitost in trajnost v celotni vrednostni verigi.


Delovno mesto se nahaja v Markovcih, Slovenija (delo na lokaciji). Pridružite se izkušeni, natančni in k sodelovanju usmerjeni ekipi, kjer boste s svojim delom prispevali k učinkoviti podpori kupcem, nemotenemu poteku naročil in odlični uporabniški izkušnji. Vaš potencial je naš navdih.


Kje boste naredili razliko


  • Obdelovali bste naročila kupcev ter zagotavljali pravočasno in natančno administrativno podporo procesom podpore kupcem.
  • Sodelovali boste pri pripravi prodajne in odpremne dokumentacije ter izvedbi carinskih postopkov.
  • Organizirali boste transporte s predhodno dogovorjenimi logističnimi partnerji.
  • Usklajevali boste aktivnosti s proizvodnjo, kontrolo kakovosti, nabavo in skladiščem za zagotavljanje nemotenega poteka naročil.
  • Organizirali, naročali in pošiljali boste vzorce ter vodili evidence o poslanih vzorcih.
  • Spremljali boste zaloge in podpirali zagotavljanje ustrezne razpoložljivosti izdelkov.
  • Zagotavljali boste ažurnost, pravilnost in skladnost evidenc ter spremljajoče dokumentacije.
  • Po potrebi boste nadomeščali sodelavce v oddelku podpore kupcem.
  • Skrbeli boste za učinkovito uporabo virov ter sodelovali pri stalnih izboljšavah procesov.

Ste pravi kandidat, če


  • Imate najmanj srednješolsko izobrazbo ekonomske, komercialne ali sorodne smeri.
  • Aktivno uporabljate angleški jezik, najmanj na ravni B2.
  • Dobro poznate Microsoft Office orodja, zlasti Excel in Outlook.
  • Vas odlikujejo natančnost, odgovornost in skrb za kakovost opravljenega dela.
  • Imate razvite organizacijske sposobnosti in znate učinkovito upravljati več nalog hkrati.
  • Uživate v sodelovanju z različnimi oddelki ter delu v timskem okolju.
  • Ste komunikativni in usmerjeni k iskanju rešitev za kupce.
  • Znate samostojno organizirati svoje delo in postavljati prioritete.

Kako boste izstopali?


  • Izkušnje na področju podpore kupcem, logistike ali obdelave naročil.
  • Poznavanje carinske dokumentacije in mednarodnih transportnih procesov.
  • Izkušnje z ERP sistemi ali drugimi poslovnimi informacijskimi sistemi.

Zakaj izbrati nas?


  • Delo v mednarodnem in stabilnem podjetju z globalnim dosegom.
  • Strukturiran proces uvajanja in podpora pri vključevanju v ekipo.
  • Sodelovanje z izkušenimi strokovnjaki iz različnih poslovnih področij.
  • Možnosti za strokovni razvoj in dodatna izobraževanja.
  • Prijetno, sodelovalno in vključujoče delovno okolje.
  • Priložnost za neposreden vpliv na kakovost storitev in zadovoljstvo kupcev.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. title: Junior reservdelshanterare
description:
Vår kund erbjuder en spännande möjlighet för dig med tekniskt intresse att ta ett stort ansvar i en bred roll med fokus på service, logistik och reservdelshantering hos ett väletablerat företag inom livsmedelsbranschen.

Om tjänsten

Som junior reservdelshanterare blir du en nyckelperson i den dagliga driften där du stöttar kunder med reservdelar och servicefrågor. Du arbetar självständigt med allt från orderhantering till leveranskoordinering och har mycket kontakt med internationella leverantörer.Arbetet är förlag vardagar 07-16 och sker på plats på kontoret/lagret alla dagar.

Du erbjuds

  • En roll med ett stort eget ansvar i en trygg arbetsmiljö
  • Gedigen upplärning med erfaren personal

Arbetsuppgifter

Rollen innebär att självständigt hantera hela flödet kring reservdelar och logistik, från kundförfrågan till packning och leveransbokning.

  • Hantera kundförfrågningar gällande service och reservdelar
  • Kommunicera med leverantörer och koordinera servicebesök
  • Ansvara för beställning, packning och leverans av reservdelar
  • Säkerställa en smidig logistik från försäljning till leverans via Sendify
  • Tolka tekniska ritningar för att identifiera rätt reservdelar
  • Hantera löpande lageradministration och kundorder i affärssystemet

Vi söker dig som

  • Grundläggande kunskap i ritningsläsning och förmåga att tolka tekniska ritningar
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift
  • God sifferförståelse och förmåga att hantera enklare matematiska beräkningar som prisomvandlingar
  • Slutförd gymnasieutbildning, gärna med teknisk inriktning

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Erfarenhet av kund- och leverantörskontakt
  • Erfarenhet av reservdelshantering sedan tidigare
  • Kunskap om affärssystemet Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
  • Truckkort (behörighet B för motvikt och skjutstativ)
  • Erfarenhet av liknande arbete inom livsmedelsbranschen

För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:

  • Förändringsbenägen
  • Hjälpsam
  • Ansvarstagande
  • Energisk

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: FE søger DevOps-profiler i Nordjylland til drift og udvikling til afdelingen for Elektronisk Indhentning
description:
Sidder du med DevOps-erfaring og har lyst til at blive en del af et team med ansvar for monitorering og drift, automatisering, samt videreudvikling af vores tekniske platforme inden for elektronisk indhentning – samtidig med du bidrager til en vigtig del af Danmarks sikkerhed? Så er det dig vi søger!

Du får udfordringer og plads til at udvikle dig
Du vil løbende arbejde med optimering af vores platforme og have stor indflydelse på, hvordan vi løser opgaverne. Overordnet får du mulighed for at understøtte og videreudvikle vores infrastruktur, automatisere driftsopgaver, samt bidrage til overvågning og fejlfinding i komplekse tekniske systemer.

Vi tilbyder et læringsrigt og tværfagligt miljø med tæt samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af flere teams og får indsigt i SIGINT-systemer, der er specialudviklet til vores fagområde – herunder løsninger inden for telekommunikation og satellitteknologi.

Der er en stejl indlæringskurve i starten, hvor vi selvfølgelig tilbyder en solid oplæring og et team, der bakker dig op undervejs. Vores systemlandskab omfatter en del løsninger, der er udviklet specifikt til vores branche, og det tager tid at sætte sig ind i. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på, at du har lyst til og evner for at lære nyt – både teknisk og fagligt.

Arbejdsstedet for stillingen er i Nordjylland.

Du og din baggrund er vigtig
Du har en relevant IT-faglig baggrund – det kunne for eksempel være datatekniker, datamatiker, ingeniør med erfaring inden for IT eller har opnået DevOps-erfaring fra tidligere stillinger.

Det vigtigste for os er din vilje til at sætte dig ind i vores fagspecifikke systemer og bidrage til, at vi fortsat kan levere stabile og sikre løsninger. Vi forventer derfor at du er nysgerrig og har en naturlig lyst til at lære nye systemer og teknologier og at du kan arbejde struktureret og selvstændigt, samtidig med at du er en god teamplayer.

Det vil være en klar fordel, hvis du også har en grundlæggende forståelse for Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, Python, Prometheus, Grafana. Har du derudover erfaring eller interesse for telekommunikation eller satellitteknologi, vil det også blive vægtet – men ikke et krav.

Din nye arbejdsplads
Forsvarets Efterretningstjeneste (FE) er Danmarks udenrigsefterretningstjeneste og arbejder – hemmeligt og åbent – for at beskytte Danmark og danske interesser i en foranderlig verden.

Vi er ikke alene om at beskytte Danmark, men vi er den eneste myndighed, der har fået mandat til at udnytte helt særlige midler til at afdække, hvad andre stater og udenlandske aktører forsøger at holde hemmeligt. Det giver mening for os at bidrage til fred, tryghed og sikkerhed for danskerne, både i den analoge og i den digitale verden og det gør vi ved at afdække, vurdere, rådgive om og modvirke både aktuelle trusler og trusler under udvikling.

Vi værdsætter styrken i vores mangfoldighed med dybe fagligheder og specialister og vi er en helt speciel og operativt orienteret vidensorganisation, der har mange forskellige opgaver, men fælles for dem alle er det vidensgrundlag, som vores efterretningsarbejde skaber.

Som ansat i FE er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Det er et krav, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele din ansættelse. Som i resten af forsvaret har du pligt til kortvarig udsendelse til udlandet.

Din lønpakke afhænger af dine kvalifikationer
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og den relevante faglige organisation, afhængig af din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund. Derudover har du mulighed for at forhandle løntillæg efter kvalifikationer. Den gennemsnitlige arbejdstid er 37 timer om ugen inklusiv betalt frokostpause. Til stillingen hører en pensionsordning, som FE betaler.

Sådan søger du stillingen
Du skal sende din ansøgning og CV via stillingsopslaget, senest den 8. november 2026.

Vi stiler mod en ansættelse fra 1. februar 2026. Vi opfordrer alle interesserede uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte den lokale HR-partner på 23269@ddis.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller ønsker flere oplysninger.

Du kan også læse mere på www.fe-ddis.dk, hvor du blandt andet finder vores ”INDBLIK” og kan få et mere detaljeret indblik i FE´s opgaver, FE som arbejdsplads og yderligere information om ansættelsesmæssige spørgsmål.

Vi ser frem til at læse din ansøgning!

title: Aerospace Medicine Specialist
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Advanced Concepts and Enterprise Engineering (ACE), supporting Blue Origin’s mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The team fosters innovation and drives engineering workflows of the future, shared solutions and standards, simplicity and lower costs, and manufacturable design.

As part of a hardworking team of talented specialists, technicians, and engineers, the Aerospace Medicine Specialist will provide expert guidance on astronaut health and medical engineering to support vehicle design and development. This role contributes to the design of astronaut interfaces, development of operational products (e.g., emergency response procedures), and the establishment of clinical standards of care for commercial astronauts and client flight crews before, during, and after missions in support of Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space.

Areas of responsibility span Aerospace Medicine, Biomedical Engineering, Flight Control Operations, Space Radiation analysis, research operations and integration, and Behavioral Health and Performance (e.g., sleep schedule modification for operators; astronaut psychological assessments, in-flight care, and emergency psychological support).

  • Identify and respond to company needs and engage across programs to ensure medical expertise influences design, operations, and strategy, growing benefit for Blue Origin.
  • Develop, implement, and represent Blue Origin health and medical standards and strategy in company, cross-company, as well as in public forums and with key partners to strengthen and form relationships.
  • Own and develop technical data and deliverables/products (e.g., health- or medically-related requirements and ConOps).
  • Identify human spaceflight risks for vehicle and operational concept development
  • Develop mitigations and strategies to prevent or minimize human spaceflight risks

Special Mentions

  • Relocation may be provided
  • Travel encouraged up to 25% of the time
  • For physician candidates: Medical Licensure and Board Certification verification required. Board-eligible status may be considered.

Responsibilities:

Include but are not limited to:

  • Support Blue Origin's Chief Medical Officer and engineering teams in the development of health, medical, and human performance vehicle design, ConOps deliverables, and risk assessments; advance company strategies and goals; and collaborate to deliver on company-wide requirements.
  • Identify and respond to company needs; engage across programs to ensure health and medical expertise meaningfully influences vehicle design, operations, and organizational strategy.
  • Develop, implement, and represent Blue Origin health and medical standards and strategy in internal forums, cross-company engagements, public forums, and with key external partners to strengthen and build relationships.
  • Own and develop technical data and deliverables/products (e.g., health- and medically-related requirements and ConOps documents).
  • Identify human spaceflight risks associated with vehicle and operational concept development; develop mitigations and strategies to prevent or minimize those risks.
  • Develop, test, and deliver countermeasures that may affect crew health, safety, and/or performance during or after spaceflight missions.
  • Identify and evaluate medical risks and requirements associated with low Earth orbit, microgravity, hypogravity (e.g., lunar surface), and deep space exploration operations.
  • Develop clinical standards of care defining direct care protocols for commercial astronauts and client flight crews before, during, and after missions.
  • Advise Business Units and special programs on astronaut health and safety issues to ensure human-rating standards are achieved.
  • Certify as a flight controller and serve as a subject matter expert in support of Mission and Flight Operations.
  • Support crew launch and recovery operations.

Qualifications:

This position is open to candidates from one of the following two professional backgrounds:

Path 1 – Aerospace Medicine Physician (Preferred)

  • Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) from an accredited institution
  • Active and unrestricted state medical license (relevant medical board complaints subject to review)
  • Aerospace Medicine Board Certification or board-eligible status
  • Continuous clinical practice in a specialty field within the past 2 years

Path 2 – Senior Biomedical Engineer (Human Spaceflight Experience)

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in engineering (e.g. Biomedical, Aerospace, Mechanical) or a closely related field
  • Experience supporting human spaceflight programs (e.g., NASA, DoD, commercial spaceflight)
  • Demonstrated technical expertise in health- or medical-related engineering within spaceflight or operationally relevant extreme environment contexts

All Candidates

  • Health and medical human spaceflight operational experience, particularly associated with Low Earth Orbit and/or exploration-class vehicles and habitats
  • Working knowledge of health and medical countermeasures to combat physiological deconditioning, maintain crew member health, and mitigate spaceflight-associated risks
  • Understanding of human health impacts in extreme environments (e.g., hyper/hypobaric environments, prehospital and remote medicine)
  • Familiarity with life support systems required for human survival in space
  • Expertise in astronaut and ground crew emergency response across different phases of flight
  • Experience writing and evaluating system requirements and verifications
  • Ability to identify, evaluate, and develop new space technologies and procedures

Desired:

  • For physicians: Active and unencumbered medical license to practice in Washington, Florida, Texas, or Alabama
  • Advanced operational experience with NASA, DoD, or commercial human spaceflight programs
  • Experience as a certified flight controller or in an equivalent Mission Operations capacity
  • Prior experience developing or contributing to human spaceflight medical standards, policies, or regulatory frameworks

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. title: Psychiatric Counselor
description:

Under the Direction of the Registered Nurse provides and maintains a safe and therapeutic milieu. Works in a collaborative manner with the multi-disciplinary treatment team and contributes to the patient’s individual treatment plan.

Job Description:

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assists multidisciplinary team in formulating, implementing, and observing outcomes of the individualized patient plan of care

  • Encourages and supports patients in maintaining ADL’s.

  • Communicates and records significant changes in patient’s condition or behavioral changes to the RN.

  • Legibly documents all pertinent data regarding patient care in the patient care record.

  • Demonstrates understanding of patients’ rights and the complaint/grievance process

  • Follows hospital and department policies and procedures

  • Works collaboratively as a co-leader or leader during scheduled groups and documents patient’s participation.

  • Maintains patient confidentiality

  • Maintains CPI and BCLS education

  • Attends or reads all staff meeting documentation

  • Demonstrates flexibility and cooperation in response to unexpected change in work volume, emergencies and staffing or scheduling changes

  • As designated, serves as Human Rights Officer for the unit. Acts as a knowledgeable resource for patients, families, and staff regarding regulatory and human rights, effectively investigates complaints, and ensures follow-through with unit Director. Attends annual DMH human rights officer training.

  • Completes other duties as assigned

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Education

  • High School Diploma Required

  • Bachelor's degree in psychology or related field or equivalent experience is preferred.

Experience

  • At least one year of experience working with psychiatric patients in an inpatient setting is preferred.

Licenses or certifications

Skills, knowledge and abilities

Physical Demands

  • Stooping, kneeling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, lifting, fingering as in picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than with the whole hand or arm as in handling; grasping, talking, talking as expressing or exchanging ideas. Involvement in the physical management of violent behaviors.

Psychiatric Counselors must possess adequate strength and stamina to work on their feet at least part of any day. In addition, it is essential that Psychiatric Counselors demonstrate an ability to recognize potential problems as they arise. In response to these situations, Psychiatric Counselors effectively assist their colleagues in the implementation of appropriate interventions for the patient and/or the milieu in crisis. Potential for exposure to communicable diseases, blood/body fluids and other hazardous waste. General hospital environment.

title: Ställföreträdande varuhuschef till Vetlanda
description:
Gillar du pulsen i ett varuhus och får energi av att se hur både människor och resultat växer? Kom och utvecklas i din roll som ledare hos oss på Rusta!

Just nu letar vi efter en Ställföreträdande Varuhuschef till vårt varuhus i Vetlanda.

Hos Rusta får du vara med och göra verklig skillnad – varje dag. I denna roll är du på den plats där allt händer, där vi möter våra kunder. Din allra viktigaste uppgift blir att vara varuhuschefen närmast, både när det gäller ansvar och det dagliga arbetet. Tillsammans ser ni till att vardagen flyter på smidigt, och när varuhuschefen inte är på plats är det du som tar rodret. Som team skapar ni ett välskött och inbjudande varuhus där både kunder och medarbetare trivs.

Om dig

Du inspirerar och stöttar dina kollegor, skapar struktur och ser till att rätt saker händer i rätt tid – med både helheten och detaljerna i fokus. Du är en trygg förebild för teamet, och du säkerställer att ni tillsammans jobbar mot varuhusets uppsatta mål. Som person är du bra på att skapa ordning och reda både i kassan och på lagret, samtidigt som du alltid har kunden i fokus och gör det där lilla extra för att skapa en välkomnande och positiv upplevelse i butik.

Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – vi lär dig! Men vi tror att du:

  • Har några års erfarenhet av att leda inom detaljhandeln, gärna från en verksamhet som hanterar stora volymer
  • Gillar att tänka långsiktigt och inspirera andra till detsamma
  • Är bra på att få med dig andra och förstår vikten av att ha kul ihop och sprida positiv energi oavsett om dagen flyter på enligt plan eller inte
  • Är rak och tydlig i din kommunikation, andra tycker att det är lätt att förstå dig
  • Gillar att ha fullt ös omkring dig och förstår vikten av att vara flexibel för att komma till bästa möjliga lösning för kunden, teamet eller varuhuset i stort
  • Har ett genuint driv att utvecklas, och kanske siktar du på att driva ett eget varuhus inom några år?

Vill du jobba hos oss?

Utöver ditt CV vill vi även lära känna dig genom:

  • Dina svar på urvalsfrågor när du ansöker
  • Ett kort test (bara lugn – det är inget matteprov)
  • Intervju på plats i varuhuset
  • Digital referenstagning och en bakgrundskoll – inget konstigt, bara rutin: Vanliga frågor och svar om bakgrundskontroller

Vill du växa med oss?

Tveka inte – skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande, så vänta inte till sista sekund. Vi ser fram emot att få lära känna dig!

Slutligen:

  • Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning, inleds med sex månaders provanställning
  • Omfattning: Heltid (38,25 h/vecka)
  • Startdatum: Enligt överenskommelse
  • Arbetstid: Varierande, morgon, dag kväll och helg
  • Lön: Enligt kollektivavtal

Rusta är detaljhandelskedjan som erbjuder ett brett sortiment av hem- och fritidsprodukter till överraskande låga priser. Vi vill att våra kunder ska känna sig välkomna, bli inspirerade och tycka att det är roligt att handla hos oss. På Rusta gör vi det lätt för många människor att köpa produkter av god kvalitet till bästa pris. Det första varuhuset öppnades 1986 i Gävle och idag har Rusta över 200 varuhus i Sverige, Norge, Finland och Tyskland.

title: Senior Sensory Scientist
description:
Job Summary

Looking for a role that challenges you while making an impact on products people use every day? We are looking for an experienced Sensory Scientist to drive R&D cognitive research within R&D and the Scent Business Unit.

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Scent: Harnessing the full emotional power of scent, driven by pioneering creativity, science, consumer expertise and a mindful approach to fragrance design.​

The role is based in Shanghai (anchor role), China. This position provides scientific excellence within a global team based on strong scientific credentials in sensory/consumer science. Be part of a motivated, passionate, and open-minded team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.


Where You’ll Make a Difference

  • Experience building high performing human panels for routine sensory and/or consumer research. Tasks include:
    • Planning and execution of panelist recruitment, screening, and training of new panelist
    • Ongoing panelist training, monitoring, calibration and maintenance to ensure a high level of panelist performance
    • Implementing standard research protocols for both sensory and consumer tests
    • Setting up daily testing sessions, ensuring all supplies, equipment, and samples are ordered, arranged, and ready for daily panel sessions
    • Setup study designs for protocols using data acquisition software, i.e., EyeQuestion
    • Managing panelist schedules and payroll for sensory and consumer panelist
    • Maintaining a safe and productive sensory testing facility
  • Conduct R&D sensory and consumer researcher within the Scent Business Unit, ensuring scientific rigor, collaboration, and professional growth
  • Implement scientific excellence in experimental design, data analysis and interpretation, and communication of insights to internal stakeholders, in full compliance with internal and external ethical standards for human subjects’ research
  • Translate insights into actionable business recommendations, facilitating speed, collaboration and focus
  • Foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the research function
  • Present research in internal and external forums, contributing to thought leadership and scientific credibility
  • Automate workflows to improve efficiency and effectiveness

What Makes You the Right Fit

  • Master’s or PhD (preferred) degree in Sensory Science
  • At least 3 years of experience leading sensory research in academia and/or the consumer goods industry; fragrance experience is preferred
  • Deep knowledge of sensory methodologies, experimental design, controlled testing environments, and planning /executing sensory and consumer insights research.
  • Proven ability to apply data analysis in perceptual research and communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience leading research projects, promoting rigor, collaboration, and development
  • Ability to work independently within a broadly defined technical area, manage multiple priorities, and connect strategic goals with project execution.
  • Strong communication, organization, stakeholder engagement, and problem-solving skills

How Would You Stand Out?

  • Advanced statistics, with experience in one or more Power BI, Python, R, SQL, or MATLAB
  • Data management experience
  • Fragrance-industry experience and a strong scientific vision for the future of fragrance
  • Automating routine workflows

Why Choose Us?

  • Join a creative, collaborative environment that encourages innovation and personal growth.
  • The role offers opportunities to expand expertise across regions and categories, work with global clients, contribute to worldwide initiatives, and receive competitive compensation and benefits packages, including performance incentives.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.
