title: Group Head of Technology
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Group Head of Technology to lead our Group’s technology strategy, digital transformation and technology-enabled operational excellence across Asia.

This is a senior Group leadership role responsible for aligning technology strategy, platforms, infrastructure and shared technology services with the Group’s business growth and regional expansion. The role will provide leadership across technology, internal IT, cloud and infrastructure, enterprise platforms, technology governance, cybersecurity coordination, service delivery, shared services, AI and automation.

The successful candidate will work closely with Group Management and business leaders to build scalable technology capabilities, strengthen operational efficiency and governance, and drive the adoption of AI, automation, cloud and emerging technologies across the Group.

The role has a regional Asia remit and will work closely with Group companies, business teams, customers, partners and vendors across multiple markets, supporting the Group’s continued regional growth and expansion.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the Group’s technology strategy and roadmap across Asia, ensuring alignment with business strategy, growth priorities and regional expansion.

  • Serve as a key technology advisor to Group Management, translating business objectives into technology priorities, investment plans, transformation initiatives and measurable outcomes.

  • Lead the development of a scalable Group technology architecture and operating model that supports multiple companies, business units and locations across Asia.

  • Provide leadership and governance for internal IT, infrastructure, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, workplace technology, identity and access management, IT service management and related shared technology services.

  • Drive the Group’s digital transformation agenda through Generative AI, AI Agents, automation, cloud, data and other emerging technologies.

  • Identify and prioritise opportunities to use AI and automation to streamline workflows, reduce manual processes, strengthen controls and improve employee, customer and operational experience.

  • Lead the technology enablement and continuous improvement of the Group’s Asia shared-services model, driving standardisation, scalability, efficiency, service quality and transparency.

  • Establish appropriate technology policies, architecture principles, governance standards, SOPs, SLAs, KPIs, escalation mechanisms and performance management frameworks.

  • Provide senior leadership and oversight of strategic technology programmes, including cloud transformation, infrastructure modernisation, enterprise applications, system integration, data, AI and automation initiatives.

  • Work closely with AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Solution, Project Management and Service Delivery teams throughout the project lifecycle, from strategy and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment and operational transition.

  • Ensure technology solutions and platforms are secure, scalable, reliable, supportable and commercially appropriate throughout their lifecycle.

  • Work closely with cybersecurity and compliance leadership to maintain effective technology risk, cybersecurity, privacy, data protection, business continuity and operational resilience frameworks.

  • Promote the responsible and secure adoption of AI, including appropriate governance, data protection, human oversight, intellectual property considerations and risk controls.

  • Oversee technology risk management, access governance, technology asset management, backup, resilience, incident management and remediation of technology-related audit findings.

  • Lead technology vendor strategy, selection, commercial evaluation, contract governance, licensing and performance management in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.

  • Develop and manage technology and shared-services budgets, investment plans, forecasts and cost-optimisation initiatives.

  • Support Group Management and business leaders on major customer engagements, strategic partnerships, new-market entry and technology-related investment decisions.

  • Provide senior sponsorship and governance for selected strategic customer or internal transformation projects where technology leadership is required.

  • Build and develop high-performing regional technology and shared-services teams, establishing clear accountability, succession planning and capability-development priorities.

  • Partner with HR and management on workforce planning, organisational design, leadership development and talent strategy for technology-related functions.

  • Collaborate with Group companies and teams across Asia, taking into consideration different business requirements, regulatory environments, market conditions and operating practices while maintaining consistent Group technology standards and governance.

  • Travel within Asia as required for management meetings, customer engagements, projects, business reviews, audits, regional transformation initiatives and other business requirements.

  • Keep abreast of developments in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, AI Agents, cloud, cybersecurity, enterprise technology, automation and digital transformation, and recommend appropriate technologies for Group adoption.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Operations Management or a related discipline. A master’s degree, MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is highly desirable.

  • Typically, 15 years or above of progressive experience in technology, IT, digital transformation, service delivery and/or technology-enabled operations, including substantial senior leadership experience.

  • Proven experience leading technology functions across multiple markets, preferably within Asia or a regional/shared-services environment.

  • Strong experience in technology strategy, enterprise architecture, cloud, infrastructure, enterprise applications, IT service management, digital transformation, automation and technology governance.

  • Strong understanding of Generative AI, AI Agents and enterprise automation, with the ability to identify practical use cases and balance innovation with governance, security and risk.

  • Good understanding of cybersecurity, technology risk, data protection, business continuity, operational resilience and regulatory requirements.

  • Proven track record in leading large-scale technology or transformation programmes and translating strategy into executable roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.

  • Experience establishing or improving regional shared services, IT service management, SLAs, KPIs, governance and operational processes is highly desirable.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including technology budgeting, business cases, investment planning, vendor management, contract negotiation and cost optimisation.

  • Experience in a System Integrator (SI), technology consulting, managed services, cloud, cybersecurity or professional services environment is highly desirable.

  • Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, change management, communication and decision-making skills.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with Group Management, business leaders, technical teams, customers, partners and vendors, and to translate complex technology matters into clear business implications and recommendations.

  • Proven ability to lead and collaborate with multicultural, geographically distributed teams across different markets, with the flexibility and cultural awareness required to operate effectively in a regional environment.

  • Regional exposure or experience working with businesses, teams, customers or projects across Asia is highly desirable.

  • Able and willing to travel within Asia as required.

  • Excellent command of written and spoken English, with strong communication and presentation skills and the ability to engage effectively with senior management, customers, partners and multicultural teams across Asia. Proficiency in additional Asian languages is an advantage but not essential.

  • Relevant professional certifications in Cloud, Cybersecurity, Enterprise Architecture, IT Service Management, Project/Programme Management, Governance or Risk would be an advantage.

title: Intern - Supply Chain Management
description:
Are you looking for an internship within Supply Chain Management as part of your education? We are looking for an ambitious student with a data-driven and curious mindset to take part in our journey of standardising/optimising processes & making data available at our fingertips. Our complexity is growing in at a fast pace and it is essential to enable the organisation to make better and faster decisions. This is a fantastic opportunity to get into the pharma/biotech industry to learn how Supply Chain is operating, working alongside with experienced specialists.


The intern will be supporting various teams within Supply Chain Operations and Material Lifecycle Management. The start date will be the 1st of February 2027. The internship is for 5-6 months.

Your primary tasks and responsibilities could include

  • Automating and speeding up tasks using Alteryx (We don’t expect you to know how to use Alteryx or Tableau, but we do expect that you have a strong interest in learning to use the tools).
  • Developing dashboards for visualisation of data with Tableau.
  • Help stakeholders optimise their use of data to allow for faster and data-driven decisions.
  • Help stakeholders describe workflows and create documentation to support optimal processes.
  • Drive minor initiatives that will support the scalability journey for Supply Chain.

Our Expectations

It is expected that you are enrolled in a Bachelor or Master Program preferably within Engineering, Manufacturing and Management, Data Science or similar at a Danish University.

Good English skills are required.

Curious of nature, detail oriented, and keen on working with processes & data. You meet and greet people with a smile and have a can-do attitude with a high degree of freedom to solve the tasks you have been entrusted with.

You work with a humility and respect for the people around you. You are robust, flexible, and able to prioritise tasks to meet defined timelines. You work structured with a quality mind set and enjoy working independently and proactively in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment.

Your Application

If this job posting has caught your interest, please upload your CV and application as soon as possible. Also confirm that you can start in February 2027 and complete a 5–6 month, full-time (37 hours/week) internship as part of your education, awarding ECTS points, and that you are permitted to do a full-time internship while enrolled in your academic program (for work-permit purposes).

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.



Working at FUJIFILM Biotechnologies

We offer a competitive compensation package in a site/company growing rapidly, with many opportunities for individual growth, we also offer access to fitness and an attractive canteen.

FUJIFILM Biotechnologies is an industry-leading Biologics Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) with locations in Hillerød, Denmark, Teesside, UK, RTP, North Carolina and College Station, Texas, USA. We use our skills, dedication, and ambition to enable impact for the world’s most innovative biotech and biopharma companies reimagining healthcare’s potential. We work across the entire lifecycle of our customers’ products – enabling success throughout. Every cure, vaccine, biologic, and advancement we contribute to starts with our people and our passion. We fuel one another’s passion, help accelerate progress, expand capabilities, strengthen innovation, and improve processes to improve lives.

Our Manufacturing site in Hillerød, Denmark, brings together a complete range of expertise, capabilities, and technologies to manufacture advanced biologics. As we continue to enhance and expand our capabilities, we are looking for people who share our passion, drive, and energy – what we call Genki – to join our team.

We offer the chance to be part of a global workplace where passion, drive, and commitment are met with opportunities for professional and personal development. Deeply committed to diversity and inclusion, we ensure that everyone no matter their background or gender has an opportunity to develop. We take pride in enriching our communities, caring for our environment, and cultivating a world of opportunity for future generations.

  • Skilled at navigating matrix structures and cross-border teams

title: Insider Threat Analyst
description:
Insider Threat Analyst

Redstone Arsenal

DEFTEC delivers mission-critical solutions through skillfully delivered services and innovative products. We are inspired by our clients' critical missions and driven to provide the most effective solutions to execute their missions, operational challenges, and requirements. Our dedicated, experienced, and talented employees work closely with our clients to ensure the delivery of exceptional services and products.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is charged with protecting and defending the United States against terrorist and foreign intelligence threats, enforcing the criminal laws of the United States, and providing leadership and criminal justice services to federal, state, municipal, and international partners. In 2011, Executive Order 13587 directed all agencies operating or accessing classified computer networks to safeguard classified information and establish insider threat detection programs. The FBI's Insider Threat Office (InTO) serves as the central coordinating component for all insider threat issues, with a mission to detect, deter, and mitigate risks originating from within the organization. This position provides critical analytical support to InTO by conducting research, analysis, and reporting that directly contribute to safeguarding FBI personnel, systems, and information from insider risks.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Research, fuse, and analyze large, disparate datasets to identify insider-threat trends/indicators and assess COAs, using SQL/Python for large-set manipulation and automation, and producing decision-quality visuals in Power BI/Tableau and Excel (macros/VBA).
  • Conduct insider-threat monitoring across UAM/DLP/UBA/SIEM; triage alerts and perform log analysis in Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel; develop repeatable detections leveraging KQL/SPL and automation in Python/Excel VBA.
  • Build and tune data pipelines, queries, and automations aligned to InTO SOPs with minimal re-work (SQL/Python, Splunk saved searches/alerts, Sentinel analytics rules, Power BI dataflows).
  • Utilize Microsoft Purview, Defender, and Sentinel; Azure services; and tools such as a Commercial UAM software to detect, investigate, and respond to data-loss and misuse events.
  • Access classified and open-source systems; collect, organize, and format data per InTO SOPs; manage secure processing/transmittal/storage while applying configuration and privilege management best practices.
  • Compare and fuse multi-source reporting (FBI HQ, field offices, partner agencies) to find correlations, discrepancies, and gaps; generate and triage leads/alerts using Splunk dashboards, Sentinel workbooks, and Power BI.
  • Develop and prototype analytics (queries, programs, algorithms) for large-scale analysis using SQL/Python and Azure; perform statistical analysis/data exploration and optimize datasets for strategic program support.
  • Produce clear, concise analytic products, reports, briefs, charts, tables, and graphs, in Power BI/Tableau/Excel; present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Perform DLP functions and insider-risk investigations using Purview/Defender, Digital Guardian, and Splunk/Sentinel; identify inappropriate/unauthorized activity, associations, or communications.
  • Provide technical/operational support for data and case requests; create Splunk searches, Sentinel queries, and Excel/Power BI views to accelerate discovery and response.
  • Execute QC of analytic processes/products (query validation, dashboard accuracy, SOP compliance) across Splunk/Sentinel/Power BI; prioritize multiple projects effectively.
  • (ITMU role) Mentor/QA less-senior analysts; set detection standards; lead prototype analytics; and mature enterprise use of the Microsoft security stack (Purview/Defender/Sentinel/Azure), Splunk, Power BI, and automation with SQL/Python/Excel VBA.

Required Qualifications

  • Active TS/SCI clearance.
  • Education/Experience: Bachelor's degree; or an additional 4 years of directly related experience (totaling 8+ years) in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience: Minimum 4 years performing administrative, analytical, and research functions in national-security or operational-security environments.
  • Productivity & Tools: Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and Google Chrome; ability to navigate multiple browser windows/tabs, and copy/paste across applications.
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills; proven ability to brief and collaborate with diverse stakeholders.
  • Analytic Communication: Demonstrated skill in oral presentations and in writing reports that explain methods and results of mathematical/quantitative analysis to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Data & Scripting: Strong SQL and Python for large-dataset manipulation, automation, and ETL; working knowledge of KQL (Microsoft Sentinel/Log Analytics) and SPL (Splunk).
  • SIEM & Logging: Splunk hands-on (data onboarding/normalization, dashboards, alerts; ES/CIM mappings).
  • Microsoft Security Stack: Microsoft Sentinel (analytic rules, workbooks, UEBA, automation/Logic Apps), Microsoft Defender (Endpoint/Identity/Email), and Microsoft Purview (DLP policies, sensitivity labels, insider-risk controls).
  • Cloud & Telemetry: Azure familiarity (Log Analytics/Kusto, Azure Monitor, Data Explorer; basic Data Factory/orchestration) supporting pipelines and playbooks.
  • DLP/Insider Risk: Experience with Digital Guardian or a Commercial UAM software (policy creation/tuning, incident triage).
  • Visualization: Power BI (DAX, Power Query) and/or Tableau (calculated fields, LOD) to deliver decision-quality visuals.
  • Advanced Excel: Power Query/Pivot and VBA/macros for repeatable analysis and workflow automation.
  • Engineering for InTO SOPs: History of building/tuning pipelines, queries, and dashboards aligned to government/InTO formats with minimal re-work and strong QC.
  • Domain Depth: Familiarity with UAM, DLP, UBA, SIEM, and Windows/M365/network logs; ability to craft repeatable detection methods.

DEFTEC offers a comprehensive whole-life benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, holiday, paid time off, 401K with a match, life insurance, short/long-term disability, and educational reimbursement. The DEFTEC team comprises professionals who make a difference daily in crucial national security missions. Our leadership knows that this happens by employing a diverse team that is well cared for. Our top priority is our employees, making DEFTEC an ideal workplace.

title: IT Infrastructure & Data Center Operations Manager - J12875
description:
Salary: $75,000 – $90,000 per month

About the Client:

We are representing one of the largest global cloud computing providers. They build, own, and operate massive-scale infrastructure that keeps a significant portion of the internet running. The engineering culture is highly pragmatic and data-driven, focusing heavily on continuous improvement, physical security, and maintaining absolute uptime for enterprise customers.

The Role & Landscape:

You will step in to take full operational ownership of several physical data center sites in Hong Kong. This is a hands-on management role where you bridge the gap between facility operations and infrastructure strategy.

  • Site Management: Oversee daily data center operations, ensuring strict adherence to safety, physical security, and customer data protection protocols.

  • Team Leadership: Directly manage, coach, and evaluate a team of junior technicians.

  • Incident & Change Control: Own the lifecycle for problem, incident, and change management workflows across your sites.

  • MEP & Capacity Planning: Monitor and manage Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) infrastructure, including power and cooling systems, alongside server capacity planning.

  • Financial Ownership: Drive annual budgeting for your sites, managing both CAPEX and OPEX financials efficiently.

What We Are Looking For:

  • Experience: At least 3 years of direct people management experience, acting as the performance manager for a technical team.

  • Technical Core: Deep knowledge of IT infrastructure, data center operations, and continuous process improvement. Familiarity with MEP (Power/Cooling) is highly preferred.

  • Communication: Bilingual fluency in English and Chinese is mandatory. You must be able to adapt your communication style seamlessly—breaking down technical issues for junior technicians one minute, and presenting capacity reports to regional senior leadership the next.

  • Financials: Practical experience managing annual budgets (CAPEX/OPEX).

  • Preferred Certifications: ITIL, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, CDCP/S/E, or Linux administration (RHCSA, LPIC).

Why Apply To This Role:

This isn't a hands-off administrative job; you are essentially the site director for critical infrastructure. You get high visibility with regional leadership, significant budget control, and the autonomy to run your facilities. It’s an opportunity to manage physical infrastructure at a scale most IT professionals never get to touch.

If this outstanding opportunity sounds like your next career move, please submit through "Apply Now" or send your resume in Word format to Danny Kwan at resume(at)pinpointasia(dot)com and put IT Infrastructure & Data Center Operations Manager - J12875 in the subject header.

title: Head of Technology Governance & Program Management, Senior Vice President
description:
Who we are looking for

State Street seeks to recruit a Head of Technology Governance and Program Management to significantly uplift its independent governance of risk, regulatory program management and remediation while bringing connectivity and consistency of execution through dependency management, transparent reporting and improved overall accountability. The candidate should have experience in understanding of technology organization in a regulated financial services organization, strong program management as well as governance and execution. This leader will have a broad range of responsibilities to oversee a sustainable governance process as well as clear execution management or strategic remediations programs and large-scale initiatives ensuring their interdependencies are clearly laid out and managed on an agile and iterative basis. This leader will provide clear independent reporting across this portfolio in alignment with organizational standards set by the CAO; and will tracking and reporting to the organizational leadership as well as official relevant committees and external parties such as regulators and advisors as required.

This role will report into CIO International, Head of GTS Transformation, Risk and Governance

Due to the role requirements this job needs to be performed primarily in the office with some flex work opportunities available.

This role will be primarily based in US (preferably Boston) and will consider candidates based in London, UK location. Internal associates will be considered for this role.

What you will be responsible for

Specifically this role will be:

  • This leader will provide independent program execution to all the technology regulatory and risk transformation initiatives across the GTS organization managing interdependencies, critical path item management and ensuring success criteria is met by the required milestones while delivering against a strategic end-state
  • The role will collaborate closely with the CIO leadership team and second and third line teams and country leaders to ensure there is clear alignment and escalation management on all items
  • Manage dependencies across programs to ensure no surprises come up and outcomes across a variety of sources and jurisdiction can be achieved through the most effective manner
  • Provide clear and succinct reporting in alignment with standards set by the CAO office to organizational committees such as CRC, TRC and TORC as well as regulators and BRG and other board committees as required
  • This role will manage some senior managers that will directly be responsible to turn gap findings into effective remediation plans as well as manage some of those horizontal risk and governance transformation items directly while providing governance to over program managers that exist across the organization
  • This leader will also manage resources who will ensure continuity of program management and detailed execution planning from findings and next steps that come out of programs such as the MRIA submission to ensure effective remediation plans are in place, and the necessary resourcing across full-time and consulting resources are in place to execute commitments and align items to existing programs

What we value:

  • A smart, challenging and energetic leader, with a passion and deep understanding of program management across Global organizations.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across different organizational lines and manage strong execution against an evolving environment with competing priorities
  • A leader, viewed by others has having a high degree of integrity and forethought in making decisions; able to act in a transparent and consistent manner, not afraid to deliver and manage complex and difficult messages
  • Need to understand the dynamics of large scale transformation programs, preferably with an understanding of risk and regulatory positions for a global bank as well as a technology organizational context
  • Ability to take data and input from others to foresee potential challenges; threats to the program or unintended circumstances and able to head off potential impacts as a result
  • Skills around being able to create structure in an unstructured white space environment and establish rigorous repeatable processes while shifting in an agile manner to address challenges that come up

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Minimum of 10+ years of related experience within the financial services industry including time spent managing in an executive capacity
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex transformation / remediation programs.
  • Relevant regulated financial service expertise, with an understanding of challenges of running a large-scale Technology transformation program
  • Managed cross-border teams based over multiple locations, additional points for experience with strong connectivity to the regulators
  • Extensive experience in managing large, complex third parties, who are critical to the success of the program
  • Bachelors / Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related technical field or relevant work experience is highly preferred.
  • Experience with US regulations as well as a strong working level of knowledge of European and Asia Pacific regulations.
  • Extensive, in-depth relevant experience in program management, including experience of leading multi-year, cross-functional or enterprise-wide programs
  • Exceptional understanding of standards-based program management and business analysis practices (Agile/Six-Sigma/Lean), with demonstrable skills in program and project management tools and methodologies
  • Strong project planning skills and expertise in large, complex program management, across multiple work-streams; releases and complex data migrations
  • Extensive background in executing change; understanding of the regulatory landscape and emerging themes is highly preferred.

Salary Range:

$225,000 - $337,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

title: Billing Coordinator
description:
At H&P, our people are our strength.

Position Summary

The Revenue Coordinator is responsible for supporting the organization's revenue and billing operations by ensuring the timely and accurate creation of customer invoices, maintenance of billing records, and resolution of billing-related inquiries. This role works closely with Regional Accounting and Finance teams to ensure services are properly billed and revenue is recognized in accordance with company policies.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, and highly organized with strong analytical and communication skills.


Key Responsibilities

Billing & Invoice Processing

· Prepare, review, and distribute customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner.

· Verify billing information, rates, contract terms, and supporting documentation prior to invoice generation.

· Process billing adjustments, credits, and corrections as needed.

· Ensure all billable services, products, and projects are invoiced according to customer agreements.

· Maintain billing schedules and monitor invoicing deadlines.

· Create well set ups in Oracle for drilling rigs

Revenue Support

· Assist with revenue tracking and reporting activities.

· Support month-end and year-end close processes by providing revenue-related information and documentation.

· Reconcile billing records and identify discrepancies requiring resolution.

· Monitor unbilled revenue and assist in resolving outstanding issues.

Customer & Internal Support

· Research and resolve invoice discrepancies in collaboration with internal teams.

· Provide documentation and support for customer audits and requests.

Data Management & Reporting

· Maintain accurate customer account and billing information within company systems.

· Monitor key billing metrics and identify trends or issues.

· Assist management with ad hoc reporting and analysis.

Process Improvement

· Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy and efficiency.

· Support implementation of process improvements and automation initiatives.

· Maintain billing procedures and process documentation.

· Participate in system testing and upgrades related to billing and revenue processes.


Qualifications

Education

· Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field preferred.

· Equivalent experience may be considered.

Experience

· 1-3 years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, customer accounting, revenue operations, or related fields.

· Experience working with ERP or billing systems preferred.

· Experience in a high-volume transaction environment is a plus.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

· Understanding of billing and invoicing processes.

· Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

· Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

· Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.

· Ability to analyze and reconcile data.

· Strong customer service and communication skills.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

· Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or similar systems preferred.


Key Competencies

· Customer Focus

· Attention to Detail

· Problem Solving

· Teamwork and Collaboration

· Accountability

· Communication

· Time Management

· Process Improvement

· Adaptability


Reporting Structure

Reports To: Revenue Supervisor

Direct Reports: None


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

· Invoice accuracy rate

· Timeliness of invoice generation

· Billing cycle completion rates

· Resolution time for billing inquiries

· Reduction in invoice corrections and rework

· Customer satisfaction related to billing support

· Compliance with billing procedures and controls

Thank you for your interest in joining our team!

title: MCN Coordinator Analyst - Temporary
location: LOC5026: Carretera a Villa de García Km. 3.0 , Santa Catarina, NLE, 66350, Mexico
description:
About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure the safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

About the role

Owns the engineering-to-manufacturing change process: reviews incoming Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), assesses their impact on released product structures within the PLM system (Windchill), and converts approved changes into Manufacturing Changes (MCNs). Ensures bill-of-materials (BOM) accuracy and traceability across all product variants before changes reach the production floor.


Key Responsibilities


As a MCN Coordinator Analyst - Temporary, you'll be responsible for:

  • Read, interpret, and validate ECNs — identify affected parts, revisions and product variants.
  • Maintain and query product structures/BOMs in the PLM system; perform "where-used" analysis to scope full change impact.
  • Compare product structures before/after a change (released vs. work-in-progress) to detect added, removed, or quantity-changed components at any BOM level.
  • Validate that detected differences match engineering intent, investigate and resolve discrepancies.
  • Draft, issue, and track MCNs that document approved production-floor changes (substitutions, quantities, find-number/structure updates).
  • Maintain full traceability: ECN → change evidence → MCN, for audit and quality records.
  • Coordinate timing and cutover with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and quality teams.
  • Flag parts/changes still in Design or Under Review states that aren't yet ready for production release.
  • Identify and help implement process/tooling improvements to reduce manual effort and rework.

Requirements


We are looking for people who are proactive. If this is you, get in touch.

As a minimum you must have:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in engineering, manufacturing or technical field.
  • 2+ years in configuration management, product data management, or engineering change management.
  • Hands-on experience with a PLM system (Windchill, Teamcenter, Agile, Enovia, or similar).
  • Strong Excel skills (comparisons, lookups, macro-driven tools).
  • Experience with multi-level BOMs, part revisions, and lifecycle states (Design → Released → Production).
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple concurrent changes/deadlines.
  • English advanced

Although not necessary, it would be nice if you have:

  • CM2 or similar Configuration Management certification.
  • Experience in HVAC, industrial equipment, or other variant-heavy manufacturing environment.
  • ERP familiarity (SAP, Oracle) for cross-system part/BOM validation.

Benefits

We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and well‑being programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees’ health, security, and success.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or otherwise engage in the hiring process, please contact us at Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com. We will make every effort to meet your needs in accordance with applicable laws.

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

title: Consultant, Data, Analytics & AI
description:
Putting people first, every day

BDO is a firm built on a foundation of positive relationships with our people and our clients. Each day, our professionals provide exceptional service, helping clients with advice and insight they can trust. In turn, we offer an award-winning environment that fosters a people-first culture with a high priority on your personal and professional growth.

Your Opportunity

Our Toronto office is looking for a Consultant to join its Strategy, Value Creation & Analytics practice within Financial Advisory Services. This role sits at the intersection of business, data, analytics and artificial intelligence. The successful candidate will combine strong technical capabilities with business acumen and client facing skills to help organizations solve complex problems, improve decision making and adopt modern data and AI enabled ways of working. This is a new role.


The ideal candidate will be intellectually curious, technically strong and comfortable learning and applying new technologies. Using modern AI tools effectively is an expected part of day to day work. The candidate should be able to use AI to improve research, analysis, coding, problem solving, documentation and solution development, while applying professional judgment and validating outputs.


As part of the team, you will support client and stakeholder needs while helping organizations advance their data, analytics and AI capabilities. You will translate complex business and financial requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate technical concepts in a way that is accessible to business stakeholders.


Responsibilities

• Work with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business problems, define analytical requirements and translate them into practical data, analytics and AI solutions.

• Apply business analytics to research, analyze and interpret complex information, identify meaningful patterns and develop actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

• Identify opportunities where AI, automation or advanced analytics can improve existing business processes, analytical workflows or client solutions.

• Design, prototype and implement AI enabled solutions and workflows where appropriate, including solutions using large language models, APIs, structured prompting, retrieval based approaches, workflow automation and other emerging AI technologies.

• Develop analytics applications, reporting solutions and decision support tools using Power BI, Tableau and other visualization or analytics technologies.

• Work hands on with data using SQL, Python, Power Query, Excel and related technologies to extract, transform, integrate, analyze and validate structured and unstructured data.

• Design, build and maintain scalable data transformation and ETL processes that support analytics, reporting, AI applications and business decision making.

• Apply statistical analysis, machine learning and other analytical techniques where appropriate, and translate technical outputs into practical business insights and usable tools.

• Develop KPIs, metrics, analytical frameworks and data models that enable organizations to monitor performance and make more informed decisions.

• Assess data quality, identify gaps or inconsistencies and apply appropriate validation and quality control procedures before information is used for analytical or AI driven decision making.

• Collaborate with clients to define project requirements through interviews, workshops, research and data analysis, and contribute to project plans, timelines and implementation approaches.

• Work closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders, clients, and other teams to support the successful implementation and adoption of data and AI solutions.

• Communicate analytical findings and technical concepts clearly through presentations, reports, dashboards and other client ready deliverables.

• Stay current on developments in analytics, artificial intelligence and data technologies, and proactively evaluate how new capabilities can be applied to client and internal business problems.

• Apply responsible AI practices, including appropriate consideration of data privacy, confidentiality, security, accuracy, explainability and human oversight when using AI technologies.


How do we define success for your role?

• You demonstrate BDO's core values through all aspects of your work: Integrity, Respect and Collaboration.

• You develop a strong understanding of your clients' industries, business models, challenges and opportunities.

• You combine strong technical execution with practical business thinking rather than treating analytics or technology as an end in itself.

• You are comfortable working directly with data and technology and can independently investigate, troubleshoot and solve technical problems.

• You critically evaluate analytical and AI generated outputs rather than accepting results without appropriate validation.

• You communicate complex analytical and technical concepts clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders.

• You identify opportunities to improve the quality, efficiency and effectiveness of client delivery through data, automation, analytics and AI.

• You consistently produce high quality, accurate and well structured work.

• You actively contribute ideas, share knowledge and support the development of the team's data, analytics and AI capabilities.

• You continuously grow your expertise through learning, experimentation and professional development.


Your experience and education

• A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics or a related quantitative field.

• Approximately 0 to 2 years of relevant experience in data analytics, data science, business analytics, technology consulting or a related field.

• Strong analytical and problem solving skills combined with business acumen and an interest in understanding how organizations operate.

• Strong hands on proficiency with SQL and Python or R.

• Strong proficiency with Power BI or comparable business intelligence and visualization technologies.

• Strong proficiency with Excel and familiarity with Power Query and other data transformation technologies.

• Demonstrated ability to manipulate, analyze and validate complex datasets using a combination of SQL, Python, Excel and analytical tools.

• Practical experience using generative AI tools to support professional work, with an understanding of how to structure effective prompts, provide appropriate context, evaluate responses and validate outputs.

• Familiarity with large language models and modern AI concepts, including prompt design, APIs, retrieval augmented generation, AI agents or workflow automation. Deep specialization in all of these areas is not required, but candidates should demonstrate the ability and willingness to learn and apply new AI technologies.

• Familiarity with analytical development practices such as version control, reusable code, documentation, testing and quality assurance is considered an asset.

• Experience with cloud data or AI platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud is considered an asset.

• Exposure to financial fundamentals, financial analysis or financial modeling is considered an asset.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to business audiences.

• Comfortable working directly with clients and stakeholders to understand requirements, present findings and build trusted relationships.

• Strong initiative and the ability to independently investigate unfamiliar problems, learn new technologies and propose practical solutions.

• Motivated, detail oriented, rigorous and comfortable working in a fast moving consulting environment.

• An interest in the continued development of data, analytics and artificial intelligence, with a demonstrated willingness to continuously learn as technologies and methodologies evolve.

The compensation range for this role is $60,000-$90,000 annually.


Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.


At BDO, our people experience is guided by three core pillars—Do work with genuine care, Do what matters with purpose, and Do what’s next - shaping how we support our people, serve our clients, and grow together.

Our firm is committed to providing an environment where you can be successful in the following ways:

  • We enable you to engage with how we change and evolve, being a key contributor to the success and growth of BDO in Canada.
  • We help you become a better professional within our services, industries, and markets with extensive opportunities for learning and development.
  • We support your achievement of personal goals outside of the office and making an impact on your community.
  • We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, and you can do your best work with genuine care and purpose
  • We encourage innovation and forward thinking, empowering you to embrace what’s next and help shape the future of our firm

Giving back adds up: Where company meets community. BDO is actively involved in our communities by supporting local charity initiatives. We support staff with local and national events where you will be given the opportunity to contribute to your community.

Total rewards that matter: We pay for performance with competitive total cash compensation that recognizes and rewards your contribution. We provide comprehensive benefits from day one, and a flexible personal time off policy. We’re committed to supporting your overall wellbeing and provide reimbursement for wellness initiatives that fit your lifestyle.

Everyone counts: We are committed to creating a workplace where employees can participate fully, contribute meaningfully and succeed without barriers. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace defined by respect, fairness, and a true sense of belonging for everyone. We recognize and celebrate the unique experiences, identities, and perspectives that each of us bring – and that these experiences strengthen how we work together. Our commitment extends to ensuring that our application process is both inclusive and accessible. If you require accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us.


Flexibility: All BDO personnel are expected to spend some of their time working in the office, at the client site, and virtually unless accommodations or alternative work arrangements are in place.

Our model is a blended approach designed to support the flexible needs of our people, the firm and our clients. It’s about creating work experiences that meet everyone’s needs and providing flexibility to adjust when, where and how we work to meet the expectations of our role.

Code of Conduct: Our Code of Conduct sets clear standards for how we conduct business. It reflects our shared values and commitments and includes guiding principles to help us make ethical decisions and maintain trust with each other, our clients, and the public.

title: Solution Engineer specialized in PAM
description:
As a Solution Engineer – Privileged Access Management (PAM) & Identity Infrastructure at TDC NET, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and operating enterprise Identity and Privileged Access Management solutions. You will be responsible for securing privileged access across infrastructure, applications, cloud platforms, and operational technology while ensuring seamless integration with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, PKI, and modern automation practices.

About the job

Working closely with Infrastructure, Security, Platform Engineering, and Application teams, you will help automate identity services, improve security controls, and improve operational efficiency through Infrastructure-as-Code and modern engineering practices.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, implement, configure, and maintain enterprise PAM solutions.
  • Integrate servers, applications, databases, network devices, and cloud platforms into the PAM ecosystem.
  • Manage and support Microsoft Active Directory, Entra ID , LDAP, MFA and related identity services.
  • Support and maintain Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), including certificate lifecycle management and secure authentication mechanisms.
  • Automate PAM and identity-related processes using Infrastructure-as-Code and scripting.
  • Monitor platform performance, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and continuously improve platform stability and security.
  • Identify security risks and implement mitigation strategies aligned with enterprise security standards.
  • Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

"We are building more than an IAM platform. We are building a modern identity engineering capability. If you enjoy solving complex security challenges, driving automation, and making a real impact, you'll fit right in with our team."

– Abhishek Kumar, Senior Manager – Identity & Access Management, TDC NET

About you

You are passionate about Identity & Access Management, infrastructure security, and automation. You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and continuously improving enterprise security platforms through modern engineering practices.

You thrive in collaborative environments where Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, and DevOps come together to build secure and scalable identity services.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience working with Identity & Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), or Security Infrastructure.
  • Extensive experience with Microsoft Active Directory, Entra ID, Group Policy, LDAP, and key authentication technologies.
  • Solid understanding & experience with Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), certificate lifecycle management, TLS/SSL, and authentication mechanisms
  • Experience with Keycloak, Hashicorp vault , Ping or equivalent platforms
  • Practical experience implementing, configuring, and supporting Delinea Privileged Access Management (PAM), HashiCorp Boundary, or equivalent privileged access solutions.
  • Solid understanding of authentication and authorization protocols such as Kerberos, LDAP, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and RADIUS.
  • Experience operating in highly regulated enterprise settings, with a solid graspof security frameworks, compliance requirements, and audit controls.
  • Extensive troubleshooting skills across Windows, Linux, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Applicants are required to meet the criteria for submitting a security clearance application.

Good to Have

  • Experience working with HashiCorp Vault for secrets management and privileged credential management.
  • Experience using Terraform for Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation.
  • Experience using Git and modern version control workflows.
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar DevOps pipelines.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Bash, or Python scripting for automation and operational tasks.
  • Familiarity with container platforms such as Docker or Kubernetes.

What We Offer

At TDC NET, you'll join a collaborative engineering team focused on building and operating modern Identity and Privileged Access Management services that protect critical infrastructure and enable secure digital transformation.

You'll have the opportunity to work with modern IAM technologies, automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, and cloud identity services while influencing technical direction and helping shape the future of our identity engineering capabilities.

If solving challenging security issues and improving identity, automation, and privileged access sounds appealing, we'd be happy to hear from you.

Contact:

If you have questions about the position or want to know more about what it means to work at TDC NET, feel free to reach out to Abhishek Kumar, Senior Manager-IAM, on abik@tdcnet.dk.

We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to our team at TDC NET.

title: Supply Planner Coordinator - Vitamin Well I NOCCO I Barebells
description:
Vitamin Well Group develops premium functional drinks, snacks and protein products designed for modern, everyday life and on-the-go consumption. Our portfolio includes Barebells, NOCCO and Vitamin Well. With over 750 employees and revenue of more than SEK 10 billion, we are present in over 50 markets, with our headquarters in Stockholm and local teams and partners around the world. Our growth is driven by a focus on building strong brands, creating products with uncompromising taste and clear functionality, and consistently raising the bar across our categories.

A successful product launch starts long before the products reach the shelves. Production needs to stay on schedule, deliveries need to arrive on time and when plans change, someone needs to act. We are now looking for a Supply Planner Coordinator to join our Supply Planning team in Stockholm, with a particular focus on Barebells Bars. A role where attention to detail, quick thinking and getting things done make a real difference.

About the role

As Supply Planner Coordinator, you will support the planning and execution of production and supply activities, working closely with our Supply Planner, external manufacturing partners and internal teams to help ensure our products reach the right markets at the right time. You will work alongside experienced planners, taking ownership of defined operational tasks while building your expertise in supply planning.

You will coordinate purchase orders, track production and deliveries, monitor inventory levels and keep planning data accurate. When delays, shortages or unexpected changes arise, you will help identify potential issues early, follow up with the right people and work towards a solution. Your ability to stay on top of the details and act when something needs attention will be important to keeping our supply operations on track.

The position is based at our headquarters in Stockholm and reports to Head of Supply Planning.

In short, your responsibilities will be:

  • Support production planning and scheduling in collaboration with external manufacturing partners.

  • Manage purchase orders, confirmations and delivery dates in Microsoft Dynamics 365.

  • Track production progress, deliveries and inventory levels to identify potential delays or shortages.

  • Maintain accurate planning data and help investigate and resolve discrepancies in orders, deliveries and stock.

  • Coordinate with internal teams and manufacturing partners to follow up on supply and delivery priorities.

  • Support planning updates, reporting and improvements to planning processes.

What you can expect

  • Real business impact: Be part of a team where your work contributes to product availability and successful launches across our markets.

  • Hands-on experience: Build your knowledge of supply planning through daily collaboration with internal teams and external manufacturing partners.

  • Room to grow: Gradually take on more responsibility and develop your skills, with the opportunity to progress towards a Supply Planner role.

Who are you

You enjoy a structured approach to work, but also the challenge of adapting when priorities shift. A delayed delivery, changing production schedules or several urgent issues at once? You stay sharp, figure out what needs attention first and get things moving.

title: Familie-, anbringelses- og netværkskonsulent til Børne- og ungeafsnittet i Ballerup Kommune
description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle et nyt team af familie-, anbringelses- og netværkskonsulenter, så kig med her. Vi søger en ny kollega med start fra 1. januar 2027, som har lyst til at finde løsninger sammen med børn, familier og deres netværk og samtidig være med til at udvikle et stærkt team.

Vores gode kollega er gået på pension og derfor søger vi dig, der har lyst til og mod på at være med i udviklingen af vores nye team – FAN-teamet. Teamet er en sammenlægning af familie- og netværkskonsulenter, sikkerhedsplanskonsulenter og familieplejekonsulenter.

I børne- og ungeafsnittet har vi igennem nogle måneder arbejdet med en organisationstilpasning, som tilgodeser, at vi igennem de senere år er blevet flere. Der har været behov for en justering, der blandt andet betyder mindre teams, ledelse tættere på og en samling af forskellige understøttende funktioner. For teamet af familie-, anbringelses- og netværkskonsulenter betyder justeringen at de vil indgå i et større team med andre konsulenter, herunder socialfaglige konsulenter, skolekonsulent m.fl. Teamet vil blive et understøttende team for alle børne- og ungerådgivere. Samtidig har vi brudt med den mere klassiske måde at tænke familieplejekonsulentsopgaver på.

Med vores nye organisering ønsker vi at vores familie-, anbringelses- og netværkskonsulenter kommer til at arbejde endnu tættere sammen og i nogen grad have et opgavefællesskab.

Teamets opgaver er overvejende at arbejde i komplekse sager med et højt bekymringsniveau, i sager hvor børn er anbringelsestruet eller hvor der er truffet afgørelse om anbringelse. Vores erfaring er at de bedste løsninger for at sikre barnets trivsel og udvikling ofte findes og understøttes i barnets netværk. Derfor vil vi gerne blive endnu bedre til at involvere børnenes og familiernes netværk både før, under og efter en anbringelse.

Derfor søger vi i Børne- og ungeafsnittet en engageret og dedikeret kollega, som i samarbejde med de øvrige faggrupper i afdelingen, samt ledelse skal understøtte vores mission om at integrere netværket som en bæredygtig løsning i barnets liv.

Det vi særligt ønsker at udvikle i det nye team, er vores arbejde med familiernes netværk både forebyggende sager og i anbringelser.

Dine opgaver vil således kunne bestå af

  • Udarbejde sikkerhedsplaner i særligt komplekse sager med stor bekymring for børn og unges trivsel
  • Afdække netværk i forbindelse med anbringelse og hjemgivelser
  • Inddrage netværk i bæredygtige løsninger for familier og børn
  • Kortere intensive forløb med fokus på inddragelse af børn og familier (efter Barnets Lov §§ 30 og 32)
  • Understøtter at børn kan fastholdes i de almene fællesskaber
  • Indgå i tæt samarbejde med børne- og ungerådgiverne
  • Godkendelse af netværksplejefamilier
  • Understøttelse af netværksplejefamilier

Dine kompetencer
Det er vigtigt, at du har en bred viden og erfaring inden for det børnesociale område. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra arbejdet med børn i udsatte positioner og at du trives med en høj grad af selvstændighed i din opgaveløsning. Samtidig skal du trives med at samarbejde med andre.

  • Du har en socialpædagogisk eller socialfaglig uddannelsesbaggrund og eventuelt en relevant efteruddannelse inden for familiebehandling eller lignende.
  • Du ønsker at arbejde involverende og insisterende sammen med familierne.
  • Du ser stor værdi i at inddrage familiens netværk.
  • Du arbejder systematisk og med tæt opfølgning.
  • Du har et solidt kendskab til børne- og familieområdet.
  • Du har kendskab til netværksinddragende metoder.
  • Du ser en stor værdi i at barnet inddrages i egen sag.
  • Du kan lide en afvekslende hverdag og trives, når der er nok at lave.
  • Du er holdspiller og ser værdi i samarbejde, dialog og tværfaglige løsninger.
  • Du har den robusthed og vedholdenhed, vi ved, det kræver.

Det får du hos os

  • En ambitiøs arbejdsplads med højt til loftet
  • Krav om høj faglighed
  • Kompetenceudvikling
  • Høj grad af frihed til kreativ opgaveløsning
  • Gode kolleger, der glæder sig til at byde dig velkommen
  • Højt humør og gode grin
  • En introduktionsplan og en mentor
  • Faglig sparring i teamet og med teamleder
  • En travl og spændende hverdag
  • Ekstern supervision.

Hvem er vi
Sammen med børnene, de unge og deres familier, samarbejdspartnere, netværk og civilsamfundet ønsker vi, at skabe bæredygtige løsninger for udsatte børn og unge. Vi vil hjælpe til at sikre, at vores børn og unge har en oplevelse af, at der er tryghedsskabende voksne i deres liv, så de har mulighed for at indgå i fællesskabet i deres familie, i skolen og i fritiden. Vi tror på, at de rigtige løsninger for vores børn og unge gør, at de sikkert og hurtigt kan komme tilbage til deres hverdag.

Vi arbejder ud fra en fælles børne- og ungepolitik, som er udviklet sammen med Center for Dagtilbud, Skoler og Klub.

Vil du vide mere
Du kan få mere at vide om stillingen ved at kontakte teamleder Camilla Maria Vindfeldt på telefon 2069 1377 eller konsulent Jack Studsgaard på telefon 2274 5675.

Læs mere om Ballerup Kommune som arbejdsplads på

Ansættelsesproces og løn
Ansættelsesdatoen er den 1. januar 2027.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler den 10. november 2026.

Ansøgningsfrist: den 3. november 2026.

Vi tilbyder løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst for Pædagogisk personale i døgninstitutioner og hjemmevejledere i kommunerne og efter overenskomst for socialrådgivere og socialformidlere i kommunerne.

Ansættelse sker efter principperne om lokal løndannelse og efter aftale med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Lønintervallet for stillingen som socialrådgiver og socialformidlere er 36.020 kr. - 45.547 kr. pr. måned uden pension ved fuldtidsansættelse (37 timer ugentligt).

Lønintervallet for stillingen som pædagogisk personale i døgninstitutioner og hjemmevejledere er 34.223 kr. - 44.804 kr. pr. måned uden pension ved fuldtidsansættelse (37 timer ugentligt).

Den endelige løn fastsættes efter forhandling mellem arbejdsgiver og den faglige organisation, der har forhandlingsretten på det relevante overenskomstområde. Lønnen afhænger blandt andet af din uddannelse, dokumenterede anciennitet og kvalifikationer.

Ballerup Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Læs mere her

Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke. Derfor opfordrer vi alle uanset køn, alder, handicap, religion, seksuel orientering eller etnisk baggrund til at søge job hos os.

title: Penetration Testing Analyst, Vice President
description:
Penetration Testing Analyst, Vice President


Who we are looking for

We are seeking a Vice President, Penetration Testing Analyst, to join State Street's Threat Intelligence and Assurance organization. This is a senior, hands-on technical role and serves as the team's in-house technical authority for complex penetration testing engagements and for validating remediation.


Why this role is important to us

You will lead the technical execution of scenario-based testing against high-value systems and services, and you will own the validation of fixes for the resulting findings. Working with finding owners, offensive security partners, external testing providers, security operations, and risk and regulatory partners, you will make sure testing is realistic, findings are technically sound, and every fix holds up under real-world attack conditions. You will be accountable for the technical defensibility of closure decisions presented to senior leadership and the Lines of Defense. You will also help mature a repeatable, high-quality internal testing capability.


What you will be responsible for

As a Vice President, Penetration Testing Analyst, you will:

  • Serve as the senior technical lead across the engagement lifecycle, including scoping, test planning, rules of engagement, execution oversight, and post-test remediation planning.
  • Provide real-time technical guidance during engagements by assessing tester activity, judging operational risk, and guiding escalation decisions with appropriate discretion.
  • Hold external testing providers to a high technical standard by challenging their attack paths, evidence quality, severity ratings, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping, so that results are accurate, actionable, and defensible.
  • Lead coordination with finding owners and engineering teams to turn findings into clear technical remediation requirements and measurable validation criteria, so fixes address root causes rather than narrow point issues.
  • Lead the strategy for validating remediation. This includes grouping related findings, defining test criteria and expected outcomes, and personally retesting fixes against the original attack path and other ways of reaching the same objective.
  • Assess remediation across the wider estate, including variant attack paths, implementation consistency, and any new exposure the fix itself introduces.
  • Make the final technical call on closure recommendations, backed by evidence-based reporting that confirms each finding as closed, open, or partially closed, with executive summaries for senior and non-technical audiences.
  • Present testing and validation outcomes to senior leadership and governance forums, and defend the technical basis for findings, residual risk, and closure decisions.
  • Design and lead targeted TTP assessments and collaborative purple team exercises, so that detection, response, and preventive controls are validated against relevant attacker behavior.
  • Feed detection and control gaps found during testing to Detection Engineering, Assurance, and Security Operations, and track the resulting improvements through validation.
  • Provide offensive security support to partner teams, including risk and regulatory functions, and help set the methods, test plans, evidence standards, and lessons-learned practices that mature the internal capability. You will also mentor team members and partners.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

  • Extensive hands-on experience in offensive security, such as advanced penetration testing, red teaming, or adversary simulation, ideally in financial services or another highly regulated industry.
  • Expert-level practical knowledge of Active Directory and Entra ID attack paths, privilege escalation, lateral movement, credential abuse, EDR evasion, and cloud attack techniques across Azure and AWS.
  • Advanced proficiency with offensive tooling and C2 frameworks, such as Cobalt Strike, BloodHound, Mimikatz, Metasploit, and Kali Linux, plus scripting for custom tooling and automation (Python, PowerShell, or similar).
  • A proven record of leading remediation validation for complex findings, including defining closure criteria and deciding whether controls work in practice rather than just on paper.
  • Deep working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK, scenario-based test design, and how detection and response capabilities are measured during testing.
  • Experience directing and challenging third-party testing providers, with the judgment to separate exploitable risk from theoretical findings.
  • Executive-level written and verbal communication, with the ability to defend technical conclusions to senior leadership, governance bodies, and independent reviewers.
  • Discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive, confidential engagement information.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 or more years of related experience
  • Industry-recognized offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSCE3, CRTO, GXPN, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting large-scale remediation validation programs is strongly preferred.

Salary Range:

$120,000 - $202,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

title: Tømrer til tagarbejde og renovering i Aalborg
description:
Vil du have firmabil, frihed under ansvar og blandede tømreropgaver?

Vi mangler en tømrer i Aalborg til nybyg, renovering, service og tagarbejde.

Du lander i et tømrerhold på cirka 10 ansatte, hvor opgaverne spænder bredt. Her er både boliger og erhverv, så hverdagen kan skifte mellem byggeplads, renovering, service og tagarbejde. Arbejdet ligger som en blanding af selvstændige opgaver, makkerarbejde og sjak. Der er familiefølelse i hverdagen, og frihed under ansvar er ikke bare pynt på opslaget.

Rollen passer til dig, der gerne vil bruge faget bredt i stedet for at blive låst fast i én type opgave. Nogle opgaver kræver at du tager styringen selv, andre løses bedst sammen med en makker eller et hold. Firmabilen er en del af pakken, og kørekort er et krav.

Det får du

Løn: 170-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Aalborg og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 10 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Nybyg, renovering, service og tagarbejde

Din hverdag

Dagen afhænger af opgaven foran dig. På nybyg handler det om at få tømrerarbejdet gjort ordentligt fra start, mens service og spjæld kræver at du kan afslutte tingene pænt samme dag. Ved tagarbejde og renovering skal rækkefølgen sidde rigtigt, så næste del af arbejdet kan fortsætte.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder med nybyg i både boliger og erhverv
  • Løser renoveringsopgaver fra første gennemgang til færdig aflevering
  • Tager service og spjæld, hvor tingene skal klares effektivt
  • Udfører tagarbejde med styr på rækkefølge og finish
  • Monterer vinduer og døre efter mål

Familiefølelse er et af de ord, virksomheden selv bruger om hverdagen. Det betyder, at du skal kunne lide et sted hvor folk hjælper hinanden videre, men stadig forventer at du tager ansvar for dit eget arbejde.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som tømrer, gerne fra blandede opgaver
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og sige til, hvis noget ikke stemmer
  • Kan indgå i både makkerpar og sjak
  • Møder stabilt og afleverer ikke noget halvt

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet nybyg, renovering, service eller tagarbejde før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide en hverdag med frihed under ansvar.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en tømrer mere i Aalborg, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

title: Dansk Erhverv søger skattechef
description:
Skat er et af de vigtigste rammevilkår for et stærkt og konkurrencedygtigt dansk erhvervsliv. Derfor er stillingen som skattechef i Dansk Erhverv en helt unik mulighed for at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem danske virksomheder og det politiske miljø på Christiansborg.

Jobbet

Som skattechef vil du arbejde tæt sammen med både vores medlemmer og politikere for at sikre de bedste skattemæssige rammer for danske virksomheder. Sammen med vores skatteteam er du ansvarlig for at holde dig opdateret på de nyeste politiske dagsordener, repræsentere medlemmers udfordringer i dialog med myndigheder, udarbejde høringssvar og positionspapirer. Samtidig bliver en del af et team, der har ansvaret for at udvikle og fremme den skattepolitiske dagsorden.

Skatteafdelingen er en del af Dansk Erhvervs centrale afdeling for Erhvervspolitik og Analyse der omfatter Analyse og Makro, Uddannelse, Forskning, Skat, Iværksætteri, Regelforenkling og Arbejdsmarkedspolitik.

I Dansk Erhverv driver vi på skatteområdet en række udvalg og arbejdsgrupper, som du har ansvaret for at udvikle og drive sammen med resten af det skattepolitiske team. Derudover holder Dansk Erhverv på skatteområdet løbende konferencer og netværksmøder, vejleder medlemmer, ligesom vi er talerør for vores medlemmer over for politikere, myndigheder og medier.

Den ideelle kandidat har skattefaglig erfaring og et bredt skattepolitisk kendskab, forståelse for det politiske system og skattemyndighederne – og vigtigst af alt brænder for skattepolitik og sager.

Erfaring med og fagligt kendskab til erhvervslivets skatteforhold er et stort plus, og du skal have lyst til at vejlede bredt om skattefaglige sager til Dansk Erhvervs medlemskreds.

Opgaverne vil bl.a. bestå af:

  • Drive og udvikle Dansk Erhvervs skattepolitik med medlemmerne i centrum

  • Kommentering af skattepolitiske emner og betydning for erhvervslivet

  • Drive faglige netværk og være Dansk Erhvervs talsperson på skat – i både pressen og med politiske stakeholders

  • Skrive høringssvar og positionspapirer

  • Deltagelse i politiske dialoger og møder internt og eksternt

  • Vejlede Dansk Erhvervs medlemmer om skatteforhold

  • Tage ansvar for at udvikle en konsistent skattepolitik på tværs af hele Dansk Erhverv

Med i bagagen har du

Vi forestiller os, at du har relevant erfaring med politisk interessevaretagelse inden for skat og afgifter.

Vi forventer, at du er idérig med politisk forståelse og er god til at skrive og formidle politiske budskaber, både skriftligt og mundtligt. At du har gode samarbejdsevner og trives i et travlt miljø, hvor tempoet er højt og hvor du kan holde overblikket og arbejde med flere sager, der kører samtidigt.

Følgende beskrivelse passer på dig:

  • Du har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund indenfor jura, økonomi, statskundskab, eller lignende

  • Du har praktisk erfaring indenfor skatteområdet gerne fra en skattefunktion i en virksomhed eller som rådgiver

  • Du har gode analytiske evner og erfaring med at være i dialog med politiske stakeholders

  • Du har gode kommunikationsevner og lyst til at være Dansk Erhvervs skattepolitiske ansigt i medier og lignende

  • Du er initiativrig og arbejdsom

Vi tilbyder

En spændende stilling med mulighed for faglig udvikling, ledelse af et mindre team, ansvar for egne projekter og indflydelse på vigtige politiske dagsordner.

Et job i en nytænkende og moderne erhvervs- og arbejdsgiverorganisation, hvis mission er at skabe konkurrencekraft for vores medlemmer. Du får resultatorienterede, engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger, der agerer professionelt og fagligt i top, og du kan forvente en arbejdsplads med højt humør og kort fra tanke til handling. Kulturen i Dansk Erhverv er kendetegnet ved, at vi er handlekraftige, netværksorienterede og vi spiller hinanden gode.

Vi tilbyder varierende arbejdsopgaver i et uformelt miljø. Vi er netværksorienterede og lægger stor vægt på faglige fællesskaber.

Dit daglige arbejde vil foregå i Tietgenhus. Løn og pensionsordning efter aftale.

Ansøgningen

I Dansk Erhverv mener vi, at mangfoldighed gør os stærkere og medvirker til at skabe udvikling og fornyelse. Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, religiøs overbevisning, seksuel orientering, politisk tilhørsforhold og etnisk oprindelse mv.

Du kan få yderligere oplysninger hos nuværende skattechef Kasper Svendsen, kasv@danskerhverv.dk eller Underdirektør Sofie Findling Andersen, sfia@danskerhverv.dk.

Brænder du for skattepolitik og ønsker at gøre en forskel for danske virksomheder, så hører vi gerne fra dig. Ansøgning bilagt cv og eksamenspapirer sendes online via linket ”ansøg” hurtigst muligt og senest den 29. oktober 2026.

Dansk Erhverv handler på vegne af vores medlemmer og samfundet
I Dansk Erhverv handler vi hver dag på vegne af 18.000 medlemsvirksomheder og flere end 100 brancheforeninger. Vi er erhvervsorganisation og arbejdsgiverforening for et af verdens mest handlekraftige erhvervsliv. Vi tilbyder rådgivning inden for medarbejder- og virksomhedsforhold og politisk gennemslagskraft. Vores indsatser bygger på medlemmernes aktive deltagelse i netværk og udvalg. I Dansk Erhverv arbejder vi hver dag for, at Danmark bliver verdens bedste land at drive virksomhed i. Det er vores vision. For kun på den måde kan vi fremtidssikre velstanden og velfærden.
