title: Senior FPGA/Prototype Design Engineer
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

We are seeking a Senior FPGA/Prototype Design Engineer to work in conjunction with the Design Validation team to ensure our ASIC designs are fully validated. You partner with design, verification, and software teams to accelerate software development, enable early hardware integration, and support post-silicon bring up. Your work directly supports Blue Origin's mission of enabling millions of people to live and work in space for the benefit of Earth.


Key Responsibilities:


• Develop and maintain ASIC to FPGA retargeting flows, including resource constraints, clock rate reductions, and memory retargeting.

• Deliver FPGA prototype platforms covering multiple design configurations, top levels, and release qualification.

• Qualify commercial emulation platforms for release and assess test case compatibility and coverage partitioning against simulation.

• Reproduce and debug prototype and emulation failures with design and verification teams through resolution.

• Build portable platform environments spanning block and top level, RTL and gate, pre-silicon and silicon.

• Support post-silicon bring up using shared pre-silicon bench and simulation platforms.

• Accelerate software development and early hardware integration through prototype releases and documented feature limitations.

• Support internal platform users through triage, documentation, and direct technical assistance.


Basic Qualifications:


• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• 7+ years of experience in FPGA prototyping, emulation, or digital design verification.

• Experience with FPGA implementation tools and flows, including synthesis, constraints, and timing closure.

• Experience developing and debugging production RTL in System Verilog or Verilog authored by others.

• Experience defining FPGA prototype or emulation flows, including build automation and release management.


Preferred Qualifications:


• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Experience with emulation platforms supporting large scale SoC validation and release.

• Background in space-based communications, wireless communications, modem, baseband, or DSP hardware.

• Experience verifying LDPC, FEC, framing, or beamforming logic using bit-accurate reference models.

• Experience with interconnect or NoC verification covering performance, bandwidth, QoS, and deadlock analysis.

• Experience verifying fault tolerance features such as ECC, redundancy schemes, or fault injection.

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Candidates may be subject to verification and BGS screening as per applicable law.

title: Junior Embedded Operations Engineer
description:
The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate for this role is a hands-on engineer who enjoys working at the bench and is not afraid to get stuck into a problem. You are comfortable with microcontrollers, the command line, and test equipment, and you can read a datasheet without needing someone to explain it to you. When something does not work, you dig into it, find the cause, and document what you found. You are early in your career, but you take initiative and do not wait to be told what to do next.

Key Responsibilities

As a Junior Embedded Operations Engineer, you will:

  • Build, flash, and test proof-of-concept setups for new sensors, modules, and features.

  • Read and interpret technical datasheets to evaluate and integrate new components.

  • Use oscilloscopes, test jigs, and HIL (hardware-in-the-loop) setups to find faults and debug issues.

  • Support our production runs with our external manufacturer by reviewing test results and flagging issues early.

  • Help monitor our deployed Data Collector™ units and troubleshoot device issues using logs and data.

  • Write scripts to automate testing and repetitive operational tasks.

  • Travel occasionally to customer sites to support device deployments.

  • Document setups, test results, and procedures thoroughly and consistently.

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with microcontrollers (e.g., STM32, ESP32), from work, studies, or personal projects.

  • Experience with command-line scripting (Bash, Python, or similar).

  • Good understanding of Linux.

  • Experience with AWS IoT or a similar cloud IoT platform.

  • Practical experience with oscilloscopes (DSO), multimeters, and other test equipment.

  • Understanding of test jigs, HIL testing, and other testing methods for finding faults.

  • Ability to read and understand technical datasheets independently.

  • Comfortable with practical, hands-on work such as wiring, measuring, and basic soldering.

  • Committed to documenting all the work and processes you own.

  • Ability to work with a high degree of independence and take initiative.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

  • Residing within commuting distance of our Copenhagen office - no remote, no relocation.

Good To Have

  • Experience with cellular IoT (LTE-M/NB-IoT) and MQTT.

  • Experience with RS-485/Modbus or other industrial communication interfaces.

  • Previous experience providing technical support within a team.

What We Offer

  • A full-time, in-office position.

  • A professional and positive working environment.

  • Hands-on work on real products deployed on the electrical grid.

  • The opportunity to work closely with experienced engineers.

  • An environment that genuinely rewards proactiveness and new ideas.

  • Encouragement to develop your own tools and improve our processes.

  • A cozy office close to public transportation (between Frederiksberg Allé and Enghave Plads metro stations).

How To Apply

Please apply with your resume in English through The Hub. Only candidates who apply through The Hub will be considered for this position. Applications via email will be disregarded. Use the provided email address only for inquiries or further information about the role.

In your application, briefly tell us about a hardware or device problem you solved on your own. Links to projects, GitHub, or photos of your work are very welcome.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. Everyone is welcome here, regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

For more information or questions, please contact us.

For more information or questions please contact us at vedant@oktogrid.io or phone number +45-25768888

Working at

Oktogrid

Oktogrid™ is helping electricity providers bring the grid online for higher reliability and a safer energy transition. The future will be electric, Oktogrid™ is giving the insights needed to keep the power flowing. We are a dedicated team working with industry heavyweights in optimising the usage of the electrical grid and making sure that the electrification of our society remains sustainable.

title: Driftsansvarlig for egen portefølje • CEJ, København
description:
**Driftsleder med ansvar for egen portefølje

**Vil du være en del af en virksomhed, hvor fællesskab, samarbejde og trivsel er i centrum? Vi søger en engageret medarbejder, der vil vokse sammen med os i en kultur, der fremmer både faglig og personlig udvikling.

Vi søger en driftsleder, der vil stå i spidsen for driften og sikre, at hverdagen kører effektivt, sikkert og med høj kvalitet.

_CEJ Ejendomsadministration er blandt landets største ejendomsadministrationsselskaber. Vi administrerer i dag en portefølje på omkring 1.600 ejendomme for både private foreninger og professionelle investorer, og dækker hele Danmark fra vores afdelinger i København og Aarhus.

_Du bliver en del af en stabil ejendomsadministration, der tager stadig flere markedsandele. Vores ca. 300 medarbejdere er et bredt udpluk af eksperter indenfor administration, økonomi, teknik, jura og IT.

Vores driftsafdeling har ca. 60 medarbejdere, hvis du ønsker en rolle med ansvar, mulighed for et tæt samarbejde med både medarbejdere, leverandører og kunder på en arbejdsplads med højt humør og hvor smil vægtes højt, så er det dig vi søger.

**Din fremtidige rolle

**Vi søger en ny kollega til vores investeringskunde segment, hvor du skal have relevant erfaring og skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt med drift og udvikling af ejendomme.

I rollen vil du skulle arbejde på tværs i vores organisation, og have berøring med alle afdelinger, fordi vi arbejder med en matrix organisering, for at sikre en optimal håndtering af vores kunder.

**Dine Arbejdsopgaver

**

  • Driftsmæssig ansvarlig på egen portefølje af ejendomme
  • Overordnet ansvar for optimering af drift
  • Udarbejdelse af drifts- og vedligeholdelsesbudgetter
  • Ansvarlig for optimering af driftsudgifter på porteføljeniveau
  • Have tæt dialog med ejere, asset managere mm. om udvikling af de forskellige ejendomme
  • Udføre vedligeholdelsesplaner og bygningssyn
  • Udføre tilsyn og byggestyring ved mindre ombygninger/istandsættelser (udbud, bygge- og økonomistyring)
  • Teknisk sparring med driftslederne og administratorer internt i organisationen
  • Ad hoc-opgaver, herunder teknisk bistand til administratorer, ejere om drift- og vedligeholdelse af ejendomme, samt eventuelt lejlighedsvise syn og håndværkerkontakt i forbindelse med istandsættelser af lejligheder

**Vi tilbyder

**

  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling
  • Et konstant udfordrende og afvekslende job, som du selv er med til at planlægge
  • Sociale, imødekommende og humoristiske kollegaer i alle aldersgrupper
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer
  • Frokostordning, pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring m.m.

**Vores drømmekandidater

**Du tænker kreativt, arbejder struktureret og trives i dialogen med både kolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere og kunder. Samtidig motiveres du af at være en del af et team, hvor vi spiller hinanden gode, deler viden og skaber resultater sammen.

**Du Har Flere Af Nedenstående Kvalifikationer

**

  • Er struktureret og har gode vaner ift. at skabe overblik, har struktureret tilgang til drift, opfølgning og beslutningsgrundlag
  • Kan arbejde i et travlt miljø, hvor der er løbende udvikling
  • Er udadvendt og ligetil
  • Kan kommunikere i øjenhøjde med både store og mindre kunder, både skriftligt og i tale
  • Har forretningsforståelse og formår at se helheden i arbejdet
  • Tager ansvar og når i mål med opgaverne
  • Kan arbejde tværfagligt og ser vigtigheden i det
  • Gerne erfaring fra en driftsafdeling/ejendomsadministration
  • Har kørekort

**CEJ som arbejdsplads

**Når du vælger CEJ som arbejdsplads, bliver du en del af en virksomhed, hvor høj faglighed, socialt samvær og humor går hånd i hånd. Vi prioriterer den kollegiale hygge, selvom arbejdstempoet er højt.

I CEJ har vi højt til loftet og kort vej til ledelsen, og det betyder, at dine ambitioner kan blive realiseret hurtigere end noget andet sted. CEJ er ejet af en erhvervsdrivende fond, stiftet i 1986 af Carl Emil Jensen, som startede CEJ i 1950’erne. CEJ Aarhus kom til i 2012.

Læs mere om CEJ og vores tilgang til miljø, kultur, sociale fællesskaber samt ansvarlig virksomhedsdrift og ledelse i vores ansvarlighedsrapport.

Vi tilbyder attraktive personalegoder, som blandt andet omfatter pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring og fysioterapi, samt fredagsbarer, fester og sportsaktiviteter for vores medarbejdere i alle aldersgrupper. Og din arbejdsplads vil ligge centralt på Frederiksberg.

**Ansøgning

**Har du lyst til at blive en del af CEJ’s organisation, så send os din ansøgning og CV ved at klikke på "ANSØG" ovenfor.

Vi interviewer løbende kandidater og besætter stillingen så hurtigt som muligt. Opslaget vil derfor være tilgængeligt, indtil vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Vi behandler alle henvendelser fortroligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at Mads Blomgreen på tlf. 70 70 52 06.

title: Lokalsamordnare till Nynäshamns kommun
description:
Vill du vara med och se till att kommunens lokaler möter verksamheternas behov – både i dag och i framtiden? Som lokalsamordnare får du en central roll i att samla behov, skapa struktur och föra lokalfrågor framåt. Du blir en viktig länk mellan kommunens verksamheter och de funktioner som arbetar med fastighetsfrågor och bidrar till välgrundade beslut och lösningar som fungerar över tid.

Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer in i ett verksamhetsområde under utveckling och får vara med och påverka hur kommunen arbetar med lokalförsörjning framåt. I rollen samarbetar du nära lokalstrateg och andra kollegor med olika kompetenser. Du får växla mellan självständigt arbete och gemensam problemlösning i en varierad vardag.

Som lokalsamordnare kommer du bland annat att:

  • vara en central kontakt och ett stöd för förvaltningarna i lokalfrågor
  • fånga upp, sammanställa och analysera verksamheternas nuvarande och framtida lokalbehov
  • samordna lokalärenden mellan verksamheter, lokalstrateg, fastighetsavdelning och andra berörda funktioner
  • stödja verksamheterna vid exempelvis förändrade lokalbehov, omlokaliseringar, samlokaliseringar och avveckling av lokaler
  • ta fram och kvalitetssäkra underlag inför prioriteringar, beslut och beställningar
  • följa lokalärenden genom processen och bidra till tydlighet kring ansvar, tidplan och nästa steg
  • medverka i arbetet med kommunens lokalförsörjningsplan och andra planeringsunderlag
  • utveckla arbetssätt, rutiner och gemensamma processer inom lokalförsörjningsområdet
  • bidra till en aktuell och samlad bild av kommunens lokaler, lokalbehov och nyttjandegrad
  • delta i relevanta projekt, arbetsgrupper och samverkansforum.

Tjänstens innehåll kan utvecklas över tid i takt med att kommunens gemensamma arbete med lokalförsörjning fortsätter att utvecklas.

Om arbetsplatsen

Kommunstyrelseförvaltningens uppdrag är att leda, samordna och följa upp kommunens verksamheter. Vi säkerställer att kommunen fungerar effektivt och att invånarna får den service de behöver, samtidigt som vi stöttar förtroendevalda och förvaltningar. Rollen kommer finnas inom ekonomiavdelningen som består av fyra enheter; Ledningsstöd, Redovisning, Lön och Upphandling. Avdelningen har ca 40 medarbetare. Du kommer att vara placerad inom Ledningsstöd som är en stödverksamhet till framför allt chefer inom hela kommunen. Medarbetare inom Ledningsstöd består av controllers och ekonomer, kvalitetscontrollers, statistiker, portföljstrateg och lokalstrateg.

Det här söker vi hos dig

Vi söker dig som har:

  • relevant högskoleutbildning eller annan utbildning och erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig
  • erfarenhet av lokalförsörjning, fastighetsfrågor eller lokalplanering
  • god förståelse för hur lokaler fungerar utifrån både verksamheternas behov och de krav som ställs
  • erfarenhet av samordning, utredning, verksamhetsutveckling, projektledning eller liknande arbete
  • förmåga att samla in, strukturera och analysera information samt omsätta den i tydliga underlag
  • god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift
  • god digital kompetens och vana att arbeta i olika administrativa system.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

  • arbete i en politiskt styrd organisation
  • kommunal verksamhet och dess planerings- och beslutsprocesser
  • att leda eller samordna processer med många berörda parter
  • ekonomiska underlag, avtal eller uppföljning inom lokal- eller fastighetsområdet.

Personliga egenskaper vi letar efter

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara strukturerad och ha förmåga att se både helheten och de frågor som behöver lösas här och nu. Du arbetar självständigt, tar initiativ och driver frågor framåt samtidigt som du är lyhörd för verksamheternas olika behov. Eftersom arbetet innebär många kontaktytor behöver du vara kommunikativ och ha lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla samarbeten. Du kan hantera flera parallella frågor, tydliggöra komplexa sammanhang och bidra till lösningar när olika behov och perspektiv behöver vägas samman.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Det här erbjuder vi dig

  • Hos oss får du göra skillnad i människors liv. Här har du nära till din chef och dina kollegor, påverkan och beslut.

  • Nynäshamn är en lugn och trygg kommun. Tryggheten finns även i våra team – vi är prestigelösa, uppmuntrar och backar upp varandra när det behövs.

  • Nynäshamns kommun är en del av Sveriges starkaste tillväxtregion. Vår resa ger dig möjlighet till utmaningar och varierande arbetsuppgifter.

  • Vi erbjuder tillgång till gym. Du får även friskvårdstimme eller friskvårdsbidrag.

  • Du har möjlighet till semester- och pensionsväxling.

  • Vi har en aktiv personalförening där du kan hyra stugor i fjällen och i skärgården. Du kan också delta i olika aktiviteter som till exempel padel, kajak och ridning.

  • Här har vi flextid och kortare arbetstid under sommaren. Det finns också möjlighet till distansarbete.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och använder en kompetensbaserad rekryteringsmetod för en rättvis och objektiv bedömning. Mångfald är en tillgång, och vi välkomnar alla sökande. Nynäshamns kommun har valt att ta bort det personliga brevet och ersatt det med urvalsfrågor som är relevanta för tjänsten. Svaren i urvalsfrågorna och CV ligger till grund för om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i processen.

Vissa tjänster kan kräva utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

The Claims Examiner position handles a variety of claims with a focus on providing the highest level of service for policyholders and ICW Group to bring claims to an equitable conclusion within Company standards and best practice guidelines. The Claims Examiner works with a sense of urgency, understands insurance coverage concepts, and navigates the legal system with the support of counsel to drive strategic outcomes.

  • Effectively communicates with policyholders, agents, attorneys, and witnesses to gather information and provide the highest possible level of customer service.

  • Utilizes appropriate resolution tactics (e.g., mediation, negotiation, denial, litigation or offer) to proactively drive outstanding results.
  • Operates within the requirements of related state and/or the governing entity rules and regulations as well as internal claims handling policies and procedures.
  • Partners with defense counsel throughout the litigation process in line with ICW litigation guidelines while monitoring legal fees and costs

All Claims Examiners:

  • Makes recommendations for streamlining processes
  • Ensures accuracy of data in claims system for compliance with applicable regulatory reporting
  • Provides knowledge transfer across the organization
  • Continuously seeks to improve technical skills by attending job related training and tracking current case law

  • Administers timely and appropriate benefits to injured workers; manages and approves payment of benefits within designated authority level. Works within applicable state rules, regulations as well as ICW Group’s internal claims handling policies and procedures.
  • Creates and adjusts reserves in a timely manner to ensure reserving activities are consistent with company policies
  • Resolves claims fairly and equitably, acting in the best interest of the insured while providing timely benefits to injured workers as required by law

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position has no supervisory responsibility


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Bachelor's degree (or equivalent combination of education and experience) required along with a minimum 1- 4+ years’ related claims or claims handling experience.


CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Workers’ Compensation: Certification that meets the minimum standards of training, experience, and skill required. WCCA and WCCP preferred. State Workers Compensation License is required in some branches.

  • Write reports and business correspondence
  • Respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers (insured), claimants and regulatory agencies
  • Present information at meetings, to management and clients
  • Solve practical problems and deal with a variety of variables in situations where limited standardization exists

Workers’ Compensation: Knowledge of workers’ compensation claims handling, reserving, litigation management, and resolution strategies

Office environment – no specific or unusual physical or environmental demands and employees are regularly required to sit, walk, stand, talk, and hear.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

title: Samordnare med IT-kompetens
description:
Jordbruksverket finns för att främja en ökad och hållbar matproduktion och god djurvälfärd i hela Sverige. Vi bidrar till en levande landsbygd. Hos oss arbetar cirka 1850 personer. Huvudkontoret ligger i Jönköping men vi har även stor regional verksamhet. 

Vi arbetar aktivt för att våra medarbetare ska vara hållbara och trivas på jobbet! Vi investerar långsiktigt i våra medarbetare och vill att de utvecklas tillsammans med oss! Vi erbjuder en god arbetsmiljö med generösa förmåner med upp till 35 semesterdagar, friskvårdsbidrag samt friskvårdstid. I en stor del av våra anställningar erbjuder vi en flexibel arbetstid, möjlighet att jobba mobilt och arbeta delar av arbetstiden på distans.

Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta på Jordbruksverket på vår webbplats: www.jordbruksverket.se/jobbahososs

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Har du erfarenhet av en samordnande roll och förmåga att lyfta blicken och se hur saker hänger ihop? Har du intresse för IT-utveckling och erfarenhet av utvecklingsarbete? Har du kunskap om lantbrukets förutsättningar och tycker det är viktigt med ett livskraftigt jordbruk i Sverige? Då kan du vara en av våra nya kollegor!

Vi söker en samordnare till Stödutvecklingsenheten. Vi är idag 28 medarbetare på enheten som gemensamt driver arbetet framåt. I den här rollen kommer du ha ett eget ansvar för att rätt uppgifter prioriteras och genomförs. Du arbetar tätt tillsammans med kollegor inom Jordbruksverket men har även externa kontakter framförallt med Länsstyrelsen.

Enheten har ett viktigt arbete att tillsammans med andra utforma effektiva stöd och processer som både är enkla för lantbrukaren och enkla att administrera. Enheten ansvarar för kravställning, acceptanstest och systemförvaltning av de system som finns för handläggning av jordbrukarstöden till lantbrukare.

EU :s jordbrukspolitik genomförs i olika reformer. De närmaste åren kommer vi parallellt att arbeta med nuvarande och nästa reform. Det innebär att arbetet kommer att präglas av att forma, utveckla och sjösätta den framtida jordbrukspolitiken. Det kommer bland annat innebära skriva underlag, utforma och realisera nya stöd och arbetssätt, utveckla våra IT-system och införa digital teknik. Parallellt med detta arbete kommer vi att fokusera på att hitta mer effektiva arbetssätt så att hela jordbrukarstödsprocessen får ett effektivare flöde till nytta för våra kunder. Arbetet kommer att präglas av mycket nyutveckling där alla inblandade måste vara drivande.

Som samordnare är de huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifterna

	• Utforma krav på hur IT-system ska fungera och testa IT-system.
	• Skriva rutiner, meddelanden och genomföra utbildningar för länsstyrelsen.
	• Delta i tvärfunktionella grupper och andra arbetsgrupper framförallt med fokus på nästa reform.
	• Delta i revisioner som genomförs av Ekonomistyrningsverket, Revisionsrätten och EU-kommissionen.
	• Utveckla nya arbetssätt och metoder för att hitta effektivare arbetssätt.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har en högskoleutbildning inom relevant område samt god kunskap om svenska jordbrukets villkor och förutsättningar. Du talar och skriver bra svenska. Det är viktigt att du har erfarenhet av att kravställa IT-system då detta är en betydande del av arbetet. 

Det är meriterande om du har

	• Erfarenhet av en samordnande roll
	• Erfarenhet av att arbeta i handläggningssystem
	• Erfarenhet av arbete där utveckling stor i fokus

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och söker dig som kan skapa och hålla ihop strukturer och processer både för dig själv och andra. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och vill jobba mot gemensamma mål. Du kan se helheten och samband i komplex information. Du är prestigelös och kan tänka utanför boxen och hitta nya lösningar på problem.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Löneform: Månadslön.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Placeringsort är Jönköping med möjlighet att arbeta delar av arbetstiden på distans.

För oss är det viktigt att all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden tillvaratas. Vi välkomnar alla sökande och eftersträvar mångfald. Vi tillämpar normalt 6 månaders provanställning.

Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning beroende på din kompetens, erfarenhet och ansvar i enlighet med de centrala löneavtalen RALS/RALS-T.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi vill därför inte bli kontaktade av annonsförsäljare eller rekryteringsföretag.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Job Title

Integration Engineer

Job Description


Vanderlande is the global market leader for future-proof logistic process automation at airports and in the parcel market. Furthermore, we are also a leading supplier of process automation solutions for warehouses, which seamlessly integrate innovative systems, intelligent software and life-cycle services.


At Vanderlande, you can develop your career, satisfy your ambitions, aspire to new heights, while enjoying personal growth and thriving on achievement.

General merchandise, fashion and food retail companies need to be flexible in handling the levels of orders, fulfil online orders and store deliveries, and cope with a lack of available workforce. Such companies continuously improve their supply chains and invest in innovative technologies. Vanderlande understands the complexities associated with operating a successful warehouse operation and delivers future proof logistic process automation.

These automation systems are composed of many (electro-)mechanical and IT components, built by teams in various parts of the world and must be integrated with other (software) systems to support the processes of our customers.


Your position

As an Integration Engineer, your part of the integration team and involved in integrating the various components and (sub)systems into a solution. This is especially challenging for large and complex systems consisting of individual carrier systems, automatic storage and retrieval systems, automated guided vehicles, robots, conveyors, control software and IT infrastructure. You test the system to ensure that it works according to the design. Often, testing involves attempts to intentionally break the system to identify any problem areas, based on an analysis of technical risks. Test- and integration engineers contribute to the success of projects through their superior knowledge of the system as a whole, its operational objectives, how its parts work together, and the technical factors that go into its development.


Key tasks and responsibilities:

  • Create test case designs based on test plan and design documentation.
  • Program stubs/drivers (test harness).
  • Create test scripts (for automatic tests).
  • Prepare test environment (setup IT infra, deploy software and tooling, configure system).
  • Operate system (using GUI and scripts/commands) and test environments (e.g. emulation models).
  • Align with stakeholders on test execution and defect solution (internally with product teams and development, externally with user representatives).
  • Execute tests (both in factory and on site) and log results.
  • Verification of solutions to defects.
  • Create test reports.
  • Create issue reports (in change management tooling).
  • Manage and coordinate groups of people for test preparation and execution.
  • Perform zone level testing supporting PLC / SCADA commissioning
  • Perform area level testing supporting PLC / SCADA commissioning
  • Document integrated system level testing for PLC and SCADA commissioning (Low Volume / High Volume test)

Required qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, or Software Engineering or Equivalent or 1 year of experience in implementation of material handling systems or industrial controls systems or 1 years of experience in PLC applications (Allen-Bradley Preferred, Siemens is also valuable).
  • Must be willing and able to travel 60% routinely, with increased amounts if projects demand.
  • This position may require occasional on-call after-hours support.
  • Good communication skills in English.
  • Proactive and willingness to learn.
  • Ownership culture.
  • Knowledge of computer systems and Windows (personal computers).
  • Must be able to communicate effectively.
  • Must have the ability to properly prioritize work/activities.
  • Ability to work in a team and autonomous situations.
  • Team mentality and willingness to accept responsibility for project completion.
  • Possess a strong ability to solve problems and research solutions

Desired qualifications:

  • Solid understanding of Electrical controls hardware design and 480 VAC / 120VAC / 24VDC power distribution.
  • Solid understanding of networking principles and computer hardware selection and setup.

title: Sterile Processing Tech I 40 Hours
description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities including but not limited to:


1. Ensures proper operation of autoclave equipment prior to use on a daily basis. Inspects gas plasma and steam autoclaves for visible signs of malfunction and reports discrepancy to supervisor immediately.

2. Performs biological and chemical tests during work shift. Maintains appropriate spore testing routinely and records results as required.

3. Follows policy and procedure in processing all contaminated instruments and supplies returned to Sterile Processing. Disassembles and cleans procedure trays and instruments using detergent. Replaces lost or damaged instruments as required to complete the tray.

4. Uses knowledge of sterilization principle to correctly wrap and package items for sterilization.

5. Assembles all instrument procedure trays and packs, using instrument count sheets as a guide. Accurately labels supplies with appropriate identification, indicating the date prepared and sterilized, preparer’s initials, and product name.

6. Processes all applicable items using the appropriate form of sterilization.

8. Applies aseptic technique in daily work assignment. Performs general cleaning

of work surfaces, supply shelves, and storage cabinets. Maintains assigned work areas and equipment in a clean and organized condition to maintain required standards for handling of sterilized and clean materials and equipment.

9. Assembles case carts for Operating Room and Day Surgery, including instrument kits and disposable products for use in-patient care areas. Utilizes hospital computer system to accurately order and charge for supplies.

10. Handles soiled instruments and equipment from ancillary departments to be reprocessed.

11. Receives, replenishes and rotates material into the Sterile Processing Department inventory storage areas.

12. Identifies inactive and outdated supplies, makes recommendation for inventory reduction or deletion, submits inventory correction and adjustment to supervisor.

10. Accurately charges all supplies through computerized inventory management system.

11. Participates in the training and orientation of new employees. Assists in supplies distribution as assigned.

Ability to read, write, understand, follow written and verbal instructions, and communicate effectively in English

Knowledge of all general and special instrumentation.

Understanding of infection control principles and sterilization techniques.

Routine heavy lifting, pushing, bending, carrying, standing, and walking constantly.

Position requires rotating weekend and holiday availability.

title: Team Leader
description:
By living according to a common set of values, we create a culture that unifies, embraces the uniqueness we all bring to the company, and positions Integer for long-term success.

At Integer, our values are embedded in everything we do.

Customer

We focus on our customers’ success

Innovation

We create better solutions

Collaboration

We create success together

Inclusion

We always interact with others respectfully

Candor

We are open and honest with one another

Integrity

We do the right things and do things right

Integer is a global organization providing innovative, high-quality technologies and manufacturing to Medical Device OEM’s to enhance the lives of patients worldwide. Our two major business lines are as a Medical Device Outsourcer (including the businesses of Cardiac & Vascular, Cardiac Rhythm Management & Neuromodulation, and Power Solutions) and a provider of high-end, niche batteries (the business of Electrochem) for specialized applications in the energy, military, and environmental markets. We are guided by our six values, including Customer, Innovation, Collaboration, Inclusion, Candor, and Integrity. Working at Integer means you are part of a team passionately pursuing excellence in all that we do and always reaching for the next great achievement.

The primary purpose of this role is to provide support to the manufacturing team in achieving its production goals and customer quality requirements. This includes monitoring and escalating any issues to the production supervisor, engaging the team, helping drive to continuous improvement within the area, and performing supporting tasks to allow the operators to focus on their main tasks.

title: Avionics Hardware Engineer (Level 3) - Lunar Permenence
description:
Application close date:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

As part of a passionate and accomplished team of experts, you will be a crucial member of our Core Avionics organization in the Lunar Permanence Business Unit. Directly contribute to the successful development of avionics components for our Lunar Vehicles. Work with a team of engineers to define, test, and certify avionics hardware. Responsibilities for this role are varied and dynamic, spanning the entire product life cycle from conception to sustainment, with partners across multiple technical functions. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration to enable affordable, safe, and repeatable spaceflight.

You will be working on development, manufacturing, and testing of Lunar Command and Data Handling (C&DH) and Power Management and Distribution (PMAD) components. Your engineering responsibilities include developing product requirements, defining interfaces, supporting hardware build, integration, and test, developing and implementing verification and qualification strategies, conducting root cause analysis, and developing mitigation plans for hardware failures.

Above all, we are looking for an avionics hardware engineer who is intellectually curious, holds a strong desire to continuously improve the capability and quality of products, and is dedicated to safety. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Special Mentions

  • Relocation provided
  • Travel expected up to 20% of the time. Most work will reside in Kent, WA.
  • Predominately 1st shift M-F; however, some evening or weekend work may be required during prime test campaigns
  • On-site requirement 5-days / week
  • Multiple positions available

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Supporting C&DH and PMAD Responsible Engineers in avionics box lifecycle development in areas such as:

  • Hardware build, integration, and test of Engineering Development Unit (EDU) and flight hardware
  • Verification and qualification activities
  • Requirements development and interface definition
  • Root cause analyses for hardware failures and mitigation plan development

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, or other related field
  • Avionics hardware build and test experience
  • Complex hardware design experience in product design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR)
  • Knowledge of / experience in requirements development and requirements-based verification
  • Familiarity with integrated systems verification, including developing hardware verification test plans and verification test reports for certification / qualification
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master of Science in Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related fields
  • Successful candidates typically have 6+ years of proven track record in design, development, or test of space industry avionics components and systems
  • Experience developing digital, analog, and / or mixed-signal circuit board designs for avionics systems (including design, prototyping, schematics, layout, test and verification)
  • Experience in circuit analysis and simulation, such as worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity analysis, and logic or P-Spice simulation
  • Experience in grounding and general board layout principles, including EMI/EMC tradeoffs
  • Experience with Jama or similar requirements management tools
  • Experience with MIL-STD/DO-160/SMC-S-016 environmental qualification testing of avionics hardware
  • Familiarity with ARP 4754 and/or DO-254/DO-178 or similar standards
  • Familiarity with product development lifecycle phases
  • Familiarity with hardware development, integration, or verification


Base Pay Range for:

WA applicants is $130,706.00 - $182,987.70

Other site ranges may differ

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. title: Product Designer
description:
Product design at Taylor & Francis is a creative and strategic discipline that shapes our platforms and user experiences. As a Product Designer reporting to the Head of Product Design, you'll own end-to-end design from problem discovery to production-ready solutions, creating meaningful experiences for the people who use our products.

This role goes beyond traditional UX design. You'll bring product thinking to design and design thinking to product, understanding both why and how something should be built. You'll actively use research, data and direct customer contact throughout your design process, while maintaining a high standard of interaction design and visual craft.

As part of a growing design function, you'll also help shape how we approach design across Taylor & Francis, contributing to shared standards, collaborative practices and a culture of continuous improvement.

Discovery & Problem Shaping

You'll be an active participant in discovery, not simply a recipient of its outputs. You'll help define which problems are worth solving and shape how teams investigate them.

  • Engage directly with customers and users, conducting your own qualitative research, exploring behavioural data and bringing a designer's perspective to understanding user needs.
  • Partner with design and research team to plan research activities and translate findings into actionable design opportunities.
  • Contribute to problem framing and opportunity definition alongside Product Managers, using journey maps, service blueprints and experience principles to make complex problems tangible.
  • Identify the moments in user journeys that matter most and advocate for the design investment those moments deserve.
  • Bring an informed design perspective to prioritisation, balancing user needs, business goals and technical considerations.

Design Craft & Execution

You'll bring strong interaction design expertise and attention to detail, creating experiences that are usable, accessible, consistent and thoughtfully designed.

  • Lead the design process end-to-end, from early sketches and conceptual exploration through wireframes, interaction design, prototyping and high-fidelity production-ready designs.
  • Explore multiple design directions for significant problems, using creative exploration and evidence to inform decisions rather than converging too quickly on a single solution.
  • Design thoughtful interactions that consider feedback, states, transitions, error handling, accessibility and edge cases.
  • Build and test prototypes at the fidelity appropriate to the question, from quick sketches to detailed interactive prototypes.
  • Work closely with Engineering and Product teams to understand technical constraints, business rules and the full range of scenarios designs need to support.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of our design system, helping create consistent, accessible and reusable experiences across products.

Research-Informed Design

Strong design at Taylor & Francis is grounded in genuine user understanding. You'll be an active contributor to research, not just a consumer of its findings.

  • Plan and conduct lightweight research activities, including usability testing, concept evaluation and exploratory interviews, as a natural part of your design process.
  • Collaborate with UX Researchers on more complex studies, contributing to research questions, synthesis and the translation of findings into design decisions.
  • Combine qualitative research, behavioural analytics and customer intelligence to inform and evaluate design decisions.
  • Identify assumptions and uncertainties early, determining what needs to be tested before committing to solutions.
  • Maintain an understanding of user behaviours and needs through regular engagement with research, data and direct customer contact.

Cross-Functional Partnership

The best experiences at Taylor & Francis come from close collaboration across Design, Product, Engineering, Research and Data.

  • Work with Engineering from early in the design process, involving technical colleagues in problem exploration and solution development.
  • Partner with Product Managers to shape what gets built, not just how it looks, contributing to roadmap discussions, trade-offs and definitions of success.
  • Collaborate with Data and Customer Intelligence teams to understand behavioural patterns and how data-driven features can be expressed through useful, understandable experiences.
  • Work with Business Analysts and Engineering to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria reflect the intended user experience.
  • Communicate design decisions clearly, presenting the rationale, evidence and trade-offs to colleagues and senior stakeholders.

Building Our Design Practice

As part of a growing design function, you'll help establish how design operates across Taylor & Francis.

  • Contribute to shared design principles, standards and ways of working that support consistent, high-quality experiences.
  • Share your expertise through constructive critique, mentoring and collaborative problem-solving, while developing capabilities beyond your core discipline.
  • Advocate for the value of design and research, helping teams understand how evidence-led design contributes to better product and business outcomes.
  • Strong experience in product design or UX design, with a portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership of complex digital product experiences.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates both design thinking and craft, showing how you approached problems, explored alternatives and arrived at solutions.
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills, with attention to usability, accessibility, consistency and detail.
  • Genuine product instinct, with the confidence to contribute to problem definition, prioritisation and strategic product discussions.
  • Practical experience conducting user research and translating findings into design decisions.
  • Proficiency in Figma and experience contributing to or maintaining design systems.
  • Experience working collaboratively in multidisciplinary product teams, particularly alongside Product Managers and Engineers.
  • Comfort interpreting behavioural analytics and customer data to inform design decisions.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to explain and defend design decisions constructively.
  • An interest in helping establish and improve design practices within a growing team.

At Taylor & Francis we care about our colleagues, promoting work-life balance, wellbeing, and flexible working. You will be joining a thriving business, working alongside an exceptional group of people. We believe that the skills and experience you bring to Taylor & Francis are invaluable. We want you to have the opportunity to develop your abilities, and to innovate and develop in areas which you are passionate about.

This role is based in the UK and you must have the right to work and live in the UK.

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at conference – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. title: Parts Associate
description:

title: Director, Customer Solutions
description:
Job Description Summary:

The Director of Customer Solutions shapes how The Coca-Cola system serves key national retailers across DSD, e-commerce, warehouse delivery, and emerging fulfillment models. This role connects customer insight, supply chain expertise, retailer data, digital capability, and bottler execution to improve service, strengthen on-shelf availability, and create measurable value for customers and the system.

As part of the NAOU Supply Chain & Customer Operations team, this leader solves high-impact execution challenges by combining analytics, digital enablement, risk mitigation, and cross-functional leadership. The role requires strong influence, practical problem solving, and disciplined execution to deliver measurable progress.

Key Responsibilities

Customer & System Leadership

  • Build systemwide capabilities that create competitive advantage with national customers by translating retailer needs into aligned bottler engagement, package strategies, sales and operations planning, and go-to-market execution.
  • Serve as the customer-facing supply chain lead, connecting customer priorities, system capabilities, and cross-functional resources to deliver practical solutions and measurable value.

Customer & Digital Enablement

  • Advance digital, AI, automation, and order-to-cash capabilities that improve order accuracy, exception management, replenishment signals, service visibility, decision speed, execution efficiency, and customer growth.

Service Excellence & On‑Shelf Availability

  • Lead customer-specific service improvement plans that strengthen in-stock performance, on-shelf availability, shopper experience, revenue delivery, and Annual Business Plan commitments.
  • Use service metrics, customer scorecards, and early risk signals to build contingency plans, mobilize cross-functional teams, and drive continuous improvement.

Stewardship Responsibilities

  • Lead operating forums that convert retailer data, insights, replenishment signals, order patterns, and scorecards into aligned priorities, decisions, and execution plans.
  • Drive transformation by influencing without authority, building capability, scaling new ways of working, and sustaining adoption across customer, bottler, and cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations, Logistics, Engineering, Analytics, or related field required; MBA, Master’s degree, or advanced certification in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Operations, or related discipline preferred. Equivalent education and relevant experience may be considered.

title: AI Implementation Lead
description:
Help shape how AI is used at MyDefence from strategy and architecture to working solutions.

AI is moving fast. For us, the ambition is not to adopt technology simply because it is new, but to understand where it can create real value and build the right foundations to use it responsibly.

We are looking for an AI Implementation Lead who can help shape and implement MyDefence’s approach to artificial intelligence. This is a role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of strategy and hands-on technology: someone who can think about architecture, governance and long-term direction – and then turn ideas into proof-of-concepts that demonstrate what is actually possible.

You will join our IT & Security organisation, report to our CISO and become a go-to person for AI across MyDefence, working with teams across the whole global organisation.

What you will do
Your role will span AI strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on implementation. You will help us identify where AI can make a meaningful difference as well as where it should not be applied.

A key part of your role will be turning direction into something tangible. You will build and demonstrate proof-of-concepts, work with technologies such as Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, agentic frameworks and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and help move successful concepts towards production.

Your key responsibilities will include:

AI strategy, architecture & governance

  • Design MyDefence’s AI strategy, together with a Global AI-team, and target architecture, and turn it into concrete, deliverable initiatives.
  • Provide governance and oversight of AI adoption, ensuring it is responsible, compliant, and aligned with company priorities.
  • Assess opportunities and risks and recommend where AI should and should not be applied.

Technical delivery & proof-of-concept

  • Build and demonstrate proof-of-concepts hands-on using tools such as Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and similar platforms.
  • Translate strategy into working implementations and guide their move from concept to production.

Data foundations

  • Ensure the data foundations for AI are sound - proper data quality, structures, and governance are prerequisites for reliable AI.
  • Work with consultants and internal teams to get data structures right so AI can be implemented and deliver value on top of them.
  • Apply business data analytics skills to connect data, AI, and real business needs.

Staying at the frontier

  • Track developments across the AI field, including what leading providers such as
  • Anthropic and OpenAI are shipping and current best practices.
  • Maintain a clear-eyed view of pitfalls and risks so MyDefence adopts the right technologies and avoids the wrong ones.

Who we are looking for
You are curious about where AI is going and focused on turning new technology into real value. You combine technical expertise with a pragmatic, hands-on approach.

You have a relevant degree in computer science, data science, engineering or a similar field or equivalent professional experience, along with experience designing and implementing AI solutions.

We imagine that you bring:

  • Proven experience designing and implementing AI solutions, including hands-on proof-of-concept work.
  • Hands-on experience with modern AI platforms such as Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Copilot-studio.
  • Experience working with agentic frameworks and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.
  • A solid understanding of data structures, data quality, and business data analytics.
  • The ability to communicate AI concepts, opportunities and risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Experience with responsible AI adoption and relevant compliance considerations is considered an advantage.

Who you are
You are curious by nature and genuinely interested in where AI is heading, but you also have a critical eye and know how to separate hype from solutions that create real value. You enjoy working in a fast-moving field and are motivated by both exploring new possibilities and turning them into something tangible.

We see you as someone who:

  • Is curious and continuously learning, keeping up with developments and best practices within AI.
  • Takes a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach, balancing strategic thinking with getting things built.
  • Thinks critically about opportunities, risks, and limitations rather than adopting technology for technology’s sake.
  • Communicates complex topics clearly and enjoys working with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Works well across teams and is comfortable collaborating with consultants, vendors and partners.
  • Is comfortable working in a security-conscious environment where confidentiality and responsible decision-making are essential.

What we stand for
At MyDefence, we live by a shared set of values that guide us – both in how we do business and in our everyday interactions as colleagues. These values are our compass, ensuring that we move toward the same goal with courage, execution, and care.

We Dare (Courage)
We challenge the status quo, embrace new ideas, and have the courage to make decisions that move us forward.

We Do (Execution)
We take ownership, deliver on our commitments, and turn ideas into action.

We Care (I Am Your Wing(wo)man)
We support one another, succeed as a team, and build strong relationships based on trust and respect.

How to apply
If you're motivated by building, improving, and challenging the status quo rather than simply maintaining what's already in place, we'd love to hear from you.

Questions? If you have any questions about the role, please do not hesitate to reach out to Casper Skyum Høgh, who will be happy to provide further details about the position.

Submit your application and CV as soon as possible; we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position once we have found the right candidate.

As part of your employment with MyDefence, you will be required to undergo a background check tailored to your role and the level of access granted (both digital and physical). Maintaining eligibility for such background checks is a continuous requirement throughout your employment.

MyDefence
At MyDefence, we are committed to staying at the forefront of next-generation drone detection and jamming solutions. By combining advanced radio frequency expertise with precision and rapid response capabilities, we deliver tomorrow's CUAS solutions. Our close collaboration with frontline forces provides invaluable realtime insights into evolving drone threats and tactics, enabling us to innovate with unmatched accuracy.

Our solutions are purpose-built to support military operations and protect critical infrastructure, including airports, corporate facilities, and high-security environments. They empower users to detect and neutralize threats effectively while enhancing mobility and operational efficiency. With innovation at the heart of our mission, we continuously adapt to battlefield developments, ensuring our technology remains a step ahead of emerging challenges.

At MyDefence, our mission is clear: We Save Lives

title: Projektudvikler til myndighedsarbejde og planlægning af biogasanlæg
description:
Projektudvikler til myndighedsarbejde og planlægning af biogasanlæg

Vil du være med til at udvikle fremtidens Biogasanlæg og gøre en forskel for den grønne omstilling?

Vi søger en ingeniør eller kollega med anden teknisk baggrund, som vil tage ansvar for planlægning og udvikling af nye projekter inden for biogasproduktion og CO₂-fangst.

Som en del af Bigadan vil du bidrage til udvikling af biogasanlæg og teknologier, der omdanner organiske restprodukter til grøn energi.
Vi indsamler og bioforgasser organiske restprodukter som gylle og madaffald til værdifulde biogene produkter – herunder flydende biogen CO₂ til lagring i undergrunden og naturligvis grøn gas til gasnettet. Produkter, der kommer til gavn i resten af samfundet. Kort sagt skaber vi cirkulære kredsløb mellem by, land og industri med biogasteknologi.

Om jobbet
Bigadan er i gang med at udbygge sine biogasanlæg, og vi har derfor brug for en kollega, der kan drive planlægning, projektudvikling og myndighedsbehandling i projekterne.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:

  • Udarbejdelse af projektbeskrivelser og ansøgninger til store og små projekter
  • Deltage i projektudvikling og bidrage med viden til tidsplan og myndighedsproces frem til byggefase
  • Varetage dialogen med projektets interessenter, herunder myndigheder og rådgivere
  • Bidrage med indhentning af relevant dokumentation forud for idriftsætning af projekter

Arbejdspladsen er på hovedkontoret i Skanderborg, (og du vil med jævne mellemrum komme rundt omkring på vores biogasanlæg i Danmark.) Desuden har du mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage.

Kvalifikationer
Vi forestiller os, at du har en teknisk baggrund – fx som ingeniør – gerne med flere års erfaring fra en tilsvarende stilling i enten en privat eller offentlig virksomhed, eller som myndighed ved kommune, region eller styrelse.

Biogasprojekter har berøring med en bred vifte af myndigheder og lovgivninger. Det er en fordel med erfaring inden for et eller flere af følgende områder:

  • Beredskabsloven, tekniske forskrifter og Gassikkerhedsloven
  • Bygningsreglementet
  • Miljøbeskyttelsesloven, herunder miljøvurderinger og miljøgodkendelser
  • SEVESO-direktivet og risikovirksomheder
  • Planloven, herunder lokalplanlægning og kommuneplanrammer

Vi er en virksomhed med en jordnær tilgang til arbejdet. Vi har dybe rødder i den jyske muld, en stærk familiær ånd og hjælper hinanden på tværs af organisationen med hverdagens udfordringer og opgaver. Vi har en lækker og varieret frokostordning og du bliver en del af vores sundhedspakke, som blandt andet inkluderer sundhedsforskning. Derudover holder vi sociale arrangementer uden for arbejdstiden for at styrke fællesskabet og skabe relationer på tværs af vores arbejdspladser.

Interesseret?
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jonatan Gonge på mail: JGO@Bigadan.dk. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, og vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende. Upload derfor din ansøgning og dit CV på .

Om Bigadan
Vi udvikler, bygger, driver og ejer biogasanlæg og arbejder på tværs af hele værdikæden fra sourcing af organiske restprodukter til produktion af energi, biogent CO₂ og biogødning. Vi drifter 10 biogasanlæg, heraf 3 med CO₂-forflydningsanlæg, samt et antal gastankstationer.

Hver dag omsætter vi husdyrgødning, madaffald og andre organiske restprodukter til produkter med værdi for energi-, landbrugs- og industrisektoren. Det bidrager til forsyningssikkerheden, sikrer bedre udnyttelse af ressourcerne og recirkulerer næringsstoffer tilbage til jorden.

Vi mangler en elektriker til industri og erhverv i Skive.

Du bliver en del af en el-virksomhed på cirka 25 ansatte, hvor erhverv og industri fylder godt i ordrebogen. Arbejdet ligger i Skive og omegn, så du får en lokal hverdag frem for lange ture ud af området. Opgaverne spænder fra almindelige el-installationer til automatik, specialinstallationer og større industriinstallationer.

Rollen passer til dig, der gerne vil have frihed under ansvar og selv kan tage fat ude hos kunden. Du kører selv ud i firmabilen, men du lander ikke et sted hvor du står uden kollegaer bag dig. Der er lagt op til sjove og gode opgaver, hvor du får lov til at bruge faget ordentligt.

Det får du

Løn: 200-230 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Skive og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 25 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Industri, erhverv og specialinstallationer

Din hverdag

Dagen består af aftalte el-opgaver, hvor du selv kører ud og får arbejdet til at hænge sammen. Du vurderer rækkefølgen i opgaverne, melder ind hvis noget ændrer sig, og bruger din erfaring til at få installationerne løst ordentligt. Materialer og løsning afhænger af opgaven, for jobbet spænder bredt fra erhvervsel til specialinstallationer.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder med el-opgaver i industri og erhverv
  • Løser specialinstallationer hos erhvervskunder
  • Monterer og tilslutter el-tavler
  • Fremfører kabler og ledninger
  • Monterer belysning og armaturer

Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde, men det skal også være i orden. Derfor passer jobbet bedst til dig, der tager ansvar for dine aftaler og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som elektriker
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt ude hos kunden
  • Trives med industri, erhverv og specialinstallationer
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet kræfter med automatik, tavler eller større industriinstallationer. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide en hverdag, hvor du selv tager styringen.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en elektriker mere i Skive, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

description:
Senior Cloud Developer

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

In the HPE Hybrid Cloud, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what’s next for you.


Management Level Definition:

Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. provide team leadership and mentoring to others.


Joining our Hybrid Cloud HPE team and working as part of our OpsRamp team is a chance to make history and be a driving force in the industry. We are revolutionizing cloud computing by building a large-scale, enterprise-ready platform that powers a hybrid edge-to-cloud world. Our platform enables the world's largest and most diverse enterprise IT teams and managed service providers to control the chaos of modern digital infrastructure, and to deliver quickly, efficiently, and at scale while keeping their data secure and meeting sustainability goals.

We do this through hybrid discovery and monitoring, event and incident management, remediation, and automation, powered by AI. We help our enterprise and MSP customers avoid costly outages and performance issues that result in lost revenue and productivity.

With over 100,000 dedicated customers and 10 million devices in production, we are committed to accelerating transformation across data, connectivity, cloud, and security, providing essential solutions for businesses of all sizes. Together, we make the impossible possible, and we are confident in our ability to lead the way in shaping the future of cloud computing.


What You’ll do:

• Must have 9-12 years of experience in designing, implementation and deployment of highly scalable SaaS applications/platforms and distributed systems.

• Understand cloud-native architecture concepts and have knowledge of best practices for high availability, scalability, resilience, performance, and security requirements in the cloud.

• Proven abilities to prepare necessary Design Specifications, participate in Design and Code Reviews and work with Customer Support Teams for Customer Escalations.

• Strong background in Core Java, Multi-Threading, Data Structures, Distributed Systems, Spring framework, Spring security, Hibernate

• Working knowledge of large event stream platforms (Kafka or similar message bus architecture)

• Strong data structure and algorithm skills to work with distributed backend systems

• Experience designing and building APIs

• Experience working with elasticsearch, cassandra, mysql.

• Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and CI/CD environment

• Knowledge of Cloud Platform - CoreOS, Kubernetes, and Docker containers.

• Demonstrated abilities to work with Product management, QA, and remote teams.

• Have Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills.

. Deep expertise in AI-First SDLC methodologies, with a proven ability to identify, implement, and leverage AI-driven solutions to enhance operational efficiency, innovation, and business value.


What You Need to Bring:

• Bachelor's, Master's in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent

• Strong understanding of the current state of ITOM markets, infrastructure automation, continuous integration/deployment, security, networking, and cloud-native models.

• Contributing in the development of trino connectors

title: Leasing Professional - Glen Cove, NY
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.

title: Retail Key Holder

As a Key Holder, better known as a “Floor Leader,” at Skechers, you’ll take on an essential Retail Leadership Role, contributing to store operations and mentoring your team to deliver exceptional customer service. In this entry-level management role, you’ll oversee daily operations, support sales goals, and help maintain the store's premium shopping environment.
