title: Leasing Professional - McDowell Point 55+ Active Adult
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Sales Consultant is responsible for executing the property’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals. This role serves as a key point of contact for prospective residents, guiding them through the leasing process with professionalism and a deep understanding of the community’s lifestyle offering. The Sales Consultant supports resident satisfaction throughout the lease term and proactively manages lease renewals in alignment with Active Adult best practices. Responsibilities include lead management, CRM utilization, data analysis, event support, and collaboration with the Lifestyle Coordinator to enhance resident engagement. The Sales Consultant upholds Greystar’s professional standards and ethical expectations while delivering exceptional service to residents, prospects, and guests.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the property’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting property tours and showing apartments, continuing the relationship with prospects, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
2. Collects all pertinent information from prospective residents at move-in and records as appropriate.
3. Stays informed about and collaborates with teams/leadership on current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy, market rent, and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the property’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
4. Designs and executes marketing activities and events to create and drive traffic to the property, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools and following other property-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
5. Uses the on-site property management software application to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents, and review and analyze data.
6. Ensures that the property and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the tour path and show ready units, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the property’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.

7. Follows-up with prospects and new residents within 24 hours to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew. Documents all follow up and classes leads during the lifecycle of the sales process.
8. Executes and performs activities in support of the property’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time, following the AA renewal playbook.
9. Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).
10. Demonstrates customer services skills by treating residents, prospects, guests, and others with respect, answering questions, and responding sensitively to complaints about maintenance services. Interacts with all residents and acknowledges them by name.
11. Attends community and networking events, aligns with local associations and community organizations, and participates in outreach marketing efforts to drive traffic to community and generate viable referral sources and new business leads, ensuring Greystar AA outreach expectations are consistently met.
12. Completes various financial, administrative, and other reports and analysis, and performs other duties as assigned or necessary.
13. Assists Lifestyle Coordinator by attending and assisting with the setup of events as required.

BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS:
• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, hospitality, or related field preferred.
• 1-3 years minimum of relevant experience in the application and usage of a sales, marketing, internet and customer service background sufficient to resolve customer complaints and issues and complete financial records, documents, and reports.
• Demonstrated ability to read, write, and communicate effectively to comprehend and complete legal documents, sell and explain apartment features, and answer questions.

• Mathematical skills necessary to process sales conversions.

• Ability to apply sales skills, such as generating sales leads, conducting sales presentations, qualifying prospects, and closing.


SPECIALIZED SKILLS:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions.

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to drive a golf cart on property.

• Proficiency in word processing, spreadsheet, property management applications, and database management programs in order to complete required reports and documents.

• Proficiency and fluency in using the internet for marketing, advertising, and sales-related circumstances.

• Ability to adapt to specific markets and professionals to ensure your sales message is received appropriately.


TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
• Team members work in an office environment but also may have frequent exposure to outside elements where temperature, weather, odors, and/or landscape may be unpleasant and/or hazardous.
• Incumbents must be able to physically access all exterior and interior parts of the property and amenities.
• Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance and be able to stand for extended periods of time.
• Routine, local travel may be required to attend business meetings, conduct market research, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
• Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which may include evenings, weekends and/or holidays.

title: Business Central-konsult med fokus på produktion – Göteborg
company: Columbus Sweden, Poland, Germany & Czech Republic
description:
Tycker du att det är roligt att arbeta med Business Central och vill vara med och driva digitalisering och affärsutveckling hos våra kunder? Har du dessutom förståelse för produktion och hur affärsprocesser hänger ihop från inköp och planering till lager, försäljning och ekonomi? Då kan Columbus vara rätt plats för dig!

Vi fortsätter att stärka vårt dedikerade Business Central-team inom Dynamics 365. Framför oss har vi många spännande kundåtaganden och vi söker nu en Business Central-specialist som vill hjälpa våra kunder att utveckla smarta, hållbara och verksamhetsnära lösningar. Just nu lägger vi särskild vikt vid produktionsförståelse, samtidigt som rollen ger möjlighet att arbeta brett med Business Central och fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor.

Vad innebär rollen?

Du arbetar nära våra kunder för att förstå deras verksamhet, behov och affärsmål och omsätter dem till hållbara lösningar i Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Rollen kombinerar delar av applikationskonsultens, affärskonsultens och lösningsarkitektens perspektiv. På senior nivå kan rollen motsvara Functional Solution Architect (FSA), med ett större ansvar för lösningsdesign, rådgivning och funktionell ledning inom specialistområdet.

Produktion är ett viktigt fokus i den här rekryteringen. Vi söker därför särskilt efter dig som förstår produktionsprocesser och kan se hur Business Central stödjer hela verksamhetsflödet och samspelet mellan exempelvis produktion, Supply Chain, lager, inköp, försäljning och ekonomi.

  • Arbeta med analys, processkartläggning, kravarbete och lösningsdesign tillsammans med kund.

  • Designa, konfigurera och implementera Business Central-processer, med särskilt fokus på produktionsrelaterade behov där det är relevant.

  • Guida kunder i hur de bäst kan använda Business Central för att utveckla och effektivisera sina verksamhetsprocesser.

  • Leda eller bidra i workshops och driva funktionella lösningar framåt tillsammans med kund och leveransteam.

  • Stödja testning, utbildning, go-live och vidareutveckling av kundlösningar.

  • Samarbeta nära med utvecklare, arkitekter, projektledare och andra konsulter.

  • På seniorare nivå bidra inom presales, estimat, kundrådgivning och kunskapsdelning.

Vem är du?

Du gillar att vara rådgivare och att dela med dig av din kunskap. Du trivs både med att arbeta självständigt och tillsammans med andra, och du är bekväm i en kundnära roll där du behöver förstå verksamheten bakom systemkraven.

  • Du har flera års erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central som konsult eller superuser.

  • Du har förståelse för produktionsprocesser. Erfarenhet från tillverkningsindustrin är särskilt relevant i den här rekryteringen.

  • Du kan kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och engelska i en professionell miljö.

  • Du delar Columbus' företagsvärderingar och bidrar till ett bra samarbete med kunder och kollegor.

Varför ska du jobba hos oss?

Här får du möjlighet att göra det du är bra på tillsammans med kunniga kollegor som delar erfarenheter och hjälper varandra framåt. Du blir en del av ett svenskt Business Central-team som ingår i ett större globalt BC-team med många spännande kundåtaganden framför oss.

  • Möjlighet att arbeta nära kunder och få eget ansvar tidigt.

  • Ett tydligt fokus på Business Central och verksamhetsutveckling, med produktion som ett prioriterat kompetensområde just nu.

  • En verksamhet som vill ligga i framkant när det gäller AI inom Business Central.

  • Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas på Consultant-, Senior- eller Principal-nivå beroende på erfarenhet och utveckling.

Här får du göra det du är bäst på, tillsammans med kollegor som uppskattar både dig och det du gör. Du blir en del av ett team som stöttar varandra, firar framgångar tillsammans och gärna skrattar. Vad säger du? 😃

Ansökan och nästa steg

Hos oss kan du ansöka med din LinkedIn och/eller ditt CV. Du behöver inte skicka in något personligt brev. I vår rekryteringsprocess tar vi alltid referenser och genomför en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning eller eventuellt erbjudande ges. Har du frågor, vänd dig till Alexander Tonelli. Intervjuer kommer att hållas löpande.

Efter avslutad rekryteringsprocess skickar vi en fråga om din upplevelse som kandidat. Det tar bara någon sekund att besvara frågan och hjälper oss att förbättra vår rekryteringsprocess.

Jobba på Columbus

Människorna kommer alltid först på Columbus. Vi är ett globalt konsultbolag med lokal närvaro, som hjälper företag med deras digitala förändring och att blomstra genom teknik, data och mänsklig insikt. Vi är också en arbetsplats där du som medarbetare får utveckla din karriär och få stöd genom tydliga och strukturerade karriärvägar.

Vår kultur bygger på tillit, samarbete, nyfikenhet och ett gemensamt engagemang för att leverera värde till våra kunder. Oavsett om du är erfaren eller precis i början av din karriär, kommer du att hitta friheten att utforska idéer, utmana det invanda och forma din egen väg hos oss.

Med över 1 500 kollegor i fler än 10 länder kombinerar vi globala perspektiv med lokal förståelse. Det som förenar oss är vår tro på att skapa en meningsfull påverkan – för våra medarbetare, våra kunder och resan framåt.

Let’s thrive, grow, and shape the future together.

Nyfiken på Columbus?

Spana in vårt Instaflöde för att få en bild av hur det är att jobba hos oss genom våra kollegor. Klicka på bilden för att komma till Instagramkontot.

Helt ofiltrerat har vi samlat in omdömen från nuvarande och tidigare kollegor. Klicka nedan för att läsa mer.

title: Finance Transformation Governance, Managing Director
description:
Who we are looking for

The Managing Director, Finance Transformation Governance will lead the governance, risk, and control strategy supporting Finance's transformation agenda. This executive will be responsible for ensuring that business process redesign, automation, technology implementations, data initiatives, and operating model changes are executed within a robust governance and control framework.


As a strategic leader within Finance, the Managing Director will establish and oversee a comprehensive framework to assess the impact of transformation initiatives on Finance processes, risks, controls, regulatory obligations, and policy compliance. The role will serve as a key partner to Finance Transformation, Controllership, Regulatory Reporting, Finance Business Risk Management (BRM), Technology, Compliance, and Enterprise Risk teams to ensure that transformation efforts strengthen operational effectiveness while maintaining a sound control environment.


The successful candidate will drive the integration of risk and control considerations into transformation design, promote the adoption of automated and preventive controls, and ensure that Finance remains aligned with enterprise policies, governance standards, and regulatory expectations throughout periods of change.


What you will be responsible for

Establish and Lead the Finance Transformation Governance Framework

  • Design and implement the governance framework supporting Finance transformation initiatives across the organization.
  • Establish standards, methodologies, and decision-making processes to evaluate transformation activities from a governance, risk, and control perspective.
  • Develop executive reporting, metrics, and governance forums to provide transparency into transformation program risks, dependencies, control impacts, and remediation activities.
  • Advise senior Finance leadership on governance implications associated with strategic investments, organizational redesign, automation initiatives, and technology implementations.
  • Serve as the primary Finance governance leader overseeing the intersection of transformation execution, risk management, and internal controls.

Assess Transformation Impacts on Finance Processes and Controls

  • Establish a consistent framework to identify and assess the impact of transformation initiatives on end-to-end Finance processes, key controls, regulatory reporting obligations, and financial risk management activities.
  • Ensure that process, control, data, and technology impacts are evaluated before significant transformation initiatives are approved and implemented.
  • Lead reviews of future-state operating models to identify emerging risks, control gaps, segregation of duty concerns, and compliance considerations.
  • Oversee process inventories and process mapping efforts to maintain an accurate understanding of how transformation activities affect the Finance control environment.
  • Provide effective challenge and independent review of transformation programs to ensure risks are identified and appropriately mitigated.

Drive Control Design for Automated and Digital Processes

  • Lead the development of Finance's strategy for embedding automated, preventive, and technology-enabled controls within transformed business processes.
  • Partner with Finance Transformation, Technology, and BRM teams to design controls that support new digital workflows, automation tools, AI-enabled solutions, and system implementations.
  • Develop standards and guidance for control rationalization, control automation, and control modernization initiatives.
  • Ensure newly designed controls are sustainable, auditable, scalable, and compliant with regulatory and enterprise requirements.
  • Promote reduction of manual controls through implementation of automated monitoring and preventive control solutions.

Partner Across Finance Business Risk Management

  • Establish strong partnerships across Finance Business Risk Management functions to ensure consistent risk and control practices during transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate with SOX, Regulatory Reporting, Operational Risk, Issue Management, and Control Testing teams to identify and address transformation-related risks.
  • Ensure transformation programs maintain appropriate risk assessments, control documentation, issue management, and testing requirements.
  • Drive consistency in governance and control standards across Finance organizations undergoing change.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for transformation-related risk and control matters.

Ensure Alignment with Enterprise Governance and Policy Requirements

  • Partner closely with Enterprise Risk Management, Compliance, Legal, Technology Risk, Operational Risk, Corporate Audit, and Corporate Governance functions across the organization.
  • Ensure Finance transformation programs comply with enterprise policies, standards, risk frameworks, and governance requirements.
  • Interpret company policies and governance expectations and translate them into practical requirements for Finance transformation teams.
  • Represent Finance in enterprise governance and risk forums related to major transformation programs and strategic initiatives.

Executive Leadership and Influence

  • Act as a strategic advisor to the Chief Accounting Officer & Corporate Controller, CFO organization, and Finance leadership teams regarding transformation governance, risk, and control matters.
  • Influence senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Compliance to drive effective transformation outcomes.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, continuous improvement, and proactive risk management.
  • Champion best practices in governance, process excellence, controls, and operational resilience across the Finance organization.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in Finance, Controllership, Finance Transformation, Risk Management, Audit, Regulatory Reporting, or related disciplines.
  • Significant leadership experience within a large financial services organization or similarly regulated environment.
  • Demonstrated success leading governance, risk, and control activities associated with large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Deep understanding of Finance processes, internal controls, SOX compliance, regulatory reporting, operational risk, and governance frameworks.
  • Experience designing and implementing automated controls and managing control implications associated with technology-enabled transformation.
  • Proven ability to influence executive leadership and drive change across complex organizational structures.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience within Finance Business Risk Management, Corporate Controllership, Regulatory Reporting, Corporate Audit, or Enterprise Risk functions.
  • Familiarity with enterprise transformation programs involving ERP modernization, workflow automation, data platforms, AI, robotics, and digital enablement.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, Corporate Audit, and external auditors regarding transformation governance and control matters.

title: Revenue Integrity Analyst II
description:
About Us:

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

Exciting Opportunity at MSK: Revenue Integrity Analyst II

At Memorial Sloan Kettering (MSK), our Revenue Integrity team plays a critical role in ensuring accurate coding, charge capture, compliance, and financial integrity, directly supporting MSK's mission to end cancer for life. The Revenue Integrity Analyst II serves as a coding and revenue cycle subject matter expert, partnering with clinical, coding, and operational teams to optimize charging workflows, maintain regulatory compliance, and strengthen reimbursement outcomes across the organization.


Role Overview


  • Serve as a subject matter expert on revenue integrity, charge capture, diagnostic coding, and billing compliance.
  • Perform comprehensive reviews of Charge Description Master (CDM) records to ensure coding accuracy, compliance, and ongoing integrity.
  • Investigate coding and charging discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement standardized corrective actions.
  • Manage and resolve Revenue Integrity tickets related to coding edits, charge capture issues, CDM maintenance, and billing discrepancies while maintaining clear audit trails.
  • Partner with Diagnostic Coding teams, including Radiology and Pathology coders, to ensure accurate application of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, and HCPCS coding guidelines.
  • Evaluate Epic work queues, coding edits, and charge review reports to identify reimbursement risks and revenue leakage opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Operations, HIM, Billing, and Clinical departments on quarterly and annual coding updates and regulatory changes.
  • Educate clinical departments and operational stakeholders on coding requirements, charge capture accuracy, documentation standards, and compliant billing practices.
  • Present coding audit findings, revenue integrity trends, and process improvement recommendations to leadership and governance committees.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant healthcare revenue cycle experience.
  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS, charge capture processes, and billing compliance requirements especially related to LCD NCD regulations.
  • Professional coding certification required or strongly preferred, including CPC, COC, CCS, RHIA, or RHIT.
  • Experience collaborating with coding, HIM, revenue cycle, finance, and clinical teams within a complex healthcare environment.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing coding edits, denials, charge reconciliation issues, and reimbursement impacts.
  • Epic experience and familiarity with revenue cycle applications, coding work queues, and charge review tools preferred.

Core Skills


  • Advanced analytical skills with the ability to identify coding trends, documentation gaps, workflow deficiencies, and compliance risks.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare reimbursement methodologies, coding regulations, and revenue cycle operations.
  • Ability to communicate complex coding and revenue integrity concepts clearly to clinical, operational, and leadership audiences.
  • Proven ability to conduct coding education, training, and audit feedback sessions that drive sustainable improvements.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills with a focus on accuracy, accountability, and continuous process improvement.

Additional Information


  • Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday – Friday
  • Location: Hybrid; Primary remote with on site as needed at 633 Third Avenue, New York, NY
  • Reporting To the Director, Revenue Integrity

title: Pædagogisk støtteperson søges til 1:1-støtte til beboer på Fjordnæs, Hundested Plejecenter
description:
Har du erfaring med autisme og lyst til at gøre en forskel for ét menneske?

Vi søger en engageret, tålmodig og relations stærk pædagogisk støtteperson til en stilling på 30-32 timer ugentligt på hverdage. Du skal arbejde tæt sammen med én beboer på Fjordnæs på Hundested Plejecenter og være med til at skabe en tryg, struktureret og meningsfuld hverdag med plads til oplevelser, sociale relationer og livskvalitet.

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med mennesker med autisme og andre kognitive eller psykiske funktionsnedsættelser. Du kan f.eks. have arbejdet på et bosted eller i et andet tilbud, hvor individuel støtte, relationsarbejde og pædagogisk tilgang er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Du behøver ikke have en bestemt uddannelse. Det vigtigste er, at du har relevant erfaring, kan møde et andet menneske med forståelse og respekt og har lyst til at finde de løsninger, der fungerer for netop denne beboer. Den personlige kemi mellem dig og beboeren vil også være en vigtig del af det gode match.

Om stillingen

Du bliver en del af medarbejdergruppen på Fjordnæs og refererer til områdelederen. Din primære opgave er dog at yde individuel 1:1-støtte til én specifik beboer.

Beboeren har et udviklingshandicap og autisme. Autismen er den væsentligste faktor i beboerens funktionsmåde og har stor betydning for beboerens behov for struktur, forudsigelighed, genkendelighed og støtte i hverdagens aktiviteter.

Det kræver en medarbejder, der kan arbejde roligt, vedholdende og relationsorienteret og som har forståelse for, at det, der virker i én situation, ikke nødvendigvis virker i en anden. Du skal kunne aflæse beboerens signaler, tilpasse din tilgang og skabe rammer, hvor beboeren oplever tryghed og mulighed for at deltage i aktiviteter på sine egne forudsætninger.

Stillingen handler om at understøtte beboerens trivsel, selvstændighed og livskvalitet gennem individuelt tilrettelagt støtte. Du skal både kunne planlægge aktiviteter og være nærværende, når der er behov for ro, genkendelighed og tid.

Du indgår ikke i den almindelige pleje af Fjordnæs' øvrige beboere. Dit fokus er den ene beboer, du er ansat til at støtte.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Opbygge en tryg og tillidsfuld relation til beboeren og skabe en hverdag præget af genkendelighed og forudsigelighed.
  • Planlægge og gennemføre aktiviteter, der tager udgangspunkt i beboerens interesser, ønsker og behov.
  • Støtte beboeren i sociale sammenhænge og hjælpe med at skabe gode oplevelser sammen med andre.
  • Tage på ture ud af huset, f.eks. en ugentlig tur i svømmehallen, sportsbegivenheder, indkøb eller andre aktiviteter, som beboeren har glæde af.
  • Arbejde pædagogisk med personlig hygiejne og bad. Svømmehallen er i øjeblikket en vigtig ramme for, at beboeren kan komme i bad. Det kræver derfor, at du kan motivere og støtte beboeren på en respektfuld og tålmodig måde.
  • Skabe meningsfulde stunder i beboerens egen bolig, f.eks. med spil, film, musik eller andre aktiviteter.
  • Understøtte struktur og genkendelighed i hverdagen og hjælpe beboeren med overgange mellem aktiviteter.
  • Observere beboerens trivsel og reaktioner samt bidrage til relevant dokumentation og faglig sparring med kolleger.
  • Samarbejde med områdelederen og relevante medarbejdere om at sikre en sammenhængende og fagligt velfunderet indsats.
  • Du skal kunne arbejde målrettet med de små fremskridt og forstå, at udvikling og trivsel ofte skabes gennem gentagelser, tillid og en vedholdende indsats.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med mennesker med autisme og gerne også udviklingshandicap eller andre komplekse støttebehov.
  • Har arbejdet på et bosted, i et specialiseret tilbud eller i en lignende funktion med individuel støtte.
  • Er tålmodig, stabil og god til at skabe relationer.
  • Kan arbejde struktureret og forudsigeligt og samtidig tilpasse din tilgang til beboerens dagsform og behov.
  • Har en rolig og anerkendende tilgang og kan støtte uden at presse unødigt.
  • Har forståelse for, at personlig hygiejne og andre daglige aktiviteter kan kræve særlige pædagogiske strategier.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage initiativ og planlægge aktiviteter.
  • Er god til at samarbejde, dele observationer og modtage faglig sparring.
  • Har kørekort til bil og er tryg ved transportere beboeren på ture.

Du behøver ikke have en bestemt uddannelsesbaggrund. Vi lægger vægt på din erfaring, din tilgang til mennesker og din evne til at skabe en god relation. Det er vigtigt, at du kan se muligheder frem for begrænsninger og har lyst til at lære den enkelte beboer godt at kende.

Vi tilbyder

  • En meningsfuld stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at gøre en konkret forskel for ét menneske.
  • Mulighed for at bringe din erfaring med arbejdet med autisme og individuelt støttearbejde i spil.
  • En stilling med fokus på relationer, aktiviteter og livskvalitet.
  • Et kollegialt fællesskab på Fjordnæs med mulighed for sparring og samarbejde.
  • Mulighed for at præge tilrettelæggelsen af beboerens hverdag inden for de aftalte faglige rammer.
  • En stilling på 30-32 timer om ugen på hverdage.

Transport: Kørekort er et krav. Plejecentret stiller en bus til rådighed efter kl. 14. Aktiviteter og ture tilrettelægges under hensyntagen til de praktiske muligheder.

Praktiske oplysninger:

Arbejdssted: Fjordnæs, Hundested Plejecenter
Stillingsbetegnelse: Pædagogisk støtteperson
Arbejdstid: 30-32 timer ugentligt på hverdage
Reference: Områdelederen på Fjordnæs
Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår: Efter gældende overenskomst og kvalifikationer.

Vil du være den rette støtteperson?

Det vigtigste for os er at finde den person, der kan skabe en god relation til beboeren og bidrage til en hverdag med tryghed, indhold og gode oplevelser.

Hvis du har relevant erfaring, lyst til en anderledes og relationsbåret opgave og mod på at gøre en forskel, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Grundløn for laveste grundlønstrin på 37 timer er pr. 1/10-26 34.863,88 kr./md. ekskl. pension. Derudover kan der aftales kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte områdeleder Sarah Madsen på Fjordnæs på telefon 29 29 97 16 eller send en mail på salma@halsnaes.dk – ansøgning og CV skal sendes via den angivne ansøgningskanal.

Ansøgningsfrist: søndag den 8. november 2026 – der afholdes løbende samtaler.

Bliv en del af Halsnæs – et godt sted at arbejde og et godt sted at bo

Vi er en moderne og rummelig arbejdsplads med cirka 3.000 kollegaer, der hver dag gør sig umage for at levere velfærd og service af høj kvalitet. Vores værdier – redelighed, mulighed og helhed – er fundamentet for alt, vi gør.

Hos Halsnæs Kommune arbejder vi tæt på natur, hav og fjord – og med hovedstaden inden for rækkevidde. Her får du ikke kun et spændende job, men også muligheden for at skabe et liv med ro, fællesskab og aktive oplevelser. Mange vælger at bosætte sig her for at få mere plads, nærhed til naturen og et stærkt lokalt sammenhold.

Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde i Halsnæs Kommune? Besøg vores hjemmeside eller vores LinkedIn-profil.
Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at bo og leve i Halsnæs? Besøg Flyt til Halsnæs og se, hvad området kan tilbyde dig og din familie.

title: System Engineer – Video Platform Operations
description:
About the role

We are looking for a dedicated System Engineer to join our team and support the daily operations of our end-to-end Video Platform infrastructure. This position is 100% onsite and requires a proactive, technically skilled engineer who ensures the health, performance, and availability of critical systems including Origin, Packager, Encoder, CDN, Middleware, and other related services.

Key responsibilities

  • Monitor traffic and service availability across the Video Platform.

  • Investigate and troubleshoot system issues promptly.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation for Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

  • Experience with Nginx, Varnish, and Zabbix monitoring.

  • Solid understanding of HTTP/S, streaming protocols, and how CDN works.

  • Familiarity with Ansible for infrastructure automation and deployment.

  • Good communication skills for effective collaboration and escalation.

  • Strong documentation skills with attention to detail.

  • Ability to work independently with a proactive attitude in a fast-paced environment.

  • Prior experience supporting video streaming platforms or CDN operations (preferred).

  • Familiarity with video encoding workflows and monitoring tools (preferred).

Benefits

  • Opportunity to work on a large-scale video streaming platform.

  • Collaborative team and technically challenging environment.

  • Onsite role with customer engagement experience.

title: Er du sygeplejerske og klar til at prøve kræfter med ledelse og et større ansvar? Bliv assisterende afsnitsleder i Danmarks førende afdeling for dobbeltdiagnosebehandling
description:
På Psykiatrisk Center Sct. Hans søger vi dig, der ønsker medansvar for ledelse, drift og udvikling af den kognitive miljøterapi og sygeplejen i afsnittet.

Du bliver en del af Danmarks førende afdeling for dobbeltdiagnosebehandling, og du får din daglige gang i naturskønne omgivelser ved Roskilde Fjord og Boserup Skov.


Velkommen til afsnit M20

Du bliver assisterende afsnitsleder på afsnit M20 vest, hvor vi arbejder med behandling og pleje af patienter med dobbeltdiagnose. Vi arbejder ud fra en kognitiv adfærdsterapeutisk ramme og vægter således et ligeværdigt samarbejde med patienten samt tilbyder en tværfaglig indsats afhængig af patientens individuelle behov.

Patienterne er frivilligt indlagt og er motiverede for behandling. Behandlingsforløbene er på omkring 3 måneders varighed. Patientforløbet er beskrevet og for nylig revideret. Som en del af behandlingen er de fleste af patienterne hjemme på orlov i weekenderne

M20 er et integreret afsnit med plads til 25 patienter. Vi anvender minimalt tvang og arbejder intensivt med deeskalering. Afsnittet er delt i 2 teams, og du vil få din daglige gang på vest, hvor der er 13 patienter. På øst er der en kollega i samme stilling som dig, og I har et tæt samarbejde i dagligdagen sammen med oversygeplejerske, overlæge og klinisk sygeplejespecialist.

Du bliver en del af en personalegruppe, der har en ambitiøs, travl, struktureret og samtidig munter hverdag. Vi arbejder aktivt og kontinuerligt for det gode arbejdsmiljø og sætter en dyd i at være hjælpsomme, fleksible, nysgerrige og engagerede. Vi holder løbende personalemøder og har to årlige temadage.


Din rolle

Du skal være rollemodel i afsnittet for en tværfaglig, engageret og social personalegruppe bestående af både erfarne og nyansatte, som er gode til at støtte hinanden.

I rollen kommer du foruden personalegruppen til at samarbejde med hhv. patienter, pårørende, de øvrige medarbejdere på centret, hospitalets øvrige psykiatriske centre og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.


Dine ansvarsområder

I samarbejde med oversygeplejersken varetager du de ledelsesmæssige, koordinerende og pædagogiske funktioner, som er forbundet med det daglige arbejde i afsnittet.

I samarbejde med oversygeplejersken vil du have mange opgaver, men de primære vil være at:

  • deltage i afsnittets pleje og behandling. Være kontaktperson for 3-4 patienter
  • skabe rammer for gode læringsmuligheder for medarbejdere og uddannelsessøgende
  • implementere uddannelses- og udviklingsmæssige opgaver i afsnittet
  • varetage oversygeplejerskens funktioner i dennes fravær, herunder den akutte vagtplanlægning
  • sikre, at arbejdsplanlægningen tilgodeser, at medarbejderne har de rette kompetencer i forhold til de sygeplejefaglige opgaver
  • prioritere og uddelegere arbejdsopgaver samt deltage i tavlemøder og igangsætte forbedringsarbejde.
  • efter oplæring afholde gruppeterapi og psykoedukation
  • opretholde et godt arbejdsmiljø

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi søger dig, der kan understøtte en god trivsel og kommunikation i afsnittet samt evner at igangsætte og motivere den enkelte medarbejder såvel som hele afsnittet. Derudover er du autoriseret sygeplejerske.

Vi ser desuden gerne, at du:

  • har fokus på at fastholde og videreudvikle den faglige tilgang og indsats i afsnittet
  • er i stand til at bevare ro og overblik
  • er handlekraftig og bevarer motivationen – du er i den forbindelse tydelig omkring forventninger, følger op, evaluerer og giver feedback
  • er villig til fortsat faglig og personlig udvikling
  • har en anerkendende og respektfuld tilgang til kollegaer og patienter

Hvorfor skal du søge job hos os?

I denne stilling får du mulighed for at lære ledelsesfaget at kende – du får rig mulighed for at udvikle dine ledelseskompetencer og din ledelsesværktøjskasse. Alt afhængig af dine forudsætninger og din erfaring vil du modtage supervision og støtte fra din oversygeplejerske.

Du bliver en aktiv medspiller i ledelsesrummet og deltager i faste møder med afsnitsledelsen, anden assisterende afsnitsleder og klinisk sygeplejespecialist.

Du får din daglige gang på Psykiatrisk Center Sct. Hans i Roskilde med en smuk placering ud til Roskilde Fjord. Vi har et stort fokus på omgivelsernes betydning for aktivitet og bruger vores udearealer og det omgivende samfund så meget som muligt.

Du er med i ERFA-gruppen med de øvrige assisterende afsnitsleder i afdeling M og på hele centret.


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen kan tiltrædes pr. 1. december 2026 eller efter aftale.

I forbindelse med sommer eller andre særlige situationer må forventes en weekendvagt et par gange om året. Derudover kan aftenvagter forventes med jævne mellemrum. Ligeledes vil du skulle deltage i vagtbyrden på helligdage.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger overenskomst for ikke-ledende personale på Sundhedskartellets område indgået mellem Sundhedskartellets parter, herunder Dansk Sygeplejeråd og RLTN med lønindplacering som sygeplejerske.

Døgnafsnittet er døgndækket, og du vil derfor blive planlagt med blandende vagter i overensstemmelse med reglerne i den gældende arbejdstidsaftale.

Du kommer til at referere til oversygeplejersken i afsnittet.

Der er tvungen ferie i uge 29 og 30 da afsnittet i disse uger overgår til daghospital-status.


Har vi vakt din interesse?

Send os din ansøgning og CV via linket her på siden.

Ansøgningsfrist: 15. november 2026.

Samtaler: Forventes afholdt umiddelbart efter ansøgningsfristens udløb.

Har du nogle spørgsmål, eller ønsker du at vide mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte oversygeplejerske Anne Carlsen på tlf. 23 83 05 29.

Region Hovedstaden sætter mennesket først. Vi giver plads til forskellighed og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge, uanset køn, alder, etnicitet, religion, seksualitet eller funktionsnedsættelser.

title: Full Stack Developer - 20049
description:

title: Home Visiting Local Leadership Coordinator
description:
Organization Description

Family Futures’ mission is to shape a community in which all children are supported to reach their full potential. Our geographic focus is primarily Kent County with some services extending into other communities. We help children ages 0 through 5 by supporting parents, providing connections to resources and programs, and offering ways to monitor and enhance early childhood development. We believe in supporting our employees to be successful as well. Family Futures offers a strength-based, learning-driven, quality improvement-based culture that celebrates equity and diversity and an opportunity to grow while making an impact in your community. Family Futures values a diverse workplace and strongly encourages individuals with diverse backgrounds and lived experiences to apply.

Position Overview

The Home Visiting Local Leadership Group (LLG) Coordinator is responsible for creating and supporting a structured space where families, home visiting programs, and community partners can build relationships, learn about each other’s services, and work together to create a more connected local home visiting system.

Key Responsibilities

Essential Duties

  • Facilitate collaboration among home-visiting programs, families, and key community partners to ensure an integrated network of support that effectively addresses family needs.
  • Plan, organize, and facilitate regular local or regional meetings or events that bring community partners together to coordinate home visiting activities, share information, and strengthen alignment across programs and systems.
  • Convene QI teams and ensure members have the structure, communication channels, and support necessary to participate effectively in continuous quality improvement efforts.
  • Participate in Michigan Home Visiting Initiative (MHVI) Grantee Meetings to stay aligned with statewide priorities, share progress, and collaborate with peers across regions.
  • Track engagement of all required and additional community partners to maintain a collaborative group that reflects key home visiting perspectives.
  • Maintain communication with partners who cannot attend meetings regularly by keeping them informed and included through updates, shared tools, and ongoing communication.
  • Attend meetings and events as assigned by the LLG State Coordinator
  • Represent the LLG at community events, meetings, and other outreach opportunities where early childhood professionals and families are present.
  • Promote the lived experiences of families and offer opportunities for parents to get involved in system planning, evaluation, and decision-making.
  • Educate partners and the community on the home visiting system and individual models.
  • Serve as a resource to partners and community stakeholders, promoting engagement and collaboration.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Reporting and Documentation

  • Develop a local work plan and complete quarterly progress reports.
  • Facilitate the development of an annual LLG work plan.
  • Maintain accurate records of required documentation.
  • Monitor budgets and expenditures to ensure alignment with LLG guidelines.



Education & Experience

A strong candidate will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Human Services, Public Health, or a related field.
  • Knowledge of infant and child development and early childhood programs and services, with an emphasis on home visiting.
  • Experience facilitating and navigating systems-level work at the community and state level.
  • Experience in providing services to culturally diverse communities and families.
  • Knowledge of home visiting programs and local early childhood systems.
  • Knowledge and flexibility in approach to administration, program needs and problem solving.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, writing skills to communicate concepts, ideas and information to persons of diverse backgrounds.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About the role

Technology Solutions is seeking a talented Site Reliability Engineer to join our dynamic team in Pathum Wan, Bangkok. This is a full-time position that plays a crucial role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and scalability of our critical infrastructure and systems. As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will bridge the gap between software development and operations, implementing best practices that ensure our systems remain highly available and performant. This role is essential to our mission of delivering exceptional technology solutions to our clients and maintaining the highest standards of service quality.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain robust infrastructure and systems architecture that supports high availability and disaster recovery requirements

  • Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and optimise infrastructure for efficiency and cost-effectiveness

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools to streamline operational processes and reduce manual intervention

  • Conduct incident response and post-incident analysis to identify root causes and implement preventative measures

  • Collaborate with development teams to establish service level objectives (SLOs) and service level indicators (SLIs), and work towards achieving them

  • Implement and manage monitoring, alerting, and logging systems to provide visibility into system health and performance

  • Manage configuration management, version control, and deployment pipelines to ensure consistent and reliable releases

  • Provide on-call support and participate in incident management rotations to address critical issues promptly

  • Document infrastructure decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures to ensure knowledge sharing across teams

  • Review and improve security practices, compliance requirements, and system hardening measures


What we're looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 3+ years of professional experience in site reliability engineering, systems administration, or a related operational role

  • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, Java, or Bash scripting

  • Solid understanding of Linux/Unix operating systems and system administration

  • Hands-on experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure

  • Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation

  • Strong knowledge of networking concepts, TCP/IP protocols, and DNS/load balancing

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or similar solutions

title: UNPAID VOLUNTEER - Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
description:
The Role

DTID is seeking an experienced, innovative and technically accomplished Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to provide strategic and technical leadership across the organisation's emerging technology portfolio.

Reporting directly to the Director-General, the CTO will lead DTID's work across Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)/Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Data Science, Big Data Analysis, Data Modelling, Quantum Computing and technology standards.

The successful candidate will be responsible for defining DTID's technology strategy, overseeing technology research and development, leading technical teams and translating emerging technologies into practical solutions that support climate action, sustainable development and policy implementation.

The CTO will also oversee the development of Proof-of-Concepts, pilots and technology applications; strengthen DTID's internal technical capabilities; develop strategic partnerships; and provide technical leadership across multidisciplinary projects.

Strong practical proficiency in blockchain development and programming is essential for this role. Experience developing artificial intelligence or machine-learning solutions is highly desirable.

This is a senior leadership position requiring strong technical expertise, strategic thinking, people leadership and the ability to communicate complex technology concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

The Chief Technology Officer will:

  • Define and lead DTID's technology strategy and roadmap across blockchain, artificial intelligence, IoT, data technologies, quantum computing and related emerging technologies.

  • Lead and manage DTID's emerging technology teams and standards-development activities, including recruitment, onboarding, mentoring and capability development.

  • Oversee the design, development, testing and deployment of Proof-of-Concepts, pilots and technology solutions.

  • Guide the application of DLT/Blockchain, AI, machine learning, data science, data modelling, IoT and other emerging technologies across DTID projects.

  • Ensure appropriate standards for the quality, reliability, security, scalability and documentation of DTID's technology products and solutions.

  • Monitor and evaluate the performance and impact of technology initiatives and recommend improvements where appropriate.

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to Technology Officers and multidisciplinary project teams.

  • Identify and develop strategic technology partnerships with research institutions, technology organisations, governments, international organisations and other relevant stakeholders.

  • Monitor emerging technology trends and assess their potential application to climate action, sustainable development and public policy.

  • Represent DTID at relevant conferences, technical forums, stakeholder meetings and external engagements.

  • Contribute technical expertise to DTID research, publications, standards, proposals and institutional initiatives.

  • Collaborate with the Director-General and other senior leaders to ensure technology priorities support DTID's wider strategic objectives.

Requirements

Skills and Abilities

Candidates should demonstrate:

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Strong strategic and technical leadership capability.

  • Excellent analytical, mathematical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong software-development and technology architecture capability.

  • Ability to lead, mentor and develop multidisciplinary technology teams.

  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple technology projects and competing priorities.

  • Strong project-management and delivery capability.

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear information for non-technical audiences.

  • Strong professional communication, presentation and stakeholder-engagement skills.

  • Ability to build constructive relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement and take ownership of strategic priorities.

  • Ability to lead effectively within a remote and internationally distributed organisation.

  • Strong research capability and ability to evaluate emerging technologies and technical approaches.

  • A creative, innovative and solutions-focused approach to technology development.

  • Ability to commit an average of approximately 20 hours per week to the role.

General and Specialist Knowledge

Candidates should demonstrate strong knowledge and practical experience across several of the following areas:

  • Distributed Ledger Technology and blockchain architecture.

  • Blockchain programming and smart-contract development.

  • Artificial intelligence and machine learning.

  • Internet of Things technologies and architectures.

  • Data science, data analysis and data modelling.

  • Big-data technologies and data engineering.

  • Quantum computing and emerging quantum applications.

  • Cloud architecture and cloud-computing platforms.

  • Cybersecurity, information security and data governance.

  • Technology standards and responsible technology governance.

  • Agile technology-development methodologies.

  • DevOps, software architecture and technology product development.

Technical experience should include relevant programming languages, frameworks and platforms such as:

  • Solidity and Ethereum or comparable blockchain environments.

  • Python, R or other relevant programming languages.

  • TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn or comparable AI/ML frameworks.

  • APIs and data formats including JSON, XML and CSV.

  • Cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.

  • GitHub and other version-control or open-source development environments.

A portfolio of supported open-source projects, GitHub contributions, Proof-of-Concepts or deployed technology solutions would be advantageous.

Knowledge of climate change, sustainability, climate finance, international development and digital policy would also be highly desirable.

Education and Training

Candidates should preferably possess:

  • A Master's degree or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.

A PhD, MBA or other advanced qualification relevant to technology leadership, emerging technologies or innovation would be advantageous.

Relevant professional certifications in areas such as:

  • Blockchain technologies.

  • Artificial intelligence and machine learning.

  • Cloud computing.

  • Cybersecurity.

  • Data science.

  • Technology architecture.

  • Agile or project management.

would also be beneficial.

Equivalent senior-level professional experience and demonstrated technical capability may also be considered where appropriate.

  • Professional proficiency in English.

Knowledge of an additional international language would be advantageous.

Experience

Candidates should ideally demonstrate:

  • At least 5 years of substantial professional experience in DLT/Blockchain, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, data modelling or another relevant emerging technology field.

  • Senior-level experience leading technology teams, technical projects or digital innovation initiatives.

  • Demonstrable practical experience in blockchain development and programming.

  • Experience designing, developing and deploying technology applications, Proof-of-Concepts or digital solutions.

  • Experience leading multidisciplinary or internationally distributed technology teams.

  • Experience managing technology projects using Agile or comparable methodologies.

  • Experience with project planning, budgeting, reporting and technical documentation.

  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure and modern software-development environments.

  • Experience developing technology strategies, roadmaps or architecture.

  • Experience engaging senior stakeholders, external partners and technical specialists.

  • Experience identifying and developing strategic technology partnerships.

  • Experience conducting or overseeing technical research and innovation initiatives.

  • Experience working independently and taking responsibility for complex strategic and technical deliverables.

Experience developing AI or machine-learning algorithms and applications would be highly desirable.

Experience applying emerging technologies to climate action, sustainability, international development, public policy or environmental challenges would also be advantageous.

Benefits

What Difference Will You Make?

Emerging technologies are increasingly influencing how governments, international organisations and other institutions understand complex challenges, manage information and develop innovative solutions.

As Chief Technology Officer, you will shape DTID's technology direction and ensure that emerging technologies are researched, developed and applied responsibly to support sustainable development and policy implementation.

You will lead the organisation's technical capability across blockchain, artificial intelligence, IoT, data technologies, quantum computing and technology standards while helping translate research and innovation into practical applications.

Your contribution will strengthen DTID's technology leadership, research capability, innovation pipeline, technical partnerships and ability to develop responsible digital solutions for climate action and sustainable development.

Benefits

What Will You Gain from Volunteering with DTID?

Although this position is unpaid, volunteering with DTID provides opportunities to:

  • Provide executive-level technology leadership within an international organisation.

  • Shape DTID's emerging technology strategy and technical direction.

  • Lead multidisciplinary and internationally distributed technology teams.

  • Apply and strengthen expertise across blockchain, artificial intelligence, IoT, data technologies and quantum computing.

  • Lead the development of Proof-of-Concepts, pilots and emerging-technology applications.

  • Contribute to research, technology standards, publications and institutional initiatives.

  • Work at the intersection of emerging technology, climate action, sustainable development and public policy.

  • Collaborate with researchers, technology specialists, governments, international organisations and other stakeholders.

  • Build international professional networks and strategic technology partnerships.

  • Represent DTID at relevant technical forums, conferences and external engagements.

  • Contribute directly to DTID's technological capability, institutional development and international impact.

Selection Process

DTID is committed to identifying talented individuals with both demonstrated expertise and strong potential.

Applications will be considered on the basis of demonstrated technical capability, relevant professional experience, leadership experience, strategic thinking and suitability for the responsibilities of the role.

The selection process will normally include:

  1. Application screening

  2. Written or technical assessment

  3. Interview and/or technical discussion for shortlisted candidates

  4. Final selection and onboarding

title: Prototyptekniker
description:
Prototyptekniker till vårt utvecklingsteam

Är du en skicklig mekaniker som vill lösa helt nya utmaningar och vara med och elektrifiera framtidens kvävegödselproduktion?

Om NitroCapt 🌱

NitroCapt är ett svenskt climate-tech-företag som utvecklar en ny teknik för produktion av kvävegödsel. Vår process använder luft, vatten och förnybar energi och har potential att förändra hur kvävegödsel produceras – med betydligt lägre klimatpåverkan.

Nu söker vi en erfaren Tekniker till vårt R&D team som vill vara med och ta nyskapande idéer hela vägen till färdiga prototyper och unika maskiner.

Vad du kommer att göra:

Du kommer att arbeta i R&D-teamet med att bygga, modifiera, testa och förbättra prototyper och försöksutrustning.

Rollen kräver både händighet och problemlösningsförmåga – från att montera utrustning enligt ritning till att identifiera felkällor och ta fram och bygga lösningar.

Du kommer bland annat att:

• Bygga och montera prototyper och försöksutrustning.

• Svetsa, svarva, fräsa och bearbeta material.

• Demontera, modifiera och bygga om utrustning.

• Läsa och arbeta efter ritningar och tekniska instruktioner.

• Felsöka mekaniska system.

• Tillsammans med våra ingenjörer hitta praktiska lösningar på tekniska problem.

• Ha kontakt med leverantörer för att hitta komponenter.

Vi är ett entreprenöriellt och internationellt team där mycket fortfarande ska konstrueras, byggas, testas och förbättras.

Placering: Uppsala, Sverige

Vad vi söker:

Vi söker en praktisk skicklig tekniker som är nyfiken på varför saker fungerar som de gör och som lätt kan förstå och problemlösa avancerad teknik både funktionellt och teoretiskt.

Vi ser att du kan ta en idé, ritning eller ett problem utan färdig lösning och få det att fungera genom att självständigt felsöka, fundera, pröva och komma fram till lösningar.

Erfarenhet:

• Minst 5 års erfarenhet av arbete med maskiner, exempelvis inom mekanik, elektronik, pneumatik, hydraulik eller liknande. Erfarenhet från fältservice är meriterande.

• Van vid att bygga, montera, modifiera och felsöka mekanisk utrustning.

• Erfarenhet av svetsning, svarvning och fräsning.

• Förståelse för mekanisk konstruktion och design samt för tekniska instruktioner och ritningar.

• Erfarenhet av kemi, syror, gaser eller absorption är meriterande men inte ett krav.

Andra egenskaper:

• Drivs av nyfikenhet och att lösa komplexa problem.

• Är självgående och ansvarstagande.

• Grundläggande datorvana.

• Har en flexibel approach då saker kontinuerligt ändras samt en prestigelöshet i att hjälpa till med det som behövs.

• Grundläggande kunskaper i att kommunicera på engelska.

• Dina egenskaper och arbetssätt ligger i linje med våra teamprinciper PACE – Persistent, Active, Collaborative och Evolving.

Vad vi erbjuder:

• Vara med och utveckla teknik som kan göra stor skillnad för klimatet.

• Arbeta med prototyper och teknik som ännu inte finns på marknaden.

• En entreprenöriell miljö med korta beslutsvägar och stort eget ansvar.

• En internationell och kunskapsdriven arbetsmiljö och möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med ett växande team.

• Ett generöst optionsprogram med möjlighet att ta del av företagets framtida utveckling.

• 6 veckors betald semester per år.

• Tjänstepension.

• Friskvårdsbidrag.

title: Lungemedicinsk ambulatorie Gentofte Hospital søger sygeplejerske
description:
Ambulatoriesygeplejerske søges til Klinik for Lungesygdomme, Gentofte Hospital Brænder du for ambulant sygepleje, høj faglighed og tværfagligt samarbejde? Så har du nu mulighed for at blive en del af vores engagerede team i Klinik for Lungesygdomme på Gentofte Hospital.

Vi søger en sygeplejerske til en fast stilling på 30-37 timer ugentligt med ansættelse snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Om stillingen Arbejdstiden ligger på hverdage kl. 8.00-15.30 i ambulatoriet.

Stillingen er en delestilling, hvor du som led i "Fælles om vagtarbejdet" er tilknyttet et lungemedicinsk sengeafsnit på Herlev Hospital. Her indgår du med to vagter hver 6. weekend. Om der er tale om dag- eller aftenvagter aftales ud fra dine ønsker, og du tilbydes et grundigt introduktionsforløb i sengeafsnittet.

Om os Klinik for Lungesygdomme er et stort og højt specialiseret ambulatorium med følgende subspecialer:

  • Astma
  • Interstitielle lungesygdomme
  • Komplicerede lungeinfektioner
  • Alfa-1-antitrypsinmangel
  • KOL
  • Tuberkulose
  • Kompliceret søvnapnø
  • Iltbehandling
Vi arbejder i tværfaglige teams med høj faglig ekspertise og et stærkt fokus på kvalitet, patientsikkerhed og patientinddragelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver I ambulatoriet bliver du en vigtig del af udredning, behandling og pleje af patienter med lungesygdomme. Dine opgaver kan blandt andet omfatte:

  • Måling af lungefunktion
  • Reversibilitetstest
  • Mannitol- og metakolintest
  • NO-måling
  • Intravenøs behandling
  • A-punktur
  • Vejledning i brug af inhalationsdevices
  • Patientundervisning og rådgivning
Vi tilbyder Hos os bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor faglig udvikling og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et positivt og engageret kollegafællesskab
  • Høj faglighed og specialiserede patientforløb
  • Regelmæssig undervisning, tavlemøder og faglige konferencer
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde på tværs af specialer
  • Et grundigt og individuelt tilrettelagt introduktionsprogram
  • Løbende kompetenceudvikling og sparring
  • Indflydelse på vagtplanlægningen med fokus på balance mellem arbejds- og privatliv
  • En afdeling, hvor nye idéer og initiativer bliver værdsat
Vi er kendetegnet ved hjælpsomhed, loyalitet og godt humør, og vi arbejder aktivt for, at både patienter, pårørende og medarbejdere oplever høj kvalitet og respektfulde relationer.

Vi søger dig, som
  • Er autoriseret sygeplejerske
  • Trives med ambulant sygepleje og komplekse patientforløb
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig fagligt inden for lungemedicin
  • Er engageret, samarbejdsorienteret og tager medansvar for fællesskabet
  • Bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø og en høj kvalitet i patientbehandlingen
Erfaring inden for lungemedicin er en fordel, men ikke en forudsætning.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgning Ansøgningsfrist: 24. november 2026

Samtaler afholdes: 26. november 2026

Ansættelsesudvalget består af oversygeplejerske Nana Thisted samt to sygeplejersker fra ambulatoriet.

Har du spørgsmål eller ønsker at besøge afdelingen inden din ansøgning, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Oversygeplejerske Nana Thisted
Telefon: 21 24 02 28

title: Product Manager (Contract Basis)

Description
About the job

THE ROLE

Lead

  • Direct the end-to-end product strategy and vision across a portfolio of products, aligning with company-wide business objectives.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional roadmaps across multiple product teams, ensuring alignment on priorities, dependencies, and outcomes.
  • Champion a customer-centric culture across the organization, embedding user insights into strategic decision-making.
  • Ratify major product investment decisions, build-vs-buy trade-offs, and go-to-market strategies with executive stakeholders.
  • Govern product development lifecycle standards, planning cadences, and success metrics across teams.
  • Direct organizational design and hiring strategy for the product team, building high-performing PM organizations.
  • Encourage practical use of AI-assisted workflows for product discovery, documentation, analysis, and delivery operations where they improve team effectiveness.
  • Orchestrate executive-level reporting and business reviews, translating product performance into strategic narratives.
  • Champion strategic partnerships and negotiations with external stakeholders that shape the product portfolio.
  • Ratify pricing, packaging, and monetization strategies in partnership with Finance and Commercial leadership.
  • Mentor and develop Senior and Mid Product Managers, building organizational capability and succession pipelines.
  • Direct risk management for high-stakes product decisions, ensuring business continuity and stakeholder confidence.

Senior

  • Lead the product strategy and roadmap for a major product line, translating business goals into a clear execution plan.
  • Strategize go-to-market plans in partnership with Marketing, Sales, and Design leadership.
  • Authorize prioritization trade-offs across features, technical debt, and platform investments.
  • Synergize efforts across Engineering, Design, Data, and Business teams to ensure aligned, high-impact delivery.
  • Negotiate scope, timeline, and resourcing trade-offs with stakeholders, providing clear recommendations.
  • Lead discovery and validation efforts for new product bets, using data and qualitative insights to reduce risk.
  • Evaluate market trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies; recommend strategic responses.
  • Use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully for research synthesis, PRD drafting, competitive analysis, backlog clarity, and acceptance criteria, validating facts and assumptions.
  • Formulate and own key product metrics, OKRs, and success criteria for the product line.
  • Lead cross-functional planning ceremonies (roadmap reviews, sprint planning, retrospectives) for the product area.
  • Mentor and grow Mid and Associate Product Managers through structured feedback and coaching.
  • Plan and control major product launches, proactively surfacing risks and coordinating resolution across teams.

Mid

  • Plan and manage the product backlog for a defined product area, translating stakeholder input into clear requirements.
  • Control the quality of feature delivery through acceptance criteria, testing coordination, and release readiness checks.
  • Evaluate user feedback, support tickets, and usage data to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Formulate and document product requirements, user stories, and specs that align with the broader product strategy.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, and QA to deliver features end to end.
  • Recommend improvements to product features or processes based on data and day-to-day execution experience.
  • Use AI-assisted tools where helpful for research summaries, backlog organization, requirement drafts, and release notes, validating outputs before sharing.
  • Participate in roadmap planning, incorporating feedback constructively to refine scope and priorities.
  • Plan and execute A/B tests or small-scale experiments under guidance from senior product managers.
  • Contribute to competitive analysis and market research to support product decisions.
  • Stay current with product management practices and evaluate new tools or techniques relevant to the team's work.
Requirements

Lead

  • 8+ years of experience in product management, with a demonstrable track record of leading product portfolios at scale.
  • Deep expertise in setting product vision and strategy for complex, multi-product organizations.
  • Proven experience building and leading high-performing product management teams.
  • Extensive experience with executive stakeholder management, including board-level or C-level communication.
  • Strong command of business strategy, P&L ownership, and monetization models.
  • Deep experience driving org-wide product operating models, planning frameworks, and governance.
  • Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and drive alignment across large, matrixed organizations.
  • Ability to identify practical uses of AI-assisted workflows while managing privacy, quality, and business-risk considerations.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence company-wide strategy and communicate vision to diverse audiences.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen to evaluate business trade-offs at scale.
  • Experience with partnership negotiations, platform strategy, or M&A evaluation is a plus.
  • Good communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken.

Senior

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in product management, with a demonstrable track record of shipping and scaling successful products.
  • Deep expertise in product discovery, strategy formulation, and roadmap prioritization frameworks.
  • Proven mastery of data-driven decision-making, including experimentation, analytics, and metrics definition.
  • Extensive experience partnering with Engineering and Design leadership on complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Strong command of go-to-market planning, positioning, and stakeholder communication.
  • Deep experience managing full product lifecycles, from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Practical fluency with AI-assisted productivity tools for research, analysis, documentation, or workflow automation is an advantage.
  • Proven ability to influence technical and business decisions without direct authority.
  • Experience mentoring junior product managers and shaping team practices.
  • Strong command of product tools such as Jira, analytics platforms (Amplitude/Mixpanel), and roadmapping software.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly with executive and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken.

Mid

  • 2–4 years of hands-on experience in product management or related roles (e.g., business analysis, engineering, consulting).
  • Solid understanding of product development lifecycles and agile methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience writing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Basic experience with data analysis tools (SQL, Excel, or analytics platforms) to inform decisions.
  • Familiarity with user research methods and translating insights into product requirements.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for product documentation, research synthesis, or analysis is an advantage.
  • Experience using product management tools (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent).
  • Understanding of UX/UI principles sufficient to collaborate effectively with design.
  • Understanding of prioritization frameworks (e.g., RICE, MoSCoW) and backlog management.
  • Basic awareness of go-to-market processes and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with attention to detail and willingness to learn.
  • Good communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken.

title: Ledsager søges til kvinde i Ringsted
description:
Ledsager søges til 46-årig kvinde i Ringsted.

Frisk kvinde søger en ledsager. Hun fortæller selv, hvad hun skal. Hun har pt. en almindelig bil med manuelt gear, som også kan bruges på ledsagerture. Ledsager skal hjælpe med at løfte rollator eller kørestol op i bilen. Hun forflytter sig selv og kan gå korte afstande. Hun bor sammen med sin mand på landet, hvor de har en kat.

Kørestolen kan være tung, og den har ikke bremser, så man skal være robust.

Hun vil gerne bruge sin ledsagelse til svømning, hvor du skal hjælpe hende derhen og hjælpe hende med øvelser i vandet. Hun skal også hjælpes ind i omklædningen. Der er mulighed for selv at klæde om i eget rum. Der er handicapomklædning i svømmehallen. Ledsager skal køre hendes bil frem og tilbage. Det er derfor et krav, at du har kørekort.

I vinterhalvåret ønsker hun også at vinterbade og komme i sauna/saunagus. Ledsager behøver ikke gå med i vandet, men ledsager skal hjælpe borger frem og tilbage samt være i saunaen med borger.

Borger har 15 timer pr. måned til ledsagelse.
Ledsagelsen er onsdag eller fredag. Onsdag vil være kl. 06.15 til ca. 08.45 og fredag fra ca. kl. 06:30 til ca. 09:00.
Vinterbadning kan være sene eftermiddage eller om aftenen f.eks. fra kl.18-21. Det kan være både weekend og hverdage, og I aftaler fra gang til gang.

Der kan evt. forekomme andre aftaler til f.eks. sauna eller andet efter aftale.

Stillingen som ledsager er en deltidsstilling.
Ledsageordningen bruges altid til selvvalgte aktiviteter uden for borgers bolig.
Borger afholder alle udgifter i forbindelse med ledsagelsen.

Timeløn:
Hverdage: Ca. 170 kr.
Lørdag: Ca. 180 kr.
Søndag: Ca. 190 kr.
Lønnen varierer i forhold til, hvor i landet borger bor.

Stillingen skal søges via din profil på www.duos.dk og har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan ledsageteamet kontaktes på tlf. 36 34 81 28.

title: Red Team Lead Engineer
description:
Who we are looking for

As a senior member of the Red Team within the cybersecurity organization, the Red Team Lead Engineer will guide and execute adversary‑emulation activities, threat‑informed security testing, and controlled offensive security operations. The Lead Engineer is responsible for ensuring all testing activities align with organizational standards, authorization requirements, and applicable regulatory expectations, and that they are conducted safely within approved scopes and environments.

Why this role is important to us

The Red Team Lead Engineer will design and lead comprehensive, intelligence‑driven assessments across enterprise applications, platforms, cloud services, and critical infrastructure. These assessments evaluate both technical security controls and the effectiveness of detection, prevention, and incident‑response capabilities across the organization.

This role will collaborate with technical subject‑matter experts, security leadership, process and risk stakeholders, cyber threat intelligence analysts, defensive operations teams, and business system owners to ensure testing scenarios accurately represent realistic adversary behaviors and align with enterprise risk priorities. The Lead Engineer is expected to bring deep technical expertise across core security control domains, including identity and access management, data protection, secure software practices, cloud and infrastructure security, endpoint and detection technologies, network security, and vulnerability and threat management. Knowledge of security monitoring, detection engineering, and incident‑response workflows further supports effective evaluation of organizational defenses.

As a senior role, the Red Team Lead Engineer will also contribute to methodology refinement, scenario development, process improvement, documentation standards, and cross‑team coordination, helping advance the maturity and effectiveness of the overall testing program.

What you will be responsible for

  • Lead and execute adversary‑emulation activities to assess organizational defenses and security control effectiveness.
  • Oversee and perform targeted security assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and critical enterprise technologies.
  • Guide team members, assign work, and review testing approaches for quality and safety.
  • Collaborate with security, technology, and risk stakeholders to design realistic, threat‑informed testing scenarios.
  • Evaluate detection and response capabilities and drive improvements through coordinated purple‑team efforts.
  • Develop and refine testing methodologies, tooling standards, and reporting practices to mature the program.
  • Deliver audit‑ready reports and provide guidance on remediation to reduce identified risks.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  • Advanced proficiency in offensive security techniques and threat‑informed testing methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of adversary behaviors and attack frameworks to guide scenario design.
  • Broad, technical knowledge across networks, operating systems, cloud environments, and core security controls.
  • Demonstrated analytical ability to identify core issues, interpret risk, and propose practical, evidence‑driven solutions.
  • Strong organizational, time‑management, and prioritization skills in dynamic and high‑pressure environments.
  • Commitment to maintaining awareness of emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and offensive security trends.
  • Ability to develop or refine tools and automate tasks using common scripting languages.
  • Demonstrated leadership in analyzing complex issues, shaping direction, and guiding team decision‑making.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to distill complex technical concepts for diverse audiences.
  • High integrity, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling sensitive information and operating under pressure.

Education & Preferred Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent advanced security experience.
  • 4–6 years leading and/ or conducting penetration testing or red‑team activities.
  • Broad expertise across networks, operating systems, cloud, and security controls.
  • Strong knowledge of threat‑informed testing and attack frameworks.
  • Experience coordinating with defensive teams to evaluate detections.
  • Ability to script and automate tasks using common languages.

Exceptional communication and reporting skills for diverse audiencesWj
