title: Tekniksystemledare – inriktning Medicinsk IT
description:
Är du intresserad av att samarbeta med kompetenta och engagerade kollegor med förvaltning och utveckling av Försvarsmaktens ledningsstödsystem? Då kan befattningen tekniksystemledare vara något för dig. Välkommen med din ansökan!

FMTIS Teknik- och vidmakthållandekontor Ledningssystem (TVK Ledsyst) består av cirka 190 medarbetare på sju avdelningar. Enhetens huvudsakliga uppgift är anskaffning och förvaltning av Försvarsmaktens lednings- och informationssystem under hela livscykeln, från utveckling till avveckling, under såväl krig som kris och fred. Försvarsmakten och enheten är under stark tillväxt.

Logistik IT sektionen inom TVK Ledsyst ansvarar för design och vidmakthåll av en omfattande och komplex IT-produktportfölj. Sektionen består av ett kompetent sammansvetsat team som ligger i framkant inom IT Logisitksystem. Det innebär ett tvärfunktionellt arbete där hela Försvarsmakten berörs.

Vi vill nu förstärka vår leverans inom Försvarsmedicin med en Teknisksystemledare med inriktning mot Medicinsk IT. Vi söker dig som har en gedigen arbetserfarenhet från jobb inom IT-branschen, gärna med inriktning mot medicinsk IT, och är van att jobba i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT-leverantör.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

Du kommer att ha ett helhetsansvar för ett antal IT-produkter som ingår i en IT-portfölj som stödjer i materielrelaterad informationshantering och i Försvarsmaktens logistikfunktioner. Vidare leder du arbetet inom ett produktnära team där verksamhetsrepresentanter och IT-utförare ingår.

Du genomför själv, eller lägger ut uppdrag till andra, olika typer av utredningar och beredningar samt tar fram underlag nödvändiga för IT-beslut. Det innebär att du måste trivas med att skriva dokument och att du kan uttrycka dig väl i skrift, även när ämnet är komplicerat.

Då vi jobbar i ett team med en IT-portfölj kan du även få uppgifter som behövs utifrån hela portföljens perspektiv och där din kompetens och tidigare yrkeserfarenheter kan tas tillvara.

KRAV

Kvalifikationer

  • Akademisk examen inom exempelvis systemvetenskap. Alternativt lång yrkeserfarenhet inom IT-verksamheter med sjukvårds/medicinsk inriktning som arbetsgivaren bedömer gett dig motsvarande kunskaper inhämtade på annat sätt.
  • Du har förmåga att förstå och uttrycka dig i både tal och skrift (och i modeller) och på både svenska och engelska.
  • God förmåga att ställa upp och disponera text i skrivelser, rapporter och beslutsunderlag
  • B-körkort

Personliga egenskaper

Vi ser att du arbetar systematiskt, strukturerat och har ett stor drivkraft och engagemang samt en god analytisk förmåga. Vidare ser vi att du behöver vara social och ”service minded” och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra för att nå mål och skapa värdeleveranser.

Du drar dig inte för att ena dagen läsa omfattande systemdokumentation eller avtalstexter till att nästa dag möta verksamheten som nyttjar "dina" IT-produkter för att höra deras synpunkter kring leveransen och deras framtida behov.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personliga egenskaper, kompetensprofiler och yrkeserfarenhet.

MERITERANDE

Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med:

  • livscykelhantering av IT-produkter
  • upphandling av IT-produkter och IT-tjänster enligt LOU (Lagen om offentlig upphandling)
  • verksamhetsutveckling inom en IT-organisation baserat på t ex IT4IT referensarkitektur, ITIL eller något annat ramverk/standard eller inom Medicinsk IT.
  • IT-produkter som används inom sjukvård, t ex med journalsystem och tillhörande applikationer för medicinskteknisk utrustning
  • något av de IT-systemlösningar som används inom Försvarsmakten som anställd

För att myndighetens uppdrag ska vara framgångsrikt förutsätts att alla medarbetare uppträder enligt den värdegrund som finns. Försvarsmaktens värdegrund slår vakt om alla människors lika värde, rättvisa och jämlikhet och främjar demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter (läs mer på http://www.forsvarsmakten.se).

Övrigt

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare. Försvarsmakten tillämpar sex månaders provanställning för dig som inte är anställd i myndigheten.

Sysselsättningsgrad: Heltid

Arbetsort: Enköping. Resor i tjänsten till andra orter i Sverige förekommer

Civil befattning

Tillträdesdatum: Enligt överenskommelse

Upplysningar om befattningen

Sektionschef Charlotta Wolf, Avdelningschef Jonas Halllbäcken

Information om rekryteringsprocessen

Personaladministratör Mia Penttinen

Fackliga företrädare

Saco-S – Agnetha Landquist

SEKO – Matz Felix

OFR/S – ​Martin Sparr

OFR/O – Heikki V​idell

Samtliga nås via växeln 010-825 70 00

Ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-11-15. Din ansökan ska innehålla CV och ansökningsbrev där du motiverar varför du är lämpad för denna befattning samt svar på angivna urvalsfrågor.

Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats. --------------------------------------------------------Information om Försvarsmakten och det rekryterande förbandet:Försvarsmaktens telekommunikations- och informationssystemförband, FMTIS, säkerställer Försvarsmaktens förmåga att kommunicera och leda - dygnet runt, året om. Förbandet har ett samlat ansvar för Försvarsmaktens tekniska ledningssystem som stödjer militära insatser till sjöss, på land och i luften – i Sverige och utomlands. Förbandet har närmare 2000 medarbetare på mer än 32 orter runt om i landet. Läs mer på https://jobb.forsvarsmakten.se/fmtisEn anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras samt att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning.Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas.Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: Economic Vitality & Business Relations Specialist
description:
The Downtown Spokane Partnership is seeking an Economic Vitality & Business Relations Specialist who enjoys building relationships, helping businesses solve problems, and turning information into practical action.


You will serve as a primary connection between DSP and downtown businesses, entrepreneurs, property owners, and community partners. Your work will help existing businesses remain and grow downtown, connect prospective businesses with opportunities, and keep DSP informed about conditions throughout the district.


Reporting to the President & CEO, this position combines regular business visits with research, relationship management, and program coordination.



What You’ll Do

  • Support business success. Conduct proactive business visits, identify challenges and growth opportunities, and connect businesses with permitting, licensing, financing, workforce, and business-planning resources.
  • Follow through on business needs. Track assistance requests, coordinate referrals, document outcomes, and bring unresolved concerns and retention risks to the appropriate DSP staff.
  • Build downtown relationships. Maintain regular contact with businesses, BID ratepayers, property owners, managers, and brokers. Welcome new businesses and introduce them to downtown services and resources.
  • Support recruitment and investment. Maintain information about available commercial spaces, respond to prospective business inquiries, and connect entrepreneurs and expanding businesses with spaces, market information, and resource partners.
  • Maintain useful business intelligence. Keep accurate business, property, contact, and assistance records. Track openings, closures, relocations, expansions, vacancies, and investment activity.
  • Translate information into action. Analyze outreach findings, vacancy information, foot-traffic data, and other indicators; prepare economic vitality updates and draft content for board reporting and marketing materials.
  • Strengthen membership engagement. Identify prospective members and support recruitment, onboarding, renewal conversations, and participation. Coordinate with Administrative Services and Policy & External Affairs on records, advocacy engagement, and designated relationships.
  • Coordinate business programs. Organize roundtables, resource workshops, and targeted assistance initiatives that respond to business needs.
  • Collaborate across DSP. Contribute business stories, content ideas, and promotional outreach to Marketing; coordinate with businesses adjacent to placemaking projects; and help colleagues respond to recurring district concerns.



What We’re Looking For

You are approachable, organized, and comfortable starting conversations with people you have not met. You listen carefully, ask useful questions, and take responsibility for follow-through. You can balance time in the district with accurate records, research, and coordination.



Qualifications include:

  • At least two years of relevant experience in business, customer relations, project coordination, or helping people navigate resources. Business ownership and substantial relevant community experience will be considered.
  • Ability to build trust and work professionally with business owners, property representatives, public employees, and people with varied backgrounds and perspectives.
  • Strong organization, sound judgment, attention to detail, and discretion with confidential information.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain information and recommended next steps.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 and Excel, with the ability to learn CRM and market-information tools.
  • Ability to interpret basic business and market information, recognize emerging issues, and communicate findings.
  • Ability to work primarily in downtown Spokane, participate in regular district visits in varying weather, and occasionally attend early morning, evening, or weekend meetings.



We welcome candidates with experience in economic or community development, small-business ownership, retail or hospitality management, banking, real estate, membership organizations, public service, and community work. We consider relevant experience, education, training, business ownership, and community involvement together.



Experience with business assistance, membership engagement, public-agency processes, or Spokane’s business community is helpful. Familiarity with CRM systems, business surveys, commercial-space inventories, GIS, or tools such as Placer.ai and CoStar is preferred.



Why DSP Is a Great Place to Work

This position offers the opportunity to work directly with downtown businesses and see the results of your efforts in the community.



DSP’s benefits include:

  • 100% employer-paid employee health, vision, and dental insurance.
  • 100% employer-paid life insurance.
  • Voluntary supplemental life insurance and long-term disability.
  • 12 paid holidays annually.
  • 80 hours of accrued vacation plus Washington sick leave.
  • A 401(k) retirement plan with employer match up to 4%.
  • Monthly transportation/parking and technology stipends.
  • Performance bonus eligibility.



DSP offers flexible work schedules and occasional remote work options. This position is primarily based in our downtown Spokane office. Some benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and waiting/probationary periods.



About DSP

The Downtown Spokane Partnership is dedicated to a dynamic, vibrant, livable, and sustainable Downtown. As a private, 501(c)(6) nonprofit organization, DSP serves as Spokane’s central city advocate for economic and community vitality. DSP has managed the Downtown Spokane Business Improvement District since 1995, providing supplemental programs and enhanced services across an 80-block area that includes nearly 2,200 property owners and business tenants.



Our core values are Collaborative, Innovative, and Diverse.



Downtown Spokane Partnership is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to inclusion and diversity. DSP recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected statuses as required by applicable law. DSP does not discriminate based on genetic information in its employment-related policies and practices, including coverage under its health benefits program. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. All employees must have permission to work in the U.S.; employment eligibility verification is required.

title: Technical Writer
description:
Salary: Rp 6.000.000 – Rp 9.000.000 per month

Job Description

  • Establish HoLink’s documentation workflow, structure, standards, templates, and review process from the ground up.

  • Audit existing product information and identify documentation gaps based on user journeys, product features, and user needs.

  • Create and maintain end-user documentation, including User Guides, Help Center articles, Quick Start Guides, FAQs, Troubleshooting Guides, Onboarding Materials, and Release Notes.

  • Translate complex product features and technical information into simple, clear, and actionable documentation for non-technical users.

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA, UI/UX Designers, Frontend Developers, and Backend Developers to understand requirements and actual product behavior.

  • Validate documentation against the actual product experience before and after release to ensure accuracy.

  • Keep documentation synchronized with product updates, feature changes, improvements, and releases.

  • Gather input from Product, Customer Support, and user feedback to continuously improve documentation and identify recurring user issues.

  • Maintain consistent terminology, information architecture, documentation style, and version control across product documentation.

  • Coordinate with HoLink’s Indonesia Product team and China Development team to ensure requirements, implementation, and documentation remain aligned.

  • Define documentation priorities based on user impact, feature urgency, product releases, and business needs.

  • Monitor documentation effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve self-service, onboarding, usability, and reduce repetitive support inquiries.

  • Support Frontend/Backend, API, integration, and developer documentation as HoLink’s technical documentation needs grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in Technical Writing / Product Documentation.

  • Must have experience working in a SaaS company or SaaS product environment.

  • Must have experience working in the digital technology industry.

  • Experience in creative/productivity platforms, creator tools, design tools, website builders, or similar user-driven products is highly preferred.

  • Strong experience creating User Guides, Help Center articles, Release Notes, and Technical Documentation.

  • API / Developer Documentation experience is a strong plus.

  • Able to translate complex technical concepts into clear and easy-to-understand documentation for end-users.

  • Experienced in collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA, UI/UX, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and building documentation processes from scratch.

  • Portfolio with proven impact or measurable achievements is highly preferred.

title: Avionics Hardware Engineer - Lunar Permanence
description:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.


As part of a passionate and accomplished team of experts, you will be a crucial member of our Core Avionics organization in the Lunar Permanence Business Unit. Directly contribute to the successful development of avionics components for our Lunar Vehicles. Work with a team of engineers to define, test, and certify avionics hardware. Responsibilities for this role are varied and dynamic, spanning the entire product life cycle from conception to sustainment, with partners across multiple technical functions. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration to enable affordable, safe, and repeatable spaceflight.


You will be working on development, manufacturing, and testing of Lunar Command and Data Handling (C&DH) and Power Management and Distribution (PMAD) components. Your engineering responsibilities include developing product requirements, defining interfaces, supporting hardware build, integration, and test, developing and implementing verification and qualification strategies, conducting root cause analysis, and developing mitigation plans for hardware failures.


Above all, we are looking for an avionics hardware engineer who is intellectually curious, holds a strong desire to continuously improve the capability and quality of products, and is dedicated to safety. Passion for our mission and vision is required!


Special Mentions

  • Relocation provided
  • Travel expected up to 20% of the time. Most work will reside in Kent, WA.
  • Predominately 1st shift M-F; however, some evening or weekend work may be required during prime test campaigns
  • On-site requirement 5-days / week
  • Multiple positions available

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Supporting C&DH and PMAD Responsible Engineers in avionics box lifecycle development in areas such as:

  • Hardware build, integration, and test of Engineering Development Unit (EDU) and flight hardware
  • Verification and qualification activities
  • Requirements development and interface definition
  • Root cause analyses for hardware failures and mitigation plan development

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, or other related field
  • Avionics hardware build and test experience
  • Complex hardware design experience in product design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR)
  • Knowledge of / experience in requirements development and requirements-based verification
  • Familiarity with integrated systems verification, including developing hardware verification test plans and verification test reports for certification / qualification
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master of Science in Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related fields
  • Successful candidates typically have 6+ years of proven track record in design, development, or test of space industry avionics components and systems
  • Experience developing digital, analog, and / or mixed-signal circuit board designs for avionics systems (including design, prototyping, schematics, layout, test and verification)
  • Experience in circuit analysis and simulation, such as worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity analysis, and logic or P-Spice simulation
  • Experience in grounding and general board layout principles, including EMI/EMC tradeoffs
  • Experience with Jama or similar requirements management tools
  • Experience with MIL-STD/DO-160/SMC-S-016 environmental qualification testing of avionics hardware
  • Familiarity with ARP 4754 and/or DO-254/DO-178 or similar standards
  • Familiarity with product development lifecycle phases
  • Familiarity with hardware development, integration, or verification

WA applicants is $130,706.00 - $182,987.70

Other site ranges may differ

title: Jr. Systems Administrator
description:
FORT VALLEY STATE UNIVERSITY (FVSU), a state and land-grant institution of the University System of Georgia, invites applications for the position of Junior Systems Administrator.

Fort Valley State University, the only 1890 land-grant university in Georgia, is a comprehensive institution that provides an education to over 2,800 students including graduate students. The university is located in the town of Fort Valley in Peach County, the original site of the state's peach industry. Its 1,365-acre (5.52 km2) campus is Georgia's second-largest public university in area.

Fort Valley State University is an equal opportunity employer. The University does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or University System of Georgia policy.

JOB SUMMARY

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer. This position will also be directed by the Assistant Director of Information Technology and System Admin Team lead. This position is responsible for the installation, testing, maintenance, documentation, and provision of technical support for university wide systems software, as well as modifying existing and creating new systems software for specific needs. Assists with software product planning, evaluation, and testing. Assists in planning hardware changes and provides technical assistance to a variety of users across campus.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the team's ticket queue and escalating issues as necessary.
  • Build electronic forms to advance university efficiency.
  • Monitors FVSU's website daily to ensure availability, patching, performance, and security.
  • Maintain continuous system availability, system security procedures and access to user accounts.
  • Manage university-wide systems such as DHCP, DNS, file, mail, and print servers as well as their associated operating systems and software.
  • Assists in the planning and installation of new hardware and software systems.
  • Assists in the coordination and implementation of software system changes and upgrades.
  • Performs software product evaluation, including installation, testing, reporting, and technical support to the campus community.
  • Installs, configures, tests, maintains, and documents systems software including operating systems, compilers, utility programs, email systems, web-based systems, database management systems, etc.
  • Manage security solutions, including firewall, anti-virus, and intrusion detection systems
  • Develops and maintains appropriate systems data backup and disaster recovery procedures to ensure integrity of computer system data. Maintains file system integrity using system management software tools.
  • Provides technical support to peers on the use of systems and application software.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED BY THE POSITION

  • Ability to effectively adopt and integrate new networking and security technologies
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional relationship with faculty, staff and students, and provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to think logically, resolve problems, identify tasks, and develop project plans.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and requests based on the organizational goals and objectives of the university.
  • Interpersonal skills, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously and to provide input in a team environment.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or closely related field; equivalent training and experience may be considered in lieu of degree.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical problems.
  • Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation.
  • Extensive knowledge of Windows and Mac OS X Operating Systems.
  • One (1) years' experience in a multi-vendor, multi-platform environment.
  • Knowledge of PC/Mac hardware and software applications.
  • Email systems, Listserv, Oracle, Web servers, Active Directory, TCP/IP networking.
  • Understanding of common network protocols and operating systems along with their relevant security issues
  • Possess real-world operational and implementation expertise to deliver integrated security solutions

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Industry certifications for IT professionals a plus (A+, Net+, Server+, etc.)
  • Higher education institution IT experience

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
About Signify


Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.


At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.


Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.


More about the role


Job Summary

We are looking for a Lead Data Scientist with 4+ years of experience to lead data science, Generative AI, and Agentic AI initiatives. The candidate will design and build AI-driven solutions using LLMs, RAG, AI agents, machine learning, and advanced analytics. This role requires strong hands-on technical skills, business problem-solving ability, and experience guiding junior team members.

Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Design, build, and optimize LLM-based applications using techniques such as prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, and AI agents.
  • Develop and evaluate machine learning models for use cases such as prediction, classification, forecasting, recommendation, anomaly detection, NLP, and optimization
  • Work with structured and unstructured data to extract insights, build features, and create AI-ready data pipelines.
  • Evaluate GenAI and Agentic AI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination risk, safety, bias, latency, and business usefulness
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools such as Codex, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar tools for faster coding, experimentation, debugging, and documentation
  • Communicate technical findings, model performance, risks, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, AI, analytics, or related roles.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and strong working knowledge of SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with data science libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms, model evaluation, feature engineering, experimentation, and statistical analysis.
  • Practical experience with Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, vector databases, and model evaluation.
  • Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including tool calling, planning, memory, orchestration, multi-agent workflows, and guardrails.
  • Experience working with APIs and integrating AI/ML models into applications, workflows, or business systems.
  • Ability to understand, validate, debug, and improve outputs generated by GenAI tools.

Good to have skills:

  • Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar
  • Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps practices including model monitoring, prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, CI/CD, and observability


Everything we’ll do for you


You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.


Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: Payload Operations Engineer III (TS/SCI Required)
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Blue National Security (BNS) Business Unit, which is focused on delivering resilient, mission-critical space capabilities, including Blue Ring, to support national defense and objectives. With Blue Ring, our customers are empowered to achieve operational advantage across cislunar and Earth orbit domains, redefine mission flexibility, and pursue bold new concepts that were once beyond reach.

As a Payload Operations Engineer supporting Blue Ring, you will ensure mission readiness by contributing to the development of hosted and separable payload-specific operational concepts, preparing essential operations products, and serving as a key member of the on-console team during mission execution. You will collaborate extensively with engineers from across the space and ground segments to ensure payload operations and the associated mission planning are successfully performed on orbit. The ideal candidate is a systems-thinker with a strong focus on customer experience, possessing the persistence and passion to build and execute space operations from the ground up.

Join us in enabling Blue Origin's vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth — passion for our mission is required!

Special Mentions

  • This role requires occasional periods of shift work and on-call availability during mission-critical phases, anomaly resolution, and key customer milestones.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To:

  • Contribute to the development of hosted and separable payload mission plans, operations concepts, tools, and processes that enable highly effective real-time operations.
  • Develop and implement detailed spacecraft payload operations procedures, executables, telemetry displays, and other technical documentation.
  • Conduct testing and validation of payload operations products using a variety of hardware and software simulation environments.
  • Support mission planning efforts with geographically separated payload teams to ensure operational objectives are met during on-orbit operations.
  • Support the development of the overall spacecraft concept of operations, ensuring payload operability and efficiency.
  • Create detailed test procedures alongside of systems engineering teams to validate end-to-end ground to payload system capabilities.
  • Support mission readiness activities including mission rehearsals, timeline development, and post-launch test planning.
  • Monitor payload state-of-health, perform trending and analysis on performance data, and track system configurations throughout on-orbit execution.
  • Serve as liaison between payload customers and Blue Ring operations team during pre-launch coordination as well as during long-term operations.
  • Support development of payload operations sequencing and incorporation into the mission planning system.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • B.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of proven experience in spacecraft operations development or execution.
  • Must have an active Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) U.S. Government security clearance.
  • Experience developing spacecraft or hosted payload operations products, such as procedures, telemetry displays, or technical documents.
  • Experience with supporting external customers or government teams.
  • Ability to support on-console activities, including shift work, in a dynamic, real-time environment.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • M.S. in Space Systems, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or Aerospace Engineering.
  • Direct support for a commercial or government spacecraft operations organization.
  • Proficiency with command-and-control scripting languages, such as Python, SPELL, STOL, or JAS.
  • Experience working with virtualized Ground Software (e.g., Command & Control, Mission Planning, Flight Dynamics, Electronic Procedures).
  • Experience with mission planning and contact planning tools.
  • Experience with satellite fault management and/or onboard autonomy.
  • Familiarity with designing and evaluating operational readiness tests integrated with hardware-in-the-loop and software-in-the-loop simulators.

CO applicants is $119,814.00 - $167,738.55

title: Senior Ground Software Engineer - Blue Ring (TS/SCI Required)
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.

As part of a hardworking team of engineers and mission operators, you will work closely with space vehicle and ground system teams to develop, test, deploy software for critical functions like activity planning, commanding, telemetry monitoring, visualization, and training.

As a Ground Software Engineer, you will also help develop, integrate, and test the software required for the Blue Ring Mission Operations Center used to fly on-orbit vehicles. Join us in enabling Blue Origin’s vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit earth - passion for our mission is required!

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Special Mentions:

  • Relocation provided
  • Interviews will include a technical assessment

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design, implement, test, verify and deploy mission operations software systems, ensuring the success of the overall Ground System (hardware/software) supporting Blue Origin space mission operations.
  • Work with multiple teams, including engineers from fields like flight vehicle systems, mission control infrastructure, operations subject areas, and customers to define software requirements, architectures, and designs.
  • Develop rapid prototypes to prove out concepts and quantify technical risks.
  • Coordinate with systems infrastructure and system engineers to plan, develop, and verify, to ensure software products meet requirements and safety-critical standards.
  • Produce user documentation for software architecture, design, verification plans, user manual and training material.
  • Follow software development processes that meet Blue Origin and customer-required standards to ensure software safety and reliability.
  • Support frequent update cycles in support of pre-flight testing, mission validation exercises and operations training events.
  • Support mission control software operations responsibilities (maintenance, defect correction, improvements) during operator training; ground data system verification, validation, and certification; spacecraft integration; and flight.
  • Integrate software components, develop, and run unit-level and system-level tests, validate using Software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop simulators, and release certified code.
  • Support in developing materials for software design, verification plans, user manuals, and training

Minimum Qualifications:

  • B.S. or higher degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, aerospace engineering, or related field or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Experience in software engineering over the course of the full lifecycle of software development, including system design and analysis, requirement capture and development, software implementation and verification, system integration, qualification, and release.
  • Experience in software build automation, continuous integration, configuration management, verification, and deployment
  • Demonstrated software development skills in multiple software languages, with ability to implement in the language most appropriate to the problem-domain
  • Familiarity with Linux environment and comfortable with basic Unix system administration activities.
  • Ability to earn trust and maintain positive and professional relationships.
  • Active Top Secret Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing and developing ground software for space flight operations.
  • Expertise developing complex application in Python
  • Experience with REST, Kafka, GRPC, web development and/or database development and interfaces.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Cloud Technologies
  • Familiarity developing software systems for one or more of the following applications and technologies:
    • Telemetry data processing, fault monitoring, flight dynamics
    • Mission activity planning and scheduling
  • Experience with spacecraft subsystems and associated subsystem software.

title: Generalist med økonomiske og analytiske kompetencer søges til Forsvarsministeriets Regnskabsstyrelse i Hjørring
description:
Vil du arbejde med ledelsesunderstøttelse, hvor økonomi og budgetter er en stor del af opgaverne? Er du akademiker? Motiveres du af at foretage økonomiske analyser og prognoser? Deler du gerne din viden, så du kan understøtte chefer på flere forskellige områder, så de føler sig godt klædt på? Så er det måske dig vi leder efter?

Om os

Direktions- og Ledelsesstøtte er en del af Regnskabsstyrelsens stab, der ud over os, består af tre andre teams, der bl.a. understøtter direktion og ledelse. Staben arbejder med administrative opgaver rettet mod både den interne organisation og den operative struktur samt databeskyttelse og informationssikkerhed. Staben understøtter hele Regnskabsstyrelsen og koncernen som helhed.

Vi er 10 medarbejdere, der med forskellige baggrunde understøtter direktionen og ledelsen med en lang række opgaver inden for bl.a. økonomi, strategi, rekruttering, og kompetenceudvikling.

Vi lægger vægt på en uformel omgangstone, godt samarbejde og sammenhold. Vi har mulighed for fleksibel tilrettelæggelse af arbejdstiden, så vi kan få enderne til at mødes i balancen mellem arbejds- og familielivet.

Om stillingen

Du skal yde generel ledelsesunderstøttelse, men en stor del af opgaverne vil have økonomisk betydning. Du skal forvente, at den daglige sagsbehandling omfatter udarbejdelse af analyser og prognoser.

Dine opgaver vil primært være indenfor følgende områder:

  • Udarbejde og vedligeholde styrelsens budgetter i samarbejde med ledelsen og de budgetansvarlige chefer
  • Varetage den løbende økonomiopfølgning på løn, drift og øvrige økonomiske dispositioner
  • Udarbejde månedlige økonomirapporteringer, ledelsesinformation og økonomiske analyser til styrelsens ledelse
  • Rådgive og understøtte budgetansvarlige chefer i spørgsmål om budgetter, forbrug og økonomisk styring
  • Bidrage til udvikling og effektivisering af styrelsens økonomistyring, herunder styringsværktøjer, arbejdsgange og rapporteringsformater
  • Analyse på HR-data, fx sygefravær, medarbejderomsætning mv.
  • Ad-hoc analyse opgaver
Om dig

Vi ser gerne, at du er hurtig til at sætte dig ind i en række komplekse problemstillinger, er god til at samarbejde ligesom du er en god formidler både skriftligt og mundtligt. Dette med henblik på at sikre en faglig stærk understøttelse af Regnskabsstyrelsens chefer.

Desuden forventer vi, at:

  • du har et højt fagligt niveau
  • du er god til at opbygge relationer, samarbejde og kommunikere med medarbejdere på forskellige niveauer, da Forsvaret/Forsvarsministeriets Regnskabsstyrelse er en stor organisation
  • du motiveres af at skabe resultater og formår at strukturere din hverdag
Vi forventer, at du har en akademisk uddannelsesbaggrund for eksempel cand.merc., cand.scient.pol. eller lignende. Du må gerne være nyuddannet, men du kan også komme fra en stilling, hvor du har erfaring fra lignende funktioner, enten fra Forsvaret eller fra en anden offentlig virksomhed eller fra revisionsbranchen.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Hjørring.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fungerende stabschef Jesper Jungclaus på telefon 7281 0721 eller på mail: frs-chforv@mil.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Rasmus Kunzendorf på telefon 2926 3785 eller på mail pkom-rku@mil.dk.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 30. oktober 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt løbende. Stillingen er til besættelse hurtigst muligt.

Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Forsvarsministeriets Regnskabsstyrelse

Forsvarsministeriets Regnskabsstyrelse holder til i Hjørring og har ca. 250 medarbejdere med en bred civil baggrund. Vi sørger for regnskaber, betalinger, lønadministration og bogføring for hele ministeriets koncern. Samtidig hjælper vi vores kunder – de andre styrelser og myndigheder – med at styrke deres kontrolmiljø og sikre en solid økonomistyring. Vi arbejder også på at gøre processerne smartere med videndeling og automatisering, og vi lægger stor vægt på samarbejde og faglig kvalitet.

title: Quality Inspector III
description:
By living according to a common set of values, we create a culture that unifies, embraces the uniqueness we all bring to the company, and positions Integer for long-term success.

At Integer, our values are embedded in everything we do.

Customer

We focus on our customers’ success

Innovation

We create better solutions

Collaboration

We create success together

Inclusion

We always interact with others respectfully

Candor

We are open and honest with one another

Integrity

We do the right things and do things right




Who we are:

Integer is a global organization providing innovative, high-quality technologies and manufacturing to Medical Device OEM’s to enhance the lives of patients worldwide and high-end niche batteries for specialized applications in the energy, military, and environmental markets. We are guided by our six Values, including focus on Customers, Innovation, Collaboration, Inclusion, Candor, and Integrity. Working at Integer means you are part of a team passionately pursuing excellence in all that we do and always reaching for the next great achievement.

What you will do in this role:

The primary purpose of this advanced position is to support and perform the inspection and testing process of materials and products from material input to final assembly of the assigned work area, adhering to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Quality System guidelines. Carries out responsibilities with little to no supervision. Demonstrates leadership abilities in the absence of the Manager/Supervisor or Team Leader.

Ensure or Establish Controls for Products and Processes

  • Performs visual, dimensional and/or functional inspections for each raw material, in-process assembly, or finished product in accordance with authorized specification and applicable quality standards. Identify and segregate non-conforming materials and initiate the NCR process.
  • Utilizes measurement tools/equipment and hand gages to measure physical dimensions and other attributes (e.g. pin gage, caliper, optical comparator, SmartScope, pull tester, etc.). Ensures current calibration.
  • Compiles or completes quality records, reports, and/or documentation for product, material and equipment inspection ensuring GDP (Good Documentation Practices) are applied.
  • Recommends appropriate gages and other equipment for the measurement of products or parts
  • Understands and adheres to sampling plans.
  • Provides support in material transactions in Oracle.
  • Participates in the first article inspection processes.
  • Supports process audits and provides give feedback to manufacturing regarding Quality findings.
  • Participates in problem solving and provides input for process/product evaluations for continuous improvement. Provides support during the investigations and helps implement corrective actions.
  • Generate trends of non-conforming material (NCR) and assist Quality with NCR metrics analysis.
  • Manages and programs automatic CMM or Seebrez inspection equipment (if applicable).
  • Monitors Dock to Stock programs (if applicable).
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Grow on the job and help others succeed

  • Expands skill base through on-the-job training, cross training, and classroom instruction.
  • Trains personnel in proper inspection techniques, systems, equipment, and processes.
  • Provides support/guidance, data, and analysis to other departments.

Ensure Alignment on the Corporate Strategic Initiatives

  • Continually seeks to drive improvements in product and process quality and identifies and escalates quality non-conformances to assist in achieving company quality objectives and key business metrics
  • Adheres to Integer Core Beliefs, Safety and Quality requirements and applicable regulations described in the quality management system (QMS).
  • You embed Quality within your daily work life – “I own Quality.” You are a standard bearer for Quality in everything we do at Integer, by assuring adherence to our Quality Management System (QMS), facilitating and/or contributing to corrective and preventive actions, and contributing to the successful attainment of our quality KPI’s and journey to 5 Sigma.

How you will be measured:

  • Live the Integer Values through leading by example.
  • Assist the site in achieving its annual goals for safety, quality, delivery, cost, and inventory.
  • Achieve all Goals and Objectives assigned

What sets you apart:

  • Minimum Education (preferred):
    • High school graduate or equivalent may be required. Associate's degree or experience in inspection preferred.

  • Minimum Experience (preferred):
    • 4 years of work experience as a Quality Inspector or 5 years of related inspection experience in the manufacturing industry may be required. Some associate’s degrees may substitute for years of experience.

· Specialized Knowledge:

o Understanding of GD&T.

o Understanding of the ISO9001/ISO13485 quality standards preferred

o Product knowledge helpful

o IPC certification may be required

· Special Skills:

o Strong computer operation skills (Microsoft Office, Oracle Quality modules)

o Strong ability to read and interpret sampling and inspection plans and engineering drawings

  • Experience with the use of measurement tools/equipment and hand gages to measure physical dimensions and other attributes (e.g. pin gage, caliper, optical comparator, SmartScope, pull tester, etc.).

o Demonstrated experience measuring physical dimensions on parts

o Demonstrated organizational and communication skills.

o Detail oriented and organized

  • Strong and applied knowledge of tolerances
  • Strong general mathematics skills




Salary Range: $54,450 to $79,860




Our total rewards program is designed to attract, retain, and motivate associates to contribute to Integer’s success. Our compensation program includes base wages, a cash-based incentive program supporting our pay-for-performance philosophy, overtime pay, shift differentials, and call-in pay, when applicable. We provide a comprehensive benefits package with immediate eligibility including medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and adoption benefits. Parental leave is available after one year. Optional employee-paid programs include supplemental life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity and accident insurance. Employees are immediately eligible to participate in the 401(k) plan with company matching contributions. We provide 80 hours (10 days) of company designated holidays per year plus an annual allotment of paid time off.

title: Ariba Catalog Enablement Specialist
location: Building No: 12C, Floor 9,10,11, Building No: 12B -Stilt floor, Raheja Mindspace, Cyberabad, Madhapur, Hyderabad - 500081, Telangana, India
description:
About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About this role / Job Summary

The Ariba Catalog Enablement Specialist / Lead will enable, maintain, test, adopt, and govern supplier catalogs within SAP Ariba. The role will manage supplier catalog onboarding, PunchOut and CIF / hosted catalog implementation, catalog configuration and troubleshooting, UAT and go-live readiness, catalog adoption reporting, and stakeholder coordination with Procurement Operations, Supplier Management, Category Managers, AMS, Digital, IT, and suppliers.

Key Responsibilities

Supplier Catalog Enablement

• Support supplier onboarding and enablement into the SAP Ariba catalog environment, including supplier Ariba Network relationship setup and registration coordination.

• Manage catalog implementation projects across categories and regions for PunchOut and CIF / hosted catalogs.

• Coordinate with suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master-data teams to resolve missing information and enable go-live readiness.

• Maintain implementation trackers, action logs, risks, dependencies, and escalation visibility.

Catalog Configuration, Administration & Issue Resolution

• Manage incoming supplier catalogs, catalog subscriptions, catalog content updates, approver assignment checks, and catalog administration activities.

• Investigate catalog data issues, connectivity defects, price/content mismatches, transaction failures, and catalog escalations.

• Coordinate corrective actions with suppliers, AMS, master data, Ariba support, and internal business owners.

• Document standard operating procedures, configuration decisions, and lessons learned for repeatable catalog enablement.

Testing, Deployment & Go-Live Support

• Define and execute catalog test scenarios, UAT plans, transaction validation, supplier connectivity checks, and go-live readiness validation.

• Coordinate test profiles, buyer / requester validation, issue tracking, defect closure, and deployment support.

• Support hypercare during launch and ensure operational handover to support teams after stabilization.

• Ensure catalog changes align with procurement channels, preferred supplier strategy, and business controls.

Catalog Adoption, Reporting & Governance

• Drive catalog utilization, preferred supplier adoption, and spend reallocation toward approved catalog suppliers.

• Track and report catalog adoption KPIs, productivity metrics, supplier performance, catalog utilization, and spend analytics.

• Support contract expiration tracking, supplier contract alignment, and coordination with category managers.

• Create user training materials, quick reference guides, supplier communications, and adoption campaigns.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, IT, or related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.

  • 4+ years of experience in procurement operations, SAP Ariba catalog enablement, supplier enablement, P2P, eProcurement, or catalog administration.

  • Practical understanding of SAP Ariba catalog processes, PunchOut, CIF / hosted catalogs, supplier onboarding, UAT, and catalog troubleshooting.

  • Experience coordinating suppliers, category managers, procurement operations, AMS, IT, and master-data stakeholders.

  • Strong Excel / reporting, issue-resolution, stakeholder management, documentation, and project-tracking skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a global procurement CoE or shared-services model supporting multi-region catalog deployment.

  • Knowledge of supplier master data, contract data, Ariba Network, Guided Buying, buying channels, and preferred supplier governance.

  • Exposure to catalog analytics, spend leakage reduction, compliance monitoring, and adoption dashboards.

  • Lean Six Sigma, SAP Ariba certification, project management, or Agile exposure preferred.

  • Ability to translate catalog gaps into process fixes, training interventions, and adoption improvement plans.

Success Measures / KPIs

  • Increased catalog utilization and preferred supplier adoption.

  • On-time catalog implementations with effective testing, go-live readiness, and hypercare completion.

  • Reduced catalog errors, escalations, non-catalog buying, and supplier transaction defects.

  • Improved visibility through adoption reporting, spend analytics, and implementation trackers.

  • Stronger alignment between catalog coverage, supplier strategy, contracts, and procurement channels.

Key Stakeholders

  • Procurement Operations and Global SCM CoE

  • Category Management and Regional Procurement teams

  • Digital / IT / SAP Ariba support teams

  • Supplier Enablement, Master Data, Contracts, and Suppliers

  • Business requesters and approvers across global regions

title: Principal Consultant - Resources (Carbon & Circularity)
description:
Make your mark at BRE!

BRE is a world-leading global organisation for innovation, science and data in the built environment. For over 100 years, we have supported governments, businesses and industry with pioneering research, testing and expertise. We are focused on growth, scale and expanding our global impact with products, services, standards and qualifications that address the challenges of a changing world. Driven by our purpose of helping everyone, in every building, everywhere, we are creating a safer, more sustainable built environment for people and planet.

Your role at BRE

As the technical lead for Carbon & Circularity within the BREEAM Science Team, you'll be responsible for developing and maintaining the methodologies, criteria and guidance that underpin BREEAM's approach to embodied carbon, whole-life carbon and circularity.

Working closely with colleagues across Science, Product and Digital teams, you'll help ensure BREEAM remains scientifically robust, practical to implement and aligned with evolving industry standards and best practice.

This is a varied role that combines technical development, stakeholder engagement, research, industry collaboration and thought leadership. You'll be the go-to expert for complex carbon and circularity topics, while helping shape the future direction of BREEAM's sustainability standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of BREEAM's carbon and circularity methodologies across multiple schemes.

  • Develop and update criteria, benchmarks, guidance and technical content relating to embodied carbon, whole-life carbon and circular economy principles.

  • Act as the technical authority for complex queries from assessors, clients and national scheme operators.

  • Support the implementation of methodology changes within digital platforms and tools.

  • Produce technical guidance, knowledge base content and supporting documentation.

  • Monitor emerging industry trends, legislation, standards and best practice.

  • Lead and contribute to research projects that strengthen the evidence base behind BREEAM methodologies.

  • Represent BREEAM at industry events, working groups and standards forums.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure methodologies remain practical, robust and commercially relevant.

  • Provide technical support, mentoring and quality assurance across the wider team.

What we are looking for

  • Experience working within sustainability, the built environment, engineering, construction, environmental assessment or related consultancy sectors.

  • Strong understanding of embodied carbon, whole-life carbon assessment (WLCA), life cycle assessment (LCA) or circular economy principles.

  • Experience interpreting, applying or developing technical methodologies, standards or guidance.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical information to a range of stakeholders.

  • Experience managing projects, research activities or technical workstreams.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and technical writing skills.

  • Knowledge of sustainability standards and frameworks such as BREEAM, RICS Whole Life Carbon Assessment, ISO standards, UK Net Zero Carbon Buildings Standard or similar.

  • Experience participating in industry working groups, standards development or thought leadership activities.

  • Experience providing technical guidance, quality assurance or mentoring others.

  • Degree (or equivalent experience) in Sustainability, Environmental Science, Engineering, Construction, Architecture or a related discipline.

  • Relevant professional memberships or sustainability-related certifications would be advantageous.

BRE Benefits

At BRE, we offer a competitive salary, reviewed annually, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your financial security, well-being, and career development.

Financial & Security Benefits

  • Pension scheme – 5% employer-matched contribution

  • Life assurance – 4x your basic salary

  • Enhanced maternity package

Health & Wellbeing

  • HealthPartners cashback scheme – Reclaim costs on prescriptions, physiotherapy, dental care, and more

  • Onsite facilities – Restaurant, nursery, and free parking, including at-cost EV charging points

Career Development

  • Learning & development – Free access to BRE Academy and our online learning platform

  • Professional membership reimbursement

For full details on our benefits, visit: BRE Employee Benefits

Work Location Options

Mostly Remote – This role is primarily home-based, with occasional travel to our head office in Watford for planned meetings (2 - 3 times per month).

Our Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process we will be conducting 10-30 minute phone screening calls via an AI recruiter called Ryan with all shortlisted candidates. The information gathered from this screening will be used to help assess your suitability for the position.

Note to Employment Agencies

At BRE, we value the relationships we have built with our preferred recruitment partners. We do not accept unsolicited CVs from employment agencies. Any CVs submitted directly to a BRE employee or hiring manager without a signed BRE Employment Agency Agreement and an active engagement for the specific role will be considered unsolicited. In such cases, no fees will be payable should the candidate be hired through this or any other means.

Equal Opportunities Statement

BRE is an equal opportunities employer. We assess all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the grounds of race, colour, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Gillar du teknik, problemlösning och praktiskt arbete? Vill du vara en del av ett litet team där vi hjälps åt, utvecklas tillsammans och har roligt på jobbet? Då kan du vara vår nästa servicetekniker.

Om ledtec

ledtec grundades 2006, men vår historia började redan 1988 under namnet Safe Traffic, där vi utvecklade egna trafiksystem. Vi var tidiga med övergången från mekaniska skyltar till LED-baserade lösningar och har sedan dess byggt upp en lång och djup erfarenhet inom digitala informationsskyltar.

Idag är ledtec en av Sveriges ledande leverantörer av kundanpassade bildskärmslösningar för både privat och offentlig sektor. Vi levererar allt från mindre informationsskärmar till stora arenaskärmar och vägbaserade LED-displayer. Vi utvecklar även egna systemlösningar och mjukvara.

Nu söker vi en engagerad servicetekniker som vill vara med och driva ledtec framåt.

Om rollen

Hos oss får du ett varierat arbete som kombinerar praktiska uppgifter med teknisk felsökning, support och lagerhantering. Du arbetar både på vår bas i Karlstad och ute hos kunder, självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor.

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat:

  • Installation, montering och driftsättning av LED-skärmar och digitala skärmlösningar.
  • Service, felsökning, reparation och utbyte av komponenter.
  • Konfiguration och felsökning av mjukvara, styrsystem och nätverksanslutningar.
  • Support på distans och på plats, med kontakt med kunder och leverantörernas support.
  • Lagerhantering: ta emot och kontrollera leveranser, hålla ordning på utrustning och reservdelar samt plocka och packa inför uppdrag och leveranser.
  • Förberedelse och kontroll av utrustning, verktyg och reservdelar inför uppdrag.
  • Dokumentation med servicerapporter, bilder och återkoppling efter utfört arbete.

Resor och övernattningar förekommer i samband med uppdrag på annan ort. Arbetet innehåller också tunga lyft, fysiska moment och arbete på hög höjd. Relevant utbildning för arbete på höjd är meriterande, men vi kan ordna den utbildning som behövs.

Vem söker vi?

Du har ett nyfiket teknikintresse och tycker om att förstå hur komponenter och system fungerar tillsammans. Kanske har du en bakgrund inom nätverksteknik, IT eller programmering? Att byta nätdelar, kretskort och andra komponenter är något du känner dig bekväm med. Du kan också ha byggt upp dina kunskaper genom eget intresse och praktisk erfarenhet.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har goda kunskaper inom elektronik och erfarenhet av elektronikreparationer, kanske tillochmed inom LED-teknik? Du är van att felsöka och byta elektroniska komponenter som nätdelar, kretskort och styrkort.
  • Har mycket god dator- och systemvana och lätt för att sätta dig in i nya mjukvaror och externa supportsystem.
  • Tar ansvar, arbetar självständigt och driver dina uppgifter framåt.
  • Felsöker metodiskt och är noggrann med både utförande och dokumentation.
  • Arbetar strukturerat och har ett gott ordningssinne – du håller ordning på material, verktyg och utrustning och bidrar till ett välorganiserat lager.
  • Har ett serviceinriktat bemötande och kommunicerar tydligt med kunder och kollegor.
  • Kan utföra arbetets fysiska moment med rätt hjälpmedel och säkra arbetsmetoder.
  • Har möjlighet att resa och övernatta vid uppdrag på annan ort.
  • Har B-körkort. Ytterligare körkortsbehörigheter är meriterande.

Du följer instruktioner och rutiner, återkopplar när förutsättningarna förändras och ber om hjälp när det behövs. Vi värdesätter din vilja att lära och utvecklas högt.

Så arbetar vi tillsammans

Vi är ett litet team som arbetar nära varandra. Arbetsuppgifterna går ibland in i varandra, och vi hjälps åt där det behövs. Därför lägger vi stor vikt vid samarbetsförmåga, prestigelöshet och en vilja att bidra till hela teamets arbete.

Hos oss ska det vara naturligt att fråga och be om hjälp. Alla kan göra fel – det viktiga är att vara öppen och ärlig, ta ansvar och lära av det som hänt. Vi delar med oss av våra kunskaper och tror att framgång kommer av att hjälpa varandra framåt.

Vi skrattar mycket och vill att det ska vara roligt att gå till jobbet. Hos oss får du möjlighet att lära dig våra produkter och system, bidra med egna idéer och se resultatet av ditt arbete hos kund.

Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna din ansökan redan idag.

Skicka ditt CV och några rader om dig själv, ditt teknikintresse och varför du vill arbeta hos ledtec till kristina@ledtec.se.

Har du frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta Kristina Martis på 0704–921306 eller via e-post kristina@ledtec.se.

Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig!

title: Head of HR søges til Bigadan
description:
Head of HR (HR-chef) søges til Bigadan

Bigadan er bygget af mennesker, der kan deres fag og vil drive den grønne omstilling. Smeden og teknikeren på anlægget, ingeniøren, controlleren og projektlederen på kontoret. I dag er vi ca. 200 kolleger, fordelt på ni biogasanlæg i Danmark, hovedkontoret i Skanderborg, ét kontor i København, et team i Tyskland samt et team i Holland.

Bigadan er en forretning i udvikling. Vi er vokset hurtigt de seneste år, og HR skal vokse med virksomheden. Derfor har vi oprettet en ny stilling som Head of HR, der skal være med til at løfte HR og gøre en forskel på den grønne agenda.

Du får ansvaret for at sætte retning for HR i hele Bigadan. Din første opgave er at skabe et solidt HR-fundament med klare processer og ensartet praksis, der understøtter ledere og medarbejdere.

Herefter følger de mange andre HR-discipliner som uddannelse og samarbejde, og så får du ansvaret for den interne kommunikation. Det kræver erfaring, pondus og en HR-faglighed, der kan skræddersys til en teknisk virksomhed med både produktions- og funktionæransatte.

Du refererer til adm. direktør Henrik Vestergaard Laursen og får et tæt samarbejde med hele ledergruppen og på tværs af virksomheden.

Opgaven:

Skabe fundament. Du skal videreudvikle en professionel grundstruktur, der gør ledelse og HR-beslutninger bedre. Det gælder kontrakter, personalejura, on- og offboarding, ferie/barsel, fleksordninger, arbejdsmiljø, personalepolitikker med mere. Hertil kommer videreudvikling af vores HR-system (HR-ON), der samler data ét sted, og en rekrutteringsproces, der matcher fagligheden i Bigadan.

Uddannelse og udvikling. Vi vil være en virksomhed, hvor alle bliver dygtigere. Det betyder opbygning af et uddannelsesprogram bygget på Bigadans egne erfaringer samt inspiration udefra, og en løbende analyse af, hvor medarbejdere skal styrkes og udvikles.

Organisation. Godt samarbejde, faglig stolthed, købmandskab og ærgerrighed har bragt os hertil. Sammen med ledergruppen skal du videreudvikle organisationen, så vi kan løfte forretningen ind i fremtiden – også når vi bliver mange flere.

Ansvar for intern kommunikation. Vores styrke er, at mange fagligheder arbejder sammen hele vejen fra affaldshåndtering via CO₂- og biogasproduktion til afsætning. Du skal skabe en fast rytme for, hvordan vi deler beslutninger og resultater med alle 200 kolleger, og få flere til at tage ansvar for den gode fortælling.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en stærk HR-faglighed og mindst 5 års erfaring fra en større virksomhed
  • har løftet en HR-funktion før
  • har en uddannelse på mindst bachelorniveau
  • gerne har ledererfaring og kendskab til produktionsvirksomheder

Som person er du selvstændig og har pondus. Du har mod på tage diskussionen i ledergruppen. Samtidig er du empatisk og god til at udvikle og motivere andre.

Om Bigadan

Vi udvikler, bygger, driver og ejer biogasanlæg og arbejder på tværs af hele værdikæden fra sourcing af organiske restprodukter til produktion af energi, biogent CO₂ og biogødning. Vi drifter 10 biogasanlæg samt et antal gastankstationer.

Hver dag omsætter vi husdyrgødning, madaffald og andre organiske restprodukter til produkter med værdi for energi-, landbrugs- og industrisektoren. Det bidrager til forsyningssikkerheden, sikrer bedre udnyttelse af ressourcerne og recirkulerer næringsstoffer tilbage til jorden.

Interesseret?

Ansøgningsfristen er tirsdag den 10. november 2026. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte interim HR-chef Jacob Dietz, der står for rekrutteringen, på jdi@bigadan.dk.

title: Projektledare - Förvaltningssystem
description:
Om oss På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov.

Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad.

Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder.

Arbetsbeskrivning En organisation inom kollektivtrafik och järnvägsfordon söker en huvudprojektledare till ett införandeprojekt av ett nytt fordonsförvaltningssystem. Det nya systemet ska ersätta en befintlig IT-lösning som används för hantering av fordonsdata men som planeras att fasas ut.

Arbetet omfattar fördjupade behovsanalyser, beskrivningar av verksamhetens tillämpning samt framtagande av lösningsförslag. Nästa fas omfattar implementering och tester. Utrullning av systemet till berörda användare planeras att ske under andra och tredje kvartalet 2027.

Användargrupperna omfattar bland annat fordonsägare, fordonsuthyrare, operatörer och underhållsleverantörer.

Projektet består av flera delprojekt och omfattar cirka 20 deltagare. Det finns ett stort antal externa intressenter och samarbetspartner. Projektledningen omfattar även en biträdande projektledare.

Skallkrav

Konsulten ska utförligt beskriva hur respektive krav uppfylls.

1. Erfarenhet av IT-projektledning

  • Minst 8 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av att självständigt leda IT-projekt i en projektledande roll.

  • Erfarenheten ska omfatta övergripande ansvar för projektets genomförande, leveranser, tidplan, ekonomi och resurser.

2. Erfarenhet av implementering av verksamhetssystem

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att som projektledare ha lett minst tre projekt som omfattat implementering av verksamhetssystem.

3. Erfarenhet av större projektorganisationer

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att som projektledare ha lett minst ett projekt med en projektorganisation bestående av minst 10 projektdeltagare.

4. Avslut och överlämning till förvaltning

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda avslut och överlämning av minst ett IT-projekt från projektorganisation till förvaltningsorganisation.

5. Kunskap om järnvägsfordon

  • Grundläggande kunskap om järnvägsfordon och deras tekniska system.

  • Förståelse för fordonsrelaterad drift, underhåll och förvaltning.

  • Kunskapen ska ha förvärvats genom relevant yrkeserfarenhet och/eller utbildning.

6. Intressent- och leverantörssamordning

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda projekt med flera externa intressenter och organisationer, exempelvis kunder, leverantörer, operatörer, tekniska specialister och andra externa samarbetspartner.

Meriterande krav

Konsulten ska utförligt beskriva hur respektive meriterande krav uppfylls.

1. Erfarenhet från järnväg eller tekniskt komplex verksamhet

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av projekt eller verksamhet inom järnväg, järnvägsfordon eller annan jämförbar tekniskt komplex verksamhet med långlivade tillgångar.

  • Erfarenhetens omfattning och relevans för uppdraget kommer att beaktas vid utvärderingen.

2. Erfarenhet av tillgångsförvaltning

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av Asset Management, särskilt förvaltning av tekniska tillgångar med lång livslängd och höga krav på tillgänglighet, underhåll och livscykelhantering.

3. Erfarenhet av fordonsförvaltning

  • Erfarenhet av förvaltning, drift och/eller underhåll av järnvägsfordon.

4. Erfarenhet av tekniska förvaltningssystem

  • Erfarenhet av införande, utveckling och/eller förvaltning av IT-system som stödjer förvaltning, drift och underhåll av järnvägsfordon eller motsvarande tekniska tillgångar.

5. Verksamhetsnära systeminföranden

  • Erfarenhet av systeminföranden där IT-system används av flera organisationer eller verksamhetsfunktioner.

6. Förändringsledning

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av förändringsledning i en ledande roll i minst tre projekt.

Projekten ska ha omfattat införande eller förändring av IT-system som medfört förändrade processer, arbetssätt eller roller för användare och verksamhet.

Startdatum: 2026-11-09

Slutdatum: 2027-12-31

Placering: Stockholm

Omfattning: 100%

Option: 1+1 år

Ansökan När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder.

Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.
