title: AI Product Manager – Commercial & Computer Vision (US remote)
description:
Company Overview

Our client is a VC-backed AI technology company building solutions to transform workflows across the construction industry. Its platform helps construction professionals to improve efficiency and make better use of project data.

About The Role

Our client is looking for an experienced AI Product Manager – Commercial & ConTech to join their growing team. In this role, you will own the product strategy, AI model quality, user experience, and commercial growth of an AI-powered construction product, with a particular focus on mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) workflows.

This is a true build-and-sell PM role. You will work with complex construction plans, specifications, and CAD/BIM drawings to develop AI-powered outputs such as quantity takeoffs, equipment schedules, and clash risks. You will also be the commercial face of the product, running product demos, working with customers on proof-of-value projects, and helping close new business.

What We're Looking For:

  • AI/ML Product Ownership – Strong background shipping products where AI/ML model output forms the primary user experience.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Design – Exceptional intuition for designing review UX for domain experts who need absolute accuracy before trusting automated outputs.
  • Commercial & Revenue Ownership – Hands-on experience carrying revenue accountability, running first-call demos, and closing deals directly.
  • Technical Blueprint / CAD Depth – Comfort reading complex architectural/engineering plans, CAD/BIM drawings, and technical scope specifications.
  • Data-Driven Execution – Default to measuring and shipping, tying every roadmap decision back to model accuracy, time saved, or revenue generated.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the AI product roadmap end-to-end, covering document ingestion (Revit, AutoCAD, PDF plan sets) to structured outputs (quantity takeoffs, scope-gap analysis, RFI drafts).
  • Partner closely with AI/ML engineering on model performance, setting accuracy standards per scope, maintaining labeling feedback loops, and tracking metrics (precision, recall, F1).
  • Own commercial outcomes for the product line, including pipeline generation, proof-of-value engagements, and landing net-new accounts.
  • Define and refine the "trust ladder," establishing what the AI handles autonomously versus what requires human estimator review.
  • Ship next-generation plan viewers, measurement overlays, and system-aware editing tools in collaboration with design and engineering.
  • Run weekly live customer sessions and accuracy reviews with US-based clients and engineering leads to identify product issues, catch edge cases, and improve the product based on customer feedback.

Must-Have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience, ideally including Product Management experience with direct ownership of AI/ML-powered products
  • Proven track record of owning model-quality metrics (precision, recall, F1, human-review rates) alongside standard product metrics.
  • Prior revenue accountability (e.g., founding PM at an early-stage startup, technical PM who closed deals, or a hybrid PM/GTM role).
  • Fluent English communication skills with executive presence to conduct live demos and close sales calls with US-based executives.
  • Indonesia Citizen with availability to overlap 3 to 4 hours daily with San Francisco leadership

If you are a highly motivated and results-driven individual with a passion for AI/ML products and direct commercial impact, we would love to hear from you. Join the team and be a part of the journey to drive success for our clients through innovative AI solutions.

title: Principal Autonomous Navigation Engineer
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We're working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Lead the Next Generation of Deep Space Navigation

Blue Origin's Blue National Security business unit is extending humanity's reach beyond Earth orbit. Blue Ring, our multi-mission space vehicle, is designed to operate across cislunar, heliocentric, and interplanetary regimes — including missions around the Moon and Mars that will serve as critical infrastructure for humanity's expansion into deep space. These missions demand navigation solutions that go far beyond traditional ground-in-the-loop paradigms, operating with increasing autonomy across multiple dynamically complex environments.


This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.


As a Principal Autonomous Navigation Engineer on the Astrodynamics and Trajectory eXecution (ATX) team, you will serve as the technical authority for developing autonomous onboard navigation capabilities that will define future deep space missions. While our vision is fully autonomous deep space navigation, near-term missions will rely on robust ground-based orbit determination. This role also requires subject matter expertise in ground-based statistical orbit determination using radiometric measurements, which you will apply to operational missions while simultaneously leading the development of autonomous navigation systems for the future. You will integrate optical and radiometric techniques into a coherent autonomous navigation architecture spanning ground and spacecraft, driving design from concept through flight and shaping the algorithms, software, and operational processes that define Blue Origin's deep space navigation philosophy.

This is a must-have position for our lunar and Mars mission portfolio. You will set technical direction, mentor a growing team of navigation engineers, and directly enable mission success across Blue Origin's most ambitious deep space programs.

Your Impact:

  • Shape the Autonomous Navigation Architecture: Define the end-to-end architecture for onboard autonomous orbit determination, integrating optical and radiometric measurement sources into a coherent, flight-ready navigation system for cislunar and interplanetary missions.
  • Lead Deep Space Autonomous Navigation Development: Own the development and integration of optical and radiometric measurement processing into onboard algorithms for cislunar and interplanetary missions. Drive the technical roadmap from concept through flight implementation, defining the path toward fully autonomous deep space navigation.
  • Roadmap the Path to Full Autonomy: Define the long-range strategy for onboard navigation capability maturation — particularly for deep space regimes with limited ground contact — and drive its implementation across the Blue Ring fleet.
  • Support Ground Navigation Operations: Contribute to live ground-based orbit determination alongside the ATX team when operational missions require hands-on navigation support.
  • Execute Ground-Based Navigation Processing: Apply your subject matter expertise in statistical orbit determination using radiometric and optical measurements to deliver navigation solutions for early lunar and Mars missions as Blue Origin's autonomous capabilities mature.
  • Collaborate Across Disciplines: Interface with GNC, avionics, flight software, systems engineering, and flight operations teams to ensure onboard navigation algorithms are properly integrated, supported by flight hardware, and validated end-to-end.
  • Mentor and Lead: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to navigation engineers; establish best practices for algorithm development, testing, and verification.
  • Deliver Excellence: Present results and support critical design reviews using Agile development methodologies.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • M.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
  • 10+ years of proven experience in spacecraft navigation, orbit determination, or related astrodynamics disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing orbit determination algorithms.
  • Experience with optical navigation techniques (e.g., camera calibration, optical centroiding, terrain-relative navigation, star-based navigation, landmark tracking).
  • Strong fundamentals in astrodynamics, orbital mechanics, and estimation theory.
  • Applied experience in navigation tools such as Monte, STK/ODTK, FreeFlyer, or GMAT.
  • Experience in at least one of the following: Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Demonstrated ability to define navigation requirements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.
  • Experience with cislunar or interplanetary mission navigation.
  • Experience with radiometric navigation techniques (Doppler, ranging, VLBI, or similar).
  • Experience developing or deploying autonomous/onboard navigation systems in flight.
  • Experience with optical navigation in deep space approach and proximity operations.
  • Experience with GNC algorithm development and flight software integration.
  • Experience with maneuver planning & execution
  • Experience with rendezvous & proximity operations
  • Experience leading a navigation team through design, development, and operational deployment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the mission design lifecycle from conceptualization through operational flight.
  • Experience with DevOps processes including configuration control, continuous integration/deployment, Agile methodologies, and code review.
  • Previous experience with software development tooling such as Jira, git, Jenkins, Docker, and at least one IDE.
  • Willingness or ability to acquire Active Top Secret (TS) / Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) security clearance with Single Scope Background Investigation (SSBI) with polygraph preferred.


Base Pay Range for:

VA applicants is $183,193.00 - $256,469.85
CO applicants is $173,466.00 - $242,851.35

Other site ranges may differ

title: Vi söker kvinnlig assistent till en man i Torslanda
description:
Är du en omtänksam och engagerad person som brinner för att göra skillnad i människors liv? Då har vi det perfekta uppdraget för dig! Vi söker nu vikarie personliga assistenter till en glad kille på 40 år i Göteborg Torslanda.


Som assistent kommer du att stötta och följa med vår kund i vardagen, där du behöver ha barnasinnet kvar och kunna skapa en positiv och stödjande atmosfär. Flytande svenska i tal och skrift är ett krav, och du bör vara flexibel nog att arbeta både vardagar och helger. Erfarenhet av multihandikapp är en stor merit.


Uppdraget innebär att assistera en rullstolsbunden och multihandikappad kille med totalt omvårdnadsbehov. Uppdragsgivaren är en riktig glädjespridare med nära till skratt, och du kommer att få möjligheten att göra en verklig skillnad i hans vardag.


Arbetstiderna är varierande, dagtid, kvällstid och helger, det kan innebära långa pass upp till 13 timmar. Uppdragsgivaren bor tillsammans med sina föräldrar i Göteborg Torslanda. Vi söker en hållbar assistent som kan skapa en trygg och stödjande miljö för vår kund.


Om du vill vara en del av ett meningsfullt och givande arbete och samtidigt utvecklas som person är detta jobbet för dig! Skicka in din ansökan redan idag och bli en viktig del av vårt team som personlig assistent till en fantastisk kille i Göteborg Torslanda.


Som personlig assistent hos SAAND kommer du att få möjlighet att arbeta i en stimulerande och givande arbetsmiljö där ditt arbete verkligen gör skillnad i någons liv. Vi är ett företag som värdesätter våra medarbetare och erbjuder konkurrenskraftig ersättning samt möjligheter till personlig och professionell utveckling.


Om du är den dedikerade och pålitliga kvinnliga assistenten vi söker, ser vi fram emot att ta emot din ansökan. Vi ber dig vänligen skicka in ditt CV samt ett personligt brev där du beskriver din erfarenhet och varför du skulle vara en bra match för denna roll.


Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vårt team och tillsammans göra vardagen lättare och mer meningsfull för vår uppdragsgivare.


Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss på SAAND Assistans är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete inom Sverige. För att kunna jobba som personlig assistent måste du vara minst 18 år.
Utifrån lagstiftning krävs att vi som arbetsgivare begär ett registerutdrag från alla anställda som ska arbeta som personlig assistent åt ett barn under 18 år. För att trygga våra uppdragsgivare på SAAND Assistans inhämtar vi utdrag ifrån belastningsregister på samtliga vi anställer.  Därav behöver du uppvisa ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister inför en eventuell anställning.
 
Vi ser gärna att du ansöker snarast då vi går igenom urvalet löpande och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdagen. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR.

Utdrag ur belastningsregister kommer att frågas vid intervju. Registerutdraget kan du beställa digitalt via denna länk  HVB-hem, e-tjänst | Polismyndigheten

title: Deep Space Ground Navigation Engineer III
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.

Blue Origin's In-Space Systems business unit operates spacecraft across some of the most demanding regimes in spaceflight, from geostationary orbit to cislunar space and interplanetary destinations. Blue Ring, our multi-mission space vehicle, is expanding where we fly and what our navigation systems must do.

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.


You'll join the Astrodynamics and Trajectory Execution (ATX) team, which is responsible for end-to-end trajectory design and ground navigation within In-Space Systems. We are growing ATX to navigate missions to the Moon and Mars using high-thrust and electric propulsion, and to build an operational deep-space navigation capability from the ground up. In this hands-on role, you will independently own significant portions of the navigation process for an entire mission, spanning analysis, software development, and live flight operations, helping shape how our team navigates for years to come.

Your Impact:

  • Own Lifecycle Navigation: Drive navigation through requirements definition, pre-launch orbit determination and covariance analysis, gated reviews, mission rehearsals, and flight operations. Author navigation plans, analysis reports, and operations procedures.
  • Perform Orbit Determination: Define filter strategies, estimated parameters, and tracking data requirements. Process Doppler, range, and Delta-DOR data to generate orbit solutions for cislunar and interplanetary spacecraft, accounting for long light times, solar conjunction, and planetary gravity and atmosphere modeling. Communicate solution quality, uncertainty, and risk to mission leadership.
  • Fly Deep Space Missions: Perform live navigation operations through launch, cruise (including low-thrust phases), trajectory correction maneuvers, planetary approach, and orbit insertion, making solution-acceptance and maneuver-readiness recommendations under real-time constraints. Partner with ATX trajectory designers on maneuver design inputs, delivery accuracy, and maneuver reconstruction and calibration.
  • Develop Operational Navigation Software: Develop and test navigation algorithms and data processing tools in Python, Julia, C++, and Monte. Partner with the flight dynamics software architect to infuse them into ATX's Monte-based flight dynamics system.
  • Build and Validate Models: Define model-fidelity requirements, and develop and validate force models (gravity fields, solar radiation pressure, atmospheric drag, and third-body effects), measurement models, and simulation tools for high-fidelity navigation analysis.
  • Drive Automation: Automate orbit determination, tracking data processing, and navigation product workflows as ATX scales toward fleet-level operations, including through generative AI.
  • Collaborate and Grow the Team: Work with ATX, flight operations, systems engineering, and external tracking-network partners. Represent navigation in reviews, and mentor junior navigators.
  • Deliver with Agile Discipline: Scope, estimate, and plan work in deliverable increments, using tools such as Jira and git.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • M.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a Ph.D. with 3+ years of relevant experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of astrodynamics, orbital mechanics, and statistical orbit determination and estimation theory, including batch least squares, sequential filtering, and covariance analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience performing radiometric orbit determination using Doppler and range measurements, including modeling, reconstructing, and calibrating high-thrust maneuvers.
  • Proficiency in at least one of Python, Julia, or C++, with experience developing and testing analysis or operational software.
  • Applied experience with orbit determination tools such as Monte, STK/ODTK, FreeFlyer, or GMAT.
  • Experience supporting spacecraft mission operations, mission rehearsals, or comparable time-critical operational environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, scope ambiguous technical problems, and deliver results with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including presenting technical results in design reviews and authoring technical documentation.
  • Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience navigating spacecraft in cislunar or interplanetary environments, including interfacing with the Deep Space Network.
  • Experience navigating spacecraft with electric propulsion, including modeling and estimating continuous low-thrust accelerations.
  • Applied orbit determination experience in the Monte toolkit, including infusing algorithms into operational flight dynamics software.
  • Experience processing real flight tracking data, including Doppler, range, or Delta-DOR measurements.
  • Experience developing or validating dynamical and measurement models for high-fidelity orbit determination.
  • End-to-end mission lifecycle experience (SRR, PDR, CDR, ORR, rehearsals), including live navigation operations during mission-critical events, ideally on a deep-space mission.
  • Experience owning a navigation product for a mission phase, such as an orbit determination setup, navigation plan, or operations procedure.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and communicating effectively across a distributed team.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tooling, including configuration control, CI/CD, code review, Jira, git, Docker, Terraform, and Ansible.
  • Experience using generative AI tools to expedite and automate your workflow.
  • Current TS/SCI clearance with polygraph, or willingness to obtain and maintain one. This role is tailored for deep-space navigation primarily supporting civil missions in Mars and cislunar space, but candidates with clearance may have opportunities to contribute across the full range of ATX mission work long-term.

CO applicants is $119,814.00 - $167,738.55

Vi är ett konsultbolag i sydöstra Sverige som hjälper industriföretag med höga krav att lyckas med sina projekt. Vi arbetar med projektledning, produktutveckling, produktionsteknik, kvalitet och hållbarhet – alltid med struktur, tempo och ett närvarande ledarskap.

Vi tar ofta helhetsansvar för projekt från planering till överlämning, men går lika gärna in med spetskompetens inom kvalitet, hållbarhet eller ingenjörsstöd. Oavsett uppdrag jobbar vi nära kunden och skapar lösningar som fungerar i vardagen och blir hållbara över tid.

Inspirera och engagera teamet så att alla drar åt samma håll

Vara en trygg och tydlig kontaktpunkt för kunder och intressenter

Har erfarenhet av projektledning inom tekniska och industrinära projekt

Är strukturerad, kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad

Är en god ledare som får med sig teamet och skapar arbetsglädje

Trivs med att arbeta internationellt och bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer

Minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet

title: Team Lead - Midnight Shift
description:
Job Summary

Are you ready for your next step in your career?

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products. You will be having impact in hour TASTE UNIT crafting unique, technology-enabled flavor designs that define the identity of food and beverage brands,
shape trends in flavor building and fuel market success

As a Team Lead for the Midnight Shift you will supervise employees on an assigned shift to ensure the work is completed within established timing, quality, and cost standards. This position is fully onsite located in South Brunswick, NJ - USA.


Where You’ll Make a Difference


Process

  • Supervise and assure the full implementation of the safety and food safety standards within all production units. food safety/general safety scores & near miss program. Identify deficiencies, communicate and execute corrective actions.
  • Manage/oversee production area throughout shift, ensuring shipping team is operating efficiently and effectively.
  • Understand all aspects of the process. Make and fill batches as per specification, 25% of the time.
  • Collaborate with the quality department to monitor the various aspects of manufacturing to ensure final product meets set specification.
  • Ensure that all production documents are maintained, kept according to the retention policy.
  • Lead the investigation for deviations events related to the production and align with the quality team on the proper CAPA
  • Ensure compliance with all internal and external food production regulations and legislation.
  • Supervise and motivate work crew, coordinate and maintain process flow to ensure daily production targets are achieved.
  • Monitor ZPro/ Oflow to confirm all daily orders are completed as per end dates, meeting On-Time-Performance targets.
  • Ensure all tools, equipment and production devices are maintained, calibrated and in the best conditions. Communicate with Maintenance as needed to ensure uptime of production equipment.
  • Communication with WH personnel to request / satisfy any enquiry related to the production department.
  • Communicate & coordinate with office staff accordingly. Provide rapid responses and solutions to escalated issues and urgent customer demands.
  • Identify and supervise the implementation of continuous improvement (6S) projects.
  • Present daily shift report for production manager addressing all aspects of volume, safety, and quality details.
  • Communicate and execute through IFF Operating System. Lead shop floor tier meetings.

People

title: Smed til konstruktion og montage i Vejle
description:
Er du smed og vil du have firmabil, bonusordning og godt sammenhold?

Vi mangler en smed til konstruktion og montage i Vejle.

Du lander i et større smedehold, hvor konstruktion, samling og montage er kernen i hverdagen. Opgaverne ligger i erhverv, og noget af arbejdet foregår ude i felten, når emnerne skal monteres på pladsen. Du skifter mellem at løse opgaver selv og arbejde tæt med en makker, alt efter hvad opgaven kræver.

Det gode ved rollen er kombinationen af fast arbejde, firmabil og opgaver hvor du kan tage ansvar. Bonusordningen gør indsatsen mærkbar, og der er lagt vægt på godt socialt sammenhold. Du får en hverdag, hvor du både skal kunne tænke selv og være en ordentlig kollega, når opgaven kræver flere hænder.

Det får du

Løn: 190-215 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Vejle og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Konstruktion, montage og feltarbejde

Din hverdag

Dagen starter med den konkrete opgave foran dig: hvad skal fremstilles, samles eller monteres, og hvad skal være klar før næste trin. Du holder styr på rækkefølgen, får detaljerne på plads og siger til, hvis noget ændrer sig undervejs.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Fremstiller og samler konstruktioner
  • Løser montageopgaver ude på pladsen
  • Tager feltarbejde, hvor opgaven kræver det
  • Skærer, borer og tilpasser emner

Når montageopgaven flytter ud på pladsen, handler det om at få tingene til at passe første gang. Det passer godt til dig, der tager ansvar uden at gøre det tungere end nødvendigt.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Vi forventer ikke at du har lavet det hele før. Men du skal kunne se en opgave og tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som smed, gerne omkring 2 år eller mere
  • Har erfaring med konstruktion, samling eller montage
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og sammen med en makker
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet feltarbejde før. Men det vigtigste er, at du arbejder ordentligt og kan holde hovedet koldt, når noget skal passe på pladsen.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en smed mere i Vejle, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

title: Lead Data Science Manager (Commercial AI Strategy) - J13272
description:

About the Client: We are partnering with a massive, highly stable enterprise operating a dedicated AI Lab. title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
description:
Job Posting End Date

10-26-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) Analyst to identify, analyze, and communicate cyber threats that may impact the organization. This role is responsible for collecting and assessing intelligence from internal and external sources, tracking threat actors and campaigns, developing actionable intelligence products, and supporting cybersecurity operations through proactive threat identification and risk analysis.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with a deep understanding of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), cyber threat intelligence frameworks, and security operations. This individual will work closely with Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, and business stakeholders to improve the organization's ability to anticipate, detect, and respond to emerging threats.

Job Description

What you’ll do:

Essential Job Functions & Tasks



Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, analyze, and disseminate strategic, operational, and tactical cyber threat intelligence.
  • Monitor global cyber threat activity, threat actor developments, malware campaigns, vulnerabilities, and emerging attack trends.
  • Research and analyze adversary TTPs using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Produce intelligence reports, threat assessments, executive summaries, and briefing materials for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Develop and maintain intelligence requirements aligned to organizational risk and business priorities.
  • Perform analysis of security logs, network traffic, and threat intelligence sources to identify threats targeting enterprise and operational technology environments, validating IOCs and providing actionable intelligence to support detection, hunting, and incident response activities.
  • Support threat hunting, incident response, detection engineering, and vulnerability management activities through intelligence-driven analysis.
  • Investigate potential threats affecting enterprise, cloud, identity, third-party, and operational technology environments.
  • Collaborate with government agencies, industry partners, information-sharing organizations, and cybersecurity communities.
  • Maintain awareness of geopolitical events and assess their potential impact on cyber risk.
  • Track intelligence metrics and measure the effectiveness of intelligence products and recommendations.
  • Support executive decision-making through timely and actionable threat reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Intelligence Studies, Criminal Justice, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, vulnerability management, or cyber defense.
  • Experience analyzing threat actor behavior, malware activity, intrusion campaigns, and emerging cyber threats.
  • Understanding of intelligence analysis methodologies and cyber threat intelligence lifecycle processes.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and related industry frameworks.
  • Experience working with threat intelligence platforms, SIEM solutions, EDR tools, security monitoring platforms, and open-source intelligence sources.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present findings to technical and executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to assess incomplete or conflicting information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting critical infrastructure, energy, utility, industrial control system (ICS), or operational technology (OT) environments.
  • Experience integrating threat intelligence into threat hunting, incident response, or detection programs.
  • Knowledge of nation-state threats, ransomware groups, cybercriminal ecosystems, and emerging adversary trends.
  • Experience developing intelligence requirements, collection plans, and analytic products.
  • Familiarity with scripting or automation using Python, PowerShell, or similar languages.
  • Experience briefing senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Active security clearance or eligibility to obtain one is a plus.

Preferred Certifications

  • GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI)
  • Certified Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst (CCTIA)
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH)
  • GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA)
  • CompTIA Security+
  • CISSP
  • Certified Threat Intelligence Analyst (CTIA)
  • SANS FOR578 or SEC487 related coursework

Success in This Role

Successful candidates will demonstrate the ability to transform raw data into actionable intelligence, communicate cyber risk effectively, and enable proactive defense against evolving threats. They will serve as a trusted intelligence partner to security operations, threat hunting, incident response, and executive leadership teams.



What We're Looking For:

Education requirements are listed below:

  • Bachelor's degree or associate degree with 2 years relevant experience in system administration/help desk/security (cyber or physical) OR High School Diploma/GED with 4 years relevant experience in IT system administration/help desk/security (cyber or physical).

Work Experience requirement listed below:

  • 7 or more years of Information Technology related experience; OR 5 or more years of security related experience, which may include military/government work experience in addition to any experience identified above.


What You'll Get:

  • Base salary
  • Annual bonus
  • Long-term incentive
  • 401(k) match
  • AEP Pension
  • Comprehensive benefits package designed to support and enhance the overall well-being of employees.

title: Senior Product Manager B2B / Product Consultant
description:
Salary: Rp 15.000.000 – Rp 20.000.000 per month

About the role

You own the product view across every module in an engagement. You frame what the product must do and why, you approve the specification that satisfies that intent, and you make the trade-off calls inside a locked scope when something has to give. You run the weekly client cadence, and every report you send proposes the next move. You lead the demo, the training strategy, and the change-management story that gets the client's people to actually adopt what we built. You carry a maximum of two engagements at a time.

Key responsibilities

  • Lock scope against a working prototype the client has tapped through and approved as the contract, with an explicit out-of-scope list

  • Frame the product intent every specification must satisfy, and approve the specification at the buildability gate alongside the Project Leader and the Technical Lead

  • Run the weekly client cadence: reporting that proposes the next move and that the client acts on

  • Lead demos, training strategy, and change-management communication so the deliverable earns adoption

  • Orchestrate the squad day to day inside the agreed plan: assign modules to Product Consultants with the product intent attached, and keep design, build, and client reality moving together

  • Decide the medium-tier change requests with an impact assessment, and give the Project Leader early warning the moment scope and reality start to diverge

  • Get a feasibility verdict from the Technical Lead before you promise anything to a client

  • Grow a Product Consultant toward this seat on your engagement

  • Own the product deliverable of your engagements, end to end, against a named client business metric with an agreed baseline

  • Own adoption and expansion: measured adoption, a phase-2 framing, or an upsell that comes out of work you led

About you

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, product consulting, or management consulting with a product deliverable, including engagements you led in front of client directors

  • Can reframe a vague executive mandate into the actual problem, choose one focus area over the alternatives, and defend that choice with numbers to a room that thinks in budgets

  • Has locked scope against something the client could click, and has held that line through the change requests that followed

  • Directs designers and engineers well: enough technical fluency to discuss trade-offs without oversimplifying the build, enough design taste to tell excellent work from merely acceptable work and say why

  • A portfolio of application UI/UX work you can share, with at least one case study that shows the users you designed for, the mental models and pain points you worked from, and the craft decisions you made

  • Reads a messy enterprise data reality and pulls a defensible insight out of it

  • Leads change: adoption, resistance, and the politics of a large organization moving to a new way of working

  • Writes and presents at board level in Bahasa Indonesia and English

  • Uses AI as leverage across the whole job, from analysis to prototyping, and exercises judgment about where it should decide and where a person must

  • A shipped B2B product you can walk us through and defend, from the first client conversation to adoption

title: SERWIZ søger administrativ HR-Consultant
description:
Hos SERWIZ leder vi efter en ny kollega til vores HR-team, som kan supplere vores HR Support med administrative kompetencer, detaljefokus og en eksekverende tilgang til dit arbejde. Du vil i stillingen som HR-Consultant blive en del af en hverdag, hvor du på daglig basis arbejder med bl.a. følgende HR-administrative opgaver:

  • Håndtere jobannoncer
  • Kvalitetstjekke datainput fra vores ledere
  • Sikre at krav og regler for ansættelse overholdes
  • Oprettelse af medarbejdere i løn- og tidsregistreringssystem
  • Udarbejde ansættelseskontrakter
  • Opdatere ændringer i kontrakter og systemer
  • Håndtere andre ansættelsesretslige tillæg
  • Udarbejde og bekræfte opsigelser
  • Afslutte medarbejdere i løn- og tidsregistreringssystem.

Herudover vil du i løbet af din arbejdsdag også vejlede ledere i tolkning af regler, overenskomster og interne processer.

Stillingen er for dig, som ønsker at være en del af vores HR-team på 10 dedikerede medarbejdere, som arbejder med alt fra løn, administrativ support, rådgivning af ledere, rekruttering af nye WIZards og udvikling af medarbejdere og organisationen. HR- teamet rummer mange forskellige personligheder, men fælles for alle er, at vi arbejder ud fra vores People Promise ”We take care of people, who take care of business” samt den fælles ambition om at sikre ordentlige arbejdsforhold og rigtig løn til tiden for vores ca. 3.000 medarbejdere.

**Din profil

**Vi ser gerne, at du har en administrativ baggrund og erfaring fra f.eks. lignende HR-stillinger. Fagligt skal du finde glæde ved at arbejde detaljeorienteret og struktureret, og du skal følge opgaver helt til dørs. Du skal kunne arbejde efter fastlagte deadlines og ikke lade dig stresse af disse. Du er en stærk opgaveknuser, har gode kommunikative evner og du trives, når arbejdsopgaverne bliver en rutine. Vi foretrækker en ny kollega, som allerede har kendskab til overenskomster, så begreber som fritvalg, tidsregistrering, tillæg og søgne-helligdagsbetaling ikke er fremmede for dig. Du er systemvant og kan lide processer og vejledninger. Du føler dig hjemme i hele Office 365, og har du kendskab til systemerne Intega HR og Quinyx er det et plus.

Personligt skal du besidde et godt humør, være fleksibel, troværdig og bidrage med positiv stemning til teamet. For dig skabes succes kollektivt frem for individuelt.

**Vi tilbyder

**Du bliver en del af en virksomhed som er i vækst, fuld af godt humør og gode kollegaer. Du får gode arbejdsforhold og en ansættelse, hvor der er plads til faglige og personlige udviklingsmuligheder. Din base bliver vores kontor i Søborg, tæt på motorvejen. Lønpakke som modsvarer stillingens krav og kompetencer og adgang til markedets bedste kantine – synes vi selv.

**Om SERWIZ

**SERWIZ leverer Soft FM og catering af høj kvalitet med fokus på transparens og bæredygtighed i samarbejdet med kunder. Vi har ca. 3.000 medarbejdere og servicerer både offentlige og private kunder i hele Danmark.

Med et stærkt værdisæt som fundament - ’Being bold, Doing good, Taking care’ – tør SERWIZ udfordre status quo og skubbe til grænserne for, hvordan man i vores branche kan arbejde bæredygtigt, transparent og digitalt. Det er vores mål at skabe ikke bare tilfredse, men glade kunder. Det opnår vi ved at være engagerede og nærværende i udførelsen af vores services og gennem tæt samarbejde med vores kunder, hvor vi taler åbent om udfordringer, muligheder og succeser.

Vi er medlem af Servicebranchens Arbejdsgiverforening via Dansk Industri, og vores medarbejdere har overenskomster og ordnede arbejdsforhold.

**Ansøgning

**Kan du se dig selv i denne stilling? Så søg hurtigst muligt, da vi ikke kan vente med at få os en ny HR kollega med ombord.

title: Digital Platform Engineer
description:
Company description

Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.


Overview

Digital Platform Engineer - Hybrid 1-year Contract

The Digital Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining digital infrastructure to enable machine connectivity, real-time data integration, and visualization within manufacturing environments. The role focuses on establishing reliable data pipelines from shopfloor equipment (e.g., new plating line machines), ensuring seamless integration with SCADA systems, and enabling real-time monitoring and analytics through platforms such as Grafana. This position plays a critical role in building scalable and secure digital foundations to support smart factory initiatives and operational excellence.

Summary

The Digital Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining digital infrastructure to enable machine connectivity, real-time data integration, and visualization within manufacturing environments

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Setup & Configuration

• Design and implement infrastructure required to support machine connectivity and data acquisition (edge devices, gateways, network configurations)

• Configure environments for data ingestion, processing, and visualization (on-prem / cloud / hybrid)

• Ensure system reliability, scalability, and security of all platform components

Machine Connectivity & OT Integration

• Establish connectivity with manufacturing equipment (e.g., plating line machines, sensors, PLCs)

• Integrate machine data using industrial protocols (e.g., OPC-UA, MQTT, Modbus, REST APIs)

• Ensure stable and secure communication between OT and IT environments

• SCADA Integration: Collaborate with automation engineers to interface seamlessly with SCADA systems and PLCs (e.g., Siemens, Rockwell) to extract telemetry and status data.

• Data Pipeline Reliability: Ensure the continuous, low-latency ingestion of high[1]frequency machine data from the shop floor to core databases.

Real-Time Data & Visualization

• Grafana Ecosystem: Own the administration, configuration, and optimization of Grafana for the manufacturing environment. Classification: Pandora Internal

• Dashboard Development: Build, maintain, and standardize real-time dashboards tracking OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), chemical parameters (for the plating line), energy consumption, and machine health.

• Data Storage Management: Manage and optimize Time-Series Databases (e.g., InfluxDB, Prometheus, TimescaleDB) to store and query high-volume machine logs efficiently.

Collaboration & Governance

• Partner with the Manufacturing Automation, Maintenance, and Plating Operations teams to translate production needs into technical requirements.

• Enforce cybersecurity best practices for IT/OT convergence, ensuring shop-floor data pathways are secure.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical/Automation Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in a DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Industrial Automation (OT) role within a manufacturing environment.

Key Skills

Expert-level knowledge of Grafana, MQTT, OPC-UA, time-series databases, Python, Bash, Node-RED, connecting PLCs/SCADA systems

Must have Skills

• Data Visualization & Storage: Expert-level knowledge of Grafana and experience with time-series databases.

• Connectivity Protocols: Strong hands-on experience with MQTT, OPC-UA, and connecting PLCs/SCADA systems.

• Infrastructure & OS: Proficiency in Linux/Windows Server administration, networking concepts (routing, firewalls, VLANs), and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).

• Scripting: Basic programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, Node-RED) for data transformation and glue-code.

Good to Have Skills

  • Strong troubleshooting skills with a knack for diagnosing complex data-flow bottlenecks between physical machines and software layers.
  • Excellent communication skills to act as the "bridge" between traditional IT teams and shop-floor operators.
  • Agile mindset, comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving digital transformation environment.

Others

  • Hybrid Work - 4 days a week, work from the office
  • Office Location - Gemopolis Industrial, Prawet, Bangkok
  • Contract - 1 year
  • Should be fluent in Thai and English
  • Number of Interviews- 2

Additional information

As part of our dedication to an inclusive and diverse workforce, Publicis Sapient is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity without regard for race, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hiring@publicis.sapient.com

title: Logistikkoordinator till Trollhättan
description:
Är du en strukturerad och lösningsorienterad person som trivs i en roll med varierande arbetsuppgifter och många kontaktytor? Vi söker nu en Logistikkoordinator till vår samarbetspartner i Trollhättan. Här får du en central funktion i den dagliga verksamheten där du kombinerar administration, planering och koordinering för att säkerställa att arbetet flyter på effektivt.

Vi söker dig som uppskattar en händelserik arbetsdag, har förmågan att hantera flera uppgifter samtidigt och tycker om att samarbeta med andra för att hitta lösningar.

Om tjänsten

Som Logistikkoordinator ansvarar du för att samordna, administrera och följa upp olika uppdrag. Du arbetar nära såväl kollegor som externa kontakter och har en viktig roll i att säkerställa att rätt information finns tillgänglig och att arbetet genomförs enligt plan.

Du hanterar flera parallella ärenden och behöver kunna växla mellan planerade arbetsuppgifter och situationer som kräver snabba beslut. En stor del av arbetet sker i olika digitala system där du registrerar, kontrollerar och följer upp information.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innefattar:

  • Planera, koordinera och följa upp dagliga aktiviteter och uppdrag.
  • Hantera registrering, dokumentation och administration i verksamhetens system.
  • Ha löpande dialog med kunder, samarbetspartners och interna funktioner.
  • Identifiera och hantera avvikelser samt hitta lösningar när förutsättningarna förändras.
  • Kontrollera och kvalitetssäkra information och ekonomiska underlag.
  • Säkerställa att administrativa processer genomförs korrekt och inom utsatta tidsramar.
  • Medverka till att utveckla och effektivisera befintliga rutiner och arbetssätt.

Du blir en del av en verksamhet där samarbete och god kommunikation är viktiga för att lyckas. Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar samtidigt som du har kollegor omkring dig att samarbeta med.

Vi söker dig som

Vi tror att du har tidigare erfarenhet av en administrativ eller koordinerande roll, gärna inom logistik, transport eller liknande verksamhet. Du är van vid att arbeta strukturerat med flera uppgifter samtidigt och har god förståelse för vikten av korrekta underlag och tydlig kommunikation.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

  • Erfarenhet av administration, koordinering eller logistikrelaterat arbete.
  • God systemvana och förmåga att snabbt lära dig nya digitala verktyg.
  • Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och prioritera mellan olika arbetsuppgifter.
  • Ett noggrant och strukturerat arbetssätt.
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du tidigare arbetat med ekonomisk administration, uppföljning eller förbättring av administrativa processer.

Vem är du?

Vi söker framför allt en person med rätt inställning och ett genuint engagemang för sitt arbete. Du tycker om att ta ansvar, är nyfiken och har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya situationer.

Du har förmågan att behålla lugnet även när tempot är högt och ser möjligheter snarare än hinder när något inte går enligt plan. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och hjälpsam, med en naturlig förmåga att skapa goda relationer med människor omkring dig.

Vi värdesätter också att du är initiativtagande och vågar komma med förslag på hur arbetet kan göras enklare och mer effektivt. För dig är det naturligt att både ta ansvar för dina egna arbetsuppgifter och bidra till teamets gemensamma resultat.

Om uppdraget

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag på 6 månader med start så snart som möjligt. Du blir anställd av OIO och arbetar som konsult hos vår kund i Trollhättan.

  • Omfattning: Heltid 07-16
  • Start: Omgående, enligt överenskommelse
  • Placering: Trollhättan, på plats. Distansarbete ej möjligt.

Om OIO

Vår passion är att hjälpa dig till rätt roll och arbetsplats. Vi är samtidigt medvetna om att du är kräsen och väljer med omsorg inför nästa karriärsteg, det skulle vi också göra. Därför arbetar vi dedikerat i rekryteringsprocessen för att lära känna dig och dina ambitioner. Vi tror nämligen att människor på rätt plats har större chans att nå sin fulla potential. Genom schyssta, okrångliga anställningsvillkor samt ett närvarande ledarskap arbetar vi därefter aktivt med ditt engagemang och din utveckling. På så vis strävar vi efter att bli en självklar karriärpartner för dig. We are as picky as you are.

title: Cost Lead
description:
About Orbia Fluor & Energy Materials:

You are purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you will find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.

MAIN PURPOSE

Orbia is seeking an experienced Cost Engineer to join our Project Controls team supporting large-scale capital projects, including programs executed under the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) guidelines. The ideal candidate brings strong technical expertise in cost control, forecasting, and project execution within highly regulated environments. This role requires a deep understanding of DOE project controls frameworks, capital project delivery processes, and comprehensive reporting requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Cost Management & Forecasting

  • Develop, maintain, and validate project cost baselines in alignment with Capex requirements.

  • Manage commitments, expenditures, accruals, and cash flow for multi-year capital projects.

  • Prepare monthly cost performance reports, variance analysis, and earned value metrics.

  • Track and analyze trends, potential changes, and early warning indicators impacting project budget.

  • Collaborate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to update quantities, labor rates, productivity, escalation, and contingency.

Change Control & Risk Management

  • Administer the change management process: PCRs, Change Orders, and DOE critical guidelines.

  • Evaluate cost impacts for design changes, procurement adjustments, and schedule shifts.

  • Support risk analysis, quantification, and contingency drawdown pathways.

Project Reporting & Governance

  • Develop monthly dashboards, executive summaries, and project cost presentations.

  • Prepare cost summaries and briefing materials for DOE reviews, including:
    Independent Project Reviews and Audits

  • Ensure all reporting aligns with DOE requirements, internal governance, and project control procedures.

Systems & Tools

  • Utilize industry-standard cost systems such as SAP, Oracle, Autodesk or Ecosys.

  • Integrate cost data with scheduling tools (Primavera P6).

  • Maintain data accuracy and auditable traceability across all systems.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LANGUAGE, & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Finance, or related field.

  • 5+ years of cost engineering experience on Major Capital projects ($200M+).

  • DOE project or federal project experience (EVMS & Audit reviews) is required.

Preferred Experience

and much much more!

title: Budbilschaufför sökes i Umeå
description:
BUDBILSCHAUFFÖR UMEÅ (DELTID)

Instabox Umeå behöver förstärka sin arbetsstyrka och söker just nu duktiga budbilschaufför till sin terminal.

OM INSTABOX

Instabox är ett tech/logistik företag som vill förändra branschen för en smartare och fossilfri framtid. Det ska vara okrångligt att handla på nätet och därför erbjuder Instabox ett snabbt och smidigt leveransalternativ, allt för att göra vardagen enklare. Instabox startade i Stockholm 2015 och finns nu runt om i Norden samt Tyskland.

UPPDRAGSBESKRIVNING

Som budbilschaufför arbetar du i Instabox terminal där det inkommer tusentals paket som skall lastas om, sorteras och skickas ut för leverans. Arbetet består av både maskinell och manuell sortering i olika grad och beror på var du arbetar. Häri ligger att säkerställa att verksamheten fortskrider utan hinder genom att noggrant se till så att gods kommer in och ut ur terminalen enligt tidtabell. Arbetet passar dig som studerar på minst 50%, alternativt har ett annat jobb på minst 50%.

ARBETSUPPGIFTER

Sortering - Plockning - Packning - Budbilskörning

OBS! Notera att du i denna tjänst kommer att behöva hantera även lådor med alkohol.

VAD FÖRVÄNTAS AV DIG

Som budbilschaufför trivs du med ett tempofyllt, ansvarsfullt och utmanande arbete. Arbetet innehåller en hel del tunga moment och sker i ett högt tempo, vilket innebär att god fysik är en förutsättning. Även förmåga att hantera IT-hjälpmedel är bra egenskaper. Att du upplevs som positiv och professionell är viktigt – Instabox förväntar sig god service och hög kvalitet. Som person är du punktlig, noggrann och sprider en positiv stämning omkring dig. Du är en naturlig problemlösare och älskar utmaningar.

ARBETSTID

Du förväntas kunna jobba ca 2-3 dagar/vecka måndag - fredag där arbetstiderna varierar men är oftast mellan 15:30-22:30. Helgarbete kan förekomma.

KRAV

  • Du måste ha fyllt 18 år
  • B-körkort
  • God förståelse för Microsoft Office
  • Goda datorkunskaper
  • Stark lagspelare
  • God fysik
  • Goda språkkunskaper i svenska eller engelska (skriftligt och verbalt)
  • Du är studerande eller har annan sysselsättning (annat jobb) på minst 50%
  • Bakgrundskontroll – Nolltolerans mot förekommande i brottsregister

MERITERANDE

  • Erfarenhet av liknande arbete

ANSTÄLLNINGSFORM

Tjänsten är en visstidsanställning (deltid vid behov).

title: Nuclear Medicine Technologist – Elmira, NY | $82,000–$105,000 + $15,000 Sign-on
description:
Type: Full-Time, Direct Hire

The Opportunity

This Nuclear Medicine Technologist role pays $82,000 to $105,000 a year with a $15,000 sign-on bonus, and relocation assistance is available. The work goes beyond a single department: you'll perform diagnostic and therapeutic nuclear medicine procedures in both hospital and physician office settings, including mobile nuclear cardiology with a gamma camera that travels to physician offices across New York and Pennsylvania.

You'll report to the Supervisor of Nuclear Medicine and work with advanced imaging technology, from gamma cameras to PACS. Recruiting nationwide, with relocation paid.

Why This Opportunity Is Worth a Look

  • $15,000 sign-on bonus on top of a salary range of $82,000-$105,000
  • Paid relocation, with candidates considered from across the country
  • Variety of work: diagnostics, nuclear cardiology, radiopharmaceutical preparation, and therapeutic procedures
  • Mobile nuclear cardiology that takes you into physician offices rather than keeping you in one room all day
  • Patients from neonates through geriatrics
  • New graduates considered. One year of experience is preferred, not required
  • Tuition assistance and continuing education support
  • Opportunities for advancement and cross-training

Your Day-to-Day

  • Perform diagnostic nuclear medicine and nuclear cardiology procedures, including patient preparation, radiopharmaceutical administration, and IV catheter insertion as required
  • Acquire and process images using gamma cameras, PACS, and nuclear medicine management systems
  • Run quality control testing on imaging equipment and review physician orders for appropriateness
  • Order, prepare, and calculate doses of radiopharmaceuticals, including managing Tc99m kits and bulk supplies
  • Administer therapeutic doses, coordinating with referring offices and radiologists on planning and pre-testing documentation
  • Manage ordering, receiving, storage, and distribution of radioactive materials and waste in line with hospital and New York State requirements
  • Travel to physician offices across NY and PA to transport, set up, and operate a mobile gamma camera, working independently alongside physicians, nurses, and patients
  • Take part in accreditation activities and keep up continuing education

What We're Looking For

  • Current certification or eligibility for certification in Nuclear Medicine through NMTCB or ARRT
  • Eligibility for New York State Nuclear Medicine Technologist licensure
  • Valid driver's license and insurability
  • BLS certification, required within 90 days of hire
  • Preferred: formal 2- or 4-year degree in Nuclear Medicine Technology
  • Preferred: one year of experience, though motivated new graduates will be considered

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Retirement plan with employer contribution
  • Tuition assistance and continuing education support
  • Employee wellness and assistance programs

Why Candidates Say Yes

Strong pay, a $15,000 sign-on bonus, and paid relocation make the financial case. The mix of hospital-based and mobile work, plus a full range of diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, keeps the job from becoming routine.

Elmira sits in the Finger Lakes region, close to Watkins Glen, Seneca Lake, and the Corning Glass Museum. Rochester and Syracuse are each about two hours away, and the area offers affordable housing and year-round outdoor recreation.

Ready to Explore?

If this sounds like the kind of nuclear medicine role you'd want to hear more about, reach out for a confidential conversation. We're glad to answer questions and share more detail about the position.

Great Bay Staffing represents candidates with complete confidentiality. Your résumé will never be shared with a client without your knowledge and approval.

title: Director of AI Algorithms
description:
Job Responsibilities

Lead innovative LLM-powered applications for social use cases, including AIGC content generation, AI translation, image/video generation, real-time AI beauty enhancement, and AI avatar chat assistants. Deliver at least two production deployments with measurable business impact and user value.

Build high-quality vertical-domain text corpora, perform efficient fine-tuning on foundation models, optimize prompt engineering, and design robust, generalizable prompt templates and dialogue frameworks.

Select and deploy vector databases for LLMs. Own dataset extraction, cleaning and structuring for RAG pipelines, and develop knowledge graphs for GraphRAG, covering construction, updates and inference.

Continuously tune and evaluate generative models across dimensions: accuracy, safety, consistency, latency and cost, with scenario-specific adaptation. Work with RAG/GraphRAG, prompt engineering, SFT, small-model training, model pruning/quantization/distillation and RLHF.

Track global AI research and industry trends to sustain technical leadership in model architecture, engineering and commercialization. Lead the AIGC team to convert advanced AI capabilities into core competitive advantages and revenue for social products.

Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, AI, Machine Learning or related fields. 5+ years of hands-on AI algorithm R&D and engineering experience. Proven 0-to-1 AI delivery in real business settings is preferred.

Have led or deeply contributed to large model training, fine-tuning and large-scale deployment. Practical experience in RAG/GraphRAG, knowledge graphs, prompt engineering and model memory augmentation required. Possess systematic knowledge of LLM fundamentals, training paradigms and technology roadmaps.

Skilled in large-scale data preprocessing, feature engineering and data cleaning. Experience training, deploying and optimizing models on AWS, GCP, Alibaba Cloud or on-prem GPU clusters.

Preferred: 0-to-1 AI product launches serving millions of users, especially for social, content or interactive products. AI+social industry experience is highly preferred.

Deep expertise in NLP and CV core algorithms. Mastery of Transformer architecture and variants; familiar with CNN, GAN and their generative use cases. Understand commercial AI feasibility testing, risk management and compliance boundaries.

Strong technical acumen and strategic thinking, with enthusiasm for AGI. Keep up with cutting-edge papers and open-source projects to explore technical frontiers. Fluent written and reading English, proficient Mandarin; able to collaborate efficiently with cross-functional teams.

title: 1st Line Supporttekniker till Bedege!
description:

Som 1st Line Supporttekniker blir du en viktig del av Bedeges operativa supportorganisation och den första kontakten när något inte fungerar hos deras kunder. Du arbetar med verksamhetskritiska IT-lösningar, framför allt inom retail och stationsdrift, och hjälper kunder med allt från kassasystem och betalterminaler till klienter, nätverk och applikationer.

Rollen handlar om mer än att bara registrera ett ärende och skicka det vidare. Du tar emot problemet, felsöker, löser det du kan och driver ärendet framåt. Du arbetar nära både kollegorna i 1st Line och specialister inom 2nd Line. Supporten är öppen årets alla dagar mellan 06.00–22.00, vilket innebär att du arbetar enligt ett rullande schema med morgon-, kvälls- och helgpass.

Professionals Nord söker för Bedeges räkning en 1st Line supporttekniker. Tjänsten är en direktrekrytering vilket innebär att rekryteringsprocessen sker genom Professionals Nord och att du anställs direkt hos Bendege.

Den här rekryteringsprocessen hanteras av Professionals Nord och Bedege önskemål är att alla frågor kring tjänsten går till filippa.furugren@pn.se

Vi erbjuder

  • En operativ och varierad roll där du får möjlighet att utveckla din tekniska kompetens och successivt ta större ansvar.

  • Möjlighet att bli en del av ett team där man arbetar tillsammans, delar kunskap och hjälper varandra att lösa kundernas problem.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker dig som

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

  • Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift samt god engelska

  • Mycket god datorvana och ett starkt tekniskt intresse

  • Förmåga att dokumentera tydligt och strukturerat

Det är även meriterande om du har erfarenhet av exempelvis Windowsmiljöer, nätverk, fjärrsupport, ärendehanteringssystem, Microsoftmiljöer eller retail-IT.

Som person är du serviceinriktad, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad. Du behöver inte kunna svaret på varje fråga när telefonen ringer, men du ska vara trygg i att ta emot problemet, börja felsöka och ta reda på vad du kan göra för att föra ärendet framåt. Du är handlingskraftig och tar ansvar för dina ärenden från början till slut.

Du är också pedagogisk och tålmodig i ditt bemötande. Kunderna har varierande teknisk kunskap och du behöver därför kunna förklara tekniska problem på ett enkelt och respektfullt sätt. När belastningen ökar kavlar du upp ärmarna och bidrar till att teamet tillsammans löser det som behöver göras.

This role is ideal for individuals with strong analytical skills and a passion for financial markets. Key responsibilities include:

· Conduct thorough financial analysis of publicly traded companies within metals and mining.

· Assist senior analyst in conducting comprehensive industry and company analysis.

· Develop and maintain financial models to forecast company performance.

· Analyze financial statements, market data, and industry trends.

· Prepare detailed research reports, presentations, and investment recommendations.

· Monitor news, earnings releases, and other relevant information for covered companies and industries.

· Attend company earnings calls, conferences, and industry events.

· Develop, work with and maintain large data files of financial and industry data.

· Engage with sales, trading, and investment clients.

· Ensure compliance with all regulatory and firm policies.

Experience/Skills

A combination of exceptional writing skills, technical knowledge and skills in equity research, finance or accounting demonstrated through relevant work and educational experience is required. Candidates must have a clear and proven track record of achievement throughout their education and career. Prior experience in metals and mining is strongly preferred. Other necessary attributes include:

· Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in industry and/or finance.

· Must have experience working in metals and mining.

· Strong analytical and quantitative skills.

· Expert proficiency in Excel, including experience with pivot tables, VBA macros, and handling large legacy files, is required. Knowledge of Python for data wrangling is a plus.

· Proficiency in financial modeling and valuation techniques.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

· Superior work ethic, self-motivated and the ability to work independently.

· Ability to systematically manage a heavy workload and meet stringent deadlines.

· Flexibility to work irregular or extended hours.

· A keen interest in Equity Research and metals and mining.

· Solid technology skills with robust knowledge of Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Bloomberg.

Education

Candidates should have:

· Post-secondary degree in a related field of study, preferably geology or engineering.

· Preference given to candidates with Master’s degrees, CPA/CA and/or CFA charter-holders or those pursuing.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

At Grab Financial Service, we empower the people of Southeast Asia, from consumers and drivers to everyday entrepreneurs, by enabling financial inclusion for the underserved. The team is building innovative solutions by enabling commerce through banking services (invest, savings), payment services (checkout, payments platform, grab pay products, rewards), empowering through Lending(driver & merchants), empowering through agents (Kios) & protecting users through Insurance(scenario insurance). All product managers in Grab Financial Service are regional product managers across Grab's Southeast Asian markets.

Get to Know the Role

You will manage the product strategy, roadmap & execution of agent network & wallet core. You will be reporting to Senior Product Management Leader and based onsite in Grab Jakarta office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Define and own the vision, strategy, goals, and roadmap
  • Dive deep into our data to identify the biggest opportunities to optimize our systems to benefit Users and Grab.
  • Own project delivery, feature development, and experimentation end-to-end, including creating detailed product & business requirements, driving cross-functional execution, sharing insights and learnings across the org, and ensuring stakeholder visibility
  • Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, and data science to define an product strategy, develop and maintain a prioritized product backlog, and execute on delivering great experiences for users. Collaborate with Product Marketing, other Product teams, and regional/country teams on go-to-market strategies and execution.
Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • 8+ years experience in product management at a tech software company, with demonstrable success in formulating product strategy & launching new products/features with clear impact
  • Bachelors in computer science, software engineering, information technology, business, finance, economics, or related fields.
  • Experience working with distributed teams.
  • Empathy for users and a drive to discover and resolve their pain points.
Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.
