title: Familiekonsulent til Ressourcecenteret - vikariat
description:
Ressourcecenteret er en del af Mariagerfjord kommunes tilbud til børn, unge og familier med indsats af såvel forebyggende som omfattende støtte.

Vi søger en FAMILIEKONSULENT på fuld tid til et vikariat fra den 1. december 2026 til den 1. december 2027 til primær beskæftigelse i vores: Døgntilbud i Familie- og Ungehuset - 37 timer ugentligt.

Familie- og Ungehuset er en del af Ressourcecenteret, hvor børn, unge og familier modtager døgnophold med henblik på at udvikle og understøtte i udviklings- og trivselsmæssig henseende.
Vi søger således en kollega, gerne med erfaring i arbejdet med målgruppen unge og familier.

I Familie- og Ungehuset arbejder vi ud fra en fagligt funderet og anerkendende tilgang, hvor relationen er omdrejningspunktet for vores indsats. Vores pædagogiske praksis tager blandt andet afsæt i Low Arousal-tilgangen samt De Neuroaffektive Kompasser. Disse tilgange/metoder understøtter vores arbejde med at skabe trygge, udviklende og forudsigelige rammer for børn, unge og deres familier.
Vi lægger vægt på at møde den enkelte med nysgerrighed, respekt og et ressourcesyn, hvor adfærd forstås i den sammenhæng, den opstår i. Gennem mentalisering, følelsesregulering og en bevidst tilpasning af vores egen tilgang arbejder vi målrettet med at styrke trivsel, udvikling og bæredygtige relationer.

Som kollega vil du indgå i et team af fagligt dygtige og engagerede kollegaer som er tilknyttet Familie- og Ungehuset, desuden vil du være en del af en samlet personalegruppe, som også omfatter familiekonsulenter som primært arbejder i familiernes hjem.
Der arbejdes med støtte og udvikling af den unges/familiens individuelle udfordringer, det er f.eks. selvværd, selvtillid, at få øje på egne ressourcer, samt at håndtere svære situationer. Vi arbejder ligeledes med at anerkende succeser og hjælper den unge/familien til at se, når de udvikler sig

Der lægges vægt på at tilbyde en individuel, dynamisk og helhedsorienteret indsats, som kan bestå af flere sammensatte løsninger:

  • Døgnophold børn/unge

  • Døgnophold familiebehandling

  • Aflastningstilbud

  • Akut indskrivning, herunder afdækning af barnets/den unges og familiens situation.

  • Familiearbejde i hjemmet

  • Støttet og overvåget samvær

  • Efterværn

Vi søger dig, der:

  • er uddannet pædagog eller har anden relevant grunduddannelse, gerne med erfaring fra psykiatri, og/eller relevant efteruddannelse

  • kan rumme børn/unge og familier i vanskeligheder og samarbejde med forældrene om at skabe udvikling og trivsel for deres børn/unge

  • kan arbejde udviklingsstøttende med børn, unge og familier ud fra en relationel, pædagogisk og behandlingsorienteret tilgang

  • selvstændigt kan tilrettelægge, strukturere og udføre arbejde med familierne inden for de mål og rammer som fastsættes af myndighedssagsbehandler.

  • er omstillingsparat og fleksibel med hensyn til omskiftelige arbejdsopgaver og arbejdstider.

  • tager ejerskab og vil bidrage til stadig faglig udvikling af vores tværfaglige samarbejde.

  • er skriftligt velformuleret og kan varetage skriftlig dokumentation i form af statusrapporter, observationsbeskrivelser og vurderinger.

Vi tilbyder:

  • spændende og alsidige arbejdsopgaver

  • dygtige og engagerede kollegaer

  • en arbejdsplads i konstant faglig udvikling

  • et spændende og udfordrende arbejde med stor grad af selvstændighed under ansvar

  • ekstern supervision

Arbejdstiden må forventes tilrettelagt og udført i såvel dagtimer, aftentimer og i weekends.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker på overenskomstmæssige vilkår, hvor lønnen aftales med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.
Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler den 29. oktober 2026

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til afdelingsleder Elin Tollestrup Jensen tlf. 23 35 85 88
Der indhentes straffe- og børneattest, og ansættelsen er betinget af, at disse kan godkendes.

For at være ansat i Mariagerfjord Kommune skal du have MitID.

Kan du se dig selv hos os?
Så send din ansøgning til Mariagerfjord Kommune via vores hjemmeside.
Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. december 2026.
Der er ansøgningsfrist til stillingen den 26. oktober 2026 kl. 12.00

Om Mariagerfjord Kommune
Mariagerfjord Kommune er en af Danmarks smukkeste kommuner med en unik og varieret natur ved skov, strand og fjord. Vi ligger centralt mellem Aalborg og Aarhus og er på den måde et bindeled mellem Nordjylland og resten af landet. Vores mål er klart: Vi vil mere, og der er plads til flere. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe de bedste rammer for vores cirka 42.000 borgere, for vores erhvervsliv og for udviklingen af kommunen.

I Mariagerfjord Kommune ønsker vi, at alle vores 3.400 medarbejdere oplever sig som en vigtig del af fællesskabet. Vi har frihed til at bringe vores kompetencer og ideer i spil, så vi løser kerneopgaven bedst muligt og gør en forskel for vores borgere. Vi har fokus på psykologisk tryghed og viser respekt for hinandens forskelligheder. Alle tager vi et medansvar for fællesskabet og opgaven, og derfor lægger vi også stor vægt på et velfungerende samarbejde i MED-organisationen.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge job hos os, uanset personlig baggrund.

title: Senior Avionics Hardware Engineer – Lunar Permanence
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for the transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

As part of a passionate and accomplished team of experts, you will be a crucial member of the Core Avionics organization within the Lunar Permanence business unit. You will provide technical leadership for the development, delivery, and sustainment of avionics products for Lunar Vehicles, including flight computers, I/O units, embedded controllers, and associated electrical hardware.

This is a hands-on product engineering role with broad technical ownership. You will lead products through the full lifecycle—from concept, product architecture, and requirements development through design, build, integration, verification, qualification, production, and sustainment. You will actively make and influence technical design decisions, work directly with manufacturers and suppliers, and lead bench-level testing, troubleshooting, anomaly resolution, and technical risk reduction.

You will serve as a key technical leader across electrical hardware, mechanical packaging, embedded software, FPGA, controls, systems engineering, manufacturing, test, supply chain, and mission assurance. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration by enabling affordable, safe, and repeatable spaceflight.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end development and technical delivery of complex avionics hardware products, establishing the product architecture, requirements, interfaces, development strategy, verification approach, and path to production.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through design, build, integration, verification, qualification, production, and sustainment; make sound technical tradeoffs balancing performance, reliability, safety, cost, schedule, and manufacturability.
  • Lead hardware test and anomaly-resolution efforts, including bench troubleshooting with electronic test equipment, root-cause analysis, corrective-action development, risk assessment, and verification of implemented solutions.
  • Serve as the primary technical integrator across electrical hardware, mechanical enclosures and packaging, embedded software, FPGA, controls, systems, manufacturing, suppliers, test, and mission assurance organizations.
  • Mentor engineers, lead technical reviews, improve engineering methods and tools, and drive product and process improvements that strengthen quality, development efficiency, and mission success.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or another related technical field.
  • 10+ years of experience in the design, development, build, integration, test, or verification of avionics, electronic hardware, embedded systems, or comparable high-reliability hardware products.
  • Demonstrated experience independently owning complex hardware products through the full development lifecycle, including architecture, requirements, design, integration, verification, qualification, production, and sustaining engineering.
  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more relevant technical areas, such as flight computers, embedded controllers, I/O hardware, analog or mixed-signal electronics, digital electronics, power electronics, FPGA-based systems, electronic packaging, or controls interfaces.
  • Proven ability to lead complex hardware troubleshooting and root-cause investigations, provide technical direction across disciplines, and communicate technical risks, tradeoffs, and decisions to program and leadership stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience developing avionics or other safety-critical, mission-critical, human-rated, or spaceflight hardware products.
  • Experience leading integrated product architecture and requirements development across electrical hardware, mechanical packaging, embedded software, FPGA development, controls engineering, and system interfaces.
  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers through design for manufacturability, PCB assembly, box build, acceptance testing, nonconformance disposition, qualification, and production readiness.
  • Experience with spaceflight hardware environmental qualification and applicable engineering standards, including vibration, shock, thermal-vacuum, EMI/EMC, radiation, reliability, FMECA, MIL-STD, DO-160, ARP4754, DO-254, or equivalent practices.


Base Pay Range for:

WA applicants is $156,802.00 - $219,522.45

Other site ranges may differ


Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Background Check

title: Principal Analog Mixed-Signal IC Design Engineer
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

We are seeking a Principal Analog Mixed-Signal IC Design Engineer with extensive hands-on experience in the design of high-speed data converters in advanced FinFET technology nodes. You will be responsible for leading the development of ADCs and DACs and for delivering state-of-the-art performance circuits while contributing to innovative solutions that drive Blue Origin's mission of enabling millions to live and work in space for the benefit of Earth.


Key Responsibilities:


• Lead the architecture, development and integration of advanced high-speed data converters (ADCs and DACs), as well as other fundamental analog/mixed-signal functions in advanced FinFET CMOS technologies, focusing on performance optimization, power and trade-off analysis.

• Develop high-level behavioral models in MATLAB, Simulink, or SystemVerilog-AMS to validate system performance before circuit implementation.

• Utilize full proficiency in Spectre and AMS flows to develop high-performance mixed-signal circuits and systems.

• Collaborate with system architects to define block-level performance and interface requirements based on system specifications, ensuring seamless integration into RF payloads and terminals.

• Oversee layout, top-level integration, floorplanning, and verification of the overall design for successful tape-out cycle.

• Work closely with validation and product engineers to develop test plans, facilitate bring-up, optimize performance, and ensure reliable & high-yield production cycles.

• Investigate and implement fundamental analog building blocks to enhance overall circuit performance and mentor junior engineers for best design practices in analog domain.


Minimum Qualifications:


• MS in Electrical Engineering with 10+ years of relevant experience.

• Proficiency in the design of high-speed ADCs and/or DACs in FinFET technologies.

• Familiarity with analog-to-digital conversion architectures and techniques such as SAR, pipeline, TDC, delta-sigma, interleaved sampling, RF, and sub-sampling.

• Understanding of digital calibration algorithms for impairments of said architectures and techniques.

• Proficiency in mixed-mode and analog/RF modeling, simulation, and verification methodologies using toolsets such as MATLAB, Spectre, SystemVerilog, and AMS.

• Deep understanding of Electromigration and layout-dependent effects on circuit performance, namely in advanced FinFET technologies.

• Extensive experience in silicon characterization and debugging.

• Strong background in fundamental analog/RF building blocks, including amplifiers, filters, oscillators, reference generation and LDOs.

• Strong communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications:


• Familiarity with RF design concepts and metrics such as noise figure, intercept points, line-up analysis, etc.

• Fundamental understanding of device physics for process selection and performance optimization.

• Familiarity with chip-level ESD protection design and verification.

• Familiarity with digital design, digital verification, and SystemVerilog modeling.


Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Candidates may be subject to verification and BGS screening as per applicable law.

If you're looking for flexible field work with meaningful impact, don't let this opportunity pass you by. Apply today!


Why Investigators Choose Lemieux & Associates

At Lemieux & Associates, we know talented investigators are the foundation of our success. That's why we offer competitive pay of $25-$32 per hour, the flexibility of an on-call, part-time schedule, and the opportunity to work on engaging investigations that put your skills to the test. As a national leader in investigative services, Lemieux & Associates is dedicated to delivering professional SIU/DIU, surveillance, and medical canvassing services clients can rely on. Our employees are our greatest asset, and our company culture revolves around maintaining a communicative, loyal, ethical, passionate, impactful, and benevolent environment. With a leadership team boasting over 25 years of field experience, we are committed to unlocking the potential of our employees and creating a supportive, tight-knit community.

Another day, you'll be meeting with individuals to obtain written or recorded statements that help bring clarity to a claim. Throughout each investigation, you'll gather facts, assess evidence, connect important details, and compile comprehensive reports that provide clients with accurate and reliable information. Your ability to observe, document, and communicate findings will play a vital role in helping uncover the truth behind every case.


Flexible Work That Fits Your Lifestyle

title: Junior Videographer – Social & Digital Content
description:
About WeBuyVintage

WeBuyVintage is one of the UK’s largest buyers of jewellery, antiques and collectibles. We run more roadshows than any other UK company - over 250 valuation events every month - bringing trusted experts face-to-face with customers across the country.

In three years, we’ve grown from a pub-table idea into an eight-figure business, with a headcount thats grown from 30-100 in the last 2 years, we’re on a mission to make WeBuyVintage a brand everyone recognises.

The Role:
As we continue to grow, we’re looking to dramatically increase our volume of content across our social media and digital channels, and we’re looking for an enthusiastic Junior Videographer to helpus capture the people, stories and moments that make WeBuyVintage what it is.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone at the start of their videography career who wants to gain hands-on experience capturing engaging content for a growing UK brand.

You'll spend much of your time out at our roadshows, capturing the atmosphere, our expert buyers, interesting items, valuation interactions, customer testimonials and behind-the-scenes moments that bring our business to life.

Working closely with our Social & Content Lead, you'll be given creative direction and guidance while developing your own filming skills, confidence and creative eye.

The majority of your work will be capturing short-form social content for platforms including Instagram and Facebook, with TikTok and YouTube also forming part of our future plans.


Main Tasks & Responsibilities:

  • Capturing video content at our roadshows each week

  • Filming our buyers and appraisers at work - including valuations, interesting items and their expert knowledge.

  • Capturing the atmosphere and experience of our roadshows, from venue setup and customer arrivals to behind-the-scenes moments.

  • Identifying interesting stories, interactions and moments that could make engaging social media content.

  • Capturing customer testimonials and interviews, obtaining consent and helping people feel comfortable and confident on camera.

  • Capturing content for Instagram, Facebook and other social and digital platforms.

  • Working from shot lists, creative briefs and ideas provided by our Social & Content Lead.

  • Developing your own creative ideas and spotting opportunities to capture content beyond the original brief.

  • Using business-provided equipment, including iPhones / DJIs to capture high-quality footage.

  • Organising and uploading footage so it can be easily accessed and edited by our Social & Content Lead and in-house Editor.

Who We’re Looking For:

You’ll be great in this role if you have

  • Creative - naturally curious and able to spot interesting moments, people and stories.

  • Enthusiastic - genuinely interested in videography, filming and creating social media content.

  • Confident - comfortable approaching people, asking questions and capturing footage in busy environments.

  • Observant - able to recognise the moments that could make engaging content.

  • Organised - able to follow shot lists, manage footage and keep track of what needs capturing.

  • Proactive - happy to take initiative, suggest ideas and look for opportunities to get great footage.

  • Adaptable - comfortable working in different venues and responding to things happening in the moment.

  • Keen to learn - open to feedback and excited to develop your filming skills and creative confidence.

You don't need to have worked in the jewellery or antiques industry, and you don't need years of professional filming experience. What's more important is that you have a good eye for content, enjoy working with people and have a creative mindset with the enthusiasm to get out there, learn and capture great content.

Experience & Portfolio:

We're interested in seeing examples of your creativity and any experience you have capturing videos.

This could include:

  • Short-form social videos you've filmed (Reels, TikToks, Shorts)

  • Personal video projects or content you've created for your own social channels.

  • University, college or other creative projects.

  • Examples of interviews, talking-head videos or people-focused content.

  • Any experience using an iPhone, camera or other filming equipment to capture videos.

A professional portfolio isn't essential, but we'd love to see examples of what you've created.

What You’ll Get:

  • Access to Bright Exchange - enjoy thousands of exclusive employee discounts and perks

  • Employee Assistance Programme - confidential, 24/7 support for you and your immediate family, covering work, personal, and home life matters

  • On-demand professional development - access to BrightHR’s online learning platform to build new skills and support your career progression

  • Competitive pay

  • Be part of a rapidly growing, friendly UK brand

£26,000 - £28,000

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know and we’ll be happy to support you.

title: Principal Security Architect - TeraWave
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

As a Principal Security Architect, you will design, build, and enforce cybersecurity defenses across this end-to-end space system. You will secure onboard computers, firmware, and inter-satellite links on the satellite bus. You will protect the RF and optical transmissions between Earth and orbit from interception and manipulation. And you will establish zero-trust architectures that segment space network links and define rigid trust boundaries so that a breach in one element cannot propagate across the system.

This role is deeply technical and will remain so — you will be hands-on with threat modeling, architecture definition, and security design reviews. At the same time, you will be expected to provide inputs to defining the security staffing needs of the program as it evolves.

This role sits within the Chief Systems Architecture office and works closely with payload, flight software, ground systems, network engineering, and silicon teams.

Responsibilities

- Design and enforce cybersecurity architectures across the full TeraWave system — spacecraft, terminals, ground stations, command-and-control links, and cloud/edge infrastructure
- Secure onboard satellite systems including embedded computers, firmware, inter-satellite links, and other critical bus components
- Protect RF and optical/laser links between Earth and orbit against data manipulation, interception, and denial
- Establish and enforce zero-trust architectures — segment space network links, define trust boundaries, and ensure breach containment across system elements
- Perform threat modeling and risk analysis across all system segments; establish security policies and ensure adherence to regulatory frameworks
- Translate business and compliance requirements into functional security architectures, including network segmentation, firewall DMZs, and identity management schemes
- Balance security controls with operational productivity, cloud migration timelines, and program objectives
- Guide and mentor engineering teams on security practices; review proposed infrastructure and design changes for security implications; oversee incident response
- Collaborate across the company to ensure security goals and requirements are understood and addressed by manufacturing operatoins, flight operations, payload, software, ground, network, and silicon teams
- Assess evolving program security staffing needs — define roles, build the case for resources, and help hire and develop the security team as the constellation scales
- Define security requirements for TeraWaves manufacturing assembly and test processes.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Electrical Engineering, or related field; MS preferred
- 10+ years of experience spanning threat modeling, cryptography, identity management and authentication, network security, and secure software development
- Deep understanding of embedded systems security — firmware, ASICs, FPGAs — alongside modern software engineering practices
- Deep understanding of Linux security features and defense strategies
- Demonstrated ability to frame and close architectural trades — scoping the question, identifying binding constraints, and documenting defensible outcomes
- Strong technical communication skills — able to present security architecture and risk assessments clearly to both domain specialists and program leadership

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with security in export-controlled environments
- Understanding of threat actor tradecraft and state-of-the-art attack techniques
- Experience building or leading a small technical team from inception
- Experience leading threat assessmeents and defining security architectures within manufacturing environments.

title: Administrativ assistent | Lernia | Värnamo
description:
Vi söker dig som trivs med administrativa arbetsuppgifter, gillar att skapa ordning och reda och vill vara med och bidra till att det dagliga arbetet fungerar smidigt. Här får du en varierad roll där du samarbetar med kollegor och externa kontakter, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att utveckla dina kunskaper och växa i din yrkesroll.

I rollen ingår bland annat att hantera beställningar och uppföljning i affärssystemet SAP, samt att sköta utskick och mottagning av paket. Du kommer även att ha kontakt med leverantörer, hjälpa till med praktisk planering och logistik samt koordinera exempelvis luncher och andra arrangemang i samband med möten och event.

Om dig

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen söker vi dig som är strukturerad, noggrann och serviceinriktad. Du tycker om att hjälpa andra, har lätt för att samarbeta och tar gärna initiativ när du ser vad som behöver göras.

Vi tror att du är en flexibel och kommunikativ person som trivs i en varierad administrativ roll. Du arbetar självständigt när det behövs, samtidigt som du uppskattar att vara en del av ett team där man hjälps åt och arbetar mot gemensamma mål.

Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, men vi ser gärna att du har ett intresse för IT och administrativa system samt en vilja att utvecklas och lära dig nya arbetsuppgifter. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och söker dig som bidrar med engagemang, ansvarstagande och en positiv inställning.

Formell kompetens

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Meriterande

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av administrativa arbetsuppgifter.

Som en av oss

Som anställd bemanningskonsult hos oss får du alltid en marknadsmässig lön, semester, pensionsavsättning, försäkringar och anslutning till vårt kollektivavtal. Vi vill att du ska må bra hos oss så självklart erbjuder vi våra konsulter friskvårdsbidrag och företagshälsovård. Under din anställning har du en konsultchef som ansvarar för ditt uppdrag, stöttar och utvecklar dig i din yrkesroll och ser till att du trivs på din arbetsplats.

Om Lernia

Lernia är ett av Sveriges ledande bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och finns över hela landet. Med vårt omfattande nätverk erbjuder vi spännande jobb hos attraktiva arbetsgivare och varumärken som hjälper dig att utveckla din kompetens och karriär, både på lång och kort sikt.

title: Four-year fixed term academic employee position in bioacoustics and signal processing
description:
The Marine Bioacoustics lab at the Section for Zoophysiology at the Department of Biology, Aarhus University, is seeking a skilled and motivated bioacoustician to spearhead the collection and high-end analysis of calibrated acoustic data from monitoring programs, archival tags and animal experiments.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a four-year fixed term position funded by external grants starting 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.



Job description
  • You will be responsible for planning, preparing and executing field work in Denmark and internationally using hydrophone and microphone arrays, DAS, on animal tags and passive acoustic monitoring devices.
  • You will manage and maintain our recording equipment and undertake calibration and development of scientific equipment.
  • You will set up and curate data bases and develop and use software to perform discrete time series analyses of large acoustic and sensor datasets.
  • You will help supporting and training students and post docs in acoustic analyses and contribute to both specific and general courses as a co-teacher.
  • You will take the lead on writing reports to funders and governments and contribute to peer-reviewed papers and grant applications with data, plots, analyses and writing.


Your profile
  • You must have a master degree in bioacoustics, engineering or physics with strong analytical skills in quantitative acoustics and signal processing. A PhD degree and relevant experience within the specified areas will be considered an advantage.
  • You must have documented experience with programming in Matlab or Python or similar programming tools.
  • At sea field experience and boat handling skills are an advantage and so is work experience with data bases and data curation.
  • You must have strong English skills both orally and in writing, and you must thrive in an inclusive multi-cultural and diverse working environment.
  • We strive to be best bioacoustics lab in the world, and we are therefore looking for a profile for this job who shares that ambition with the needed attention and care to get things right on time.


Who we are
The Marine Bioacoustics lab currently consists of 2 senior PI´s, 2 AC-taps, 9 post docs, 6 PhD students and several MSc and Bsc. It is part of the Section for Zoophysiology, Department of Biology, Aarhus University.


What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, acoustic laboratories and access to shared equipment and novel bioacoustic tools.
  • An exciting interdisciplinary environment with many high level national and international collaborators.
  • A research climate encouraging lively, open and critical discussion within and across different fields of research.
  • A work environment with close working relationships, networking and social activities.
  • A workplace characterised by professionalism, equality and a healthy work-life balance.


Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is C.F. Mollers Alle 3, 8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Professor Peter T. Madsen, +45 5177 8771, peter.madsen@bio.au.dk.

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 2 November 2026.

Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Om Aarhus Universitet

Aarhus Universitet er et fagligt bredt og forskningsintensivt universitet med høj kvalitet i uddannelse og forskning, og et stærkt engagement i samfundsudviklingen nationalt og globalt. title: IT Infrastructure Solution Lead
description:
We are looking for an experienced IT Infrastructure Solution Lead to lead the design, implementation, and delivery of IT infrastructure solutions across multiple customer projects. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with team leadership, project coordination, and customer engagement across servers, networking, virtualization, and cloud environments.

The position is responsible for guiding and developing the Solution Engineer team, ensuring technical quality, security compliance, and consistent implementation standards while delivering projects on time and meeting customer expectations.


Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Implementation & Technical Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end implementation of IT infrastructure solutions, including servers, storage, networking, virtualization, and cloud platforms.

  • Validate system designs, deployment plans, and technical architectures to ensure alignment with project requirements.

  • Oversee implementation quality, testing, and handover processes across projects.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues, manage escalations, and conduct root cause analysis.

  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to existing solutions.

2. Team Leadership & Development

  • Supervise and guide Solution Engineers in daily operations and project execution.

  • Assign tasks, manage workloads, and monitor team performance to meet project objectives.

  • Provide technical coaching, mentoring, and skills development for team members.

  • Review technical designs, configurations, and documentation to ensure quality and consistency.

3. Project & Customer Management

  • Plan, coordinate, and track implementation activities to meet project timelines and deliverables.

  • Work closely with Project Managers, Sales teams, customers, vendors, and partners to align requirements and expectations.

  • Manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and proactively identify and mitigate technical and delivery risks.

  • Serve as the primary technical contact during implementation and post-deployment phases.

  • Provide technical consultation and recommendations to customers.

  • Communicate project progress, technical issues, and resolutions to relevant stakeholders.

  • Support pre-sales activities, including solution validation and high-level technical design.

  • Ensure customer satisfaction and a smooth transition to support and operations teams.

4. Infrastructure Security & Standards

  • Ensure implementations comply with IT security policies, industry best practices, and customer requirements.

  • Oversee system patching, hardening, vulnerability remediation, and disaster recovery (DR) setup and testing.

  • Define and maintain technical standards, templates, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and documentation practices.

  • Ensure implementation and handover documents are complete, accurate, and up to date.

  • Maintain a knowledge base and reusable deployment practices to improve delivery efficiency and consistency.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • 5–7 years of experience in IT infrastructure, system implementation, solution design, or related fields.

  • Proven experience as a Technical Lead, Team Lead, or Senior Engineer with project or team leadership responsibilities.

  • Strong technical knowledge of IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, and LAN/WAN networking.

  • Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware, Hyper-V, or Proxmox.

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or other cloud providers.

  • Strong understanding of system architecture, solution design, and system integration.

  • Knowledge of IT security practices, including system hardening, patching, and vulnerability management.

  • Experience with Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity concepts and implementation.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.

  • Good spoken and written English communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, customers, vendors, and partners.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.

  • Willingness to travel and work onsite at customer locations as required.

  • Relevant technical certifications, such as Microsoft, VMware, Cisco, or AWS, are an advantage.


Core Skills

  • Technical Leadership & Team Management: Lead, coach, and develop team capabilities while managing task assignments and workloads.

  • IT Infrastructure & Solution Architecture: Strong understanding of servers, storage, networking, virtualization, cloud, and hybrid environments.

  • Advanced Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues across multiple infrastructure layers.

  • Networking & Virtualization: Knowledge of TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, switching, firewalls, VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox, high availability (HA), and clustering.

  • System Administration: Advanced administration of Windows Server and Linux environments.

  • Cloud & System Integration: Understanding of AWS and/or Azure services and integration across multi-site or hybrid environments.

  • Security & Risk Management: Apply security best practices, vulnerability management, and risk mitigation.

  • Project Planning & Coordination: Manage implementation plans, timelines, priorities, and multiple project deliverables.

  • Customer & Stakeholder Management: Communicate technical concepts clearly and provide effective technical consultation.

  • Documentation & Standardization: Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and consistent implementation standards.

  • Vendor Management & Collaboration: Coordinate effectively with vendors, partners, customers, and internal stakeholders.

  • Adaptability & Continuous Learning: Evaluate emerging technologies and continuously improve technical capabilities.

title: R&D Risk Facilitator/FMEA Expert

title: Svejser til trykbærende udstyr i Middelfart
description:
Vil du have fast arbejde, firmabil og svejsning i industrien?



Vi mangler en svejser i Middelfart til trykbærende udstyr.



Du lander i en produktion, hvor svejsearbejdet handler om udstyr der skal renoveres, bygges op og klargøres til industrien. Det er trykbærende udstyr som flasker, tanke og komponenter, så der er brug for rolige hænder og ordentligt arbejde. Kunderne er industrielle gasaktører, og arbejdet har retning mod både service, montage og renovering. Holdet er større end et klassisk lille værksted, så du får folk omkring dig uden at blive en anonym brik.

Rollen passer til dig, der gerne vil svejse på emner hvor sikkerhed og finish faktisk betyder noget. Du skal kunne skifte mellem forskellige svejsemetoder og sige til, hvis noget ikke stemmer. Firmabilen er med i pakken, og kørekort står som et krav.

Det får du

Løn: 200-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Middelfart og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 55 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: MIG, MAG, MMA og servicesvejsning

Din hverdag

Når en opgave ligger klar, vurderer du svejsemetode, reparation og finish ud fra emnet foran dig. Nogle emner kræver MAG, MIG eller MMA, mens andre kræver TIG eller rørsvejsning. Reparationer og servicearbejde skal afleveres så næste trin kan gå videre uden bøvl.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Svejsning med MAG, MIG og MMA
  • Reparerer og servicesvejser på industrielt udstyr
  • TIG- og rørsvejsning når opgaven kræver det
  • Arbejder med trykbærende udstyr, flasker og tanke
  • Svejsning i sort stål eller rustfrit materiale

Sikkerhed fylder i arbejdet, fordi udstyret skal kunne holde til reel industriel brug. Hvis noget ikke stemmer, skal det siges højt før emnet går videre.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har gerne mindst 2 års erfaring som svejser
  • Kan arbejde med MAG, MIG eller MMA
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med TIG, rørsvejsning eller servicesvejsning. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide en hverdag hvor dit svejsearbejde skal holde.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.



Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, er opstart Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.



Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.



Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: Cultural Preservation Monitor
description:
Position Title: Cultural Preservation Monitor

Department: Cultural Preservation

Reports to: Director of Cultural Preservation and Environmental Protection

Classification: Non-Exempt

Position Status: Regular, Full-Time

POSITION SUMMARY

Provide tribal preservation monitoring and consultation for environmental projects during archaeological investigations and all ground disturbing activities required for projects.

The incumbent is expected to work in accordance with the mission, purpose, and values of the Colusa Indian Community Council.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Record all project activity on daily log which will include detailed information of project site

(photographs, audio recording, GIS mapping etc.) and archaeologist/osteologist information;

  1. Research and develop knowledge of Federal/State Gathering laws specific to surrounding counties;
  2. Work in collaboration with archaeologists and project engineers hired/employed by the

Contractor;

  1. Catalog artifacts recovered from archaeological surveys or excavation work and donated collections;
  2. Develop relationships and be in communication with local land owners and branches of government in the surrounding areas of the Colusa Indian Community Council’s trust land and tribally-owned fee land;
  3. Maintain knowledge of all Federal, State and tribal regulations relevant to historic preservation;
  4. Prepare, file and document clear, concise, and accurate records and reports, correspondence, research and field notes;
  5. Utilize GIS system for reports;
  6. Meet with Tribal Partners to assess needs and attend functions as requested;
  7. Attend regular required Department meetings;
  8. Maintain high confidentiality standards at all times;
  1. May perform other duties commensurate with the functions and level of the position.



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Licensing: Must possess a valid California Driver’s license and be at least 18 years of age



SUPERVISORIAL DUTIES: None



ADDITIONAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, and ABILITIES

  • Strong knowledge of Cachil DeHe Wintun Tribe history, culture, traditions or willingness to learn; Must be able to research the history, culture, traditions, language and other activities of the Cachil DeHe Wintun preservation efforts;
  • Able to learn Historic Preservation laws that affect historical and culturally valuable sites associated with and defined by the National Historic Preservation Act;
  • Familiarity with regulations and standards of various regulatory and credentialing groups relevant to historical preservation and cultural resource management.
  • Must possess excellent written and oral communication skill
  • Excellent PC, MS Office and research skill
  • Must have excellent time management skills and proven ability to be able to work with minimal supervisi
  • Able and willing to travel.



PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is required to:

  • Will be required to stand, stoop, bend, twist, reach and/or kneel;
  • May occasionally lift and/or move up to (25-50) pounds.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

  • May be exposed to various seasonal elements such as rain, wind, cold and heat in excess of 90°
  • The noise level is usually moderate to loud
  • Will require occasional hiking in various terrain and landscapes to accomplish inventories and surveys of Tribal Cultural Properties

title: Data & AI Governance Lead (Ref: AITC-GOV)
location: Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Tsim Mong District
description:
At Sino Group, we bring people together for a better future. We value your uniqueness, commit to your career development and prioritize your wellness. We provide an inclusive and collaborative workplace, all-round training and work-life balance to unleash your full potential and empower you to grow together with the Group, both personally and professionally.

We are looking for talented people to be part of our dynamic team!

Position Overview

The Data & AI Governance Lead will establish and operate the Group's business-led data and AI governance framework and help Business Units use data and artificial intelligence responsibly, consistently and with measurable value. The role will work directly with Business Unit leaders, process owners and data owners to improve data readiness, define accountable use and embed responsible AI practices. The role will work closely with Group IT, Information Security, Enterprise Architecture, Legal, Risk and Internal Audit on technical controls, architecture, data management, privacy, security and assurance. The position sits in the designated non-IT AI function and does not replace the accountability of Business Unit data owners or Group IT technical control owners.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the Group data and AI governance framework, policies, standards and practical guidance.

  • Define governance requirements across the AI lifecycle, from use-case intake to release, monitoring and retirement.

  • Work with Business Units to assign data owners and stewards and clarify data definitions, use, quality and oversight.

  • Assess data readiness for priority AI use cases, including source, ownership, quality, lineage, access, privacy and retention.

  • Facilitate AI risk assessments and track key risks, conditions, exceptions and remediation actions.

  • Set practical responsible AI requirements for transparency, reliability, privacy, security, traceability and human review.

  • Create reusable templates, checklists and evidence requirements for consistent AI governance.

  • Work with Group IT to turn governance requirements into enforceable controls for access, data protection, logging, monitoring and operations.

  • Ensure AI solutions do not use corporate data or enter production without required business and IT approvals.

  • Maintain the AI governance register and report governance maturity, key risks, exceptions and remediation progress.

Requirements

  • Education and Experience:

  • University degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Computer Science or related disciplines.

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years in data governance, information governance, risk, compliance, analytics or enterprise transformation.

  • Proven experience establishing governance practices across multiple business functions and influencing senior stakeholders in a sizeable organisation.

  • Experience in real estate, property management, hospitality, retail or another diversified and multi-site organisation is an advantage.

Technical and Professional Expertise:

  • Strong knowledge of data ownership, stewardship, data quality, metadata, lineage, classification, privacy, retention and records management.

  • Practical understanding of generative AI, machine learning and AI agents, including risks relating to data exposure, inaccurate output, bias, autonomy, human oversight and ongoing monitoring.

  • Experience designing risk-tiering, approval, exception and assurance processes that are rigorous but practical for Business Units.

  • Good understanding of enterprise data platforms, identity and access management, information protection, security monitoring, cloud services and system integration.

  • Familiarity with recognised governance and security principles such as ISO 27001, NIST and established data-management practices.

  • Ability to translate legal, risk and technical requirements into clear business actions and evidence expectations.

  • Experience supporting audits, control reviews or management assurance is highly desirable.

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and the implementation of agentic AI solutions using different AI models and platforms will be an advantage.

  • A good technical background across various AI platforms, models and supporting technologies would be helpful.

Certifications and Skills:

  • Professional certification in data management, privacy, risk, audit, cybersecurity, project management or a related discipline is preferred.

  • Strong business judgement and an enabling governance mindset, with the confidence to challenge constructively and escalate material risks.

  • Excellent analytical, facilitation, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.

  • Independent, structured and detail-minded, with strong ownership and disciplined follow-through.

  • Able to explain complex data, AI and risk matter clearly to senior executives, business users and technical teams.

  • Fluent in English and Chinese with strong written, presentation and interpersonal skills.

We are an equal opportunity employer who offer an inclusive and diverse workplace where people are valued and respected.

Before submitting your application, please read the Personal Data (Privacy) Policy and Personal Information Collection Statement at our Company website. Information provided will be treated in strict confidence and used for recruitment purposes only. If we have not contacted you within 4 weeks after your submission, you may consider your application unsuccessful.

title: Astrodynamics Software Integration Engineer II
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.


You'll join the Astrodynamics and Trajectory Execution (ATX) team, which is responsible for end-to-end trajectory design and ground navigation within In-Space Systems. We are growing ATX to design, navigate, and operate missions to the Moon and Mars while building the software capabilities required for operational deep-space flight dynamics. In this hands-on role, you will mature ATX-developed algorithms into reliable operational capabilities within the Flight Dynamics System (FDS). You will primarily support an assigned mission from development through live flight operations, while building reusable capabilities that scale across the Blue Ring fleet.

Your Impact:

  • Integrate Flight Dynamics Capabilities: Integrate ATX algorithms for orbit determination, orbit prediction, maneuver planning, attitude design, and associated automation into the FDS. Ensure rigor, integrity, configuration control, and compatibility with the FDS and its Monte-propagated truth environment.
  • Productionize Astrodynamics Algorithms: Work with ATX engineers to mature algorithms from analysis and development into maintainable operational Python and C++ software. Define interfaces, configurations, and data products, and write documentation to support software maintenance and end-user use.
  • Verify and Validate Software: Implement unit, integration, regression, and scenario-based testing to verify performance across mission use cases. Support requirement verification and validation (V&V) efforts and ensure software performs to required specifications using independent tools.
  • Partner Across ATX and Ground Systems: Work closely with ATX engineers and the Flight Dynamics System software architect to mature integration patterns and ensure ATX capabilities fit within the broader ground-system architecture. Coordinate with mission planning and flight operations teams on operational interfaces and workflows.
  • Support Live Flight Operations: Validate integrated capabilities through simulation, test, and mission rehearsals. Maintain operational readiness during mission-critical activities by triaging issues, isolating root causes, and delivering software patches and releases.
  • Contribute to Astrodynamics Operations: Perform operational orbit determination and/or mission design processes for an assigned lifecycle mission. Develop analysis software and contribute to flight dynamics products, reviews, rehearsals, and live operations.
  • Drive Automation for Fleet Operations: Automate algorithm integration, testing, and flight dynamics workflows as ATX scales from individual missions toward fleet-level operations, including through generative AI where it improves speed and reliability.
  • Establish ATX Software Practices: Help establish and sustain team standards for algorithmic software development, testing, code review, configuration control, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Deliver with Agile Discipline: Scope, estimate, and plan work in deliverable increments, using tools such as Jira and git.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • B.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field with 4+ years of relevant experience; M.S. in a related field with 2+ years of relevant experience; or Ph.D. in a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of astrodynamics and orbital mechanics, with applied project, research, or professional experience in either spacecraft mission design, including trajectory analysis and maneuver planning, or orbit determination, including estimation, covariance analysis, or tracking-data processing.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining scientific, simulation, autonomy, mission-planning, or operational software in a collaborative codebase, including diagnosing and resolving complex software, algorithm, or data-processing issues.
  • Strong proficiency in Python or C++ and working proficiency in the other, including software design, debugging, automated testing, and performance-aware development. Julia experience is a plus.
  • Experience with software engineering practices including version control, code review, automated testing, configuration management, and CI/CD or equivalent build-and-test workflows.
  • Working knowledge of spacecraft flight dynamics workflows, including orbit determination, orbit prediction, maneuver planning, and the use of configuration-controlled data and models to produce operational products.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, scope ambiguous technical problems, and deliver results with minimal oversight.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including collaborating across technical disciplines and authoring technical documentation.
  • Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience using the Monte toolkit for trajectory analysis, orbit determination, maneuver planning, or operational flight dynamics, and independent tools such as STK, FreeFlyer, or GMAT for algorithm V&V.
  • Experience developing or integrating operational flight dynamics, ground, mission-planning, autonomy, or other mission-critical software systems.
  • Experience supporting a production environment, including issue triage, root cause analysis, problem detection and isolation, software patches, and software releases, with a clear understanding of operational risks and impacts.
  • Experience supporting mission rehearsals, live spacecraft operations, or other time-critical operational environments, ideally on cislunar or interplanetary missions.
  • Experience with radiometric or GPS orbit determination, or with trajectory optimization and maneuver planning and execution, for high-thrust or electric-propulsion missions.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tooling, including configuration control, CI/CD, code review, Jira, git, Docker, Terraform, and Ansible, and with AWS services such as EC2, EKS, S3, MSK, and Aurora.
  • Experience communicating effectively across a distributed team.
  • Experience using generative AI tools to expedite and automate your workflow.
  • Current TS/SCI clearance with polygraph, or willingness to obtain and maintain one. This role is tailored for deep-space flight dynamics software primarily supporting civil missions in Mars and cislunar space, but candidates with clearance may have opportunities to contribute across the full range of ATX mission work long-term.

title: Director, Customer Operations
description:
Job Description Summary:

The Director, Customer Operations serves as the senior operational leader and strategic thought partner. The role builds trusted, long-term relationships for our customers, account team, Coca-Cola System, and external partner network to develop and execute integrated equipment, service, and supply chain strategies. This leader translates customer, operational, and financial insights into compelling business narratives and actionable recommendations, balancing customer priorities with scalable enterprise value. The role is accountable for delivering beverage quality, growth, service, productivity, and financial outcomes through strong cross-functional leadership, System alignment, and disciplined execution.


What You’ll Do for Us

  • Serve as the senior operational leader and trusted advisor for an assigned portfolio of customers, building long-term relationships with customer executives, account teams, bottling partners, service providers, and cross-functional stakeholders to advance mutual business objectives.
  • Develop and execute customer operations strategies that improve beverage quality, service, category growth, profitability, and customer value creation. Anticipate emerging customer needs and translate them into scalable short- and long-term solutions.
  • Lead cross-functional planning and execution of operational initiatives, including annual business planning, capital and service expense management, project governance, resource allocation, forecasting, and performance measurement to deliver customer and company objectives.
  • Leverage operational expertise, financial acumen, and data-driven insights to identify growth opportunities and solve complex business challenges, balancing customer priorities with enterprise objectives, System capabilities, and long-term business value.
  • Influence decision-making through compelling storytelling and executive communication, translating operational, financial, and customer insights into clear recommendations that drive alignment, action, and sustainable long-term partnership value.
  • Own business performance for the assigned customer portfolio, including service execution, capital deployment, profitability improvement, beverage quality, customer satisfaction, and operational productivity metrics.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Significant progressive experience in customer operations, account leadership, service, supply chain, or a related customer-facing function.
  • Demonstrated success building trusted, long-term relationships with senior customer and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including business planning, forecasting, capital management, and cost optimization.
  • Advanced ability to interpret data, identify insights, and translate findings into clear recommendations and actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive alignment in a highly matrixed, System-oriented environment.
  • Experience balancing immediate customer needs with long-term strategic and enterprise priorities.

Functional Skills:

  • Customer & Relationship Leadership Builds trusted partnerships and serves as a strategic advisor to customer executives and key stakeholders across the Coca-Cola System.
  • Executive Communication & Storytelling Translates complex operational, customer, and financial information into compelling business narratives that influence decisions and drive action.
  • Enterprise Mindset Balances customer needs, operational realities, and enterprise priorities to create sustainable value across the Coca-Cola System.
  • Financial & Commercial Acumen Develops and manages capital and operating plans while identifying opportunities to improve profitability, productivity, and return on investment.
  • Operational & Technical Expertise Applies equipment, service, supply chain, and digital capabilities to develop scalable solutions that enhance customer value and business performance.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership Leads through influence in a matrixed environment, aligning internal teams, bottling partners, and external providers to deliver results.

What We’ll Do for You

  • Empower Strategic Leadership: Lead at the intersection of customer strategy and operational excellence—shaping how Coca‑Cola delivers service, quality, and value across diverse customer portfolios.
  • Drive Enterprise Impact: Influence decisions that advance beverage quality, category growth, service performance, and financial outcomes, contributing directly to Coca‑Cola’s long‑term success.
  • Collaborate Across the System: Work alongside senior executives, bottling partners, and cross‑functional teams to align priorities and deliver integrated, scalable solutions across the Coca‑Cola System.
  • Accelerate Professional Growth: Gain exposure to enterprise‑level planning, capital management, operational execution, and strategic storytelling while developing as a trusted business leader.

title: Chief Director, AI Platform & Solutions
company: Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute
description:
Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute (ASTRI) is founded in 2000 by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. As Hong Kong’s largest government-funded research and development centre, ASTRI is a key force and super‑connector driving innovation and technology advancement in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area, and the global innovation ecosystem. This role is strengthened through its merger with Nano and Advanced Materials Institute (NAMI).

Committed to bringing high‑impact research from lab to market, ASTRI advances interdisciplinary, market‑driven R&D that delivers practical innovations for industry and meaningful benefits for society.

Its technological strengths and capabilities enable AI‑powered, cross‑disciplinary ICT and advanced materials solutions across Smart City, Financial Technologies, Digital Health and Life Sciences, New Industrialisation and Intelligent Manufacturing, Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASIC) and Advanced Electronics, New Energy and Energy Storage, and Green and ESG Technologies.

Over the years, ASTRI has cultivated a strong pool of I&T talent and earned numerous international awards for its pioneering innovations and contributions to industry and the community. Following the merger with NAMI, ASTRI’s cumulative global patent portfolio has grown to over 1,500, with more than 2,200 technologies successfully transferred to industry.

With enhanced scale and capabilities, ASTRI is uniquely positioned to elevate Hong Kong’s innovation capacity, accelerate technology commercialisation, and drive societal and economic progress through world‑class applied research.

To support our constant endeavour to position Hong Kong as a world-class smart city and an international hub of innovation and technology, we are seeking qualified professionals to fill the following position(s):

The Opportunity

ASTRI is a publicly funded applied research institute dedicated to driving economic growth and societal impact through technological innovation. Our research and development is on technologies that have strong application prospects, by focusing on the development of "0-to-1" technologies and shepherding them through the "1-to-10" validation phase to ensure market readiness.

Our key technologies work synergistically to solve complex, real-world problems. We are now seeking a visionary and operationally excellent leader to head our AI, Trusted Technology, Digital Health & Education, Intelligent Manufacturing and FinTech TD—the engine room of our institute's future.

Reports To: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Location: Hong Kong

Job Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Vision & Technology Roadmap

  • Develop and maintain a forward-looking research strategy and technology roadmap for the sector, with a core focus on LLM/LVLM, Agentic AI, and Generative AI technologies, as well as their application within Digital Health, Intelligent Manufacturing, Trusted Tech and FinTech.

  • Identify emerging trends and translate them into actionable research programs that ensure the institute remains at the cutting edge of trusted and responsible AI.

  • Champion the adoption of AI advancements across the entire institute, enabling other TDs to enhance their research productivity and solution capabilities.

2. Research and Solution Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a large, multidisciplinary team of top-tier AI researchers, engineers, and domain experts, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaboration.

  • Oversee the design and development of a core base Agentic AI platform. This platform will serve as the foundational layer for all solution teams, ensuring reusability, scalability, and robustness.

  • Guide solution teams in building vertically integrated AI applications for Trusted Technologies and FinTech, ensuring technical alignment with the core platform.

  • Possess a working knowledge of system deployment architectures and methodologies to guide the team in building solutions that are not only innovative but also feasible for real-world piloting and integration.

3. Commercialization & Impact Acceleration (0→1→10)

  • Help guide the technology commercialization, ensuring that research outputs are not only innovative but are developed with a clear path to market.

  • Possess a deep understanding of the "1-to-10" phase. While not responsible for full-scale productization, you will ensure that the "0-to-1" research planning explicitly incorporates the requirements, constraints, and feedback from early-stage validation, pilot projects, and customer engagements.

  • Work closely with the business development and partnerships teams to identify and secure opportunities for pilot deployments and market validation.

4. Stakeholder & Ecosystem Management

  • Serve as the primary technical ambassador for the sector to a diverse range of stakeholders, including:

    • Government Funding Agencies: Articulate the technical merit, strategic alignment, and potential economic impact of research programs to secure funding.

    • Strategic Clients: Understand their operational challenges and translate them into technological requirements, building trust in the ASTRI’s ability to deliver secure and trusted solutions.

    • Commercial Customers & Solution Integrators: Effectively communicate the value proposition of our technologies, build strong relationships, and secure their interest and trust as partners in the "1-to-10" journey.

  • Navigate complex multi-party collaborations, ensuring alignment of interests and smooth project execution.

Job Requirements:

Academic qualification:

  • PhD degree in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, Information Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.

Required Experience:

  • Proven Leadership: A minimum of 15+ years of experience in technology research and solution development, with at least 8+ years in a senior leadership role managing large, high-performing, and multidisciplinary teams in an applied research, corporate R&D, or advanced solution development environment.

  • Technical Depth: A strong technical background in AI/ML with a demonstrated ability to keep pace with the latest advancements in Agentic AI and GenAI. Experience architecting and building scalable AI platforms and solutions.

  • Domain Application: Proven experience applying AI to enterprises and financial services. Experience in other verticals like Digital Health and Intelligent Manufacturing is a plus.

  • Deployment Acumen: A solid working knowledge of modern software/system deployment practices. Hands-on experience with solution development and system deployment is strongly preferred.

  • Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated success in taking technologies from the lab to the market. You must have a track record of navigating the "0-to-1" to "1-to-10" transition, working with commercial partners, and understanding product requirements.

  • Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including government officials, funding bodies, and C-level executives. Experience in a publicly funded or highly regulated environment is a strong plus.

The appointment will be on renewable contract terms with a competitive salary and performance-linked gratuity. Fringe benefits include paid leave, medical, insurance coverage and contribution to MPF. The incumbent will normally work a five-day week.

For interested parties, please submit your application with detailed CV within two weeks of the post date. Applicants are encouraged to submit their applications as soon as possible. The review of applications will continue until the post is filled.

The resume should not include any sensitive personal information such as ID card no. or travel document number, etc.

Position offer is subject to the applicant’s experience and academic qualification. Only short-listed candidates will be notified. ASTRI reserves the right not to fill the position.

ASTRI is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used exclusively for recruitment only. For details, please refer to ASTRI Privacy Policy Statement.
