title: Senior Network Reliability Engineer
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.

Description:

The role is part of the Blue National Security unit and supports Blue Origin’s Quartz program. Quartz is building out a global network of Blue Origin owned and operated ground infrastructure. Quartz will be used by Blue Origin businesses and external customers providing reliable, flexible, and cost-effective communications services between Earth and space.

The Quartz team is looking for experienced personnel to join their team. We’re a group of problem-solvers with diverse skillsets, building and operating the ground stations that serve as the critical link connecting space to Earth. Working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, you’ll contribute innovative solutions while demonstrating personal leadership, technical competence, and attention to detail. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and demands your dedicated commitment to safe, reliable spaceflight.

As a Ground Network Engineer, you will be at the forefront of designing, building, and maintaining the highly available and resilient network infrastructure that connects our global network of ground stations. You will join a dedicated team of engineers who are critical to the success of our spaceflight missions. This role requires a blend of deep technical expertise in networking, a passion for automation, and a commitment to applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to create a scalable, robust, and secure network environment. Your contributions will directly impact our ability to communicate with our fleet of launch vehicles and spacecraft, enabling our vision of millions of people living and working in space.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and document the end-to-end network topology for multiple sites and a Network Operations Center (NOC).

  • Define and implement WAN/LAN architecture, including primary and backup circuits, switching, and routing.

  • Configure and manage network hardware, including routers, switches, firewalls, and out-of-band management devices.

  • Develop and implement IP addressing plans and VLAN configurations.

  • Establish and maintain network security architecture, including firewalls, VPN tunnels, and access control lists.

  • Conduct system hardening, vulnerability scanning, and remediation of findings.

  • Implement and manage network monitoring and observability platforms to ensure network health and performance.

  • Coordinate with service providers for circuit installation and troubleshooting.

  • Create and maintain comprehensive network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, and as-built documentation.

  • Develop and automate network health reporting and trend analysis.

  • Lead Quartz cyber security compliance activities

Minimum Qualifications:

  • B.S. or higher degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, computer engineering, or related field or equivalent experience

  • 8+ years of relevant experience architecting, developing and deploying scalable and maintainable network infrastructure.

  • Experience in network architecting, device installation, configuration, and monitoring.

  • Experience developing and managing network device configurations in multi-vendor environments

  • Deep understanding of protocols including but not limited to (TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, MPLS), routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, IS-IS), and network services (DHCP, DNS, NTP)

  • Experience coding in higher-level languages (e.g. Python, Go, Rust, C++, etc)

  • Highly organized team player with excellent technical written and verbal communication skills.

  • Demonstrated track record of resourcefulness from their previous assignments.

  • Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion.

  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with Juniper networking platforms (JNCIS-ENT, JNCIS-DevOps, JNCIP, or higher certifications a plus)

  • Experience with Palo Alto Networks security platforms

  • Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-series guidance, including SP 800-57, and FIPS 140-2/140-3 requirements

POSITION SPECIFICS​

Penn State Intercollegiate Athletics, a Division I and Big Ten Conference Institution, is seeking a Mental Health Clinician for the Department of Integrated Behavioral Health. This position is responsible for the assessment, triage, and provision of comprehensive clinical mental health services tailored specifically to the unique, high-pressure environment of student-athletes.


Responsibilities & Duties Include:


  • Clinical Care: Provide individual, group, and crisis counseling to student-athletes
  • Assessment & Triage: Conduct mental health screenings, manage crisis interventions, and design immediate safety or treatment plans.
  • Team Point Person: Serve as the designated Integrated Behavioral Health contact for specific athletic teams.
  • Staff Consultation: Consult directly with coaches, athletic trainers, and staff regarding student-athlete mental health, using high-level discretion to balance communication with clinical confidentiality.
  • Case Management: Coordinate care with sports medicine, psychiatric providers, and off-campus specialists, managing referrals and follow-ups.
  • Workshops & Outreach: Develop and deliver targeted mental health training, stress management workshops, and wellness initiatives for teams and staff.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate, timely, and confidential clinical records in compliance with university, state, and federal laws.
  • Program Support: Participate in an after-hours on-call rotation and assist with the supervision or mentorship of interns and trainees as needed.



Required Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong clinical skills in assessment, mental health counseling, and crisis management.
  • Understanding of college athletics culture and the unique needs of the athlete population.
  • Strong organizational skills to handle multiple team needs independently.
  • A solid understanding of boundaries and professional ethics.
  • Ability to problem-solve, handle sensitive information and nuanced situations.
  • Ability to work independently and as a member of a multidisciplinary interdepartmental team.
  • Able to communicate well and build rapport quickly with students, coaches, and staff and use high level discretion.
  • Able to demonstrate the ability to work well with a diverse group of clients.

Educational/Certification Requirements:

  • Master's degree (or higher) in Counseling or related discipline.
  • Licensure: Licensed Professional Counselor, Licensed Clinical Social Worker, Licensed Psychologist, or related discipline or has the ability to obtain within 6 months of hire.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience (can include an internship) providing mental health counseling and performance enhancement services to athletes, preferably in a university or college counseling center setting.

  • Experience with specialty areas such as substance misuse and disordered eating.

title: Kommerciel arkitekt/landskabsarkitekt
description:
Kan du omsætte kunders behov, steder og ambitioner til gode uderumsløsninger - og samtidig se forretningen i dem?

Virksomhed:

Næste ApS

Arbejdssted:

Finervej 7, 4621 Gadstrup

Ansøgningsfrist:

19/10/2026

Hos Næste udvikler og producerer vi uderumsløsninger til professionelle ejendomsejere med fokus på funktion, arkitektur, cirkularitet og lang levetid.

Vi oplever en stigende efterspørgsel efter løsninger, hvor flere funktioner skal tænkes sammen – eksempelvis skure, cykelparkering, affaldsløsninger, overdækninger, ophold, hegn og inventar.

Derfor søger vi en erfaren kommerciel arkitekt/landskabsarkitekt, som kan møde kunden tidligt, forstå både stedet og behovet og omsætte det til løsninger, der fungerer arkitektonisk, teknisk og kommercielt.

Vi leder ikke efter en klassisk projekterende arkitekt. Vi leder efter en erfaren profil, der kan se mulighederne i både det gode projekt og den gode forretning – og som motiveres af at gøre gode løsninger enkle, realiserbare og gentagelige.

Om rollen

Du bliver en del af Næstes kommercielle og faglige front mod markedet og refererer direkte til vores administrerende direktør (som også er arkitekt og hvis nuværende arbejdsopgaver du gradvis vil overtage).

Du arbejder tæt sammen med vores kommercielt ansvarlige og vores projektlederteam, men får dit eget tydelige ansvarsområde: den tidlige faglige kundedialog og udviklingen af den rigtige løsning.

Du skal kunne gå ind i en tidlig dialog om en ejendom, et gårdrum eller et større bolig- eller udviklingsområde og hurtigt forstå de vigtigste muligheder og begrænsninger: disponering, funktioner, arkitektur, adgangsforhold, brand, myndighedskrav, økonomi og kundens/rådgivers ambitioner.

Opgaven er ikke nødvendigvis at detailprojektere løsningen selv. Din vigtigste opgave er at bringe kunden/rådgiveren fra “Vi har dette projekt og disse behov” til “Her er et kvalificeret løsningsprincip, som Næste kan tilbyde, projektere og producere til denne pris”.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andre

  • Tidlig kundedialog og faglig behovsafdækning sammen med vores kommercielt ansvarlige og administrerende direktør.
  • Besigtigelse og vurdering af ejendomme, gårdrum, boligområder og andre uderum.
  • Udvikling af disponeringer, koncepter og løsningsprincipper.
  • Arkitektonisk og funktionel rådgivning om Næstes løsninger.
  • Tidlig identifikation af forhold omkring brand, adgang, myndighedskrav, konstruktion og placering.
  • Visualisering og formidling af løsningsforslag til kunder og rådgivere.
  • Bidrag til tilbud, kundemøder, præsentationer og tilbudsstrategi.
  • Tidlig vurdering af projekt- og entrepriserisici, herunder praktisk forståelse for AB18 og ABT18.
  • Kvalificering af, hvornår en eksisterende standardløsning kan anvendes, og hvornår en specialløsning er nødvendig.
  • Overdragelse af kvalificerede projekter til vores projektlederteam.
  • Samarbejde med projektlederne og produktionen om at omsætte erfaringer fra marked og projekter til bedre standardløsninger.
  • Bidrag til udviklingen af Næstes samlede produkt- og løsningsportefølje.

Den profil, vi leder efter

Du er sandsynligvis uddannet arkitekt eller landskabsarkitekt og har solid erfaring – typisk 8-10+ år – fra arkitekt-, landskabsarkitekt-, rådgiver-, entreprenør- eller ejendomsbranchen. Du er vant til at arbejde selvstændigt med professionelle bygherrer og komplekse byggeprojekter.

Måske arbejder du i dag som seniorarkitekt, projektleder eller har været associate partner. Titlen er ikke afgørende. Det afgørende er kombinationen af faglig tyngde, forretningsforståelse og lysten til kundedialogen og ansvaret – også for økonomien.

  • Har flere års solid relevant erfaring – som pejlemærke typisk 8-10+ år – fra den professionelle bygge- eller ejendomsbranche.
  • Har arbejdet med professionelle bygherrer, ejendomsejere og/eller rådgivere.
  • Kan læse et sted, en situationsplan og et byggeprojekt og hurtigt identificere muligheder og begrænsninger.
  • Har tilstrækkelig byggefaglig forståelse til tidligt at identificere problemstillinger omkring eksempelvis brand, myndighedsforhold, konstruktion og adgang.
  • Har praktisk erfaring med entrepriseprojekter og et godt kendskab til AB18 og/eller ABT18.
  • Forstår sammenhængen mellem projektering, ydelsesafgrænsning, ændringer, økonomi, tid og ansvar.
  • Er stærk i den tidlige konceptuelle fase og kan kommunikere løsninger visuelt og mundtligt.
  • Har et naturligt kommercielt blik og interesserer dig for økonomi, kundeværdi og realiserbarhed.
  • Er tryg ved selvstændigt at stå i kundemøder med professionelle bygherrer og rådgivere.
  • Arbejder pragmatisk og har respekt for produktion, standardisering og gentagelse.

Du behøver ikke være sælger i traditionel forstand. Men du skal have lyst til at være tæt på kunderne og kunne se den kommercielle mulighed i den faglige dialog.

Sådan arbejder vi

Vi bygger systemer og samlesæt. Du ser værdien i at udvikle løsninger, der kan gentages, frem for at starte forfra hver gang, og værdien i at bygge klogt og effektivt med minimalt spild af tid og materialer.

Vi lærer og forbedrer hver dag. Erfaringer fra kunder og projekter skal omsættes til bedre løsninger og unikke projekter skal kunne oversættes til standarder for at opnå en reel omstilling.

Vi vinder sammen. Du lykkes gennem samarbejdet med salg, projektering, produktion og kommunikation, og ikke mindst sammen med kunden at finde de helt rigtige løsninger.

Vi genbruger og repeterer processer. Den bedste løsning er ikke nødvendigvis den mest unikke. Ofte er det den løsning, vi kan dokumentere, producere effektivt og bruge igen. Vi genbruger og optimerer både på processer og materialer.

En central rolle mellem marked og organisation

Du refererer direkte til Næstes administrerende direktør og arbejder sideordnet med vores kommercielt ansvarlige og vores marketing- og kommunikationsansvarlige.

I den tidlige kundedialog arbejder du tæt sammen med den kommercielle funktion. Når en mulighed udvikler sig til et konkret projekt, kobles vores projektlederteam på med kompetencer inden for blandt andet projektering, konstruktion, statik, brand, IKT og klima/LCA.

Du bliver dermed et vigtigt bindeled mellem kunden, arkitekturen, forretningen og Næstes interne faglighed.

Hvad vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i udviklingen af Næstes næste vækstfase.
  • Mulighed for at kombinere arkitektur, forretning og cirkulært byggeri i samme stilling.
  • Direkte kundekontakt og mulighed for at påvirke løsningerne tidligt.
  • Kort afstand fra idé og tegning til egen produktion og fysisk resultat.
  • Stor indflydelse på udviklingen af vores fremtidige løsninger og standarder.
  • Tæt samarbejde med ledelse, kommerciel funktion, projektledere og produktion.

title: Physical Distribution Employee II
description:
Job Title

Physical Distribution Employee II

Job Description

Physical Distribution Employee


About Vanderlande

Vanderlande is a global leader in logistics process automation, specializing in automated material handling systems for airports, warehouses, and parcel operations. Our innovative solutions move millions of products and pieces of luggage around the world every day. With a strong focus on technology, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we are committed to delivering reliable solutions for our customers while providing meaningful career opportunities for our employees.


Job Summary

The Physical Distribution Employee is responsible for the receiving, journaling, packaging, control, identification, storage, movement, collection, and loading/unloading of goods within the Physical Distribution department. This role may be performed independently or as part of a team. The employee works in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and handles goods quickly, accurately, and safely to ensure shipments are delivered complete, undamaged, and on time to customers or internal sites.


Essential Functions (Job Duties and Responsibilities)

  • Execute tasks as requested or required
  • Follow defined processes for inbound, picking, outbound, and reverse logistics orders
  • Inspect, check, and identify goods
  • Perform journal entries related to packaging and storage of goods
  • Load and unload goods safely and efficiently
  • Operate sit-down and/or stand-up forklifts
  • Work safely both independently and within a team environment
  • Perform cycle counts and other inventory-related activities
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment
  • Follow all safety rules, regulations, and procedures

Required Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Valid state driver’s license with a clean driving record
  • Minimum of one (1) year of warehouse experience
  • Minimum of one (1) year of forklift operator experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Forklift Operator Certification
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office applications
  • Basic mechanical knowledge; mechanical aptitude is a plus
  • Logistics and packaging knowledge preferred

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (Competencies)

  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and understand shared responsibility
  • Strong awareness of safety and safe work practices
  • Ability to maintain productivity levels in a fast-paced environment
  • Effective communication skills
  • Results-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail

Position Type / Expected Hours of Work

  • Full-time position
  • Monday through Friday
  • May require overtime and holiday work

Travel

  • This position does not require travel

Supervisory Responsibility

  • This position has no supervisory responsibilities

Work Environment and Physical Demands

The work environment and physical demands described below are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this position.

  • Frequently lifts up to 50 pounds; occasionally lifts up to 75 pounds
  • Frequently carries up to 45 pounds; occasionally up to 50 pounds
  • Regular exposure to moving mechanical parts, vibration, fumes, or airborne particles
  • Noise levels may be loud in warehouse or job site environments
  • Highly active role requiring standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, crawling, and climbing throughout the workday
  • Regularly required to talk and hear

Other Duties

This job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of duties, responsibilities, or activities. Duties may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Vanderlande is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Lösningsarkitekt - Finance & Operations Göteborg
description:
Lösningsarkitekt – Finance & Operations

Göteborg på plats

Företaget är ett börsnoterat fastighetsbolag, grundat 2005, som äger, förvaltar och utvecklar bostäder, kommersiella fastigheter och hotell i Sverige, Danmark, Finland, Tyskland, Storbritannien och Norge. Rollen sitter i DITA (digitalisering, IT och affärsutveckling), mitt i en flerårig transformation med nytt ERP, ny dataplattform och masterdata. Företaget är affärsdrivet, inte tech-drivet: beslut går snabbt och man bär många hattar.

Om rollen

Du är teknisk ledare för lösningsarkitekturen kring Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations och tekniken runt den: Power Platform, integrationer, tredjepartsprodukter, automation och Azure. Du äger hur lösningar byggs och integreras, medan produktägaren äger vad och varför. Du sätter lösningsdesign och integrationsmönster och balanserar standard mot anpassning. Fokus är först ekonomiprocesser och därefter fastighets- och hyresadministration.

Varför rollen är unik

Företaget har cirka 2 000 juridiska enheter – långt över de cirka 250 som plattformen normalt hanterar – och olika hyreslagstiftning mellan länderna. Implementationen pågår i 3+ år, och om ett år ska fastighetssystem och inköpssystem in samtidigt. Det är en arkitekturutmaning man sällan får som konsult.

Skall krav

  • Djup erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
  • Power Platform, med Power Apps i första hand
  • Lösningsarkitektur och implementation av affärskritiska plattformar – riktmärke minst 5 år, undantagsvis 2–3 år vid tydlig potential (t.ex. en tech lead på väg in i arkitektrollen)
  • Stark teknisk förståelse för systemarkitektur, integrationer och datamodeller
  • Erfarenhet av komplexa systemlandskap och transformationsprogram
  • God förståelse för ekonomi- och verksamhetsprocesser
  • Vana att arbeta nära verksamhet, produktägare, utvecklingsteam och externa leverantörer
  • Hands-on nog att förklara exakt hur en lösning ska byggas, inte bara sätta övergripande design
  • Flytande i Svenska och Engelska


Meriterande

  • Azure och API:er
  • Teknisk bakgrund från utvecklarsidan snarare än projektledning
  • Governance, standardisering och modern plattformsförvaltning
  • Tredjepartsprodukter kring ERP, t.ex. fakturaattest och inköp (företaget har valt Xflow, men det är inget krav)
  • Fastighetsbranschen och/eller hyresadministration (starkt meriterande)
  • Har löst legal entity-struktur, prestanda och intercompany i stor skala


Vem vi söker

Vi söker en kreativ, entreprenöriell person med utvecklarbakgrund, som framgångsrikt har drivit projekt i mål och tagit ägarskap för resultatet.

  • F.d. F&O-utvecklare som vill äga arkitekturen i stället för att bara ge råd
  • Håller många parallella spår och går ändå ner på detaljnivå
  • Kombinerar tekniskt djup med affärsförståelse
  • Pragmatisk – väger lösning mot avkastning, inte en "best practice"-dogmatiker
  • Trivs i en föränderlig miljö där mandat fortfarande formas


Villkor

  • Göteborg, på plats 5 dagar/vecka
  • Anställning: tillsvidare med inledande provanställning

title: Jord- og betonarbejder til beton og afvanding i Allerød
description:
Er du jord- og betonarbejder og vil du have firmabil og fast arbejde?

Vi mangler en til beton, gravearbejde og afvanding i Allerød.

Du bliver en del af en mellemstor arbejdsplads, hvor udendørsarealer og holdbare løsninger fylder i hverdagen. Opgaverne ligger omkring Allerød, og du får firmabil som en del af pakken. Rollen er praktisk og jordnær, med beton som fast del af arbejdet og mulighed for også at tage fat på gravearbejde, kloak, afvanding og regnvand.

Det her er for dig, der gerne vil have et fast job med tydelige opgaver og ordnede forhold. Kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi du skal kunne komme ud på pladserne. Du bliver ikke målt på flotte ord, men på at arbejdet bliver lavet rigtigt og afleveret ordentligt.

Det får du

Løn: 180-200 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Allerød og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Beton, gravearbejde og afvanding

Din hverdag

Dagen handler om praktisk udførelse på pladsen: du tager fat på betonarbejde og løser de opgaver der følger med underlaget, faldet og afvandingen. Når gravearbejde eller regnvand hænger sammen med betonopgaven, hjælper du med at få det gjort i den rigtige rækkefølge.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Udfører betonarbejde på pladsen
  • Hjælper med jord- og gravearbejde efter behov
  • Arbejder med kloak, afvanding og regnvand
  • Sørger for at fald og underlag giver mening før næste fag kan komme til

Her handler arbejdet om løsninger der skal holde, også når vejret og vandet gør sit. Du skal derfor sige til, hvis noget ikke stemmer, før det bliver dækket til.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Vi forventer ikke at du har lavet det hele før. Men du skal kunne se en opgave og tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring med betonarbejde
  • Har gerne mindst 2 års erfaring fra faget
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet kræfter med jord, gravearbejde, kloak eller regnvand. Men det vigtigste er, at du arbejder ordentligt og ikke afleverer noget halvt.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: SIU Field Investigator
description:
Are you the kind of investigator who can't walk away from unanswered questions? Do you have an eye for detail, a passion for uncovering facts, and the experience to separate assumptions from evidence? Lemieux & Associates is seeking a part-time, on-call SIU Field Investigator in Buffalo, NY, who is ready to put their investigative expertise to work in a rewarding role where every case presents a new challenge. If you're looking for flexible field work with meaningful impact, don't let this opportunity pass you by. Apply today!


Why Investigators Choose Lemieux & Associates

At Lemieux & Associates, we know talented investigators are the foundation of our success. That's why we offer competitive pay of $25-$32 per hour, the flexibility of an on-call, part-time schedule, and the opportunity to work on engaging investigations that put your skills to the test. Beyond the work itself, you'll join a company that values communication, integrity, loyalty, and professional growth.


If you're ready to make an impact while enjoying flexibility and professional support, we encourage you to submit your application now!


WANT TO KNOW MORE ABOUT OUR DEDICATED TEAM?

As a national leader in investigative services, Lemieux & Associates is dedicated to delivering professional SIU/DIU, surveillance, and medical canvassing services clients can rely on. Our employees are our greatest asset, and our company culture revolves around maintaining a communicative, loyal, ethical, passionate, impactful, and benevolent environment. With a leadership team boasting over 25 years of field experience, we are committed to unlocking the potential of our employees and creating a supportive, tight-knit community.


DO YOU MEET THESE QUALIFICATIONS?

  • SIU/Claims investigation experience as a Private Investigator or Fraud Investigator
  • Must reside in the Buffalo area
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Resume and questionnaire required for consideration

Preferred Qualifications:

  • While no license is required, a Notary License is strongly preferred
  • Bilingual abilities and/or a degree in Criminal Justice or a related field

WHAT WILL YOU DO AS A SIU FIELD INVESTIGATOR?

As our SIU Field Investigator, no two days will look exactly the same. One day, you'll arrive at an accident scene to carefully document conditions and capture critical photographic evidence. Another day, you'll be meeting with individuals to obtain written or recorded statements that help bring clarity to a claim. Throughout each investigation, you'll gather facts, assess evidence, connect important details, and compile comprehensive reports that provide clients with accurate and reliable information. Your ability to observe, document, and communicate findings will play a vital role in helping uncover the truth behind every case.


Flexible Work That Fits Your Lifestyle

This position offers a part-time, on-call schedule. Work assignments will vary based on case needs and investigative demand within the Buffalo area. Ideal candidates will appreciate the flexibility of field-based investigative work while maintaining the professionalism and responsiveness needed to support client requests.


READY TO APPLY AND ADVANCE YOUR CAREER?

If you're ready to put your SIU experience to work with a respected national investigative firm, we want to hear from you. Our application process is quick, easy, and mobile-friendly, making it simple to take the next step in your career. Apply today and discover where your investigative expertise can take you.

title: Digital & Syndication Specialist
location: London, London, City of, United Kingdom
description:
Job Title: Digital & Syndication Specialist

Contract Type: Full-time fixed-term contract, 2 to 20 November 2026 (including the weekend of 14 and 15 November)

Location: London, UK (hybrid, with a minimum of two days per week in our Whitechapel office)

Reports To: Head of Content


About us:

The Earthshot Prize is the world's most prestigious environmental Prize. We exist because 2030 is a critical deadline for our planet, and we're here to celebrate groundbreaking leadership in environmental action, activate the people who can back it, and inspire optimism across the globe.

Our Storytelling team brings this mission to life, sharing the stories of the Prize and our Finalists across media, TV, social, digital, OOH and beyond. We're an ambitious team finding every possible way to tell the biggest story in the world, and to bring urgent optimism to a global audience.

Our 2026 Summit & Awards Night in Mumbai is in November and we're looking to bolster our core team to deliver this.


Job Overview:

We are seeking a London-based digital specialist with expertise in DIT and syndication management to support the Prize as we deliver our 2026 Summit in India. Our production team in Mumbai will capture a large volume of filmed and photographed content. From this, we will create best-in-class edits, secure stakeholder approval and deploy content to be shared by our incredible network of talent, creators and partners.

This role will sit at the heart of that work. You will bring robust systems to ensure efficient delivery, excellent organisational and administrative skills, and a proactive approach to making sure everyone on the team has what they need, when they need it, throughout the Summit. Expertise in working on the platform Canto is essential to manage content.

You will report to the Head of Content and work alongside our UK team of social media managers, graphic designers and video editors. You will also work closely with our team on the ground in Mumbai, who will be creating content and working with key stakeholders, including talent and creators.

This is a hybrid role, split between home and our office in Whitechapel. We ask that you join us in the office at least two days per week so you can get to know the team. You will also be office-based on 16 and 17 November to support the two largest events of the Summit.


Key Responsibilities:

Canto Management:

  • Lead the upload and management of our press hub and partner hubs, which are essential to amplifying the reach of our content and a key priority for the Prize during the Summit
  • Upload, file and reorganise content in Canto, keeping the library well structured and easy to navigate
  • Create and manage Canto portals for press, partners and other stakeholders
  • QA all content to ensure it is live, correct and delivered efficiently

DIT and Content Management:

  • Manage the video and static content pipeline as it is received from our production team in Mumbai, serving content teams in both Mumbai and London during a period of very fast turnaround
  • Set up upload folders on our cloud storage platform, Iconik, for production teams to deliver to
  • Ensure overnight uploads are received complete, filed in the correct locations and labelled accurately
  • Share the right links with editors and teams promptly, so they have the content they need without delay
  • Keep content filed correctly and easily accessible, enabling edits to be turned around quickly
  • Manage files according to stakeholder approval status, archiving content that should not go live and ensuring approved content is ready promptly

Syndication Support:

  • Work with the Digital Campaigns & Relations Manager to understand and deliver our syndication plans
  • Support the talent approvals process, sending assets, receiving approval notes and updating files accordingly so that only approved assets are available for use
  • Alert stakeholder managers when assets are ready to supply to their stakeholders, and prompt them to share where needed
  • Ensure Canto boards are easy to use and visually polished, with the right assets available at the right time

Syndication Tracking:

  • Monitor posts about the Prize from across our network, including talent, creators and partners, throughout the Summit period
  • Capture screenshots and record shared content for posterity
  • Build and maintain a tracker of all shares, helping us understand our reach and identify any gaps in our syndication plan to be addressed

Candidate Criteria:

  • Confident, hands-on experience with Canto is essential, including uploading and organising content, and creating and managing portals
  • Proven experience in digital asset management, DIT or content operations, ideally supporting fast-paced content teams
  • Experience using cloud storage and media asset management platforms such as Iconik
  • Experience supporting the syndication or amplification of content through talent, creators, partners or press
  • Excellent organisational and administrative skills, with robust systems for file management, labelling and version control
  • An exceptional eye for detail, ensuring assets are accurately labelled, approved and QA'd before they go live
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach, with strong communication skills and the ability to anticipate what teams need
  • Calm under pressure, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, live-event environment
  • Experience working with distributed teams across timezones is highly desirable
  • Experience supporting content around major live events, awards or global campaigns is highly desirable
  • Availability to work from 2 to 20 November, including the weekend of 14 and 15 November, and to work from our Whitechapel office

This role is part of the Blue National Security unit and supports Blue Origin’s Quartz program. Quartz is building out a global network of Blue Origin owned and operated ground infrastructure. Quartz will be used by Blue Origin businesses and external customers providing reliable, flexible, and cost-effective communications services between Earth and space.

Our Quartz program is looking for experienced personnel to join their team. We’re a group of problem-solvers with diverse skillsets, building and operating the ground stations that serve as the critical link connecting space to Earth. Working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, you’ll contribute innovative solutions while demonstrating personal leadership, technical competence, and attention to detail. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and demands your dedicated commitment to safe, reliable spaceflight.

We are seeking an experienced Ground Software Engineer to support the development of our mission-critical operational platforms managing our global ground station network. In this role, you will architect and implement solutions that form the vital communications backbone between Earth and space operations.

Working closely with cross-functional engineering teams and external customers, you will deliver scalable, secure, and highly reliable solutions that ensure continuous ground station availability for mission-critical spacecraft communications while providing sophisticated planning capabilities that maximize operational efficiency across the entire ground network.

title: Senior Mission Systems Engineer - Blue Ring
description:
Application close date:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.

Blue Origin is helping extend humanity's reach across the solar system by developing NASA’s Mars Telecommunications Network (MTN) – a relay communications infrastructure designed to provide reliable, high-availability data services between Mars-based users and Earth in support of NASA's civil exploration and science objectives. MTN delivers relay-as-a-service to orbiters, landers, rovers, and future crewed assets, bridging the deep space link through an integrated end-to-end ground system.

As part of a small, hardworking, and accomplished team of Mission Systems Engineers, you will work closely with spacecraft, mission operations, and ground system teams to define and mature the mission system — the integrated ground system and mission operations capability that enables MTN's relay services. You will lead the requirements, verification and validation, and interface definition efforts that ensure the ground and operations architecture meets mission objectives across significant light-time delays and long-duration operations. You will share in the team's impact on all aspects of mission systems engineering and the tools used to operate advanced deep space communications infrastructure.

We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, collaborative spirit, and dedication to quality to positively impact one of the most ambitious civil space missions of our time. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Identify, derive, develop, and maintain mission systems requirements, including traceability and verification and validation approach, necessary to implement a design that meets mission objectives.
  • Define and maintain ground element and external interface requirements and interface control documents (ICDs), including user- and payload-facing interfaces.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including engineers representing flight vehicle systems, ground software, mission operations, and payload/user customers.
  • Define the ground system and mission operations architectures that enable highly effective and labor-efficient real-time and store-and-forward spacecraft and ground system operation.
  • Plan and perform mission system product update cycles, integration and test activities, and validation exercises leading to operations training events and mission readiness.
  • Conduct testing of ground system functionality and measure performance against requirements.
  • Perform flight software to ground system integration and test.
  • Perform analysis to ensure operability across the space-ground system, and support efforts to improve operability where justified.
  • Ensure mission system requirements and interfaces align with applicable NASA and interoperability standards (e.g., CCSDS) for civil deep space missions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Ground systems architecture in the context of spaceflight operations
    • Spacecraft operations: command & control, mission planning, flight dynamics
    • Requirements definition, verification, and validation of complex systems
    • Implementing CCSDS communications protocols and standards
  • Experience across a complex system lifecycle: requirement definition, design solution definition, implementation, integration, verification, validation, qualification, and operations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

​
  • Experience with requirements management and traceability, preferably using DOORS Next Generation (DNG).
  • Experience developing and maintaining interface control documents (ICDs) for complex systems.
  • Experience with NASA civil space programs and/or integrating U.S. Government agency (e.g., NASA, JPL) missions.
  • Experience conducting end-to-end testing of large, complex systems.
  • Familiarity with DTN, delay/disruption-tolerant architectures, or deep space operations concepts.
  • Experience designing or operating spacecraft instruments and payloads.
  • Experience developing, deploying, and maintaining software in a cloud computing environment such as AWS or Azure.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python.
  • Experience with collaboration tools such as Confluence and JIRA.
  • Familiarity with version control, preferably Git.
  • Experience with configuration and product data management tools.

title: Principal Architect, System Integration & Test
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

Blue Origin is building TeraWave, a multi-thousand-satellite communications constellation delivering symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps worldwide. The system is tightly integrated end-to-end -- satellites communicating across RF and optical links with ground terminals and space-based nodes, tied together by a software stack spanning flight, mission operations, network operations, and payload systems. Validating that this full system works correctly at every stage from early development through high-rate factory acceptance is one of the most consequential challenges in the program.

As a Principal Engineer for System-Level Integration & Test, you will design and drive the system-level test program that validates TeraWave's complete hardware and software system working together. Your scope spans development and system qualification testing through to supporting provisioning and system verification at production scales. You will focus on ensuring test coverage across all system interfaces -- between hardware and software domains, across organizational boundaries, and across the RF and optical link layers that define TeraWave's end-to-end architecture. Ground terminal integration and test is a first-class element of this scope.

You will work hands-on: building test procedures, designing test facilities, debugging integration issues in the lab, and running tests alongside the team -- not just defining strategy from above. This role sits within the Chief Systems Architecture office and works closely with vehicle, payload, ground, and network teams; including the satellite integration and test team.

Special Considerations

- Relocation provided
- Travel expected up to 15% of the time

Responsibilities

- Design and maintain the system-level integration and test architecture across the full program lifecycle -- from development and system validation through factory integration -- defining the test strategy, facility designs, and validation approach for each stage
- Design progressive integrated test environments that build from isolated link-level testing through to fully integrated configurations incorporating satellites alongside emulations of network and mission operations systems, with scalability and rapid iteration as foundational requirements
- Ensure system-level test coverage is complete and unambiguous at hardware-software interfaces and across organizational boundaries, working directly with vehicle, ground, payload, and network integration and test owners
- Define and execute end-to-end test scenarios across both RF and optical link domains -- including link performance, fault response, operational mode transitions, and space-to-ground link validation
- Drive requirements and specifications for major test infrastructure -- anechoic chambers, thermal vacuum and thermal cycling systems, RF signal simulators, hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and link emulation capabilities -- ensuring the program has the assets needed to meet development and production milestones
- Partner with the broader TeraWave team to integrate system-level tests into the program's CI/CD pipelines, enabling continuous automated validation as hardware and software evolve
- Define acceptance test requirements and procedures that provide high confidence in system-level performance at production cadence, working with payload, satellite bus, and network teams
- Support FCC-required radiating tests in collaboration with the responsible teams across Blue Origin, contributing system-level test perspective to ensure appropriate coverage and regulatory compliance

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent technical field; master's degree preferred
- 8+ years of experience in system integration and test for spacecraft, satellite, or complex communications systems, with experience across both hardware and software domains
- Direct experience with satellite systems and the test venues and infrastructure used to validate RF or optical communications links, including link budget validation, end-to-end signal chain testing, and hardware-in-the-loop environments
- Experience defining and executing system-level test programs spanning development, validation, qualification, and acceptance testing phases
- Familiarity with CI/CD principles and experience integrating hardware and software validation into automated test pipelines
- Sufficient familiarity with network communications standards and protocols to define end-to-end integration test scenarios in collaboration with network engineering teams
- Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries, aligning hardware and software teams around shared test standards and interface validation requirements
- Strong verbal, written, and graphical communication skills

Desired

- 12+ years of experience in system integration and test for satellite or complex communications programs, including experience on LEO constellation programs
- Experience with optical communications link testing including free-space optical terminal validation and atmospheric or link emulation approaches
- Experience with ground terminal integration and test, including validation of space-to-ground link performance and ground-side hardware and software interfaces
- Familiarity with FCC-required radiating test processes and the regulatory compliance context for satellite communications systems
- Experience sizing and specifying major test infrastructure including anechoic chambers, thermal test systems, RF signal simulators, and hardware-in-the-loop environments
- Familiarity with factory acceptance test design for satellite production at scale, including test automation, data management, and anomaly resolution processes

description:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role supports the development and operations of New Glenn, a single-configuration, heavy-lift orbital launch vehicle capable of routinely carrying people and payloads to low-Earth orbit, geostationary transfer orbit, cislunar, and beyond. Its first stage is fully reusable, and the vehicle was designed from the beginning to be human-capable.

As part of a team of engineers and technicians, you will contribute to the test and operation of the New Glenn orbital launch vehicle. You will be responsible for processing your systems, from receipt of the New Glenn stages at the launch site through launch and landing.

You will work with other element teams to develop operational requirements and advocate for design-for-operations. As a test conductor, you will author detailed procedures and help develop test equipment to complete integrated flight systems testing. As a task leader, you will accomplish your assignments by managing a team of technicians and engineers while ensuring the safety of the team and the vehicle. You will help develop and maintain production schedules, quality documents, and engineering.

As a member of the Launch Operations team, you will ensure the launch vehicle and associated ground systems are prepared for flight. To prepare for launch, you will develop ground software requirements, write sequencer code, and help create controller panels. You will have the opportunity to earn certification as a launch controller, ultimately operating your assigned systems on launch day. You will determine and correct anomaly causes, often during time-critical operations. After flight, you will perform data reviews and incorporate process improvements.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Hendrick Autoguard - HICLocation: 6030 East Independence Blvd, Charlotte, North Carolina 28212


Position Summary

The Data Engineer is a mid-level individual contributor responsible for the systems and structures that make Hendrick Autoguard's data reliable, accessible, and useful. This role owns the design and operation of the ingestion pipelines, transformation logic, and data models that serve both business intelligence and AI initiatives.

This is not a role that waits for requirements to arrive fully formed. The Data Engineer is expected to develop a working understanding of how the business operates and to apply that knowledge when making technical decisions. A pipeline that runs on time but models the business incorrectly has not done its job. That distinction sits at the center of this role.

The role works alongside the analysts and BI developers who build reporting on the data platform, the data science and AI teams who use curated data for model development, and the team that administers the underlying cloud infrastructure. The Data Engineer makes sure the data layer serves each of these groups well, so that none of them has to rebuild it for their own use.

What This Role Does

The Data Engineer owns the movement of data from source systems into the Snowflake data platform. In practice that means designing, building, and maintaining ingestion pipelines; orchestrating workflows in Dagster so they are observable, reliable, and operationally sound; and monitoring pipeline health and data availability. When a load fails or data arrives late, the Data Engineer investigates, fixes the underlying cause, and puts alerting in place so the same problem surfaces early next time rather than in a stakeholder's report.

Once data lands, the Data Engineer develops and maintains the dbt transformation models that turn raw source data into clean, tested, and well-documented datasets. That includes designing dimensional models and data marts that support both reporting and machine learning use cases, and implementing data quality checks and testing standards throughout the transformation layer. Downstream consumers should be able to trust a dataset without re-verifying it themselves.

The Data Engineer also prepares data for AI. That work includes structuring feature datasets and training data pipelines, and collaborating with data science and AI teams to make sure the data meets their requirements for quality, freshness, and structure. The Data Engineer contributes to the semantic layer that gives AI and analytics consumers consistent, well-defined access to business metrics and entities, and keeps data lineage and governance in view, since AI applications raise the stakes on knowing where data came from and how it may be used.

The Data Engineer is also expected to advise on the strategic direction of the data engineering toolset, weighing in on platform and feature updates and evaluating new capabilities as they become available. Staying current with best practices and industry advancements in data engineering, AI data preparation, and orchestration is part of the job, not a side interest, and that knowledge should inform how the team's tools and standards evolve over time.

Across all of this work, the Data Engineer builds working knowledge of the Autoguard business processes it supports, including vehicle service contract and protection product sales through dealership partners, claims administration, and cancellations, along with the workflows and decisions that depend on data from those areas. The Data Engineer engages directly with business stakeholders to understand their data needs, translates those needs into sound technical designs, and applies business context when weighing modeling decisions, pipeline priorities, and data quality standards. That knowledge makes each new request faster to scope. It also makes the Data Engineer a useful partner when a team is still working out which question it needs to answer.

Adjacent Competencies

Dashboard and report preparation are not a routine part of this role, and primary ownership of that work belongs to analysts and BI developers. The Data Engineer may occasionally need to support that function, though, whether by building or troubleshooting a report in a pinch or by helping an analyst work through a modeling issue at the source. The Data Engineer's core job is to deliver the modeled, tested data those teams build on, and to work with them when a reporting need exposes a gap in the data layer.

Experience And Qualifications

A candidate for this role has 3–7 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related discipline. They are proficient in SQL and have hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse, a data transformation and modeling framework, and a workflow orchestration tool. Experience with Snowflake, dbt, and Dagster is strongly preferred, as is familiarity with AWS, including storage, IAM, and basic networking concepts.

Preferred experience includes Python for pipeline development or data scripting; exposure to data quality frameworks, data contracts, or observability tooling; supporting ML pipelines or AI data preparation workflows; familiarity with medallion architecture or similar layered data design patterns; and involvement in data governance or data catalog efforts. The current technology environment includes Snowflake, Dagster, dbt, AWS (S3, EC2, and IAM), Python, and GitHub.

Candidates must be able to engage with non-technical stakeholders and translate business needs into technical requirements. Clear written and verbal communication is not optional in this role. The Data Engineer produces model documentation, dataset descriptions, and design notes that analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders rely on. That documentation needs to be accurate, specific, and usable without a follow-up conversation.

Working Conditions

The Data Engineer works on site at Hendrick Automotive Group headquarters in a standard office environment, collaborating in person with technology teams and the business stakeholders this role supports. Travel is minimal, and may be by car or plane. Position is not remote due to essential functions of the job. Position is required to sit for prolonged periods of time, extensive use of computer and related functions like typing and other office equipment used in regular performance of essential functions like phone, printer.

Hendrick is an Equal Opportunity employer. Minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. For more information regarding the EEOC, please visit .

title: Electrical Installation & Wiring Assembler
description:
Gutor is a leading international manufacturer of UPS systems for industrial applications. The company has been in business for over 75 years and has a proven track record of delivering high-quality products and services. Gutor's products are designed to meet the demanding needs of industries such as oil & gas, petrochemical, chemical, nuclear, and transportation. The company also has a global presence with over 600 employees in more than 30 countries and branches in Brazil, China, India, Malaysia, Mexico, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and the U.S.A to name a few.

Gutor is committed to providing its customers with the best possible support. The company has a team of experienced engineers and technicians who are available to help with any problems that may arise.

The Electrical Installation and Wiring Assembler is responsible for installing, routing, and terminating electrical wiring and components for Gutor’s large Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems. This role ensures all electrical assemblies meet engineering specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES


Electrical Assembly & Wiring


  • Install and route wiring harnesses, cables, and connectors according to schematics and wiring diagrams.
  • Terminate wires using crimping, soldering, and connector assembly techniques.
  • Mount electrical components such as circuit breakers, bus bars, and control panels within UPS enclosures.
  • Responsible for in-process quality control

Testing & Quality Assurance


  • Perform continuity checks and insulation resistance tests on wiring assemblies.
  • Verify proper wire labeling, routing, and termination per engineering standards.
  • Ensure compliance with electrical codes, safety regulations, and company quality procedures.

Documentation & reporting


  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and assembly instructions.
  • Complete wiring checklists, test reports, and production documentation accurately.

Collaboration


  • Work closely with mechanical assemblers and test technicians to integrate electrical and mechanical components.
  • Communicate wiring issues or discrepancies to supervisors and engineering teams.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification in electrical assembly preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in electrical wiring or assembly, preferably in industrial or power systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and wiring diagrams.
  • Proficiency with hand tools, crimping tools, and electrical testing equipment (multimeters, insulation testers).
  • Knowledge of electrical safety practices and standards (e.g., NEC, OSHA).
  • Physical ability to handle wiring tasks in large enclosures and stand for extended periods.
  • The position is not eligible for employer-sponsored visa sponsorship now or in the future.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


  • Experience wiring large-scale electrical or power systems.
  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles.
  • Basic understanding of mechanical assembly.
  • Fluency in Spanish.

WORK ENVIRONMENT


  • Manufacturing floor with exposure to electrical components, machinery, and occasional heavy lifting.
  • Requires use of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment).

WHAT WE OFFER


  • The salary range for this position is $25.00-$29.00 USD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications. This is a non-exempt position and is eligible for overtime pay in accordance with applicable laws. Overtime may be required based on business and production needs.

  • Cigna Dental and Vision Insurance
  • FSA and HSA savings account options
  • Basic Life and AD&D Insurance
  • Voluntary supplemental life insurance
  • Health & Fitness Reimbursement

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Erfaren projektleder til kvalitetssikring af to store byggeprojekter på Rybners Klimaerhvervsskole
description:
Kan du tage ansvar for at sikre, at to af vores største og mest visionære byggeprojekter kommer succesfuldt i mål? Og har du blik for både kvalitet, proces og en tryg overlevering til vores egen bygningsafdeling?

Så er du måske vores nye projektleder på Rybners Klimaerhvervsskole.

Om os og jobbet

På Rybners Klimaerhvervsskole uddanner vi fremtidens arbejdskraft til den grønne omstilling på energiområdet. Det skal vores fysiske rammer naturligvis også afspejle. Vi er derfor i gang med at virkeliggøre to store og spændende byggeprojekter, som skal understøtte missionen om at være et nationalt fyrtårn på området.

Projekterne vil været drevet af en totalrådgiver, der står for den daglige projektering og styring. Din opgave bliver ikke at projektere selv, men at være skolens stærke repræsentant og bygherrerådgiver på pladsen.

Du sikrer, at totalrådgiveren leverer i henhold til aftalerne, at tidsplanerne holder, og at kvaliteten lever op til vores standarder. Når byggerierne nærmer sig afslutning, får du en central rolle i at sikre en struktureret og gnidningsfri overgang, så vores egen bygningsafdeling overtager driften af bygningerne optimalt.

Du vil som projektleder også få ansvar for andre bygge- og vedligeholdelsesprojekter på tværs af skolens 4 adresser. Du vil organisatorisk blive en del af skolens bygningsafdeling med reference til Chefen for Campus Service. Du vil i stillingen komme til at samarbejde særdeles tæt med lederen for bygningsafdelingen som varetager alle bygge- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver for skolens samlede bygningsmasse på mere end 80.000 m2.

Dine primære ansvarsområder:

  • Overordnet projektopsyn: Føre tilsyn med at projekter skrider frem som planlagt og overholder budgetter.
  • Modpart for totalrådgiver: Udfordre, sparre med og styre den eksterne totalrådgiver i tæt samarbejde med Rybners' ledelse.
  • Kvalitetssikring: Sikre at udførelsen lever op til de stillede krav, standarder og specifikationer.
  • Aflevering og overdragelse: Lede processen ved afleveringsforretning, mangeludbedring og den endelige overdragelse til vores interne bygningsafdeling.
Vi forventer, at du

  • har en relevant byggefaglig uddannelse (f.eks. bygningskonstruktør eller ingeniør)
  • har solid erfaring med at styre større byggeprojekter og kender byggeriets faser fra A-Z
  • er vant til at arbejde sammen med rådgivere, entreprenører, håndværkere, og samarbejde med interne afdelinger
  • er løsningsorienteret og vedholdende når der opstår udfordringer
  • kan bevare overblikket, træffe beslutninger i rette tid og kommunikere tydeligt på tværs af organisationen
  • arbejder struktureret med kvalitetssikring og afleveringsprocedurer
  • kan tænke bæredygtige, klimavenlige og energirigtige løsninger ind i projekterne.
Vi tilbyder

  • et spændende og selvstændigt job på en dynamisk uddannelsesinstitution i udvikling
  • mulighed for at tage professionelt ejerskab over projektstyringen og kvalitetssikringen på to markante byggeprojekter med fokus på fremtidens rammer
  • en uformel omgangstone og engagerede kolleger med stor faglighed.
Løn- og ansættelsesforhold

Ansættelse sker i henhold til den overenskomst der repræsentere din uddannelse. Bygningskontruktører og ingeniører ansættes i henhold til gældende Cirkulære om overenskomst for Akademikere i staten.

Bygningskonstruktører indplaceres afhængig af erhvervserfaring i lønintervallet kr. 332.306-422.491 årligt. Hertil kommer 18,07% fuldt arbejdsgiverbetalt pension. Der kan desuden være mulighed for at aftale tillæg på baggrund af relevant erfaring og kvalifikationer.

Ingeniører indplaceres afhængig af erhvervserfaring i lønintervallet kr. 340.573-442.529 årligt. Hertil kommer 18,07% fuldt arbejdsgiverbetalt pension. Der kan desuden være mulighed for at aftale tillæg på baggrund af relevant erfaring og kvalifikationer.

Ansættelsesstedet omfatter alle Rybners’ adresser i Esbjerg.

Ansøgning

Hvis du synes, at jobbet lyder spændende, og passer ovennævnte kvalifikationer på dig, kan du søge jobbet ved at klikke på "Søg jobbet" og udfylde skemaet efter den givne anvisning.

På Rybners vil vi gerne modtage ansøgninger elektronisk via vores rekrutteringssystem, da vi ønsker at sikre den bedst mulige og mest effektive behandling af ansøgningerne, herunder at efterleve persondataforordningens krav.

Når du har sendt din ansøgning, modtager du en e-mail som kvittering. Vær opmærksom på at denne e-mail og senere e-mails fra Rybners kan være modtaget i din mappe "uønsket post".

Alle interesserede, uanset personlig baggrund, opfordres til at søge jobbet.

Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 47.

Vil du vide mere?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Chef for Campus Service, Jacob la Cour Søborg på telefon: 51579096 eller e-mail: js@rybners.dk.

title: Flight Dynamics Software Engineer III - Blue Ring
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue National Security (BNS), where our focus is the design, development, and delivery of launch and spacecraft systems for national security missions. Through Blue Ring, our all-in-one, high-powered hybrid solar-electric and chemical-propelled spacecraft, we provide unmatched mission maneuverability, versatility, and capacity at dramatically lower-profile costs.

As part of a hardworking team of engineers and mission operators, you will work closely with space vehicle and ground system teams to develop, test, and deploy the Flight Dynamics System (FDS) — the ground-based astrodynamics software responsible for orbit determination, maneuver planning, collision avoidance, engine commodity tracking, and flight dynamics product generation for Blue Ring spacecraft.


As a Flight Dynamics Software Engineer, you will build and operate the microservices and data pipelines that translate astrodynamics algorithms into production mission-critical systems. You will collaborate directly with the Astrodynamics and Trajectory eXecution (ATX) team and mission operations to ensure Blue Ring vehicles remain safely on orbit.


We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!


Special Mentions

  • Relocation provided
  • Interviews will include a technical assessment

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design, implement, test, verify and deploy FDS microservices supporting orbit maintenance, collision avoidance, engine commodity bookkeeping, and flight dynamics product generation.
  • Work with multiple teams, including engineers from fields like flight vehicle systems, mission control infrastructure, operations subject areas, and customers to define software requirements, architectures, and designs.
  • Translate astrodynamics algorithms developed by the ATX team into production services, working across the boundary between numerical methods and software engineering.
  • Develop rapid prototypes to prove out concepts and quantify technical risks.
  • Coordinate with systems infrastructure and system engineers to plan, develop, and verify, to ensure software products meet requirements and safety-critical standards.
  • Produce user documentation for software architecture, design, verification plans, user manual and training material.
  • Follow software development processes that meet Blue Origin and customer-required standards to ensure software safety and reliability.
  • Support frequent update cycles in support of pre-flight testing, mission validation exercises and operations training events.
  • Support mission control software operations responsibilities (maintenance, defect correction, improvements) during operator training; ground data system verification, validation, and certification; spacecraft integration; and flight.
  • Integrate software components, develop, and run unit-level and system-level tests, validate using Software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop simulators, and release certified code.
  • Support in developing materials for software design, verification plans, user manuals, and training.

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.S. or higher degree in computer engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, aerospace engineering, or related field or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of software development experience.
  • Experience in software engineering over the course of the full lifecycle of software development, including system design and analysis, requirement capture and development, software implementation and verification, system integration, qualification, and release.
  • Experience in software build automation, continuous integration, configuration management, verification, and deployment.
  • Demonstrated software development skills in multiple software languages, with ability to implement in the language most appropriate to the problem-domain.
  • Familiarity with Linux environment and comfortable with basic Unix system administration activities.
  • Ability to earn trust and maintain positive and professional relationships.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and developing ground software for space flight operations.
  • Expertise developing complex applications in Python.
  • Experience with REST, Kafka, GRPC, web development and/or database development and interfaces.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Cloud Technologies.
  • Familiarity with astrodynamics concepts such as orbit determination, maneuver planning, or collision avoidance.
  • Familiarity developing software systems for one or more of the following applications and technologies:
    • Telemetry data processing, fault monitoring, flight dynamics
    • Mission activity planning and scheduling
    • Spacecraft ephemeris generation and dissemination
    • Conjunction data processing and space situational awareness
  • Experience with spacecraft subsystems and associated subsystem software.

title: Leasing Professional- The Ashborough
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION


Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.


Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

#LI-DG3


The hourly range for the position is $21.00 - $23.00


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.
