title: Fuldtidsstilling i salg - Aarhus
description:
Telefonsælger til Vivo Sales nye afdeling i Aarhus

Vil du udvikle dig inden for salg og kommunikation og samtidig blive en del af en arbejdsplads med højt humør, stærkt sammenhold og fokus på personlig udvikling?

Hos Vivo Sales i Aarhus søger vi nye kolleger til vores salgsteam. Du behøver ikke have erfaring med salg i forvejen, det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, udvikle dig og blive dygtigere.

Uanset om du har afsluttet din uddannelse, holder sabbatår eller blot er klar til nye udfordringer, kan stillingen være et godt næste skridt.

Om jobbet

Som telefonsælger hos Vivo Sales kontakter du privatpersoner og rådgiver om a-kasse, fagforening og lønsikring.

Din opgave er at skabe en god og professionel dialog, afdække kundens behov og præsentere de løsninger, der passer til den enkelte.

Du får grundig oplæring i både produkter, salg og samtaleteknik, så du bliver godt klædt på til jobbet. Derfor er tidligere salgserfaring ikke et krav.

Om Vivo Sales

Vivo Sales arbejder med mødebooking og direkte salg og har afdelinger i Vejle, Silkeborg og Aarhus. Vi er omkring 50 medarbejdere på tværs af afdelingerne.

Hos os går faglig udvikling og et godt arbejdsmiljø hånd i hånd. Vi lægger vægt på, at vores medarbejdere trives, udvikler deres kompetencer og samtidig bliver en del af et socialt fællesskab.

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Grundig oplæring og løbende sparring

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for salg og kommunikation

  • Et socialt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger,

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Mulighed for at opbygge værdifuld erfaring med salg, kundedialog og behovsafdækning

  • Sociale arrangementer og aktiviteter, der styrker fællesskabet på tværs af lokationer.

  • Små faste traditioner i hverdagen, blandt andet juice hver torsdag

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Trives med at tale med mange forskellige mennesker

  • Har lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

  • Er engageret og møder på arbejde med en positiv indstilling

  • Motiveres af at arbejde med salg og resultater

  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og stemningen på arbejdspladsen

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, hvad der allerede står på dit CV, men at du har motivationen til at lære og blive dygtig til jobbet.

Praktisk information

Arbejdssted: Toldbodgade 8, st. 8000 Aarhus C
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid
Ansøgning: Via ansøgningslinket på siden

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning til os. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre mere om dig.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på 55 55 64 64 på hverdage mellem kl. 9.00 og 15.00.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: Theatrical Casting Specialist
description:
GROW YOUR CAREER WITH US
At Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH), we know our future success depends on our ability to attract and retain the very best talent. Our brands deliver vacations of a lifetime with innovative product offerings, a high level of service and unique guest experiences aboard each vessel and we’re continually seeking applicants who are passionate about hospitality and committed to being their personal best. As you learn more about our company, we think you will agree that there is no better time than now to become a member of the NCLH family!

APPLY ONLINE
If you’re interested to be considered for this position, please click the blue APPLY button at the top of the page to get started. All candidates must complete an on-line application to be considered.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Work with the Sr. Manager, Theatrical Casting to forecast and plan audition calendars, recruiting tours/conventions, and strategic audition advertising for all Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH) entertainment programs. Network and build strong relationships within these initiatives to enhance and increase NCLH’s profile and reputation within the entertainment industry.
  • Coordinate and attend hiring events domestically and internationally. Seek entertainment personnel, including, but not limited to singers, dancers, gymnasts, actors, and entertainment staff. Identify, record, and organize all audition materials of hirable talent, ensuring they meet the established performance standards of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH).
  • Research new talent pools to supplement the diverse talent required by NCLH entertainment programs. Consistently research and create new ideas to enhance the recruitment process for entertainment programs and productions.
  • Post and distribute clear and timely casting breakdowns through casting outlets and platforms as well as the NCLH Shows & Experiences website.
  • Send offer requests to be sent by Shipboard HR Operations Specialist once talent is approved by Sr. Manager, Theatrical Casting. Ensure offer requests include appropriate position information, role responsibilities, accurate dates, and other key information.
  • Identify brand and product appropriateness, tracking, role assignments, and other casting decisions before presenting talent for approval.
  • Work directly with vendors and audition contractors distributing all required vendor documents and ensuring all onboarding documents are submitted before the start of an audition. Verify all vendor paperwork and invoices are complete before submitting them to Theatrical Casting Management for approval.
  • Maintain communication between cast members, creative team members, Theatrical Operations, Shipboard HR Operations, and Fleet Personnel to ensure talent quality control and professionalism to determine and recommend performer re-hire status.
  • Create and maintain clear audition materials including sheet music accompaniments, audition sheet music/sides, audition music vocalist backing tracks and breakdowns, dance playback material, dance combinations options, and dance combination breakdown video tools when required. Keep all audition materials current and appropriate for the ever-changing project scopes and casting requirements of NCLH’s entertainment programs.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in theater environment as a casting director, stage manager or director/choreographer of production shows.

COMPETENCIES & SKILLS:

  • Must be innovative, creative, and have extensive knowledge related to theatrical talent casting, music, dance, contracts, negotiation, recruiting, personnel management, and marketing.

  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
  • Excellent judgment, delegation and decision-making ability to assess reports from all directions and take appropriate action.

title: Senior Director, Digital Capabilities & Products
description:
Job Description Summary:

The Global Digital Network (GDN) accelerates growth by unlocking The Coca-Cola Company’s competitive advantages through data, technology, and artificial intelligence (AI). Within GDN, Digital Operations delivers capabilities and tools that enable the Public Affairs, Communications, and Sustainability (PACS) team to communicate with proactivity, speed, quality, and consistency across our global organization.


As part of the DPC Digital Experiences team, the Senior Director, Digital PACS Capabilities and Products will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of PACS digital communications. This role blends communications expertise with digital product management and technical fluency, serving as Product Owner for the Global Corporate Website and overseeing a suite of leading-edge digital communications platforms. You will collaborate with PACS, developers, UX teams, architects, analytics specialists, agencies, and technology vendors. By translating business needs into scalable solutions and constructively challenging technical partners, you will ensure impactful and innovative delivery of digital products and programs.


This role offers the exciting opportunity to lead the development of groundbreaking digital/AI capabilities while shaping best practices to drive engagement and measurable business outcomes. Success requires a strategic leader with strong decision-making, a solutions-oriented mindset, and a passion for cultivating immersive, scalable and repeatable programs that empower PACS teams globally. With an action-oriented approach, you will proactively tackle challenges, streamline workflows, and foster trust and alignment across stakeholders. By leveraging tools such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Typeface, Copilot Studio, and Poppulo, you will continuously improve our platforms and products, enabling future-ready communications in an evolving technology landscape.


What You’ll Do in This Role:


  • Set strategy and roadmaps: Partner with PACS to define the strategy and multi-year roadmap for digital communications capabilities, aligned with GDN priorities and PACS business goals.
  • Integrate AI automations: Identify opportunities for AI-driven workflow automation across platforms, define business requirements, and work with GDN technical teams to bring scalable solutions to life.
  • Enable user adoption: Lead global onboarding, training, and change management initiatives that promote user engagement and ensure consistent utilization of the team’s digital tools.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Facilitate coordination between PACS teams, GDN teams, and Operating Units to prioritize, develop, and deliver platform features and enhancements.
  • Optimize investments: Establish criteria and governance for prioritizing investments in tools, features, and use cases, focusing on long-term value while avoiding short-lived trends.
  • Website optimization: Lead efforts to ensure the Global Corporate Website is optimized for both human audiences and large language models (LLMs), prioritizing content relevance, structure, and metadata to enhance discoverability, readability, and machine learning compatibility.
  • Streamline workflows: Design and maintain cross-platform workflows that support efficiency, consistency, and brand alignment across web (AEM), email (Poppulo), and AI-generated (Typeface) channels.
  • Vendor management: Evaluate vendor and agency performance against business objectives, develop data-driven recommendations for renewals or exits, and oversee contract milestones.

Qualifications and Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s Degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in digital product management, program development, publishing platforms, or AI-powered tools within complex global organizations.
  • Proven track record as a Product Owner or Digital Product Manager, including building and managing roadmaps, prioritizing backlogs, defining requirements, and resolving technical debt issues.
  • Demonstrated success designing, launching, and scaling digital capability programs that connect effectively with users and deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in evaluating, deploying, and managing digital communications technologies such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Poppulo, Typeface, Airtable, and emerging AI-enabled tools.

Functional skills:

  • Strong, highly dynamic and engaging communications skills – clear writing style and personable live presentations – that captures attention and builds influence.
  • Ability to translate complex technical ideas into clear, actionable plans for diverse audiences (technical and non-technical).
  • Strong leadership experience in managing cross-functional teams with competing priorities, tight deadlines, and high-stakes decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern web technologies and architecture, including APIs, REST, JSON, GraphQL, component-based design, CDNs, and hybrid CMS configurations.
  • Advanced understanding of UX design, accessibility (WCAG), SEO, Core Web Vitals, responsive design, and performance optimization.
  • Proficiency with enterprise CMS platforms, preferably Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), and knowledge of Adobe’s broader ecosystem (e.g., Adobe Target, Adobe Experience Platform).
  • Working knowledge of front-end coding standards (HTML5, CSS, JavaScript) paired with expertise in digital delivery practices such as version control (Git), integration pipelines (CI/CD), and release management processes.
  • Experience collaborating with creative teams, design systems, and tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud and Figma.
  • Strong grasp of privacy, consent management, cookies, web security, and third-party technology integrations.

description:

In T&O, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels.


Role Overview

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented operational risk professional to join the Consumer Banking Wealth Management Operations (CBWMO) Risk and Control team. The role is responsible for supporting management of operational risk and controls, monitoring key risk indicators, coordinating the follow-up of control issues, and preparing risk and governance information. The successful candidate should bring relevant experience in banking operations, risk management, internal controls, audit, or compliance, together with the ability to work independently and engage effectively with stakeholders.

  • Incident Management: Coordinate fact gathering, impact assessment, root cause analysis, incident documentation, and follow-up of corrective and preventive actions for operational incidents.

  • Reporting & Governance: Compile and update key risk indicators (KRIs), quality metrics, incident records, meeting materials, and routine management reports.

title: Pædagog søges – tæt teamsamarbejde, faglig supervision og mulighed for indflydelse på din vagtplan
description:
Vil du gøre en forskel for seks mennesker med udviklingshandicap – og samtidig være en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, tillid og arbejdsglæde er en vigtig del af hverdagen?

Vi søger en pædagog til 30 timer om ugen til et af husene på Botilbuddet Aage Holms Vej i Hjørring med tiltrædelse den 1. december 2026 eller snarest derefter.

En hverdag, der giver mening

I huset bor seks mennesker med udviklingshandicap, som alle er kørestolsbrugere med andre følgeproblematikker. Vi arbejder hver dag for at skabe en tryg og meningsfuld hverdag, hvor den enkelte bliver mødt med respekt, nærvær og forståelse for sine ønsker, behov og ressourcer.

Som pædagog bliver du en vigtig del af beboernes hverdag. Du er med til at skabe gode relationer, understøtte selvbestemmelse og give den enkelte de bedste muligheder for trivsel og livskvalitet.

Du bliver en del af et mindre team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler vores erfaringer og sammen finder de bedste løsninger for beboerne. Derudover arbejder vi med ”makkerhuse”, hvor hvert hus har en primær ”makker” man arbejder sammen med ved behov.

Her udvikler vi os sammen

Vi prioriterer faglighed og tror på, at vi bliver dygtigere, når vi er nysgerrige på vores egen praksis og lærer af hinanden.

Vi arbejder blandt andet med:

  • Neuropædagogik – som tilgang for at forstå den enkelte og tilpasse vores pædagogiske indsats.
  • Low arousal – som metode hvor ro, tryghed og en konfliktnedtrappende tilgang er i fokus.
  • Visualisering – som metode som støtte til overblik, kommunikation og forudsigelighed.
  • SMARTE mål – som metode til at arbejde systematisk med beboernes trivsel og udvikling.
Vi tilbyder faglig supervision med afsæt i neuropædagogik, hvor vi sammen kan undersøge konkrete situationer, dele perspektiver og udvikle vores faglige tilgange.

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, bidrage med din faglighed og være en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi udvikler os sammen.

Tillid, dialog og arbejdsglæde

Vores kerneværdier er tillid, dialog og arbejdsglæde. De er fundamentet for vores samarbejde og den måde, vi møder både beboere og kolleger på.

Vi ønsker en arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til at stille spørgsmål, dele idéer og tale åbent om det, der lykkes – og det, der er svært. Vi tager fælles ansvar og tror på, at et godt kollegaskab er med til at skabe kvalitet i arbejdet med beboerne.

På Botilbuddet Aage Holms Vej er vi 130 medarbejdere fordelt på otte huse. Du bliver dermed en del af et større fagligt fællesskab med kolleger på tværs af organisationen.

Indflydelse på din egen vagtplan

Vi ved, at et godt arbejdsliv også handler om at få hverdagen til at hænge sammen.

Derfor benytter vi et vagtplanlægningssystem, hvor du kan ønske dine vagter og dermed få indflydelse på din egen vagtplan. Vi forsøger at imødekomme medarbejdernes ønsker samtidig med, at vi sikrer en god hverdag for beboerne.

Vi forestiller os, at du …

  • Er uddannet pædagog og har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker med udviklingshandicap.
  • Møder beboerne med respekt, omsorg og blik for deres ressourcer og selvbestemmelse.
  • Er nysgerrig på din faglighed og har lyst til at reflektere over din praksis.
  • Trives med både selvstændige opgaver og tæt teamsamarbejde.
  • Har lyst til at indgå i personlig pleje og sundhedsfaglige opgaver.
  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og arbejdsglæden.
Erfaring fra handicapområdet er en fordel, men din motivation og lyst til faglig udvikling er mindst lige så vigtig.

Praktisk information

Stilling: Pædagog, 30 timer om ugen
Arbejdstider: Skiftende dag- og aftenvagter
Weekendvagt: Hver anden weekend i ulige uger
Tiltrædelse: 1. december 2026 eller snarest derefter

Qualification & Start-Up

  • Support Installation Qualification (IQ) execution, and lead Operational Qualification (OQ) and Performance Qualification (PQ) activities for liquid filling operations.
  • Coordinate production start-up sequencing across liquid filling lines and packaging interfaces.
  • Own process validation and fill accuracy verification for liquid filling operations.
  • Drive closure of deviations and punch-list items identified during qualification and start-up for liquid filling operations.

SOP Development, Training & Capability Building

  • Own development of liquid filling SOPs, work instructions, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Lead preparation of liquid filling operational training materials.
  • Lead Train-the-Trainer activities for liquid filling operations.
  • Drive operator capability for liquid filling during start-up and ramp-up phases.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Drive implementation of best practices for liquid filling operations.
  • Lead benchmarking and improvement initiatives for liquid filling operations.
  • Own delivery of improvements in liquid filling line efficiency, quality performance, and operational reliability.
  • Build and reinforce a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence within liquid filling operations.

Qualifications / Requirements

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in manufacturing or production operations within beverage, food, FMCG, pharmaceutical, or related industries.
  • Hands-on experience in filling, packaging, bottling, or production operations.
  • Experience working in a manufacturing environment with automated production equipment.

Preferred

  • Experience with beverage filling, bottling, or packaging operations.
  • Experience supporting production start-ups, new line installations, or operational improvement projects.
  • Experience with SAP PE, MES, or manufacturing systems.
  • Experience in highly automated manufacturing environments and in coordinating cross-functional or vendor teams.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Food Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Equivalent depth of manufacturing operations experience may be considered.

Technical Knowledge

  • Solid understanding of liquid filling and packaging operations.
  • Working knowledge of process control and line automation interfaces, material traceability, and manufacturing workflows.
  • Knowledge of production performance metrics including OEE, downtime, waste, and productivity measures.
  • Sound understanding of GMP, food safety, and quality systems.
  • Basic knowledge of qualification and validation processes (IQ, OQ, PQ) and change control.

Skills

  • Strong ownership, accountability, and ability to drive activities to closure with minimal supervision.
  • Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to align and work effectively with cross-functional teams, contractors, and equipment vendors.
  • Strong planning and organizational skills, with high attention to detail and operational discipline.
  • Ability to master new processes, equipment, and systems quickly and transfer that knowledge to others.
  • Positive, hands-on, and proactive approach, with resilience in a fast-paced project environment.

Language

  • Business-level English proficiency.
  • Ability to communicate and present effectively with global project and leadership teams.

IT Skills

  • Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Working proficiency with SAP PE, MES, CIMO, and manufacturing systems.
  • Familiarity with digital manufacturing and data analytics tools is advantageous.

Organizational Impact

  • Secure successful readiness and start-up of liquid filling operations for Project Nuri.
  • Safeguard product quality and fill consistency across production runs.
  • Establish standardized operating procedures, changeover governance, and workforce capability for liquid filling operations.
  • Lead liquid filling stabilization, process performance, and operational and performance qualification, and support installation qualification and commissioning activities.
  • Contribute to Project Nuri's vision of highly automated, digitally enabled, and operationally excellent manufacturing operations.

Location

  • The primary work location is Korea.
  • Domestic and international travel may be required during Detail Design, FAT/SAT, and operational readiness phases.
  • Travel frequency will vary depending on project phase and operational readiness requirements.

title: Retail Key Holder
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Key Holder, better known as a “Floor Leader,” at Skechers, you’ll take on an essential Retail Leadership Role, contributing to store operations and mentoring your team to deliver exceptional customer service. In this entry-level management role, you’ll oversee daily operations, support sales goals, and help maintain the store's premium shopping environment. Whether you're looking to advance your Retail Manager career, refine your skills as a Key Holder, or grow into a Retail Management role, this opportunity offers room to thrive within the Skechers global brand.

COMPENSATION RATE

STARTING RATE: $17.32

BENEFIT HIGHLIGHTS:

  • Competitive pay with regular increases.
  • Generous discounts on Skechers footwear, apparel, and accessories (including exclusive Friends and Family discounts!).
  • Flexible schedules to support work-life balance.
  • On-the-job training to strengthen skills in Retail Leadership Roles, Customer Service Management, and store operations.
  • Opportunities for career advancement in Retail Management with a global brand like Skechers.
  • Additional Benefits & Perks to be reviewed during the interview process.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Customer Service Management: Engage with customers to deliver expert advice on Skechers products, ensuring every shopper leaves with the perfect fit and great experience.
  • Retail Leadership Role: Supervise daily operations, including store opening and closing procedures as required, ensuring security protocols and excellent operational standards.
  • Team Leadership: Mentor and support team members to grow their skills in entry-level retail that include customer service, sales, and daily operations.
  • Sales and Goals: Actively contribute to achieving store and individual sales targets by implementing effective selling techniques and promoting key Skechers products.
  • Store Operations: Execute merchandising plans, restock products, and maintain store cleanliness to enhance the shopping environment.
  • Retail Supervisor Duties: Oversee stock and inventory routines while collaborating with store management to address operational needs.
  • Problem Solving: Proactively identify and resolve in-store challenges to ensure a smooth shopping experience for customers.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU:

  • Ability to work a varied schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Problem solving skills to resolve any issues that may arise in-store.
  • Highly organized to manage inventory, staffing, and other operational tasks.
  • Ability and desire to foster a respectful, safe, and fun environment for Skechers store employees.
  • Comfortable mentoring team members and communicating with all levels of the store team.
  • Acts with a sense of confidentiality and urgency.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.
  • Previous experience as a Key Holder, Shift Leader, or Retail Supervisor in retail, restaurant, or hospitality industry is preferred but not required.
  • Sales skills to drive revenue growth and meet targets.
  • Excellent communication skills in written, verbal and interpersonal skills.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age at time of application.

Step into your next retail career with Skechers!

About Skechers

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.


Equal Employment Opportunity
Skechers is committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and respectful work environment. Skechers provides equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment without regard race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic established by local, state or federal law.

Applicants for employment who require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job should request appropriate accommodation by emailing benefits@skechers.com.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each job responsibility satisfactorily. The skills, abilities and physical demands described are representative of those duties that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. title: Clinical Pharmacy Specialist | Neuro-Oncology
description:
About Us:

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

Exciting Opportunity at MSK: Our Clinical Pharmacy team is looking for a Neuro-Oncology Clinical Pharmacy Specialist to join our team!

Role Overview:

The Pharmacy Specialist is the designated hospital-wide expert in the area of clinical pharmacy and directly provides leadership for the continued growth of comprehensive clinical pharmacy services. The Clinical Pharmacy Specialist plays an integral role as the therapeutic resource for drug information and pharmacotherapy of their service’s patients. The position is also responsible for the division's educational and quality improvement programs.

As a Clinical Pharmacy Specialist at Memorial Sloan Kettering, you will have the opportunity to play a critical role in our fight to conquer cancer alongside clinicians who are internally and externally recognized as leaders in multiple fields. Our belief in unifying basic science with clinical investigations, collaboration across all department levels, and most importantly, the unmatched dedication and compassion of our staff has resulted in Memorial Sloan Kettering being named among the elite hospitals for cancer care in the nation, according to the U.S. News & World Report listing of Best Hospitals.

The Pharmacy Department utilizes a multidisciplinary approach to patient care, where the emphasis is on therapeutic efficacy and safety. We provide comprehensive, clinical and dispensing services in both inpatient and ambulatory care settings through a decentralized satellite pharmacy services model.

We are looking for a confident, independent individual to join our Neuro-Oncology Pharmacy Specialist team. In this role, you will serve as a fully integrated member of the inpatient neuro-oncology service and ambulatory clinic to provide advanced clinical pharmacy services, including:

  • Drug therapy design and monitoring, patient medication counseling, and participation in Collaborative Drug Therapy Management (CDTM)
  • Committee participation and development of treatment guidelines and pharmacy policies
  • Preceptorship of PGY2 Pharmacy residents and pharmacy students
  • Education of hospital staff through Grand Rounds presentations and in-service training

Key Qualifications:

  • Doctorate in Pharmacy, Oncology experience preferred
  • NYS license (or eligibility)
  • Completion of an ASHP-accredited pharmacy practice residency and an ASHP-accredited oncology residency, or equivalent experience are required.

Core Skills:

  • A confirmed, dynamic leader and creative problem solver.
  • Self-motivated and driven for excellency.
  • A collaborator and contributor for team integration.
  • Passionate about working in a state-of-the-art institution.
  • Continually striving to increase your knowledge and expertise in clinical pharmacy.

Additional Information:

  • Regular hours of work fall between Monday - Friday, 37.5 hours per week
  • Flexibility may be required depending upon the needs of the department
  • The inpatient service is located at 1275 York Avenue, and outpatient clinic is located at the Rockefeller Outpatient Pavilion (160 E 53rd Street)
  • Reporting into: Manager, Oncology Clinical Pharmacy

Please submit a statement of interest along with your CV to this application.

title: Vil du være en del af Forsvarets nervecenter? Bliv Kommunikationscenteroperatør i København – og spil en nøglerolle i Danmarks militære kommunikation.
description:
Vil du være en del af Forsvarets nervecenter?

Bliv Kommunikationscenteroperatør i København – og spil en nøglerolle i Danmarks militære kommunikation.

Vi leder efter nye kolleger til vores vagtteam i FKO COMMCEN KBH. Her sidder du midt i det digitale maskinrum og sørger for, at vigtig kommunikation når frem – hurtigt, sikkert og præcist. Det er ikke bare "en stilling". Det er en funktion, der binder hele Forsvaret sammen – nationalt og internationalt.

Hvad går jobbet ud på?

Du bliver en del af et hold, der har døgnbemanding, og som arbejder med klassificerede kommunikationssystemer og militære netværk.

Du kommer til at overvåge, sende og modtage kritiske informationer mellem ministerier, Forsvarets myndigheder, styrelser og ambassader.

Det er her, du kan mærke, at dit arbejde har en reel betydning – hver eneste dag.

Hvem er du?

  • Du er udnævnt konstabel eller civil og trives med at tage ansvar.
  • Du har måske erfaring som radio-, konsol- eller O-rumsoperatør – eller fra en anden teknisk beredskabsfunktion.
  • Du brænder ikke nødvendigvis for it – men du er nysgerrig, og du vil gerne lære.
  • Du arbejder godt både alene og sammen med andre, og du forstår, at præcision og pålidelighed er afgørende.
  • Du kan begå dig på både dansk og engelsk, og du er klar til at tage på kursus i Danmark og udlandet.

Vi sørger for resten

Du behøver ikke være CIS-ekspert fra start. Vi uddanner dig løbende – både i København og via nationale og NATO-kurser. Du lærer desuden det hele gennem ”on the job training”, og vi klæder dig grundigt på til at løse opgaverne.

Hvad kan du forvente?

  • Skiftende vagter med stabil turnus.
  • Mulighed for videreuddannelse og udvikling.
  • En stilling i frontlinjen af Forsvarets digitale infrastruktur.
  • At blive en del af en sektion, hvor det gode kollegiale fællesskab prioriteres højt og hvor vi værner om det gode arbejdsmiljø og det stærke sammenhold.

Alle stillinger ved COMMCEN KBH er værnsfælles militære eller civile stillinger, idet det tilstræbes, at sammensætningen af COMMCEN indeholder både civile og militære færdigheder.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er slået op både dcivilt og militært.

For militære ansøgere gælder følgende: Stillingen er en konstabelstilling på overenskomstmæssige vilkår. Stillingen kan besættes med en tjenestemand. Løn m.v. er, afhængig af værnstilknytning, reguleret ved den til enhver tid gældende LC/CO10-fællesoverenskomst og organisationsaftale mellem Forsvarsministeriets Personalestyrelse, CO10 og Centralforeningen for Stampersonel for stampersonel af linjen og reserven samt elever i Forsvarsministeriet med tilhørende myndigheder, eller mellem Forsvarets Personeltjeneste og Hærens Konstabel- og Korporal forening for konstabelgruppen af linjen og reserven, konstabelelever og korporaler af linjen og reserven i Hæren.

Dette er et åbent stillingsopslag, hvorfor ansættelsessamtaler kan blive afholdt løbende. Stillingerne er ledige, så ansættelsen kan ske efter aftale.

Dit faste tjenestested vil være i København.

Som ansat i Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforløbet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Du skal være opmærksom på, at der knytter sig fysiske og funktionsrelaterede helbredsmæssige krav til stillingen.

I stillingen er du til enhver tid forpligtet til at kunne opfylde de helbredsmæssige og fysiske krav, der er fastsat for funktionen – her A2 som betyder, at du skal kunne helbredsgodkendes til tjeneste i Danmark, nord + vest Europa, samt sejlads i danske farvande og Østersøen.

KONTAKT OG ANSØGNING

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte leder for COMMCEN KBH OS Ralph Aa. Ryding på mail FKO-O-J6LDKO@mil.dk eller telefon 7284 0611 eller mobil 2167 5498.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, kan du kontakte HR-konsulent oversergent Christian Terp ved Personelkommandoen på mail PKOM-CTN@mil.dk

Såfremt du er omfattet af en lokal tjenesteplan eller er udpeget til deltagelse i internationale operationer, skal du gøre opmærksom på dette i din ansøgning.

title: Food Safety and Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

  • CURRENT PENN STATE EMPLOYEE (faculty, staff, technical service, or student), please login to Workday to complete the internal application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

  • CURRENT PENN STATE STUDENT (not employed previously at the university) and seeking employment with Penn State, please login to Workday to complete the student application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

  • If you are NOT a current employee or student, please click “Apply” and complete the application process for external applicants.

Approval of remote and hybrid work is not guaranteed regardless of work location. For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see Notice to Out of State Applicants.

​

POSITION SPECIFICS​

Housing and Food Services at Penn State is seeking a highly motivated Food Safety & Quality Assurance Specialist to lead and maintain comprehensive food safety, allergen management, food defense, and quality assurance programs supporting Penn State Bakery and Warehouse operations.


This position plays a critical role in ensuring products are safe, consistently produced, meet regulatory requirements, and exceed customer expectations. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with bakery production, warehouse operations, purchasing, and leadership teams to develop, implement, and continuously improve food safety and quality systems.


Key Responsibilities


Food Safety, Food Defense & Regulatory Compliance

  • Develop, implement, and maintain HACCP plans, Preventive Controls programs, and other food safety documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local food safety regulations.
  • Establish and monitor Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), sanitation standards, allergen controls, and food safety procedures.
  • Conduct routine food safety inspections and maintain required records and documentation.
  • Support regulatory inspections, third-party audits, and compliance reviews.
  • Monitor changes in food safety regulations and communicate impacts to operations.
  • Develop and maintain Food Defense and Food Security programs, including vulnerability assessments, access controls, visitor management, and mitigation strategies.
  • Coordinate food defense training and maintain food defense plans.

Quality Assurance & Product Compliance

  • Establish and maintain finished product specifications and quality standards.
  • Investigate quality concerns, perform root cause analyses, and oversee corrective actions.
  • Create, review, and maintain compliant product labels.
  • Verify ingredient statements, allergen declarations, nutritional information, and other required labeling elements.
  • Evaluate formulation, ingredient, supplier, and packaging changes for food safety, regulatory, and quality impacts.
  • Support new product launches and process improvements.

Allergen Management

  • Develop and oversee allergen control programs for Bakery and Warehouse operations.
  • Implement procedures to prevent allergen cross-contact.
  • Verify cleaning, sanitation, and product changeover procedures.
  • Collaborate with production teams to develop allergen-conscious scheduling practices.
  • Maintain ingredient specifications and allergen information within menu management systems.
  • Deliver allergen awareness training to employees.

Sanitation & Environmental Monitoring

  • Develop and monitor sanitation procedures, schedules, and verification programs.
  • Oversee environmental monitoring and testing activities.
  • Verify cleaning and sanitizing effectiveness for facilities, equipment, and food-contact surfaces.
  • Monitor temperature controls, cold chain management, and storage requirements.
  • Investigate temperature deviations and coordinate corrective actions.
  • Manage pest control programs and verify completion of preventive measures.

Auditing, Traceability & Recall Readiness

  • Develop audit schedules, inspection tools, and compliance tracking systems.
  • Conduct internal food safety and quality audits.
  • Maintain documentation required for regulatory compliance and audit readiness.
  • Develop and test traceability and recall programs.
  • Conduct mock recalls and evaluate system effectiveness.
  • Support product holds, recalls, investigations, and disposition decisions.

Supplier & Ingredient Quality

  • Support supplier evaluation and approval processes.
  • Review Certificates of Analysis (COAs), supplier documentation, specifications, and food safety records.
  • Monitor ingredient and packaging quality and resolve supplier quality concerns.
  • Coordinate corrective actions and supplier follow-up activities when necessary.

Training & Leadership Support

  • Develop and deliver food safety, quality, sanitation, allergen, and GMP training programs.
  • Maintain training records and support employee development.
  • Coach employees and supervisors on food safety and quality expectations.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and resource for food safety and quality-related questions.
  • Provide operational and supervisory support for Bakery and Warehouse operations as needed.
  • Act as a liaison between quality assurance, production teams, warehouse operations, and leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Animal Science, Microbiology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and four years of relevant experience.
  • ServSafe Certification.
  • Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining food safety and quality management systems.
  • Experience conducting audits and managing corrective and preventive action programs.
  • Knowledge of FSMA Preventive Controls for Human Food requirements.
  • Knowledge of food allergen regulations and labeling requirements.
  • Experience with food labeling, ingredient declarations, and nutritional compliance.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively train, coach, and influence employees at all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across production, warehouse, culinary, purchasing, and leadership teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServSafe Instructor Certification.
  • Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) Certification.
  • Experience in bakery, food manufacturing, food production, or warehouse operations.
  • Experience with environmental monitoring, microbiological testing, and food defense programs.
  • Experience managing Certificates of Analysis (COAs) and supplier quality programs.

What You'll Bring

  • A passion for food safety and quality excellence.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to balance regulatory compliance with operational effectiveness.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement and risk mitigation.
  • Leadership skills that foster accountability, collaboration, and employee engagement.

At Penn State Housing and Food Services, you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on food safety, quality, and customer satisfaction while supporting one of the nation's leading university dining programs. You'll work alongside dedicated professionals committed to innovation, operational excellence, and delivering exceptional products and services to the Penn State community

MINIMUM EDUCATION, WORK EXPERIENCE & REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS

Bachelor's Degree
3+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience accepted
Required Certifications:
None

Welcome to The Coca-Cola Company, where we are not just a beverage company, but a global institution that cherishes innovation and leadership. We are on the lookout for a seasoned Director of Finance with a sharp focus on Financial Planning and Analysis. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker that is ready to guide our fiscal operations and contribute to our rich legacy of success and industry leadership. About the Role

  • Leading the Financial Planning & Analysis team in the development and monitoring of annual revenue/expense budgets and measuring annual operating results.

title: Transmission Forester Assoc- Sr
description:
Job Posting End Date

Job Summary

Assign and recommend industry accepted management practices to provide corrective control of non-compatible vegetation conditions in utility rights of way to vegetation control contractors; inspect ongoing and completed assignments to assure contract compliance to reduce preventable vegetation interruptions of service and to provide, as much as practical, access to facilities for the purpose of repair and inspection.

Job Description

This posting represents a role which can be filled at multiple levels. The description below shows the requirements for the Transmission Forester Associate (SG5) with increased requirements for the Transmission Forester (SG6) and Transmission Forester Sr (SG7) level.

Job Description


The Transmission Forester Associate is responsible for assigning and recommending industry accepted management practices to provide corrective control of non-compatible vegetation conditions in utility rights of way to vegetation control contractors. This involves inspecting ongoing and completed assignments to assure contract compliance to reduce preventable vegetation interruptions of service and to provide, as much as practical, access to facilities for the purpose of repair and inspection. This role will also ensure compliance with FAC-003, actively oversee vegetation clearing for capital construction, and perform aerial patrols as required for FAC-003 compliance or reliability.

What you’ll do:

  • After training, ground patrol lines and facilities to assess vegetative conditions and recommend utility vegetation operations, maintain records of work, and make the necessary arrangements with landowners for vegetation management and access to facilities.
  • After training, perform aerial patrol on FAC-003 compliance lines to assess vegetation to conductor distances, actively capture conditions in forestry computers during aerial patrol, and coordinate any required response for imminent threats identified during the patrol.
  • Investigate and resolve landowner issues and concerns; document and resolve areas where FAC-003 vegetation management plan is constrained.
  • With assistance, estimate vegetation management requirements and costs for construction and rebuilding of new and existing facilities.
  • With assistance, determine future utility vegetation management requirements and recommend short and long-term vegetation management work plans and best management practices.
  • Contact governmental agencies, other utilities, landowners, and others to arrange and coordinate right-of-way vegetation management work plans required.
  • Inspect vegetation management and work planning contractors for safety and contract compliance, recommending acceptance or corrective action.
  • With assistance, recommend work plans, priorities, schedules, and contractor requirements in accordance with the vegetation management program and FAC-003 compliance.
  • Apply and keep informed of current contract provisions.
  • Maintain records and prepare reports on costs, production, and work quality. Operate the forestry computer programs and records systems
  • Guide and train others involved with the vegetation management program in proper work practices and utility vegetation management procedures.
  • With assistance, identify and schedule aerial herbicide and aerial saw vegetation management.

What we’re looking for:

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in forestry, Urban Forestry, Natural Resource Management, Arboriculture, or a related field and two (2) years of experience as a contract utility forester desired, OR
  • Associate’s degree in one of the same fields and four (4) years’ experience in utility vegetation management industry, OR;
  • High school diploma and six (6) years as a contract forester or other related positions in the utility industry.

License & Certificates:

  • Knowledge and safe use of pesticides required.
  • Arborist certification is desirable.
  • Possession of Certified Pesticide Applicator's license is desirable for each state within the forester’s area of responsibility.
  • International Society of Arboriculture (ISA) certification required or can obtain within two years of employment.
  • Completion of an “in the wires zone” aerial patrol course within one year of employment.

Additional Requirements

  • Must act as a professional, employing a great deal of diplomacy to "sell" the Company's necessary vegetation control projects to the public.
  • Courses in horticulture and/or vegetation management are desirable.
  • Competency in GIS systems and Microsoft Office components such as: Access, Excel,
  • PowerPoint and Word in addition to other analytical tools are required.
  • Extensive travel is required to inspect and plan for the Company's right-of-way maintenance program.


What you’ll get:

title: Strategic Planner
description:
Mb Solutions seeks a Strategic Planner to support planning, programming, and resourcing efforts that enable Army Materiel Command to deliver critical insight into emerging sustainment and logistics requirements, including installations, AORs, and training exercises, as well as strategic, operational, and sustainment initiatives. The Strategic War Planner will help ensure AMC meets key suspense requirements for Secretary of the Army (SA)/Chief of Staff of the Army (CSA) updates by identifying and supporting mitigation of risks and impacts tied to HQs AMC Sustainable Readiness Module (SRM) mission planning and execution, while also providing support to the Army Readiness Synchronization Update (ARSU).

Key Responsibilities

  • Support AMC strategic planning efforts to translate emerging ASCC requirements into actionable planning, programming, and resourcing recommendations.
  • Ensure compliance with SA/CSA suspense timelines, including timely development and coordination of updates, risks, and impact assessments.
  • Provide analysis and planning support for HQs AMC SRM mission and the ARSU process, including:
    • Coordination of plans/activities across stakeholders
    • Identification of risks, gaps, and required support capabilities
    • Tracking execution impacts and necessary adjustments
  • Evaluate emerging strategic conditions and rapidly assess effects on AMC priorities, footprint, and resource shifts.
  • Conduct deliberate planning and crisis action planning (CAP) cycles to inform AMC readiness and sustainment posture.
  • Analyze national strategy, Joint doctrine, COCOM posture statements, and OPLANs/CONPLANs to identify AMC equities, risks, and capability requirements.
  • Support enterprise-level improvement by evaluating the effectiveness of:
    • Policies, programs, missions, functions
    • Staffing and organizational workload
  • Provide broad, interdisciplinary strategic analysis at the Army Service Component Command (ASCC) or Combatant Command (CCMD) level.
  • Support senior leader decision-making by communicating complex strategic issues clearly and recommending courses of action.

Required Qualifications

title: Software Engineering Manager, AI Platforms
description:
Job Description Summary:

The Manager, AI-Augmented Platform Engineering is a hands-on engineering manager responsible for the day to day delivery, quality and reliability of a MarTech , Customer & Commercial platform or major component within a larger product line such as CDS or GAM. Reporting to the Director, MarTech , Customer & Commercial Product Development, this leader runs a focused engineering team, stays close to the code, and brings AI-native practices into how the team builds, tests, secures and operates the platform. The role pairs strong execution with people leadership, turning the product roadmap into shipped, dependable software that delivers business value.

What You’ll Do for Us:

  • Lead the engineering and delivery of a MarTech , Customer & Commercial platform or component (for example, a service within CDS or GAM), owning sprint execution, quality, reliability and on-time delivery.
  • Manage and grow a focused engineering team of 6 to 10 engineers across in house and strategic vendor talent, providing coaching, feedback and day to day technical direction.
  • Stay hands on: contribute to design, code review and troubleshooting, and step in to help the team in a crunch.
  • Drive AI-augmented engineering: adopt agentic and AI-assisted development to lift team velocity and quality while keeping human oversight and code-review rigor.
  • Deliver high quality engineering for consumer experiences (websites, web services, apps) and MarTech , Customer & Commercial & AdTech platform features, working within Owned Platforms, Adobe Marketing Cloud, DAM, and related tools.
  • Implement modern data patterns: extend the stack beyond SQL and NoSQL to vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) where they improve personalization, search and grounded AI features.
  • Build for AI-era security and trust: design for prompt injection, data poisoning and model hallucination alongside traditional application security, with clear guardrails.
  • Own platform reliability and cost: apply SRE/SLO practices, CI/CD automation, observability, and AI cost discipline such as token-overhead management and semantic caching.
  • Translate the Director's roadmap into clear, executable engineering plans, and report status, progress, risks and dependencies to leadership and stakeholders.
  • Partner with Product Management, Data Services and cross functional teams to deliver against shared outcomes, not just task completion.
  • Coach the next generation of engineering talent, setting standards for technical excellence, ownership and continuous learning.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in software engineering, including at least 2+ years leading or managing engineers, with hands-on delivery of consumer-facing digital apps or enterprise MarTech , Customer & Commercial components. A builder at heart who stays close to the code.
  • Delivery ownership: proven track record shipping high quality software on time within an agile / Product Operating Model, accountable for quality, reliability and outcomes.
  • Team leadership: experience managing or leading small engineering teams, including a mix of in house and vendor talent, with a focus on coaching and growth.
  • AI-native engineering (preferred): hands-on familiarity with agentic and AI-assisted development, LLM integration and RAG patterns, vector databases, and the security (prompt injection, data poisoning) and cost (token FinOps, semantic caching) disciplines the AI-native stack requires.
  • Cloud & DevOps depth: strong technical skills with public/private cloud (AWS or Azure) and DevOps methodologies, including CI/CD pipelines for test, build and deployment automation.
  • MarTech , Customer & Commercial / AdTech familiarity: working knowledge of the MarTech , Customer & Commercial ecosystem, including 1st party consumer data and consumer identity resolution concepts.
  • Communication: clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical topics to product, business and vendor partners.
  • Leadership style: an inspiring, hands-on leader who builds team trust, drives collaboration, and balances delivery speed with engineering quality.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science or related field required. Equivalent combination of relevant education, training and demonstrated experience also considered.

Skills: Platform Engineering · Agentic / AI-Augmented Development · RAG & Vector Databases · Cloud (AWS/Azure) · DevOps/CI-CD · SRE & Reliability · AI Security & Guardrails · AI Cost / FinOps · 1st Party Data Concepts · Agile Delivery · Team Coaching

title: Business Office Representative
description:
**Starting wage is based upon applicable years of experience towards the role**

General Purpose: The Business Office Representative is responsible for supporting all aspects of the hospital revenue cycle, including patient financial services, insurance claims processing, reimbursement follow-up, collections, and customer service. This position works collaboratively with patients, providers, clinical departments, and insurance payers to ensure timely claim submission, accurate reimbursement, and resolution of patient accounts. The Business Office Representative maintains a thorough understanding of Critical Access Hospital (CAH) billing and reimbursement guidelines while providing exceptional customer service and maintaining compliance with federal, state, and payer regulations.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Answer patient billing questions and explain patient financial responsibility.
  • Make first statement and collection calls on outstanding patient balances.
  • Establish and maintain patient payment plans according to hospital policy.
  • Discuss available payment options, including Patient Financial Assistance and Medicaid eligibility.
  • Assist patients in completing Financial Assistance applications and obtaining required documentation.
  • Collect and process patient payments.
  • Prepare and reconcile daily deposits according to hospital cash handling policies.
  • Update and verify patient demographic and insurance information within Athenahealth.
  • Document all patient communications and account activity in Athenahealth.
  • Work assigned claim worklists within Athenahealth.
  • Review, research, and resolve claim edits, claim holds, denials, and rejected claims.
  • Research patient accounts to ensure balances are accurate before collection activity.
  • Resolve billing discrepancies through collaboration with ER Registration, Coding, and Clinical Departments.
  • Process appropriate account adjustments in accordance with hospital policy.
  • Assist with credit balance resolution.

  • Recommend accounts for outside collection agency placement according to hospital policy.

  • Maintain thorough documentation of all account activity within Athenahealth.

  • Follow up on all contract accounts.

  • Coordinate with the remote Business Office to resolve claim, billing, reimbursement, and account issues.

  • Submit authorizations for inpatient, outpatient and swing bed services.

  • Maintain Extended Care Facility (ECF) billing records and supporting documentation.

  • Work the refund worklist and process approved patient and insurance refunds in accordance with hospital policy.

    Other Duties/Responsibilities: Performs other duties as assigned by the manager. Identifies organization problems and opportunities for improvement and brings solutions and suggestions to supervisor’s attention.

    Experience: 3 - 5 years of healthcare revenue cycle experience is required, with Critical Access Hospital (CAH) business office experience strongly preferred. Experience should include healthcare billing, patient financial services, insurance claims processing, collections, and utilization review/authorizations.

Knowledge, Skills, and Ability: Must be able to read, write, and understand English and communicate effectively with patients, staff, providers, insurance representatives, and other healthcare professionals. Requires a strong knowledge of hospital revenue cycle operations, including Critical Access Hospital (CAH) reimbursement principles, Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, commercial insurance, Workers' Compensation billing, claim processing, denial management, patient collections, and financial counseling. Must be proficient in Athena Practice Management and Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, Microsoft Office applications (including Excel), payer portals, and electronic remittance advice (ERA). The ability to accurately interpret Explanation of Benefits (EOBs), determine payer reimbursement, contractual adjustments, denials, and patient responsibility is essential. Knowledge of the Wyoming Medicaid application process, including assisting patients with eligibility and application completion, is highly recommended. Must be able to obtain and track inpatient, outpatient, and swing bed authorizations through payer portals. Strong customer service, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills are required, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, maintain confidentiality, and comply with hospital policies and HIPAA regulations.

Working Environment: Working in a healthcare setting requires a high level of confidentiality, accuracy, and professionalism. This position involves frequent patient interaction by phone and in person, coordination with clinical staff, extended periods of computer and phone use, and adherence to hospital policies and patient-centered care standards.

Applies intermediate subject-matter knowledge to resolve a variety of common and moderately complex technical issues. Works independently within established practices, procedures, and policies. Provides informed team input and limited project-direction support.

Om stillingen

Som kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder får du ansvar for den løbende kvalitetssikring af vores hjemmeplejeruter i de 10 kommuner, vi samarbejder med.

Dit arbejde vil bl.a. bestå i at besøge borgere og medarbejdere, hvor du gennem observationer, dialog og faglige vurderinger følger op på, om hjælpen svarer til borgernes aktuelle behov og vores faglige standarder. Du taler med borgerne om deres oplevelse af hjælpen med fokus på tryghed, kontinuitet og sammenhæng i plejen.

Du ser samtidig på, om ruter, tidsforbrug og arbejdsgange er tilrettelagt hensigtsmæssigt. Her får du adgang til relevante økonomiske og driftsmæssige nøgletal, som du sammenholder med dine observationer for at finde afvigelser og muligheder for forbedringer.

Du kan således se frem til en selvstændig hverdag, hvor du bruger din faglige erfaring til at komme med konkrete forbedringsforslag, så vi bruger vores tid og ressourcer bedst muligt og samtidig imødekommer borgernes behov og overholder de faglige krav.

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen, hvor cirka 80% af arbejdstiden er udekørende og 20% er administrativ.

Dine primære ansvarsområder:

  • Følge op på og kontrollere kvaliteten på dag- og aftenruter, borgernes tilfredshed og sammenhængen i plejen
  • Vurdere, om hjælpen fortsat svarer til borgerens behov, og sammen med de ansvarlige følge op, hvis der er behov for at få visiteringen revurderet
  • Undersøge og dokumentere om ruterne er planlagt hensigtsmæssigt i forhold til opgaver, tidsforbrug, transport og medarbejderressourcer
  • Bruge økonomiske og driftsmæssige nøgletal til at følge op på, om de ressourcer, vi bruger, svarer til den hjælp, vi er visiteret og honoreret til at levere
  • Samarbejde med områdeledere og faglige koordinatorer om forbedringer og følge op på, om de har den ønskede effekt

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent eller social- og sundhedshjælper
  • Har solid erfaring fra hjemmeplejen og kender den praktiske hverdag i en udekørende funktion
  • Er fagligt stærk, selvstændig og har et godt blik for kvalitet i den daglige pleje
  • Har forståelse for sammenhængen mellem visitation, planlægning, borgernes behov og en økonomisk ansvarlig drift
  • Har flair for tal og kan bruge relevante nøgletal til at finde afvigelser og muligheder for forbedringer
  • Er god til at skabe relationer og kommunikere respektfuldt og konstruktivt
  • Er nysgerrig, løsningsorienteret og tør stille spørgsmål til eksisterende arbejdsgange
  • Kan bruge dine observationer til at komme med konkrete forbedringsforslag
  • Har kørekort

Vi lægger vægt på, at du kan bruge din faglige viden i praksis og samtidig har blik for helheden. Du skal både kunne se muligheder for forbedringer og turde påpege forhold, der ikke fungerer, med respekt for både borgere og kollegaer.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En selvstændig stilling, hvor du får mulighed for at præge kvaliteten og udviklingen af vores hjemmepleje
  • En varieret hverdag tæt på borgere, kollegaer og ledelse
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi værdsætter din faglighed og tager godt imod initiativ og konkrete forbedringsforslag
  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med engagement, humor og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab
  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende Plejeoverenskomst mellem Dansk Erhverv og FOA


Hvem er vi i DFS Plus?

Vi er et dynamisk, privat hjemmeplejefirma med 25 års erfaring, der samarbejder med 10 kommuner på og omkring Vestegnen samt flere private aktører. Dagligt leverer vi pleje til over 1.000 borgere og arbejder i et unikt fællesskab med 160 engagerede kollegaer.

Vores kultur er præget af humor, stærke relationer og godt samarbejde. Vi er store tilhængere af sociale arrangementer, da det støtter op om fællesskabet.

Er vi din nye arbejdsplads?

Arbejdstiden omfatter både dag- og aftenvagter, så du kan følge kvaliteten i hele vores drift. Du vil både kunne arbejde fra vores lokation i Taastrup og Hvidovre. Stillingen er som udgangspunkt uden weekendarbejde.

Samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende, og opslaget fjernes, når vi har fundet den rette kollega.

Der vil blive indhentet straffeattest i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Kan du se dig selv i stillingen her i DFS Plus, så send os endelig din ansøgning via nedenstående link. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte vores rekrutteringsteam på hr@dfs-plus.com

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

THE TEAMReporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, you will lead the global data platform function within Information Technology, with responsibility for the end-to-end lifecycle of our enterprise data and analytics platform. You will provide leadership to the global data platform team, including the Data Engineer, Global, while working closely with Enterprise Architecture, Applications, Technology Experience, Talent & Culture, and stakeholders across our corporate offices and hotels.

YOUR ROLEAs Director, Data Platform, Global, you will shape the strategy, architecture, engineering, operations, governance, and continuous improvement of our enterprise data and analytics platform. You will translate business, digital, and AI ambitions into a reliable, secure, scalable, and AI-ready data foundation that supports corporate offices, existing hotels, and new property openings. Providing executive-level guidance on data platform investments, you will ensure our data services meet defined service levels, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

Through strong leadership and partnership across the organisation, you will help Rosewood Hotel Group operate as a data-driven organisation and safely scale enterprise AI and GenAI use cases. HOW YOU’LL MAKE THE PLACEDefine and maintain the global enterprise data platform strategy, aligning it with business priorities, corporate IT roadmaps, and AI and digital transformation initiatives. Establish and govern enterprise data architecture and design patterns across cloud data warehouses, lakehouses, master data management, data integration, event streaming, analytics, and consumption tools.

Own the global operational performance of the data platform, including availability, reliability, data freshness, quality, observability, incident response, service levels, and continuous improvement. Build and operate governed, semantically documented, AI-ready data foundations that support analytics, retrieval-augmented generation, feature serving, automation, and enterprise AI and GenAI solutions. Embed data governance and privacy engineering into the data lifecycle, covering policy enforcement, access controls, classification, cataloguing, lineage, data quality, sensitive-data handling, retention, and auditability.

Lead platform modernisation and cost optimisation across AWS, GCP, and Azure, applying infrastructure-as-code, modern transformation and orchestration frameworks, and FinOps discipline. Manage strategic vendor relationships, multi-year budgets, investment planning, business cases, contracts, service performance, and technology consolidation across the data platform environment. Develop a high-performing global data platform team and build strong relationships with senior business leaders, property management, corporate stakeholders, technology partners, and Talent & Culture.

COULD THIS BE YOU? You bring extensive progressive experience in data architecture, platform engineering, or solution design within large multinational organisations, including substantial global or multi-site responsibility. You are an experienced people leader with a strong record of managing engineers and specialists in complex, mission-critical environments and developing future technical leaders.

You have deep expertise in cloud data platforms and modern lakehouse or warehouse architectures across AWS, GCP, and Azure, together with hands-on capability in SQL and Python. You understand modern data integration, transformation, modelling, master data management, data observability, dbt, event streaming, data cataloguing, lineage, and policy enforcement. You have successfully built and operated governed, AI-ready data foundations that support analytics, automation, and enterprise AI and GenAI use cases.

You bring practical knowledge of data privacy and regulatory compliance, including GDPR, PDPA, China PIPL, anonymisation, masking, tokenisation, pseudonymisation, and secure test-data practices. You are a strategic thinker and influential communicator who can translate complex business needs into scalable platform capabilities while leading cross-functional delivery, vendor relationships, and senior stakeholder engagement. You hold a bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field, communicate effectively in spoken and written English, and bring an international mindset with the flexibility to support global changes, cutovers, and incident response when needed.

An advanced degree, relevant cloud, privacy, governance, service management, or project management certification, and experience in luxury hospitality or multi-brand environments would be advantageous. OUR BENEFITSAs part of our team, you’ll enjoy a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your wellbeing, professional growth, and life beyond work. This includes medical coverage, retirement benefits, paid time off, complimentary room nights, learning and development opportunities, global career opportunities, and industry-leading paid parental leave supporting eligible associates across all paths to parenthood.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOUAt Rosewood Hotel Group, your voice is heard and valued. We’re a community that encourages associates to be themselves, not fit into a fixed culture, and this philosophy shines through in our commitments to reflect and honor the history, culture and geography of our destinations. We’re not only committed to building and nurturing genuine, long-lasting relationships but to transforming them, and our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) strategy helps put these principles into practice.

title: Installationsledare / ledande montör till Eltel i Stockholm
description:
Har du praktisk erfarenhet inom fiber, nätverk eller telekom och är redo för en mer arbetsledande roll? Trivs du i projekt där du får kombinera tekniskt arbete med ansvar, planering och problemlösning? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig!

Eltel Networks är en ledande aktör inom kritisk infrastruktur och erbjuder tjänster som möjliggör förnybar energi och högpresterande kommunikationsnät. Företaget designar, planerar, bygger och säkrar driften av nätverk som är avgörande för ett hållbart och uppkopplat samhälle. Genom att skapa robusta lösningar för el- och kommunikationsinfrastruktur bidrar Eltel till att stödja både dagens behov och framtidens krav. Deras arbete främjar en mer hållbar utveckling och skapar en grund för en effektiv och stabil uppkoppling för kommande generationer.

Eltel har en säkerhetsprofil och arbetar nära säkerhetsklassade kunder och följer strikta säkerhetsstandarder och certifieringar. De säkerställer att alla tekniska installationer och nätverkslösningar lever upp till högt ställda krav för informationssäkerhet. För närvarande genomför Eltel flera installations- och infrastrukturarbeten på olika anläggningar, där de ansvarar för viktiga tekniska installationer och nätverkslösningar.

I rollen som Installationsledare/ledande montör kombinerar du praktiskt installationsarbete med ett arbetsledande ansvar ute i projekt. Du planerar och fördelar det dagliga arbetet, leder tekniker på plats och säkerställer att installationerna genomförs enligt ritningar, tidsplaner, kvalitetskrav och säkerhetsrutiner.

Arbetet är helt förlagt ute i projekt och omfattar framför allt installationer inom fiber, datakommunikation och teknisk infrastruktur. Du arbetar nära projektledare, projektörer och kunder och ansvarar för att driva arbetet framåt samt hantera praktiska och tekniska frågor som uppstår längs vägen.

Du blir en del av ett team med tekniker, projektörer och projektledare och arbetar i projekt runt om i Stockholm med omnejd. Resor och arbete på andra orter kan förekomma.

We are looking for

Som person är du ansvarstagande, strukturerad och noggrann, med en god förmåga att planera och följa upp ditt arbete. Du är initiativtagande och lösningsorienterad och trivs med att ta ansvar och driva arbetet framåt. Eftersom rollen innebär regelbunden kontakt med kunder, beställare och andra aktörer ute på arbetsplatserna är du kommunikativ, professionell och bekväm i olika kontaktytor. Vi tror också att du har ett stort driv att utvecklas och motiveras av möjligheten att successivt ta ett större ansvar.

Krav för rollen:
• Minst gymnasieutbildning, gärna med inriktning mot teknikområde/teleteknik
• Praktisk teknisk erfarenhet av fiber, nätverk, telekom eller närliggande område
• Erfarenhet av arbetsledning eller ha haft större ansvar i ex projekt och lett andra, planerat och samordnat
• Goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan!

title: Data Center Specialist
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Manage daily data center operations to ensure that all supporting systems operate efficiently on a 24x7 basis, meet the agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and comply with data center best practices and international standards, such as Uptime Institute, TIA-942, and BICSI.

  • Manage vendors and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance activities for hardware and equipment within the data center. Control operational risks and ensure all activities comply with the Bank’s policies and recognized data center best practices.

  • Monitor and maintain the data center’s physical security infrastructure and controls, including physical access control policies, CCTV systems, authentication and authorization procedures, and access-log reviews.

  • Collaborate with IT project teams and vendors to develop appropriate solutions, monitor project implementation plans, and ensure proper deployment of infrastructure within the data center, including equipment placement, power consumption, and structured cabling.

  • Coordinate with relevant IT departments to monitor, develop, and plan data center capacity and budgets in support of existing and upcoming technology projects.

  • Work closely with the Facilities Management team to plan, design, operate, and maintain data center facility systems.

  • Interpret and understand electrical Single-Line Diagrams and analyze the root causes of data center facility incidents, including developing corrective and improvement plans and managing related budgets.

  • Maintain and continuously improve data center operational procedures, including incident management procedures and data center emergency response plans.

  • Provide on-call support during non-business hours for emergencies, such as power outages or failures of critical data center facility systems, and be available to work outside normal business hours when required.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date data center documentation, including asset inventories, data center layouts, floor plans, and rack bay-face diagrams.

  • Prepare data center operational and capacity reports, including space capacity, power capacity and utilization, Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE), and maintenance reports.

  • Support internal and external audit activities related to data center operations, facilities, security, and compliance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Relevant experience in operating or managing a large-scale data center environment.

  • Familiarity with banking IT infrastructure architecture and data center project management.

  • Good knowledge of data center facility systems, including UPS, generators, Computer Room Air Conditioning (CRAC), fire suppression systems, and other critical infrastructure.

  • Knowledge of internationally recognized data center standards, particularly TIA standards and Uptime Institute requirements.

  • Understanding of ITIL practices, including Event Management, Incident Management, and Problem Management.

  • Strong vendor management, coordination, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with IT teams, facilities teams, project teams, vendors, and auditors.

  • Ability to provide on-call support and work outside normal business hours during critical incidents or emergencies.

  • Data center professional certifications, such as CDCP, CDCS, or ATS, are preferred but not mandatory.

title: Executive Director-LVR001
description:

title: Career Consultant
description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

We are looking for (2) Career Consultants - (1) for New England (MA, ME, NH, RI, VT) territory and (1) for Philadelphia/New Jersey/Delaware territory. Each role must reside in their designated territory.


RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):


Service to PGA Professionals:

  • Provide insightful and meaningful career counseling and career coaching to PGA Professionals throughout their career life cycle from job search and membership to retirement.
  • Provide career services to include job search strategies, resume development, interviewing skills, offer negotiation, and exit and retirement strategies.
  • Promote the benefits and grow the utilization of PGA ExecuSearch, Job Seeker Profiles, the PGA Job Board and other employment tools across PGA platforms (e.g. - PGA.org, PGA.com, PGA member app, etc.).
  • Provide education programs to PGA Professionals through all available venues (national, sections and chapters).
