  • Promote and generate participation in PGA Player Development programs and strategies and document the value it brings to facilities and PGA Members.

Service to Employers:

  • Provide exceptional hiring services and resources, and assistance to employers to enhance relationships with industry stakeholders. Services and resources include PGA ExecuSearch, hiring process planning, resume review, interview planning, compensation and benefit packages, correspondence, and PGA preferred background check provider.
  • Provide compensation reports within department guidelines.
  • Market the value of PGA Professionals to non-PGA facilities and the industry.
  • Assist in creating awareness of PGA Player Development strategies and programming.

Service to PGA Sections:

  • Manage and maintain relationships with Section leadership, staff, and Section Education and Employment Committees.
  • Partner with Sections to develop employment strategies, and deliver employment presentations and education seminars to industry employers and organizations.

  • Assist in the development and improvement of PGA Career Services programs, projects, systems, publications and information.

  • Attend community/Section programs providing instruction or programming targeting new and existing golfers as available.

SHARED VALUES:

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values, challenges and opportunities you are experiencing.


SUPERVISION:

No supervisory responsibilities.


FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

No financial responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree: (B.A.) or equivalent in Business Administration, Human Resources, Professional Golf Management (Executive Management preferred) or related field.

Must have knowledge of managing multiple priorities, in a multi-functional work environment. Demonstrated leadership skills and a proven ability to motivate and manage professionals to achieve results. Skilled in customer service and/or sales. title: Pædagogisk personale søges til Mosetoft, Viborg
description:
Mosetoft - Et sted for dig, der vil mere end det sædvanlige

Da Rasmus startede på Mosetoft, havde han næppe forestillet sig, at han 18 år senere stadig skulle være her. I dag er han især stolt af den udvikling, han har været med til at skabe hos borgerne – og af de kollegaer, der altid stepper op, når der er brug for det.

Når du starter på Mosetoft, træder du ind i en hverdag med borgere, der har komplekse behov. Det stiller krav til dig som medarbejder. Du skal kunne skabe ro og forudsigelighed, stå fast i din faglighed og samtidig være nysgerrig på, om der findes en anden vej.

For på Mosetoft skal man turde prøve noget af – og samtidig vide, hvorfor man gør det.

Forudsigelighed er en vigtig del af hverdagen for borgerne. Derfor er der styr på detaljerne, klare aftaler og en fælles struktur, som vi arbejder efter. Det skaber tryghed for borgerne – og det er samtidig med til at passe på os medarbejdere.

For Maria, der har været på Mosetoft i 5 år, er det noget af det, hun er mest stolt af: at være med til at skabe den forudsigelighed, borgerne har brug for.

Det betyder, at du som ny medarbejder skal være tro mod de fælles aftaler. Der er ikke nødvendigvis en forklaring på alt, du kan se fra første dag. Men der er altid en grund til, at vi gør, som vi gør – og du får mulighed for at spørge, undre dig og forstå den faglige tanke bag.

Du skal turde prøve noget nyt

Du skal kunne bruge dine kollegaer, stille faglige spørgsmål og være åben for refleksion. Vi arbejder blandt andet med LA2U. For Rasmus og Thea, som har været hos os et år, er netop implementeringen af LA2u et eksempel på, hvordan fagligheden hele tiden udvikler og forandrer sig på Mosetoft.

Du skal ikke komme med én løsning til alle

Borgerne på Mosetoft er forskellige, og derfor er de gode løsninger heller ikke ens.

Det kræver, at du kan se mennesket foran dig og være nysgerrig på, hvad der virker for netop den borger. Nogle gange handler det om at skabe ro. Andre gange om at prøve noget nyt. Og nogle gange er udvikling et meget lille skridt, som måske ikke er synligt for andre end dig og dine kollegaer. Det skal du kunne være i.

Samarbejde

Det er en vigtig del af kulturen på Mosetoft, at vi passer på hinanden. Maria beskriver det som et sted med hjælpsomme kollegaer, hvor man kan sige til, hvis man har brug for hjælp – og hvor man bliver mødt med refleksion og faglige spørgsmål.

Det betyder også, at vi ikke forventer, at du som ny medarbejder kan det hele fra dag 1. Du får en grundig introduktion, følgevagter og et introduktionsprogram.

Mosetoft er en fagligt seriøs arbejdsplads. Men hverdagen behøver ikke være alvorlig hele tiden.

Der er plads til humor, grin og fællesskab på tværs. Kollegaskabet fylder meget hos de medarbejdere, vi har talt med, og flere peger netop på kollegaerne som en vigtig grund til, at de bliver.

Thea beskriver Mosetoft som en sjov, lærerig og tryg arbejdsplads, hvor man bliver set, hørt og anerkendt.

Og det er ikke kun noget, vi siger. Det kommer til udtryk i hverdagen, når en kollega spørger, hvordan du har det, når nogen giver en hånd med, eller når man sammen finder en løsning på noget, der er svært.

Ved du, hvad du går ind til?

Mosetoft er ikke et sted, hvor alle dage er nemme. Vi arbejder med komplekse borgere, og nogle dage kræver mere af dig end andre.

Til gengæld bliver du en del af et team, der står sammen, når det bliver svært. Du får mulighed for at gøre en forskel over tid og være med til at skabe udvikling, selv når udviklingen kommer i små skridt.

Rasmus har været på Mosetoft i 18 år. Han er stadig her på grund af borgerne, fagligheden og kollegaerne.

Kan du se dig selv i det? Har du en pædagogisk uddannelse? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om Mosetoft

Mosetoft er en del af Specialområde Udviklingshandicap (SUA). Region Midtjyllands samlede tilbud til voksne med udviklingshandicap.

Vi rummer 21 skønne, voksne borgere, med udviklingshandicap, lav kognitivt funktionsniveau og potentiale for udadreagerende adfærd.

Vi er opdelt i huse i en tæt, samlet matrikel, og prioriterer en god normering.

På Mosetoft og i SUA udlever vi værdierne Samarbejde, Udvikling og Ansvarlighed.

Det betyder at vi er:

  • Hjælpsomme medspillere – Der taler med hinanden, bruger humor og bidrager til respektfuld kommunikation.
  • Reflekterende praktikere – Der er nysgerrige på egen og fælles praksis, støtter op om besluttede initiativer og er åbne for refleksion.
  • Professionelle fagpersoner – Der møder borgere, pårørende og kollegaer med respekt og ansvarlighed. Vi engagerer os i nærværet med borgerne og bruger vores professionelle dømmekraft aktivt.
Det formelle

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller gerne vil have nærmere info om stillingen skal du endelig ikke tøve med at kontakte:

Rasmus Stigaard - Afdelingsleder - rassti@rm.dk – 20 95 35 47

Anders Hougaard – Afdelingsleder – andehu@rm.dk – 29 99 75 62

Mike Broder Jørgensen - Afdelingsleder - mike.broder@rm.dk - 51 22 71 33

Vi afholder samtaler d. 3/11 og d. 5/11.

Ansøgningsfrist: 29/10-2026.

Startdato: 1. januar 2027, eller tidligere hvis muligt.

Du kan finde yderligere information om Mosetoft på

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

title: Senior Workday Compensation Analyst
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The primary purpose and function of the Senior Workday Compensation Analyst is to lead the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Workday Compensation and Advanced Compensation to support Greystar's global workforce of 30,000+ team members spanning 19 countries. This individual will bring a consulting mindset and exceptional technical depth to the role, serving as a senior functional expert with proven experience delivering full life cycle implementations of both the Compensation and Advanced Compensation modules. This individual will lead initiatives on behalf of the compensation team, regularly communicate with and provide updates to stakeholders across the organization, and ensure compensation programs, salary structures, bonus plans, and merit cycles are accurately configured and aligned with organizational strategy across all applicable Workday modules including HCM, Advanced Compensation, and alignment with Payroll. This role requires demonstrated success operating within a large, diverse, decentralized, and international organization.

JOB DESCRIPTION

• Lead full life cycle implementation of the Workday Compensation and Advanced Compensation modules, including requirements gathering, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support, applying a consulting mindset to advise stakeholders on best practices.

• Configure and maintain Workday Compensation and Advanced Compensation including salary plans, grade profiles, merit and bonus plan setup, stock plans, and compensation eligibility rules across a complex, multi-country environment.

• Lead initiatives on behalf of the compensation team, driving projects from scoping through completion and serving as a subject matter expert and mentor within the team.

• Communicate with and provide regular updates to global stakeholders (across Europe, APAC, LATAM and India) across HR, Payroll, Finance, and business leadership on project status, configuration decisions, and compensation cycle progress.

• Configure and maintain collective bargaining compensation setup and related pay structures across multiple countries, ensuring alignment with union agreements and country-specific requirements.

• Administer annual and off-cycle compensation review cycles, including worksheet configuration, approval workflow setup, and cycle launch and close activities.

• Partner with HR, Payroll, Finance, and Total Rewards teams to translate compensation program design into accurate Workday configurations that support operational consistency and data integrity.

• Maintain compensation data integrity by conducting regular audits of salary grades, compensation bands, worker compensation profiles, and plan assignments across the global organization.

Support the design, testing, and deployment of new compensation programs and enhancements within Workday, including requirements gathering, configuration, and user acceptance testing.

• Assist in the analysis and reporting of compensation data, building Workday reports and dashboards to support Total Rewards decision-making, pay equity reviews, and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Manage job profile and compensation grade maintenance, ensuring alignment between Workday configuration and organizational job architecture as roles evolve.

• Support internal and external audit activities by providing compensation-related data extracts, documenting configuration controls, and assisting with evidence gathering for compliance requirements.

• Monitor and respond to compensation-related tickets and inquiries, providing end-user troubleshooting and escalation support for issues across Workday Compensation modules.

• Assist in testing and validation of compensation configurations during Workday bi-annual releases and system updates, ensuring changes do not introduce unintended impacts to compensation processing.

• Collaborate with the broader HR Applications team to identify recurring compensation process issues, configuration gaps, and opportunities to improve compensation cycle efficiency and scalability.

• Maintain accurate compensation documentation including configuration guides, process runbooks, and compensation plan inventories to support knowledge sharing and audit readiness.

• Support training efforts by helping educate HR, managers, and business users on Workday compensation processes, merit cycle participation, and compensation program best practices.


Other Responsibilities:

• Completes various human resources, technology, administrative, and other reports and analysis, and performs other duties as assigned or as necessary.


Organizational Responsibilities:

• Follows established policies and procedures by monitoring and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, organizational standards, and operational processes related to area(s) of responsibility and reporting violations or infractions to appropriate individual(s).

• Practices proper safety techniques in accordance with Company, property, and departmental policies, procedures, and standards.

• Identifies areas for improvement and offers suggestions to improve efficiency and productivity.

• Keeps abreast of current changes in technology, processes, and standards within the industry and area(s) of responsibility by attending internal and external training classes, research and/or subscribing to the internet or other professional publications or utilizing other appropriate method(s) to obtain business and professional information and applies knowledge and practices to area(s) of responsibility.


Working Conditions:

• Incumbents work in an office environment.

Physical Demands:

• Incumbents must be able to view computer screens and other electronic equipment, and reports for extended periods of time where visual strain may result.

• Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to ten (10) pounds independently and twenty-five (25) pounds with assistance.

• Rare or occasional travel may be required to attend business meetings, training classes, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.


Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

• 5-10 years of experience at a Senior Analyst level administering Workday Compensation and Advanced Compensation in a large, diverse, decentralized, international organization is required.

• Strong hands-on knowledge of Workday compensation architecture, including compensation plans, grades, eligibility rules, merit and bonus cycle configuration, and compensation review workflows.

• Experience with Total Rewards program design principles and the ability to translate compensation strategies into Workday configurations.

• Demonstrated consulting mindset with exceptional technical skill, including the ability to advise stakeholders on leading practices, influence design decisions, and lead complex configuration efforts independently.

• Knowledge of collective bargaining compensation setup and configuration across multiple countries (including UK, Ireland, Spain, Netherlands, Australia etc.), including union pay structures and country-specific compliance requirements.

title: Bæredygtighedsspecialist til fremtidens anlægsprojekter
description:
Vil du være med til at flytte bæredygtighed fra ambition til handling i fremtidens anlægsprojekter? Og synes du, at det er mindst lige så spændende at påvirke beslutninger som at lave analyserne bag dem?

Hos Novafos arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe løsninger, der gør en forskel for mennesker og miljø. Vi har store ambitioner på bæredygtighedsområdet, og nu søger vi en kollega, der kan hjælpe os med at omsætte ambitionerne til konkrete valg i vores anlægsprojekter.

Vær med, når de store beslutninger bliver truffet

Du bliver en del af teamet Bæredygtighed & Projektstyring i Spildevand Plan og Projekt. Her får du en vigtig rolle i at bygge bro mellem bæredygtighed, anlægsprojekter og data.
Du bliver både faglig specialist og sparringspartner for projektledere, rådgivere og entreprenører. Din opgave bliver blandt andet at hjælpe i projekterne med at træffe kloge valg om materialer, design og løsninger med afsæt i klima- og ressourcehensyn.
Du bliver involveret tidligt i projekterne, hvor dine analyser og anbefalinger skal være med til at påvirke investeringer og projekteringsvalg.
Samtidig får du mulighed for at være med til at udvikle de metoder og værktøjer, som skal styrke bæredygtighedsarbejdet og dokumentation på tværs af Novafos, et område under hastig udvikling.

Her får du sat din faglighed i spil

Dine daglige opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Vurdere og udfordre LCA og klimaberegninger i anlægsprojekter
  • Sparre med projektledere gennem hele projektforløbet
  • Bidrage til bæredygtighedsvurderinger og opfølgning på projekternes bæredygtighedsplaner
  • Kvalificere beslutninger om materialevalg, design og anlægsløsninger
  • Samarbejde med rådgivere og entreprenører om at finde de bedste løsninger
  • Bidrage til indsamling af dokumentation, rapportering og kvalitetssikring
  • Analysere og formidle projektdata
  • Være med til at udvikle fælles metoder, værktøjer og arbejdsgange

Du står ikke alene med opgaven

Du får to nære kolleger, som allerede arbejder med bæredygtighed i projekterne, og sammen skal I være med til at udvikle området videre.
Samtidig bliver du en del af Novafos' netværk af bæredygtighedsspecialister, hvor erfaringer, idéer og viden deles på tværs af organisationen. Vi hjælper hinanden, udfordrer hinanden fagligt og arbejder sammen om at skabe de bedste løsninger.

Hvad bringer du med dig?

Måske arbejder du i dag hos en rådgiver, en forsyning eller en bygherre. Det vigtigste er, at du har erfaring med bæredygtighed i anlægsprojekter og lyst til at bringe din viden i spil tæt på virkelige projekter. Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med LCA og klimaberegninger
  • Har forståelse for materialevalg og projektering i anlægsprojekter
  • Kan analysere og formidle data på en måde, som understøtter gode beslutninger
  • Trives med at samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder
  • Er nysgerrig, analytisk og struktureret

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med samarbejde mellem bygherre, rådgivere og entreprenører samt kendskab til EPD'er, miljødata og bæredygtig projektering.

En arbejdsplads med plads til hele dig

I Novafos tror vi på, at balancen mellem arbejde og fritid er afgørende for din trivsel og jobglæde. Vi respekterer dine arbejdstider og værner om et trygt og stabilt arbejdsmiljø, så du også har overskud til familie og privatliv. Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • Fleksible arbejdstider og en arbejdsuge på 37 timer inkl. frokost
  • Mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra efter aftale med nærmeste leder
  • Gode ansættelsesforhold igennem KL-overenskomst
  • Støtte til din faglige udvikling gennem kurser, intern undervisning og uddannelse
  • Gode kontorfaciliteter i Birkerød, herunder aflåst cykelparkering samt gratis parkeringspladser til bil
  • Kantineordning, massageordning, sundhedsforsikring, fitnessrum, en aktiv personaleforening og arrangementer som sommerfest, julefrokost, yoga, DHL-stafet mv.

Lyder det som et job for dig eller har du spørgsmål?

Kontakt os endelig hvis du har spørgsmål vedrørende jobbet. Vær opmærksom på at vi afslutter processen når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så skynd dig at sende os din ansøgning. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Novafos er et af Danmarks største vand- og spildevandsselskaber og forsyner borgere i Allerød, Ballerup, Egedal, Frederikssund, Furesø, Gentofte, Gladsaxe, Hørsholm og Rudersdal.
Som klimavenligt forsyningsselskab arbejder vi målrettet med bæredygtighed, klimasikring og udvikling af nye løsninger, der skaber værdi for både samfund og miljø.

title: Platform Services – Open Architecture Product Strategy - Managing Director
description:
Job Title

Platform Services – Open Architecture Product Strategy - Managing Director

Job Description

Who we are looking for
Qualified applicants should have extensive asset management operational experience at investment manager and/or service provider across multiple disciplines. Qualified applicant will need to understand State Street architecture and operating model to identify opportunities to augment/integrate with 3rd party tools and/or services. Demonstrated understanding and experience integrating new products and/or systems required. Applicants should be at ease leading others with no hierarchical connection and should also be comfortable working in a high growth business, fast paced environment driving the firms strategy and product capabilities. This position will require working across multiple geographies.

Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is a part of a global, cross-divisional team supporting State Street. State Street redefines the common definition of ‘front to back’ to mean powering better performance and outcomes at every point on the investment lifecycle and is the first open platform from a single provider that connects the front, middle and back office. It harmonizes data, technology and services across trusted providers to help our clients better manage their businesses. Join us if making your mark in an ever-changing, increasingly complex and competitive industry is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for
As a Product Strategist you will be responsible for Front/Middle/Back Office business engagement, understanding the customer’s needs vs our current capabilities and recommending solutions for development and implementation. This role is critical for business planning and management from the State Street Product organization. A successful candidate must have a strategic mindset, ability to collaborate, articulate a vision/roadmap and clearly communicate with clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Commercialization of products and services (how to price, articulate value proposition, sales support)
  • Think outside the box in producing solutions that work on an end-to-end basis (Front, Middle, Back)
  • Drive penetration into all segments of the bank (Asset Managers, Insurance, Asset Owners, Alts, Markets, etc)
  • Articulate the vision, design the solution, assist as necessary to implement the solution (bring to life)
  • Writing and presenting business cases that are supportable with appropriate financial (ROI) analysis
  • Understand the macro growth drivers in financial markets and apply to approach and recommendations
  • Understand competitive landscape and identify opportunities to differentiate when common technology is used
  • Partner effectively with broader product organization as well as delivery and client coverage teams

What we value

  • Leadership and ability to bring together teams across different levels and disciplines within the organization
  • Outstanding presentation, communication (oral & written), and relationship building skills across all levels of management. A detail-oriented disposition and clear, concise communication skills.
  • Strong critical thinking, problem solving, decision making and relationship management skills
  • The Enterprise Culture traits and behaviors – Choose to own it, Break through Silos, Deliver results through integrity, Do Better Every Day, Care for colleagues, clients and community

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of financial markets and investment management processes, including front, middle, back office functions
  • 15+ years operational and/or technical experience working across leading front, middle, back office systems. Private Markets experience a plus
  • Degree qualified with a financial or analytical discipline preferred, or relevant experience within the financial services industry
  • Proficient with Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Willingness and ability to travel.


About State Street
What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
Work, Live and Grow. We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.
Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility. We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift program and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.
State Street is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer.
Discover more at StateStreet.com/careers

Salary Range:

$170,000 - $267,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.

Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans.

title: Produktionsmedarbetare till betongfabrik i Hallsberg
description:
Är du praktiskt lagd, gillar att arbeta med händerna och vill utvecklas inom industrin? Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig!

Vi söker nu engagerade och ansvarstagande medarbetare till en betongfabrik i Hallsberg. Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande och kan bland annat innefatta betongarbete, snickeri, formarbete och armering.

Tidigare erfarenhet av betongarbete, snickeri, bygg eller industri är meriterande, men inget krav. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och söker framför allt dig som är praktiskt lagd, ansvarstagande och vill lära dig nya arbetsuppgifter.

Om tjänsten

Som produktionsmedarbetare blir du en del av ett team där ni tillsammans arbetar med olika moment inom tillverkningen. Arbetet är praktiskt och fysiskt, med fokus på kvalitet, noggrannhet och säkerhet.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Förbereda och montera formar inför gjutning.

  • Arbeta med snickeri, armering och betonggjutning.

  • Hantera material, verktyg och produktionsutrustning.

  • Utföra avformning, efterbearbetning och kvalitetskontroller.

  • Följa arbetsinstruktioner och bidra till ett säkert och effektivt produktionsflöde.

Arbetsuppgifterna kan variera beroende på produktionens behov.

Vi söker dig som

  • Är praktiskt lagd och trivs med fysiskt arbete.

  • Är noggrann, ansvarstagande och har god arbetsmoral.

  • Har en positiv inställning och vill lära dig nya arbetsuppgifter.

  • Trivs med att samarbeta och kan ta egna initiativ.

  • Har ett säkerhetsmedvetet arbetssätt.

Kvalifikationer

  • B-körkort är ett krav.

  • Du kan förstå och följa arbetsinstruktioner på svenska.

  • Du har god fysisk förmåga.

Meriterande erfarenheter

Det är en fördel om du tidigare har arbetat inom något av följande områden:

  • Snickeri, bygg eller anläggning.

  • Armering eller järnhantering.

  • Betongarbete, formarbete eller gjutning.

  • Industri, produktion eller tillverkning.

  • Ritningsläsning och arbete med handverktyg.

  • Truck- eller traverskörning.

Truckkort och traverskort är meriterande, särskilt erfarenhet av travers då det används för att lyfta och förflytta material och produkter i produktionen. Det är dock inget krav.

Anställningsvillkor

  • Omfattning: Heltid.

  • Start: Enligt överenskommelse.

  • Arbetstider: Dagtid, måndag–fredag. Andra arbetstider och skiftarbete kan bli aktuella framöver.

  • Placering: Hallsberg.

Ansökan

Är du en händig och engagerad person som vill ha ett varierande arbete inom produktion? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig!

Vi lägger stor vikt vid din inställning och vilja att utvecklas. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, det viktigaste är att du är motiverad och vill göra ett bra jobb.

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Sjuksköterska till ortopediska avdelningen
description:
Ortopediska avdelningen, Nyköpings lasarett

Från operation till första steget - Följ patientens hela resa på ortopeden.

Om oss
Hos oss på ortopeden får du bli en del av ett tryggt och engagerat team som både stöttar varandra och har roligt på jobbet. Vi har en modern avdelning med gott om utrymme vilket bidrar till en bra arbetsmiljö. Här finns 16 vårdplatser och vi vårdar både akuta och elektiva patienter.
Vår styrka är samarbetet mellan sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, paramedicin och läkare – tillsammans gör vi skillnad för våra patienter varje dag. Vi har dessutom både utskrivningssamordnare och receptionist, vilket gör att alla yrkesgrupper kan fokusera på sina kärnuppgifter. Det bidrar till ett smidigare flöde och ett bättre arbetsklimat.

Vi erbjuder en trygg och individanpassad inskolning, och vi värdesätter att alla i teamet får växa, ta ansvar och bidra till utvecklingen på avdelningen. Här är arbetsmiljö och gemenskap minst lika viktigt som medicinsk kvalitet.

Dina arbetsuppgifter
Som sjuksköterska hos oss får möjlighet att utveckla spetskompetens. Du ansvarar framför allt för patienter med frakturer och andra skador i rörelseapparaten men det förekommer även patienter med kirurgiska och medicinska diagnoser. Du är med hela vägen, i det akuta omhändertagandet, under operationens förberedelser och eftervården då patienten tar sina första steg igen. Här får du inte bara möjlighet att utvecklas i ditt yrke, utan också chans att handleda studenter och påverka arbetssätt på avdelningen.

Din kompetens
Vi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska och som vill utvecklas inom ortopedisk vård. Du har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift, och en vilja att använda din kompetens i ett varierat arbete.

Vi tror att du är en positiv och engagerad person som trivs i team, men som också kan ta eget ansvar. Du tycker om att arbeta i ett varierande tempo och ser värdet av att skapa trygghet och kontinuitet för patienterna. Har du erfarenhet av ortopedisk vård är det en bonus – men allra viktigast är att du är nyfiken, vill lära dig nytt och bidrar till en miljö där både patienter och kollegor trivs.

Anställningsform
Tillsvidareanställning på heltid erbjuds, men andra alternativ kan diskuteras.
Grundtjänstgöring är treskift, men vi är öppna för dialog om andra önskemål – till exempel enbart natt, dag/kväll eller andra upplägg. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

title: Tilbudskoordinator
description:
I denne stilling får du en enestående mulighed for at komme med på en spændende rejse. For med direkte reference til direktøren bliver du en vigtig del af fremtidens koordinering, planlægning, kalkulering, dokumentation, indhentning af priser og opfølgning på virksomhedens tilbuds- og licitationsarbejde.

Du skal således have lyst til både at holde det interne ”maskinrum” kørende og samtidig ”kigge ud af boksen”, da du i høj grad selv er med til at skabe dit job både ”i dag og i morgen”.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være følgende:

  • Koordinere tilbudsprocessen fra modtagelse af udbud til aflevering
  • Indhente tilbud fra leverandører og underentreprenører
  • Udsende forespørgsler og følge op på tilbudsfrister
  • Gennemgå udbudsmateriale og identificere relevante oplysninger, mangler og uklarheder
  • Udarbejde mængdeudtræk
  • Opbygge og vedligeholde kalkulationsgrundlag
  • Indhente interne og eksterne priser
  • Sammenholde tilbud fra leverandører og underentreprenører
  • Følge op på manglende priser, oplysninger og afklaringer
  • Koordinere input fra projektledere, fagpersoner, indkøb og ledelse
  • Deltage i projekt- og tilbudsgennemgange
  • Registrere væsentlige forudsætninger og risici
  • Vedligeholde tilbudsregistre, kalkulationsgrundlag og relevante prisdata
  • Følge op på aftalte deadlines
  • Sikre dokumentation og struktur i tilbudsmaterialet
  • Medvirke til kvalitetssikring af tilbud inden aflevering

Kvalifikationer

Du er en dygtig indkøbsprofil, der allerede i dag har bevist din styrke inden for indkøb i byggebranchen, gerne med særligt fokus på byggeri og samarbejde med både leverandører og fagentreprenører. Fundamentet for den rette profil er således en solid erfaring med indkøb, godt købmandskab og en stærk byggeteknisk viden.

Din personlighed er ligeledes afgørende for succes i jobbet. Du er godt begavet med en udpræget analytisk sans, kombineret med en høj grad af økonomisk og teknisk forståelse – og så er du en rigtig dygtig ”købmand”.

Du evner at kombinere gennemslagskraft og konsekvens med gode samarbejdsevner, både internt og eksternt. Herudover kræver opgaven handlekraft, omhyggelighed og grundighed – også under tidspres – samt en positiv indstilling til opgaverne og et godt humør.

Du tilbydes

Et varieret og udfordrende job i en virksomhed med en unik tilgang til morgendagens projekter – dem kan vi gøre lidt bedre. Du bliver en væsentlig nøgleressource i et lille team, især på de indre linjer, hvor du i høj grad har mulighed for at sætte dit præg og udvikle dig både personligt og fagligt.

Kulturen i virksomheden er uformel og omgangstonen er ligetil. Man hjælper hinanden, og der er en rigtig god holdånd, hvor alle trækker på samme hammel. Virksomheden har skabt sin succes på kundefokus, arbejdsomhed og projekter af høj kvalitet.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår forhandles individuelt.

Virksomheden

erwin andersen a/s søger for KJ Greenland A/S, som er etableret i 2011. Virksomhedens medarbejdere har 20-30 års erfaring inden for entreprenørbranchen i Grønland. KJ Greenland er altid klar til at løse forskellige opgaver i hele Grønland, hovedsageligt entreprenøropgaver for offentlige og private bygherrer samt for mine- og olieindustrien. Væksten gør, at der kræves flere ressourcer_._

Ansøg

Er dette en udfordring for dig, mærkes dit CV og ansøgning stillingsnummer ”02.10.86” og uploades her på siden.

Al henvendelse behandles fortroligt.

Vi har ikke ansøgningsfrist på vores stillingsannoncer, idet vi indkalder kandidater successivt under rekrutteringsforløbet.

Bemærk: Jobannoncen genindrykkes løbende på diverse jobportaler. Dette er ikke et udtryk for, at rekrutteringsprocessen er startet forfra.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Student Assistant - Communication
description:
Your impact begins here

As Student Assistant Communications at the World Diabetes Foundation (WDF), you will help more people see the progress behind diabetes prevention and care projects in low- and middle-income countries. You will plan and create social media content, support campaigns such as the Global Diabetes Walk and turn stories from projects and partners into digital storytelling that informs stakeholders. Your work will strengthen WDF’s digital presence and help amplify the impact of its projects and partners around the world.

What you’ll bring

You are curious, creative and motivated to learn. You take responsibility for your tasks, and you’re comfortable asking questions and working closely with colleagues.

You also:

Are enrolled in a relevant bachelor’s or master’s programme, such as communication, media, journalism, marketing, international development, global health or a related field.

Have an interest in social media and digital communication and understand how content can be adapted for different channels and audiences.

Have experience creating written, visual, photo or short-form video content – through your studies, student work, volunteering or personal projects.

Communicate confidently in written and spoken English.

Are structured, collaborative and interested in global health and international development.

Experience with tools such as Canva, video-editing software, Mailchimp or Google Analytics. Most importantly, you want to learn and contribute.

What you’ll do

You will work hands-on with WDF’s digital channels and campaigns. You will:

Help plan, create, publish and schedule content for WDF’s LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook channels.

Support campaigns and initiatives – particularly the Global Diabetes Walk – through content planning, asset development and community engagement.

Monitor WDF’s social media channels, engage with relevant audiences and contribute to regular performance reporting.

Assist with digital storytelling, fundraising communication and WDF’s engagement activities with Novo Nordisk.

Work with colleagues to identify stories, collect photos, videos and data, and develop content aligned with WDF’s brand and communications priorities.

Depending on your interests, experience and the team’s priorities, you may also contribute to website content, newsletters, photography, short-form video and communications analytics.

Who you’ll work with

You will join WDF’s team in Gentofte, Denmark. WDF was founded in 2002 as an independent foundation by Novo Nordisk A/S and is today a leading global funder of diabetes prevention and care projects in low- and middle-income countries.

WDF is a diverse team based in Denmark, working closely with partners around the world. Day to day, you will work with colleagues across WDF to find the stories worth telling, gather the photos, videos and data behind them, and shape content for international audiences. Through fundraising communication and engagement activities, you will also see how communications support WDF’s partnerships with Novo Nordisk and other stakeholders.

What you can expect here

This is a student assistant position of 15 hours per week, starting in January 2027. You will become part of a purpose-driven, international working environment where you can:

Gain practical experience in digital communication, campaigning, and global health.

Contribute to visible initiatives such as the Global Diabetes Walk.

Develop content for international audiences and learn how communications support partnerships, fundraising and organizational priorities.

Work with experienced colleagues and receive ongoing guidance and feedback.

Take ownership of meaningful assignments that can support your professional and academic development.

Salary and Benefits

This position is hourly paid. For this position, the hourly base rate is 209,27 DKK, based on an assessment of relevant factors such as experience, educational background, demonstrated competencies, and the specific skills required for the position. In addition to the hourly base rate, Student Assistants are entitled to a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution).

Start now

Better health can’t wait. Neither can you. Your impact begins today. If you’re ready to turn real stories from projects and partners into content that builds momentum for diabetes prevention and care, apply for the Student Assistant Communications role by 22 October 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Product Manager B2B / Product Consultant
description:
Salary: Rp 9.500.000 – Rp 13.500.000 per month

About the role

You carry a module from the client's business process all the way to acceptance, and it stays yours end to end. You map the process, find the real problem behind the stated ask, write the business rules and the numbered acceptance criteria engineers build against, and prove at UAT that the problem is solved. You carry two engagements at a time, and the record you keep is the one everyone downstream works from.

Key responsibilities

  • Map the client's current-state process, identify the bottlenecks in it, and name the real problem behind the stated ask.

  • Write the business requirements and the business rules for your module.

  • Write the numbered, testable acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then form that live in the specification appendix, so an engineer can build from them without coming back to ask.

  • Explore the client's data, check it for quality, and map what each field means inside their process.

  • Keep the traceability from requirement to implementation to test, so every build traces back to a need.

  • Write UAT scenarios from the process map and the problem statement, then validate that the client's problem is solved rather than only that features function.

  • Deliver the standard operating procedures and the training when your module ships.

  • Join engineers' story kickoffs and walk them through the edge cases before they write code.

  • Draft the weekly client report for the Senior Product Consultant to approve, carrying the client's operating reality up to the product layer.

  • Keep the meeting notes, the decision log, and the change-request log as the record everyone works from.

About you

  • 2 to 4 years in product management, business analysis, or delivery consulting, or equivalent demonstrable skill.

  • Ability to turn a messy client ask into a current-state process map that shows where the real problem sits.

  • Ability to write numbered, testable acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then form that an engineer can build from directly.

  • Comfortable in a client's data: checks it for quality, spots the empty, duplicated, and malformed, and maps what each field means in the business process.

  • Ability to write UAT scenarios that test whether the client's problem is solved, and holds the pass or fail line on them.

  • Ability to keep a clean record under pressure: decisions, changes, and the reasoning behind both.

  • Ability to talk to engineers about trade-offs without oversimplifying the build, and recognizes excellent interface work from merely acceptable work well enough to spec for it.

  • Works in Bahasa Indonesia and English with client stakeholders.

  • Uses AI as leverage across the whole job and verifies its output before it reaches a client or an engineer.

  • Work you can show: specifications, process maps, prototypes, or interfaces you shaped.

title: Student Assisstant for Crisis Management
description:
Help strengthen the team that protects Denmark’s digital infrastructure when it matters most.

Would you like to turn structure, analysis and practical coordination into more effective crisis readiness? Join TDC NET and help maintain and develop the framework, tools and training that support our Crisis Management Team.

TDC NET owns and operates digital infrastructure that is critical to Denmark. Our Crisis Management framework helps the organisation respond when serious events require fast coordination, clear decisions and reliable communication. You will join the Business Continuity and Crisis Management area and work closely with experienced colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation.

About the job

We are looking for a motivated and structured student assistant who wants to learn how crisis readiness is built in practice. You will support both the day-to-day maintenance of our Crisis Management framework and the continued development of the Crisis Management Team. The role combines practical coordination, document and data management, analysis, communication and continuous improvement work.

You will receive clear priorities and guidance, but you will also be trusted to be responsible for defined tasks and follow them through. Your work will contribute directly to making plans easier to use, training more effective, and improvement actions more visible.

Purpose of the role

Your purpose is to help keep our crisis-management setup current, organised and ready for use. You will support documents, exercises, readiness activities, reporting and follow-up, while learning how operational resilience and executive crisis management work in a large infrastructure company.

Key responsibilities

  • Maintain and improve crisis plans, appendices, role descriptions, quick guides, checklists and templates.
  • Coordinate practical preparation for workshops, activation drills and crisis exercises, including invitations, rooms, Teams setup, materials and participant data.
  • Collect and structure data from training, activations and exercises, and prepare clear overviews and PowerPoint material.
  • Maintain action and improvement trackers, follow up with owners and prepare concise status updates.
  • Support stronger decision logging, situation reporting, briefing flows and role-ready crisis-room materials.
  • Carry out desk research on crisis management, operational resilience, emerging risks and best practice.
  • Help explore, test and responsibly apply AI to improve crisis preparedness, response, recovery, decision and action logging, situation reporting and post-incident learning.

What you will work on from the start

Recent exercises have identified practical opportunities to make activation faster, clarify interfaces, improve decision and situation reporting. We also want to explore how responsible use of AI can improve crisis preparedness, response, recovery, reporting and continuous learning. You will help turn these lessons into updated tools, training material, trackers and follow-up activities. You will support the work, while decisions and formal ownership remain with the relevant specialists and leaders.

Your first months

During your first months, you will learn the Crisis Management framework, key roles, exercise cycle and improvement backlog. With support from the team, you will gradually take ownership of recurring practical tasks, selected improvement actions and clearly defined deliverables. You will be expected to keep overviews current, flag issues early, and ask for guidance when decisions or sensitive information are involved.

The role is designed to combine learning with real responsibility. You will work close to both operational specialists and senior stakeholders, but you will not make crisis decisions or replace specialist role holders. Your contribution is to make the process, tools, information and follow-up more reliable and easier to use.

“You will not just help maintain documents. You will help us turn lessons from exercises into practical improvements that enhance how the organisation prepares, coordinates and responds to a crisis.”

- Noah Fröhlich, Head of Business Continuity, TDC NET

About you

We imagine that you:

  • Are enrolled in a relevant higher-education programme, for example emergency and risk management, security, political science, business, engineering, communication, law or a similar field.
  • Work in a structured way, pay attention to detail and reliably finish what you start.
  • Can turn complex information into clear notes, simple overviews and well-structured slides.
  • Are curious, proactive and comfortable asking questions when something is unclear.
  • Are skilled using Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and Word, or motivated to become so quickly.
  • Have AI fluency, practical experience with AI tools or a genuine interest in learning how AI can be used responsibly in crisis management.
  • Communicate fluently in English, both in writing and verbally.
  • Can handle sensitive information responsibly and exercise sound judgement.
  • Are able to obtain and maintain the security clearance required for the position. Employment will be conditional on successful security approval.
  • Can work approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility around exam periods.

Previous experience with crisis management is not required. We value your structure, judgement, curiosity and willingness to learn.

What you will gain

  • Practical experience with crisis management, business continuity and operational resilience in critical infrastructure.
  • Insight into how executive teams prepare for and manage serious incidents.
  • Experience planning exercises, analysing results and converting lessons into practical improvements.
  • Enhanced capabilities in structured problem solving, project coordination, data analysis and executive communication.
  • Close collaboration with experienced colleagues across technology, security, operations, communications, legal and senior management.
  • The opportunity to take real responsibility for defined deliverables and see the impact of your work.

Contact:

If you have questions about the position or want to know more about working with Crisis Management at TDC NET, please contact the Head of Business Continuity, Noah Fröhlich on nof@tdcnet.dk.

title: Licensed Surveillance Field Investigator
description:
Join Lemieux & Associates as a part-time Licensed Surveillance Field Investigator and put your expertise to work with a respected leader in investigative services.

Backed by a leadership team with more than 25 years of field experience, we are committed to maintaining the highest standards in investigative services while providing flexible part-time opportunities, competitive pay of $25 - $32 per hour, and opportunities for professional growth.


This is a part-time position that offers flexible hours. Candidates must be willing and able to work irregular hours and travel as needed to complete assignments and meet client needs.


YOUR CONTRIBUTIONS MATTER

As a Licensed Surveillance Field Investigator, you will conduct both mobile and stationary surveillance assignments throughout Bismarck, ND and surrounding areas. You will capture clear, steady HD video while accurately identifying and confirming subjects' locations. Throughout each assignment, you will utilize your investigative expertise, strong computer skills, and professional judgment to document observations and gather information. You will prepare detailed, accurate reports that provide clients with reliable findings, while maintaining a commitment to timely, high-quality work and the professional standards that have made Lemieux & Associates a trusted name in investigative services.

  • Strong computer and internet proficiency
  • Commitment to producing timely, high-quality work
  • Experience conducting surveillance investigations
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills

Preferred:

ABOUT US

As a national leader in investigative services, Lemieux & Associates is dedicated to delivering professional SIU/DIU, surveillance, and medical canvassing services clients can rely on. Our employees are our greatest asset, and our company culture revolves around maintaining a communicative, loyal, ethical, passionate, impactful, and benevolent environment. With a leadership team boasting over 25 years of field experience, we are committed to unlocking the potential of our employees and creating a supportive, tight-knit community.


JOIN US!

Take the next step in your investigative career with a company that sets the standard for excellence. If you're ready to join a professional, results-driven team and put your investigative skills to work, apply today through our mobile-friendly application.

title: Project Manager, Special Projects, NA
description:
About Vantage


Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


Position Overview

This role will assist various members of the Construction Executive team with preparation of information for executive presentations, Departmental Initiatives, and commitments. Detailed planning and execution management to accommodate a wide team member knowledge base will be necessary. Your responsibility will include ensuring that programmatic outcomes are being met, establishing clear communications across teams, and driving improvement in quality. This role is for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit who can adapt to change as the organization scales.


Essential Job Functions:

  • Lead all aspects of assigned construction projects, not limited but inclusive of the following:
  • Proficient in estimating, RFP development, pre-bid planning, schedule creation, budget forecasting, leading OAC & stakeholder meetings, oversight, and coordination.
  • Excellent at taking initiative, problem solving, time management, and thinking outside the box.
  • Excellent at understanding contract types; i.e., GMP, Lump Sum, NTE, MSA’s, etc.
  • Excellent at understanding invoicing; i.e., lien waivers, pay applications, retention, etc.
  • Lead all design phases and documents working internally with stakeholder groups and Subject Matter Experts.
  • Drive all aspects of construction including pre-construction, design development, permitting and entitlements, competitive bid process, team selection, construction oversight, commissioning, and project closeout.
  • Act as project leader, drive coordination and integration of internal customers within the project.
  • For assigned construction projects, manage General Contractors, vendors, stakeholders and project management resources.
  • Coordinate and supervise projects requiring design-build and/or design bid build contractors.
  • Oversight of physical construction activities on site.
  • Lead commissioning of critical systems integration across new customer builds and existing data centers.
  • Seamless hand-off of physical data center and project documents to customer and operations.
  • Manage contractor safety performance, while upholding Vantage Data Center safety standards/data center work rules.
  • Coordinate logistics planning for all OFCI equipment.

Duties:

  • Report to assigned Vantage Special Projects team and manager.
  • Manage assigned portfolio execution of data center remediation projects from concept through commissioning and prepare various reports on a monthly and/or quarterly basis.
  • Manage and lead multiple small, medium and large sized projects concurrently, independently and in various locations.
  • Depending on the project size (typically for medium or large projects) mentor, manage and assist Special Projects Assistant Project Manager(s) with daily tasks, learning, guiding and development.
  • Drive day-to-day construction decisions to conclusion.
  • QA/QC work of assigned projects to confirm accuracy. Handle inputs and delivery of work products with internal team members to ensure that new data center spaces follow all applicable VDC applicable requirements.
  • Establish and track project budgets. Submit approval packages to TOF approval group.
  • Partner with Base Building Director(s), Construction Cost & Finance to produce monthly project forecasts including variance analyses as well as execution of Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and project authorizations for new and existing contractors and vendors.
  • Vendor/Contractor management including qualification and relationship building/maintenance.
  • Review monthly billing with Special Projects team, confirm substantiation and audit vs budget.
  • Ensure ‘lessons learned’ are held and placed in the feedback loop to drive continuous improvement.
  • Ensure project team aligns with project turnover documentation requirements to Operations.
  • Work closely with Operations to coordinate design criteria and construction with ongoing maintenance and operation of existing facilities.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture or a similar field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5-7 years of Construction Project Management experience is required, 8-12 years is preferred.
  • Sophisticated and technical construction experience is required.
  • Data Center and General Contractor experience is highly preferred.
  • Owner Representative and/or Life Science experience is preferred.
  • Experience in CSA (civil, structural, architectural) and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) construction project management is a requirement.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, project management tools like MS Project, P6, Bluebeam and Procore.
  • Travel may be required and could grow, but will be assessed by the Special Projects team.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.


Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.


Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

title: Leasing Professional - Ridgescape at Highlands Ranch
location: Ridgescape at Highlands Ranch, Highlands Ranch, CO
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.


Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

#LI-RS2

The hourly range for this job is $18 - $20.


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).

title: Butikschef till Synsam Karlskrona 100 % - Vikariat
description:
Som butikschef hos oss på Synsam blir du en nyckelspelare i ett av Nordens mest innovativa företag inom optik och livsstilsprodukter. Hos oss kommer du inte bara ansvara för en butik, du kommer vara med och bygga framtidens kundupplevelse på ett bolag som gör skillnad!

En dag som butikschef och stjärnledare på Synsam Den orangea ridån går upp när du kliver in genom dörrarna till butiken. Du kommer till en arbetsplats där kreativitet och kundfokus inte bara är ord – det är vårt DNA. Som butikschef hos oss får du inspirera och utmana ett dynamiskt team av butikssäljare och optiker som brinner för service, försäljning, kvalitet och innovation. Butiken blir er Synsam-scen där ni, utifrån Synsams riktlinjer, levererar kundservice i världsklass, driver igenom nytänkande projekt, lanserar produkter och tjänster, samt skapar nya standarder för kundbemötande och service.

Dessutom får du i rollen som butikschef förtroendet att:

  • Forma och utveckla en butikskultur som speglar våra värderingar – hos oss är kunden nr 1, vi tar ansvar och vi är innovativa.

  • Ta helhetsansvar för butikens framgångar, från rekrytering och upplärning av personal till resultat, kundupplevelse och lokal marknadsföring.

  • Tänka utanför boxen när det gäller att nå försäljningsmål och optimera resultat. Med både frihet och ansvar, söker vi en ledare som vågar prova nytt och lära av sina erfarenheter.

Vi tror på ett ledarskap som inspirerar och motiverar varje individ i teamet. Som butikschef på Synsam får du en central roll i att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där varje medarbetare känner sig sedd, hörd och värdefull. Du leder ditt team med engagemang och närvarande ledarskap och främjar ett arbetsklimat där samarbete, respekt och ömsesidig förståelse står i centrum.

Vem är du? För att lyckas i rollen som butikschef på Synsam tror vi att du är en engagerad, målinriktad och lösningsfokuserad person som brinner för ledarskap. Du har förmågan att lyfta och utveckla dina medarbetare, att skapa en miljö där varje teammedlem vill växa, samtidigt som du har ett skarpt affärssinne, tar ansvar för butikens resultat och är bekväm med att arbeta i digitala system.

Vidare ser vi gärna att du har:

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av ledarskap där du visat på goda resultat. Du behöver inte komma från vår bransch, vi kommer att förse dig med rätt verktyg för att du ska ha möjlighet att lära dig allt du behöver veta.

  • Alternativt så arbetar du redan inom optikbranschen eller retail som säljare med framgångsrika resultat och lockas av att driva din egen butik och utveckla dig som ledare.

Varför Synsam? På Synsam får du inte bara ett jobb, utan en möjlighet att göra karriär på en arbetsplats där kundfokus, innovation och ansvarstagande står i centrum. Vi har stora ambitioner och välkomnar dig till ett sammanhang där du kan växa och ta nya steg 🚀

Utöver detta erbjuds du som butikschef bland annat: ✨ Kollektivavtal ✨ Kontinuerliga utbildningar via Synsam Academy ✨ Bonussystem utöver grundlön ✨ Generöst friskvårdsbidrag ✨ Personalrabatter

Tjänsten är ett vikariat på ett år med chans till förlängning.

Om rekryteringsprocessen Rekryteringen sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag – så vänta inte! 🚀 I vår rekryteringsprocess ingår tester, intervjuer samt bakgrundskontroll avseende brott och ekonomi. För anställning krävs att du har giltig rätt att arbeta i Sverige i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning. Observera att vi ej tar emot ansökningar via e-post.

Vi på Synsam söker engagerade och talangfulla personer i alla åldrar! Hos oss värdesätts mångfald och vi tror att olika perspektiv och erfarenheter berikar vårt arbete och bidrar till vår gemensamma framgång. Ta chansen att bli vår nästa stjärnledare - vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! 🤩

title: Global Process Analyst, Finance
description:

We are looking for a Global Process Analyst, Finance to join our Finance Transformation organisation. While the team is responsible for the overall development of Konecranes’ global finance and controlling processes, this position will focus specifically on Accounts Receivable (AR) and Treasury.

Finance Transformation is part of the Group Finance function and drives the transformation and continuous development of Konecranes’ global finance and controlling processes. The team leads development projects across Finance & Control and supports the effective use of key finance systems and processes, including SAP, Aico, TIS, CLM, CoProcess, Emburse, VAT and Indirect Tax.

In this role, you will contribute to the harmonisation and development of Konecranes’ global finance processes. This is a versatile position where you will work as a Product Owner within an Agile Scrum team, giving you an excellent opportunity to apply your process development experience while further developing your project management skills.

You will work closely with the Finance Global Process Owner for AR and Treasury. Depending on the initiative, you may independently lead development activities, take responsibility for finance-related development and implementation as part of a project team, or act as a project manager for development projects.

You will also play an important role in connecting business end-users, Global Process Owners and IT, helping to translate business needs into practical process and system improvements.

If you are a proactive and ambitious professional who enjoys collaborating with others, solving problems and improving ways of working, we would love to hear from you.

    Your responsibilities

    • Provide finance process guidance and drive harmonisation and continuous improvement in cooperation with the Finance Global Process Owner.
    • Collaborate with business stakeholders and IT to identify, collect and document requirements.
    • Identify, test and document solutions and facilitate knowledge transfer to relevant stakeholders.
    • Provide process and SAP user training, create end-user instructions and support business users.
    • Lead or support projects and smaller development initiatives as a Finance representative.

    We are looking for

    • A relevant academic degree in economics, finance or accounting.
    • Previous experience in accounting and finance process development.
    • Fluency in written and spoken English. Other languages are considered an advantage.
    • Previous hands-on experience with SAP, particularly Finance modules, and MS Excel

    The following are considered an advantage:

    • Experience working in a project environment.
    • Experience with TIS, CoProcess, Power BI or Jira.
    • Experience with Agile Scrum methodology.

    As a person, you are

    • Curious and development-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset.
    • Proactive and confident when interacting with stakeholders and gathering requirements.
    • Responsible and able to work independently.
    • Collaborative and approachable, with strong communication skills.
    • Adaptable to changing situations, with good organisational skills.

    Who join us?

    • Work in a global environment in a versatile role with opportunities to collaborate across different functions.
    • Develop professionally and take on increasing responsibilities.
    • Benefit from a comprehensive benefits package, including performance-based incentives, ePassi, occupational healthcare, free gyms at our offices and an Employee Share Savings Plan.
    • Enjoy hybrid and flexible ways of working that support work-life balance.

    Interested?

    We’d love to hear from you. Submit your CV in English by Sunday, 25.10 at 23h59 via the Konecranes Careers page. We review applications regularly, so we encourage you to apply early.

    For further information about the role, please contact Laura Mäkelä, Global Process Owner, AR & Treasury, by email at laura.makela [at] konecranes.com.

    If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact Katre Laan, Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, at katre.laan [at] konecranes.com.

That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

title: Plejecenter Dybbøl søger sundhedsfagligt personale
description:
Plejecenter Dybbøl søger sundhedsfagligt personale - Vær med til at skabe fællesskab og en meningsfuld hverdag
  1. Brænder du for at gøre en forskel i andres liv- hver eneste dag?
  2. Er faglighed, dialog og medbestemmelse noget, der motiverer dig?
  3. Vil du være en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi slipper kræfterne løs og tror på beboerne som medskaber og ikke tilskuer?

Så er det måske dig vi søger 😊

Hvem er vi:

Vi er en engageret og faglig stærk arbejdsplads, hvor vi sammen skaber en tryg og meningsfuld hverdag for vores beboere. Hos os tror vi på, at fællesskab og samarbejde er nøglen - både i forhold til kollegaer og beboere. Vi har 59 beboere, fordelt i 3 huse, og bor ca. 2 km fra Sønderborg centrum med udsigt over Alssund.

Vi arbejder ud fra værdier som - respekt - faglighed og selvbestemmelse og vi tror på, at det bedste sker i dialog og tæt samspil med hinanden.

Vi søger en kollega som:
  • Har fokus på faglighed og kvalitet i opgaveløsningen.
  • Ser værdien i selvbestemmelse og inddragelse af beboeren.
  • Arbejder anerkendende og sætter dialog i centrum.
  • Ønsker at være en aktiv del af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok.
  • Har mod på at være medskaber af nye ideer og løsninger.

Vi kan tilbyde:
  • En hverdag præget af meningsfulde opgaver og faglige udfordringer.
  • Tæt samarbejde og støtte fra engagerede kollegaer og ledelse.
    Du bliver en del af et team af social- og sundhedshjælpere/-assistenter og sygeplejersker, som i fællesskab løser de daglige pleje- og omsorgsopgaver.
  • En fleksibel arbejdsplads med respekt for balance mellem arbejde og fritid.

Praktisk info:

Vi søger 2 nye kolleger - SSH/SSA - fra henholdsvis den 1. november og 1. december. Der er tale om fastansættelse og i blandede vagter. Der skal påregnes arbejde hver anden weekend. Ansættelse på 37 timer ugentlig er muligt - vi er fleksible i forhold til timetallet.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold følger overenskomst mellem Kommunernes Landsforening og FOA - Fag og Arbejde.

Ved ansættelse i stillingen vil du blive bedt om samtykke til at vi indhenter straffeattest.

Du kan få yderligere oplysninger ved at kontakte daglig leder Betina Lyck Andersen på telefon 2790 6087.

Ansøgningsfristen er søndag den 25. oktober 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at blive afholdt onsdag den 28. oktober 2026.

Ansøgningen sendes elektronisk.



Sønderborg Kommune - en arbejdsplads i verdensklasse

Sønderborg Kommune er et ambitiøst arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi sammen gør en forskel og skaber et endnu bedre lokalsamfund.

Uanset om du er med til at realisere vores visioner, politiske beslutninger eller leverer kerneydelser af højeste kvalitet tæt på borgerne, bliver du anerkendt for din indsats og dit engagement.

Vi investerer i dig gennem løbende kompetenceudvikling og spot på talentet, så du udvikler dig og når dit fulde potentiale igennem et helt arbejdsliv.

Vi har modet til at vende tingene på hovedet i løsningen af både små og store udfordringer. Det giver nye perspektiver og blik for innovative løsninger.

Vi samarbejder tæt med lokale virksomheder for at fremme vækst og grøn udvikling i vores område, hvilket skaber en dynamisk og inspirerende arbejdsplads.

Vi er en arbejdsplads med høj grad af fleksibilitet, som giver plads til både karriere og fritid.
