title: Servicesassistent søges til Sergentskolen Bangsbo
description:
Vil du være med til at understøtte den daglige drift i Forsvaret?

Trives du med administrative opgaver, koordinering og kontakt med mange forskellige samarbejdspartnere? Har du sans for struktur og service, og motiveres du af en alsidig hverdag med både kontoropgaver og praktiske opgaver? Så er du måske vores nye administrative medarbejder ved Etablissementspartnerelement Frederikshavn.

Om os

Etablissementspartnerelement Frederikshavn er en del af Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen, som understøtter Forsvarets myndigheder med blandt andet drift, service og vedligeholdelse af faciliteter.

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi samarbejder tæt om at levere gode løsninger til vores brugere. Vores hverdag er præget af mange forskellige opgaver og kontaktflader, og vi lægger vægt på høj service, kvalitet og et godt samarbejde.

Om stillingen

Du får en central rolle i den daglige drift og understøttelse af vores brugere og samarbejdspartnere.

Dine primære opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Håndtere indkøb af varer og tjenesteydelser samt tilhørende administration
  • Yde professionel kundeservice til interne og eksterne brugere
  • Administrere arbejdsrekvisitioner, brugerhenvendelser og posthåndtering
  • Foretage budgetopfølgning, rapportering og administrative kontroller
  • Fordele opgaver til interne samarbejdspartnere og bidrage til den daglige drift
Herudover kan der forekomme opgaver som varemodtagelse, administration af nøgle- og briksystemer, eskortering samt øvrige ad hoc-opgaver.

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med administrative arbejdsopgaver og trives i en rolle med mange kontaktflader.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljen
  • Er serviceminded og god til at skabe relationer
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet
  • Har erfaring med administrative systemer og almindelige IT-værktøjer
Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med indkøb, økonomiopfølgning eller lignende administrative funktioner, men det er ikke et krav.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) i staten.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Frederikshavn.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Chef Lars Kornevald på telefon 4054 5979.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Stinne Strøjr Hansen på telefon 2023 9031.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 29. oktober 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt løbende. Stillingen er til besættelse den 1. december 2026.

Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen

Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen (ETK) støtter og servicerer militære og civile myndigheder under Forsvarsministeriet. Vores opgave er at levere og udvikle attraktive fysiske rammer, som er nødvendige for deres daglige virke.
Vi bygger nyt, vedligeholder, driver kantiner og gør rent på tjenestesteder i hele landet.
Vi har på vegne af Forsvarsministeriets koncern ansvaret for det grønne område, der blandt andet omfatter miljø, energi og naturpleje.
Vores hovedkontor er i Hjørring, men vi har medarbejdere i hele landet. Vi er i alt 1600 ansatte, der tæller både civilt og militært ansatte. Vi er en organisation baseret på stærke fagfællesskaber, og vi prioriterer det tværgående samarbejde højt.

• Vi har ansvaret for over 600 lokationer spredt ud over hele Danmark.
• Vi administrer over 6000 bygninger og forvalter øvelsesområder, der samlet set er på størrelse med Mors.
• Vi bygger og vedligeholder i år for knap en milliard og er blandt andet bygherre på store projekter som campus til de nye F35-kampfly.

title: Career Consultant
description:
Join a team of proud, passionate, and caring people that together share their diverse talents and backgrounds to serve our members and grow the game of golf. Being at the PGA of America means you are supported, respected, and appreciated for your contributions.

The Career Consultant for this role supports South Texas and must reside in this territory.


RESPONSIBILITIES (Specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):


Service to PGA Professionals:

  • Provide insightful and meaningful career counseling and career coaching to PGA Professionals throughout their career life cycle from job search and membership to retirement.
  • Provide career services to include job search strategies, resume development, interviewing skills, offer negotiation, and exit and retirement strategies.
  • Promote the benefits and grow the utilization of PGA ExecuSearch, Job Seeker Profiles, the PGA Job Board and other employment tools across PGA platforms (e.g. - PGA.org, PGA.com, PGA member app, etc.).
  • Provide education programs to PGA Professionals through all available venues (national, sections and chapters).
  • Assist PGA Professionals in gathering and utilizing information from PGA and industry data resources.
  • Promote the benefits of the PGA Compensation Survey and other related Association surveys.
  • Promote and generate participation in PGA Player Development programs and strategies and document the value it brings to facilities and PGA Members.

Service to Employers:

  • Provide exceptional hiring services and resources, and assistance to employers to enhance relationships with industry stakeholders. Services and resources include PGA ExecuSearch, hiring process planning, resume review, interview planning, compensation and benefit packages, correspondence, and PGA preferred background check provider.
  • Provide compensation reports within department guidelines.
  • Market the value of PGA Professionals to non-PGA facilities and the industry.
  • Assist in creating awareness of PGA Player Development strategies and programming.

Service to PGA Sections:

  • Manage and maintain relationships with Section leadership, staff, and Section Education and Employment Committees.
  • Partner with Sections to develop employment strategies, and deliver employment presentations and education seminars to industry employers and organizations.
  • Support Section and Chapter membership meetings, Board meetings and special events as needed.
  • Communicate with Section Executive Directors and leadership quarterly (at a minimum) and provide golf industry updates on Employment.
  • Attend Section tournaments/events to cultivate relationships, foster goodwill, and support PGA Section staff.

Association/Departmental Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the development and improvement of PGA Career Services programs, projects, systems, publications and information.
  • Assist in the marketing and promotion of Association and PGA Career Services programs and initiatives.
  • Engage in proactive outreach and collaborate with other Career Consultants to identify candidates for available opportunities.
  • Provide support as needed to non-industry candidates and search support for nontraditional PGA Member roles such as General Managers, Golf Course Superintendents, etc.
  • Provide editorial content and articles for Section newsletters, PGA magazine, and other industry publications.

Contributions to the Game and Business of Golf:

Talent Development

  • Educate and inform the marketplace about the impact PGA Professionals have on the community, golf business, and local economy.
  • Provide field support and collaborate with PGA of America Diversity and Inclusion efforts.
  • Active participant in PGA of America recruiting efforts as needed.

Allied Associations & Partners

  • Establish effective working relationships with the Amateur body, including state and local golf associations.
  • Engage with local chapters of GCSAA, CMAA, and NGCOA.
  • Assist department leaders in improving working relationships with golf management companies.

Golfer Development

  • Participate in player development programs hosted by PGA Professionals, working in conjunction with fellow field staff.
  • Attend community/Section programs providing instruction or programming targeting new and existing golfers as available.

SHARED VALUES:

Embody the organization's shared values and help ensure the organization's values-based culture thrives by proactively identifying and addressing any shared values, challenges and opportunities you are experiencing.


SUPERVISION:

No supervisory responsibilities.


FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITY:

No financial responsibilities.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree: (B.A.) or equivalent in Business Administration, Human Resources, Professional Golf Management (Executive Management preferred) or related field.
  • Five (5) years of experience in golf operations or golf industry management/leadership.
  • Employment/club relations experience, career counseling and Human Resources management training preferred.
  • PGA Member preferred.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:


Job Knowledge/Technology: Must have knowledge of the golf industry and/or golf facility operations, employment and/or recruiting. Knowledge of the PGA of America and Section operations are preferred. Must have knowledge of managing multiple priorities, in a multi-functional work environment. Demonstrated leadership skills and a proven ability to motivate and manage professionals to achieve results. Skilled in customer service and/or sales. Must have a thorough knowledge of administrative principles and procedures with the ability to lead various projects and programs. A knowledge of the organizational functions of a business operation. Must possess a high degree of trust and confidentiality. Basic fluency in artificial intelligence (AI) tools and concepts. This includes using AI to enhance business operations and drive innovation, enabling us to better serve our Members and stakeholders. Working knowledge of Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets, and Google Docs.


Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.


Ability to travel approximately 50% per year.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

PGA does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, veteran status, gender identity or expression, marital or familial status, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, to ensure full equality of opportunity in all operations and activities of the organization, every staff member employed by the PGA shall be selected under fair employment procedures that provide equal employment opportunities to all people. title: Building Operator
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Building Operator performs technical and mechanical work that ensures the physical aspects of the buildings, grounds, amenities, and common areas of the property meet the Company’s standards for cleanliness, appearance, safety, and overall functionality.

A Class 5 Power Engineering License is required for this position.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Completes assigned work orders generated from resident requests for service, as well as preventative maintenance on the property by diagnosing the source or cause of the defect or problem, and making repairs in accordance with established policies, procedures, safety standards, and code requirements.
  • Completes the “make-ready” process to prepare vacant apartment homes for leasing and new move-ins by completing the pre-move-out inspection, creating a “punch” list of maintenance work needed, scheduling vendors and contractors as needed, obtaining needed supplies and materials, completing all maintenance tasks, and inspecting completed work.
  • Follows procedures for accessing and obtaining materials, supplies, equipment, tools, and other items from the property’s maintenance department by tracking inventory used, returning unused items to the established location, and notifying the maintenance supervisor about re-ordering needs.
  • Completes documentation and other paperwork in a timely, accurate, and complete fashion so that service requests can be appropriately documented and tracked.
  • Assists in maintaining the grounds, common areas, and amenities by picking up trash and debris, pressure-washing breezeways and pool areas, performing general cleaning, and painting curbs and signage as needed.
  • Supports cost-cutting and expense control programs by fixing rather than replacing parts when possible, not being wasteful with materials and supplies, and practicing the correct use for tools and equipment.
  • Must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2+ years of residential maintenance experience is required.
  • Incumbents must provide own hand tools unless prohibited by law and must be knowledgeable and skilled in the safe use and maintenance of hand tools, power tools, user-moved aids, mechanical equipment and measuring devices.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply principles of logical thinking to define and correct problems.
  • Proficiency in customer service and interpersonal communication skills in order to effectively interact with residents, clients, team members, and other business contacts, respond courteously to questions and requests, and stay calm when addressing and resolving customer problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to read, write, and communicate effectively to represent company management in a support capacity, act as first point of contact for internal team members and external visitors to the Company, and answer questions related to department operating policies.
  • High School diploma, GED or related experience and/or training.

SPECIALIZED SKILLS:

  • Incumbents must have a valid Class 5 Power Engineering License.
  • Incumbents must have all certifications as required by Municipal and Local jurisdictions.

TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to 11 kilograms independently and 22 kilograms with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

#LI-Onsite

Robust Benefits Offered:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits effective your first day of employment.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 5 family responsibility days and 5 company sick days. Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • Paid Parental Leave Top-Up Benefit (*For eligible team member).
  • Group RRSP with Company Match up to 5% of pay after 3 months of service. Open to full-time and part-time team members, with spousal RRSP and lump sum contribution options.

  • Ongoing Learning Opportunities & Education Assistance Programs.

Greystar does not conduct any interviews via text or messaging, and all communication will come from official Greystar email addresses (@greystar.com). title: Smed til konstruktionsfremstilling og montage i Kolding
description:
Vil du have firmabil, bonusordning og godt socialt sammenhold?

Vi søger en smed til konstruktion og montage i Kolding.

Du lander i et større smede-setup, hvor opgaverne ligger på erhverv. Arbejdet handler om konstruktionsfremstilling, samling, montage og feltarbejde. Nogle opgaver løser du selv, og andre tager du sammen med en makker. Det giver en hverdag, hvor du både skal kunne tage ansvar og spille ordentligt sammen med dem omkring dig.

Firmabilen er en del af pakken, og der er bonusordning oveni lønnen. Det sociale sammenhold er vigtigt her, så du skal have lyst til at være en del af holdet og ikke bare møde ind, svejse færdig og køre hjem. Du bliver behandlet som en voksen fagperson, der kan få tingene gjort ordentligt.

Det får du

Løn: 185-210 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Kolding og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Konstruktion, montage og feltarbejde

Din hverdag

Dagen drejer sig om at få konstruktioner samlet og gjort klar til montage. På værkstedet handler det om præcise samlinger, og ude på opgaven handler det om at få løsningen sat ordentligt på plads.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Fremstiller og samler konstruktioner
  • Monterer løsninger ude hos erhvervskunder
  • Løser feltarbejde på montageopgaver
  • Skærer, borer og tilpasser emner efter mål
  • Arbejder selvstændigt eller sammen med makker alt efter opgaven

Der er bonusordning, og det sociale sammenhold er en del af hverdagen. Du skal derfor både kunne levere godt håndværk og være ordentlig at arbejde ved siden af.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som smed eller fra lignende konstruktionsarbejde
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Har lyst til både konstruktion, samling og montage
  • Møder stabilt og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer
  • Kan tale ordentligt med kolleger og kunder

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet feltarbejde før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage fat og lave arbejde, der kan holde til at blive brugt.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en smed mere i Kolding, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

title: Senior Data R&D Engineer
description:
Job Overview

Responsible for the construction of financial and Web3 data infrastructure tailored for AI application scenarios—building a complete end-to-end chain from external data ingestion and standardized processing to metrics analysis and data services. Capable of independently taking ownership of key modules (technical architecture design to final delivery) and continuously driving improvements in data quality, system stability, and engineering efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Data Architecture & Platform Engineering: Lead core module design and evolution focused on multi-source heterogeneous data ingestion, time-series data processing, and AI data consumption scenarios. Establish scalable data models, ingestion standards, and service contracts while balancing delivery speed, maintenance costs, and long-term scalability.
  • Multi-Source Data Ingestion & Governance: Direct the integration of stock/ETF market feeds, macroeconomic stats, financial news, social sentiment, on-chain data, and DeFi/derivatives metrics. Build reusable collection, parsing, and validation capabilities to resolve multi-source asset mapping, methodology discrepancies, missing data, and historical revisions.
  • Data Processing & Analytics: Translate investment research requirements into explicit data models, metric formulas, and computation logic. Build aggregated analytics and event identification for price anomalies, capital flows, market sentiment, and key market events to empower signal generation, explainability, and backtesting.
  • AI Data Service Layer: Collaborate with product, investment research, and AI/algorithm teams to design data interfaces suited for AI retrieval and tool calling (Function Calling). Refine management mechanisms for raw facts, derived metrics, and AI analysis outputs to guarantee low latency, lineage attribution, and analytical traceability.
  • Performance & Reliability: Manage collection scheduling, concurrency control, idempotent writes, crash recovery, historical backfilling, and data replay mechanisms. Establish measurable data quality/service metrics (SLAs) while constantly optimizing throughput, query latency, storage overhead, and external API call costs.
  • Technical Delivery & Engineering Practices: Own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle—from requirement refinement and architectural design reviews to dev/testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Enhance overall team delivery quality and speed via rigorous code reviews, technical documentation, and AI-assisted software engineering practices.

Qualifications

  • Core Experience: 3+ years of Java backend development experience with a track record of independently leading core modules or complex projects. Proven ability to identify core problems, define system boundaries, evaluate design trade-offs, and drive execution to successful delivery even under ambiguous requirements.
  • Java & System Design Mastery: Deep understanding of concurrency models, thread pools, JVM memory/GC tuning, transaction management, and exception handling. Proficient with Spring Boot; capable of designing modular, easy-to-test, and evolvable services using Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, alongside diagnosing complex performance and stability bottlenecks.
  • Data Modeling & Database Optimization: Proficient in PostgreSQL and JPA/Hibernate with a solid grasp of indexing, transaction isolation levels, locking mechanisms, and query execution plans. Experienced in designing time-series partitioning, batch writes, Upserts, and aggregation queries based on scale and access patterns to resolve performance and consistency issues caused by rapid data growth, concurrent writes, and historical backfills.
  • Data Ingestion & Governance: Experience designing multi-source data adapter and standardization frameworks that systematically handle API schema changes, rate limits/quotas, incremental cursors, duplicate/out-of-order data, and job fault tolerance. Deep understanding of asset tickers, numeric precision, temporal alignment, data lineage, and data quality validation to build verifiable and replayable data pipelines.
  • Distributed Systems Engineering: Proficient with Redis, Dubbo, Nacos, SchedulerX, or equivalent distributed infrastructure. Sound judgment on the operational boundaries of cache consistency, distributed locking, timeout retries, and fault isolation. Skilled in designing task sharding, concurrency control, observability/alerting, and capacity planning around business goals.
  • Data Analysis & Business Abstraction: Hands-on experience in traditional finance, Web3, or both. Deep understanding of the business domain behind financial metrics, underlying data sources, and practical constraints. Proficient in using SQL, scripts, and sample verification to validate analytical conclusions and identify metric drifts, point-in-time mismatches, and data anomalies affecting research signals.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Codex, Claude Code) in daily development. Skilled at organizing prompt requirements, architectural constraints, and code contexts to perform task decomposition, code generation, unit test creation, debugging, and code reviews. title: Leasing Professional - Haven
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Property Type: Lease - Up

Unit Count: 134

Schedule: Wednesday-Sunday; 9am-6pm *subject to change depending on business needs.

Requirements: 3-5 years of leasing experience required. Lease - up experience preferred.



Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.


Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.



#LI-DZ1

The pay range for this position is $23.00 - $25.00/hour. (Menifee, CA)


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.

title: CADD Technician
description:
Ready to grow your CADD career with a team that actually supports you? Hampton, Lenzini and Renwick, Inc. (HLR) is a growing, employee-owned engineering consulting firm looking for a CADD Technician to join our Geospatial department. With offices across Illinois, this position can be located in any of our locations; Elgin, IL - Springfield, IL - Mt. Carmel, IL. We offer a flexible, fun work environment and a highly competitive benefits package. You'll collaborate daily with engineers, land surveyors, and environmental scientists, utilizing tools like Bentley, TopoDOT, and ArcGIS. Best of all, you won't be left on an island-you'll be guided by a strong technical mentor and backed by a collaborative team of techs and engineers invested in your success.


Hampton, Lenzini and Renwick, Inc. (HLR), an employee-owned company, has an opportunity for a motivated CADD Technician professional to join our team. The ideal candidate is a quick learner, organized, detail-oriented, and committed to quality. The position may be in any of our offices and reports to the Geospatial Manager.


On any given day, you'll:

Work closely with engineers on the development of plans and drawings for our local agency clients. Attention to detail and communication between engineer and technician are key to being successful in this position.

Responsibilities

  • Generate terrain models, corridors, horizontal and vertical alignments, cross-sections, and plan sheets using Bentley OpenRoads Designer (ORD) and MicroStation.
  • Utilize TopoDOT in conjunction with MicroStation to extract existing topographic linework, features, and surface models from 3D laser scan data.
  • Produce structural drawings, civil roadway plans, profiles, and detail sheets in compliance with client and IDOT standards.
  • Utilize ArcGIS Pro and ArcMap to view, process, and integrate spatial data into design workflows.
  • Perform quantity calculations, earthwork computations, dimensions, and routine engineering design support.
  • Read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, or government regulations regarding CADD related requirements.
  • Maintain expertise in evolving CADD, Surveying, and Geospatial software, processes, and industry standards.
  • Utilize Google Workspace, Microsoft Excel, and Word for effective project organization, documentation, and team communication.

Qualifications and Desired Skills and Experiences

  • Technical degree in Civil Engineering Technology, CADD, Surveying/Geospatial Technology, or equivalent (0-5 years of practical experience).
  • Proficiency or working knowledge of MicroStation and OpenRoads Designer (ORD).
  • Experience or familiarity using TopoDOT for point cloud feature extraction.
  • Working knowledge of Autodesk Civil 3D is a plus.
  • Experience with ArcGIS Pro and/or ArcMap.
  • Comfortable working in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Google Workspace environments.
  • Basic plan reading skills and familiarity with IDOT/local agency CADD standards.
  • Valid driver's license.

title: Private Banking-rådgiver til Vejle
description:
Vil du rådgive formuende kunder og være med til at udvikle en af Sydjyllands stærkeste Private Banking-forretninger?

Vi søger en Private Banking-rådgiver til vores afdeling i Vejle. Opgaven er en fortsat udvikling af en eksisterende portefølje i tæt samarbejde med afdelingens erhvervs- og investeringsrådgivere.

I Vejle bliver du en del af en stærk Private Banking-afdeling, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe værdi for vores kunder på tværs af afdelingen. Du får en selvstændig rolle med ansvar for egne kunder, men du bliver samtidig en del af et fagligt miljø med kompetente kolleger, korte beslutningsveje og et tæt samarbejde på tværs af banken.

Afdelingen består i dag af 10 medarbejdere og har ambitioner om fortsat vækst i de kommende år.

  • Helhedsorienteret rådgivning af formuende privatkunder og ejerledere
  • Rådgivning om investering, pension, finansiering og formueplanlægning
  • Videreudvikling af en eksisterende kundeportefølje
  • Opbygning af nye kunderelationer og tiltrækning af nye Private Banking-kunder

Om os
Ringkjøbing Landbobank er en kundefokuseret relationsbank med 21 afdelinger og omkring 700 medarbejdere. Vi kombinerer stærk lokal tilstedeværelse med moderne digitale løsninger og tilbyder skræddersyet rådgivning til privat-, erhvervs- og private banking-kunder samt udvalgte nicher.

Vores kultur bygger på passion, gode relationer og en grundlæggende tro på, at vi lykkes bedst sammen. Medarbejdertrivslen er i top, og vi hjælper hinanden til fælles bedste – både for kunderne og bankens udvikling.

Vi er stolte af at være kåret som Årets Bank 10 år i træk, og vi gør os umage hver dag for at leve op til den tillid.

title: Senior Photonics Packaging Engineer
description:
The Mission

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications.

Getting photonic integrated circuits (PICs) out of the lab and into packaged, manufacturable modules is one of the hardest problems in our field, and often the one that decides whether a promising chip becomes a product. As a diverse team of 16, we are at an inflection point, growing our engineering capability to take our photonic interconnect technology from prototype toward scalable, production-ready products.

As Senior Photonics Packaging Engineer, you own that transition. You will work in tight collaboration with our electronic, R&D and photonic engineers and our CTO, with real influence over technical direction as we scale.

Key Responsibilities

You own the packaging of our PICs end to end: turning a functional die into a robust, manufacturable module. In practice that spans the optical interface (fiber attach, alignment and bonding), the electrical interface (from DC and control lines through to high-speed RF interconnect), and the substrate or interposer that ties them together, glass, silicon, ceramic or organic. Few people have worked on all of these in equal depth, and we don't expect you to have. We do expect you to understand how a choice in one area constrains the others, and to be able to reason through the trade-offs with us.

Alongside the builds, you'll advance our packaging methods from bench-level assembly toward repeatable, pilot-production-ready processes, characterise what you build yourself and use the results to debug and refine, and bring packaging constraints upstream into design reviews so that packageability and yield are designed in rather than fixed later. You'll also help establish engineering and characterisation processes that suit a small, fast-moving team today and still hold up as we grow.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years in photonics engineering with deep, hands-on expertise in advanced PIC packaging. Demonstrated ownership of at least one packaging technology from lab prototype toward pilot production is highly preferred.

  • Technical Background: A strong engineering or scientific background in photonics, integrated optics or a related field, with genuine hands-on advanced PIC packaging experience. You should have a working understanding of the breadth of modern packaging, optical coupling and attach, high-speed RF and DC electrical interfaces, and interposer and substrate technologies, even where your own depth sits in one or two of them. Working knowledge of optical characterisation methods and instrumentation, and comfort interpreting the data yourself, is essential.

  • Education: A master's or Ph.D. in Photonics, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.

  • Nice to have: Photonic design or modelling experience, comfort running simulations to inform packaging trade-offs, reliability qualification experience, or experience working with external foundry, substrate or assembly partners.

  • Collaboration & Communication: You are a clear communicator who can engage both engineering peers and leadership on technical trade-offs. You are comfortable operating with autonomy and thrive in a small, collaborative, fast-paced deep-tech environment.

The Perks

We care about your long-term growth and well-being. We offer performance-based stock options, healthcare insurance, professional development support, and a positive culture with free snacks. You will also enjoy standard Danish benefits, including 5 weeks of paid holiday and maternity/paternity leave.

How To Apply

If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial l journey, we encourage you to submit your CV and a cover letter.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Phanofi is committed to providing a workplace where equal opportunity and non-discrimination are fundamental principles. In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

For more information or questions please contact us at haris@phanofi.com

Working at

Phanofi

In today's data-centric world, seamless and high-speed communication is essential. Phanofi is at the forefront of this revolution, dedicated to building faster, greener, and more scalable data centers for generations to come. As a hardware spin-off from the Technical University of Denmark, Phanofi leverages cutting-edge photonics technology to redefine the limits of data transmission. Our innovative solutions are designed to empower AI computing for the future generation. Join us on this exciting journey as we build a photonics powerhouse in Denmark and shape the future of data communication!

description:

title: Product Owner – Warehouse Management System (WMS)
description:
Product Owner – Warehouse Management System (WMS)

Sebagai Product Owner, Anda akan bertanggung jawab dalam mengembangkan dan mengoptimalkan Warehouse Management System (WMS) secara end-to-end. Anda akan menjadi penghubung antara kebutuhan bisnis dan operasional warehouse dengan tim teknologi untuk memastikan solusi yang dikembangkan mampu menyelesaikan permasalahan operasional dan memberikan dampak bisnis yang terukur.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

  • Product Roadmap & Backlog: Menyusun, memprioritaskan, dan mengelola product roadmap serta product backlog berdasarkan kebutuhan bisnis dan prioritas operasional.

  • Problem & Process Analysis: Mengidentifikasi permasalahan, bottleneck, dan peluang improvement pada proses warehouse dan inventory management.

  • Product Requirement: Menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis dan operasional menjadi product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, serta dokumentasi produk yang jelas.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Berkolaborasi dengan tim Business, Warehouse, Logistics, UI/UX, Engineering, dan QA dalam proses pengembangan produk.

  • End-to-End Product Development: Mengawal pengembangan fitur mulai dari discovery, development, testing, hingga release dan post-release evaluation.

  • System Integration: Memastikan WMS dapat berfungsi secara optimal serta terintegrasi dengan sistem lain dalam ekosistem perusahaan.

  • Product Performance: Memonitor product performance, user feedback, dan operational metrics untuk mengevaluasi efektivitas fitur dan dampaknya terhadap efisiensi serta akurasi operasional warehouse.

  • Continuous Improvement: Mengidentifikasi dan menginisiasi improvement berdasarkan data, feedback pengguna, serta perkembangan kebutuhan bisnis.

Minimum Requirements

  • Memiliki pengalaman 1–3 tahun sebagai Product Owner atau Product Manager, khususnya dalam pengembangan produk berbasis teknologi.

  • Memiliki insight dan pemahaman yang baik mengenai Warehouse Management System (WMS) serta proses operasional warehouse.

  • Memiliki pemahaman mengenai Logistics Management System dan proses bisnis/logistik end-to-end.

  • Memiliki pemahaman mengenai Supply Chain Management dan keterkaitannya dengan proses warehouse dan logistics.

  • Memiliki kemampuan problem solving dan analytical thinking yang kuat, termasuk kemampuan menggunakan data untuk melakukan problem validation dan pengambilan keputusan.

  • Memahami proses product development lifecycle, mulai dari discovery, requirement gathering, development, testing, hingga release.

  • Mampu menyusun product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, dan product backlog dengan baik.

  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan kolaborasi yang baik untuk bekerja dengan stakeholder bisnis, operasional, dan tim teknologi.

  • Pengalaman langsung dalam mengembangkan atau mengelola produk WMS, Logistics, atau Supply Chain menjadi nilai tambah.

title: Payment Business Risk and Resilience Lead, Vice President
description:
Who we are looking for:

We are looking for a strategic, delivery-focused payments leader to lead the business execution of our Payments Risk and Resiliency Programs across payment anomaly detection, end-to-end payment traceability, and SWIFT resiliency. The successful candidate will establish integrated governance, align business and technology delivery, manage interdependencies, lead the transition from project implementation to a sustainable business-as-usual operating model, and assume ongoing ownership and daily management of these capabilities to ensure their continued effectiveness, governance, and delivery of business outcomes


Why this role is important to us?

Our Payments Risk and Resiliency Programs are intended to strengthen payment messaging resilience through improved end-to-end traceability, anomaly detection and response, and infrastructure readiness. This role provides the senior business leadership needed to connect the three workstreams, maintain delivery discipline and ensure that new capabilities become controlled, scalable and operationally effective services.

Join us if contributing to our Payments Risk and Resiliency Programs is a challenge you are up for.


What you will be responsible for

  • Own the integrated business delivery plan, scope, roadmap, governance and executive reporting across the three Payments Risk and Resiliency workstreams.
  • Translate the programme charter and business requirements into prioritized deliverables, accountable owners, milestones, dependencies and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional engagement across Payments Operations, Technology, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Risk, Compliance, Client Service, Finance and SWIFT stakeholders.
  • Direct the business analysis approach, ensuring requirements, process maps, operating model decisions, controls, user stories and acceptance criteria are complete and traceable.
  • Oversee anomaly detection implementation, including operating model design and implementation, rule management, data requirements, case management, explainability, exception handling, approval controls, testing and production readiness.
  • Oversee payment traceability delivery, including application inventory, lifecycle-event mapping, payment identifier correlation, exception visibility, access controls and client-safe status design.
  • Coordinate SWIFT resilience planning, readiness, governance decisions, test strategy, adoption planning and alignment with the anomaly and traceability workstreams.
  • Establish the Anomaly Detection target operating model, resourcing, training, procedures, service measures, control framework, and transition plan to BAU, assuming ongoing ownership and management of the function following implementation.
  • Manage delivery risks, funding and resource dependencies, escalating decisions and issues with clear options and recommendations.
  • Align anomaly detection and cyber-response processes so suspicious or incorrect payment activity is triaged effectively during resilience events.
  • Represent the programme at steering committees and senior forums using concise, evidence-based reporting.

What we value:

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

  • Senior leadership, operations and programme delivery experience in global payments, treasury, settlement or financial market infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end payment flows, SWIFT messaging, screening, operational controls, resilience and technology dependencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead business and technology change from discovery through implementation and BAU transition.
  • Excellent governance, executive communication, stakeholder influence and decision-making skills.
  • Strong risk, control, regulatory and audit awareness, including operational resilience and data protection considerations.

Education & Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, technology, risk or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of relevant financial services experience, including senior programme or change leadership.
  • Experience leading multi-workstream payment or operational resilience programmes is highly valued.

$110,000 - $188,750 Annual

  • Prepare construction drawings, specifications, and cost estimates for projects.
  • Perform cable rating studies and cable pulling calculations.
  • Conduct load flow analysis, voltage drop studies, and reliability assessments.

  • Conduct field visits with customers and electrical contractors to determine required system additions needed to support new and additional customer loads.
  • Coordinate work with customers to meet service requested delivery dates.
  • Investigate customer service issues and lead the development of solutions.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and field teams to ensure project execution.
  • Form an effective team relationship with operating company management to communicate network issues and improvement needs.

  • Technical Expertise: Exhibits journey level proficiency plus advanced knowledge that enables the engineer to serve as a leader within the assigned organization. Keeps abreast of new products, developments, technologies, procedures and equipment. Understands and analyzes interrelationships between systems and component equipment. Interprets codes and regulations and develops standards relevant to the area of assignment.



  • Leadership & Guidance: Provides guidance and exercises judgment and discretion in providing guidance and direction to other Engineers. Leads, facilitates and coordinates work activities of others within the work group, team, department, corporate entity, or those external to the company as required to perform all routine engineering work. Ensures all work activities are performed in accordance with the policies, practices, standards and rules of the company and complies with the regulations and procedures required by external agencies. Promotes engineering professionalism and standards. Coordinates and conducts training sessions.



  • Planning & Organization Ability: Participates in the development of plans by establishing measurable goals, objectives and requirements for specific areas of responsibility. Coordinates the development of input necessary to establish projected cost of all projects. Is proficient in use of scheduling techniques (CPM, PERT, flow charts, etc.) for budget and planning activities. Identifies and initiates appropriate corrective action when objectives are not being met.

title: Intern - Drug Product Manufacturing
description:
Do you want to work with stakeholders at all levels across a multinational pharmaceutical company? Are you skilled at handling data and do you have good communication skills? Are you academically strong and want to use your abilities to make your own mark on the world?

Then an internship in Drug Product Manufacturing (DPM) at FUJIFILM Biotechnologies (FLBD) in Hillerød is the place for you. An internship at FLBD includes specific tasks related to management, such as following up on the execution of Operational Readiness, as well as tasks related to process establishment and execution.


You will be part of a large international project that you can influence, while gaining an exceptional opportunity to gain in-depth knowledge of a wide range of processes of different natures in a large international company in rapid development. You get your foot into the biotechnology industry and get to work directly with a new high-tech filling-line, as well as the critical operations management systems and underlying culture that enable operations. You are keen to make a difference by being part of a factory that delivers medicine to patients.


What you’ll do:

  • Participate in projects of different natures.
  • Perform communication tasks.
  • Conduct data analysis and visualization.
  • Independently drive larger or smaller projects.
  • Facilitate board meetings.
  • Design operations management systems.
  • Train and coach various LEAN tools.
  • Perform various ad-hoc tasks.

About you:

  • Currently enrolled in a relevant education in Denmark.
  • Good oral and written skills in English.
  • Able to analyze different types of data/processes and draw concrete, relevant conclusions.
  • You show commitment, curiosity, and drive.
  • Proficient IT skills are an advantage; skills within the Microsoft Office suite are required.
  • You may get to work extensively with Tableau, Alteryx, and Microsoft Power Suite.
  • Your learning and development during your time at FUJIFILM Biotechnologies Denmark is owned by you - you set the ambition and direction yourself.

Everyday life as an intern in DPM meets your creative skills and curious qualities, while there is great independence and freedom in solving tasks. You can influence your role as an intern, depending on your interests, skills, and ambitions. This means, among other things, that you can try your hand at different roles such as facilitator, project manager on smaller projects, and independent tasks.

In DPM, we work with SHINGO’s Principles of Culture of Excellence, and this is a fantastic opportunity to help build a LEAN organization from scratch if your interests and skills match the task.

Practicalities:

  • Internship type: Full-time (37 hours/week)
  • Duration: 5–6 months
  • Start: 1 February 2027
  • Location: Hillerød, Denmark

Eligibility requirement:

  • It is a requirement that students receive full ECTS credits for the semester to be considered for the internship.
  • Your enrolment must permit a full-time internship (for work-permit compliance).

Application process:

Please submit your resume and cover letter in English as soon as possible, detailing your experience and motivation for applying to this internship. Also confirm that you can start in February 2027 and complete a 5–6 month, full-time (37 hours/week) internship as part of your education, awarding ECTS points, and that you are permitted to do a full-time internship while enrolled in your academic program (for work-permit purposes).

If you have any questions or doubts, feel free to contact Continuous Improvement Partner Vincent Pedersen at +45 41 94 53 86 or at vincentflemmingmoeller.pedersen@fujifilm.com

Working at FUJIFILM Biotechnologies

We offer a competitive compensation package in a site/company growing rapidly, with many opportunities for individual growth, we also offer access to fitness and an attractive canteen.

FUJIFILM Biotechnologies is an industry-leading Biologics Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) with locations in Hillerød, Denmark, Teesside, UK, RTP, North Carolina and College Station, Texas, USA. We use our skills, dedication, and ambition to enable impact for the world’s most innovative biotech and biopharma companies reimagining healthcare’s potential. We work across the entire lifecycle of our customers’ products – enabling success throughout. Every cure, vaccine, biologic, and advancement we contribute to starts with our people and our passion. We fuel one another’s passion, help accelerate progress, expand capabilities, strengthen innovation, and improve processes to improve lives.

Our Manufacturing site in Hillerød, Denmark, brings together a complete range of expertise, capabilities, and technologies to manufacture advanced biologics. As we continue to enhance and expand our capabilities, we are looking for people who share our passion, drive, and energy – what we call Genki – to join our team.

We offer the chance to be part of a global workplace where passion, drive, and commitment are met with opportunities for professional and personal development. Deeply committed to diversity and inclusion, we ensure that everyone no matter their background or gender has an opportunity to develop. We take pride in enriching our communities, caring for our environment, and cultivating a world of opportunity for future generations.

We aim to foster a collaborative, innovative and rewarding environment, where diverse perspectives and people come together united by a common purpose and shared values. We pursue our fullest potential as individual contributors and team members. We strive to be the employer of choice and offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.

description:

title: Selvstændig og kvalitetsbevidst maler søges til Raunstrup Bygningsservice A/S – Nordjylland
description:
Motiveres du af frihed under ansvar? Har du et skarpt øje for den håndværksmæssige finish, og vil du være en del af en veletableret, landsdækkende byggekoncern med ordnede forhold?

Grundet fortsat høj efterspørgsel på vores service- og renoveringsydelser søger Raunstrup Bygningsservice A/S en dygtig og selvstændig malersvend til vores afdeling i Aalborg.

Vi løser opgaver for store landsdækkende virksomheder samt forsikringsselskaber i hele Nordjylland. Som vores nye kollega får du en hverdag med høj grad af tillid, hvor du kører direkte ud til kunderne hjemmefra i din egen fuldt udstyrede servicebil.

Effektiv digital hverdag med fokus på kvalitet

I denne stilling bliver du ansvarlig for dine egne maleropgaver fra opstart til afslutning. Du vil opleve en struktureret hverdag, hvor alle opgaver er planlagt for dig på forhånd og tilgængelige via din tablet eller smartphone. Dine primære sparringspartnere vil være kontoret og vores taksatorer, som sikrer det rette grundlag for opgavernes udførelse.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver omfatter:

  • Alsidigt malerarbejde, herunder finspartling, slibning og maling i forbindelse med renoveringer.

  • Service- og genopretningsopgaver hos både hjemme ved private og hos erhvervsdrivende.

  • Sikring af optimal kvalitet, finish og kundetilfredshed på hver enkelt sag.

  • Digital registrering og dokumentation af det udførte arbejde på pladsen.

Vi tilbyder attraktive rammer og professionelle vilkår:

  • Højt udstyrsniveau: Fast servicebil til rådighed, fuldt udstyret med kvalitetsværktøj samt funktionelt arbejdstøj med firmalogo.

  • Frihed og fleksibilitet: Stor selvstændighed til at tilrettelægge din egen arbejdsdag med udgangspunkt fra din bopæl.

  • Tryghed i ansættelsen: Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer samt en fuldt dækkende sundhedsordning med hurtig diagnose og behandling.

  • Fagligt fællesskab: Løbende fællesmøder med struktureret videndeling, ledelsesmæssig sparring og en god, uhøjtidelig omgangstone i teamet.

Vores forventninger til dine faglige og personlige kvalifikationer:

  • Baggrund: Du er uddannet maler og har flere års dokumenteret erfaring fra lignende service- eller renoveringsstillinger.

  • Håndværksmæssig stolthed: Du er kvalitetsbevidst, har sans for detaljen og leverer altid et professionelt resultat.

  • Adfærd: Du er serviceminded, præsentabel og velformuleret i din dialog med kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

  • Arbejdsform: Du arbejder løsningsorienteret, tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og trives i en hverdag med mange skiftende projekter.

  • Formalia: Du besidder et gyldigt kørekort (kategori B) og er fortrolig med brugen af digitale værktøjer (tablet/smartphone) i det daglige arbejde.

Da vi udfører arbejde for flere kunder hvor straffeattest er et krav, der skal derfor ved ansættelse fremvises en straffeattest.

Vil du være en del af Raunstrup?

Raunstrup ønsker at fremme ligestilling og mangfoldighed og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen.

Hvis du ønsker at blive en del af et velfungerende team, hvor godt håndværk og den gode kundeoplevelse er i højsædet, bedes du kontakte Driftsleder Alex Aagaard på tlf. 24 63 02 08 for en uddybende samtale om stillingen.

Om Raunstrup A/S

Raunstrup Bygningsservice er en del af Raunstrup A/S, som er en moderne og nytænkende landsdækkende byggekoncern med over 480 ansatte. Vi blev grundlagt i 1967 og råder i dag over afdelinger i Aarhus, Randers, Silkeborg, Aalborg, Esbjerg, Vejle, Sorø, Ringsted og Odense. Vores stærke kompetencer inden for bygningsservice samt total-, hoved- og fagentrepriser danner grundlaget for koncernens fortsatte vækst og positive udvikling.

title: MK2 Crew Lander GN&C Engineer III - Lunar Permanence
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

As part of a hardworking team of engineers, you will join our Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GN&C) team. You will share in the team’s impact on GN&C models, analysis, and flight code for spacecraft from Earth to the Moon! You will work with software-in-the-loop simulations, hardware-in-the-loop labs, and on-vehicle simulations. You will collaborate with other engineers in derivation and development of subsystem requirements, performing analyses and trade studies to validate requirements, and maintaining subsystem specification, budgets, and performance metrics. In this capacity, you will be responsible for exemplifying best practices, balanced technical judgment, and superior work ethic.


We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Actively involved in the development of the tools needed to design, build, deploy and support our unique and state-of-the art simulation infrastructure
  • Develop and integrate multidisciplinary models for a multi-vehicle simulation using Simulink and C/C++
  • Support the definition, development, and execution of simulations and tools necessary for verification of subsystem functionalities
  • Perform analyses and trades necessary in the development and verification of subsystem requirements
  • Assist in the development of GN&C algorithms and flight software
  • Support verification and testing, ensuring the subsystem complies to its requirements
  • Interact with engineers across disciplines to assist with and ensure validation of models

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.S. in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, or systems engineering
  • Applied industry experience and/or M.S. or Ph.D. focused on GN&C
  • Experience in modeling GN&C components, and analyzing performance of GN&C subsystem or components via simulation, testing, or analytical methods
  • Strong fundamentals in rigid body dynamics, fluid mechanics, and 1st principles physics-based mathematical models
  • Hands-on experience with testing frameworks and Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines such as Gitlab Understands relationship between GN&C, vehicle sizing, and vehicle automation
  • Knowledge in control, navigation, and astrodynamics fundamentals

title: Kundeservicemedarbejder til Rito
description:

er en succesfuld webshop med salg af garn og kreative hobbyartikler. Vi er 95 engagerede medarbejdere, der brænder for at give vores kunder den bedste oplevelse hver gang. Vi sælger varer i 10 lande – 7 inden for EU og 3 uden for EU (US, UK + NO).

title: Technical Services Librarian
description:
The City of Indianola is currently welcoming applications for the position of a full-time Technical Services Librarian.

The City of Indianola (pop. 16, 069) is a growing community with a historic downtown, located approximately 15 minutes south of Des Moines. It is a safe community with Midwestern values, friendly people and excellent schools. Indianola, which is home to Simpson College, the world-renowned Des Moines Metro Opera and the National Balloon Museum and U.S. Ballooning Hall of Fame, is known for its excellent access to outdoor activities, a nice trail system, five major parks and two golf courses. The community welcomes thousands of visitors annually who come to Indianola to enjoy major events such as the National Balloon Classic, the Warren County Fair and other events.

Under the Director's supervision, coordinates the day-to-day operations of circulation services while performing and overseeing technical services activities that support the organization, accessibility, and maintenance of the library's collections. This position provides excellent service to library users, supervises circulation workflows, and performs duties related to cataloging, classification, acquisitions, processing, and collection maintenance.

This position is responsible for a number of tasks, including, but not limited to:

  • Coordinates daily circulation operations, and resolves issues related to patron accounts and library records.
  • Monitors circulation activity and resolves patron account, materials, and service issues.
  • Trains Library Assistants in circulation tasks.
  • Manages and maintains the library's Integrated Library System (ILS), print management systems, and circulation software to resolve technology issues, updates, upgrades, and replacements.
  • Servers as liaison between the library and automation vendors, sales representatives and City technology staff to resolve technology issues, updates, upgrades, and replacements.
  • Develops, implements, and manages cataloging, processing, mending, and overdue procedures of library materials.

The successful candidate will have:

  • Associates degree from an accredited college or university required, with a Master of Library Science degree preferred.
  • 1-3 years prior experience working in a library or experience working with targeted age groups; or any equivalent combination of experience and training which provides the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities.
  • Proficiency in working with computers and on-line electronic resources.
  • Must have Public Library Staff Certification with the State of Iowa or become certified within one year of employment.

Salary range is $28.08/hour ($58,426.92 annually) to $37.95/hr. ($78,393.97 annually) with benefits. This is a full-time union position with a comprehensive benefits package that includes vacation, sick leave, personal leave, life insurance and AD&D, short and long-term disability, health, dental, and vision insurance, retirement, tuition reimbursement, and an employee assistance program. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a post-offer drug screening and background check. Cover letter and resume required.

The City of Indianola is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need any accommodations during the selection process because of a disability, please notify the Human Resources department at (515) 961-9410 and we will provide appropriate accommodations.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a post-offer drug screening and background check

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Toronto)
description:
LumApps is now more than just an Employee Experience Platform — it is an AI-powered Employee Hub that supports companies in their digital transformation of communication, collaboration, and engagement with their customers, partners, and above all their employees.

Our platform is a proven leader in this dynamic market with a truly unique vision and product. It has been deployed by Fortune 500 clients around the world and is delivering meaningful business benefits. LumApps is identified as a leader in Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Intranet Packaged Solutions as well as in Intranets Forrester Wave, and regularly selected for the French Tech Next40/120 program.

✨ In 2025, LumApps strengthened its leadership position by partnering with Beekeeper, a pioneer in frontline employee experience solutions. This strategic collaboration expands our reach and impact across all types of workers — from HQ to the frontline.

Our mission: To make people feel that they belong and have a purpose.

To create an environment where all employees are engaged and work together towards the same goal. Over 700 leading companies trust our solution to:

🎯 Improve the productivity of their teams with our AI-powered Collaborative Experience Platform integrated with both Google and Microsoft collaborative suites,

🎯 Transform employees into real ambassadors of their company,

🎯 Make employees more efficient and better connected to their peers and relevant information, regardless of their location, with the tools and information they need at their fingertips,

🎯 Help companies reduce turnover, accelerate employee onboarding, better collaborate and share knowledge, and even improve their customer experiences.

With a team of over 600 Lumies spread across 11 offices (Lyon, Paris, Lille, Sophia Antipolis, London, Barcelona, Hamburg, Austin, Tokyo, Zurich, Krakow), we support large enterprises all around the world. Over the past year, we have been driving an ambitious phase in our journey under the impulse of our new shareholder Bridgepoint, aimed at propelling us to become the clear leader in our market and shine worldwide in our industry. We are looking for individuals who are excited to actively participate in this transformation.

If these core values sound like you: "be bold, do amazing things", "say what you mean, do what you say", "one team, same mission", "always be evolving": apply now!

*The Enterprise AI Challenge*

While the market focuses on Generative AI prototypes, the true challenge for global enterprises lies in production and scale. Generic AI models often fail because they lack context and cannot securely access siloed enterprise data like ERPs, HRIS, or legacy systems.

LumApps AI is a high-velocity initiative focused on solving this "Last Mile Integration" problem. We are the bridge between our core platform and customer value. We don’t just license a platform; we deploy top engineering talent to the front lines to ensure AI becomes a secure, deeply integrated, and scalable force multiplier for the modern workforce.

*The Role*

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are the "tip of the spear" for our most strategic initiative. You will solve hard technical truths on the ground, accelerating the adoption of our core AI technologies: Micro-Apps and Agents.

You will sit at the intersection of engineering and customer impact, navigating technical constraints to deploy live, ROI-generating AI Agents within rapid cycles. This is a rare opportunity to accelerate your career by working with senior leadership and opening doors toward future roles as an architect, tech lead, or product manager.

Candidates must be located in the Greater Toronto Area to be considered. The salary range associated with this position is $160K - $190K CAD.

*Missions*

  • Strategic Co-Innovation: Embed with customers to map complex data environments and identify high-friction business workflows, such as HR onboarding or IT support.

  • Rapid Prototyping & Delivery: Build proof-of-concept AI Agents and integrations using APIs, webhooks, and LLMs that plan, decide, and act within the LumApps ecosystem.

  • Enterprise Integration: Architect the middleware and custom connectors required to bridge LumApps with systems like SAP, Workday, or ServiceNow.

  • Field Feedback Loop: Act as the trailblazer for our Core R&D team. You will identify systemic integration patterns in the field and contribute code to harden and evolve our core platform, as well as abstract your custom solutions into scalable, repeatable "Industry Vertical Packs."

*Skills*

  • Bring 6+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, with demonstrated excellence in analytical thinking and software development.

  • Get-it-done Mindset: A strong bias for action and the ability to self-prioritize in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

  • Full-Stack Fluency: Proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, Java or Python. You should be comfortable with frontend frameworks like React and backend API design.

  • Innovation Curiosity: A passion for emerging tech, specifically Generative AI, RAG architecture, AI Frameworks and Agentic workflows.

  • Communication: Full professional proficiency in English to communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customers.

  • Availability to Travel: Willingness to travel for regular on-site workshops with customers across North America.

*Bonus Skills*

  • Consultant Mindset: Experience working directly with customers, understanding their needs and designing high-value solutions to fulfill their expectations

  • Agile Experience: Experience working in Scrum environments.

  • Security Knowledge: Understanding of enterprise identity frameworks like OICD, OAuth 2.0 or SAML.

  • Professional Fluency: Bilingual in English and French.

💡 Why You’ll Love Working at LumApps

At LumApps, we believe in fostering an environment where every team member feels valued, supported, and empowered to thrive. Here's a glimpse of what we offer:

🏖️ Generous Paid Leave – 25 vacation days (prorated based on hire date), 9 sick days, 10 paid holidays, plus 2 floating holidays

🏥 Health Insurance – United Healthcare, 100% employer-paid benefits from day 1

💰 401k Retirement Plan – We match 100% of your contribution up to 4%

👶 Family-Friendly Policy – Inclusive maternity & paternity leave

🎉 Team Celebrations & Seasonal Events – Because culture matters

💻 Equipment of Your Choice – We provide you with a company laptop

We aim to celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.
