title: Performance Associate - Houston, TX
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Performance Specialist plays a key role in driving operational excellence for our regional assets by analyzing performance metrics, identifying needs, and strategizing coaching and training initiatives. This role aims to drive leasing and customer service efforts through assessing multiple avenues of data and action plans.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Review Weekly Operations Reports (WOR) to assess trends and identify performance opportunities.
  • Develop performance agendas for site visits, focusing on leasing and customer service
  • Create leasing action plans with clear accountability and due dates.
  • Maintain and manage conversion tracking spreadsheets.
  • Assist in planning and executing marketing and retention events.
  • Schedule and coordinate performance visits, including sending calendar invites.
  • Evaluate lead management practices, including email response time/ etiquette and phone call quality via LM Systems.
  • Create coaching plans based on on-site observations to support leasing training.
  • Collaborate with the Sr. Manager to develop training reviews for lead management, leasing, and customer service.
  • Update and distribute the Broadstone Weekly Report.
  • Analyze shopping reports and develop action plans when performance gaps are identified.
  • Review and coach teams on DARs (Daily Activity Report) as needed.
  • Organize and participate in “Kick Off” meetings for new initiatives or properties.
  • Monitor Kingsley and Reputation platform scores and develop customer service action plans when targets are not met.
  • Shadow team members on phone, email, and in-person interactions to evaluate sales performance and create coaching plans.
  • Conduct on-site reviews of lead management systems and scores, offering strategies to improve performance.
  • Review action plans with Community Managers and gather insights on additional performance challenges.
  • Hold weekly meetings with the Sr. Manager to plan ahead and address any emerging challenges.
  • Facilitate coaching sessions through site visits, virtual meetings, and regional workshops (e.g., Leasing, ACM/CM meetings, New Hire training, Roundtables).
  • Participate in meetings with Regional Property Managers to discuss property-specific training needs.

#LI-AK1


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.

title: Technology Intern
description:
Thank you for your interest in employment with the Desert Research Institute. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. We ask that you keep in mind the following when completing your application:

  • Once you start the application process you cannot save your work. Please ensure you have all required attachment(s) available to complete your application before you begin the process.

  • Please see the application instructions under each posting for information on submittal deadlines.

If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, contact Human Resources Hotline at (775) 673-7431 or recruit@dri.edu.

Job Description

Nevada Robotics at DRI is hiring four part-time Technology Interns to work in Northern Nevada up to 12 hours a week during the 2026-2027 school year.

The Desert Research Institute (DRI) is Nevada’s nonprofit environmental research institution and a member of the Nevada System of Higher Education. Founded in 1959, DRI conducts world-class scientific research focused on some of the most pressing environmental challenges facing communities in Nevada and around the globe. Its scientists study topics such as water resources, air quality, renewable energy, ecosystem health, drought, wildfire, and environmental resilience. With campuses in Reno and Las Vegas, DRI brings together scientists, engineers, educators, and students to develop science-based solutions that improve human and environmental health. The institute is known for its innovative research, including studies of atmospheric processes, hydrology, earth and ecosystem sciences, groundwater management, and water sustainability.

Nevada Robotics is a statewide education outreach and workforce development program that empowers students, educators, and communities through hands-on robotics, drone, engineering, and technology learning experiences. Its vision is a Nevada education system where all students have early and equal access to engaging and quality computer science instruction to build a foundation for their success in STEM classes, majors, and jobs. The program provides access to high-quality educator professional development, and career-connected learning opportunities that prepare learners for success in Nevada's growing STEM industries.


By partnering with schools, districts, industry leaders, higher education institutions, and community organizations, Nevada Robotics creates pathways for students to develop critical skills in problem-solving, teamwork, coding, engineering design, and innovation.

What You'll Do

● Work with the team to 3D print, build, create an interface for, and install 3D-Printed Automatic Weather Station 3D-PAWS.

● Use strong written and verbal communication for logging, reporting, and team interaction.

● Work collaboratively with the 3D-PAWS intern team to meet project goals and timelines.

● Work at Saturday student drone competitions.


What You'll Bring

● A strong interest in science and innovation in education.

● Your skills in engineering, electronics, manufacturing, and coding.

● Creativity, curiosity, strong attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

Why You'll Love DRI

● A chance to create a device that will serve and benefit students, teachers, scientists, and communities/

● Access to an innovative science and education environment.

● Mentorship from and collaboration with experienced innovators.

● Flexible scheduling to accommodate academic commitments.

● Opportunities to connect with DRI scientists and staff.

Required Qualifications

● Full-time, undergraduate college student status.

● Studying or majoring in engineering, manufacturing, physics, computer science, or similar area of study.

● Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite (including Teams and Outlook) and Google Suite programs.

● Familiarity with Python, R, or MATLAB for data analysis and visualization.

Preferred Qualifications

● Exposure to electronics assembly, microcontrollers (Arduino, Raspberry Pi), or 3D printing is desirable.

● Smartphone or tablet handling for field data logging and cloud-synced uploads.

● Experience working in the field in varied weather conditions and terrains.

Physical Requirements: This position may need to occasionally perform physical tasks such as lifting objects of 20-60 lbs., stooping, bending, and kneeling and standing for long periods of time. This position may require desk work and sitting at a computer for several hours at a time.

Conditions of Employment: Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Reliable transportation is required.

Compensation Grade/Benefits: $18 - $20 / hour DOE, up to 12 hours per week; no benefits

Exempt

No

Full-Time Equivalent

30.0%

title: Skal du med på rejsen? Dansk Erhverv Byggeri søger politisk chefkonsulent
description:
Vil du være med til at sætte den politiske retning for et af Danmarks største erhverv? Og samtidig præge opbygningen af Dansk Erhverv Byggeri? Så er muligheden der nu! Vi er i fuld gang med at opbygge Dansk Erhverv Byggeri, og i den forbindelse søger vi en politisk chefkonsulent med et stort drive og lyst til at sætte byggeriet på landkortet.

Jobbet

Byggeriet er med til at løse nogle af vores allerstørste samfundsopgaver. Fra boliger og grøn omstilling til klimatilpasning, infrastruktur og forsvar. Det giver os en bred politisk dagsorden og mange muligheder for at gøre en forskel.

Som politisk chefkonsulent får du selvstændigt ansvar for at udvikle og drive politiske indsatser. Du skal spotte mulighederne, formulere løsningerne på vegne af vores medlemmer og tage dialogen med dem, der kan være med til at få dem gennemført. Vi giver dig plads til at løbe med de politiske bolde og følge dine idéer helt frem til konkrete resultater.

Dine dagsordener kan eksempelvis være hurtigere byggesagsbehandling, forenkling af regler, mere renovering og cirkulært byggeri eller bedre rammer for klimatilpasning. Vi tilrettelægger dit ansvarsområde med blik for dine kompetencer og ambitioner.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:

  • Udvikle og drive politiske dagsordener fra første idé til udspil, alliancer og dialog med politikere og embedsværk
  • Opbygge tætte relationer til medlemsvirksomheder og omsætte deres hverdag, udfordringer og ambitioner til konkrete politiske forslag
  • Udarbejde politiske oplæg, høringssvar og analyser i samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af Dansk Erhverv
  • Skabe synlighed om vores dagsordener gennem pressehistorier, debatindlæg, sociale medier og medlemskommunikation
  • Udvikle netværk og arrangementer, der samler branchen og styrker Dansk Erhverv Byggeris politiske gennemslagskraft og medlemsfællesskab

Du lykkes, når virksomhedernes behov bliver til politiske indsatser, som flytter noget, og når medlemmerne oplever, at vi er tæt på dem og skaber værdi.

Med i bagagen har du

Du har solid erfaring med politisk interessevaretagelse eller politikudvikling fra eksempelvis en organisation, et ministerium, en virksomhed eller et bureau. Du kender de politiske beslutningsprocesser og ved, hvordan man får en sag fra idé til indflydelse.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

  • Har politisk tæft og blik for både den gode løsning og den vej, der kan gøre den til virkelighed
  • Tager initiativ, arbejder selvstændigt og trives med ansvar for at skabe fremdrift
  • Er stærk til at skabe relationer både internt og eksternt og samle virksomheder og andre aktører om fælles mål
  • Skriver skarpt og kan gøre komplekse problemstillinger forståelige og relevante
  • Har forretningsforståelse og blik for at skabe værdi for medlemmerne
  • Bidrager med nysgerrighed, god energi og lyst til at spille dine kolleger gode

Du har en relevant videregående uddannelse. Kendskab til byggeriet og dets værdikæde er en fordel, men ikke en nødvendighed. Det vigtigste er din evne til at drive politiske sager og din lyst til at sætte dig ind i virksomhedernes virkelighed.

Vi tilbyder

Du kommer med på rejsen på et tidspunkt, hvor du kan sætte et tydeligt præg på både vores politiske arbejde og udviklingen af Dansk Erhverv Byggeri. Hos os er der masser af plads til at tænke nyt, afprøve idéer og tage ansvar. Du får mulighed for at udvide dit netværk, udvikle din faglighed og vokse med opgaverne.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med vores branchedirektør og får adgang til stærke faglige miljøer på tværs af Dansk Erhverv. Vi bruger hinandens viden og kontakter og sparrer om både de store linjer og det næste konkrete skridt. Teamet er desuden en del af afdelingen for Klima, Energi, Byggeri og Miljø.

Vi er ambitiøse på branchens og hinandens vegne. Vi lægger vægt på en hverdag med god energi, et tæt samarbejde og kollegialskab og højt humør. Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde, og vi fejrer fremskridtene sammen.

Du får frihed til at tilrettelægge dit arbejde i et uformelt miljø med gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling. Løn efter aftale og pensionsordning. Arbejdssted: Dansk Erhverv, Børsgade 4, København.

Ansøgningen

Vil du være med? Du er velkommen til at kontakte Katrine Bjerre, branchedirektør for byggeri, på kabj@danskerhverv.dk eller tlf. +45 22747186.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV inkl. evt. bilag via linket ”Ansøg” senest 31. oktober 2026.

Vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende, og vi lukker processen, når vi har fundet den rigtige kandidat. Send derfor gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

I Dansk Erhverv mener vi, at mangfoldighed gør os stærkere og medvirker til at skabe udvikling og fornyelse. Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, religiøs overbevisning, seksuel orientering og etnisk oprindelse mv.

Kandidater til stillingen skal være indstillet på at skulle igennem en persontest i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen.

Dansk Erhverv handler på vegne af vores medlemmer og samfundet
I Dansk Erhverv handler vi hver dag på vegne af 18.000 medlemsvirksomheder og flere end 100 brancheforeninger. Vi er erhvervsorganisation og arbejdsgiverforening for et af verdens mest handlekraftige erhvervsliv. Vi tilbyder rådgivning inden for medarbejder- og virksomhedsforhold og politisk gennemslagskraft. Vores indsatser bygger på medlemmernes aktive deltagelse i netværk og udvalg. I Dansk Erhverv arbejder vi hver dag for, at Danmark bliver verdens bedste land at drive virksomhed i. Det er vores vision. For kun på den måde kan vi fremtidssikre velstanden og velfærden.

Job Description:

HPE Networking will unleash the power of the combined HPE Aruba Networking and Juniper Networking solutions. It is designed to cater to a diverse range of customer segments. HPE Networking's innovative technology and open standards-based approach to networking are resonating with customers worldwide. The Senior Presales, Systems Engineer is a key role in the success of HPE Networking that enables HPE to sell and support sophisticated networking and security solutions.

If you have over-the-top technical capability and curiosity; if you can influence both technical and business partners by translating business goals and challenges into technical solutions while differentiating HPE from competing solutions; if your interpersonal and high-impact presentation skills evoke passion and confidence; if you’re a born problem-solver that loves to get into the details and have a burning desire to answer the hard problems in a constantly evolving, results-oriented industry - HPE is the place for you!

HPE is at the heart of this transformation with its industry-leading technologies that are ever more software-defined, helping to answer the most challenging issues in connectivity. Digital transformation is everywhere, with technologies such as Multi-Cloud, Cybersecurity, Automation, IoT, AI, Machine Learning, and 5G driving the next waves of innovation.


Responsibilities

  • Provide pre-sales technical consultation in the design, engineering, sale, and implementation of sophisticated products, applications, and solutions.
  • Working in partnership with sales teams, strategic and industry partners in assessing the potential application of our products ensuring that optimum systems solutions are provided to new and existing customers.
  • Proven experience of process, tools, and techniques for responding to a customer’s proposals (RFP, RFQ, RFI) and create viable proposals that grow HPE Networking's business in a driven and opportunity-filled sales environment.
  • Experience and knowledge in developing and consulting on architecture designs, engineering bill of materials, and implementation specifications for next-generation networks and solutions.
  • Use your industry and product knowledge to engage and influence customer technology strategies through showcasing Juniper technologies during technical sales presentations, product demonstrations, proof of concept, and trial engagements.
  • Build, develop, and maintain strong professional relationships with customer IT decision-makers and industry partner community
  • Deliver training and support to our industry partners and customer engineers.
  • Continuously learn and stay ahead of the industry and competitive solutions, products, and services.
  • Enjoy the personal growth career opportunity that comes from exposure to the latest technological innovations and apply these capabilities to address the real-world challenges of our customers.

Education & Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in a technical/pre-sales role, and 5 years as a Sales or Systems Engineer.
  • Bachelor's and/or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, and or related field or equivalent experience.
  • Extensive experience in designing/engineering/consulting on LAN/WAN, Campus, Data Center, Security, and Cloud technology solutions.
  • Extensive experience in implementing and operating small-mid-large-scale Campus and branch networks utilizing enterprise Networking and Security solutions.
  • Extensive experience and depth of knowledge around the HPE Networking product line, key competitors’ products, solutions, and vertical market use cases.
  • Long-established experience and hands-on expertise with networking industry technologies across routing, switching, and security technology domains from a pre-sale, operational or engineering point of view
  • Solid interpersonal, relationship, and communication skills with extensive experience in customer-facing sales activities (presenting, whiteboarding etc.) and Exec/C-level engagements.
  • Recognized technical capability, ability to learn quickly, and apply skills in new protocols and applications and their context to customers.
  • Deep understanding of Routing Protocols (IGPs, EGPs, Layer-2/3 VPN’s)
  • Extensive experience of datacenter network design (EVPN/VXLAN, Clos architectures, underlay fabric)
  • Extensive experience of MPLS and WAN network design (LDP, RSVP, SR-TE, etc.)
  • Experience of network security (NGFW, UTM, DDoS, IPSec, MACSec, SIEM) is an advantage.
  • Experience with management solutions such as Paragon, MIST, Apstra or equivalent competitive products is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience with either Juniper or other vendors solutions.

What we would love you to have

  • Proficiency in AI networking technologies. This includes RoCEv2, DCQCN, UEC and AI design options at scale.
  • Experience of emerging technology areas. This includes Virtualization, VMWare, OpenStack, VNF, and Container solutions.
  • DevOps experience in automation using Python, Chef, Puppet, Ansible, YANG, JSON, Netconf and Ansible.
  • Experience with cloud-based technologies such as AWS, GCP and Azure
  • JNCIP, JNCIE, CCNP, CCIE, etc. or other industry certification is desired

What makes you a phenomenal fit

  • Positive attitude, a desire to learn new technologies, and the ability to handle competing priorities in a very challenging environment.
  • Embraces HPE culture and values and acts as an advocate and role model for the brand
  • Must be willing and able to travel as required to meet business and customer demands

Accessibility


HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.


Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected:

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

description:

Job Description

Responsibilities

Patient Ambassador & Utility Tech

Location: Murray, KY
Pay: $17.00 per hour
Employment Type: Full-Time
Available Shifts:

  • 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM
  • 6:30 AM – 3:00 PM
  • 12:30 PM – 8:00 PM

Join Our Team!

HHS Talent Solutions is hiring Patient Ambassadors and Utility Technicians to join the Food & Nutrition Services team at Murray Calloway County Hospital!


We're looking for dependable, hardworking, and friendly individuals who take pride in providing excellent service and maintaining a clean, safe environment for patients, visitors, and hospital staff.


Patient Ambassador

As a Patient Ambassador, you will play an important role in providing exceptional dining experiences for hospital patients. You will assist with meal selections, deliver meals, and ensure patients receive accurate orders while providing friendly and compassionate customer service.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist patients with menu selections and meal orders.
  • Ensure meals are accurate and meet patients' dietary requirements.
  • Deliver meals to patients in a timely and professional manner.
  • Distribute and collect patient menus.
  • Prepare hot and cold food items, beverages, and condiments.
  • Maintain cleanliness and sanitation in food preparation and service areas.
  • Follow all hospital food safety and infection prevention guidelines.
  • Provide friendly, compassionate service to patients and hospital staff.
  • Support other dietary team members and management as needed.

Utility Technician

As a Utility Technician, you will help maintain a clean, organized, and sanitary kitchen environment. This position focuses on dishwashing, equipment sanitation, general cleaning, and assisting with deliveries to ensure the Food & Nutrition department operates efficiently.


Responsibilities:

  • Wash, rinse, sanitize, and properly store dishes, pots, pans, utensils, trays, and kitchen equipment.
  • Operate and maintain dishwashing equipment and three-compartment sinks.
  • Monitor cleaning chemicals and sanitizing solutions to ensure proper sanitation.
  • Sweep, mop, and maintain kitchen floors, dining areas, and storage spaces.
  • Remove trash, break down cardboard boxes, and replace trash liners.
  • Receive, organize, label, date, and properly store food and supply deliveries.
  • Restock clean dishes, trays, soap, towels, and other necessary supplies.
  • Transport and replenish ice as needed.
  • Assist with temperature monitoring and required logs.
  • Maintain cleanliness of kitchen equipment, counters, and workstations.
  • Complete daily cleaning assignments and closing procedures.
  • Follow all food safety, sanitation, and workplace safety guidelines.
  • Assist team members and management with additional duties as needed.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years old.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English.
  • Strong teamwork and customer service skills.
  • Dependable, punctual, and willing to work in a fast-paced hospital environment.
  • Ability to follow instructions, safety guidelines, and sanitation procedures.
  • Maintain professional appearance and proper personal hygiene.
  • Previous food service, restaurant, kitchen, hospitality, or healthcare experience preferred but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Frequent bending, reaching, lifting, and stooping.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to safely operate equipment necessary to perform assigned duties.

Employment Requirements

  • Successful completion of a background check and drug screening.
  • Proof of eligibility to work in the United States.
  • Compliance with applicable hospital health and safety requirements.

About HHS

Founded in 1975 as Hospital Housekeeping Systems, HHS is a private, family-owned company dedicated to providing exceptional support services across healthcare, senior living, hospitality, and other industries. HHS specializes in housekeeping, food service, and facility management, serving nearly 1,000 customers across six industries.

Through HHS Talent Solutions, we connect qualified, dedicated individuals with opportunities to support essential operations at healthcare facilities.


HHS is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and providing opportunities for all qualified applicants. Veterans and individuals with military experience are encouraged to apply.

description:
Carrier Global Corporation, światowy lider w dziedzinie inteligentnych rozwiązań klimatycznych i energetycznych, angażuje się w tworzenie innowacji, które zapewniają komfort, bezpieczeństwo i zrównoważony rozwój. Dzięki nowoczesnym rozwiązaniom w zakresie kontroli temperatury, jakości powietrza oraz transportu poprawiamy jakość życia, wspieramy kluczowe sektory gospodarki oraz zapewniamy bezpieczny transport żywności, leków ratujących życie i wielu innych produktów. Od momentu wynalezienia nowoczesnej klimatyzacji w 1902 roku działamy z jasno określoną misją: poprawiać jakość życia oraz świat, który wspólnie tworzymy. Naszą pozycję lidera zawdzięczamy światowej klasy, różnorodnemu i inkluzywnemu zespołowi, który stawia klienta w centrum wszystkich działań.

Więcej informacji można znaleźć na stronie corporate.carrier.com lub obserwując Carrier w mediach społecznościowych @Carrier.


Viessmann jest światowym liderem w dziedzinie zrównoważonych rozwiązań klimatycznych i energetycznych, zajmującym się tworzeniem przestrzeni życiowych dla przyszłych pokoleń. Obecnie, jako część grupy Carrier, firma Viessmann łączy innowacyjne technologie z silnym zaangażowaniem w ochronę środowiska, promując zrównoważony rozwój i komfort.


Do głównych zadań osoby na tym stanowisku należeć będzie terminowe wykonywanie przeglądów, napraw, usuwanie awarii urządzeń oraz realizacja prac bezpiecznie i zgodnie z zasadami bezpieczeństwa Carrier.

Viessmann Sp. z o.o.: ul. Dekarska 16, Rusocin; 83-000 Pruszcz Gdański, PL

title: Leasing Professional - Thornton Place
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

Thornton Place has an immediate opening for an experienced Leasing Professional! Our team members are high performers that care about customer service and exceed expectations. The Leasing Professional plays a critical role in our success.

Nestled in Northgate, this community of 387 units offers every comfort and convenience is within walking distance. Just south of the Northgate Mall you will find yourself ideally located in the center of a growing and expanding neighborhood full of excitement. Located along I-5 at the Northgate Transit Center, you’re mere minutes from downtown Seattle!

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

In addition to our competitive compensation, we offer housing discounts of up to 40% at Greystar communities, cell phone allowance, monthly bonus incentives, and a robust benefits and perks package.


What your day might look like

Being part of a team and having fun while providing excellent customer service

Conduct prospect building and apartment tours, including virtual leasing and in-person tours

Ensuring a stellar move-in experience for our customers'

Market research on comps for marketing and advertising purposes

Community event planning and execution

Follow up with prospects by phone and email

Utilizing social media and internet platforms to market available units

Assisting in lease renewals

Respond to resident concerns


What we are looking for

Previous sales and customer service experience desired, but a positive can-do attitude is required

Proficient in MS Office Suite, additional property management software (Yardi/One Site) desired but not required

Demonstrated ability to read, write, and communicate effectively and complete legal documents, sell and explain apartment features, and answer resident questions

High level of professionalism in both manner and dress


What sets us apart: Greystar maintains a focus on people, genuine relationships, and shared values with a diverse and inclusive culture. We offer robust training and development for all positions to provide long term career opportunities. If you're looking for more, we’re looking for you!


Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.


Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

#LI-KL

The hourly range for this position is $22.15 - $25.00


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

title: Assistant Manager, IT Infrastructure
description:
About the role

Assist the Team Lead in planning, designing, implementing, and operating the company's overall IT infrastructure (network, servers, SAN storage, Windows/Linux systems), and take charge of day-to-day information security operations as well as infrastructure- and security-related projects. Ensure systems are highly available, secure, and aligned with business needs.


Key responsibilities

  • Infrastructure Operations (BAU)

    - Responsible for daily monitoring, configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of enterprise networks (LAN/WAN, Firewall, Switch, Router, Wi‑Fi, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP).

    - Manage servers and virtualization platforms (Windows Server, Linux, VMware / Hyper‑V, etc.), including installation, configuration, patch management, capacity planning, and high availability design.

    - Manage SAN/NAS storage and backup solutions to ensure effective execution of data backup, restoration testing, and disaster recovery planning.

    - Monitor system and network performance (availability, utilization, throughput, latency); perform root cause analysis on alerts and incidents, and implement improvement measures.


  • Operating Systems and Directory Services

    - Manage and maintain Windows Server environments (AD DS, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, File/Print Server, etc.) and integration with Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD.

    - Manage Linux servers (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu, etc.), including installation, configuration, security hardening, scripting automation, and routine maintenance.

    - Manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls (AD, Email, Cloud systems) to ensure compliance with the principle of least privilege and regulatory requirements.


  • Information Security (Infrastructure Security)

    - Assist in formulating and implementing infrastructure-level information security policies, standards, and procedures (including ISO 27001-related requirements).

    - Handle day-to-day security operations such as firewall policy, network segmentation, access control, endpoint protection, DLP, and log monitoring.

    - Participate in security risk assessments, vulnerability management, patch compliance, and compliance audits, and follow up on remediation actions.

    - Support security incident response, including investigation, escalation, remediation, and post-incident review.


  • Infrastructure & Security Projects

title: Sektionschef til afdelingen for militære cyberoperationer i Forsvarets Efterretningstjeneste – genopslag
description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle, planlægge og gennemføre skarpe offensive cyberoperationer til gavn for Forsvaret og Danmarks sikkerhed? Brænder du ligeledes for at videreudvikle dine ledelsesmæssige færdigheder? Så søger vi lige nu en sektionschef med operativt mindset til en sektion i afdelingen for militære cyberoperationer.

Du får udfordringer og plads til at udvikle dig
I afdelingen for militære cyberoperationer leverer vi offensive cyberoperationer til gavn for Forsvaret og Danmarks sikkerhed. Vores mål er at imødegå trusler mod dansk sikkerhed gennem at påvirke, modvirke eller hindre en modstanders evne til at operere i eller gennem cyberspace. Det er et område, som er i konstant udvikling og vækst, hvor vi har mulighed for selv at sætte retningen. Med udgangspunkt i en stærk faglighed, gå-på-mod og initiativ har vi fokus på at skabe operative resultater ved brug af FE’s særlige kompetencer og kapaciteter.

Sektionen består af medarbejdere med forskelligartede kompetencer og uddannelsesmæssige baggrunde, herunder både specialister og generalister, hvilket stiller krav til din ledelsesmæssige spændvidde.
Du vil som sektionschef få ansvaret for, at sektionen skaber operative resultater. Samtidig får du ansvaret for personaleledelse og -udvikling.

Du vil desuden skulle fungere som afdelingschefens tætte sparringspartner og lejlighedsvise stedfortræder i det daglige.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil primært være:

  • Lede en solid og faglig velfunderet operativ planlægningsproces
  • Lede indsættelsen af FE’s ressourcer og kapaciteter under hensyntagen til de operative muligheder og udfordringer
  • Kvalitetssikre skriftlige produkter
  • Udvikle sektionens kapacitet og opgaveløsning
  • Planlægge kompetenceudvikling for sektionens medarbejdere
  • Indgå i en velfungerende ledelsesgruppe
  • Indgå i tværgående samarbejde med både interne og eksterne aktører
  • Bidrage til udadvendte aktiviteter såsom kapacitetsfaglig rådgivning
  • Dertil vil dine arbejdsopgaver også betyde, at du skal deltage på tjenesterejser i udlandet af kort varighed
Du og din baggrund er vigtig
Du har erfaring fra tidligere stillinger som chef eller teamleder og har indsigt i eller forståelse for operationsplanlægning og processer knyttet til håndteringen af sensitive sager.
Med et stærkt fagligt fundament og en struktureret tilgang driver du processer og indsatser, der omsætter kunders behov til konkrete operative løsninger, hvor FE’s særlige kompetencer og kapaciteter bringes mest effektivt i spil. Du har et særdeles stærkt fokus på samarbejde og tillid, og er opmærksom på, hvordan sektionens arbejde indgår i en sammenhæng, der skaber værdi for FE, Forsvaret og Danmarks sikkerhed.

Du har interesse for og er i stand til at forstå komplicerede tekniske problemstillinger og formidle tekniske forhold til et bredt publikum. Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med eller har kendskab til forskellige indhentningsdiscipliner samt har kendskab til FE’s forretningsmodel.

Du vil få en bred kontaktflade på tværs af FE, og det er vigtigt, at du som person kan opbygge og fastholde vigtige relationer.

Der er tale om dygtige og specialiserede medarbejdere i sektionen, som rummer en stærk faglig viden. Din ledelsesstil skal være værdsat af dine medarbejdere, og som leder er du i stand til at skabe en retning og få opbygget et velfungerende samarbejde med en høj grad af medarbejderinddragelse.

Du er vedholdende, initiativrig, tager ansvar og evner at tænke kreativt. Og så besidder du et operativt mindset og drives af at skabe resultater gennem evnen til at eksekvere. Det er også vigtigt, at du har styr på dine prioriteringer, for der er ofte mange bolde i luften. At du evner smidigt tværgående samarbejde i alle retninger er naturligvis en selvfølge.

Afdelingen er præget af en uformel tone, og vi forventer, at du kan bidrage med godt humør og en positiv indstilling og dermed bidrage til at FE er et godt sted at arbejde.

Din nye arbejdsplads
Forsvarets Efterretningstjeneste (FE) er Danmarks udenrigsefterretningstjeneste og arbejder – hemmeligt og åbent – for at beskytte Danmark og danske interesser i en foranderlig verden.

Vi er ikke alene om at beskytte Danmark, men vi er den eneste myndighed, der har fået mandat til at udnytte helt særlige midler til at afdække, hvad andre stater og udenlandske aktører forsøger at holde hemmeligt. Det giver mening for os at bidrage til fred, tryghed og sikkerhed for danskerne, både i den analoge og i den digitale verden og det gør vi ved at afdække, vurdere, rådgive om og modvirke både aktuelle trusler og trusler under udvikling.

Vi værdsætter styrken i vores mangfoldighed med dybe fagligheder og specialister og vi er en helt speciel og operativt orienteret vidensorganisation, der har mange forskellige opgaver, men fælles for dem alle er det vidensgrundlag, som vores efterretningsarbejde skaber.

Din lønpakke afhænger af dine kvalifikationer

Militær:
Stillingen besættes efter protokollat til overenskomst for akademikere i staten om officerer under Forsvarsministeriet.

Stillingen er indplaceret i løngruppe 5, som omfatter majorer og orlogskaptajner.

Alternativt er du erfaren kaptajn/kaptajnløjtnant, der er optaget på eller i gang med MMS. I så fald vil der være mulighed for at indgå en uddannelsesaftale eller fortsætte en eksisterende aftale. Du vil i perioden frem til en eventuel udnævnelse i stillingen bestride stillingen som funktion i højere stilling.

Er du allerede ansat i Forsvarsministeriets Koncern, vil du fortsat være ansat i henhold til gældende aftaler mellem Forsvarsministeriets Personalestyrelse og Hovedorganisationen af Officerer i Danmark om løn og ansættelsesvilkår for tjenestemandsansatte eller overenskomstansatte officerer i Forsvaret.

Du skal være opmærksom på, at der knytter sig fysiske og funktionsrelaterede helbredsmæssige krav til stillingen. I stillingen er du til enhver tid forpligtet til at kunne opfylde de helbredsmæssige og fysiske krav, der er fastsat for funktionen – her A1 som betyder, at du skal kunne helbredsgodkendes til tjeneste i Danmark og sejlads i danske farvande.

Civil:
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og den relevante faglige organisation, afhængig af din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund. Derudover har du mulighed for at forhandle løntillæg efter kvalifikationer. Den gennemsnitlige arbejdstid er 37 timer om ugen inklusiv betalt frokostpause. Til stillingen hører en pensionsordning, som FE betaler.
Som ansat i FE er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Det er et krav, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele din ansættelse. Som i resten af forsvaret har du pligt til kortvarig udsendelse til udlandet.

Sådan søger du stillingen
Du skal sende din ansøgning og CV via stillingsopslaget, senest den 29. oktober 2026.

Vi forventer at gennemføre samtaler med ansøgere løbende.

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte den lokale HR-partner på 20968@ddis.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller ønsker flere oplysninger.

Du kan også læse mere på www.fe-ddis.dk, hvor du blandt andet finder vores ”INDBLIK” og kan få et mere detaljeret indblik i FE´s opgaver, FE som arbejdsplads og yderligere information om ansættelsesmæssige spørgsmål.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: (One-Year Direct Contract) Product Owner cum Business Analyst, Finance COO, Group Finance
description:

We provide insights and analyses that help the bank make sound business decisions – whether in the areas of product development or customer profitability. We also provide capital management, business planning, forecasting, and tax and accounting advisory services.

This pivotal role will be responsible for overseeing the digital transformation journey of finance business processes within DBS. This includes a comprehensive approach - from understanding current landscapes to the successful development and adoption of AI-powered automation.

This role requires strong analytical rigor, the ability to think out of the box and excellent stakeholder management to ensure that all solutions are tailored, effective, and aligned with the bank's strategic objectives.

Responsibilities

Process Analysis & Requirement Definition

  • Translate complex business requirements and operational challenges into clear, concise, and actionable technical specifications for the engineering team.
  • Work closely with business users to gather feedback, validate understanding, and refine requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Map existing business processes using BPMN tools and document the associated end-to-end data lineage.

Solution Design & Development Partnership

  • Champion the adoption of AI and ML tools, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within finance processes.
  • Act as a key liaison between finance stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring mutual understanding and alignment on project goals and technical approaches.
  • Partner with engineering teams in the design and architecture of robust, scalable, and user-friendly digital products.

Requirements

title: Leasing Professional - Tampa
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating the community’s marketing, leasing, and renewal strategies to achieve occupancy, revenue, and resident retention goals by performing all activities related to leasing to new residents, providing resident satisfaction throughout the term of the lease, and securing resident lease renewals.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Essential Responsibilities:
• Performs all sales and leasing activities to achieve the community’s revenue and occupancy goals by greeting and qualifying prospects, conducting community tours and showing apartments, processing applications, credit screening, and criminal background checks, preparing the lease and move-in package, and ensuring a smooth resident move-in and lease signing.
• Inspects apartments prior to resident move-in and ensures apartments are in move-in ready condition and schedules any outstanding item to be addressed with the maintenance team.
• Stays informed about current market and competitor conditions that may impact the community’s occupancy and sales results, develops and implements short- and long-term marketing plans and goals to sustain occupancy, and follows the community’s established policies related to concessions, specials, and other programs to boost occupancy.
• Designs and executes marketing activities to create and drive traffic to the community, including implementing resident referral and employer outreach programs, using internet marketing tools (Craigslist, Facebook, e-mail, and other websites), and following other community-specific marketing plans, drives, and special programs.
• Uses the on-site property management software (OneSite, Yardi, etc.) to track apartment availability, record traffic and leasing activities, manage resident and prospect data, and capture critical demographic and other information about existing and future residents.
• Ensures that the community and show units meet the Company’s standards for show quality by daily inspecting the marketing corridor and leasing tour, communicating maintenance and upkeep needs to the community’s maintenance team members, merchandising and ensuring a physically appealing show unit and/or model and amenities, and preparing the leasing office for daily leasing activities.
• Follows-up with prospects and new residents to ensure satisfaction by sending e-mail, thank-you notes, and cards or making telephone calls or other contacts to finalize decisions to lease and/or renew.
• Executes and performs activities in support of the community’s lease renewal program by preparing lease renewal letters and packages for residents, meeting with and contacting renewing residents in advance of move-out dates, and ensuring that lease renewal documents are signed and implemented on time.
• Responds quickly and courteously to resident and client/owner concerns and questions, and takes prompt action to solve problems and/or document and convey resident or other requests to the appropriate individual(s).

Required Licenses or Certifications:
• Incumbents must have all licenses and/or certifications as required by State and Local jurisdictions

• Incumbents must have valid driver’s license to operate a golf cart on property.

Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

The hourly range for this position is $17.00 - $19.00


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

*Benefits offered for full-time employees. For Union and Prevailing Wage roles, compensation and benefits may vary from the listed information above due to Collective Bargaining Agreements and/or local governing authority.


Greystar will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Greystar is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Important Notice: Greystar will never request your banking details or other sensitive personal information during the interview process. Greystar does not conduct any interviews via text or messaging, and all communication will come from official Greystar email addresses (@greystar.com). If you receive suspicious requests, please report them immediately to AskHR@greystar.com.

title: Produktägare
company: GD, Digital strategi och plattform, Utveckling av plattformar, Produktledning
description:
Vill du vara med och bygga moderna tekniska plattformar för samhällsviktig infrastruktur?

Hos E-hälsomyndigheten får du arbeta med nationella e-hälsotjänster som bidrar till en trygg läkemedelshantering och gör det enklare för apotek, vården och medborgare att få tillgång till kritisk information i rätt tid. Drivs du av att säkerställa att det som byggs skapar verkligt värde för användare och verksamhet? Då kan det här vara rollen för dig!

Om tjänsten

I rollen som agil produktägare inom IT-området ingår du i ett tvärfunktionellt utvecklingsteam där du har ett övergripande ansvar för teamets backlogg, prioriteringar och riktningen framåt. Du arbetar nära andra agila produktägare och ledande roller för att säkerställa hög leveransförmåga och att vi arbetar mot gemensamma mål.

Teamets ansvar ligger i att utveckla och förvalta IT-komponenter i den gemensamma plattformen som ska kunna användas i verksamhetens tjänsteutveckling. För närvarande sker utveckling av t ex AI-gateway, automatiserade certifikathantering, Digital Post samt Renovate-AI.

Du ansvarar för att teamet arbetar med rätt saker vid rätt tidpunkt, samtidigt som du kontinuerligt kommunicerar med produkternas användare för att fånga behov och omsätta dem till värdeskapande utveckling. Du får även möjlighet att samordna arbetet med både interna och externa intressenter och driver flera initiativ parallellt i en komplex miljö med många beroenden.

Du tillhör enheten produktledning som omfattar ledande roller i vår agila organisation såsom SAFe-ramverkets roller (PM, RTE, PO samt SA). Utöver detta finns domän- och lösningsarkitekter som kommer vara nära samarbetspartners för att lösa tågens behov.

Enheten tillhör sektionen Utveckling av plattformar, som ansvarar för att utveckla och ta fram gemensamma IT-komponenter som delas mellan verksamhetsområden och övriga avdelningar. Fokus är bl a att leverera tjänster genom självbetjäning och att kunna få fullständiga CI/CD-flöden för verksamhetens produkter.

Vi ingår i avdelningen Digital strategi och plattform som består av medarbetare som utöver vår sektion arbetar inom områdena applikationsdrift och -support, digital arbetsplats, digital strategi, portfölj och utredning.

Avdelningen ansvarar för myndighetens IT-styrning, arkitektur, utvecklingsmetodik och ramverk såsom t ex vårt agila arbetssätt. Vi ansvarar också för att tillhandahålla, förvalta och utveckla IT-drift och -support, återanvändningsbara IT-komponenter och tekniska gemensamma plattformar för myndigheten.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som rör dig mellan olika perspektiv med förmågan att se helheten. Du är en person som får saker att hända genom att aktivt driva arbetet framåt. Du trivs i dialogen mellan olika kompetenser och skapar förutsättningar som möjliggör gemensam leverans. Du skapar goda relationer och framdrift tillsammans med andra. Vidare ser du möjligheter i nya arbetssätt och vågar prova nya vägar. Du omsätter idéer till handling och utmanar, testar och justerar som en naturlig del av att skapa värde. Som ledare skapar du engagemang och delaktighet i teamen.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • akademisk examen inom data/IT/systemvetenskap eller motsvarande flerårig likvärdig arbetslivserfarenhet
  • flerårig aktuell erfarenhet som produktägare (PO), teknisk projektledare eller liknande roll i komplexa IT-miljöer, med prioritering utifrån värde, användarbehov och effekt
  • flerårig erfarenhet av att arbeta i och leda agila utvecklingsteam, exempelvis av ramverket SAFe
  • minst fem års teknisk erfarenhet av arbete inom IT- eller plattformsorganisationer med ansvar för gemensamma utvecklingsverktyg/miljöer, tekniska plattformar och gemensamma IT-komponenter
  • mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.

Det är meriterande för tjänsten om du har:

  • erfarenhet från hälso- och sjukvårdssektorn eller annan reglerad verksamhet
  • erfarenhet av IT- och informationssäkerhet samt regelefterlevnad inom offentlig sektor
  • erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt i medelstora till stora organisationer
  • erfarenhet av att driva, prioritera och införa AI-förmågor, verktygsstöd, tjänster och plattformar inom IT-verksamhet och utvecklingsteam.

Vad erbjuder vi?

E-hälsomyndigheten är en myndighet i tillväxt och vi driver utvecklingen av nationell digital infrastruktur inom hälsa, vård och omsorg. Vi skapar förutsättningar för digitala tjänster och lösningar för både privatpersoner och professioner inom hälso- och sjukvård, apotek och socialtjänst. Vi arbetar för att hälsodata ska bli tillgängliga i hela vårdkedjan.

Vi är cirka 700 medarbetare i Kalmar och Stockholm. Hos oss finns möjlighet att göra skillnad i en innovativ miljö med trevliga och kompetenta arbetskamrater. Alla medarbetare har förtroendearbetstid och kan arbeta delvis på distans. Läs mer om E-hälsomyndigheten som arbetsplats: Jobba hos oss

Är du intresserad?

Frågor angående rekryteringsprocessen besvaras av:

Anställningen är tillsvidare med sex månaders provanställning. Tillträde snarast eller enligt överenskommelse. Placeringsort för anställningen är Stockholm eller Kalmar. Arbetet kan innebära tjänsteresor, främst mellan de båda orterna.

title: Managed Service Specialist (in-office position)
description:
Managed Service Field Specialist (Full-Time)


NextStep Networking is growing! As part of the Net X IT Solutions family of companies, NextStep Networking works alongside a full-service managed service provider (MSP) dedicated to helping organizations stay productive, secure, and technologically confident — so they can focus on what matters most. Together, we deliver comprehensive IT solutions, including managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, and ongoing technical support. Our shared commitment to personalized service, reliable solutions, and strong client relationships helps organizations operate with confidence and achieve their goals.

We’re looking for team members who are passionate about technology, effective problem-solvers, and committed to delivering exceptional support. As a member of the NextStep Networking team, you’ll be part of a growing organization that collaborates closely with Net X IT Solutions to serve businesses and organizations across a variety of industries. If you want to make a meaningful impact by helping clients leverage technology to work smarter, safer, and more effectively, we’d love to have you on our team.


About the Role:

As a Managed Service Helpdesk Specialist, you’ll serve as the primary point of contact for client support needs. Most of your work will occur remotely from our helpdesk, where you’ll diagnose issues, resolve tickets, support user accounts, and ensure systems remain stable and secure.


You’ll also complete on-site visits as assigned, such as hardware deployments, troubleshooting that requires hands-on work, scheduled maintenance, pre-scheduled time, etc.


This is a full-time role, with occasional after-hours “on-call” responsibilities for evening or weekend support.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide first-level technical support via phone, email, remote tools, and ticketing system
  • Diagnose and resolve computer, printer, and peripheral hardware issues
  • Manage user accounts, passwords, and device enrollments
  • Support Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Windows OS, and proprietary applications
  • Assist with A/V setup for meetings and public events
  • Log service tickets, track progress, and maintain accurate documentation
  • Adhere to data privacy and cybersecurity protocols
  • Participate in an on-call rotation for evening/weekend support as needed

What You Bring: Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of hardware, software, and networking fundamentals
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 Admin Console, Google Workspace, and Active Directory
  • Familiarity with MDM tools and cloud management systems
  • A+ and Network+ certifications (or willingness to obtain) highly desirable

Professional Qualities:

  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Analytical and adaptable problem-solver
  • Able to multitask and prioritize effectively
  • Positive attitude and eagerness to learn
  • Commitment to confidentiality and data security best practices

Minimum Requirements:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Eligible to work in the United States (proof of work authorization required)
  • Valid driver’s license with reliable transportation and clean driving record
  • Experience providing end-user or deskside IT support preferred
  • Strong interpersonal and time management skills
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a client-facing role
  • Strong proficiency in spoken and written English to communicate clearly with clients and team members


Physical & Work Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and perform hands-on technical work
  • Regularly required to stand, walk, and use hands to handle or feel
  • May occasionally need to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl
  • Work occurs primarily occurs in the office and at client locations
  • Local travel required; some overnight travel may occur

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

We believe technology should empower, not frustrate. As part of NextStep Networking, you’ll work with purpose — helping local government teams deliver essential services through reliable IT systems.


We offer an excellent benefits package, including:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • 401K
  • Professional development and certification support
  • A respectful, collaborative culture that values learning and growth


Other Duties:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Dance Assistant
description:
Join Our Team as a Dance Assistant!

Do you love working with children and supporting their creativity through dance? The Dundee Township Park District is looking for a responsible, positive, and energetic Dance Assistant to help our young dancers learn, grow, and shine in a fun and supportive environment.


What You’ll Do

As a Dance Assistant, you will:

  • Help the Dance Instructor set up the classroom and prepare materials for each class.
  • Assist children throughout the class with their lessons and activities.
  • Support the Instructor by helping keep the classroom organized, clean, and safe.
  • Step in to assist or lead activities when needed.
  • Arrive 15 minutes before class and stay 15 minutes after to help straighten the room.
  • Ensure all equipment is properly cared for and cleaned.
  • Secure a substitute if you are unable to attend a scheduled class.
  • Communicate important matters promptly and professionally.
  • Provide excellent customer service to participants, families, and staff.
  • Follow all Park District part-time policies, safety guidelines, and procedures.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support the program.


Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys helping children learn in a positive environment. You bring:

  • A friendly, patient, and supportive attitude.
  • Experience or knowledge of basic dance steps and skills.
  • A desire to work with children and help them succeed.
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
  • The ability to stay organized and take initiative.
  • The ability to remain calm and helpful in busy or stressful moments.
  • Good physical condition with mobility to assist in class activities.
  • Must currently be in high school or older.


Schedule

This is a part-time position.
Hours vary depending on when dance classes are scheduled.

Typical hours include:

  • Monday–Friday: Between 9:00 a.m. and 8:00 p.m.
  • Saturday & Sunday: Between 9:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m.
    Hours depend on the needs of the current dance session.



In Exchange for Your Time and Talent, While Employed, We Offer:

Choose one of the following:

  • Individual 100-day Fitness Center Pass
  • Family Season Pass to Dolphin Cove Aquatic Center
  • Family Season Pass to Randall Oaks Zoo and Park

Plus:

  • Free or discounted Park District programs, merchandise, and concessions
  • Access to Credit Union membership


Ready to Join Us?

If you're passionate about helping children learn and creating a warm, organized, and encouraging dance environment, apply today and help bring joy to our community with the Dundee Township Park District!

title: Lunar | Shift Leader - Manufacturing, Ops & Assembly | A shift
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

This role requires an exceptional technical professional to join our expert team, bringing comprehensive knowledge of clean work assembly, ISO-rated cleanroom operations, welding and laser welding techniques, precision machining and fabrication, and post-processing in controlled environments. The position oversees technicians supporting Lunar ZBO HEX production activities and demands proficiency in failure analysis, Lean manufacturing principles, project scheduling, and tight-tolerance stack-up analysis through final mechanical processing. Daily responsibilities include managing technician workflows, coordinating schedules, providing mentorship, and facilitating cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful production outcomes in our advanced manufacturing environment.

Special Mentions:

  • Relocation provided, if eligible
  • Shift available: Monday – Thursday (A shift)

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Coordinate and steer the collective efforts of all Lunar ops technicians.
  • Enforce clean room standards and operational protocols (includes annual reviews, regular mentoring and disciplinary action).
  • Interface with area leadership from across Kent operations and prioritize work based on production schedule and organizational goals for Lunar programs.
  • Schedule risk identification and mitigation for precision clean room assembly processes.
  • Coordinate support organization efforts to minimize production interruptions in ISO-rated environments.
  • Ensure product quality and conformance to specifications for clean work assembly and precision fabrication.
  • Disposition non-conforming hardware to efficiently return them to conforming state and normal product flow within tight tolerance requirements.
  • Improve area safety and efficiency through regular auditing and continuous improvement of clean production processes.
  • Establish and analyze area metrics for trend extrapolation to drive the following:

· Personnel training and development in specialized clean room and precision manufacturing techniques.

· Development and implementation of efficiency improvement projects for ZBO/HEx related activities.

· Optimization of product flow through clean production environments.

· Root cause analysis and the implementation of corresponding corrective action plans for failure analysis.

· Identification and elimination of defects within the clean manufacturing value stream.

· Reduction of downtime for product and personnel in controlled environment production.

• Lead efforts to transition Lunar program products from engineering development to full rate production.

• Drive manufacturability, provide constructive feedback to engineering/design community on tight tolerance stack-up analysis and final mechanical processing requirements.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Associate's degree or 5 years experience in rocket engine/aerospace manufacturing or similar manufacturing environment.
  • Minimum of 2 years in a leadership position leading a team of 5+ people.
  • Lean manufacturing experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret controlled documentation and processes such as: mechanical drawings, welding/assembly/cleaning procedures / work instructions, schematics, engineering drawings, and parts lists.
  • Able to adapt to constant changing work assignments and fast paced work environment.
  • Proficient with computers, the ability to use MS Office, shop floor management software (ERP) and related programs.
  • Ability to distinguish colors is required.
  • Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed.
  • Must be able to lift 35 lbs. unassisted, stoop, bend, crawl, and maneuver in tight spaces.
  • Ability to earn trust, maintain positive and professional relationships, and contribute to a culture of inclusion
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience monitoring, tracking and continually improving total cost equation.
  • Familiarity with Design for Manufacturability, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and Failure Mode Effects Analysis.
  • Experience preferred in fast-paced production environment with flight quality hardware.
  • Six Sigma experience.
  • Able to travel for short and extended trips as needed. Up to 10% travel


Base Pay Range for:

WA applicants is $113,158.00 - $158,420.85

Other site ranges may differ


Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)

  • Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.
