title: Test Engineer II | Blue Batteries
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

Applies standard engineering knowledge and methods to develop, execute, and analyze tests for avionics products, test equipment, and software systems supporting the New Glenn and Blue Moon product lines. Responsible for the execution and support of acceptance test plans and the build, integration, and checkout of testers, fixtures, and harnesses at Grandview. Collects and analyzes measurement data, maintains accurate test records, and reports findings. Provides safe, repeatable, high-quality test capability that helps verify requirements for current and next-generation launch vehicles and spacecraft. Ensures test procedures and tester configurations meet applicable standards. Contributes to reducing test cycle time and equipment downtime.


This role supports the development and operations of the New Glenn and Blue Moon product lines. We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!


Special Mentions

  • Relocation provided
  • Travel expected up to 15% of the time
  • Interviews will include a technical assessment

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Production test support

  • Execute acceptance testing of avionics modules (LV and HV) and energy storage systems for spacecraft applications per approved procedures
  • Develop and execute test plans for electrical/electronic systems, with guidance from senior engineers
  • Execute environmental testing, including thermal cycling, vibration, shock, and vacuum
  • Document test articles, test configurations, and reference documents
  • Collect data, analyze results, evaluate trends, and report findings, including yield and test cycle time
  • Lead root cause investigation for assigned test failures; escalate complex or cross-system issues; support nonconformance dispositions
  • Identify and implement improvements that reduce test cycle time and equipment downtime
  • Participate in design reviews and requirement traceability; contribute to the Test Compliance Matrix
  • Apply working knowledge of certification and regulatory requirements to lab tests (MIL-STD-461, DO-160, DO-178, DO-254, etc.)
  • Participate in cross-functional teams for DFMEA, root cause investigations, and functional safety hazard analyses

Tester build support

  • Support design, build, integration, checkout, and validation of testers, fixtures, and harnesses
  • Develop tester requirements, wiring documentation, and configuration records
  • Write and debug test scripts based on the purpose of the test
  • Partner with the Test Fabrication Shop on fixture and cable builds
  • Maintain tester readiness, including calibration, repair, and spares coordination
  • Support facility readiness and test readiness reviews

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field
  • years of relevant experience in electronics test, validation, or production engineering
  • Hands-on experience with lab test equipment (power supplies, DMMs, oscilloscopes, etc.)
  • Experience with software tools such as LabVIEW, JIRA, MATLAB, or similar
  • Hands-on experience executing, and contributing to the development of, test plans for electronics systems
  • Familiarity with industry-standard electrical test equipment and procedures
  • Ability to earn trust and maintain positive, professional relationships

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in a related field
  • Experience in production, manufacturing test, or ATE environments
  • Experience building or validating test fixtures, harnesses, or automated testers
  • Troubleshooting to component level; experience with NCR/MRB and corrective action
  • Familiarity with MIL-STD-461 and environmental test practices
  • Experience with battery or HV test equipment (e.g., Arbin), fault tree analysis, and DFMEA
  • Experience in R&D or systems integration environments


Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
  • Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
  • Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.


Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com. Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

title: Retail Shift Supervisor
description:
Job Title: Retail Shift Supervisor

Employment Type: Full-Time / Hourly

Goodwill Southwest Florida is seeking a Retail Shift Supervisor to support the management team in the daily operation of the store. This position assists with achieving sales, expense, profit, production, merchandising, customer service, and mission-related goals while ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. The Shift Supervisor provides leadership, training, and operational support to create a safe, productive, and customer-focused environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Safety

  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized store environment through adherence to Kaizen principles, PPE requirements, safety procedures, facility inspections, incident reporting, and monthly safety meetings.
  • Ensure all required store equipment is maintained in safe operating condition and support compliance with all safety standards and requirements.

Financial Results

  • Assist in achieving store sales, expense, profit, customer transaction, and Ecommerce revenue goals.
  • Support efforts to increase customer count, average sales per customer, and sales per square foot in accordance with store objectives.
  • Comply with all recycling and salvage procedures to maximize donation value and reduce disposal expenses.

Customer & Mission Services

  • Ensure staff maintain positive relationships with customers and donors and resolve guest concerns in a timely and satisfactory manner.
  • Help educate customers, donors, and the community about Goodwill programs and mission services.

Production & Merchandising

  • Sort and grade merchandise, hang and price items according to established guidelines, and meet daily production goals.
  • Maintain attractive merchandise displays, proper signage, inventory rotation, and compliance with all pricing, merchandising, and Good, Better, Best guidelines.
  • Ensure all mission-related signage is properly displayed throughout the store.

Administrative

  • Prepare and submit accurate reports, control store expenses, and ensure compliance with loss prevention policies.
  • Complete required documentation, including DSRs, bank deposits, Kaizen inspections, facility checklists, meeting records, and other organizational reporting requirements.

Store Maintenance

  • Assist with the physical operation of the store and premises.
  • Submit maintenance requests according to company policy and maintain cleanliness of the sales floor, backroom, and exterior areas.

Staffing & Leadership

  • Foster effective communication with employees through store meetings and ongoing interaction.
  • Supervise, train, and support employees to ensure achievement of production, pricing, recycling, salvage, and quality control standards.
  • Facilitate and participate in weekly staff training and educational sessions designed to improve knowledge, motivation, and performance.
  • Establish and reinforce individual performance standards in alignment with organizational expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures.
  • Work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed to support store operations.

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • One year of retail sales experience preferred.
  • Ability to learn and operate point-of-sale systems, donation systems, office computers, and telephones.
  • Ability to supervise and train employees in production, merchandising, checkout, and customer service functions.
  • Ability to work effectively under stressful conditions while demonstrating good judgment, patience, and understanding.
  • Ability to understand and follow oral and written instructions.
  • Ability to read, write, speak, hear, and perform business-related mathematical calculations.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Ability to bend, stoop, reach, twist, lift, push, pull, and move items weighing up to 40 pounds.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to occasionally work outdoors in varying temperatures and weather conditions.

Why Goodwill?

  • Mission-driven nonprofit organization
  • Collaborative leadership team
  • Opportunity to impact and change lives across Southwest Florida

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 403(b) retirement plan
  • Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee discounts
  • Tuition reimbursement

title: Procesoperatør til skiftehold - er du teknisk stærk og ansvarsbevidst?
description:
Er du teknisk interesseret, og trives du med ansvar i et produktionsmiljø? Så har vi en spændende mulighed til dig.

Vi søger en procesoperatør til en virksomhed, hvor du vil få en central rolle i den daglige drift og overvågning af produktionsanlæg. Du bliver en del af et team, der arbejder for at sikre en stabil og effektiv produktion med fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og løbende optimering. Stillingen byder på en varieret hverdag, hvor du både arbejder med overvågning af processer, fejlfinding og praktiske opgaver i produktionen.

Du vil få ansvar for at holde produktionen kørende og bidrage til, at eventuelle udfordringer bliver håndteret hurtigt og effektivt. Jobbet kræver derfor overblik, teknisk forståelse og lysten til at tage ansvar i dagligdagen


Arbejdsopgaver
  • Overvågning og kontrol af produktionsprocesser
  • Udbedring af driftsforstyrrelser og mindre fejl
  • Prøvetagning og kvalitetskontrol
  • Skift af klinger og øvrige løbende driftsopgaver
  • Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af produktionsudstyr
  • Lettere fysisk arbejde i forbindelse med den daglige drift

Faglige Kvalifikationer
  • Er uddannet procesoperatør, mejerist eller har en lignende teknisk baggrund
  • Alternativt har erfaring fra produktions- eller procesindustrien
  • Har forståelse for produktionsanlæg og tekniske processer
  • Kan kommunikere på dansk
  • Har fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og ordentlighed i dit arbejde

Personlige kvalifikationer
  • Ansvarsbevidst og mødestabil
  • Selvstændig og initiativrig
  • Omhyggelig og kvalitetsbevidst
  • Løsningsorienteret og god til at bevare overblikket
  • En holdspiller, der bidrager til et godt samarbejde
  • Fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider og skiftehold

Særlige forhold

Arbejdstider

  • Arbejde på skiftehold
  • Dag-, nat- og weekendarbejde kan forekomme
  • Der kan indgå 12-timers vagter i arbejdsplanen
  • Opstart hurtigst muligt


Løn

  • Faglært: 222 kr. pr. time
  • Ufaglært: 185 kr. pr. time

title: Product Manager
description:
Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Product Manager atau Product Owner atau role terkait (Business Analyst, Product Owner).
  • Berpengalaman dalam mengelola end-to-end product lifecycle: ideation, requirement gathering, development, testing, hingga launch.
  • Memiliki pengalaman menangani project atau product di industri perbankan atau financial technology, seperti QRIS, ATM, EDC, etc.
  • Mampu melakukan analisa kebutuhan bisnis dan menerjemahkannya menjadi product requirements (PRD), user story, dan acceptance criteria.
  • Familiar dengan proses agile/scrum dan bekerja dengan cross-functional teams (tech, UI/UX, QA, operations).
  • Memahami regulasi dan compliance perbankan, termasuk risk management, data privacy, dan keamanan sistem (menjadi nilai tambah).
  • Mampu melakukan market research dan competitor analysis untuk pengembangan produk.
  • Memiliki kemampuan problem solving, komunikasi, dan stakeholder management yang baik.

title: IT Product Specialist
description:
Salary: Rp 5.500.000 – Rp 6.500.000 per month

PT Digital Multi Sinergy sedang mencari IT Product Specialist yang memiliki kemampuan analitis, memahami teknologi dan solusi IT, serta mampu menjembatani kebutuhan customer dengan product, solution, dan vendor.

Responsibilities:

  • Menganalisis kebutuhan dan permasalahan customer untuk menentukan product/IT solution yang sesuai.

  • Melakukan research dan evaluasi terhadap berbagai IT product, technology, dan solution dari vendor.

  • Memahami dan menganalisis data menggunakan SQL serta tools pendukung lainnya.

  • Memahami design dan management arsitektur IT sesuai kebutuhan bisnis/customer.

  • Membandingkan spesifikasi, fitur, harga, dan kemampuan berbagai product/solution untuk mendapatkan solusi yang sesuai.

  • Menjadi technical liaison antara customer, internal team, dan vendor.

  • Berkoordinasi dengan vendor terkait product information, technical specification, quotation, implementation, dan kebutuhan customer.

  • Menyusun product/solution recommendation, technical documentation, dan proposal apabila dibutuhkan.

  • Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi dan melakukan eksplorasi terhadap new products & solutions yang dapat dikembangkan oleh perusahaan.

  • Bekerja sama dengan tim Sales/Business Development untuk menerjemahkan kebutuhan customer menjadi solusi IT yang feasible.

Requirements:

  • Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.

  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja 1–2 tahun di bidang IT Product, IT Solution, IT Business Analyst, Pre-Sales, IT Consultant, atau posisi terkait.

  • Memiliki kemampuan analisis data dan memahami SQL/database.

  • Memahami konsep dasar IT infrastructure, system architecture, network, cloud, data center, cybersecurity, atau teknologi IT terkait.

  • Familiar dengan berbagai IT tools, software, hardware, cloud services, dan technology solutions.

  • Memiliki kemampuan untuk melakukan product research dan solution assessment berdasarkan kebutuhan customer.

  • Mampu berkomunikasi dan berkoordinasi dengan vendor maupun customer.

  • Memiliki kemampuan analisis, problem solving, dan critical thinking yang baik.

  • Mampu menjelaskan hal-hal teknis menjadi informasi yang mudah dipahami oleh tim non-teknis.

  • Proaktif, cepat belajar, dan memiliki ketertarikan terhadap perkembangan teknologi.

title: Affärskonsult inom Business Central till Columbus Dynamics – Stockholm
company: Columbus Sweden, Poland, Germany & Czech Republic
description:
Tycker du att det är roligt att arbeta med Business Central och vill vara med och driva digitalisering och affärsutveckling hos våra kunder? Har du dessutom förståelse för produktion och hur affärsprocesser hänger ihop från inköp och planering till lager, försäljning och ekonomi? Då kan Columbus vara rätt plats för dig!

Vi fortsätter att stärka vårt dedikerade Business Central-team inom Dynamics 365. Framför oss har vi många spännande kundåtaganden och vi söker nu en Business Central-specialist som vill hjälpa våra kunder att utveckla smarta, hållbara och verksamhetsnära lösningar. Just nu lägger vi särskild vikt vid produktionsförståelse, samtidigt som rollen ger möjlighet att arbeta brett med Business Central och fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor.

Vad innebär rollen?

Du arbetar nära våra kunder för att förstå deras verksamhet, behov och affärsmål och omsätter dem till hållbara lösningar i Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. Rollen kombinerar delar av applikationskonsultens, affärskonsultens och lösningsarkitektens perspektiv. På senior nivå kan rollen motsvara Functional Solution Architect (FSA), med ett större ansvar för lösningsdesign, rådgivning och funktionell ledning inom specialistområdet.

Produktion är ett viktigt fokus i den här rekryteringen. Vi söker därför särskilt efter dig som förstår produktionsprocesser och kan se hur Business Central stödjer hela verksamhetsflödet och samspelet mellan exempelvis produktion, Supply Chain, lager, inköp, försäljning och ekonomi.

  • Arbeta med analys, processkartläggning, kravarbete och lösningsdesign tillsammans med kund.

  • Designa, konfigurera och implementera Business Central-processer, med särskilt fokus på produktionsrelaterade behov där det är relevant.

  • Guida kunder i hur de bäst kan använda Business Central för att utveckla och effektivisera sina verksamhetsprocesser.

  • Leda eller bidra i workshops och driva funktionella lösningar framåt tillsammans med kund och leveransteam.

  • Stödja testning, utbildning, go-live och vidareutveckling av kundlösningar.

  • Samarbeta nära med utvecklare, arkitekter, projektledare och andra konsulter.

  • På seniorare nivå bidra inom presales, estimat, kundrådgivning och kunskapsdelning.

Vem är du?

Du gillar att vara rådgivare och att dela med dig av din kunskap. Du trivs både med att arbeta självständigt och tillsammans med andra, och du är bekväm i en kundnära roll där du behöver förstå verksamheten bakom systemkraven.

  • Du har flera års erfarenhet av Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central som konsult eller superuser.

  • Du har förståelse för produktionsprocesser. Erfarenhet från tillverkningsindustrin är särskilt relevant i den här rekryteringen.

  • Du kan kommunicera obehindrat på svenska och engelska i en professionell miljö.

  • Du delar Columbus' företagsvärderingar och bidrar till ett bra samarbete med kunder och kollegor.

Varför ska du jobba hos oss?

Här får du möjlighet att göra det du är bra på tillsammans med kunniga kollegor som delar erfarenheter och hjälper varandra framåt. Du blir en del av ett svenskt Business Central-team som ingår i ett större globalt BC-team med många spännande kundåtaganden framför oss.

  • Möjlighet att arbeta nära kunder och få eget ansvar tidigt.

  • Ett tydligt fokus på Business Central och verksamhetsutveckling, med produktion som ett prioriterat kompetensområde just nu.

  • En verksamhet som vill ligga i framkant när det gäller AI inom Business Central.

  • Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas på Consultant-, Senior- eller Principal-nivå beroende på erfarenhet och utveckling.

Här får du göra det du är bäst på, tillsammans med kollegor som uppskattar både dig och det du gör. Du blir en del av ett team som stöttar varandra, firar framgångar tillsammans och gärna skrattar. Vad säger du? 😃

Ansökan och nästa steg

Hos oss kan du ansöka med din LinkedIn och/eller ditt CV. Du behöver inte skicka in något personligt brev. I vår rekryteringsprocess tar vi alltid referenser och genomför en bakgrundskontroll innan anställning eller eventuellt erbjudande ges. Har du frågor, vänd dig till Alexander Tonelli. Intervjuer kommer att hållas löpande.

Efter avslutad rekryteringsprocess skickar vi en fråga om din upplevelse som kandidat. Det tar bara någon sekund att besvara frågan och hjälper oss att förbättra vår rekryteringsprocess.

Jobba på Columbus

Människorna kommer alltid först på Columbus. Vi är ett globalt konsultbolag med lokal närvaro, som hjälper företag med deras digitala förändring och att blomstra genom teknik, data och mänsklig insikt. Vi är också en arbetsplats där du som medarbetare får utveckla din karriär och få stöd genom tydliga och strukturerade karriärvägar.

Vår kultur bygger på tillit, samarbete, nyfikenhet och ett gemensamt engagemang för att leverera värde till våra kunder. Oavsett om du är erfaren eller precis i början av din karriär, kommer du att hitta friheten att utforska idéer, utmana det invanda och forma din egen väg hos oss.

Med över 1 500 kollegor i fler än 10 länder kombinerar vi globala perspektiv med lokal förståelse. Det som förenar oss är vår tro på att skapa en meningsfull påverkan – för våra medarbetare, våra kunder och resan framåt.

Let’s thrive, grow, and shape the future together.

Nyfiken på Columbus?

Spana in vårt Instaflöde för att få en bild av hur det är att jobba hos oss genom våra kollegor. Klicka på bilden för att komma till Instagramkontot.

Helt ofiltrerat har vi samlat in omdömen från nuvarande och tidigare kollegor. Klicka nedan för att läsa mer.

title: Make-Ready Technician - Napa Oaks
description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

Ensures that vacant units meet the established quality standards for re-leasing by performing technical and mechanical
work that ensures the timely turn of all vacant apartment homes to market ready condition that meet the Company’s
standards for occupancy.

JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Completes all needed repairs and improvements to apartment homes prior to resident move-in by following the community’s make-ready checklist.
  • Ensures apartment homes have been properly caulked and sealed as needed around windows, sink areas, toilets, bathtubs, and showers.
  • Inspects all sheetrock for damage, and repairs and/or replaces as needed.
  • Performs touch-up paints for vacant and occupied units as directed by Service Supervisor or Community Manager.
  • Assists in maintaining the grounds, common areas, and amenities by picking up trash and debris, pressure-washing breezeways and pool areas, performing general cleaning, and painting curbs and signage as needed.
  • Supports cost-cutting and expense control programs by fixing rather than replacing parts when possible, not being wasteful with materials and supplies, and practicing the correct use for tools and equipment.
  • Completes make-ready checklist and all other required maintenance documentation in a timely manner as required by the Supervisor or Manager.
  • Complies with Greystar’s safety and risk-management policies by attending and participating in the community’s routine safety meetings, completing required training on OSHA and other safety related laws and requirements, and by reporting accidents and incidents promptly and accurately.
  • Demonstrates customer services skills by treating residents and others with respect, answering resident questions, responding sensitively to complaints about maintenance services, and completing assigned work orders with efficiency and urgency.

Physical Demands:

  • Incumbents need to be able to stand, walk, and/or sit for extended periods of time and bend, stoop, climb ladders, reach, carry objects, and crawl in confined areas.
  • Incumbents must be able to work inside and outside in all weather conditions (rain, snow, heat, hail, wind, sleet).
  • Incumbents must be able to push, pull, lift, carry, or maneuver weights of up to twenty-five (25) pounds independently and fifty (50) pounds with assistance.
  • Rare or regular travel may be required to assist other properties as needed, attend training classes, business meetings, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Incumbents must be able to work a flexible work schedule, which includes taking “call” during evenings, weekends and holidays.

#LI-CR1

The hourly range for this position is $17.00 - $21.00



Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

*Benefits offered for full-time employees. For Union and Prevailing Wage roles, compensation and benefits may vary from the listed information above due to Collective Bargaining Agreements and/or local governing authority.


Greystar will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Greystar is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Important Notice: Greystar will never request your banking details or other sensitive personal information during the interview process. Greystar does not conduct any interviews via text or messaging, and all communication will come from official Greystar email addresses (@greystar.com). If you receive suspicious requests, please report them immediately to AskHR@greystar.com.

title: Lead ML Operations Engineer
description:
About Signify


Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.


At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.


Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.


More about the role


Job Summary

Develops and maintains Machine Learning (ML) infrastructure to support scalable and efficient model deployment. Monitors and optimizes machine learning models in production environments to ensure high performance and reliability. Collaborates with data scientists and engineers to implement best practices for model integration and data processing.

Key Areas of Responsibility

title: Uddannelsesvejleder søges til arresthusene i Midt- og Vestjylland
description:
Har du lyst til at være med til at opbygge en ny vejledningsfunktion, hvor du kan gøre en konkret forskel for mennesker i en af livets mest sårbare situationer?

Vi søger en uddannelsesvejleder på 32 timer om ugen til arresthusområdet under Nordjyllands arrester og tilsyn. Du vil blive ansat i Herning arrest, men skal også dække arresthusene i Nykøbing Mors, Viborg, Holstebro og Ringkøbing.

Som uddannelsesvejleder bliver du en del af en ny faglig indsats i arresthusene, hvor du i tæt samarbejde med arresthusenes skolelærere, socialrådgivere og øvrige medarbejdere skal understøtte indsattes muligheder for uddannelse.

Hvem er vi?
Arresthusene er en del af Danmarks Fængsler og spiller en central rolle i indsattes vej videre til enten afsoning eller løsladelse. Her møder vi mennesker i en afgørende fase af deres liv, hvor der ofte er behov for hurtig afklaring, realistiske perspektiver og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Som uddannelsesvejleder bliver du en del af en ny faggruppe, der skal styrke den uddannelsesrettede indsats i arresthusene. Sammen med skolelærere, socialrådgivere, fængselsbetjente og ledelse bidrager du til at skabe sammenhæng i den indsattes uddannelsesforløb – både under opholdet i arresten og i overgangen til fængsel eller løsladelse.

Du får en unik mulighed for at være med til at udvikle en ny funktion, hvor du er med til at forme både arbejdsopgaver, samarbejdsformer og den fremtidige vejledningsindsats.

Om jobbet
Som uddannelsesvejleder får du en varieret hverdag med både individuelle vejledningssamtaler, administrative opgaver og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • gennemføre individuelle vejledningssamtaler med indsatte om uddannelses- og beskæftigelsesmuligheder
  • motivere indsatte til uddannelse – også når de ikke umiddelbart er i målgruppen for AVU eller FVU
  • vejlede om uddannelsesmuligheder under afsoning og bidrage til, at den indsatte visiteres til det mest relevante tilbud
  • vejlede om uddannelsesmuligheder efter overførsel til fængsel eller ved løsladelse
  • gennemføre akutte vejledningssamtaler ved eksempelvis nyindsættelser, overførsler eller afbrudte uddannelsesforløb
  • indhente eksamensbeviser, uddannelsesdokumentation og tidligere OBU-test samt sikre korrekt journalisering
  • registrere vejledningsforløb og dokumentation i PUMA
  • holde indsattes uddannelsesønsker og handleplaner opdaterede
  • koordinere ventelister til undervisning i tæt samarbejde med arresthusenes lærere.
  • samarbejde med vejledere i øvrige fængsler og arresthuse for at skabe gode overgange mellem institutionerne
Stillingen indebærer en del administrativt arbejde, hvor struktur, dokumentation og opfølgning er en vigtig del af opgaven.

Du får din daglige gang i flere arresthuse og skal derfor trives med en mobil hverdag, hvor planlægning og fleksibilitet er en naturlig del af arbejdet. Flere af arresthusene har begrænsede kontorfaciliteter og derfor skal du være indstillet på at arbejde hjemmefra. Det er desuden en forudsætning for at kunne varetage jobbet, at du har kørekort.

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en diplomuddannelse i uddannelses-, erhvervs-, studie- og karrierevejledning eller tilsvarende kvalifikationer. Har du ikke allerede uddannelsen eller tilsvarende dokumenterede kvalifikationer, skal du være indstillet på som led i din ansættelse at tage diplomuddannelsen
  • har et indgående kendskab til voksenuddannelsessystemet
  • har erfaring med vejledning af voksne med forskellige forudsætninger
  • arbejder struktureret og har blik for dokumentation og administrative processer
  • kan skabe tillid og motivation hos mennesker, der ofte befinder sig i en sårbar og uafklaret livssituation
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde
  • trives i en hverdag, hvor planer kan ændre sig med kort varsel
  • har gode skriftlige og mundtlige formidlingsevner
  • har lyst til at være med til at udvikle en ny funktion og bidrage aktivt til at forme den fremtidige vejledningsindsats.
Erfaring fra samt kendskab til uddannelsesmulighederne i Danmarks Fængsler er en fordel, men ikke en forudsætning.

Vi tilbyder
Som ansat i Danmarks Fængsler bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med stor samfundsmæssig betydning og mange forskellige fagligheder.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • mulighed for at være med til at etablere og udvikle en ny vejledningsfunktion i arresthusene
  • et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du kan gøre en konkret forskel for mennesker i en afgørende fase af deres liv
  • et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde med lærere, socialrådgivere, fængselsbetjente og ledelse
  • en afvekslende hverdag med stor grad af selvstændighed
  • grundig introduktion og oplæring i Danmarks Fængslers rammer og sikkerhedsprocedurer
  • faglig sparring og mulighed for at udvikle vejledningsindsatsen sammen med engagerede kolleger.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse og aflønning sker i henhold til fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Lærerenes Centralorganisation (LC) og CO10 samt organisationsaftale for vejledere ved Studievalg Danmark og Kriminalforsorgens institutioner og de eventuelle hertil indgåede lokalaftaler. Der vil herudover kunne aftales tillæg afhængig af erfaring og kvalifikationer.

Ansættelsesområdet er Danmarks Fængsler.

Arbejdsstedet er Herning arrest, men med tjeneste på tværs af arresterne i Nykøbing Mors, Viborg, Herning, Holstebro og Ringkøbing.

Stillingerne er på 32 timer om ugen med forventet opstart den 1. februar 2027.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du i forbindelse med samtalen giver dit samtykke til, at Danmarks Fængsler må indhente og vurdere oplysninger om dig i det Centrale Kriminalregister.

Ansøgning
Stillingerne søges elektronisk via knappen ”Søg stillingen”. Din ansøgning, CV, dokumentation for uddannelse samt andet relevant materiale skal være modtaget i rekrutteringssystemet senest den 30. oktober 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i Herning d. 11. november 2026.

Hvis du indkaldes til samtale, skal du til samtalen medbringe billedidentifikation, f.eks. pas eller kørekort. Inden ansættelse skal vi modtage dokumentation for CV.

Alle interesserede uanset personlig baggrund opfordres til at søge.

Yderligere spørgsmål
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Steffan Skånning Brogaard, tlf. 72552866.

For yderligere information om Danmarks Fængsler henvises til hjemmesiden www.danmarksfængsler.dk.

title: Vice President, Data Engineering
description:
Why Join

Imagine having the opportunity to build and shape the data foundation that powers critical business decisions across the bank. As a Vice President, Data Engineering, you will lead the design and evolution of enterprise-scale data platforms, enabling advanced analytics, AI, regulatory reporting, and digital transformation initiatives.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, data scientists, and technology teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure data solutions that support the bank's strategic objectives.

How You Succeed

To succeed in this role, you will combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities to architect and deliver modern data platforms. You will drive the adoption of engineering best practices, establish scalable data pipelines, and ensure data is trustworthy, accessible, and governed across the organization.

Success will be measured by your ability to build high-performing engineering teams, optimize platform performance, improve data quality and reliability, and enable faster delivery of business insights through robust data infrastructure.

What you will be doing:

  • Define and drive the strategic roadmap for the enterprise data platform, ensuring scalability, resilience, security, and operational excellence.

  • Design, develop, and maintain large-scale batch and real-time data pipelines using modern data engineering frameworks and technologies.

  • Lead the architecture and optimization of distributed data platforms, including Hadoop, Spark, Data Lake, and cloud-based data ecosystems.

  • Establish and govern data engineering standards, including data quality, metadata management, lineage, observability, and platform monitoring.

  • Partner with business, analytics, data science, and application teams to translate business requirements into scalable and reusable data solutions.

  • Drive DataOps and platform automation initiatives, including CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, and release management.

  • Optimize platform performance, cluster utilization, storage efficiency, and processing workloads to support growing business demands.

  • Ensure compliance with enterprise security, risk, governance, and regulatory requirements across all data environments.

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of data engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies and propose enhancements that strengthen the bank's data capabilities and future-readiness.

Who are we looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or Big Data environments, including leadership or solution architecture responsibilities.

  • Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale data platforms and data integration solutions.

  • Strong hands-on expertise in the Hadoop ecosystem, including HDFS, YARN, Hive, HBase, Sqoop, and related technologies.

  • Advanced knowledge of Apache Spark (Core, SQL, Structured Streaming) and distributed computing concepts.

  • Proficiency in Python, Scala, Java, and advanced SQL for large-scale data processing and optimization.

  • Experience working with modern data architecture patterns including Data Lakes, Lakehouse platforms, and cloud-native data services.

  • Strong understanding of data modelling, data governance, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.

  • Experience implementing DevOps/DataOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and orchestration technologies.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and business audiences.

  • Proven track record of leading engineering teams and delivering complex data transformation initiatives in large organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in banking, financial services, or highly regulated industries.

  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as Teradata, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

  • Knowledge of data governance, regulatory reporting, risk, compliance, and audit requirements.

  • Experience supporting AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics workloads on enterprise data platforms.




What we offer:


Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Knowledge Specialist
description:
- Casual opportunity - Service Improvement Program
- $74.36 per hour (HEW 8) + 25% casual loading + 12% super
- Enjoy a vibrant on-campus location, close to public transport

Shape how research knowledge is captured, curated and reused – and see your work applied at scale


In this role, you will design the knowledge environment for Macquarie University's Research Program – the frameworks, taxonomies, repositories, and content that make evidence, methodologies and lessons learned genuinely accessible to researchers, professional staff, industry and community partners.

Reporting to the Research Program Manager within Service Improvement, you will work across a program that brings diverse expertise into one place. If you enjoy moving between design and practical delivery – this role offers real scope to make a difference.


About the Role


As Knowledge Specialist – Research Program, you will:

  • Develop and implement the Research Program Knowledge Management Plan
  • Build and maintain SharePoint knowledge repositories, knowledge bases, FAQs, templates and guidance materials
  • Draft, edit, curate and publish knowledge articles, research insights, lessons learned, methodologies and research resources
  • Gather content from researchers and subject matter experts, translating complex information into accessible, plain-language content
  • Maintain knowledge article trackers and publication schedules, and monitor milestones, risks, issues and deliverables against knowledge management plans
  • Conduct content reviews and audits so that knowledge assets remain current, accurate and useful
  • Test and refine search functionality (AI), keywords, and user experience
  • Facilitate workshops and stakeholder engagement meetings, as required
  • Provide training to lift knowledge management capability across the program
  • Advance continuous improvement and wider adoption of knowledge management practice

About Us


Service Improvement partners across the University to deliver programs that change how our people work. The Research Program brings together researchers and professional staff to generate, translate and apply knowledge – and this role makes certain that knowledge endures well beyond any single project.


About You


You are an experienced knowledge or information management practitioner who is as comfortable analysing content and building knowledge capability. You translate complexity into clarity, you know your way around SharePoint, and you build credibility quickly with researchers and senior stakeholders in busy, evolving environments.


Selection Criteria


  • Tertiary qualifications in Information Management, Research Management, or a related discipline, with equivalent experience also considered
  • Demonstrated hands-on capability with SharePoint, knowledge bases, and content management systems, including search optimisation and user experience testing
  • Proven track record creating, editing, and publishing knowledge articles, guidance materials and templates for varied audiences
  • Experience working with subject matter experts and stakeholders in complex or matrixed environments
  • Well-developed reporting, project coordination, and stakeholder engagement capability, including preparation of papers for governance forums
  • Capacity to combine plan with day-to-day operational delivery, alongside experience facilitating workshops, training, or communities of practice

To be considered, please apply online with your CV and a cover letter outlining how your experience aligns with the selection criteria (above).

title: GRC Manager - Technology Risk & Governance
description:
Pinnacle Group exists to connect people with opportunity. For the last 25 years, we've done exactly that by living our core values of putting people first, delivering excellence in all we do, and giving back to the communities in which we live and work. We are a leading workforce solutions company supporting the talent needs of global leaders in financial services, technology, communications, utilities, and transportation and we are one of the largest women and minority-owned companies in our industry. Our team of service-driven, energetic, and diverse professionals is well-respected in our industry and our leadership team is aligned and focused on taking the company to the next level. If you're looking for a new opportunity where you can truly make a difference, we hope you'll apply for a position with us.

Job Summary

  • Own and manage the third-party risk management program, including risk-based vendor assessments, onboarding reviews, and periodic evaluations throughout the vendor lifecycle.
  • Partner with Information Security, Legal, Compliance, IT, and business stakeholders to identify, assess, document, and mitigate technology, cybersecurity, privacy, AI, and vendor-related risks.
  • Review SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001 certifications, penetration testing reports, business continuity plans, disaster recovery documentation, privacy materials, and related compliance evidence.
  • Interface with third-party auditors, vendors, and internal stakeholders to gather documentation, respond to assessment requests, and support audit readiness.
  • Support responses to technology-related third-party questionnaires, ensuring information is accurate, complete, consistent, and professionally documented.
  • Maintain organized assessment records, risk documentation, compliance evidence, and supporting materials in accordance with internal policies and procedures.
  • Prepare risk summaries, dashboards, reports, and governance materials for leadership and committee review.
  • Maintain and support Pinnacle Group’s ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 compliance in partnership with IT and other key stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to create, maintain, and implement AI-related standards, procedures, and risk governance practices.
  • Enhance and maintain Pinnacle Group’s business continuity plan in collaboration with appropriate business and technology stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Compliance, or a related field.
  • Experience in technology risk, governance, compliance, information security, audit, third-party risk management, or a related discipline.
  • Strong experience performing vendor risk assessments for SaaS platforms, cloud providers, managed service providers, software vendors, and AI-enabled products.
  • Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC standards, NIST, CIS Controls, and related governance practices.
  • Experience interfacing with third-party auditors and responding to security, risk, compliance, or vendor assessment questionnaires.
  • Ability to assess technology vendors, identify risk concerns, document findings, and communicate recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across auditors, vendors, IT, Legal, Compliance, and business teams.
  • Experience using Drata or similar governance, risk, and compliance platforms preferred.
  • Working knowledge of AI-related risks, controls, governance standards, and emerging compliance considerations preferred.

title: Technik/ Techniczka Serwisu (woj. Małopolskie)
description:
O firmie Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, światowy lider w dziedzinie inteligentnych rozwiązań klimatycznych i energetycznych, angażuje się w tworzenie innowacji, które zapewniają komfort, bezpieczeństwo i zrównoważony rozwój. Dzięki nowoczesnym rozwiązaniom w zakresie kontroli temperatury, jakości powietrza oraz transportu poprawiamy jakość życia, wspieramy kluczowe sektory gospodarki oraz zapewniamy bezpieczny transport żywności, leków ratujących życie i wielu innych produktów. Od momentu wynalezienia nowoczesnej klimatyzacji w 1902 roku działamy z jasno określoną misją: poprawiać jakość życia oraz świat, który wspólnie tworzymy. Naszą pozycję lidera zawdzięczamy światowej klasy, różnorodnemu i inkluzywnemu zespołowi, który stawia klienta w centrum wszystkich działań. Więcej informacji można znaleźć na stronie corporate.carrier.com lub obserwując Carrier w mediach społecznościowych @Carrier.

Obecnie do naszego zespołu poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Technika / Techniczki Serwisu, odpowiedzialnej za region województwa małopolskiego. Do głównych zadań należeć będzie terminowe wykonywanie przeglądów, napraw oraz usuwania awarii urządzeń chłodniczych oraz realizacja prac bezpiecznie zgodnie z zasadami bezpieczeństwa Carrier.



Wymagania:

· Wykształcenie chłodnicze mile widziane.

· Znajomości zagadnień chłodniczych i klimatyzacyjnych.

· Uprawnienia Elektryka, grupa I, E 2,5,10.

· Świadectwo kwalifikacji F-Gaz.

· Mile widziana doświadczenia zawodowe w dziedzinie agregatów wody lodowej

· Obsługa komputera, pakiet MS Office.

· Prawo jazdy kategorii B.

· Gotowość do odbywania podróży służbowych

Obowiązki:

· Wykonywanie cyklicznych przeglądów agregatów wody lodowej, jednostek dachowych, szaf klimatyzacji precyzyjnych, chłodnic.

· Usuwanie awarii i usterek zleconych przez Serwis Carrier Polska.

· Uczestnictwo w uruchomieniach i odbiorach nowych urządzeń chłodniczych.

· Zgłaszanie zapotrzebowania na części zamienne i inne materiały niezbędne do zapewnienia ciągłości wykonywanych prac.

· Odbiór części do prac z magazynów serwisowych.

· Wypełnianie kart serwisowych po każdej wizycie na obiekcie.

· Wypełnianie terminowe tygodniowych kart pracy.

· Pozyskiwanie zamówień w zakresie napraw, modernizacji i części zamiennych.

· Przygotowanie z Kierownikiem regionu oferty do Klienta.

· Uczestnictwo w szkoleniach organizowanych przez pracodawcę.



Zakres wynagrodzenia

Wynagrodzenie roczne na tym stanowisku wynosi od zł 96 072,00-zł120 00,00 brutto rocznie. Na wysokość wynagrodzenia w tym przedziale mogą wpływać m.in. umiejętności, wykształcenie, doświadczenie oraz inne indywidualne kwalifikacje wybranego kandydata.

Benefity

Oferujemy konkurencyjny pakiet całkowitego wynagrodzenia, który może obejmować dodatkowe świadczenia oraz inicjatywy wspierające dobrostan pracowników. Zakres świadczeń różni się w zależności od stanowiska i lokalizacji i ma na celu wspieranie zdrowia, bezpieczeństwa oraz sukcesu pracowników.


Równe traktowanie w procesie rekrutacji

Carrier zobowiązuje się do przestrzegania zasad równego traktowania oraz niedyskryminacji.

Wszyscy wykwalifikowani kandydaci będą brani pod uwagę w procesie rekrutacji bez względu na rasę, kolor skóry, religię, płeć, orientację seksualną, tożsamość płciową, pochodzenie narodowe, wiek, niepełnosprawność lub jakąkolwiek inną kategorię chronioną na mocy obowiązujących przepisów prawa.

Jeśli potrzebujesz racjonalnego wsparcia w celu ukończenia procesu aplikacyjnego, udziału w rozmowie kwalifikacyjnej lub innego etapu rekrutacji, prosimy o kontakt pod adresem Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com. Dołożymy wszelkich starań, aby zapewnić odpowiednie wsparcie zgodnie z obowiązującymi przepisami prawa.


Termin składania aplikacji

Aplikacje będą przyjmowane przez co najmniej 14 dni kalendarzowych od daty publikacji ogłoszenia. Data publikacji: 5 czerwca 2026

Ochrona danych osobowych

Kliknij w link, aby zapoznać się z informacją o Ochronie Danych Osobowych Kandydatów.


Wykorzystanie technologii AI

W wybranych etapach procesu rekrutacyjnego mogą być wykorzystywane narzędzia oparte na technologiach sztucznej inteligencji, przy zapewnieniu odpowiedniego nadzoru ze strony osób zaangażowanych w proces.

title: State Government & Politics Reporter
description:
Strengthening and empowering all of the communities we serve.

The Oregonian/OregonLive in Portland, Oregon, is hiring a State Government & Politics Reporter to join our nationally award-winning newsroom. We seek a journalist who thrives on holding powerful public officials to account, has a track record of using public records to heighten government transparency and accountability and has a nose for high-impact political stories and quick talkers.

This Reporter will break daily news on a competitive statewide beat while also preparing frequent weekend takeouts from breaking political news, personalities, failings and successes. Working collaboratively with a second state politics reporter, you will help drive the direction of our state politics coverage. Using a variety of storytelling techniques and platforms, you’ll help cover elections, the Legislature, state agencies and other powerbrokers, keeping an eye on the real-world implications of policy and spending choices on Oregonians.

You will work with a politics editor who not only is deeply invested in the reporter’s success but also has a proven track record of helping reporters enhance their stories and shine.

The reporter will be expected to consistently elevate the voices of people of color, those navigating poverty or disability or others who are too rarely heard by those in power or reflected in news coverage.

We are looking for a deeply curious person with experience and skills to develop deep and diverse sourcing while remaining nimble in the face of breaking news. The ideal candidate will bring an enterprise-driven approach to the beat, with the skill and energy to deliver hard-hitting agenda-setting coverage on a regular basis. The reporter should have a track record of, or demonstrated interest in, shining a light on the influence of powerful interests in shaping politics and government and the opportunities for government to do better by those with the least political power.

The salary range for this position is $60,000 - $85,000 annually.

This is a hybrid position based in the Portland metro area. This position requires reliable transportation to meet with sources and cover events at the Oregon Capitol in Salem.

Applicants should submit a cover letter, resume and 3-5 stories showcasing their reporting and writing skills.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Become an authority on state government including deep expertise on state budgets, legislative processes and readily available state politics and government data sources (such as campaign finance and lobbying databases)
  • Work collaboratively with other reporters, including another state government reporter and others (in beats ranging from education, homelessness and business) to uncover news and report on ongoing issues
  • Publicly represent The Oregonian/OregonLive in limited situations, including political debates and possibly on national news programs as an expert on Oregon politics and government
  • Regularly file public records requests and generally seek the transparency necessary to hold powerful leaders accountable
  • Show curiosity, collegiality and flexibility when, on occasion, news demands that the organization pivots to high-priority events

Our ideal candidate will have the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or communications, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Minimum of 5 years of journalism experience with a track record of clear, engaging writing, fresh story framing and diverse sourcing.
  • Excellent time management skills with ability to work under tight deadlines when needed
  • Ability to analyze data sets to find the smart stories, including the effectiveness of state programs and policies, state hiring and spending and other government accountability metrics
  • Inclination and ability to insist on compliance with public records and public meeting laws to give readers maximum transparency about elected officials’ performance
  • Skill at using social media and digital platforms to drive traffic and engage readers
  • Experience with or willingness to learn about audience best practices
  • Comfort with taking photos, video and audio on assignment as needed
  • Advanced data analysis skills are a plus
  • Fluency in another language spoken widely in Oregon is an asset, but not required

title: Timelønnede vikarer til Boligerne i Skovlunde
description:
Er du hjertevarm og engageret? Så har vi de skønneste beboere, som har brug for dig. Hos os tilbyder vi en dejlig atmosfære, hvor der er plads til mange grin og faglig sparring på tværs af faggrupper.

Du kan se frem til et meningsfyldt arbejde, hvor du får en grundig introduktion til dine opgaver samt indflydelse på din arbejdsdag.

Boligerne i Skovlunde er et socialpædagogisk botilbud med 33 fantastiske borgere. Hos os er der ansat pædagoger, omsorgsmedhjælpere samt sundhedsfagligt personale.

Vi søger vikarer, der brænder for målgruppen lige så meget, som vi selv gør, og som bl.a. kan træde til ved ferie og sygdom.

Med udgangspunkt i borgernes selv- og medbestemmelse og den enkeltes ressourcer og behov, stræber vi efter at give de bedste betingelser for at leve et godt liv.

Arbejdstiden er planlagt mellem kl. 7.00-23.00 i skiftende vagter alle ugens dage.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

  • Interesse for det pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige område
  • Værdsætter gode relationer med borgerne, de pårørende og dine kolleger
  • Trives i en hverdag, hvor der er forskelligartede arbejdsområder med borgerne, og hvor fleksibilitet og rummelighed er en naturlig del af hverdagen
  • Er indstillet på at hjælpe borgerne med personlig pleje og omsorg samt praktiske opgaver som oprydning, rengøring, indkøb mm.
  • Vil arbejde aktivt i det forpligtende fællesskab, hvor åbenhed og refleksion er afgørende for udvikling af vores fælles faglige og psykiske arbejdsmiljø.

Dine kompetencer

  • Er reflekterende omkring det at arbejde i borgernes eget hjem
  • Kan bevare roen, overblikket og går glad på arbejde
  • Har kendskab til IT på brugerniveau med henblik på faglig dokumentation og kommunikation. Vi arbejder i fagsystemet Nexus.

Det får du hos os

  • En fantastisk arbejdsplads med en god stemning og godt humør
  • Engagerede kolleger og de skønneste beboere
  • Et godt pårørendesamarbejde som vi vægter meget højt
  • Et tæt og godt samarbejde mellem det pædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige personale på tværs af huset. Vi ser det som en force at kunne sparre og udvikle vores kompetencer sammen til gavn for borgeren
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi vægter fælles faglighed og refleksion højt imellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

Hvem er vi
Boligerne i Skovlunde er et socialpædagogisk døgntilbud, hvor der bor 33 voksne borgere i tre forskellige bo grupper. For alle borgerne gælder, at det er mennesker med kognitive udviklingshandicap, hvoraf nogle også har fysiske funktionsnedsættelser.

Med udgangspunkt i borgernes selv- og medbestemmelse og den enkeltes ressourcer og behov, stræber vi efter at give de bedste betingelser for at leve et godt liv.

Boligerne i Skovlunde er en del af organisationen Voksne med Handicap, som også rummer Dagtilbuddet i Skovlunde, Aftenklubben i Skovlunde, Aflastningstilbuddet Torvevej, og Bofællesskabet Sønderhaven i Måløv.

Boligerne i Skovlunde ligger 5-7 min. gang fra Skovlunde station.

Så hvis du ønsker at blive en del af vores skønne sted, vil vi med glæde tage imod din ansøgning.

Vil du vide mere
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte Daglig leder Trine Braikia på telefon 4477 6309 i tidsrummet 8.00-16.00.

Læs mere om Ballerup Kommune som arbejdsplads på job.ballerup.dk

Ansættelsesproces og løn

Ansættelsesdatoen er snarest muligt.

Vi holder samtaler i takt med, at vi modtager ansøgningerne.

Stillingen er som vikar med timer mellem 0-37 om ugen.

Ansøgningsfrist: 13. november 2026.

Vi tilbyder løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter overenskomst for omsorgs- og pædagogmedhjælper i kommunerne.

Ansættelse sker efter principperne om lokal løndannelse og efter aftale med den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Lønintervallet for stillingen som omsorgs- og pædagogmedhjælper er (Trin 15) til og med 4 års erfaring: 27.864 - 35.904 kr. pr. måned uden pension (37 timer).

Den endelige løn fastsættes efter forhandling mellem arbejdsgiver og den faglige organisation, der har forhandlingsretten på det relevante overenskomstområde. Lønnen afhænger blandt andet af din uddannelse, dokumenterede anciennitet og kvalifikationer.

Vi indhenter straffeattester.

Ballerup Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Læs mere her

Send din ansøgning online. Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor og vedhæft din ansøgning, CV og uddannelsesbevis.

title: Svejser til MIG og MAG i Aalborg
description:
Vil du have firmabil, bonusordning og sjovt at gå på arbejde?

Vi mangler en svejser til MIG og MAG i Aalborg.

Du lander i et større setup, hvor erhvervsopgaverne fylder hverdagen. Rollen er for dig, der godt kan lide at arbejde selvstændigt og få tingene gjort ordentligt. Du har firmabil med i pakken, så der er styr på transporten mellem opgaverne. Samtidig er der lagt vægt på godt socialt sammenhold, så du ikke bare bliver en løs mand på en opgave.

Det her er til dig, der gerne vil svejse, tage ansvar og være et sted hvor tonen betyder noget. Mottoet er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Og når der også er bonusordning, kan man mærke at indsatsen bliver taget alvorligt.

Det får du

Løn: 190-210 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Bonus: Bonusordning

Arbejdsområde: Aalborg og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: MIG, MAG og selvstændigt svejsearbejde

Din hverdag

Opgaverne har svejsning som det faglige centrum, og du bruger især MIG, MAG og MMA. Du holder selv styr på dit arbejde, kvaliteten i svejsningen og hvornår du skal sige til hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Svejser med MAG, MIG og MMA
  • Svejser i sort stål eller rustfrit
  • Svejser efter tegning eller WPS
  • Tilpasser og klargør emner før svejsning
  • Kontrollerer dit eget arbejde før aflevering

Mottoet her er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Der er godt socialt sammenhold omkring jobbet, men uden at du skal have nogen i nakken hele dagen. Du får plads til at tage ansvar og gøre arbejdet færdigt på en ordentlig måde.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har et par års erfaring som svejser
  • Har prøvet MAG, MIG eller MMA før
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt uden at kvaliteten glipper
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med flere svejsemetoder før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage fat og levere et stykke arbejde du kan stå inde for.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, er opstart hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en svejser mere i Aalborg, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

description:

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. As a Key Holder, better known as a “Floor Leader,” at Skechers, you’ll take on an essential Retail Leadership Role, contributing to store operations and mentoring your team to deliver exceptional customer service. In this entry-level management role, you’ll oversee daily operations, support sales goals, and help maintain the store's premium shopping environment. title: Community Reporter - Temporary
description:
Strengthening and empowering all of the communities we serve.

The Oregonian/OregonLive seeks a full-time, temporary Community Reporter to help our newsroom expand its coverage outside the city of Portland. This role requires someone who does not rely solely on officials or institutions for story ideas, but listens closely to the buzz in the community, and turns that curiosity into useful and trusted journalism.

This position is responsible for monitoring community calendars, public information feeds, meeting agendas and community conversations – in person and on social media – to stay on top of daily news and identify the questions readers want answered. The reporter needs to move quickly from listening to reporting: making calls and getting into the community to produce several timely posts daily. They should be on the hunt for stories people are already talking about as well as those that will surprise and bring joy to our readers.

Candidates should also feel comfortable using AI responsibly as a tool to work smarter, surface story ideas, build context and go deeper on important topics.

The pay rate for this position is $28.00 - $32.00 per hour. This is a full-time, temporary position for up to six months.

This job requires reliable transportation to meet with sources or cover events.

Our ideal candidate will have the following:

  • A degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least one year of professional journalism experience with a demonstrated ability to produce clear, compelling and accurate reporting.
  • Ability to identify, verify and develop stories that resonate with everyday residents, including ideas surfaced through reader questions, social media conversation, search trends and public records.
  • Comfort appearing on camera and producing short, engaging social videos that bring reporting to wider audiences.
  • Comfort working at a high tempo, balancing fast, accurate daily updates that readers can’t find elsewhere and will subscribe to receive.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, as well as in The Oregonian/OregonLive office.
