title: AI Product Engineer
description:
SmallClaims is a legal tech company that recovers small, valid claims of up to €25,000 through the courts. Claims that businesses write off today because pursuing them costs more than they are worth. Our AI agents run the whole process, from legal assessment and settlement to filing, judgment and enforcement, while our in-house lawyers quality-assure the work and appear in court. That has cut manual case handling from over 15 hours to about 1.5 hours per case. We have handled 5,000+ cases, win 90%+ in court and serve 500+ Danish customers. Case intake has grown more than 370% since 2023, and we have just raised €2M from Vendep Capital to grow in Europe. Now we are growing the engineering team.

THE ROLE

You take ownership of your own areas within our AI service (Python/FastAPI, LLM pipelines) and our back-office platform, the tool our case managers and lawyers run the operation on. Ideas take form together with the team, product specialists and the CTO. You take them from there, end to end across the stack: shape, build, ship, verify, follow up.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

  • Own parts of and build features in our AI service: LLM orchestration with structured outputs, tool calling, and complex agentic workflows.

  • Build the back-office platform our case managers and lawyers use every day, and talk to them to find out what they really need.

  • Set up and improve evals and observability, so we know our agents are right before we scale them.

  • Ship and run what you build, from staging to production on AWS, with tests and CI as a habit.

WHAT WE WORK WITH

  • Stack: Laravel/PHP, Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Google.

  • How we build: Coding agents are part of daily work here. We expect you to be ahead of the curve on building with AI, not catching up to it.

WHO YOU ARE

  • 3+ years building and operating software in production, from a startup, a bigger company, open source or other serious project.

  • You think like a product owner. You want responsibility and ownership, and you take a complicated problem to a shipped feature.

  • You are good with data: you understand complex data sets and data pipelines, and you can build with them, visualise them and explain them.

  • You hold strong opinions lightly. You are direct in disagreement, but easy to work with after the decision.

  • You communicate directly and are honest about mistakes. You can talk to real users and are comfortable with shifting priorities.

  • You love building, love learning, and are curious about the domain itself: the legal process, not just the tech.

EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

Must have

  • Strong backend development, incl. background jobs, auth models and API design.

  • Solid relational database experience (Postgres/SQL or similar): schema design, migrations, performance.

  • Hands-on LLM building in production, not just demos: orchestration, structured outputs, tool calling, evals, tracing, prompt design, injection.

  • Works daily with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode or similar), knows their strengths and limits, and stays up to date.

  • Testing as a habit: feature and end-to-end tests, CI, verifying your own work through staging to production.

  • Cloud and deployment literacy (AWS or similar, Docker, CI/CD). You can operate what you ship.

Nice to have

  • Python/FastAPI, Laravel/PHP or Next.js specifically.

  • Production migration: third-party service changes, database moves, major-version upgrades, data backfills.

  • Operating AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and Linux servers hands-on.

  • Eval or observability tooling for agentic workflows.

  • Integrations where no documented API exists: webhooks, browser extensions, automation, scraping.

  • Legaltech, fintech or another regulated domain.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Real ownership of core parts of the AI platform in a small team that ships every week.

  • Close work with the CTO, product specialists and the lawyers who use what you build.

  • Our base is the office in Copenhagen, but regular remote work is fine

How to apply:

Apply via The Hub with a short intro, your CV, GitHub and links to things you have built: apps, side projects, something you shipped at work. Next, we send you our skills checklist as a self-assessment plus a few short written questions, then interviews with the team, then an offer. We keep the process short and give you a clear answer at every step.

For more information or questions please contact us at careers@smallclaims.ai

SmallClaims – turning unpaid invoices into won court cases Every year, European businesses write off billions in valid, winnable claims. Not because they would lose in court, but because pursuing a €3,000 invoice with lawyers and court fees costs more than the claim is worth. The court system was built for a time when a lawyer handled every case. That works for a €1M dispute. It does not work for a 15,000 DKK invoice. SmallClaims fixes that. We are a Copenhagen-based legal tech company that recovers small, valid claims of up to €25,000 through the courts. Our AI agents run the whole process, from legal assessment and settlement to filing, judgment and enforcement, while our in-house lawyers quality-assure the work and appear in court when needed. Manual case handling has dropped from over 15 hours to about 1.5 hours per case, which makes claims that were once uneconomic worth pursuing again. Today we have handled 5,000+ cases, win 90%+ of our court cases and serve 500+ customers in Denmark, from businesses with many outstanding invoices to debt collection agencies and law firms. Case intake has grown more than 370% since 2023. In 2026 we raised a €2M seed round led by Vendep Capital to expand into more European markets. We are a small team of lawyers who build and engineers who litigate. If you want real ownership from day one and to help build the engine that gives every business access to justice, no matter the size of the claim, we would like to hear from you.

title: Career Services Specialist – Advanced Professional
description:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

  • CURRENT PENN STATE EMPLOYEE (faculty, staff, technical service, or student), please login to Workday to complete the internal application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

  • CURRENT PENN STATE STUDENT (not employed previously at the university) and seeking employment with Penn State, please login to Workday to complete the student application process. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.

  • If you are NOT a current employee or student, please click “Apply” and complete the application process for external applicants.

Approval of remote and hybrid work is not guaranteed regardless of work location. For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see Notice to Out of State Applicants.

​

POSITION SPECIFICS​

The Office of Science Engagement, within the Eberly College of Science, seeks candidates for the position of Career Services Specialist- Advanced Professional, a key contributor to advancing undergraduate student engagement in research opportunities and experiential learning. The Career Services Specialist- (Research) will design, deliver, and evaluate programs that support Eberly College of Science students in exploring, securing, and succeeding in undergraduate research opportunities at Penn State and beyond.


The selected candidate will work closely with students to support the following:

  • Encourage participation in undergraduate research experiences across the Eberly College of Science and the broader Penn State community
  • Advise students on identifying research opportunities that align with their academic and professional goals
  • Guide students through the process of securing research positions, including developing effective application materials and communicating with potential faculty mentors
  • Assist students in exploring and applying to summer undergraduate research programs, including Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REUs), institutional summer research programs, and other national opportunities
  • Support students as they prepare for the next stages of their research journey, including summer research experiences, presentation opportunities, graduate school exploration, and research-focused career pathways
  • Evaluate the effectiveness and impact of research engagement programs, workshops, and advising services

This position works collaboratively with the Office of Science Engagement team, Eberly College of Science academic departments, faculty mentors, Undergraduate Research and Fellowship and Mentoring, and other campus partners to develop and deliver innovative undergraduate research programming that promotes student success and engagement.


Duties will include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Design, implement, coordinate, and assess undergraduate research programs and initiatives (virtual, hybrid, and in-person)
  • Coordinate the Summer Undergraduate Research Experience (SURE) program, including student recruitment, application management, program logistics, participant support, and program assessment
  • Meet individually with undergraduate students to discuss research interests, identify opportunities, and provide guidance on securing research experiences at Penn State and externally
  • Develop and deliver workshops, presentations, and programming related to undergraduate research engagement, summer research opportunities, research skill development, graduate education preparation, and professional development
  • Serve as a guest lecturer in undergraduate courses and student programs on topics related to finding and engaging in undergraduate research
  • Teach SC 100: Introduction to Research, including curriculum delivery, student mentoring, and assessment
  • Collaborate with faculty, departments, and campus partners to increase awareness of, and access to, undergraduate research opportunities
  • Develop resources and initiatives that help students navigate research pathways and take the next step in their academic and professional development
  • Coordinate marketing and communication efforts related to undergraduate research opportunities through websites, publications, digital communications, and social media in partnership with the Office of Science Engagement
  • Represent the Office of Science Engagement at on-campus and off-campus events, which may occasionally require evening and weekend hours

Required Qualifications

Successful candidates must either have demonstrated a commitment to building an inclusive, equitable, and diverse campus community or describe one or more ways they would contribute to these efforts.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with undergraduate students in academic advising, mentoring, research, or related educational settings
  • Experience coordinating or supporting undergraduate research programs
  • Knowledge of undergraduate research opportunities, summer research programs, and pathways to graduate education
  • Experience developing and delivering educational programming, workshops, or classroom instruction
  • Strong presentation and public speaking skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Exemplary attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Team-oriented mindset with the ability to build collaborative partnerships across campus
  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort developing and improving processes

Application Requirements

Candidates are required to submit both a cover letter and résumé with their application. The cover letter should highlight their experience supporting undergraduate student success, mentoring students, developing educational programs, and fostering engagement in undergraduate research.


This position will require successful completion of the three publicly available clearances:

  • Pennsylvania State Police Criminal Background Check (SP4-164)
  • Pennsylvania Child Abuse History Clearance Form (CY-113)
  • Federal (FBI) Fingerprint Background Check (Criminal History Report)

Flexible Work

This position offers a flexible work arrangement that combines remote and on-campus work. Questions related to flexible work should be directed to the hiring manager during the interview process.

MINIMUM EDUCATION, WORK EXPERIENCE & REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS

Bachelor's Degree
3+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience accepted
Required Certifications:
None

BACKGROUND CHECKS/CLEARANCES

This position requires the following clearances in addition to applicable background checks: PA State Police Criminal Background Check, PA Child Abuse History Clearance Form, and Federal (FBI) Fingerprint Criminal Background Check.

Penn State does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of a staff employment Visa. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

SALARY & BENEFITS

The salary range for this position, including all possible grades, is $54,060.00 - $78,444.00.

Salary Structure - Information on Penn State's salary structure

Penn State provides a competitive benefits package for full-time employees designed to support both personal and professional well-being. In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, employees enjoy robust retirement plans and substantial paid time off which includes holidays, vacation and sick time. One of the standout benefits is the generous 75% tuition discount, available to employees as well as eligible spouses and children. For more detailed information, please visit our Benefits Page.

The ASR includes crime statistics and institutional policies concerning campus security, such as those concerning alcohol and drug use, crime prevention, the reporting of crimes, sexual assault, and other matters. The ASR is available for review here.

EEO IS THE LAW

If you are unable to use our online application process due to an impairment or disability, please contact 814-865-1473.

We embrace individual uniqueness, as well as a culture of belonging that supports equity initiatives, leverages the educational and institutional benefits of inclusion in society, and provides opportunities for engagement intended to help all members of the community thrive. title: Telecomms Technician B-A
description:
Job Posting End Date

10-26-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date

Job Summary

The Telecom Technician C will perform basic to intermediate level installation, maintenance, repair or replacement, testing, and inspection of various Telecommunications equipment, systems, and infrastructure. This role will work to gain knowledge and understanding of various Telecommunications technologies, business processes, and business partner requirements; and will work to gain knowledge of emerging technologies. Technician C will perform these tasks under immediate or general supervision according to the task level and will adhere to standard practices and procedures. Technician C is a 2-year, 2-step progression program with job levels C2 and C1.

Job Description

This posting represents a position that offers a range of opportunities for advancement. The minimum qualifications outlined below apply to the Telecom Technician C with increased requirements for the Telecom Technician B and A levels.


What you'll do:

Essential Job Functions & Tasks:


  • Perform intermediate to advanced level installation, acceptance testing, and documentation of various Telecommunications related equipment and systems. May assist in performing, or perform, higher level work for next-level training or as assigned.
  • Perform intermediate to advanced level troubleshooting and system testing, maintenance, and repair of electronic and optical equipment, infrastructure, and systems. May assist in performing, or perform, higher level work for next-level training or as assigned.
  • Maintain accurate records, reports, drawings, and other data required for all work performed.
  • Utilize Telecom knowledge gained to assist and cross-train others in technical disciplines.
  • Focus on learning and advancing beyond present levels of competency in multiple technologies or deeper in a specific technology.
  • Inspect and maintain test equipment, tools, automotive equipment and safety/protective equipment in good working order and compliance.
  • Demonstrate the ability to read, understand, and update electronic and electrical prints, diagrams, and asset records related to Telecom equipment and technologies.
  • Demonstrate the ability to operate tools and other equipment necessary to perform job duties.
  • Assist others as requested or assigned and provide training and guidance to employees in lower classifications.
  • Perform all duties in accordance with the Company’s safety rules and operating regulations, NERC CIP and environmental compliance and practices.
  • Respond to emergency callouts as required.
  • Perform essential job functions and tasks as defined in lower-level job descriptions in the Telecom Technician Job Family and other duties as assigned.
  • Successfully complete all assigned training.

The Technician B must achieve a working knowledge and demonstrate intermediate level technical support skills in two or more technologies, and/or advanced level skills in one or more of the following technology examples, as assigned by leader:

  • Transmission and Distribution station data networks, SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition), distribution automation systems, smart grids, and telecom for other utility systems.
  • Generation and Renewables facilities telecom voice and data systems.
  • Transport systems, such as microwave radio, fiber optic, and other transport/wireless systems.
  • Land Mobile Radio System: P25 site electronics and mobile radio installation, support and programming, and RF antenna systems.
  • Fiber optic cables, fiber splicing, testing, and termination/connecting methods.
  • AC/DC electrical power systems, including basic understanding of circuits and components of distribution and transmission stations and networks.
  • Telecom wiring and cabling requirements, installation methods, and industry standard practices.
  • Networking systems that include routers, switches, wireless access points, and related devices.
  • Infrastructure support equipment and facilities such as DC chargers/rectifiers, batteries, UPS systems, generators, transfer panels, security and monitoring, HVAC, grounding and signal cabling, site access roads, site yards, fences and gates, shelters, towers, and antenna systems.
  • Specialized support of centers such as transmission and distribution dispatch centers and control centers, customer call centers, data centers and other specialized locations.

What we're looking for:


Education Requirement and Work Experience are listed below:


Associate degree, or equivalent 2-year technical degree, in electrical engineering technology, electronic technology, or related technology field; or military training/experience in related technology field; or High school diploma with a minimum 5 years of related work experience or industry knowledge.


Must demonstrate equivalent knowledge and skills as a qualifying Telecom Technician C and have a minimum of 5 years of technical work experience in addition to education requirement.

For internal candidates (AEP Employees) Only: Must have a minimum of 2 years of satisfactory work experience, equivalent to, or as a Telecom Technician C (steps C2 and C1). Must have successfully completed all required training for the previous job level; and demonstrated/successfully tested the knowledge, skills, and capabilities required of an experienced Telecom Technician C.


  • Must possess and maintain a valid state driver’s license.
  • Exhibit AEP competencies are always expected of every employee. A positive attitude, respectful behavior, and genuine support for teammates and leaders are necessary.
  • A strong electronics / telecommunications aptitude is desired and essential to success.
  • Overnight travel and daily travel for work as required.
  • Assist in adjusting resource demands as required.
  • Be available for call-out and planned overtime as necessary to support our 24x7 operation.
  • Demonstrate computer and application skills needed to perform assigned Telecom work and documentation. Demonstrate effective oral and written communication skills.

Physical demand level is Heavy, and may include lifting, carrying, and installing/removing heavy items up to 60 lbs. such as electronic and optical equipment, racks, test equipment, tools, cables and terminals, and other items required to support projects and operational activities at all job locations.


What you'll get:


At AEP, we’re more than just an energy company — we’re a team of dedicated professionals committed to delivering safe, reliable, and innovative energy solutions.


Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and being part of a forward-thinking organization, this is the company for you!

title: Product Intern
description:
Salary: Rp 1.500.000 – Rp 2.000.000 per month

Job Requirements

  • Final-year student or fresh graduate in Business, Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • No formal work experience required. Relevant internship, organizational, or project experience is a plus.

  • Genuine interest in how businesses work and how client or user problems get turned into structured solutions.

  • Some exposure to product documentation (user stories, use cases, acceptance criteria) is helpful but not required — willingness to learn fast matters more.

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets and basic data exploration.

  • Basic understanding of common AI concepts and use cases.

  • Good written and spoken communication in both Indonesian and English.

  • High ownership, structured thinking, and comfortable asking questions when things are unclear.

  • Able to work hybrid in Jakarta and visit clients occasionally (expenses reimbursed).


Job Descriptions

As a Product Intern, you'll work closely with our Product Consultants on real client engagements and internal product work. The scope is smaller and the supervision is closer than a full-time Consultant role, but the work itself is real — not shadowing, not busywork. You'll be involved in actual problem-solving, documentation, and delivery, with a mentor checking your work and helping you get better at it.

Responsibilities

  • Help gather client pain points through interviews or observation, and put together a simple issue tree for a clearly scoped problem, with guidance.

  • Support analysis of client business data for one specific context.

  • Help map current-state processes for one function and spot obvious bottlenecks.

  • Draft a simple solution flow or use case based on client requirements, under close supervision.

  • Draft a PRD for a small, well-scoped feature (basic user story and acceptance criteria) for review by a Consultant or PM.

  • Support the engineering team with basic effort estimation on small tasks.

  • Help execute one AI use case using an already-defined toolset, under supervision.

  • Take part in one workstream under the 4D framework (Decide, Data, Design, Digital) — manage your own tasks and report progress regularly.

  • Help prepare materials for change communication based on direction from the team.

  • Contribute 1–2 simple insights per workstream, with guidance, and learn to flag when data isn't sufficient.

Decision Authority

  • Execute tasks within an assigned scope; larger decisions need supervisor sign-off.

  • Escalate blockers or unclear scope to your supervisor promptly.

  • Responsible for task-level output quality and how quickly you improve — not for strategic outcomes.

Success Metrics

  • Quality of deliverables within assigned scope (draft issue tree, simple process map, draft PRD).

  • Speed of learning and responsiveness to feedback.

  • Ability to follow consulting/product workflows with guidance.

  • Contribution to team output (AI use case or consulting deliverable) as a supporting member.

title: Training Coordinator
description:
Commissionaires Nova Scotia (CNS)
is the province’s leading provider of security, safety, training, and identification services. As part of the Canadian Corps of Commissionaires, we are proud to provide meaningful employment opportunities for veterans of the Canadian Armed Forces and RCMP, their families, and others who want to contribute to the safety and well-being of Nova Scotians.



Recognized with the 2025 Canadian Outstanding Security Performance Award (OSPA) for Outstanding Partnership, CNS is committed to delivering high-quality services while creating a workplace where our people can build meaningful and rewarding careers.


We are currently seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and collaborative Training Coordinator to join our team. This role is responsible for coordinating internal and external training programs, maintaining accurate training records, and supporting the scheduling and administration of training activities. The successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring our employees have the training and qualifications needed to succeed in their roles while supporting the continued growth of CNS's training services.


WHAT WE OFFER

At CNS, we want our employees to build careers they are proud of. We offer a supportive workplace, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to contribute to an organization with a strong social mandate.

Depending on the position and employment status, CNS employees may be eligible for:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive health and dental benefits
  • RRSP/TFSA matching program
  • Vacation and sick leave
  • Paid training and professional development opportunities
  • Education assistance and scholarship opportunities
  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement
  • The opportunity to build a meaningful career with a national organization committed to serving those who have served


Training Administration

  • Facilitate the organization and scheduling of internal and external courses offered by CNS
  • Create and maintain an annual training schedule as directed by the Training & Development Manager
  • Liaise with other service providers of training as required
  • Act as the first point-of-contact for people attending courses
  • Promote the training program through collaborative relationships across all of CNS
    • Support Regional/District and Site Managers/Supervisors to ensure that their staff are working towards training requirement compliance, including but not limited to CNS courses: First Aid, Non-Violent Crisis Intervention, WHMIS, Use of Force and Persons with Security Responsibilities
    • Support the instructors in ensuring that online training credentials and evaluation forms are accurately created and logged, maintaining detailed records using CNS’s HR platform (BambooHR), as well as MS Office Suite
    • Support the instructors in completing and distributing training certificates
    • Liaise with instructors to communicate organizational needs/areas requiring support
  • Liaise with the financial team to enable external clients to pay for courses (through invoices and other methods)
  • Create/approve training shifts for Commissionaires to allow them to be paid for their training
  • Collate and communicate CNS training feedback to the Training & Development Manager
  • Act as the Training & Development Manager as required


Facilitation

  • Occasionally instruct CNS-specific course materials (with additional training provided if necessary)
  • Continually improve CNS’s training course offering, including reviews of current course content/curriculum and developing new training resources
  • Occasional travel is required for training, exercises, or coordination meetings.


Education and Knowledge

i. Education: (Minimum Required): University degree (business preferred) or an acceptable equivalent of education and experience.

ii. Certifications: (If applicable): Be able to complete a successful criminal records check; hold a valid Nova Scotia Driver's License, and have access to a reliable vehicle OR access to reliable means of transportation; Be able to apply for and obtain a Government of Canada reliability level security clearance

iii. Skills and Abilities: (Minimum Required)
• Able to communicate effectively in English (the ability to work in both official languages would be considered an asset)
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
• Superior project management skills
• Able to work effectively over various mediums (i.e. in-person, virtual, offsite)
• Able to work effectively as part of a team
• Able to successfully adapt to changing priorities
• Superior attention to detail in creating, organizing and managing robust recordkeeping databases
• Ability to effectively deliver course material in an instructional capacity, as required

iv. Professional/Technical Knowledge:
• Experience as a Training Coordinator would be considered an asset
• Experience with a modern Learning Management System (LMS) or applications, with focus on adult learning
• Background/experience in Business Administration
• Minimum of two (2) years of experience in an administration role
• A solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Teams, Word etc.)


Ready to Join Us?


Our goal is to create an inclusive, diverse workplace representative, at all job levels, of the citizens we serve. At Commissionaires we support, value, and respect the different views, cultures and experiences of our employees, clients, business partners and community members. We welcome applicants that identify as Indigenous/Aboriginals, or African Nova Scotians and/or Other Racially Visible Persons, or Persons with Disabilities, or Persons who identify in the 2SLGBTQ+ community or others who reflect the diversity of Nova Scotian communities. If you are a member of one of these equity groups, you are encouraged to self-identify on your cover letter or during the application process.


We thank all applicants for their interest, but only those chosen for an interview will be contacted.

title: Operater v proizvodnji slanih arom
description:
Job Summary

Ste pripravljeni začeti kariero v proizvodnem okolju ter prispevati k varni, kakovostni in učinkoviti proizvodnji slanih arom?

IFF je globalni vodja na področju arom, dišav, živilskih sestavin ter zdravja in bioloških znanosti. Ponašamo se s trajnostnimi inovacijami, ki izboljšujejo vsakodnevne izdelke.


V Global Operations zagotavljamo kakovost, varnost, učinkovitost, operativno odličnost in trajnost v celotni vrednostni verigi.


Kot operater I v proizvodnji slanih arom v Škofji vasi boste del natančne, sodelovalne in razvojno usmerjene ekipe. S svojim delom boste neposredno vplivali na kakovost izdelkov, varnost procesov in zadovoljstvo naših kupcev.


Kje boste naredili razliko


• Pripravljali boste materiale, opremo in delovno okolje za nemoten potek proizvodnje.
• Izdelovali boste izdelke in polizdelke ter izvajali polnjenje v embalažo skladno s proizvodnimi zahtevami.
• Upravljali boste osnovne proizvodne stroje in naprave v skladu z delovnimi navodili in tehnološkimi postopki.
• Rokovali boste z viličarjem in skrbeli za varen transport materialov.
• Izvajali boste rutinska proizvodna opravila v skladu s standardi kakovosti, varnosti in higiene.
• Skrbeli boste za red, čistočo ter osnovno pripravo proizvodnih naprav, embalaže in delovnega prostora.
• Vodili boste proizvodno dokumentacijo in zagotavljali točnost evidenc.
• Sodelovali boste pri medprocesnih kontrolah in podpori zagotavljanju kakovosti izdelkov.
• Sodelovali boste z ekipo ter prispevali k učinkoviti komunikaciji in nemotenemu poteku dela.


Ste pravi kandidat, če


• Imate zaključeno srednjo poklicno ali strokovno izobrazbo, želeno kemijske, živilske ali gostinske smeri.

• Ste pripravljeni delati v dveh izmenah v proizvodnem okolju in upoštevati predpisane postopke ter standarde.

• Delate natančno, odgovorno in zanesljivo.

• Razumete pomen varnosti, kakovosti in higiene pri delu.

• Znate slediti delovnim navodilom in delati v okviru določenih procesov.

• Učinkovito sodelujete z drugimi ter prispevate k pozitivnemu delovnemu okolju.

• Ste pripravljeni na učenje in razvoj novih znanj ter veščin.

• Osnovno uporabljate računalniška orodja za vnos podatkov in evidenc.

Kako boste izstopali?


• Imate izkušnje z delom v proizvodnem okolju.

• Imate izkušnje v gostinstvu ali živilski industriji.

• Poznate informacijski sistem SAP.

Zakaj izbrati nas?

title: Smed til konstruktion og montage i Randers C
description:
Er du smed og vil du have firmabil, bonusordning og godt sammenhold?

Vi mangler en smed til konstruktion og montage i Randers C.

Du bliver en del af en større smedeafdeling, hvor opgaverne ligger i erhverv og industrielt præget montage. Arbejdet spænder fra konstruktion og samling til feltarbejde ude på opgaverne. Rollen skifter mellem selvstændige opgaver og arbejde med makker, så du skal kunne tage ansvar uden at stå helt alene. Firmabil er en del af pakken, så hverdagen bliver nemmere når arbejdet flytter sig fra værksted til montage.

Det her er til dig, der gerne vil bruge hænderne på rigtigt smedearbejde og samtidig have ordnede rammer omkring jobbet. Bonusordningen giver lidt ekstra at arbejde for, og det sociale sammenhold betyder, at du ikke bare bliver et nummer i rækken. Du får fast arbejde, faste rammer og en hverdag hvor du både skal kunne tænke selv og spille sammen med andre.

Det får du

Løn: 180-205 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Randers C og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Konstruktion, samling og montage

Din hverdag

Når en opgave er klar, tager du fat i konstruktionen, samler delene og følger arbejdet videre til montage. Nogle dage handler mest om fremstilling og tilpasning, mens andre dage ligger ude i feltet, hvor tingene skal monteres ordentligt første gang. Firmabilen gør det praktisk at komme mellem opgaverne uden bøvl.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Fremstiller og samler konstruktioner
  • Monterer ståldele ude på opgaverne
  • Løser feltarbejde hos erhvervskunder
  • Skærer, borer og tilpasser emner
  • Arbejder med smedeopgaver hvor finish og pasform skal sidde rigtigt

Det sociale sammenhold er en del af pakken, så du lander et sted hvor folk også taler sammen, når arbejdet ikke lige handler om stål og montage. Hvis noget ikke stemmer på en opgave, siger du til i tide og får det løst ordentligt.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Vi forventer ikke at du har lavet det hele før. Men du skal kunne se en opgave og tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som smed eller med lignende metalarbejde
  • Har et par års erfaring og kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • Kan både arbejde alene og sammen med en makker
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har prøvet både konstruktion og montage før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage ansvar for dit arbejde og afleverer noget, du kan stå inde for.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

  • Comfort working independently and managing multiple concurrent engagements

The expected range of compensation for this role is $68,000-$104,000 annually.


Why BDO?

Our people-first approach to talent has earned us a spot among Canada’s Top 100 Employers for 2026. This recognition is a milestone we’re thrilled to add to our collection of awards for both experienced and student talent experiences.

As a Sales Associate, better known as a “Product Specialist,” at Skechers, you’re not just working a job—you’re joining a team where growth, customer connections, fashion, and comfort are at the core. In this entry-level retail role, you’ll engage with customers, provide exceptional customer service, and contribute to the success of the store.   • High school diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

Du ingår i en grupp med andra dokumentationsresurser som leds av en teamledare, samtidigt som du arbetar i flera pågående stationsprojekt.


Ansvaret omfattar beställning och samordning av digitala modeller och modellinformation, kvalitetssäkring samt överlämning till förvaltningsorganisationen. Du administrerar och kvalitetssäkrar den digitala projekthanteringen inom 3D-modellering och BIM samt arbetar med granskning, kravställning, loggföring, lagring och distribution av leveranser och informationsmängder.


Du bidrar även till kontinuerlig verksamhetsutveckling och uppdatering av tekniska riktlinjer inom BIM och modellorienterade arbetssätt. Uppdraget genomförs som resurskonsult under beställarens ledning och styrning.


Arbetsuppgifter


• Delta i framtagandet av förfrågningsunderlag

• Säkerställa att externa parter uppfyller dokumentationskrav och att datamängder följer programvarutekniska krav och rutiner

• Koordinera interna och externa dokumentationsleveranser

• Kvalitetsgranska modeller, exempelvis genom kollisionskontroll

• Samverka med entreprenörers BIM- och datasamordnare kring rutiner, processer och stöd i frågor

• Samordna, administrera och strukturera informationsflöden för beställaren och mellan entreprenörer

• Läsa in granskad och godkänd dokumentation i beställarens digitala system

• Bidra till verksamhetsutveckling och tekniska riktlinjer inom BIM och modellbaserade arbetssätt


Obligatoriska krav


Vi söker dig som har:


• Högskole-/universitetsutbildning om 120 poäng/180 högskolepoäng inom teknik, alternativt YH-examen om 400 YH-poäng som byggnads-/anläggningsingenjör med inriktning BIM/CAD/infrastruktur, alternativt YH-examen om 400 YH-poäng som ingenjör inom elkraft. Bevis för utbildning eller certifikat kan komma att begäras in.

• Minst fem års arbetslivserfarenhet av arbetsuppgifter motsvarande dokumentationscontroller/dokumentationsansvarig (document controller) eller datasamordnare i anläggningsprojekt. Erfarenheten ska vara aktuell och förvärvad under de senaste sju åren.

• Minst ett års arbetslivserfarenhet av att utveckla ledningssystem genom utveckling och implementering av processer alternativt styrande och stödjande dokument.

• Minst två års arbetslivserfarenhet som ansvarig BIM-samordnare/modellsamordnare i anläggningsprojekt.

• Arbetslivserfarenhet från en beställarorganisation i minst ett uppdrag.


Meriterande


• Minst ett års arbetslivserfarenhet på heltid av arbete i projekt med gasisolerade ställverk

• Minst två års arbetslivserfarenhet av att leda och fördela arbete inom en arbetsgrupp med minst fem personer


Uppdragsinformation


• Roll: BIM-samordnare

• Omfattning: 100 %

• Plats: Sundbyberg

• Resor: Inrikesresor kan förekomma någon gång per år

• Säkerhetsprövning: Säkerhetsskyddsöverenskommelse krävs för uppdraget


Om Soros Consulting


Soros Consulting arbetar med kvalificerad konsultförmedling inom IT, teknik och verksamhetsutveckling. Vi matchar erfarna specialister med uppdrag där deras kompetens skapar tydliga resultat. Vårt fokus är kvalitet, långsiktighet och att skapa goda förutsättningar både för konsulter och uppdragsgivare genom tydlighet, professionalism och hållbara relationer.

title: Instrumenttekniker till Kraton
description:
Om oss

Kraton är en global ledare inom talloljebaserade specialkemikalier med verksamhet i Europa, USA och på flera marknader världen över. Genom att förädla förnybara råvaror från skogen utvecklar vi produkter som används i vardagen och bidrar till en mer hållbar framtid. Säkerhet, innovation och hållbarhet är centrala delar av vår verksamhet.

Om rollen

Vill du arbeta i en processindustri där teknik, problemlösning och säkerhet står i centrum? Som Instrumenttekniker hos oss blir du en viktig del av ett engagerat team som ansvarar för att säkerställa en stabil och driftsäker produktion.

Du ingår i en grupp av nio tekniker med kompetens inom instrument, automation och industrielektriska system. Tillsammans arbetar vi för att utveckla våra arbetssätt och skapa en välorganiserad arbetsplats med fokus på ständiga förbättringar, säkerhet och samarbete.

Rollen erbjuder en varierad vardag där du arbetar med både förebyggande och avhjälpande underhåll av våra instrument- och automationssystem. Du får möjlighet att kombinera praktiskt arbete i anläggningen med felsökning, analys och förbättringsarbete.

Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:

  • Kalibrering och verifiering av tryck-, nivå-, flödes- och våginstrument.
  • Felsökning och underhåll av reglerventiler, flödesmätare och temperaturkretsar.
  • Planering och genomförande av förebyggande underhållsinsatser.
  • Kontroll och provning av brandlarmsystem.
  • Programmering, optimering och felsökning i styrsystem, bland annat DeltaV och Siemens PLC.
  • Medverkan i förbättringsprojekt, riskanalyser och initiativ som bidrar till ökad driftsäkerhet och effektivitet.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint teknikintresse och drivs av att lösa problem. Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och tycker om att kombinera självständigt arbete med nära samarbete tillsammans med kollegor från olika delar av verksamheten.

Du trivs i en roll där arbetsdagarna varierar och där du får ta stort eget ansvar. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och ser värdet i att dela kunskap, samarbeta och be om stöd när det behövs.

För oss är säkerhet en självklarhet. Därför söker vi dig som arbetar noggrant, följer rutiner och bidrar till en säker arbetsmiljö för både dig själv och dina kollegor.

Kvalifikationer

  • Gymnasieutbildning med inriktning mot el, instrument, automation eller styr- och reglerteknik, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet.
  • Erfarenhet av felsökning och underhåll inom industriell verksamhet.
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.
  • God datorvana.
  • B-körkort.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av processindustri, PLC-system, DCS-system, instrumentering eller styr- och reglerteknik.

Beredskap ingår i tjänsten.

Övrig information

Vi värdesätter mångfald och en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där olika erfarenheter, perspektiv och kompetenser bidrar till vår utveckling. Vi välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund och kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper i denna rekrytering.

För att bidra till en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö genomförs alkohol- och drogtest som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.

Ansökan

Vill du vara med och bidra till en säker och driftsäker produktion i en verksamhet med fokus på teknik, utveckling och hållbarhet?

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag.

title: Constructability Lead Senior - Principal
description:
Job Posting End Date

10-25-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

Job Summary

The role of a Construction Lead within one or more primary disciplines including Constructability, Construction Planning, Transmission Lines, Substations, Distribution, Fiber Communications, or Tower Communications is to provide leadership and field oversight to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality construction execution, with a strong emphasis on identifying and addressing safety risks. This position serves as the subject matter expert and primary liaison between Construction Management and cross-functional partners, supporting project planning, coordination, and execution while ensuring alignment across stakeholders, schedules, and field activities.

Job Description

Note: This position is posted at multiple grade levels and offers a range of opportunities for advancement. The minimum qualifications outlined below apply to the Construction Lead Senior level, with increased educational, skill, experience and certification requirements for higher level Construction Lead Principal.


What You’ll Do:

Essential Job Functions & Tasks


Constructability

  • Focuses on integrating construction methodology into early project development through the creation and standardization of Constructability Scoping Reports.
  • Requires the ability to evaluate projects at a conceptual level and define optimal construction approaches prior to detailed design.
  • Involves leading cross-functional scoping efforts to align construction sequencing, access, and execution strategy early in the project lifecycle.
  • Includes use of GIS, drawings, and other tools to help provide a construction sequence, identify access constraints, and evaluate outage coordination, material flow, and logistical risks.
  • Emphasizes incorporation of site conditions, constructability challenges, and execution constraints into standardized scoping deliverables.
  • Requires experience supporting continuous improvement efforts, including lessons learned integration, contractor feedback incorporation, and refinement of constructability practices to improve planning consistency, efficiency, and execution readiness.

Transmission Lines, Substations, and Distribution

  • Requires expertise in high-voltage and medium-voltage electrical infrastructure construction, including transmission line systems, distribution networks, and substation equipment such as transformers, breakers, and bus systems.
  • Includes interpretation of discipline-specific technical documentation such as transmission plan and profile drawings, structure loading trees, sag and tension charts, substation one-line diagrams, protection and control schematics, and distribution staking sheets and feeder layouts.
  • Involves construction methods unique to these systems, including conductor stringing, sagging and tension operations, structure erection, substation equipment installation, and distribution activities such as pole setting, framing, and overhead and underground conductor installation.
  • Requires coordination of work in energized or near-energized environments with consideration for construction, outage sequencing, planning, switching requirements, and system reliability impacts.

What You Will Need:


Construction Lead Senior


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Safety or related field and six (6) years’ experience of overseeing/directing transmission and distribution station construction and/or transmission line construction work.

OR

  • ABET accredited Associate degree in electrical, construction management, safety, civil engineering technology or related field of study and eight (8) years’ experience in overseeing/directing transmission and distribution station construction and/or transmission line construction work

OR

  • High school diploma or GED with a minimum of ten (10) years of direct experience as an AEP/contractor line or station field employee or Construction Rep.

Work Experience

  • Related experience is defined as involvement with transmission overseeing/directing transmission and distribution station construction and/or transmission line construction work. A thorough knowledge of the transmission system, from a design and operation perspective. AND experience within transmission engineering, and/or construction management is desired to fulfill responsibilities of this job.

Other Requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, mentor, and train junior personnel.
  • Must be a team player, inquisitive, analytical, and be able to interact with and maintain working relationships with diverse teams.
  • Ability to read and interpret one-line station diagrams and transmission line switching diagrams and anticipate proper clearance points and zones of protection.
  • Aptitude to understand and interpret conceptual scopes of work and visualize the safest and most effective method of construction and identify potential risks and hazards to be removed.
  • Capacity to lead in understanding, developing, and clearly presenting complicated construction sequencing to the project team.
  • Must have strong computer skills and be able to grasp and use new technologies as they become available.
  • Strong analytical skills are needed to visualize a conceptual project and how it will be built, able to visualize and plan for potential risks associated with the construction or proposed facilities.
  • Being able to conduct substation and transmission line site visits. Driving a vehicle long distance to conduct site visits.
  • Avid concentration levels. Decision making and collaborative skills in stressful situations.


Construction Lead Principal


  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, or related field and eight (8) years’ experience of overseeing/directing transmission and distribution station construction and/or transmission line construction work.

OR

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Technology or ABET-accredited Engineering Technology with ten (10) years of relevant experience.

OR

  • Associate degree in Construction Management Technology or ABET-accredited Electrical or Civil Engineering Technology with twelve (12) years of relevant experience.

OR

  • High school diploma or GED with fourteen (14) experience in construction, project execution, or field operations within electric utility or infrastructure environments.

Work Experience

  • Related experience is defined as involvement with transmission overseeing/directing transmission and distribution station construction and/or transmission line construction work. A thorough knowledge of the transmission system, from a design and operation perspective. AND experience within transmission engineering, and/or construction management is desired to fulfill responsibilities of this job.

Other Preferred Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook, for data analysis, reporting, and communications.
  • Experience using Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive for collaboration, document management, and team coordination.
  • Familiarity with Power BI for data visualization and reporting, and Power Automate for workflow optimization is a plus.
  • Strong ability to develop professional presentations, dashboards, and reports to communicate project status, risks, and performance metrics.
  • Experience working in a digital, collaboration-driven environment with structured file management and version control practices.
  • Ability to quickly learn and apply enterprise systems such as project scheduling tools, work management systems, and GIS platforms.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills to support standardized processes, reporting, and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • An understanding of Bulk Electric System operations, construction management practices, or engineering disciplines supporting transmission, distribution, or communication infrastructure is required.
  • Candidates must demonstrate strong analytical and technical capabilities, including the ability to interpret project documentation, plans, and schedules.

What You’ll Get:


In addition to competitive compensation, AEP offers a unique comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.


Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do

At AEP, we’re more than just an energy company — we’re a team of dedicated professionals committed to delivering safe, reliable, and innovative energy solutions. Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and being part of a forward-thinking organization, this is the company for you!

title: Principal Product Strategist
description:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

The Product Strategy team at Grab plays a crucial role in propelling and sustaining our overarching Product Vision. We foster a collaborative and innovative work culture, focusing on developing and orchestrating strategies across all product verticals and platforms. By driving strategic alignment and prioritizing impactful actions, our team ensures that Grab continues to lead and adapt in the dynamic tech landscape.

Get to Know the Role

This role You will be pivotal in defining and executing strategic initiatives that align with Grab's long-term goals. You will work cross-functionally to identify opportunities, drive roadmap decisions, and resolve execution gaps. This role offers significant growth opportunities, enabling you to interact with senior leadership and potentially move into more senior roles within our organization. You will be an individual contributor, reporting to the Head of Product Strategy & Product Operations. This is a fully onsite role, based in Jakarta.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Develop and maintain coherent strategy across verticals and platforms product teams
  • Identify new opportunities, threats and latest tech/market trends to help develop long-term strategic plans for future products, including partnership opportunities to accelerate realization of our roadmap
  • Set direction and rhythm in the tech roadmap planning and review to ensure focus on actions towards company and tech priorities

title: Director, Business Planning & Financial Analysis
location: Hilton Head, South Carolina, United States
description:
Strengthening and empowering all of the communities we serve.

Director, Business Planning & Financial Analysis

Remote-based position

The Role

We are seeking a Director, Business Planning & Financial Analysis to serve as Automotive’s lead analyst and strategist. This highly visible senior individual contributor will partner across Sales, Operations, Product, and Finance to improve decision-making, forecasting, execution, and profitable growth. The role owns sales and revenue performance analytics, commercial forecasting inputs, customer and OEM economics, business intelligence, operating metrics, and strategic planning support.

You will translate data into actionable insights and assess how contracts, OEM programs, product mix, delivery models, third-party costs, and operational decisions affect revenue, COGS, margin, and profitability. You will also develop forward-looking forecasts and scenario analyses to strengthen commercial decisions and business planning.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Serve as Automotive's lead commercial analyst and strategist, providing analysis and recommendations that support profitable growth, operating performance, and strategic decisions.
  • Lead business cases, investment evaluations, scenario modeling, market and customer opportunity analysis, resource-allocation decisions, and long-range planning.
  • Develop revenue operations reporting and dashboards that track pacing, pipeline, customer activity, product performance, KPIs, and other operating metrics.
  • Develop commercial forecast inputs with Automotive leaders and partner with Finance, which owns the budget and forecast processes, to improve forecast quality and explain business drivers.
  • Assess and forecast COGS by customer, OEM program, product, and segment, including third-party, fulfillment, delivery, vendor, and other variable cost drivers; identify trends, risks, and margin pressure.
  • Evaluate the revenue, COGS, gross margin, scalability, and risk of contracts, OEM arrangements, pricing proposals, products, and other commercial initiatives before commitments are made.
  • Analyze actual versus expected revenue, COGS, margin, customer and product profitability, concentration, retention economics, and downside risk; recommend actions to improve results.
  • Partner with Sales leadership on quotas, territories, coverage, capacity, seller productivity, attainment, performance benchmarks, and sales compensation design and evaluation.
  • Identify process, data-quality, and reporting improvements; define requirements and partner with Operations, Product, Technology, and Finance on implementation.
  • Align Automotive leadership and cross-functional partners around shared assumptions, accountability, and executive-ready recommendations explaining results, outlook, and proposed actions.

What you Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Analytics, Finance, Management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • At least seven years of progressive experience in revenue or sales operations, commercial strategy, business operations, strategic planning, consulting, analytics, or a related discipline; automotive experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience advising executive leaders through strategic analysis, scenario modeling, business cases, forecasts, and performance reporting.
  • Strong understanding of revenue drivers, COGS, gross margin, customer and contract economics, product profitability, and commercial performance metrics.
  • Experience forecasting variable and third-party delivery costs and translating operational assumptions into margin outcomes.
  • Experience with sales compensation, quota setting, territory modeling, capacity planning, or sales performance analysis.
  • Ability to communicate complex analysis as clear, practical recommendations and influence cross-functional outcomes without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, organization, and relationship-management skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and AI proficiency, with experience using business intelligence and data visualization tools; automotive advertising, digital media, SaaS, OEM program, or related industry experience preferred.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role operates in a general office environment and may be performed remotely. Business hours align to East Coast management. It requires extensive computer use and analytical work. Occasional travel may be required.

title: Kundservicemedarbetare inom order och fakturering
description:
Trivs du i en roll där du får kombinera kundservice, administration och ekonomi? Är du en person som gillar att ha många kontaktytor, lösa problem och samtidigt säkerställa att detaljerna blir rätt? Då kan detta vara en möjlighet för dig!

Vi söker nu en serviceinriktad och noggrann Kundservicemedarbetare till en av våra partners. Här får du en varierad roll där du blir en viktig kontaktperson för företagets kunder och arbetar med allt från inkommande frågor och orderhantering till fakturering och administrativ uppföljning.

Om tjänsten

I rollen som Kundservicemedarbetare blir du en del av ett team där samarbete, service och struktur är viktiga delar av vardagen. Du arbetar huvudsakligen med att ta emot inkommande samtal och mejl från kunder, besvara frågor och hjälpa dem vidare i olika ärenden.

Utöver den dagliga kundkontakten har du ett administrativt ansvar kopplat till kundernas beställningar och pågående uppdrag. Du arbetar även med kundfakturering, där du säkerställer att uppgifter och underlag är korrekta innan fakturor skickas ut.

Arbetet innebär att du hanterar flera ärenden parallellt och behöver kunna växla mellan kundkontakt, problemlösning och administration. Du har ett nära samarbete med dina kollegor och andra funktioner inom verksamheten för att säkerställa att kunderna får snabb och professionell hjälp.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att vara:

  • Ta emot och hantera inkommande samtal och mejl från kunder.
  • Besvara kundfrågor, hantera ärenden och följa upp pågående uppdrag.
  • Registrera och administrera kundorder och beställningar i affärssystem.
  • Arbeta med kundfakturering, inklusive kontroll av fakturaunderlag och uppgifter inför fakturering.
  • Hantera fakturarelaterade frågor och eventuella felaktigheter.
  • Samarbeta med interna avdelningar för att säkerställa en effektiv ärendehantering och god kundupplevelse.

Vi söker dig som

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har åtminstone två års erfarenhet av kundservice och kundfakturering, gärna från en verksamhet där du har hanterat många kundärenden och arbetsuppgifter parallellt. Du är van vid att arbeta i olika system och har en god förståelse för vikten av korrekt information och noggrann dokumentation.

Krav för tjänsten är:

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av kundservice med kundkontakt via telefon och mejl.
  • Erfarenhet av kundfakturering, där du självständigt har arbetat med att skapa, kontrollera eller hantera fakturor till kunder.
  • Erfarenhet av administrativt arbete, gärna kopplat till orderhantering eller kundärenden.
  • God datorvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i affärssystem.
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Som person är du serviceinriktad, lösningsorienterad och trivs med att hjälpa andra. Du har lätt för att kommunicera med olika människor och kan bemöta kunder på ett professionellt och positivt sätt, även när tempot är högt.

Vi tror också att du är en person som uppskattar struktur och ordning, samtidigt som du är flexibel och har förmågan att prioritera när flera ärenden behöver hanteras samtidigt. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, är noggrann med detaljer och tycker om att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid din personliga lämplighet för rollen.

Om anställningen

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid under initialt 6 månader där du blir anställd som konsult hos OIO. Förutsatt att du trivs väl och båda parter är nöjda med samarbetet finns möjlighet till förlängning.

Du får en introduktion i verksamheten och möjlighet att lära dig arbetssätt och system tillsammans med erfarna kollegor, så att du får rätt förutsättningar att komma in i rollen.

Om uppdraget

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag på 6 månader med start så snart som möjligt. Du blir anställd av OIO och arbetar som konsult hos vår kund i Göteborg.

  • Omfattning: Heltid - 07-16
  • Start: Omgående, enligt överenskommelse
  • Placering: Göteborg, på plats. Distansarbete ej möjligt.

Om OIO

Vår passion är att hjälpa dig till rätt roll och arbetsplats. Vi är samtidigt medvetna om att du är kräsen och väljer med omsorg inför nästa karriärsteg, det skulle vi också göra. Därför arbetar vi dedikerat i rekryteringsprocessen för att lära känna dig och dina ambitioner. Vi tror nämligen att människor på rätt plats har större chans att nå sin fulla potential. Genom schyssta, okrångliga anställningsvillkor samt ett närvarande ledarskap arbetar vi därefter aktivt med ditt engagemang och din utveckling. På så vis strävar vi efter att bli en självklar karriärpartner för dig. We are as picky as you are.

title: Director, Financial Analysis - GTM
description:
There are NO limits to your career: come shape the future and be part of a truly unique global culture at OutSystems!

The FP&A Director – GTM is a high-impact senior role that will serve as the primary financial thought partner to Sales and Marketing leadership, converting data and insight into decisions that accelerate revenue growth and margin improvement.


This role sits at the intersection of strategic finance, GTM operations, and decision intelligence, and the decisions you drive will have cross-functional impact on GTM investment and strategy, not just analytical output. You will own GTM financial planning end-to-end, from ARR modeling and quota capacity planning to board-level reporting, while also anchoring Finance's contribution to the function’s priority of embedding standardized, data-driven decision-making into OutSystems' growth engine.


Key Responsibilities

GTM Strategic Partnership

• Act as the dedicated financial business partner to Sales, Marketing, and Revenue Operations leadership - translating strategy into financial plans and financial data into executive decisions.

• Develop and maintain ARR driver models, pipeline analytics, and customer lifetime value frameworks that connect GTM activity to multi-year revenue outcomes aligned to targets.

• Evaluate ROI on campaigns, channel investments, and sales coverage models using the standardized ROI framework being rolled out company-wide.


Team Leadership & Organizational Development

• Manage, mentor, and grow a team of GTM finance analysts, fostering a high-performance culture grounded in Finance's core values of Trust, Stakeholder Success, Innovation, and Alignment.

• Champion AI-enabled, scalable ways of working, actively contributing to the talent model redesign for AI-first output, automation, and leverage-driven productivity.

• Build the team's ability to communicate financial and data insights through compelling storytelling to executive and non-finance audiences.


Financial Planning & Forecasting

• Own the annual GTM financial plan, rolling forecasts, and scenario analysis for Sales and Marketing P&Ls; ensure plans are reflected in the Pigment EPM platform as it replaces legacy processes.

• Build and maintain driver-based models, consistent with the multiyear strategic model linking GTM execution to financial outcomes.

• Develop and refine SaaS metrics and create visibility for the CFO, CEO, and Board.


Revenue & Quota Operations

• Partner with Sales Operations to drive global quota capacity planning across roles and regions based on sales productivity benchmarks and market coverage analysis.

• Lead GTM headcount and territory planning, incorporating AI-enabled analytics to improve precision and reduce planning cycle time.

• Support pricing strategy evolution, including AI and consumption-based model economics, in partnership with the cross-functional pricing team.


Decision Intelligence & Reporting

• Translate operational KPIs tied to ARR growth, margin expansion, and productivity into actionable dashboards and insights for GTM leaders, advancing the goal of standardizing decision intelligence as a core operating model.

• Prepare, review, and present monthly, quarterly, and annual GTM financial reports to the CFO and executive team; support Board presentations with rigorous variance analysis and forward-looking commentary.

title: Video Editor – Social & Digital Content
description:
About WeBuyVintage

WeBuyVintage is one of the UK’s largest buyers of jewellery, antiques and collectibles. We run more roadshows than any other UK company - over 250 valuation events every month - bringing trusted experts face-to-face with customers across the country.

In three years, we’ve grown from a pub-table idea into an eight-figure business, with a headcount thats grown from 30-100 in the last 2 years, we’re on a mission to make WeBuyVintage a brand everyone recognises.

The Role


As we continue to scale, we’re looking to dramatically increase our volume of content across our social media and digital channels, and we’re looking for a talented video editor to help us turn our growing library of raw footage into engaging, on-brand content.

This is a high-volume, fast-paced editing role and we're looking for someone who is creative, trend-savvy and efficient - who can take an idea or a folder of raw footage and quickly turn it into something people want to watch.

The majority of your work will be short-form social video, primarily for Instagram and Facebook, as well as TikTok in the near future. Some longer-form content and editing will also be required as we capture more educational content for YouTube and various digital marketing channels.

You’ll be working closely with our Social & Content Lead who will provide raw footage from our roadshows, events, behind-the-scenes moments, customer testimonials, our buyers and wider business.




Main Tasks & Responsibilities:

  • Editing a high volume of short-form social content.

  • Turning raw footage into engaging, platform-ready videos.

  • Creating strong hooks, pacing, cuts, captions, text overlays, music and other editing elements.

  • Editing interviews, testimonials and talking-head content into concise, engaging videos.

  • Creating different versions of content where useful, including alternative hooks, openings or cutdowns.

  • Occasionally editing longer-form content for YouTube and various digital channels.

  • Repurposing longer-form content by editing footage into shorter social-first cuts.

  • Editing video assets for our paid Meta ads, working alongside our wider marketing team and external paid ads agency.

  • Taking existing concepts and briefs and bringing them to life, while also suggesting your own creative approaches.

  • Keeping up with current social trends, formats and editing styles and knowing how to apply them appropriately.

  • Managing multiple edits and delivering work with fast turnaround times

Who We’re Looking For:

You’ll be great in this role if you have

  • Fast and efficient - comfortable working through a high volume of footage and edits.

  • Creative - able to spot the interesting moment and turn ordinary moments into engaging content.

  • Trend-savvy - understands current social formats, pacing, hooks and editing styles.

  • Commercially minded - understands how content needs to perform, not just look.

  • Self-sufficient - able to take a brief or rough idea and run with it.

  • Platform-aware - understands how content needs to work differently across social platforms.

  • Practical - has a good eye for detail and is able to align with brand guidelines.

You don’t need to have worked in the jewellery or antiques industry. What’s more important is that you understand how to turn everyday moments and stories into something that makes people stop scrolling.


Experience & Portfolio:

A strong portfolio is essential.

We're particularly interested in seeing:

  • Short-form social videos you've edited.

  • Reels, TikToks, Shorts or other social-first content.

  • Any paid social / advertising creatives you've worked on.

  • Examples showing strong hooks, pacing and creative editing.

  • Content that champions human moments and strong storytelling.

  • Longer-form work and examples of how you've created shorter cutdowns from it.

You don’t need to have worked in the jewellery or antiques industry. What’s more important is that you understand how to turn everyday moments and stories into something that makes You don’t need to have worked in the jewellery or antiques industry. What’s more important is that you understand how to turn everyday moments and stories into something that makes people stop scrolling.
