title: CNC Machinist & Programmer
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

As part of a hardworking team of engineers and technical specialists, you will serve as a hands-on CNC Machinist & Programmer supporting emergent fabrication and machining for Lunar Operations. In this combined role, you will take hardware from engineering intent to finished and inspected parts by reviewing models and drawings, developing machining strategy, creating CAM programs, setting up and running 3-axis and 5-axis mills and CNC turning centers, performing manual machining when needed, and executing final part inspection. You will thrive in a fast-paced development environment where processes are still being built, documentation matters, and flexibility and ownership are critical to delivering flight-relevant hardware.

Position Specific Details:

  • Shifts: 1st | Mon-Fri (8am-5pm)
  • Locations: Space Coast, FL
  • Relocation: Available


Key Responsibilities:

  • Program, set up, and operate 3-axis and 5-axis CNC mills and CNC lathes and turning centers to produce precision parts that meet engineering requirements.
  • Create and prove-out Siemens NX CAM programs, including tool selection, workholding approach, and cutting parameters, targeting HAAS equipment when applicable.
  • Perform complete job execution from planning through inspection, including setups, setup sheets and tool lists, safe prove-out, offsets and comp adjustments, and documentation for repeatability.
  • Execute first-article and development builds, optimizing feeds, speeds, toolpaths, workholding, and sequencing to improve cycle time, surface finish, and dimensional capability.
  • Machine and finish components in materials like aluminum, stainless steels, Inconel, and Monel using disciplined tool-life and heat management.
  • Perform in-process and final inspection using precision measurement tools like micrometers, calipers, height gages, indicators, and bore gages.
  • Record inspection results clearly and support CMM and Metrology as required.
  • Troubleshoot machining and process issues like chatter, tool wear and breakage, workholding distortion, dimensional drift, and surface damage, then implement corrective actions.
  • Maintain a safe, organized shop environment and follow safety and quality procedures to protect flight and mission-critical hardware.
  • Support manual machining and benchwork like drill and tap, ream, deburr, blend, and fit up when CNC is not the best solution.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, and Operations to clarify requirements, resolve discrepancies, and provide practical feedback on machinability and inspection approach while maintaining schedule.
  • Contribute to building shop capability by standardizing tooling, programming templates, probing strategies, and documentation, and support preventive maintenance and basic machine health checks.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED plus relevant technical training, or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 5+ years of combined CNC machining and programming experience producing tight-tolerance hardware.
  • Demonstrated ability to set up and run mid-to-high complexity jobs, including datum strategy, work offsets, tool length offsets, and safe prove-out practices.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications, including GD&T per ASME Y14.5 at a working level.
  • Working knowledge of CNC programming concepts and the ability to edit and verify G-code as needed.
  • Experience holding tolerances to ±0.001 in or tighter where required, and selecting appropriate inspection methods to verify conformance.
  • Proficiency with shop math like trigonometry and basic computer skills like Windows and common documentation tools.
  • Ability to troubleshoot process issues and communicate clearly with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to safely work in an industrial and manufacturing environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with HAAS mills and lathes, including best practices for safe prove-out, tool management, and probing.
  • Proficiency with Siemens NX CAM, including multi-axis programming, simulation and verification, and disciplined programming workflow.
  • Demonstrated success machining difficult materials like Titanium, Inconel, Monel, and stainless steels, including tool selection, surface integrity awareness, and tool-life management.
  • Experience with 5-axis simultaneous machining and complex multi-op workholding like soft jaws, vises, tombstones, and custom fixtures.
  • Familiarity with machining simulation tools like Vericut or equivalent, plus probing and on-machine measurement.
  • Experience supporting development programs where requirements evolve quickly and the machinist and programmer helps define best-known methods.
  • Exposure to related processes like heat treat, EDM, grinding, welding, coatings and plating, and how they influence machining strategy and inspection.
  • Trade school certification, A.S. degree in machining or manufacturing technology, or equivalent advanced training.

Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
  • Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
  • Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.


Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at EEOCompliance@blueorigin.com. Please note this is a publicly managed inbox. Please do not include any personal medical information in your request.

title: Klinisk Sygeplejespecialist søges til Neurorehabiliteringen, Neurologisk Afdeling, OUH Svendborg
description:
Vi søger en klinisk sygeplejespecialist, der brænder for at være med til at forene udvikling af sygeplejefaglige kompetencer, det interdisciplinære samarbejde i afsnittet samt implementering af evidensbaseret sygepleje i det neurorehabiliterende speciale.

Neurorehabiliteringen har plads til 34 patienter fordelt på 4 teams. Patienterne har behov for rehabilitering efter stroke, traumatisk hjerneskade, hjertestop eller anden erhvervet hjerneskade.

På Neurorehabiliteringen er vi et stort tværfagligt personale bestående af sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, ergoterapeuter og fysioterapeuter, læger, neuropsykologer, socialrådgiver og sekretærer. Desuden er der fast tilknyttet portører, diætist og logopæder samt rengøringspersonale.

Neurorehabiliteringen er kendetegnet ved at have et velfungerende tværfagligt samarbejde, der skaber et sammenhængende og helhedsorienteret patientforløb i et tæt samarbejde med patient og pårørende.

Vi søger 1 klinisk sygeplejespecialist med tiltrædelse 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge med weekendvagt hver 5. weekend og udgangspunktet for fordelingen af klinktid og ikke-kliniktid er 80/20

Rammen for tidsfordeling planlægges over tid i tæt samarbejde med oversygeplejersken.


Som klinisk sygeplejespecialist på NR Svendborg får du mulighed for:

  • At arbejde tæt sammen med anden klinisk sygeplejespecialist, klinisk ergoterapeutspecialist, klinisk fysioterapeutspecialist samt afsnittets øvrige personale.

  • At blive medansvarlig for sygeplejefaglig udvikling og implementering af nye tiltag, som kan understøtte det mono- og tværfaglige samarbejde i afsnittet og på tværs af neurologisk afdeling

  • At være medansvarlig for facilitering af klinisk evidensbaseret sygeplejepraksis, hvor forskningsbaseret viden, klinisk ekspertise, patientens perspektiv samt kontekst danner baggrund for kliniske beslutninger i patientplejen

  • At indgå i tæt samarbejde med afsnitsledelsen på NR samt Neurologisk Afdelings øvrige kliniske sygeplejespecialister og udviklingssygeplejerske

  • Identificere læringsbehov hos kollegaer i plejegruppen samt planlægge og varetage undervisning.

  • Implementere Ny kompetencemodel for plejepersonalet samt indgå i arbejdet omkring generiske kompetencekort for sygeplejersker og social-og sundhedsassistenter

  • Indgå i arbejdet omkring MyMedCards, herunder udarbejdelse af specialist kompetencekort.

For uddybning af funktionen se funktionsbeskrivelse her.


Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har autorisation som sygeplejerske

  • Har relevant kandidat- eller masteruddannelse

  • Gerne har erfaring inden for det neurologiske speciale, meget gerne neurorehabilitering, men det er ikke et krav

  • Kan håndtere komplekse problemstillinger med stor erfaring og viden om kommunikationsformer

  • Er teoretisk velfunderet med udtalte analytiske evner

  • Kan formidle faglig viden og erfaringer klart og forståeligt

  • Kan planlægge, gennemføre og evaluere kliniske sygeplejefaglige udviklingstiltag


I Neurologisk afdeling tilbyder vi:

  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring

  • Indflydelse på egen arbejdstidsplan

  • Tæt samarbejde med udviklingssygeplejerske og kliniske sygeplejespecialister fra de andre afsnit

  • Fokus på arbejdsmiljø

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor du får rig mulighed for at sætte dit præg


Løn- og ansættelsesforhold:
Aflønningen sker efter overenskomst indgået mellem den faglige organisation og Region Syddanmark. Hvis du ikke allerede er ansat i Region Syddanmark, er der 3 måneders prøvetid.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår for stillingen følger af Sundhedskartellet- overenskomst 32.17.1. Startlønnen for stillingen kan findes via følgende link: Se startløn for stillinger i Region Syddanmark.
Udover startlønnen kan lønnen indeholde forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Yderligere oplysninger:
Du er velkommen til at kontakte oversygeplejerske Stine Bechager Riber på tlf. 21354223 eller klinisk sygeplejespecialist Sanne Boysen på tlf. 29120821.

Har stillingen vakt din interesse, er du meget velkommen til at sende en motiveret ansøgning med CV og dokumentation for autorisation. Vi foretrækker at modtage ansøgningen elektronisk.


Ansøgningsfristen er den 11. november 2026
Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt den 20. november.


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Fältservicetekniker till uppdrag i Stockholm
description:
Fältservicetekniker till uppdrag i Stockholm med omnjed

På uppdrag av vår kund söker vi en engagerad och tekniskt nyfiken fältservicetekniker för ett långsiktigt konsultuppdrag i Stockholm. Har du ett praktiskt handlag, gillar att lösa tekniska problem och har erfarenhet av IT, installation eller teknisk service? Trivs du med en varierad arbetsdag där du får möta olika kunder och miljöer? Då kan det här vara nästa möjlighet för dig!

Om uppdraget

I rollen som fältservicetekniker arbetar du ute hos kund med installation, felsökning, underhåll och reparation av teknisk utrustning. Du får en varierad vardag med uppdrag hos kunder inom bland annat finans, retail och kontorsverksamhet.

Du utgår från kundens kontor i Stockholm och arbetar i hela Stockholmsområdet samt i närliggande regioner, exempelvis Uppsala. Resor mellan olika kundplatser är en naturlig del av arbetet, vilket passar dig som uppskattar variation, självständighet och möjligheten att arbeta i olika miljöer.

Uppdragsperiod: Inledande anställning på 6 månader med möjlighet till tillsvidareanställning hos kunden därefter.

Omfattning: 100 %

Placering: Stockholm

Distansarbete: Nej

Lön: 155kr/timme

Arbetsuppgifter

Som fältservicetekniker får du en varierad och praktisk roll där du arbetar med installation, service och felsökning av IT-utrustning hos olika kunder. Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:

description:
About the Opportunity

Premier Global Links LLC is recruiting a Staff-level Software Engineer for an innovative technology company building high-scale data integration and synchronization systems.

This role focuses on designing and scaling distributed backend systems that move large volumes of customer data reliably and efficiently. You will tackle complex engineering challenges involving streaming, performance optimization, system reliability, and multi-region cloud infrastructure.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on backend engineer with strong distributed systems fundamentals, experience scaling mission-critical services, and a track record of delivering high-impact projects in fast-growing technology companies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and scale distributed backend systems for high-volume data synchronization.
  • Improve data processing throughput, synchronization speed, system reliability, and performance.
  • Develop event-driven and streaming architectures using technologies such as Kafka and message queues.
  • Identify and resolve bottlenecks across distributed services, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Build systems capable of supporting significant growth in data volume, traffic, and customer demand.
  • Contribute to multi-cloud and multi-region infrastructure, including data residency requirements.
  • Design low-latency services and caching systems for real-time data access and personalization.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams and customers to solve complex scalability challenges.
  • Own technical projects from architecture and implementation through deployment and optimization.
  • Establish engineering practices that improve observability, reliability, and maintainability.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial backend and distributed systems work.
  • Staff-level engineering capability, demonstrated through technical ownership, system design, and high-impact contributions.
  • Experience working at a high-growth technology company or startup through significant stages of growth.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, scalability, fault tolerance, and performance optimization.
  • Proven experience designing and scaling production systems that handle substantial data volumes or high throughput.
  • Experience building event-driven systems, data pipelines, or synchronization services using technologies such as Kafka and message queues.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-based production environments.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex backend systems and improving system reliability.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering teams.
  • Ability to work remotely within U.S. or Canadian time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data synchronization engines or processing terabytes of data per day.
  • Knowledge of streaming technologies and frameworks such as Kafka, Spark, or Flink.
  • Experience with multi-cloud, multi-region, and globally distributed infrastructure.
  • Experience developing low-latency APIs, caching layers, or real-time personalization systems.

Final compensation will depend on experience, qualifications, and the overall compensation package.

title: Constructability Lead Senior - Principal
description:
Job Posting End Date

10-25-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

Job Summary

The role of a Construction Lead within one or more primary disciplines including Constructability, Construction Planning, Transmission Lines, Substations, Distribution, Fiber Communications, or Tower Communications is to provide leadership and field oversight to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality construction execution, with a strong emphasis on identifying and addressing safety risks. This position serves as the subject matter expert and primary liaison between Construction Management and cross-functional partners, supporting project planning, coordination, and execution while ensuring alignment across stakeholders, schedules, and field activities.

Job Description

Note: This position is posted at multiple grade levels and offers a range of opportunities for advancement. The minimum qualifications outlined below apply to the Construction Lead Senior level, with increased educational, skill, experience and certification requirements for higher level Construction Lead Principal.


What You’ll Do:

Essential Job Functions & Tasks


Constructability

  • Focuses on integrating construction methodology into early project development through the creation and standardization of Constructability Scoping Reports.
  • Requires the ability to evaluate projects at a conceptual level and define optimal construction approaches prior to detailed design.
  • Involves leading cross-functional scoping efforts to align construction sequencing, access, and execution strategy early in the project lifecycle.
  • Includes use of GIS, drawings, and other tools to help provide a construction sequence, identify access constraints, and evaluate outage coordination, material flow, and logistical risks.
  • Emphasizes incorporation of site conditions, constructability challenges, and execution constraints into standardized scoping deliverables.

Transmission Lines, Substations, and Distribution

title: Produktionsmedarbetare till kund i Luleå
description:

I rollen kommer du att arbeta med enklare montering där du spelar en viktig roll för att säkerställa en effektiv och kvalitativ produktion. title: Rengøringsassistent/Servicesassistent søges til Sergentskolen Bangsbo
description:
Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for medarbejdere og gæster på Sergentskolen i Bangsbo? Trives du med selvstændige opgaver, et godt kollegialt fællesskab og en hverdag, hvor kvalitet og service er i fokus? Så er du måske vores nye serviceassistent.

Om os

Etablissement – og Terrænkommandoen leverer og udvikler de fysiske rammer for de militære operative enheder og de øvrige myndigheder under Forsvarsministeriet. Det gælder alt fra vedligehold af bygninger og arealer, sovepladser til soldaterne, skriveborde til kontorer, mad i kantinerne og rengøring.

Du bliver en del af et mindre team, som hver dag er med til at sikre gode rammer for elever, medarbejdere og gæster på Sergentskolen.

Om søværnets sergentskole

Søværnets Sergentskole er beliggende i det naturskønne Bangsbo, i den sydlige del af Frederikshavn. Sergentskolen er en del af Søværnets Officersskole og Forsvarsakademiet. Der kommer ca. 800 elever årligt igennem skolen på flere forskellige uddannelser.

Om stillingen

Som serviceassistent bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen på Sergentskolen i Bangsbo. Du er med til at skabe rene og velfungerende rammer for skolens medarbejdere, elever og gæster.

Dine primære opgaver er at:

  • Udføre daglig og periodisk rengøring
  • Bestille rengøringsmidler og øvrige forbrugsvarer
  • Varetage vask af tøj
  • Oplære nye kolleger og bidrage til teamets fælles opgaver
  • Udføre egenkontrol og sikre høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen
Du bliver en del af et team på seks medarbejdere, hvor vi vægter samarbejde, hjælpsomhed og kvalitet højt. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med fast arbejdssted i Frederikshavn. Arbejdstiden ligger primært mellem kl. 06.00 og 16.00, og der kan lejlighedsvis forekomme arbejde på søgnehelligdage. Vi tilbyder attraktive ansættelsesvilkår, herunder pensionsordning og betalt frokostpause.

Om dig

Vi ser gerne du er uddannet serviceassistent, eller har erfaring med rengøring. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære og bidrage til fællesskabet. Vi sørger naturligvis for en grundig oplæring.

Herudover ser vi gerne, at du taler, læser og forstår dansk.

Dine kolleger værdsætter dig for din konstruktive dialog med dine kolleger. Herudover har du et godt humør, også når vi har travlt.

Du er serviceminded og fleksibel, og du er god til at overskue dine arbejdsopgaver.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og Organisationsaftale for rengøringsassistenter, sanitører, specialarbejdere og visse erhvervsuddannede m.fl. i staten mv. (3F).

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Frederikshavn.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Chef Lars Kornevald på telefon 4054 5979 eller Inspektrice Lisa Gajhede Pedersen på telefon 5133 3179.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Stinne Strøjr Hansen på telefon 2023 9031.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 29. oktober 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt løbende. Stillingen er til besættelse den 1. december 2026.

Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis/svendebrev. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen

Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen (ETK) støtter og servicerer militære og civile myndigheder under Forsvarsministeriet. Vores opgave er at levere og udvikle attraktive fysiske rammer, som er nødvendige for deres daglige virke.
Vi bygger nyt, vedligeholder, driver kantiner og gør rent på tjenestesteder i hele landet.
Vi har på vegne af Forsvarsministeriets koncern ansvaret for det grønne område, der blandt andet omfatter miljø, energi og naturpleje.
Vores hovedkontor er i Hjørring, men vi har medarbejdere i hele landet. Vi er i alt 1600 ansatte, der tæller både civilt og militært ansatte. Vi er en organisation baseret på stærke fagfællesskaber, og vi prioriterer det tværgående samarbejde højt.

  • • Vi har ansvaret for over 600 lokationer spredt ud over hele Danmark.
    • Vi administrer over 6000 bygninger og forvalter øvelsesområder, der samlet set er på størrelse med Mors.
    • Vi bygger og vedligeholder i år for knap en milliard og er blandt andet bygherre på store projekter som campus til de nye F35-kampfly.

title: Applied Scientist (Optimization and Decision Systems) - Colorado Springs, CO
description:
Davidson is distinguished in the aerospace and missile defense industry, in part, because of its excellence in hiring exceptional experts, engineers and software developers dedicated to delivering advanced, intelligent technology solutions in defense of our nation.

Davison is seeking an Applied Scientist in Colorado Springs to develop algorithms and computational solutions for complex real-world problems involving optimization, uncertainty, simulation, and sequential decision-making.

This role combines applied mathematics, algorithm development, programming, and experimental analysis. You will work on problems that require translating ambiguous requirements into practical models, evaluating alternative approaches, and adapting methods to fit real-world constraints.

Working closely with the technical lead, you will have the autonomy to investigate problems, challenge assumptions, propose improvements, and implement solutions. Your work will span improving existing applications, developing simulation-based optimization methods, and advancing real-time decision systems that use information as it becomes available.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Formulate complex problems using appropriate mathematical and computational models, making and evaluating assumptions where necessary.
  • Develop, adapt, and combine algorithms from optimization, probability, statistics, machine learning, and sequential decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to improve decisions and computational efficiency by exploiting available information and information revealed over time.
  • Design computational experiments, analyze results, and use evidence to evaluate approaches and guide improvements.
  • Implement algorithms and contribute to maintainable software in Python and C++, including improving existing applications, testing, and code quality.
  • Develop and optimize discrete-event simulations and contribute to real-time systems for sequential decision-making under uncertainty.
  • Collaborate with the technical lead to assess existing approaches, identify limitations, and develop practical alternatives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in mathematics, operations research, statistics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, with 5+ years of relevant experience; or a Master's or PhD in a related field with 3+ years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated experience applying quantitative, statistical, or algorithmic methods to complex real-world problems.
  • Practical programming ability in Python and C++.
  • Experience applying relevant methods such as optimization, probability, statistics, simulation, stochastic optimization, reinforcement learning, bandit algorithms, or active learning. Candidates need experience in some relevant areas, not all.
  • Ability to critically evaluate assumptions and approaches, reason through ambiguity, and develop and test practical solutions.
  • Familiarity with Git and GitHub or comparable version-control tools.
  • Ability to communicate technical reasoning, results, and trade-offs clearly.

Desired (not required) competencies:

  • Experience with any of the following: sequential decision-making, reinforcement learning, stochastic optimization, bandit algorithms, or active learning.
  • Experience with simulation-based optimization.
  • Familiarity with supervised and unsupervised learning.
  • Experience with scientific computing, simulation, or computational experimentation.
  • Experience improving software from prototype to maintainable application.
  • Familiarity with automated testing or CI/CD practices.
  • Graduate-level study or research in a relevant quantitative or computational discipline.

Relevant experience may come from professional work, research, graduate projects, or other substantial technical projects. Candidates are not expected to have expertise in every listed method.

Clearance:

Ability to obtain a DoD secret clearance

The Opportunity

This is a self-directed technical role for someone who enjoys applying their knowledge to interesting, open-ended problems. You will have room to explore approaches, question assumptions, and implement improvements while collaborating with the technical lead on problem formulation and overall direction.

The emphasis is on sound technical reasoning, practical algorithm development, and evidence-based problem-solving-not on any single academic discipline, algorithm, or software framework.

  • Represents the engineering team across all phases of larger and more-complex development projects, supporting development environments, container-orchestrated server resources, and provisioning workflows used daily by SDK and post-silicon engineers.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer/Electronics Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent.

  • Experience designing software that runs across multiple platform types — physical switches, virtual/simulation environments, and hardware emulation.
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps tooling and infrastructure: CI/CD (Jenkins), Git/GitHub, containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and Linux-based server environments.
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals (L2/L3, traffic generation, packet flows) and/or ASIC/SDK or post-silicon test environments is a strong plus.
  • Software testing methodology, including writing and executing test plans, debugging, and building test scripts and tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language. Ability to effectively communicate tool architectures and design proposals and negotiate options at management levels.

title: Constructability Lead Senior - Principal
description:
Job Posting End Date

10-25-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

Job Summary

The role of a Construction Lead within one or more primary disciplines including Constructability, Construction Planning, Transmission Lines, Substations, Distribution, Fiber Communications, or Tower Communications is to provide leadership and field oversight to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality construction execution, with a strong emphasis on identifying and addressing safety risks. This position serves as the subject matter expert and primary liaison between Construction Management and cross-functional partners, supporting project planning, coordination, and execution while ensuring alignment across stakeholders, schedules, and field activities.

Job Description


What You’ll Do:


Constructability

  • Focuses on integrating construction methodology into early project development through the creation and standardization of Constructability Scoping Reports.
  • Requires the ability to evaluate projects at a conceptual level and define optimal construction approaches prior to detailed design.
  • Involves leading cross-functional scoping efforts to align construction sequencing, access, and execution strategy early in the project lifecycle.
  • Includes use of GIS, drawings, and other tools to help provide a construction sequence, identify access constraints, and evaluate outage coordination, material flow, and logistical risks.
  • Emphasizes incorporation of site conditions, constructability challenges, and execution constraints into standardized scoping deliverables.
  • Requires experience supporting continuous improvement efforts, including lessons learned integration, contractor feedback incorporation, and refinement of constructability practices to improve planning consistency, efficiency, and execution readiness.

Fiber Communications

  • Centers on fiber optic network construction, including aerial and underground cable installation, splicing, testing, and system commissioning.
  • Requires understanding of fiber optic cable systems, routing methods, and network configurations supporting utility communication infrastructure.
  • Includes interpretation of fiber-specific documentation such as splice diagrams, fiber assignment records, and communication network schematics, along with familiarity in testing practices including OTDR validation and signal performance verification.
  • Involves installation methods unique to fiber deployment, including cable pulling, blowing, aerial placement, splice enclosure installation, and fiber termination.
  • Emphasizes coordination of communication system integration to maintain network continuity and operational functionality.

Other Requirements

  • Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, mentor, and train junior personnel.
  • Must be a team player, inquisitive, analytical, and be able to interact with and maintain working relationships with diverse teams.
  • Ability to read and interpret one-line station diagrams and transmission line switching diagrams and anticipate proper clearance points and zones of protection.
  • Aptitude to understand and interpret conceptual scopes of work and visualize the safest and most effective method of construction and identify potential risks and hazards to be removed.
  • Capacity to lead in understanding, developing, and clearly presenting complicated construction sequencing to the project team.
  • Must have strong computer skills and be able to grasp and use new technologies as they become available.
  • Strong analytical skills are needed to visualize a conceptual project and how it will be built, able to visualize and plan for potential risks associated with the construction or proposed facilities.
  • Being able to conduct substation and transmission line site visits. Driving a vehicle long distance to conduct site visits.
  • Avid concentration levels. Decision making and collaborative skills in stressful situations.

What You Will Need:


Construction Lead Senior

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Safety or related field and six (6) years’ experience of overseeing/directing transmission and distribution station construction and/or transmission line construction work.

OR

  • ABET accredited Associate degree in electrical, construction management, safety, civil engineering technology or related field of study and eight (8) years’ experience in overseeing/directing transmission and distribution station construction and/or transmission line construction work

OR

  • High school diploma or GED with a minimum of ten (10) years of direct experience as an AEP/contractor line or station field employee or Construction Rep.

Work Experience

  • Related experience is defined as involvement with transmission overseeing/directing transmission and distribution station construction and/or transmission line construction work. A thorough knowledge of the transmission system, from a design and operation perspective. AND experience within transmission engineering, and/or construction management is desired to fulfill responsibilities of this job.

Construction Lead Principal

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or related field and eight (8) years’ experience of overseeing/directing transmission and distribution station construction and/or transmission line construction work.

OR

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Technology or ABET-accredited Engineering Technology with ten (10) years of relevant experience.

OR

  • Associate degree in Construction Management Technology or ABET-accredited Electrical or Civil Engineering Technology with twelve (12) years of relevant experience.

OR

  • High school diploma or GED with fourteen (14) experience in construction, project execution, or field operations within electric utility or infrastructure environments.

Work Experience

  • Related experience is defined as involvement with transmission overseeing/directing transmission and distribution station construction and/or transmission line construction work. A thorough knowledge of the transmission system, from a design and operation perspective. AND experience within transmission engineering, and/or construction management is desired to fulfill responsibilities of this job.

Other Preferred Requirements

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook, for data analysis, reporting, and communications.
  • Experience using Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive for collaboration, document management, and team coordination.
  • Familiarity with Power BI for data visualization and reporting, and Power Automate for workflow optimization is a plus.
  • Strong ability to develop professional presentations, dashboards, and reports to communicate project status, risks, and performance metrics.
  • Experience working in a digital, collaboration-driven environment with structured file management and version control practices.
  • Ability to quickly learn and apply enterprise systems such as project scheduling tools, work management systems, and GIS platforms.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills to support standardized processes, reporting, and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • An understanding of Bulk Electric System operations, construction management practices, or engineering disciplines supporting transmission, distribution, or communication infrastructure is required.
  • Candidates must demonstrate strong analytical and technical capabilities, including the ability to interpret project documentation, plans, and schedules.

What You’ll Get:


In addition to competitive compensation, AEP offers a unique comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.


Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do

At AEP, we’re more than just an energy company — we’re a team of dedicated professionals committed to delivering safe, reliable, and innovative energy solutions. Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and being part of a forward-thinking organization, this is the company for you!

title: Kock
description:
Pitcher’s är en Gastropub kedja där ett gediget hantverk och umgänge med vänner står i centrum. Hit kan du komma för att få god mat och dryck, men även för att koppla av en stund i goda vänners lag. Pitcher’s Norrmalm i Stockholm öppnade 2017 och är det självklara valet för dig som vill umgås med vänner och gillar god mat och dryck och aktiviteter.

Vi finns på Regeringsgatan 113, precis vid korsningen till (Birger Jarlsgatan/Tegnergatan).

Pitcher´s Norrmalm söker en kock med minst 5-6 års erfarenhet och gärna med utbildning. Tjänsten gäller extra arbete kvällar/helger. Du som söker skall ha yrkesstolthet och brinna för det du gör. Du behöver kunna arbeta självständigt men även i team, vara flexibel, stresstålig och punktlig i ditt arbete. Du bör även ha goda läs och skrivkunskaper och gärna datakunskaper, vara lyhörd och kunna laga mat från grunden och efter recepturer som vi tillhandahåller kontinuerligt. Du bör även ha erfarenhet från olika a´la carte menyer, grillrätter och hamburgare. Lön enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten kan tillsättas omgående!

Stämmer du in på detta, skicka in ditt CV och bild till oss redan idag, info.norrmalm@pitchers.se

title: Financial Reporting, Senior Associate
description:
Who we are looking for

As part of our business expansion in Luxembourg we are looking for an experienced Financial Reporting professional to join our AIS Financial Reporting team. This position has responsibility for the review of Annual and Semi-Annual Financial Statements as well as monthly/quarterly reports for Alternative Structures (Private equity / Real Estate / Debt funds) and Hedge funds under Lux GAAP, US GAAP and IFRS.

Under the supervision of the “Unit Head – AIS Financial Reporting”, the team member will play a key management role when ensuring that quality deliverables are sent to our clients for their Alternative Structures (Private equity / Real Estate / Debt funds) and Hedge funds under Lux GAAP, US GAAP and IFRS. The AIS Financial Reporting team leverages a delegated service model with part of the functions outsourced to our outsourcing locations (Hubs). With senior team members’ guidance, the Senior Associate will guide the Hubs according to the department and bank’s strategy.

In close relation with the other Financial Reporting Leads, the Senior Associate will ensure that the assigned client-base (incl. the related stakeholders: auditor, translator, printer, regulator, etc.) is serviced according to best practice and market standards. This includes e.g., that new demands or specific projects are adequately reflected in the overall development queue of the department.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Global Services (SSGS). SSGS gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and transfer agency to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGS’ tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for

  • Have efficient communication with other departments (such as fund accounting, depositary and transfer agency), optimising data feeds / troubleshooting for the department.
  • Oversee and perform a technical review of financial statements in accordance with relevant GAAP requirements for alternative investment structures.
  • Coordinate the receipt of comments on financial statements drafts from both internal and external parties.
  • Research, resolve and/or take appropriate actions to avoid recurrence of errors.
  • Actively contribute to the team’s deliverables with accuracy and timeliness.
  • Identify weaknesses in the workflows and come up with proposals for enhancements.
  • Be part of project activities (i.e., client on-boarding, milestone planning, ad-hoc projects).
  • Manage the assigned client-base relationships and ensure service excellence especially by consistently looking for improvements and alternative solutions that would enhance the existing process chain (automation, set-up, scalability, etc.).

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role


  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Stakeholder-management skills.
  • Attention to detail, reliability and responsiveness.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills and ability to deliver under pressure.
  • Analytical skills.
  • Ability to guide and support junior colleagues and Hubs.
  • Sense of ownership and accountability for work.
  • Continuous-improvement mindset.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor/University degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field
  • Relevant professional qualification or progress toward one is preferred, such as ACCA, ACA, CPA or equivalent.
  • Min 5 years of experience in Accounting, Audit and/or Financial and Regulatory Reporting within the Funds industry.
  • Experience and knowledge of Alternative Structures (Private equity / Real Estate / Debt funds) and Hedge funds and the financial reporting around these structures under Lux GAAP, US GAAP and IFRS.
  • Knowledge of Regulatory Reporting applicable for the relevant funds.

About State Street


Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

title: Senior Estimator - Top Secret/SCI required
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

Join Blue Origin's proposal pricing team and help shape the cost strategy behind the next generation of spaceflight.


You'll develop, document, and defend cost estimates for programs spanning liquid rocket propulsion, suborbital and orbital launch, lunar landing services, and in-space applications. You'll work directly with engineering, program management, supply chain, finance, and capture leaders to build competitive, compliant proposals for commercial and government customers. Your work will directly influence which opportunities we pursue, how we price them, and how we win the business that funds our vision of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth.


This role suits an experienced estimator who enjoys variety, from a fast-turn commercial quote to a large multi-volume government proposal, and who wants to help build and improve the estimating practices of a fast-growing company.


If working outside of the Kent/Renton office, it will require regular travel to the Seattle area.


What You'll Do:

Develop and deliver estimates

  • Build, review, and present cost estimates and price volumes that comply with internal policies and external requirements (FAR, DFARS, NFS, CAS, and customer-specific RFP instructions)
  • Write clear, defensible Basis of Estimate (BOE) narratives that document estimating approaches, assumptions, and rationale
  • Develop estimates for Internal Research & Development (IR&D) efforts
  • Manage multiple estimating efforts at once, across varying levels of scope definition, complexity, and dollar value

Support the proposal lifecycle

  • Partner with capture, technical, program, supply chain, and finance teams from RFP release through submission, negotiation, and award
  • Interpret RFPs, SOWs, and customer cost documents, and translate them into estimating plans and data requests
  • Contribute to pricing strategy, should-cost analysis, and risk and opportunity assessments
  • Support commercial and government customers across Blue Origin's product lines: liquid rocket propulsion, suborbital launch, orbital launch, lunar landing services, and in-space applications

Build the function

  • Identify and lead improvements to estimating tools, templates, data, and processes
  • Help build and maintain estimating models, rate structures, and historical databases
  • Mentor and develop less-experienced estimators and pricing analysts

What You Bring:

Required

  • Active Top Secret clearance
  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, engineering, or a related field
  • 10+ of cost estimating or proposal pricing experience in aerospace, defense, or another complex government contracting environment
  • Working knowledge of FAR, DFARS, NFS, CAS, and TINA, and of preparing compliant cost or price volumes
  • Experience writing BOEs and developing bottoms-up, parametric, and analogous estimates
  • Ability to read and interpret RFPs, SOWs, and cost-related customer documents
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including building and interpreting complex, multi-tab models
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain and defend an estimate to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to build trusted relationships across disciplines and contribute to an inclusive team culture

Preferred

  • Experience in aerospace, launch vehicle, spacecraft, or propulsion programs
  • Experience with parametric estimating tools (e.g., PRICE, SEER) and pricing or ERP systems (e.g., Deltek, SAP, Oracle)
  • Experience building estimating, pricing, or cost management models
  • Familiarity with NASA, Space Force, or other national security space procurements
  • APMP, ICEAA (CCEA/CEBP), or similar certification
  • Experience mentoring others or leading process improvement initiatives

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You're energized by Blue Origin's mission and by pricing work that supports human spaceflight and lunar exploration
  • You like being the bridge between engineering reality and a competitive, compliant price
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy making incomplete data into a defensible estimate
  • You hold yourself to a high standard of quality and accuracy under tight proposal deadlines
  • You want to help shape how a growing company estimates and prices its work
  • You understand the requirements and dynamics of working classified programs.


Base Pay Range for:

CO applicants is $114,455.00 - $160,236.30
WA applicants is $124,476.00 - $174,265.35

Other site ranges may differ


Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
  • Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
  • Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

title: AI Business Enablement Lead
description:
Company Description

Are you motivated by helping people and business functions unlock the value of AI in their daily work? Do you thrive in a role where you influence, enable, and drive change across a large international organisation?

As our new AI Business Enablement Lead, you will play a key role in accelerating AI adoption across JYSK. Based at our Head Office in Aarhus, you will work closely with business leaders and colleagues across functions to turn AI opportunities into practical solutions that create value.

This is a unique opportunity to join a newly established AI function and shape how AI becomes part of the way we work. As the first person in this role, you will help build the foundation for future growth while working closely with the Central AI team and stakeholders across the business.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, we believe that dedication creates opportunities. We offer you a role with a high degree of responsibility, visibility, and influence across the organisation. You will join a company where decisions are made quickly, ideas are welcomed, and colleagues work together with trust, respect, and a shared ambition to improve how we do business.

You will become part of a growing AI function that supports colleagues across JYSK, helping business areas build confidence and capability in using AI. At the same time, you will have excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development in an international environment.

As our first recruit in this new AI function, you will set the benchmark. For the right candidate with a strong, proactive mindset, this role offers a clear path to grow into leading our future team of AI Business Enablement Specialists.

Furthermore, we offer you:

  • A unique opportunity to shape and drive AI adoption across JYSK
  • Significant exposure to senior stakeholders and business leaders across functions
  • Close collaboration with AI specialists, engineers, and data professionals
  • A workplace built on trust, empowerment, and freedom with responsibility
  • A modern Head Office environment in Aarhus with a strong team culture
  • Attractive employee benefits, social activities, and staff discounts
  • Opportunities for continuous learning, development, and future career growth

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

You will act as a trusted partner to business functions, supporting leaders and teams in identifying, prioritising, and implementing AI opportunities. Through training, coaching, stakeholder engagement, and structured change management, you will help ensure that AI becomes a natural and valuable part of daily work across JYSK.

Your success will depend on your ability to build relationships, simplify complex topics, and guide colleagues through transformation in a practical and business-focused way.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

  • Partnering with business leaders to identify, evaluate, and prioritise high-value AI use cases
  • Designing and delivering practical AI training, workshops, and enablement activities for business users
  • Establishing best practices, reusable frameworks, prompt libraries, responsible AI practices and AI adoption guidelines
  • Driving AI adoption strategies and supporting departments on their AI maturity journey
  • Collaborating closely with the Central AI team to evaluate initiatives and determine the right solution approach
  • Monitoring business impact, and value creation through defined success metrics
  • Engage with the broader AI Ambassador network to improve usage and adoption of AI across all units at JYSK.
  • Facilitating cross-functional collaboration to reduce duplication and promote shared learning across JYSK

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for someone who combines strong business understanding with the ability to drive change and inspire others. You are comfortable working across functions, navigating ambiguity, and helping colleagues understand how AI can support their goals.

You bring a practical and collaborative approach, and you enjoy turning new technologies into meaningful business outcomes.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

  • Has 5-7 years of relevant experience
  • Holds a degree in Business, Information Systems, Innovation Management, Engineering, or a related field
  • Has proven experience driving change management, transformation, or business improvement initiatives across an organisation
  • Demonstrates strong practical experience with AI tools, enterprise copilots, prompt engineering, and AI-enabled workflows
  • Has excellent stakeholder management skills and can influence without direct authority
  • Can assess, prioritise, and communicate business value from AI use cases
  • Enjoys coaching and enabling colleagues while creating engagement around new ways of working

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Head of AI, Karan Honavar at +45 2812 8374.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

title: Sygeplejerske til K0161
description:
Det er så givende at arbejde med vores patientgruppe. Mange af dem er sårbare og med lidt skæve eksistenser, og vi gør virkelig en forskel for dem.

Samarbejdet mellem læger og plejepersonale er fantastisk.

Vi har det sjovt i personalegruppen, selvom vi nogle gange har travlt. Vi har god selvironi, og vi synes selv, at vi er sjove.

Vi har god psykologisk tryghed.

Sådan beskriver personalet selv hverdagen på K0161 – og det er netop den kombination af faglighed, fællesskab og humor, vi gerne vil invitere dig til at blive en del af.

På gastromedicinsk sengeafsnit K0161 på Nordsjællands Hospital søger vi en sygeplejerske, der har lyst til at gøre en forskel for patienter med komplekse gastromedicinske problemstillinger.

Måske er du nyuddannet og leder efter et sted, hvor du kan udvikle dig. Måske har du erfaring fra et andet medicinsk- eller kirurgisk speciale og har lyst til at prøve kræfter med gastroenterologien. Eller måske har du mange års erfaring og søger nye faglige udfordringer.

Det vigtigste er ikke, hvor meget gastromedicinsk sygepleje du kan i forvejen. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære og være en del af vores fællesskab.


Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med? K0161 er et specialiseret gastromedicinsk sengeafsnit normeret til 12 patienter per 1. januar 2027. Afsnittet er en del af Kirurgisk Afdeling på Nordsjællands Hospital. Vi arbejder med en varieret patientgruppe, og du vil blandt andet møde patienter med:

  • Levercirrose og komplekse hepatologiske problemstillinger
  • Inflammatorisk tarmsygdom (IBD) og biologisk behandling
  • Akut pancreatitis
  • Sociale og psykosociale udfordringer
Vi arbejder ud fra Fundamentals of Care, hvor relationen til patienten, kvalitet i sygeplejen og patientinddragelse er centrale elementer.


Hvem er vi? Vi er en personalegruppe med bred diversitet bestående af sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, farmakonom og afdelingsfysioterapeut med forskellige aldre, baggrunde og mange års forskelligartet erfaring. Vi ser vores forskelligheder som en styrke, da vi kan lære af hinanden og bringe forskellige perspektiver og kompetencer i spil.

Vi har et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med læger og andre faggrupper. Vi tror på, at de bedste patientforløb skabes, når vi bruger hinandens kompetencer og taler åbent sammen.

Og så betyder det sociale en del for os. Vi vil gerne være en arbejdsplads, hvor der både er plads til høj faglighed og udvikling, men også humor og et godt grin i hverdagen. Vi prioriterer et kollegialt fællesskab og ses desuden til sociale arrangementer uden for arbejdsdagen på tværs af faggrupper.


Hvem er du?
  • Du er autoriseret sygeplejerske og har lyst til at arbejde med både akutte, komplekse og længerevarende patientforløb
  • Du er fagligt nysgerrig og interesserer dig for at forstå sammenhængen mellem patientens symptomer, sygdom og behandling
  • Du har lyst til at udvikle dine sygeplejefaglige kompetencer og blive dygtigere inden for blandt andet observation, klinisk vurdering, medicinhåndtering og pleje af den medicinske patient
  • Du trives med en hverdag, hvor der kan være mange forskellige patientforløb, og hvor du skal kunne bevare overblikket og prioritere dine sygeplejeopgaver
  • Du kan lide at arbejde tæt sammen med læger, social- og sundhedsassistenter og andre faggrupper og ser det tværfaglige samarbejde som en vigtig del af et godt patientforløb
  • Du bidrager aktivt til et godt fagligt og socialt arbejdsmiljø og har lyst til både at dele din egen viden og lære af dine kolleger
Mentorordning Vi ved, at det tager tid at lære et nyt speciale og/eller en ny personalegruppe. Derfor får du et individuelt tilpasset introduktionsforløb og en mentor, så du gradvist bliver fortrolig med specialet og får mere ansvar i takt med, at du er klar.

Vi lægger vægt på, at det skal være trygt at være ny hos os. Du skal kunne spørge om hjælp, sparre med dine kolleger og sige højt, hvis der er noget, du er usikker på.


Praktisk Stillingen er på 32-37 timer om ugen med blandede vagter i toholdsskift. Du vil have weekendvagt hver 2. eller 3. weekend, og du har medindflydelse på egen vagtplan.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Du ansættes i henhold til overenskomst for ikke-ledende personale på Sundhedskartellets område. Du er under ansættelsen omfattet af den til enhver tid gældende arbejdstidsaftale indgået mellem Regionernes Lønnings- og Takstnævn og Dansk Sygeplejeråd.



Klik på linket for at se aktuel startløn:

https://www.regionh.dk/om-region-hovedstaden/fakta/arbejdsplads/Sider/Startloen.aspx

Kontakt og ansøgning Ansøgningsfrist: 16. november 2026. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Er du nysgerrig, men ikke helt klar til at søge endnu? Så ring til os eller kom forbi til en kop kaffe! Vi tager gerne en uforpligtende snak om jobbet og fortæller mere om, hvem vi er.

Oversygeplejerske Gitte Madsen

tlf. 23 27 34 69, Gitte.madsen.05@regionh.dk

tlf. 48 29 67 52
