title: Lægesekretær/sundhedsadministrativ koordinator søges til nyreteamet i Afdeling for Urinvejssygdomme på Herlev
description:
En af vores kolleger i nyreteamet har skiftet team, hvilket betyder at vi nu har muligheden for at tilbyde en ny kollega ansættelse i vores mindste team.

Hvis du synes det lyder spændende – så læs videre – og så får du måske lyst til at søge stillingen med det samme, eller komme ud og besøge os her på Afdeling for Urinvejssygdomme på Herlev



Stillingen er med ren dagvagt og på 30-37 timer pr. uge – men helst 37.



Hvem er vi

Vi er en stor multifacetteret og engageret lægesekretærgruppe, som ser frem til at få endnu en dygtig lægesekretær-/sundhedsadministrativ koordinatorkollega.



Om stillingen

I nyreteamet er der færre patientfremmøder end i afdelingens øvrige teams. Til gengæld spiller vi en central rolle i forbindelse med vores MDT-konferencer og interne konferencer, hvor patientforløb vurderes og planlægges.



På vores nyre-MDT-konferencer deltager du som sekretær, og spiller en central rolle undervejs. Du skriver på storskærm efter diktat fra lægerne og sørger for at notere undervejs, bla. hvilket brev eller hvilke tider, patienten efterfølgende skal have. Efter konferencen taler du med vores forløbskoordinator, som også er med på konferencen, mhp at sikre patientforløbene. Det er også dig, der laver de indledende arbejdsgange forud for konferencen, og ligeledes er det dig, der sørger for efterforløbet.

MDT-konferencerne er essentielle for nyreteamet og som ny sekretær i teamet er det derfor afgørende, at du har lyst til at skrive direkte og være lidt i centrum. Til gengæld bliver du et skattet medlem af det tværfaglige team i forbindelse med konferencerne.



Det er vigtigt at understrege at du ikke bliver sluppet alene løs på en MDT før vi er sikre på at du er flyvefærdig. Du vil de første måneder kun være på konference sammen med erfaren kollega. Vi har p.t. to sekretærer som har en konference om ugen, hver.



Mødetiden taler vi om – men den vil ligge mellem 7.30 -15.30. Desuden er der gode muligheder for hjemmearbejdsdage efter 4-6 måneders ansættelse.



En arbejdsplads med struktur og udvikling

Som ny hos os bliver du tildelt en mentor, som du kommunikerer med allerede før du starter. Der bliver lagt et introduktionsprogram som løbende tilpasses lige netop dig. Det tilstræbes at den meste oplæring i starten sker ved mentor og 1-2 andre kolleger mhp at sikre kontinuitet og kvalitet i oplæringen.

Vi arbejder teamopdelt i tværfaglige teams - og er organiseret med Anita som sundhedsadministrativ leder.

I hvert af vores teams har vi en sekretærtovholder, som står for den daglige fordeling af vores arbejdsopgaver. De tre teamspecialer hos os på Herlev er nyre, prostata og urothel (blære).



Udover de faste opgaver i hvert team, har vi fælles opgaver som kører i turnus mellem de tre teams – hvilket sikrer variation og kompetencer.



Vi arbejder ud fra dagslister/besøgslister, hvilket betyder at vi gør den enkelte patient færdig når han/hun har været i ambulatoriet. Vi booker, registrerer, koder, påsætter forløbsmarkører, maksimale ventetider, kræftpakkekodning osv. Dette betyder at vi ”kommer hele vejen rundt om patienten” i én arbejdsgang. Tilsvarende har vi opfølgning af patienter fra vores sengeafsnit, hvor vi på samme vis kommer hele vejen rundt om patienten, registrerer operationskoder og sender epikrise/udskrivningskort til egen læge. Vi har finpudset vores arbejdsgange, evaluerer og tilpasser dem løbende – hvilket betyder at de er toptunede.



Vi har regelmæssigt mono-og tværfaglige teammøder, og fire gange årligt er der sekretærmøde med fremmøde/og på Teams, hvor alle deltager.



I vores afdeling vægtes de sundhedsadministratives kompetencer højt af både ledelsen og vores tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere - og der arrangeres løbende formaliseret undervisning for os. Anita vægter kompetencegivende uddannelse højt, så mange af os har taget relevante moduler af sundhedskommunomen. Her udover deltager afdelingen løbende i uddannelsen af sundhedsadministrative koordinatorer.



Afdelingen holder tværfaglig temadag i september, hvor alle deltager, ligesom vi har en julefest hvert år i november. Julefesten kan du nå at komme med til her i 2026 hvis du er hurtig.





Da vi er en højt specialiseret urologisk afdeling med deraf følgende høj kompleksitet i opgaveløsningen, vil vi rigtig gerne have at du



  • er uddannet lægesekretær/sundhedsadministrativ koordinator (dette er faktisk ufravigeligt)
  • er ansvarsbevidst
  • kan SP – eller har potentiale og lyst til at lære det
  • kan skrive efter direkte diktat (på vores konferencer)
  • arbejder struktureret og har overblik, også i pressede situationer
  • både kan arbejde selvstændigt og teamorienteret
  • vægter det tværfaglige og er opsøgende
  • er god til at prioritere og ændre fokus hurtigt (vigtigt)
  • tør sige din mening og spørge ind
  • er løsningsorienteret
  • har "teamspirit" og gode kommunikationsevner
  • er imødekommende




Hos os får du
  • erfarne, dygtige, engagerede og ikke mindst søde kolleger
  • grundig oplæring tilpasset dig
  • en god og respektfuld omgangstone
  • kollegial omsorg og plads til et godt grin
  • et godt tværfagligt samarbejde
  • gode muligheder for hjemmearbejdsdage
  • Introduktionsprogram med mentorordning efter onboardingprincippet
  • Erfarne tovholdere og funktionsledere
  • Lægesekretærfaglig ledelse
  • En lydhør og nærværende afdelingsledelse
  • Løbende specialeundervisning for sekretærgruppen
  • Personligt kompetenceudviklingsprogram med gode muligheder for efteruddannelse


Stillingen ønskes besat 1.12.26 eller snarest derefter.



Hvis du synes om, hvad du har læst, kan du enten skynde dig at sende en ansøgning, eller kontakte Anita, på tlf. 38689508, eller mail anita.nielsen.06@regionh.dk

Du skal også være meget velkommen til at komme forbi til en snak og et kig før du sender din ansøgning – så skriver eller ringer du bare til Anita og aftaler et tidspunkt .



Ansøgningsfrist: onsdag d. 28.10.26, - vi holder dog løbende samtaler – så vent endelig ikke med at kontakte os til sidste øjeblik!

title: Accountants Payable Assistant
description:
Be a part of something bigger...

Our Story

Be a part of something bigger...

Radar Healthcare is dedicated to improving patient safety by bringing together the expertise of healthcare professionals and the power of intuitive software. Our innovative platform has been developed in partnership with industry experts to ensure organisations always meet regulatory standards – making it easier than ever for healthcare providers to deliver top-quality care to their patients.

We’re on a mission to become a world-leading health-tech pioneer, and we know that we can only achieve this with the help of talented individuals like you. If you’re passionate about improving healthcare outcomes and want to work in a team of like-minded individuals, we invite you to join us on our journey.

So if you’re up for an exciting challenge and want to be part of a team that’s making a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Our Values

At Radar Healthcare, we are all proud of our values-led, open, supportive and inclusive culture. It's just as important that anyone joining our friendly team share the same values as us, to ensure we're all on the same page from day one, so we're looking for people who feel aligned to the following:

🤝🏽 Customer focused with a partnership approach

📖 Open, honest and transparent

🧠 Innovative

🫶🏼 Ethical, trustworthy and caring

Our People & Culture

At Radar Healthcare, we understand and celebrate the fact that our people are our best assets! We are proud to showcase our diverse and passionate talent that encapsulates our vision, purpose and values in our shared mission of innovation in healthcare. We’re an ambitious but caring team, and so supporting our colleagues and partners is always a top priority. Not to mention, we’re not all work and no play – we love getting together to celebrate our achievements together in various settings, whether it be our winter and summer socials, our people-led full company days, team get togethers or simply just interacting and supporting one another over coffee breaks either remotely or in person at our amazing Leeds office.

"We're also super proud to be Great Place to Work-Certified, based on outstanding feedback directly from our team earlier this year, with 91% of the team agreeing that they "would strongly endorse my company to friends and family as a great place to work" Not to mention Radar Healthcare has been named one of the UK’s Top 100 Companies to Work For 2025, one of the Top 20 Tech Companies to Work For, and has received a Two Star Accreditation from Best Companies, recognising ‘Outstanding’ levels of workplace engagement."" 🫶🏼

The Opportunity

Radar Healthcare's new ⭐Accounts Payable Assistant ⭐

To support the Finance team in managing the company’s purchase ledger operations while gaining practical experience and knowledge of financial processes within the health tech sector. The role supports accurate invoice and expense processing, supplier payments, account maintenance, financial record-keeping, reporting and compliance, while developing capability in financial systems, data analysis and process improvement.

What you’ll be doing to make a difference:

Invoice and Expense Processing

• Receive, verify and code supplier invoices accurately.

• Manage the employee expenses process from start to finish.

• Enter invoice data accurately into the financial system.

• Match invoices with purchase orders and goods received notes.

Payment Management

• Prepare payment runs.

• Schedule and process supplier payments.

• Maintain accurate records of payments made and outstanding.

Supplier Account Maintenance

• Reconcile supplier statements with internal records.

• Resolve discrepancies and queries with suppliers.

• Maintain up-to-date supplier information.

• Complete new vendor verification.

Financial Record-Keeping and Banking

• Maintain the purchase ledger system and organise financial documents.

• Prepare reports on accounts payable status and ageing.

• Enter bank transactions and complete bank reconciliations.

• Support payment run management.

Payroll, Data Analysis and Reporting

• Process payroll in accordance with third-party instructions.

• Compile data for purchase ledger reports and analyse spending patterns and supplier performance.

• Prepare financial summaries for management review.

Compliance and Process Improvement

• Assist in ensuring adherence to financial policies and procedures.

• Maintain records for audit purposes and support the team in staying current with relevant financial regulations.

• Identify and suggest improvements to purchase ledger processes.

Stakeholder Communication and Team Support

• Respond to supplier enquiries and prepare information for internal stakeholders.

• Monitor the accounts and purchases mailbox.

• Assist other Finance team members as required.

• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment.

Security and Quality Responsibilities:

• Protect the confidentiality, integrity and security of financial, supplier and employee information.

• Follow information security policies, access controls and approved methods for processing, storing and sharing data.

• Verify supplier and payment information and remain alert to phishing, fraud and suspicious requests, escalating concerns promptly.

• Maintain accurate records, follow documented controls and quality standards, and check work carefully before processing.

• Support audits, identify data quality improvements, escalate control failures and complete required security and data protection training.

Your journey so far...

  • Ability to work with numbers and perform simple calculations accurately.

  • Familiarity with basic office software, particularly Microsoft Excel.

  • Basic understanding of financial concepts such as invoices, purchase orders and credit notes.

  • Demonstrable interest in finance and/or the healthtech sector.

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and suppliers.

  • Ability to manage and prioritise tasks efficiently.

  • Eagerness to learn and develop.

  • Effective time management, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple tasks.

  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve straightforward discrepancies.

  • Ability to work collaboratively within a Finance team.

Even better if you…

  • Experience using Sage Intacct.

The Bigger Picture

Whilst we value professional experiences and qualifications, we’re committed to maintaining a culture of growth and development here at Radar Healthcare. We take into account each candidates demonstrable skillset, drive and ethos so even if you don’t feel 100% qualified for the role – we welcome you to connect with us. We’d love to hear from passionate candidates from all backgrounds that align themselves with our company values and are excited to make a difference in healthcare!

What we offer in return...

💰 A competitive salary of up to £27,000 per year, dependent on experience

💜 Values-led culture - we’re extremely proud of our culture. Learn more about what makes it special here

🏢 Flexible working – We believe in empowering our team to work in a way that suits them best. Whether you’re an early bird or prefer working from home most of the time, we trust you to get the job done around our core hours. We have a base expectation of 1 day per month in the office but outside of this, although we have a fantastic office in the heart of Leeds (complete with a rooftop bar for the summer months), the choice is yours!

🏝️ 25 days holiday (+ Bank holidays) continually increasing with service, plus the option to buy up to a week to suit whatever exotic adventures or big life events you have planned for the year ahead

🎂 Birthdays off and a surprise through the letterbox - we love to make a song and dance about every year around the sun!

🤝🏽 Charity leave – giving back is important to us, so we empower all our team members to support charity every year on company time

🧠 Mental healthcare - Face to face counselling support, an app, and an Employee Assistance Program and many colleagues trained in mental health first aid

👩🏾‍⚕️ Healthcare - Cover with Medicash, you get money back when you spend on health appointments e.g. physio, dental, optician, prescriptions, private GP + more

💛 Life cover – a pay-out of 3x your salary to support your beneficiaries if the worst happened

💐 Compassionate leave of up to 5 days time off if you lose a loved one

🤕 Paid sick leave - Enhanced sick pay after 6 months (increasing with service)

🍼 Enhanced family leave - Primary caregivers (maternity/adoption); 16 weeks full pay, 10 weeks half pay & secondary caregivers (paternity); 2 weeks full pay and another 2 weeks full pay to take in your new arrivals first year of life (once you have been with us for 1 year)

💵 Pension - We’re invested in your future, we contribute 3% of your salary to your pension pot, helping you save up for those golden years!
🚙Electric vehicle scheme - Save up to 60% on the cost of an Electric Car

👶Workplace Nursery Scheme - Save up to 41% on nursery fees while accessing a growing network of nursery partners across the UK

🚲Cycle, Tech & Home schemes - Save on home and tech purchases by spreading the cost through interest-free salary deductions, with access to products from leading retailers.

💻 Technology – Rest assured, we'll have a laptop all set up and ready for you on your first day. Additionally, in your first week, we’ll conduct a WFH risk assessment to ensure you have everything you need, including a second screen, keyboard, mouse, and any other goodies!

🐶 Dog friendly office

🎈 Socials – we get together as a full company at least four times per year, plus at least once a quarter in individual teams, too. Not including all the fun activities being planned by our newly formed social committee.

🧩 Discounts on cinema, vouchers, gym memberships, days out and much much more

✨ PLUS a monthly £36 allowance on our flexible benefits platform Radar Rewards to spend on whatever else you might be after (private medical insurance, dental insurance, critical illness cover, or upgrade any of the covers above) with the ability to top up from salary if desired. We’re all different, after all!

Accessibility

If you require any special considerations or adjustments to our application and interviewing process, please don't hesitate to let us know. We understand and celebrate the fact that every person that we connect with is different and therefore requires different starting points on their journey with us. If you have a medical condition or disability we are committed to ensuring that our process is inclusive and accessible for all, let us know how we can best support you.

Connect with us!

We'd love to hear from you! If this role isn't quite right for you but you feel like Radar Healthcare could be, click the Connect button on our careers site and we'll keep you in the loop of new opportunities as they arise. You can also find out more about our mission, values and culture by checking out our various channels:

🎧 Listen to Our What the HealthTech podcast

🔗 Connect with us on Linkedin

💚 Discover why Radar Healthcare is a fantastic place to work from our very own people on Glassdoor!

Connect with us on our journey and get to know the people who make us shine!

title: Solutions Architect IV, Procurement
description:
By living according to a common set of values, we create a culture that unifies, embraces the uniqueness we all bring to the company, and positions Integer for long-term success.

At Integer, our values are embedded in everything we do.

Customer

We focus on our customers’ success

Innovation

We create better solutions

Collaboration

We create success together

Inclusion

We always interact with others respectfully

Candor

We are open and honest with one another

Integrity

We do the right things and do things right




What is Project Symphony?

To advance us further along our journey to excellence at Integer Holdings Corporation, we are launching Symphony, a program that will implement an updated enterprise resource planning (ERP) system and establish enterprise-wide standard processes and structure. This includes ensuring Symphony directly enables the Integer Production System, including elements such as the production monitoring and improvement process, sales, inventory, and operations planning. The program will effect change across the company, which will have a direct impact on optimizing business processes, enhancing operational efficiency, and positioning Integer for continued success. Symphony is about having the right business processes in place supported by a single, modern, integrated ERP platform.

What you’ll do in this role:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Procurement Architect with deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA and Ariba Suite to join our ERP Center of Excellence (CoE). This role will play a pivotal part in the implementation of SAP and provide ongoing support and optimization of the platform post go-live. The ideal candidate will bring strong functional knowledge of Procurement processes, architectural design capabilities, and a strategic mindset to help shape the future of our ERP landscape.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead procurement transformation initiatives using SAP S/4HANA and Ariba suite (Sourcing, Contracts, Buying, Invoicing, Supplier Lifecycle & Performance, and Business Network).
  • Help optimize SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) processes including purchasing, inventory management, invoice verification, and material master data.
  • Manage full-cycle SAP Ariba implementations, ensuring seamless integration with SAP S/4HANA MM.
  • Design and implement procurement workflows aligned with best practices and digital capabilities.
  • Drive vendor onboarding and enablement strategies, ensuring compliance and data integrity.
  • Implement and support VMI and Consignment programs to enhance inventory visibility and supplier collaboration.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful SAP implementation and change management.
  • Provide expert guidance on procurement analytics, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Assist with scoping prospective changes and advising business and ERP/IT leadership.
  • Experience in project cutover, go-live, and hyper-care support.
  • Data Management activities: Data Extraction, Cleansing, Mapping, Migration, and Reconciliation.
  • Ensure solutions adhere to internal controls, SOX compliance, and audit standards.
  • Design and implement seamless integration with other SAP modules and external systems.
  • Maintain documentation of configurations, processes, and change management, using Signavio, SAP Cloud ALM and similar tools.
  • Build trust with Supply Chain leaders and business process owners and share best practices and past experiences that will help with decision making.
  • Collaborative, empathetic, and committed to sharing ideas and knowledge with cross-functional teams, project team members and delivery partners.
  • Support change management and training initiatives to ensure user adoption.
  • Mentor and provide technical leadership to SAP project teams, consultants, and offshore delivery partners.
  • Assess updates in Materials Management, Ariba and related modules and recommend improvements for efficiency and automation.

What sets you apart:

  • Education:
    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Experience:
    • 8+ years of experience in SAP Procurement, with at least 3 years in Ariba Suite and S/4HANA Materials Management architecture and implementation. At least two full-cycle Ariba and S/4HANA implementations in an architect or lead role. Proven experience with SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud.
    • Proven track record in large-scale ERP implementations, preferably in a global environment.
    • Experience with Ariba downstream processes like Guided Buying, Catalog Management, and Invoice Management.
    • Medical Device industry experience is a plus.
  • Skills:
    • Strong understanding of procurement business processes and how they translate into SAP solutions.
    • Strong understanding of Supplier Lifecycle and Performance management processes.
    • Good Understanding of VMI, Consignment and Outside Processing.
    • Strong understanding of Ariba modules: Sourcing, Contracts, Buying & Invoicing, Supplier Lifecycle & Performance, and Business Network.
    • Hands-on experience in configuration of SAP Materials Management for procurement, inventory management, invoice verification, and material master data.
    • Skilled in data extraction, cleansing, mapping, migration, and reconciliation.
    • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
    • Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and evolving environment.
    • Experience with Maquiladora setup is a plus.
    • Experience with SAP Fiori, SimpleMDG, OneSource, WalkMe, OpenText, Cloud ALM, Signavio, Tricentis is a plus.
    • Knowledge of SAP Activate Methodologies in a Plus.
    • Certifications in SAP, preferably in Ariba and Procurement, is a plus.

Travel

  • This position may require 30% or more of your time traveling domestically and internationally to Integer manufacturing sites, customer sites, and supplier sites, as required.
  • As such, you have a current passport and can secure appropriate visas, as required, for travel to international locations as specified.
  • Preference will be given to US Citizens, EAD, and Green Card holders.





Our total rewards program is designed to attract, retain, and motivate associates to contribute to Integer’s success. Our compensation program includes base salary and a cash-based incentive program supporting our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide a comprehensive benefits package with immediate eligibility including medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and adoption benefits. Parental leave is available after one year. Optional employee-paid programs include supplemental life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity and accident insurance. Employees are immediately eligible to participate in the 401(k) plan with company matching contributions. We provide 80 hours (10 days) of company designated holidays per year plus an annual allotment of paid time off.




U.S. Applicants: Equal Opportunity Employer. In addition, veterans and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

title: Lube Tech
description:
Stevenson-Hendrick Toyota JacksonvilleLocation: 3124 New Bern Highway, Jacksonville, North Carolina 28546


Summary: The Lube Technician is responsible for performing express lube duties on vehicles.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This job has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

  • Adheres to express lube guidelines.
  • Performs lube, oil and filter changes by draining and replacing oil and filter, and lubricating all joints, including idler arm steering knuckles, tie rods ends and ball joints.
  • Reports all necessary repairs to service advisor.
  • Installs completed LOF reminder sticker in vehicle.
  • Checks battery, tire air pressure, windshield fluid, transmission fluid and power steering fluid levels and refills as needed.
  • Checks coolant level and refills as necessary.
  • Ensures that vehicle is clean and free of fluid residue or fingerprints.
  • Checks fluid level prior to release of vehicle to ensure proper levels.
  • Maintains CSI at or above Company standards
  • Maintains an organized, clean and safe work area
  • Participates in required training
  • Records all hours worked accurately in company timekeeping system
  • Follows Safeguards rules and regulations.
  • Demonstrates the Company’s Core Values
  • Complies with Company policies and procedures
  • Observes all Federal, State, Local and Company safety rules and regulations in the performance of duties.

title: Datasamordnare – Järnväg och infrastruktur
description:
Vi söker en datasamordnare inom järnväg och infrastruktur till en myndighet inom trafik.

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag. Stationeringsort är Stockholm.

Uppdraget omfattar cirka 80 % av heltid, med möjlighet till utökning.

Uppdraget innebär ett nära samarbete med kunden vilket ställer stora krav på flexibilitet och samarbetsförmåga.

Uppdraget

Vi söker en erfaren datasamordnare till en myndighet inom trafik i Stockholm.

Uppdraget är placerat inom en verksamhet som ansvarar för utveckling och förnyelse av Roslagsbanans och Saltsjöbanans infrastruktur, med projekt inom bland annat elkraft, signalanläggningar, depåer och järnvägsutbyggnad.

Som datasamordnare ansvarar du för CAD- och datasamordning, dokumenthantering samt inventering och utredning av teknisk dokumentation. Du säkerställer att ritningar, modeller och handlingar hanteras enligt gällande processer och håller hög kvalitet.

Arbetet sker främst i Bluebeam, Athena och Avima och omfattar även hantering av befintlig ritningsdokumentation. Erfarenhet av strukturen i SL:s fysiska ritningsarkiv är därför viktig.

Du samarbetar nära projektledare, tekniska specialister och externa projekteringsleverantörer för att säkerställa enhetliga arbetssätt och korrekta dokumentationsleveranser.

Arbetsuppgifter

Ansvara för CAD- och datasamordning samt koordinera digitala och fysiska leveranser av bygghandlingar från projektering till produktion.

Säkerställa att tekniska handlingar och anläggningsdokumentation hanteras enligt gällande processer för dokumenthantering, granskning samt in- och utcheckning.

Samordna leveranser av granskningshandlingar samt inhämta och sammanställa granskningssynpunkter.

Administrera och kvalitetssäkra projektens tekniska dokumentation i Avima enligt fastställd mappstruktur.

Samordna leverans av relationshandlingar samt drift- och underhållsdata till förvaltningsorganisationen.

Administrera och protokollföra datasamordningsmöten samt samordna externa projekteringsleverantörer.

Delta i projektmöten, rapportera till projektledaren och samarbeta med tekniska specialister och övriga projektmedlemmar.

Krav (OBS, obligatoriska)

Du ska ha högskoleexamen omfattande minst 180 högskolepoäng inom samhällsbyggnad, väg och vatten, lantmäteri, farkostteknik, maskinteknik, elektroteknik, datateknik eller annan likvärdig utbildning.

Du ska ha minst 5 års erfarenhet som datasamordnare.

Du ska ha minst 5 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete inom projekteringsprocessen på uppdrag av eller inom en offentlig beställarorganisation.

Du ska ha minst 5 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete inom CAD och/eller BIM, inklusive användning av modelleringsprogram som AutoCAD, MicroStation eller likvärdiga programvaror.

Du ska ha minst 5 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av att administrera eller samordna produktdokumentation i ett eller flera av projektskedena systemhandling, bygghandling och relationshandling.

Du ska ha minst 5 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av hantering av ritningar, modeller, dokument och annan projekteringsrelaterad information.

Meriterande

Du har minst 2 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete med förvaltning av anläggningar eller teknisk dokumentation inom spårbunden trafik.

Du har minst 2 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbete i system för hantering av allmänna handlingar och diarieföring.

Du har minst 2 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av arkivering av teknisk dokumentation, inklusive diarieföring och registrering i rithanteringssystem.

Du har minst 2 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av att upprätta, administrera eller kvalitetssäkra leverabellistor för teknisk dokumentation vid överlämning av projekt.

Personliga egenskaper

Du arbetar systematiskt och strukturerat.

Du är lösningsinriktad, har en öppen inställning till problem och bjuder in till dialog och samverkan.

Du kommunicerar enkelt och tydligt utifrån mottagarens behov och behärskar svenska och engelska flytande i både tal och skrift.

Du har god förmåga att prioritera och hantera flera olika arbetsuppgifter parallellt.

Du har god samarbetsförmåga och skapar samt bevarar goda relationer.

Du är självgående, initiativtagande och hittar alternativa lösningar.

Om oss

Centios övergripande mål är att vara ett konsultbolag som erbjuder smarta och hållbara lösningar som utvecklar samhället på ett positivt sätt.

Våra medarbetare erbjuds villkor som är anpassade för individen. Det innebär att arbetstider, arbetsomfattning, arbetsplats och kompetensutveckling så långt som möjligt anpassas utifrån medarbetarens behov.

Bland våra medarbetare hittar du engagerad personer som brinner för samhällsutveckling. Vi jobbar i små grupper där du kan bidra med dina erfarenheter samtidigt som du får ta del av andras kunskap och erfarenhet.

För oss är det viktigt med välmående och att hitta en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid. Därför har vi en nollvision mot stress och sätter trivsel och hälsa främst.

Läs gärna mer om oss på centio.se.

Vänligen skicka ditt CV på svenska.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Senior System Administrator
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Senior System Engineer is responsible for designing, operating, and continuously improving the organization’s IT infrastructure and system platforms. This role plays a critical part in ensuring the stability, security, and scalability of on-premises and virtualized environments, while supporting day-to-day operations and leading technical improvements in line with the organization’s infrastructure roadmap.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience across virtualization (VMware with future HCI migration), Windows and Linux servers, enterprise storage, backup and recovery (Veeam), middleware platforms, and database systems. In addition to operational excellence, the Senior System Engineer is expected to mentor junior team members, improve standards, and contribute to long-term infrastructure planning.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage and maintain enterprise infrastructure including VMware, servers, storage, and network systems, ensuring high availability, performance, and capacity planning

  • Support HCI initiatives including assessment, design, and migration activities

  • Install, configure, and maintain Windows Server and Linux environments, including Active Directory, group policies, and security configurations

  • Perform system patching, upgrades, and routine maintenance following operational and security best practices

  • Manage IT asset inventory, licenses, and maintain SOPs and operational documentation

  • Operate and maintain backup and recovery using Veeam, including monitoring, restore testing, and supporting DR/BCP and failover activities

  • Provide infrastructure support for IIS, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL, including installation, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and high availability setup

  • Handle incidents, service requests, and support root cause analysis, problem management, and change/release processes

  • Apply security hardening, patching, and support audit and compliance requirements

  • Act as a technical escalation point, mentor team members, and collaborate with cross-functional teams and vendors


JOB SPECIFICATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in system engineering or senior system administration roles.

  • Strong experience with VMware or other virtualization, and enterprise server environments.

  • Practical experience administering Windows Server and Linux systems in production environments.

  • Experience with enterprise storage, backup solutions (preferably Veeam), and disaster recovery operations.

  • Exposure to middleware (IIS) and database platforms such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL.


Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Virtualization: VMware (vSphere, ESXi); exposure to HCI platforms is a strong advantage.

  • Operating Systems: Windows Server, Linux (various distributions).

  • Backup & DR: Veeam Backup & Replication, restore and DR testing procedures.

  • Middleware: IIS, application services hosting concepts.

  • Databases: Infrastructure support for SQL Server and PostgreSQL (preferred).

  • Scripting/Automation: PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent (preferred).

title: Er du social- og sundhedsassistent og uddannet nøgledemensperson – eller har du lyst til at blive det? Så er det lige dig, vi søger
description:
Gudbjerg plejecenter søger pr. 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter en social- og sundhedsassistent til fast dagvagt på 37 timer og med weekendarbejde hver 2. weekend. Vi er fleksible, hvis du har andre ønsker til dit timetal.

Gudbjerg er et lille og hyggeligt plejecenter, som er beliggende midt i Gudbjerg by. Byen er omgivet af naturskønne skove og marker. Vi har 26 boliger fordelt på 7 demensboliger, 16 plejeboliger og 1 ældrebolig.

Vi har et tæt samarbejde med lokalsamfundet. Vi er så heldige, at plejecenteret har 6 venner tilknyttet, som ugentligt kommer, og udfører frivilligt arbejde.

Midt i al herligheden ligger vi kun 10 km. fra Svendborg.

På Gudbjerg Plejecenter er vi særligt stolte over:

  • vores hyggelige hus, som allerede afspejler sig, når man kommer ind i forhallen.
  • at vi er rigtig gode til at tage imod nye kolleger. Vi kan alle huske, hvordan vi som nye medarbejdere havde brug for en grundig introduktion, og værdsatte hvordan vores faglige kompetencer blev inddraget i sektionens arbejde.
  • et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi har fokus på god trivsel, gensidig tillid, er gode til at vidensdele og give hinanden sparring.
  • et tæt samarbejde, hvor vi konstant har fokus på læring og udvikling og har helhed i opgaveløsningen.
  • at vi arbejder med en ordentlighed over for det enkelte menneske, og møder beboerne og deres pårørende med værdighed og empati.
  • at vi arbejder forebyggende og med borgeren i centrum ved hele tiden at indtænke forbedringstiltag.
  • at vi er idrætscertificeret og arbejder kontinuerligt med aktiviteter som styrker kroppen og sindet. Gennem sang og musik og det gode humør styrker vi fællesskabet og det gode ældreliv.

Vi ønsker os en kollega der:

  • har lyst til at dygtiggøre sig i arbejdet med borgere, som har demenssygdomme samt være med til at dygtiggøre sine kolleger inden for demensområdet.
  • har fokus på det gode arbejdsmiljø og bidrager positivt til en aktiv arbejdsdag og samværet med beboerne.
  • vil være med til at arbejde ud fra den nye ældrelov, som trådte i kraft den 1. juli 2025, hvor vi er i fuld gang med at udvikle medarbejdernes kompetencer og selvkoordinerende teams.
  • er god til at deeskalere den svære samtale og inddrage viden, der kan berige til det gode hverdagsliv og borgerens selvbestemmelse.
  • har gode samarbejdsevner med andre faggrupper og glæden ved at løfte i flok.
  • kan udføre de arbejdsopgaver, som ligger inden for assistentens kompetenceområde og i tæt samarbejde med sygeplejersken og assistenter.

Ældreområdet

Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver dør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop det menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd. Vi har ikke en færdig opskrift på det gode ældreliv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Men vi gør os altid umage med at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed. Vi insisterer på at skabe de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt. Vi har også høje forventninger til dig og din faglighed. Du får lov at bruge det, du kan, og arbejde med det, du brænder mest for. Du vil få en synlig leder, du kan sparre med, og dejlige kolleger at dele hverdagen med.

Om Svendborg Kommune

Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordner. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling.

Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden.

Vores værdier findes ikke kun på papiret, vi bruger dem faktisk som kompas hver dag. Vi møder hinanden i øjenhøjde, i dialog og med tillid, og sammen skaber vi en tryg ramme, hvor vi alle kan løse vores opgaver selvstændigt, fleksibelt og ansvarligt.

Løn og ansættelse

Ved spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Anette Sølvberg Møller på telefon 2488 6834.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold efter gældende overenskomst med FOA.

Der skal kunne forevises en privat straffeattest ved ansættelse i stillingen.

Ansøgningsfrist 20.10.2026.

Samtaler afholdes 23.10.2026.

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 36.205 og 46.820 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

title: Erfaren fysioterapeut til Center for Kræftrehabilitering og Palliation
description:
Fysioterapeut med erfaring inden for Kræftrehabilitering og Palliation

Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for borgere, som har kræft inde på livet. Har du lyst til at arbejde med rehabilitering i et tværfagligt miljø? Og har du erfaringen inden for kræft og palliation både fra kommune og sygehus. Så er du måske vores nye fysioterapeut i Center for Kræftrehabilitering og Palliation i Odense Kommune.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en fysioterapeut på 37 timer ugentligt til vores tværfaglige team i Center for Kræftrehabilitering og Palliation. Det er et krav at du har erfaringen inden for kræftrehabilitering og palliation fra kommunen og sygehuset. Stillingen er selvtilrettelæggende.

Centeret tilbyder rehabiliterings- og palliative forløb før, under og efter kræftbehandling til borgere over 18 år. Borgernes behov og funktionsniveau varierer betydeligt og afhænger blandt andet af sygdomsforløb, behandling og livssituation. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor du varetager opgaver inden for patientrettet forebyggelse og genoptræning.

Din hverdag vil være præget af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, tæt tværfagligt samarbejde og fokus på at skabe de bedst mulige forløb for den enkelte borger. Du bliver en del af et engageret team bestående af 11 medarbejdere: 3 sygeplejersker, 5 fysioterapeuter, 2 ergoterapeuter og 1 klinisk diætist. Vi lærer af hinanden, spiller hinanden gode og ser vores forskellige fagligheder som en styrke.

Din hverdag

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Afholdelse af afklarende samtaler, både mono- og tværfagligt.

  • Individuel og gruppebaseret genoptræning til borgere, der har eller har haft kræft.

  • Planlægning, gennemførelse og evaluering af træningsforløb med fokus på funktionsevne, mestring og livskvalitet.

  • Arbejde med udgangspunkt i Sundhedslovens § 119, § 140, Serviceloven § 86 stk. 1 og Ældreloven § 9 samt Sundhedsstyrelsens anbefalinger for kræftrehabilitering og palliation.

  • Rådgivning og vejledning af borgere og pårørende.

  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af undervisningstilbud til borgere med kræft.

  • Bidrage til udvikling, kvalitetssikring og tværfaglig koordinering af centerets indsatser.

  • Tværsektorielt samarbejde og faglig sparring med OUH og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

  • Dokumentation i Nexus

Du får naturligvis et individuelt introduktionsforløb og tilknyttes en mentor, som sikrer, at du kommer godt fra start i stillingen.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er uddannet fysioterapeut og har dansk autorisation.

  • Har erfaring med rehabilitering af borgere med kræft og palliative problemstillinger både fra sygehus og kommune.

  • Har erfaring med holdtræning.

  • Har en funktionel og borgercentreret tilgang til træning og rehabilitering.

  • Trives i arbejdet med borgere i sårbare og komplekse livssituationer.

  • Har stærke relationelle kompetencer og formår at skabe tillid og tryghed.

  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og trives i tværfaglige fællesskaber.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og reflekteret.

  • Har lyst til faglig udvikling og holder dig opdateret på ny viden.

  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for undervisning og formidling.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et meningsfuldt arbejde i Center for Kræftrehabilitering og Palliation.

  • Et stærkt tværfagligt arbejdsmiljø med høj faglighed.

  • Gode muligheder for faglig sparring og kompetenceudvikling.

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, udvikling og trivsel.

  • Faglig og personlig udvikling.

  • Grundig introduktion til arbejdsopgaver og organisation.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi griner sammen, hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt med forventet tiltrædelse den 1. januar 2027.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst mellem KL og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte rehabiliteringsleder Sara Neto på telefon 21 28 06 79 eller fysioterapeut Gry Kobberø på telefon 40 49 97 12.

Ansøgningsfrist

Ansøgningsfristen er torsdag den 29. oktober 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler onsdag den 4. november 2026.

title: Senior Vice President - Post-Trade Systems - Applications – IT
description:
Company Introduction:

We’re home to Asia's most dynamic and vibrant capital markets.
Connecting capital, ideas, inspiration and innovation for deeper, more diverse and liquid global capital markets; providing greater choice and opportunity for our customers, each and every day.

HKEX is a purpose-driven company. Our commitment to the long-term development of our business and our markets is articulated in our purpose: "To Connect, Promote and Progress our Markets and the Communities they support for the prosperity of all."

Job Summary:

The Information Technology Division is responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of HKEX market systems and IT infrastructure.

Job Duties:

The incumbent will work in the area of Development & Support for HKEX post trade application systems, and lead a team responsible for the related architecture design, development, implementation and production support, as well as work across related business and operations stakeholders achieving common business results.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage all phases of application road map, architecture design and life cycle for post-trade application systems, and carry out review of associated deliverables and evolution in adherence to standards and policies

  • Set, interpret and drive strategic direction, and deliver technology that meets post trade business requirements

  • Plan, review and implement system development and technical delivery through requirement definition with key business stakeholders, collaboration with other application teams and infrastructure team on common system and architecture impact, as well as exercise vendor management where appropriate

  • Oversee production support for core mission critical systems to attain robust system availability

  • Foster continuous technology advancement and development of the department, as well as lead people management agenda including performance management and development

  • Undertake assignments and projects as assigned by department head

Requirements:

  • Degree in Computer Science, MIS, IT or related disciplines

  • At least over 15 years’ relevant experience, of which at least 10 years at management level

  • Strong leadership skills and capabilities in managing complex IT agenda across diverse stakeholders from senior IT leaders, specialist, to business and operations leaders

  • Ability to define solutions that solve complex business problems

  • Solid experience in managing and developing large scale mission critical systems on open platform

  • Knowledge of industry-wide technology strategies and best practices

  • Knowledge of risk and controls landscape, ensuring company-wide standards are met

  • Keen understanding of project control and budget management

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, managerial and people management skills

  • Experienced in motivating large organization and teams

HKEX is committed as an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity is one of our core values and we look to support, respect diverse perspectives, abilities, culture and experiences within our workplace

description:

title: Tomma vägar och fria helger  CE-chaufför natt, Jönköping
description:

Gillar du att köra när vägarna är tomma? Nu söker vi en CE-chaufför till vår kund på Torsvik i Jönköping, ett av Sveriges viktigaste logistiknav.

Om uppdraget

Du kör stand by-körningar mellan vår kunds terminaler och ser till att gods kommer fram i tid. Det är inga distributionsrundor med många stopp, utan rena linjekörningar från terminal till terminal. Du blir en viktig del av flödet som varje natt håller Sverige i rörelse.

  • Måndag till torsdag, så du är ledig från fredag morgon
  • Start i november

Vår kund är en stor och väletablerad aktör inom logistik med verksamhet i hela Norden. De satsar på hållbara transporter och ett tryggt arbetsklimat. Torsvik ligger mitt i Sveriges logistiska hjärta, med vägar åt alla håll.

Vi söker dig som

  • har CE-körkort, giltigt YKB och digitalt förarkort
  • har erfarenhet av tung trafik (meriterande)
  • är ansvarstagande, noggrann och trivs med att jobba självständigt
  • har bra säkerhetstänk i trafiken och på terminalen

Vi erbjuder

  • fasta nattider med långhelg varje vecka
  • ett stabilt uppdrag hos en av de största aktörerna inom logistik
  • en kontaktperson hos Simplex Bemanning som finns på plats och följer upp hur det går för dig

Ort: Torsvik, Jönköping

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Om oss:

Vi är Simplex — ett bemanningsföretag som skapar möjligheter. Varje år hjälper vi över 2 500 personer vidare i karriären genom att matcha rätt person med rätt arbetsplats, inom logistik, transport, återvinning, industri, produktion och andra branscher.

Vi är ett av Sveriges 20 största bemanningsföretag och rankas topp 14 bland landets Blue Collar-specialister. Men det som driver oss är inte listplaceringar — det är att se människor växa och företag utvecklas.

Hos oss möts du av engagerade konsultchefer som finns nära dig genom hela din resa. Vi jobbar med några av Sveriges vassaste företag, och genom oss öppnas dörrar till uppdrag och arbetsplatser du annars inte hade haft tillgång till.

Är du redo för nästa steg i karriären? Vi ser fram emot att arbeta tillsammans med dig.

title: Retail key holder
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Key Holder, better known as a “Floor Leader,” at Skechers, you’ll take on an essential Retail Leadership Role, contributing to store operations and mentoring your team to deliver exceptional customer service. In this entry-level management role, you’ll oversee daily operations, support sales goals, and help maintain the store's premium shopping environment. Whether you're looking to advance your Retail Manager career, refine your skills as a Key Holder, or grow into a Retail Management role, this opportunity offers room to thrive within the Skechers global brand.

COMPENSATION RATE

STARTING RATE: $16.38


BENEFIT HIGHLIGHTS:

  • Competitive pay with regular increases.
  • Generous discounts on Skechers footwear, apparel, and accessories (including exclusive Friends and Family discounts!).
  • Flexible schedules to support work-life balance.
  • On-the-job training to strengthen skills in Retail Leadership Roles, Customer Service Management, and store operations.
  • Opportunities for career advancement in Retail Management with a global brand like Skechers.
  • Additional Benefits & Perks to be reviewed during the interview process.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Customer Service Management: Engage with customers to deliver expert advice on Skechers products, ensuring every shopper leaves with the perfect fit and great experience.
  • Retail Leadership Role: Supervise daily operations, including store opening and closing procedures as required, ensuring security protocols and excellent operational standards.
  • Team Leadership: Mentor and support team members to grow their skills in entry-level retail that include customer service, sales, and daily operations.
  • Sales and Goals: Actively contribute to achieving store and individual sales targets by implementing effective selling techniques and promoting key Skechers products.
  • Store Operations: Execute merchandising plans, restock products, and maintain store cleanliness to enhance the shopping environment.
  • Retail Supervisor Duties: Oversee stock and inventory routines while collaborating with store management to address operational needs.
  • Problem Solving: Proactively identify and resolve in-store challenges to ensure a smooth shopping experience for customers.

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU:

  • Ability to work a varied schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Problem solving skills to resolve any issues that may arise in-store.
  • Highly organized to manage inventory, staffing, and other operational tasks.
  • Ability and desire to foster a respectful, safe, and fun environment for Skechers store employees.
  • Comfortable mentoring team members and communicating with all levels of the store team.
  • Acts with a sense of confidentiality and urgency.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.
  • Previous experience as a Key Holder, Shift Leader, or Retail Supervisor in retail, restaurant, or hospitality industry is preferred but not required.
  • Sales skills to drive revenue growth and meet targets.
  • Excellent communication skills in written, verbal and interpersonal skills.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age at time of application.

Step into your next retail career with Skechers!

About Skechers

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.


Equal Employment Opportunity
Skechers is committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and respectful work environment. Skechers provides equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment without regard race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic established by local, state or federal law.


Reasonable Accommodation
Applicants for employment who require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job should request appropriate accommodation by emailing benefits@skechers.com.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each job responsibility satisfactorily. The skills, abilities and physical demands described are representative of those duties that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities, who are otherwise qualified for the job position, to perform the essential functions.

title: Client Service Onboarding Representative, Senior Associate (m/f/n)
description:
Who we are looking for

We welcome applications from highly motivated candidates for the position of Client Service Onboarding Representative. In this role, you will report to the Client Service Team Lead and contribute to the continued success of our globally expanding bank. If you are eager to take ownership of your responsibilities, collaborate within a multicultural team, develop effective solutions, and pursue professional growth in a dynamic global organization, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Why this role is important to us

You will be joining the Investment Services function that allows us to deliver a comprehensive, holistic approach to each client relationship — for asset managers and asset owners, insurance companies, and official institutions globally. It means our client-facing functions work together to bring the very best solutions and services the firm has to offer — across all of our locations, products, and capabilities.

Join us if making your mark on the long-lasting client relationships we build is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for

As a Client Service Representative you will responsible for:

  • Collaboration and coordination in relation to account openings for the Bank’s branches
  • Building strong partnerships with the Bank’s specialist departments at both global and local levels
  • Cultivating trusted client relationships through proactive and professional engagement

  • Driving the successful coordination of new launches across local and international markets
  • Contributing to a collaborative team environment by actively supporting colleagues in day-to-day operations
  • Playing an active role in project initiatives and contributing to their successful delivery

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  • A strong service orientation and a keen interest in direct client interaction
  • A proactive approach, the ability to perform effectively under pressure, and an independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style
  • The ability to quickly grasp complex matters, combined with flexibility, strong teamwork, and effective communication skills
  • An independent and responsible approach to work

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Completed banking apprenticeship or a comparable commercial qualification
  • Sound knowledge of securities and investment fund operations
  • Fluency in German and a very good command of English
  • Excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook

About State Street


Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: Svejser til MAG, MIG og MMA i Aarhus N
description:
Vil du have firmabil, bonusordning og et sted hvor det skal være sjovt?

Vi mangler en svejser til erhvervsopgaver i Aarhus N.

Du bliver en del af et større hold, hvor opgaverne ligger på erhvervssiden. Arbejdet foregår i Aarhus N og omegn, og du har firmabil til hverdagen. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men lander ikke et sted hvor du bare bliver sendt ud uden nogen omkring dig.

Rollen passer til dig, der kan tage ansvar for dine svejsninger og holde tempo uden at gå på kompromis med arbejdet. Her er der bonusordning, godt socialt sammenhold og et klart motto: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Det får du

Løn: 190-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Aarhus N og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Svejsning, erhvervsopgaver og selvstændigt arbejde

Din hverdag

Din dag er bygget op omkring svejseopgaver, hvor du selv tager fat på det der ligger foran dig. Firmabilen gør det nemt at komme ud til opgaverne, og du skal kunne arbejde roligt videre, også når du står med ansvaret selv.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • MAG, MIG og MMA-svejsning
  • Svejsning i sort stål eller rustfrit
  • Svejsning efter tegning eller WPS
  • Tilpasning og klargøring før svejsning
  • Kontrol af egne svejsninger før aflevering

Mottoet her er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Det betyder også, at du skal kunne tage din del af ansvaret og samtidig være en ordentlig kollega.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Vi forventer ikke at du har lavet det hele før. Men du skal kunne se en opgave og tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring som svejser
  • Har prøvet MAG, MIG eller MMA-svejsning før
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt uden at miste overblikket
  • Møder stabilt og holder dine aftaler
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra erhvervsopgaver. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan svejse ordentligt og tage ansvar for det du afleverer.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: Laborant til daghold i miljølaboratorium
description:
Eurofins Miljø A/S er et af Danmarks førende miljølaboratorier. Vi specialiserer os i kemiske og mikrobiologiske analyser af vand, jord og luft, og vi håndterer hele processen fra planlægning og prøvetagning til analyser og evaluering af resultater.

Vores metalafdeling fungerer som nationalt kompetencecenter og udfører analyser af metaller og mineraler i forskellige prøvetyper, herunder jord, bygningsaffald, slam, fødevarer og meget mere. Afdelingen analyserer årligt omkring 400.000 prøver.

Jobbeskrivelse

Vi søger en engageret laborant til vores daghold i Metalafdelingen. Arbejdstiden er efter aftale, fordelt i tidsrummet mellem kl. 06.00 – 18.00.

Som laborant vil du være involveret i hele processen fra modtagelse af prøver til færdige analyseresultater. Dine primære opgaver vil omfatte håndtering af prøver på ICP-OES, CV-AAS og ICP-MS apparater.

Kvalifikationer

  • Du har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund som laborant eller tilsvarende samt besidder solide faglife kompetencer indenfor laboratoriearbejde.

  • Du har forståelse for prøveforberedelse, analysemetoder og databehandling.

  • Du kan arbejde i overensstemmelse med gældende metodeforskrifter, kvalitetskrav og sikkerhedsprocedurer.

  • Du evner at arbejde sytematisk, struktureret og bevare overblikket i travle perioder.

  • Du har gode samarbejdsevner og en positiv indstilling

  • Evne til at bevare overblikket i travle perioder

Arbejdet kræver både stående og gående aktiviteter, så fysisk mobilitet er vigtig.

Yderligere oplysninger

Det betyder meget for os, at du har det godt på dit arbejde

Sundhedsfremmende initiativer
Vi fremmer et sundt og arbejdsmiljøvenligt klima, og medvirker til, at vores medarbejdere er sunde og raske. Det sker igennem forskellige initiativer som støtter op om din psykiske og fysiske trivsel.

Tryghedsordning
Du tilbydes som Eurofins medarbejder en pensionsordning, sundhedsforsikring samt tilknyttet uvildige rådgivere, som løbende kan guide dig.

Kantineordning
Vores kantineordning byder på et varieret udvalg af varme og kolde retter, frugt og grønt - og kage :-)

Personaleforening
Vi ønsker at fremme det gode kollegaskab og arrangerer forskellige sociale aktiviteter og arrangementer, med hjælp fra vores lokale personaleforening.

Fleksibilitet
Vi arbejder ud fra præmissen frihed under ansvar og tilbyder derfor fleksible mødetider med mulighed for hjemmearbejde og medbestemmelse, såfremt stillingen understøtter dette.

Din udvikling
Din udvikling er vigtig for os. Du vil i samarbejde med din nærmeste leder drøfte Eurofins karriereveje, nationale og internationale talentprogrammer og anden udvikling.

#TestingForLife

Arbejdstid
37 timer fordelt på 5 ugedage.
Du vil desuden indgå i vores lørdags-turnus, hvor man arbejder lørdag ca. hver 8. uge, og holder tilsvarende fri i ugen før eller efter.

Arbejdssted
Ladelundvej 85, 6600 Vejen

Tiltrædelse
Efter aftale


Interesseret?

Du søger stillingen online ved at klikke på "Jeg er interesseret". Vi afholder løbende samtaler og ansætter så snart, den rette kandidat er fundet og vi opfordrer derfor til, at du sender dit CV og evt. relevante bilag hurtigst muligt. Under ”Besked til ansættelsesteamet” modtager vi meget gerne en kort motivation for din ansøgning.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte PBU Manager Amira Itani på mail Amira.Itani@etn.eurofins.com

Udvælges du som en af de kandidater, vi ønsker at invitere med i rekrutteringsprocessen, vil du modtage et link til en kort videobesvarelse af nogle spørgsmål forud for en eventuel samtale.

I forbindelse med rekrutteringen, vi du blive bedt om at fremvise straffeattest.

Vi glæder os til at byde vores nye kollega velkommen!

#TestingForLife

Eurofins Scientific er en international life science virksomhed, som tilbyder et unikt udvalg af analyser til kunder inden for mange forskellige industrier, med det formål at gøre livet og vores miljø mere sikkert, sundere og mere bæredygtigt. Fra den mad du spiser, til vandet du drikker, til medicinen du anvender, arbejder Eurofins sammen med de største virksomheder i verden, for at understøtte, at de produkter virksomhederne udbyder er sikre, deres ingredienser er autentiske og at mærkningen på produkterne er korrekte. Eurofins er verdensledende inden for test af fødevarer, miljø, farmaceutiske og kosmetiske produkter, samt agro-science CRO services. Eurofins er ydermere en af de globale markedsledere inden for specifikke test og laboratorieservices inden for genomics, farmakologi, retsmedicin, CDMO, avanceret materialevidenskab, samt support til kliniske studier.

På lidt mere end 30 år er Eurofins vokset fra at været et enkelt laboratorium i Nantes i Frankrig, til at bestå af 65.000 medarbejdere i et netværk af mere end 1000 selvstændige selskaber og over 950 laboratorier i 57 lande. Eurofins tilbyder en portefølje af mere end 200.000 analytiske metoder, til at evaluere sikkerhed, identitet, sammensætning, ægthed, oprindelse, sporbarhed og renhed af biologiske stoffer og produkter. Som en af de førende spillere inden for specialiseret klinisk diagnostisk test, tilbyder vi endvidere vi innovative klinisk diagnostiske testydelser.

I 2025 genererede Eurofins en samlet indtægt på 7,296 milliarder Euro og er i blandt de aktier, som har performet bedst i Europa over de sidste 20 år.

title: Assistant Manager, IT Infrastructure (Operations & Compliance)
company: Hong Kong Internet Registration Corporation Limited
description:
Hong Kong Internet Registration Corporation Limited (HKIRC), a non-profit making and non-statutory corporation responsible for the overall administration of “.hk” domain names in Hong Kong. HKIRC is also responsible for the on-going liaison with local and international bodies on issues relating to the development and administration of Internet domain name systems. We are looking for highly motivated and independent candidates for the position of:

Responsibilities:

Mainly to oversee the daily operations of the IT team (infrastructure, project, and IT operations), ensuring high system availability, robust change management compliance, and strict operational discipline. This role acts as the critical gatekeeper to monitor day-to-day infrastructure activities, audit system logs, and ensure 100% transparency in incident reporting and cross-team communication.

Infrastructure Management -

  • Enforce strict adherence to ITIL frameworks, Change Management processes, and internal SOPs. Continuously monitor and audit team members’ daily infrastructure activities, server/service modifications, and configuration changes to prevent unauthorized updates or undocumented workarounds.

  • Implement and execute dual-verification mechanisms for critical infrastructure interventions, including manual service restarts, critical patch applications, or database/network configuration rollbacks.

  • Coordinate the IT infrastructure team project execution and other IT matters.

  • Support any Emergency operation support for data centre & BAU operation, even at non-office hours/PH.

Management and Support -

  • Support IT Manager in team supervision, service quality, staff coaching and daily operations.

  • Review and maintain IT policies, documents, technical and operation procedures, IT asset records to achieve ITSM requirements, security requirement in place for all IT Infrastructure and data centre operation.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for external technical teams (e.g., Application, DevOps, Cyber Security, external support vendors…etc) to resolve infrastructure-related disputes with clear, data-backed evidence.

  • Supervise the team’s incident response and escalation workflow. Lead technical Root cause Analysis (RCA) based on objective log data, data centre records, and system facts, delivering, transparent post-mortem reports to management and affected stakeholders.

  • Ensure rapid resolution of IT issues.

  • Provide quick response and quick decision making.

  • Monitoring and maintenance PROD & DR environment, to ensure business continuity.

  • Degree holder in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information System or related disciplines.

  • Strong Hands-on experience in server-side administration, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux, enterprise backup solutions, and awareness training.

  • Strong familiarity with ITIL processes (Change Management, Incident Management), including IR, Security monitoring, Endpoint protection, patch/asset management and security risk / audit process is preferred.

  • Strong problem-solving with ability to think strategically, and excellent analytical mindset with a zero-tolerance approach to ambiguous communication, problem-hiding, or opaque operational ethics.

  • Extensive knowledge and certification holder in IT Security, ISO27001 and/or ITIL/ITMS is preferred.

  • Proficiency in both written and spoken English, Cantonese and Mandarin.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.

Attractive remuneration and fringe benefits will be offered to the right candidates. Interested parties please send Resume with Expected Salary (a must) to the HR and Administration Manager at Unit 501, Level 5, Core C, Cyberport 3, 100 Cyberport Road, Hong Kong or by clicking "Apply Now".

title: Thermal Analyst III, CFD - Lunar Permanence
description:

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.

This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. In this role you will contribute to a team of Thermal Engineers simultaneously developing groundbreaking thermal hardware for lunar landers and driving those designs through build, test, and verification. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

title: Product Operations Associate
description:
Please note:
This job opening is for SkyCrunch, a sister company of FORMULATRIX. Please review the details below before submitting your application.


About

SkyCrunch (SkyCrunch.com) builds trip-planning and cost-intelligence software for business aviation. When flight crews plans a route, they need to know what fuel and ground handling will cost at each possible stop. This information is scattered across hundreds of fuel suppliers and FBOs (Fixed Base Operators, the companies that handle aircraft on the ground), most of whom still quote by email. We aggregate this information, normalize it, and put it on a map so an operator can compare stops in seconds instead of hours.

We're a small team moving at a fast pace. What we need now is someone to own the layer between the aviation world and the software: getting the pricing data in, understanding what it actually means, and turning that understanding into things we can build.

Responsibilities

  • Research and gather pricing, fee, and service data from FBOs and fuel suppliers through web data extraction, public sources, and direct email outreach.

  • Communicate with FBOs, fuel providers, and pilots to turn confusing fee schedules into rules the software can encode.

  • Learn how the aviation fuel business works, e.g. how contracts are priced, why the same gallon costs different amounts, and what a handling fee actually covers.

  • Use AI tools to build small internal tools, clean up messy data, and prototype ideas, with technical guidance from the team.

  • Write clear specifications and test cases that others can build from and verify.

  • Run tests periodically and document results properly.

  • Support outbound communication with partners and prospects.

Requirements

  • Any major welcome - we focus on what you can actually do.

  • Strong written and spoken English; you'll be communicating with an English-speaking team.

  • Confidence working with data and structure. You should be comfortable using spreadsheets and have tinkered with Excel or automation tools before.

  • A habit of asking why; noticing when something (like a fee schedule) contradicts itself and following up until it makes sense.

  • A basic understanding of UI design principles.

  • Willingness to work on-site in Bandung, West Java.

Nice to Have

  • A genuine interest in aviation (flight sim, avgeek, aviation photography, or industry background).

  • Experience writing documentation, specifications, or test cases for others to follow.

  • Familiarity with AI tools beyond casual chat use; deliberate prompting, building something real with them.

Why This Job

  • High ownership and real influence on product and technical direction.

  • A fast-growth startup environment: small team, fast feedback, direct collaboration with leadership.

  • Opportunities to grow into a broader technical leadership role as the company scales.

  • Flexible working hours.

title: Advanced Computational Cognitive Scientist
description:
Job Summary

Looking for a role that challenges you while making an impact on products people use every day? We are looking for an experienced Advanced Computational Cognitive Scientist to drive R&D cognitive research within R&D and the Scent Business Unit.

IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Scent: Harnessing the full emotional power of scent, driven by pioneering creativity, science, consumer expertise and a mindful approach to fragrance design.​

The role is based in Shanghai (anchor role), China. This position sits within R&D, Cognitive Science team, as part of the R&D Scent New Frontiers Group. We are a vibrant research group with a mission to establish IFF as the leader in Cognitive Science applied to fragrance innovation through integrated Sensory, Consumer & Neuroscience methods & technologies.

Where You’ll Make a Difference

  • Define and implement data management and analytical strategy tailored for the cognitive science team
  • Training researchers within the cognitive science team on the implementation of advanced analytical methods
  • Building cutting-edge data science methods and tools in close collaboration with programs leaders
  • Ensure all aspects of human research are in full compliance with best practices for data collection, storage, processing, analytics, visualization, interpretation and cloud-based data sharing
  • Ensuring standards of data quality that adhere to strict scientific principles, ethical policies and follow IFF safety standards and data security
  • Identify and implement methods to automate end-to-end data flows

What Makes You the Right Fit

  • Master’s or PhD in a field related to cognitive science.
  • Strong experience with handling and integrating explicit and implicit sensory, consumer and neuroscience data
  • A proven record of applying advanced data analytical methods and computer programming in the context of perceptual research
  • Ability to work independently within a broadly defined technical area, aligning strategic priorities with assigned project activities.
  • Strong strategic thinking and communication skills with demonstrated ability to apply methods across a diverse array of applications
  • Demonstrated track record of operating as a data scientist at the interface of all three domains (sensory, consumer, and neuroscience)
  • Demonstrated aptitude at delivering data science solutions, either directly or in partnership with data scientists and engineers
  • Strong team player with influencing skills
  • Strong written and presentation communication skills; Must be able to effectively communicate findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences as well as senior leaders
  • Ability to publish research in peer-reviewed journals

How Would You Stand Out?

  • Experience in the fragrance industry
  • Experience combining sensory, consumer, and neuroscience data with related data streams for big data powered analytics and modeling
  • Demonstration of advanced competency in data science, including advanced statistics, AI-based modeling and programing experience, i.e., Python, R, SQL, MATLAB, in the context of cognitive science
  • Experience with data management, including incorporation of modern infrastructure such as AWS, Azure, and Snowflake

Why Choose Us?

  • Join a creative, collaborative environment that encourages innovation and personal growth.
  • The role offers opportunities to expand expertise across regions and categories, work with global clients, contribute to worldwide initiatives, and receive competitive compensation and benefits packages, including performance incentives.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.
