title: Drill Press Supervisor
description:
Position Summary:

The basic function of the Drill Press Department Supervisor is to supervise and coordinate the activities of workers engaged in operating a variety of industrial machines so that GMM may produce under the optimum conditions of productivity, efficiency, cost effectiveness and ease of operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following: Other duties may be assigned.

  • Work with the team leaders/working supervisors to coordinate dispatch lists and routing of work assignments within the department.

title: Genopslag - Pædagog søges til Børn- og Ungehjem Nordkraft
description:
Er du typen, der hellere tager en fodbold med under armen end sætter dig bag et skrivebord? Tror du på, at stærke relationer skabes gennem fælles oplevelser, aktivitet og nærvær? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores team på Nordkraft.

Vi søger først og fremmest den rette person. En pædagogisk uddannelse er en fordel, men erfaring, personlighed og andre relevante kompetencer kan være mindst lige så værdifulde. Som en del af teamet omkring seks anbragte unge i alderen 12-18 år får du en aktiv rolle i at skabe trivsel, relationer og udvikling. Vi søger en voksen, der ikke blot vil støtte de unge, men også har lyst til at deltage i aktiviteter, leg og bevægelse sammen med dem og være med til at skabe en aktiv hverdag.

Bevægelse som vej til udvikling

På Nordkraft arbejder vi bevidst med at skabe en hverdag, hvor de unge får positive oplevelser. Mange af vores unge har brug for støtte til at komme i gang, finde motivationen og opleve glæde.

Vi søger en pædagog, der har lyst til at være medspilleren frem for tilskuer. Det kan være gennem aktiviteter i huset, fx brætspil, pool, bordfodbold eller i haven, hvor vi har bål, fodbold, volleyball og andre spil. Vi har cykler til rådighed og bor tæt ved fjorden, Lille Vildmose og marker omkring os. Aktivitet kan også være madlavning, bage kager, lave perler, tegne/male eller oplevelser ud af huset.

Du behøver ikke være eliteudøver i nogen form for sport, madlavning eller kreative aktiviteter. Det vigtigste er, at du har energi, engagement og lyst til selv at deltage og til at være primus motor for, at det sker.

Et lille Børn- og Ungehjem med stærke relationer

Nordkraft er normeret til seks unge, hvilket giver mulighed for at arbejde tæt på den enkelte. Vi tror på, at udvikling sker gennem trygge relationer, tydelige voksne og en hverdag med nærvær. Du kan læse mere om målgruppen på vores hjemmeside.

Hos os bliver du en del af en personalegruppe, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, sparrer fagligt og værner om et godt arbejdsmiljø.

Vi tilbyder

  • en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og stor fleksibilitet

  • synlig og nærværende ledelse

  • mulighed for faglig udvikling og kompetenceudvikling

  • intern oplæring og uddannelse i KRAP

  • kollegaer med humor, engagement og lyst til samarbejde

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • er uddannet pædagog eller har en anden til formålet uddannelse og/eller erfaring med målgruppen

  • er tydelig, omsorgsfuld og stærk til relationsarbejde

  • kan motivere unge til deltagelse og fællesskab

  • trives i en aktiv og omskiftelig hverdag

  • ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger

  • har lyst til at være fysisk aktiv sammen med de unge

Arbejdstid

  • Fuldtidsstilling

  • Hverdagsdøgn med overnatning

  • Arbejde hver tredje weekend

  • Opholdsstedet er åbent 365 dage om året

Praktisk information

Ansøgninger behandles efter opslagets udløb 28.10.2026

Arbejdssted:
Børn- og Ungehjem Nordkraft
Vester Fjordvej 3
9280 Storvorde

Send din ansøgning til: ansoegninger@opholdsstedet-nordkraft.dk

title: Senior Network Engineer (Shopee)
description:
The Operation teams at Shopee covers the operational end-to-end process, from when the buyer searches for a product listed on the Shopee platform, to the moment the buyer receives the products. The team analyses and monitors operational KPIs across the region and conducts root cause analysis when operation performance fluctuates. The Operations team comprises Customer Service, Payment, Listings, Warehouse, Logistics, Seller Operations and Fraud.

About the Team:

Corporate IT is the backbone of our business. Our team helps the company to develop a competitive advantage through defining our technology objectives, assessing solution options, and devising technical solutions that help us achieve both strategic goals and meet operational requirements. As a part of our team, you’ll help deliver seamless IT experiences and support to our internal employees by providing responsive helpdesk service, stable networks and reliable IT systems.

As a Network Engineer, you will be responsible for corporate network design and governance, implementation of various technical solutions to meet corporate requirements, and providing technical support in a fast-paced and demanding environment.

Job Description:

  • Design, configure, and maintain core/distribution/access switching infrastructure across all sites
  • Support and troubleshoot connectivity between the SD-WAN gateway and local gateway routing to ensure stable site-to-site connectivity
  • Manage and optimize routing and VLAN segmentation for multi-site connectivity
  • Administer firewalls and network security controls to protect enterprise infrastructure
  • Design, deploy, and troubleshoot enterprise wireless infrastructure (WLCs and APs), including coverage planning and RF optimization for warehouse and office environments
  • Contribute to infrastructure design for server rooms, including rack layout, UPS systems, and fiber/LAN cabling standards
  • Support CCTV network design and integration
  • Perform incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), and recovery planning for network-related incidents
  • Review vendor quotations, technical specifications, and implementation plans for network infrastructure projects
  • Collaborate with vendors, regional teams, and business stakeholders on project implementation and technical governance
  • Support monitoring and operational visibility efforts using tools such as Zabbix, Grafana, and Elastic to proactively detect and resolve issues
  • Maintain documentation for network architecture, configurations, and standard operating procedures
  • Participate in on-call rotation and provide escalation support for critical incident

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field
  • Active CCNP (Enterprise, Security, or Routing & Switching) or equivalent vendor certification (e.g., PCNSE, NSE 4-7, HCIP)
  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise network engineering, with hands-on experience across switching, routing, firewalls, and wireless technologies
  • Proven hands-on experience configuring and managing multi-vendor network and security platforms, including Cisco, Huawei, Meraki, Palo Alto, or Fortinet
  • Strong knowledge of VLAN design, network segmentation strategies, and network security best practices
  • Experience with enterprise wireless platforms (WLC and AP deployment, RF planning, heatmap design)
  • Practical exposure to server room, MDF, and IDF infrastructure design, including structured cabling standards, racking layouts, UPS sizing, and cooling requirements
  • Prior experience supporting multi-site environments or networks in warehouse, logistics, or high-density retail environments is highly preferred
  • Working knowledge of monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Grafana, or Elastic
  • Ability to define alerting thresholds, escalation rules, standby procedures, and on-call runbooks for critical services and events
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills for complex network issues
  • Effective communication skills for coordinating with vendors, regional teams, and business stakeholders
  • Ability to work under pressure with flexible working hours
  • Ability to work onsite with occasional travel required
  • Must have a valid driving license; owning a car is preferred

description:

Who are we?

Integer is a global organization providing innovative, high-quality technologies and manufacturing to Medical Device OEM’s (original equipment manufacturers) to enhance the lives of patients worldwide and a provider of high-end niche batteries for specialized applications in the energy, military, and environmental markets. We are guided by our six Values, including focus on Customers, Innovation, Collaboration, Inclusion, Candor, and Integrity. Working at Integer means you are part of a team passionately pursuing excellence in all that we do and always reaching for the next great achievement.


What you’ll do in this role:

The primary purpose of this position is to perform work which involves general engineering methods and tools. As an entry level engineer, you will ensure that Integer’s internal and external customer expectations are met or exceeded with the direction, instruction and guidance from more experienced engineers and managers in your organization.

  • You adhere to Integer’s Values and all safety, environmental, security and quality requirements including, but not limited to: Quality Management Systems (QMS), Safety, Environmental and Security Management Systems, U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations, company policies and operating procedures, and other regulatory requirements.

  • You will participate in projects that require you to investigate, develop, document and implement new product and process technologies of moderate complexity and scope.
  • You will perform work on technical projects where you will follow Integer’s standard quality management and production system methodologies to investigate opportunities for product and process improvements.
  • You will apply standard data analysis practices and techniques to establish root cause for product and process failures or to support the justification for improvements to products and processes.
  • You will be required to observe products and processes to recognize discrepancies in results and follow operations throughout a series of detailed steps or processes to establish root cause of the discrepancies.
  • You are expected to collaborate with others in the exchange of information, ask questions and regularly check for understanding in support of your development as an engineer.
  • You embed Quality within the Engineering discipline – “I own Quality.” You are a standard bearer for Quality in everything we do at Integer, by assuring adherence to our Quality Management System (QMS), facilitating and/or contributing to corrective and preventive actions, and contributing to the successful attainment of our quality KPI’s and journey to 5 Sigma.
  • You may perform other duties as needed and as directed by your line of supervision.

Provide support of Integer’s Manufacturing Excellence and Market Focused Innovation Strategies

  • You champion the development of and deployment of the systems and tools to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
  • You embrace the Manufacturing Excellence culture based on the Integer Production System and its five focus areas:
    • Strategy Alignment through Site Hoshin Plans, the regular cadence of Sales, Inventory, and Operations’ Planning (SiOP) meetings, and regular updates to the value stream maps.
    • Leadership of Sustained Change by ensuring production monitoring & improvement activities and deployment of Leader Standard Work.
    • Standardization through workplace organization & visual controls (5S), Manufacturing Standard Work, and robust training & certification programs.
    • Associate Engagement promoted through the adoption of standardized problem solving. methodologies, behavior-based safety programs, and improvement idea and suggestion systems.
    • Systems & Process Optimization through adoption of principles of built in quality, optimized scheduling & material system designs, work cell design, and total productive maintenance.

How you will be measured:

  • The specific measures listed below may be subject to change and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list:
  • Safety is our highest priority; you will be an active supporter of the Integer Environmental, Health & Safety programs.
  • You will have defined Goals and Objectives specifying key projects and expected milestones to achieve.
  • Quality – Achievement of site Quality KPI’s
  • Innovation and ideation are critical aspects of your role and you will be expected to generate continuous improvement suggestions and support the implementation of them.


What sets you apart:

  • You have earned, as a minimum, a bachelor’s degree in an engineering or related technical field and have between 0-3 years of experience.
  • Candidates who do not meet the education requirement may be considered with 5+ years of relevant experience.

  • You demonstrate a competencies in both written and oral communications.
  • You maintain a calm demeanor that transcends the high energy, constantly changing production environment.

title: Sr. PCB Design Engineer - New Glenn
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role supports the development and operations of New Glenn, a single-configuration, heavy-lift orbital launch vehicle capable of routinely carrying people and payloads to low-Earth orbit, geostationary transfer orbit, cislunar, and beyond. Its first stage is fully reusable, and the vehicle was designed from the beginning to be human-capable.

As part of a small, hard-working and accomplished team of experts, you will be responsible for avionics controller hardware architecture for various spaceflight systems. You will share in the team's impact on all aspects of avionics engineering product development; architectural definition and hardware and software development (design and verification). You should be comfortable working in fast-paced and often uncertain environments, contributing to innovative solutions, while demonstrating personal leadership, technical competence, and attention to detail. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your dedicated commitment and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable spaceflight.


We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!


Responsibilities:

  • Develop avionics hardware (boards and integrated assemblies). Have a solid understanding of the entire product life-cycle, including concept and requirements definition, design, prototyping, verification (power-on, functional / acceptance / qualification testing) and release to production.
  • Develop analog and digital boards that interact with avionics systems (including sensors and electromechanical/electrohydraulic actuators); including analysis, schematic capture, layout, design review, test/verification and release.
  • Support avionics architecture trades studies, analyses, performance characterization and specification, device selection, and controller roadmap direction.
  • Support risk analyses, failure modes effects and criticality analyses (FMECA), design for test/manufacture/cost (DFx), and root-cause analysis of test discrepancies.
  • Participate in program level technology development, mission assurance and safety initiatives, and avionics development process improvements.

Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or related field with 7+ years of direct experience in electronics hardware development
  • Direct hands-on experience developing sophisticated commercial or aerospace electronic assemblies (designing custom cards or integrating COTS hardware).
  • Direct hands-on experience with analog, digital and mixed-signal circuit analysis, simulation, design, test, debug, signal integrity, power, grounding and board layout.
  • Exposure to analog and digital filters, signal conditioning and signal processing using discrete components.
  • Familiarity with use of sophisticated computational devices (combinational and sequential logic) to supervise sensors and control actuators; including design, development and verification.
  • Highly organized standout colleague with excellent technical communication skills (written and verbal)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Graduate degree in related engineering or technical field with 10+ years of direct experience in electronics hardware development
  • Proven expertise designing high-reliability, safety-critical, Class 2/3 board assemblies; including familiarity with IPC 6xx and NASA-STD-8739.n (or similar) standards.
  • Proficiency using Altium/Cadence OrCAD / Allegro (or similar tools) to design complex aerospace boards; and experience working with external board manufacturing and assembly vendors.
  • Exposure to designing safety or critically important aerospace flight hardware aligned with DO-254.
  • Exposure to development of high-reliability, radiation-tolerant, radiation-hardened flight hardware intended for prolonged exposure to extreme space environments


Base Pay Range for:

WA applicants is $156,802.00 - $219,522.45

Other site ranges may differ

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)

Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

title: Vil du være med til at fremme vuggestuebørns bevægelsesglæde i Tumlehuset?
company: Hvidovre Kommune, Center for Økonomi og Personale
description:
Til vuggestuen i idrætsinstitutionen Tumlehuset søger vi 2 personer, der har gode erfaringer med at arbejde sammen.

I Tumlehuset søger vi to personer til vores ene vuggestueteam, hvor mindst én af jer skal være uddannet pædagog. Er I glade for at arbejde sammen, men tænker at det er nu I skal prøve noget andet, så er det måske hos os jeres næste job er.

Vi er en idrætsinstitution, hvor krop og bevægelse er en naturlig del af børnenes hverdag. Vi tror på, at børn lærer med hele kroppen, og vi arbejder målrettet med at skabe inspirerende læringsmiljøer, der fremmer bevægelsesglæde og som der understøtter børns trivsel, udvikling og deltagelse i fællesskaber.

Vi er en personalegruppe, der oprigtigt holder af at være sammen. Vi griner meget, hjælper hinanden, løfter i flok og ved, at gode relationer mellem de voksne er med til at skabe de bedste rammer for børnene. Der er plads til både høj faglighed, sparring, refleksion og ikke mindst humor i en travl hverdag.

Vi sætter stor pris på vores fællesskab og nyder også at mødes til sociale arrangementer uden for arbejdstiden. Det er ikke et krav at deltage, men det siger noget om den kultur, vi har skabt sammen.

I Tumlehuset møder du en ledelse, der prioriterer trivsel og arbejdsmiljø højt. Vi tror på, at medarbejdere, der trives, skaber de bedste betingelser for børnene. Derfor vægter vi nærværende ledelse, tillid, medindflydelse og en hverdag, hvor vi kan grine sammen, samtidig med at vi løser vores kerneopgave med høj kvalitet.

Vi søger jer:

  • Hvor mindst én af jer er uddannet pædagog.
  • Brænder for arbejdet med børn og fællesskaber.
  • Har interesse for eller erfaring med bevægelse, motorik og pædagogisk idræt.
  • Bidrager positivt til samarbejdet med både børn, forældre og kolleger.
  • Har lyst til at være en aktiv del af både vores faglige og sociale fællesskab.
Hos os får du:

  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og engagerede kolleger.
  • Vuggestue med 4 voksne og 12 børn.
  • En stærk kultur præget af humor, omsorg og arbejdsglæde.
  • Mulighed for at arbejde i en idrætsinstitution, hvor bevægelsesglæde er en central del af hverdagen.
  • Faglig sparring og udvikling.
  • Et hus med meget lavt sygefravær.
  • En ledelse, der sætter arbejdsmiljø og trivsel højt på dagsordenen.
Vi opfordrer jer til at komme på besøg, så I kan mærke om vi er stedet for jer. Vi behandler alle ansøgere med stor diskretion og kan godt planlægge besøg udenfor almindelig åbningstid, hvis I ønsker dette.

For yderligere oplysninger er du velkommen til at kontakte daginstitutionsleder Janni Drewsen på 4173 8430.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job Description

  • Support the team in planning, designing, building, deploying, and maintaining Cloud solutions on the on-premises VMware platform (private cloud) and Hyperscaler Cloud Service Providers, e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, and Huawei Cloud

  • Manage and support troubleshooting for any incidents related to Cloud Services (IaaS, OS, Monitoring, Networking, Security) to meet agreed SLAs

  • Experience managing on-premises and Cloud Infrastructure (hybrid environments), including:

a. Solid IT infrastructure technical knowledge and hands-on experience

b. Experience in infrastructure and system monitoring, including alerting, capacity, and availability management

  • Documentation & Customer-facing Skills:

a. Strong technical writing skills — able to produce runbooks, SOPs, RCA reports, architecture diagrams, and operation manuals

b. Customer-facing communication — comfortable interacting with enterprise customers via email, phone, meetings, and incident war-rooms; able to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical stakeholders

a. Initiative, self-supervised, self-motivated, and highly responsible

b. Calm under pressure and ownership mindset during high-severity outages

c. Willing to continuously learn new cloud services, AI tooling, and operational best practices

  • Strong communication skills in Thai and English; service mind, positive thinking and “CAN DO” attitude

description:

Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This role works with and supports the team of property management professionals in achieving occupancy and retention goals by performing administrative tasks related to leasing, marketing, and customer service at the community.

JOB DESCRIPTION

title: Head of IT
description:
Salary: $40,000 – $55,000 per month

Head of IT, Enterprise Systems & Information Security — Hostmost Engineering Ltd

Location: Wong Chuk Hang, Hong Kong (Hong Kong Island South) Employment type: Full-time, permanent Salary: HK$40,000 – HK$55,000 per month, commensurate with experience Reports to: Director of Operations Reference: IT-HEAD-2026

About Hostmost

Hostmost Engineering Ltd is a Hong Kong-headquartered maritime engineering group serving the international shipping industry, with approximately 200 staff across seven offices in Hong Kong, Singapore, the Philippines, China, Vietnam, Canada and the United States. Our engineers service navigation, communication and safety equipment on vessels worldwide, and our operations run continuously across time zones.

The role

We are seeking a Head of IT, Enterprise Systems & Information Security with group-wide responsibility for the technology that connects our seven offices. Reporting directly to the Director of Operations, the role owns the group’s enterprise systems, its Microsoft 365 identity and tenant security, its ERP platform, its automation layer and its information security posture across every jurisdiction in which we operate.

This is a senior position that is unusual in its breadth. The group runs a developer-grade technology estate — an in-house enterprise web platform, a self-hosted automation platform of over 100 production workflows, self-hosted archiving, AI-assisted document and helpdesk systems and a Business Central ERP — with a very small IT team. The role therefore requires a single individual who combines four disciplines that are rarely found together: enterprise application architecture and development, systems integration and automation at scale, Microsoft 365 tenant and identity security ownership, and applied AI engineering. The successful candidate will personally design, build, secure and operate these systems, and will lead the function across offices in seven countries.

Responsibilities

Group-wide enterprise systems - Own the strategy, architecture and delivery of all internal enterprise systems for all seven offices - Personally design, build and maintain the group’s internal enterprise web platform (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL) — the system of record for meetings, documents, HR processes, leave, organisation structure, engineer scheduling and archives across the group - Own the self-hosted automation platform (n8n) and its 100+ production workflows integrating ERP, helpdesk, HR, security and field-service systems - Lead the group ERP migration to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central: master data, integration architecture, document layouts, vendor management and contract governance

Identity, tenant and information security - Own the group’s Microsoft 365 tenant across seven countries: Entra ID identity architecture, Conditional Access, privileged-access governance, SharePoint, Exchange Online, Graph API and tenant administration - Own the group’s information security posture: email authentication and filtering (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, transport rules, threat-intelligence feeds), identity security, partner and vendor access control, and incident investigation and response - Maintain the group’s security governance framework: risk register, security plan, policies, and data-privacy compliance across every operating jurisdiction

Platforms, automation and infrastructure - Design, deploy and operate AI-assisted systems: document classification, retrieval-based assistants over technical and policy documentation, and helpdesk automation - Own the helpdesk platform (Zendesk) and its automation across all offices - Manage self-hosted cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker), including backup, monitoring and disaster recovery - Lead IT operations and support across all offices and time zones, and report to the directors on governance, security and delivery

Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate all of the following with documented, verifiable examples:

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience evidenced by a documented track record of delivered systems

• Minimum 5 years in enterprise IT systems delivery, including at least 2 years leading an IT function or major programme

• Personal, hands-on delivery of a production enterprise web application (React, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST integration) as sole or lead developer — a portfolio of systems built will be required

• Ownership of a workflow automation platform (n8n or equivalent) at scale in production, integrating multiple enterprise systems

• Full Microsoft 365 tenant ownership for a multi-country organisation: Entra ID, Conditional Access, privileged-access governance, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Graph API and PowerShell

• Information security ownership including email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), threat-intelligence integration, identity security, and documented incident investigation and response

• ERP implementation or migration experience; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central strongly preferred

• Operation of self-hosted services on cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) with Docker, including backup and disaster recovery

• Applied AI / LLM integration in production: retrieval pipelines, document classification, vector databases

• Experience supporting multi-office, multi-jurisdiction operations across time zones

• Fluent English essential; Cantonese and/or Mandarin an advantage

• Experience in the maritime, shipping or engineering services sector an advantage

To apply

Please send a CV and a covering note describing, with specifics, the enterprise systems you have personally designed, built and secured, to recruit@hostmostgroup.com, quoting reference IT-HEAD-2026.

Hostmost Engineering Ltd is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Principal mmWave IC Design Engineer - TeraWave
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

We are seeking a Principal mmWave IC Design Engineer to drive the development of state-of-the-art RF/mmWave integrated chips at Blue Origin. In this pivotal role, you will be designing cutting-edge integrated front-end circuits such as power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, phase shifters, variable-gain amplifiers, mixers, multipliers, and synthesizers at RF/mmWave frequencies, primarily in advanced silicon technologies. Your innovation in front-end implementation will be critical in realizing system architectures for next-generation communication networks and advancing our mission of enabling millions of people to live and work in space for the benefit of Earth.


Special Mentions:

- Relocation provided

- Travel expected up to 10% of the time

- Interviews will include a technical assessment

- This role will be based onsite in San Diego, CA or Cupertino, CA. A temporary remote work exception is approved while our San Diego site is being developed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design state-of-the-art RF/mmWave front-end chipsets, including power amplifiers, low-noise amplifiers, phase shifters, variable-gain amplifiers, mixers, multipliers, and synthesizers.
  • Partner with RF system engineers to run feasibility studies and architect RF/mmWave transmitter and receiver front-ends, translating system-level requirements into chip-level specifications.
  • Design and simulate on-chip electromagnetic (EM) structures and collaborate with the package engineering team on co-optimization of IC/package interfaces.
  • Supervise chip-level front-end integration and optimization throughout the development lifecycle and ensure successful production
  • Work with third-party design partners

Minimum Qualifications:

  • B.S. or Ph.D. degree in Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline
  • 10+ years of experience in millimeter-wave/RFIC design using SiGe, CMOS, and SOI technologies, with successful completion of multiple product lifecycles for high-volume chipsets.
  • Strong experience with various circuit topologies for amplifiers, mixers, switches, and synthesizers, specifically at mmWave frequencies with fully integrated on-chip implementations.
  • Proven expertise in the analysis and optimization of transmitter and receiver front-ends for complex modulated waveforms, including practical modeling and circuit simulations of TX/RX chains with time-sampled waveforms.
  • Hands-on experience in mmWave IC characterization and debugging.
  • Experience with analog building blocks such as operational amplifiers, bias generators, temperature sensors, LDOs, and ADC/DAC implementations.
  • Proficiency in EM simulations for both on-chip and package components.
  • Prior experience with top-level integration, including ESD, mixed-signal/mixed-mode verification, and DFM concepts.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with beamforming front-ends and phased array implementations.
  • Experience in high-performance IC development using III-V technologies (e.g., GaAs, GaN).
  • Strategic mindset and strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and drive complex projects to completion.
  • Experience mentoring early-career engineers.


Base Pay Range for:

CA applicants is $269,175.00 - $376,843.95

Other site ranges may differ


Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.

title: Bliv pædagogisk assistentelev – og vær med til at gøre en forskel!
description:
Drømmer du om en hverdag, hvor du arbejder med mennesker, udvikling og relationer?
Som pædagogisk assistentelev får du en uddannelse, der åbner døren til et meningsfuldt arbejdsliv, hvor du hver dag bidrager til, at børn, unge eller voksne trives, lærer og udvikler sig.

Børn og Unge i Aarhus Kommune ansætter elever allerede inden opstart på Grundforløb 2. Det giver dig som elev mulighed for at have et forsørgelsesgrundlag under hele uddannelse til pædagogisk assistent, og du er sikret ansættelse på hovedforløbet, inden du evt. opsiger nuværende stilling.

Har du lyst til at:

  • arbejde med udvikling, trivsel og læring hos mennesker i alle aldre?
  • få et spændende og meningsfyldt job med masser af faglige og personlige udfordringer?
  • opleve, at du gør en reel forskel i hverdagen?
  • blive en del af en uddannelse, som ruster dig både menneskeligt og fagligt?
Så er uddannelsen som pædagogisk assistent noget for dig!

På uddannelsen veksler du mellem skole- og oplæringsperioder. I skoleperioderne går du på SOSU Østjylland i Aarhus N, og i oplæringsperioderne arbejder du i en af Aarhus Kommunes daginstitutioner eller SFO’er, hvor du får praktisk erfaring med de arbejdsopgaver, en pædagogisk assistent udfører.

Vi forventer, at du som elev:

  • har lyst, engagement og personligt overskud til at arbejde med mennesker
  • kan kommunikere tydeligt og samarbejde godt med både kolleger, borgere og pårørende
  • er selvstændig, nysgerrig og har respekt for forskellighed
  • deltager aktivt i undervisning og oplæring – og arbejder målrettet mod dine læringsmål
  • bidrager positivt til fælles dialog og udvikling
  • er pligtopfyldende, fleksibel, loyal og tager ansvar for dine opgaver og aftaler
Adgangskrav

For at kunne starte på grundforløbet skal du opfylde de formelle krav for pædagogisk assistentuddannelsen. Kravene varierer afhængigt af alder og erhvervserfaring.
Du kan læse mere om ansættelseskravene på:

  • Uddannelsesguiden.dk
Børn og Unge i Aarhus Kommune søger aktuelt også pædagogiske assistentelever til EUD-hovedforløbsuddannelsen med opstart i januar 2027 og elever til EUX-uddannelsen med opstart i februar 2027. Ansøgere til de to hold skal søge via stillingsopslagene målrettet disse stillinger. Du finder stillingsopslagene på Job i Aarhus Kommune

Ansættelse, oplæring og skole:

Når du bliver ansat som pædagogisk assistentelev, indgår du en uddannelsesaftale med et dagtilbud i Aarhus Kommune. Aftalen dækker både Grundforløb 2 og hovedforløbet. Grundforløb 2 varer i alt 20 uger inkluderet to ugers virksomhedsforlagt undervisning.

Skoleperioderne foregår på:

SOSU Østjylland - Aarhus

Hedeager 33

8200 Aarhus

På hovedforløbet skal elever i oplæring 3 gange i en daginstitution eller SFO. Den første oplæringsperiode vil altid være i en daginstitution. Oplæringsstederne er geografisk placeret forskellige steder i hele Aarhus Kommune, derfor skal du regne med transporttid til dit oplæringssted.

I forbindelse med at du søger stillingen, skal du angive, om du vil have en oplæringsplads i Aarhus Nord, Aarhus Midt eller Aarhus Syd.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Elevuddannelsen er omfattet af overenskomsten for pædagogmedhjælpere og pædagogiske assistenter.

Løn er på nuværende tidspunkt:

  • Elevløn ca. 13.500. pr måned
  • Voksen-elevløn (over 25 år) ca. kr. 26.200 pr. måned
Lønnen reguleres løbende i henhold til overenskomsten.

Ugentligt timetal: 37

Du har 3 måneders prøvetid i ansættelsen. Prøvetiden starter den dag, du begynder i den første oplæringsperiode.

Der er tale om en tidsbegrænset stilling fra den 9. februar 2027 til hovedforløbet afsluttes.

Stillingen er til enhver tid betinget af en tilfredsstillende offentlig straffeattest og en anmærkningsfri børneattest.

Ansøgning:

Du skal søge via Aarhus Kommunes E-rekrutterings system. Klik på ”Send ansøgning” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning. Vær derfor omhyggelig med at udfylde din mailadresse. Vi tager ikke imod ansøgninger på anden vis.

Når du har åbnet rekrutteringssystemet og følger ansøgningsguiden, bliver du bedt om at svare på en række spørgsmål, og om at uploade forskellige dokumenter. Herunder en ansøgning, et CV og din opholdstilladelse, såfremt du ikke er dansk statsborger. Du har også mulighed for at uploade anbefalinger fra andre arbejdsgivere eller evaluering fra virksomhedsforlagtundervisning.

Ansøgningsfrist: 1. november 2027

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 46

Hvis du vil vide mere:

Hvis du vil vide mere om uddannelsen, kan du læse på SOSU Østjyllands hjemmeside .


I Aarhus Kommune sætter vi børnene i centrum
Vi vil give alle børn og unge de bedste betingelser for at lære, udvikle sig og trives. Det kræver stærke læringsfællesskaber og tværfagligt samarbejde mellem de voksne omkring barnet.
I Aarhus Kommune bliver du en del af en samarbejdskultur, hvor data, viden og erfaringer inddrages, så alle får mulighed for at lære sammen af hinanden og med hinanden på tværs af professioner, medarbejder- og ledelsesniveauer. Vi tror på at børn og unge gør, hvad de kan. Børnene er ikke problemet, men de viser problemet. I Aarhus Kommune tager de voksne ansvar for læring, udvikling og trivsel for alle børn og unge.

title: Outdoor Adventures Fall Break Expedition Leader
description:
APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:

Duties & Responsibilities Include (but not limited to):

  • Lead multi-day fall break trip, with activities including but not limited to: backpacking, canoeing, caving, fly fishing, hiking, ice climbing, kayaking, mountain biking, mountaineering, rock climbing, standup paddleboarding, and whitewater rafting.

    • develop a trip itinerary

    • request and pack all necessary equipment
    • coordinate vehicle logistics

description:

Job Summary

Responsible to the assigned supervisor for performing entry level engineering work activities and projects requiring the application of engineering knowledge in a safe, effective, efficient and economic accomplishment of assigned objectives.

Job Description

What You’ll Do:
This position is for the role of a Tools & Analytics Engineer within the Transmission System Operations Engineering (TSOE) organization. The role entails supporting and enhancing the tools, applications, data systems, analytics, and automation processes used to manage Transmission Facility Ratings, Configuration Management, transmission modeling, and regulatory compliance activities across the transmission system.

Expected activities include, but are not limited to:

  • Providing technical support for TSOE-owned applications, databases, reports, dashboards, and automation solutions used by Transmission Engineering, Operations, Ratings & Configuration, and Configuration Management organizations.
  • Developing, maintaining, and enhancing software applications, scripts, APIs, reports, and integrations used to support transmission modeling, facility ratings, engineering workflows, and business processes.
  • Creating and supporting SQL, Oracle, and other database queries to analyze engineering, operational, and compliance-related data and provide actionable information to engineering and leadership teams.
  • Designing, developing, and maintaining Power BI dashboards, performance metrics, and reporting solutions that improve visibility into Transmission operations, Configuration Management activities, FAC-008 compliance, and engineering performance.
  • Supporting Transmission Planning System (TPS), ODMS, facility ratings processes, and related transmission modeling tools by validating data quality, identifying discrepancies, and coordinating corrective actions.
  • Reviewing outage requests, asset changes, engineering records, and system data to identify potential impacts to transmission models, facility ratings, and systems of record.
  • Performing root cause analysis of data quality issues, model discrepancies, reporting inaccuracies, and process failures to identify improvement opportunities and enhance data integrity.
  • Collaborating with engineering, operations, IT, vendors, and external stakeholders to define requirements, implement enhancements, and support modernization of TSOE applications and data systems.
  • Providing subject matter expertise related to transmission system modeling, facility ratings, MLSEs, electrical asset data, Configuration Management, and applicable NERC and industry standards.
  • Identifying and implementing opportunities to automate manual processes, improve engineering efficiency, reduce compliance risk, and increase the accuracy and accessibility of transmission system data.

Engineer Associate SG6

*ABET - Engineering Accreditation Commission of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology.

  • **VP or above may waive the requirement for a degree from a university with an Non ABET accredited program

In addition:

  • Transmission system modeling (TPS, ODMS, PSSE, bus/branch concepts)

  • Power BI development
  • Python, .NET, PowerShell, or other programming experience

title: Community Outreach Assistant I
description:
About Us:

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

Exciting Opportunity at MSK: Community Outreach Assistant I

At Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK), our mission is to end cancer for life through exceptional patient care, research, and education. The Community Outreach Coordinator plays a vital role in expanding access to cancer prevention and screening services by engaging directly with community members, fostering partnerships, and supporting health education initiatives throughout New York City.

Role Overview

  • Serve as a key representative of MSK's community outreach and cancer screening initiatives, building trust and awareness within diverse communities.
  • Conduct community outreach and provide education on cancer prevention, early detection, screening services, and available healthcare resources.
  • Coordinate and support community-based events, health fairs, educational workshops, and outreach programs in partnership with local organizations.
  • Engage and follow up with community members regarding appointments, screenings, referrals, and program participation.
  • Collaborate with healthcare providers, community-based organizations, advocacy groups, and local leaders to strengthen community partnerships and expand access to care.
  • Assist with planning, organizing, and implementing outreach activities designed to increase cancer screening participation and health awareness.
  • Maintain outreach calendars, community engagement activities, resource directories, and program documentation.
  • Collect, track, and report outreach and program data to support program evaluation, quality improvement, and reporting requirements.
  • Support special projects, educational initiatives, and research-related activities that advance community health and cancer prevention efforts.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Public Health, Health Sciences, Social Sciences, Community Health, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Fluency in both English and Spanish, with the ability to effectively communicate with diverse populations.
  • Experience in community outreach, community health, patient navigation, healthcare coordination, public health, nonprofit organizations, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with community members, healthcare partners, and external organizations.
  • Experience coordinating multiple projects, events, or outreach activities while managing competing priorities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and data tracking systems, with strong attention to detail and documentation practices.

Core Skills

  • Community engagement, relationship building, and stakeholder partnership development.
  • Verbal and written communication skills, including health education and public presentations.
  • Organization, event coordination, and project management abilities.
  • Cultural sensitivity and the ability to work effectively with diverse and underserved populations.
  • Data management, reporting, problem-solving, and follow-through in a fast-paced, community-facing environment.

Additional Information

  • Schedule: Hybrid schedule with 4 days onsite and 1 day remote. Hours vary based on community outreach events, which are typically held during the day and early evening. Flexible scheduling is available, with an ideal start time later in the day to accommodate evening events. Occasional weekend participation is required.
  • Location: 633 Third Avenue, New York, NY
  • Reporting to: Associate, Community Outreach
  • To learn more about the Immigrant Health & Cancer Disparities Service, please review: Immigrant Health & Cancer Disparities Service | Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center

title: Smartphone Product Evaluator - KOL Gadget Review
description:
Job Positioning

We are looking for a digital enthusiast who is passionate about smartphones, understands Indonesian users, and has the ability to conduct independent reviews.

As the team's "internal KOL", you will, based on the budget and usage needs of local users, experience the product and compare it with competing products, and use real evidence to clearly explain: what the phone does well, what its shortcomings are, whether it is worth choosing at the same price point, and what should be prioritized for improvement.

Core Responsibilities

  1. Local Scenario Design

Combining Indonesian users' habits, KOL content and community feedback, design evaluation scenarios covering gaming, social shooting, short videos, mobile payment, mobility and battery life.

  1. Mobile Phone Experience Review

Independently conduct tests on Android mobile phones, covering camera, performance, battery life, charging, display, audio, network and system. Focus on the sustained smoothness and heat generation of games, the effect from shooting to social sharing, as well as daily experiences such as payment, navigation and message notifications.

  1. Competing Product Comparison and Evaluation

Conduct a fair comparison with competing products in the local market at the same price range, and illustrate the product’s strengths and weaknesses, target user groups and purchase tradeoffs based on its actual selling price, configurations and test evidence, so as to form an evaluation conclusion for the complete device.

  1. Evaluation, Expression and Reporting

Capable of presenting key differences through short evaluation videos, comparative demonstrations or verbal explanations, and providing feedback to the product and R&D teams in English reports, with test conditions, procedures and results clearly documented.

  1. User Feedback and Issue Closure

Track Indonesian KOLs and user comments, extract and verify key issues, submit reproducible feedback, track fixes and confirm experience improvements.

Job Requirements

  • College diploma or above, no restriction on majors, and a passion for smartphones and digital products.

  • Hands-on experience in actual testing of Android mobile phones, capable of designing test scenarios, reproducing issues, collecting evidence and compiling reports.

  • Familiar with the Indonesian mobile phone market, user habits and key purchasing concerns, and capable of evaluating products in combination with budget and target groups.

  • Understand the main software and hardware functions of mobile phones, be familiar with the content of local tech KOLs, and have the ability to make independent judgments and conduct competing product analysis.

  • Fluent in Indonesian, with strong capabilities in reading and writing English reports as well as daily work communication.

  • Familiar with common office software, and capable of using Word, Excel, PowerPoint or similar tools to organize data, compile reports and present results.

  • Proactive and responsible at work, with teamwork skills and Time Management capabilities, able to work under pressure and ensure delivery quality within project deadlines.

Bonus points

  • Have and consistently run personal tech accounts on platforms including YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, and have published original content such as smartphone reviews, competing product comparisons or phone purchase suggestions.

  • Capable of shooting, screen recording, editing and explaining in front of the camera, and can intuitively present the experience differences.

  • Have experience in tech communities or fan engagement, and be able to turn user questions into evaluation topics.

  • Be Humble - We seek honest feedback to strengthen our relationships.
  • Pursue Excellence - We strive to achieve extraordinary results and do not settle for mediocrity.

Strive for excellence and consider joining our growing team today!

JOB OVERVIEW

The Junior Software Engineer provides hands-on development and engineering support to the Splunk Engineering and Maintenance team supporting government agencies. Working under the direction of senior Data, Platform, and Detection Engineers, this role contributes across the full breadth of the SIEM environment: onboarding and normalizing data sources, maintaining platform infrastructure and configurations, developing searches, dashboards, and content, and automating recurring engineering tasks through scripting and code. This is an entry-level, growth-oriented position for an engineer with a software development or cybersecurity foundation who is expected to build depth in Splunk and security operations over time. The Junior Software Engineer collaborates with senior engineers, security analysts, and agency stakeholders, and follows established code review, testing, and change management practices.

Essential Functions:

  • Software Development and Automation.
  • Write, test, and maintain scripts and small applications (Python, Bash, PowerShell) that automate recurring Splunk engineering, maintenance, and reporting tasks.
  • Use version control, peer code review, and established branching and deployment practices for all code and configuration changes.
  • Data Engineering Support.
  • Assist with onboarding new log sources, including configuration of inputs, forwarders, parsing rules (props and transforms), source types, and index assignment.
  • Support data quality efforts by validating field extractions, timestamps, event breaking, and Common Information Model (CIM) normalization under senior engineer guidance.
  • Platform Engineering and Maintenance.
  • Support routine maintenance of the Splunk environment, including indexers, search heads, forwarders, deployment servers, and app and patch deployments.
  • Monitor platform health, license usage, ingest volume, and search performance; identify anomalies and assist senior engineers with troubleshooting and remediation.
  • Content Development.
  • Develop and maintain SPL searches, reports, dashboards, and alerts that support security, operational, and mission use cases.
  • Assist Detection Engineers with building, testing, documenting, and deploying detection content through established review and release workflows.
  • Testing, Documentation, and Quality.
  • Test changes in development and test environments prior to production deployment and validate results against expected outcomes.
  • Maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, runbooks, and knowledge articles for the work performed.
  • Operational and Customer Support.
  • Respond to assigned tickets and user requests for Splunk access, search assistance, data questions, and minor configuration changes.
  • Provide data and platform context in support of incident response, audits, and after-action activities as directed.
  • Collaboration and Professional Development.
  • Participate in stand-ups, sprint planning, code reviews, and change management processes with the Splunk Engineering and Maintenance team.
  • Work with senior engineers to translate requirements into technical tasks, and progress toward Splunk certification and technical specialization.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • US Citizen with an active Top Secret Security Clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field; equivalent technical training, certifications, or demonstrable experience will be considered.
  • 0-2 years of professional software development, IT engineering, or cybersecurity experience; internship, co-op, apprenticeship, or substantial project work is applicable.
  • Working proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, Java, Go, or JavaScript.
  • Comfort operating in a Linux command-line environment and a foundational understanding of system administration concepts.
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and standard development workflows including branching, pull requests, and code review.
  • Ability to work with structured and semi-structured data formats such as JSON, XML, CSV, YAML, and syslog, including basic use of regular expressions.
  • Foundational understanding of networking and logging concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication events) and how security-relevant events are generated across endpoint, network, and cloud.
  • Foundational cybersecurity knowledge, including core security principles, common attack patterns, and the role of a SIEM in security operations.
  • Willingness and demonstrated ability to learn Splunk and the Splunk Search Processing Language (SPL) quickly.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical work for other engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to take direction and follow established engineering processes.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the clearance and suitability requirements for the contract.

PREFERRED:

  • Hands-on exposure to Splunk (SPL, dashboards, universal forwarders, apps) or another SIEM such as Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or Google SecOps.
  • Splunk Core Certified User or Splunk Core Certified Power User, or willingness to obtain within the first year.
  • CompTIA Security+, Network+, or a comparable industry certification.
  • Experience with REST APIs, data parsing and normalization, and data pipeline concepts.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their native logging services.
  • Exposure to configuration management or infrastructure-as-code tooling such as Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, detection engineering concepts, and SOC workflows.
  • Experience supporting a federal customer or working in an accredited environment.
  • Interest in growing into a Data, Platform, or Detection Engineering specialization.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS

  • Inside office environment.
  • Working on a computer for long periods of time.
  • May involve long period of sitting at a desk.
  • The work environment is fast-paced and sometimes involves extreme deadline pressures.

OTHER DUTIES

title: Senior/Staff Engineer - Web3 - Onchain Data
description:
About the Onchain Data Team

The Onchain Data team builds the core data and technology infrastructure behind OKX Web3. We connect to diverse blockchain networks and collect, process, govern, interpret, and serve large-scale onchain data, delivering accurate, real-time, and reliable capabilities to Wallet, DEX, Explorer, Risk, CeFi, and AI products.

Our scope includes, but is not limited to:

  • Multi-chain data ingestion, parsing, computation, and unified data models;

  • Data capabilities for onchain assets, transactions, addresses, tokens, contracts, and projects;

  • Blockchain explorers, the Project Marketplace, Onchain Data APIs, bots, and agents;

  • Labels, risk detection, risk-control data, and security investigation capabilities;

  • DEX trending rankings, token scoring, and other onchain data products;

  • Global multi-region deployment, high-availability architecture, performance optimization, and system reliability;

  • Deep application of AI in engineering, data analysis, risk investigation, and intelligent operations.

You will work on challenges involving heterogeneous chains, large-scale data, real-time computation, high concurrency, high availability, data accuracy, and complex cross-functional collaboration. Your work can directly improve user experience, asset security, and business growth.

What You May Work On

This is a broad hiring track rather than a single fixed role. Your responsibilities will be matched to your strengths, experience, and interests, and may include one or more of the following:

  1. Design, build, and evolve onchain data infrastructure, data services, or business systems, taking ownership of the quality and outcomes of critical modules.

  2. Build multi-chain ingestion, real-time and batch computation, data governance, search, storage, and serving capabilities, continuously improving data accuracy, completeness, and freshness.

  3. Contribute to blockchain explorers, the Project Marketplace, onchain assets, labels, risk control, DEX rankings, token scoring, and related platforms or products.

  4. Identify critical technical and business problems, make sound judgments, design solutions, coordinate resources, drive execution, and review outcomes.

  5. Build highly available, high-performance, scalable global systems, while continuously improving reliability, cost efficiency, delivery efficiency, and user experience.

  6. Use AI tools deeply and explore agents, intelligent investigation, engineering automation, and intelligent operations, turning successful practices into reusable team capabilities.

  7. Collaborate with product, data, security, algorithm, operations, and engineering teams to drive cross-functional initiatives to completion.

title: Principal Architect, Product Integrity
description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

Blue Origin is building TeraWave, a multi-thousand-satellite communications constellation delivering symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps worldwide. The constellation spans low Earth orbit and medium Earth orbit with optical inter-satellite links, and is designed from the ground up to achieve high reliability through data-driven engineering rather than front-loaded predictions.

As a Principal Engineer for Product Integrity, you will be the team's deepest technical contributor on reliability and thermal analysis -- personally working the hardest design and qualification problems across the satellite and its subsystems. You will spend the majority of your time embedded in specific technical challenges for weeks at a time: modeling failure physics, analyzing thermal margins, supporting root-cause investigations, and helping subsystem teams finalize designs that survive launch and long-duration orbital environments.

When not solving specific problems, you will build the reliability engineering methodology that subsystem teams execute in their own verticals. This means designing accelerated life test programs, defining failure mode assessment frameworks, establishing physics-of-failure analysis tools, and shaping how test data feeds back into design decisions. You create the playbook and the tools -- subsystem owners run them. The goal is a reliability culture where teams are equipped and accountable, not dependent on a central authority.

This role sits within the Chief Systems Architecture office and works closely with domain architects, subsystem leads, and the integration and test organization.

Responsibilities

**Deep Technical Contribution (~50-70%)**

- Perform thermal analysis and reliability modeling on the most challenging design problems across the satellite, spending sustained periods embedded in specific subsystem challenges
- Develop and apply physics-of-failure models for critical failure modes -- solder fatigue, mechanism wear-out, radiation degradation, thermo-mechanical stress -- tied to specific hardware and environments
- Support subsystem teams through qualification and design finalization with hands-on analysis, not oversight
- Lead root-cause investigation and failure analysis for test anomalies and, eventually, on-orbit events
- Assess thermal and reliability margins for designs under launch and orbital environments, identifying where margins are thin and where they are adequate

**Reliability Methodology and Mechanisms (~30-40%)**

- Direct the accelerated life testing (ALT) program: define what tests are needed, what they must demonstrate, and how results translate into design or process changes
- Design and lead HALT campaigns to identify design margins and unknown weaknesses; collaborate with integration and test leads where HALT findings inform acceptance screening criteria
- Establish the failure mode assessment framework -- how teams identify credible failure modes, classify consequences, rank criticality, and score mitigations before and after
- Create practical tools and methods for subsystem teams to assess specific failure mechanisms (e.g., solder fatigue life estimation, thermal cycling margin evaluation, radiation susceptibility screening)
- Define how reliability data from testing and flight operations feeds back into design decisions -- closing the loop between what we learn and what we change
- Shape the program's approach to reliability growth: conservative initial goals informed by real test and flight data, with structured improvement as the fleet matures

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related field; MS or PhD preferred
- 12+ years of experience in reliability engineering, thermal analysis, or physics-of-failure modeling for high-reliability hardware
- Hands-on expertise in accelerated life testing (ALT), HALT, and environmental stress testing -- designing programs, not just reviewing results
- Strong background in thermal analysis for electronics or spacecraft systems (analytical and/or FEA-based)
- Experience with failure analysis and root-cause investigation across thermal, mechanical, electrical, or materials domains
- Demonstrated ability to work as a deep individual contributor on sustained technical problems, not solely in leadership or oversight roles
- Familiarity with space environments: thermal cycling, radiation, vacuum, launch loads
- Strong technical communication skills -- able to convey failure mode implications and test results clearly to both subsystem engineers and program leadership

Desired

- Experience with automatoive, satellite or constellation programs.
- Expertise in solder-joint reliability, advanced packaging integrity, or thermo-mechanical analysis of electronic assemblies
- Background in designing reliability test programs that generate quantitative life data (Weibull analysis, acceleration factor modeling)
- Experience with materials characterization or failure mode testing for mechanisms, optics, or RF components
- Track record of building reliability frameworks or test methodologies adopted across multiple teams or product lines

WA applicants is $157,059.00 - $219,882.60

At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. Vi är 35 fasta medarbetare och fem–tio medarbetare som jobbar del av tjänst eller är timanställda. Vi erbjuder våra patienter en vård av god kvalitet och har 100 % i telefontillgänglighet. Vi upplever att vi har mycket gott samarbete mellan yrkeskategorierna och har mycket bra stämning och arbetsklimat här på Vårdcentralen Ryd. Vi har distriktsläkare, ST-läkare, AT/BT-läkare, distriktssköterskor, sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, receptionist, fotvårdsterapeut, fysioterapeut, kurator, rehab koordinator, undersköterskor och vårdadministratörer. Distriktsläkarna är erfarna och ger fin handledning till nya kollegor. Vi har familjecentral där BVC arbetar tillsammans med kommunens personal. Så det är bara dig som underläkare/leg läkare som vi saknar!

Läs gärna om vår karriärstege för läkare och om dina förmåner hos oss, här hittar du även information om bestämmelser gällande lön och ersättningar.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Vi erbjuder dig ett utmanande och omväxlande arbete på vår läkarmottagning. Vi hoppas att du blir intresserad av bredden av specialistområdet allmänmedicin och kan tänka dig en framtid inom primärvården. Som underläkare hos oss kommer du erhålla regelbunden handledning samt möjlighet att delta i utbildning tillsammans med andra underläkare. Tillsammans utformar vi en introduktion utifrån dina behov.

Om dig

Vi söker dig med svensk läkarexamen eller svensk läkarlegitimation/avklarat kunskapsprov till svensk läkarlegitimation (bifogas ansökan). Vidare har du svenska språkkunskaper motsvarande nivå Svenska C1. Då du arbetar i ständig dialog med patienter, anhöriga, kollegor och andra verksamheter är det ett krav att du har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska språket i tal och skrift.

Ansökan och anställning

Som person är du trygg i dig själv och har god samarbetsförmåga. Du har gott omdöme och kommunicerar på ett tydligt sätt. Det är även viktigt att du är prestigelös, nyfiken på att lära nytt och ser konstruktiv återkoppling som en naturlig del i det dagliga arbetet. Du kan planera, organisera och prioritera ditt arbete. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Arbetstid klockan 08.00–17.00. Vi arbetar med löpande urval så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Inför anställning i ett patientnära arbete inom Region Östergötland kommer du att få fylla i en hälsodeklaration.

Varmt välkommen in med din ansökan! Om du behöver hjälp med att registrera i systemet, kontakta kundtjänst Stöd och service, 010-103 60 00, under kontorstid.

Till bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:

Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra externa aktörer och försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Region Östergötland har upphandlade avtal.

title: Junior Software Engineer- 4 Days Onsite- Englewood, CO- FreeWheel
description:
FreeWheel, a Comcast company, provides comprehensive ad platforms for publishers, advertisers, and media buyers. Powered by premium video content, robust data, and advanced technology, we’re making it easier for buyers and sellers to transact across all screens, data types, and sales channels. As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world.

Job Summary

This job entails writing and maintaining clean, efficient code for various software components while following development best practices. It supports the design and innovation of new applications that align with business goals. It involves implementing testing frameworks to validate software, documenting development processes for knowledge transfer, and analyzing integration needs. Responsibilities also include collaborating with Quality Assurance to meet technical standards, and troubleshooting to improve performance and user satisfaction.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • Writing and maintaining efficient code for software components, adhering to best practices in development
  • Supporting the design and development of new software applications aligned with business objectives
  • Implementing testing frameworks for software validation, including unit and integration tests, to ensure quality
  • Documenting the software development process, including design and deployment procedures, to facilitate knowledge sharing
  • Analyzing software integration needs and planning system architecture to meet technical specifications
  • Reviewing current practices and technical literature to inform project solutions and applying engineering methodologies
  • Working with Quality Assurance to ensure applications meet technical requirements and fit specifications
  • Troubleshooting software issues, providing resolutions to enhance application performance and user satisfaction
  • Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
  • Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
Employees at all levels are expected to:
  • Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
  • Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
  • Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
  • Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
  • Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
  • Drive results and growth.
  • Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
  • Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

AWS Architecture, Back-End Development, C++ Programming Language, Distributed Systems, Go Programming Language, Java (Programming Language), Low Latency

title: Deltidsmedarbejder søges til kundeservice med fokus på gældsindrivelse – kun få dage om måneden
description:
Deltidsmedarbejder søges til kundeservice med fokus på gældsindrivelse – kun få dage om måneden, perfekt som supplerende arbejde eller studiejob.

Er du god til at tale med mennesker og smile gennem telefonen?
Så kunne du være lige dén person vi står og mangler til vores kundeservice!

Vi søger en der kan hjælpe os i vores spidsbelastede perioder hver måned. Der er tale om fulde arbejdsdage på vores travleste dage hver måned. Vores travleste dag ligger som udgangspunkt altid omkring den 7. og nogle dage frem hver måned, men kan variere alt efter weekend- og helligdage.

Vi er en kundeservicevirksomhed, som arbejder sammen med blandt andet banker og andre finansielle institutter.
Vi har derfor brug for en, som godt kan lide at arbejde med mennesker over telefonen. En som kan sikre sig at kunden altid får en god oplevelse. En som kan være med til at skabe gode løsninger for vores kunder.

Det er ikke et krav at du har erfaring med hverken kundeservice eller gældsindrivelse på forhånd. Vi sørger for at du får grundig oplæring, så du er klar til at gå i gang med dine nye opgaver. Du skal bare have lysten til at lære nye ting.

Egenskaber vi sætter stor pris på hos dig:

- Du ved hvordan man smiler gennem telefonen

- Selvtillid og evnen til at arbejde som en del af et hold

- Gode kommunikationsevner og evnen til at skabe en god forbindelse til mange forskellige slags mennesker

- Mulighed for at arbejde fulde dage under peaken (vores spidsbelastede dage)

- Stabilitet og pålidelighed

Hvad du kan forvente af os:

- Fast timeløn med provisionsordning

- Et socialt arbejdsmiljø i rummelige omgivelser med en behagelig atmosfære

- En multinational arbejdsplads med en uformel tone og højt til loftet

- Fordelagtige arbejdstider og gode trafikforbindelser med offentlig transport til kontoret

Hvem er vi og hvad laver vi?
Nordiccom ApS er en virksomhed i vækst, med hovedkontor i hjertet af København. Virksomhederne vi repræsenterer og arbejder tæt sammen med, er større virksomheder i finans- og forsikringssektoren i Europa. Med hele det Nordeuropæiske marked som vores arbejdsplads – og telefonerne som vores værktøj – tilbyder vi løsninger i både salg og kundeservice, for en lang række virksomheder i den finansielle sektor. Derfor overholder vi bankernes standarder og kodekser, så kvaliteten altid sikres.
I Nordiccom vil du møde både danskere, svenskere, nordmænd og finlændere. Vi består af omkring 150 medarbejdere fordelt ud på de forskellige teams. Vi er i Nordiccom stolte af vores professionalisme og det er vigtigt for os at vores medarbejdere trives på arbejdspladsen. Vores mål er at forme vores medarbejdere, så de bedst muligt opnår succes. At de bliver dygtige til deres arbejde og opnår gode resultater. Al træning og oplæring foregår på medarbejdernes eget sprog.


Send en ansøgning:
Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i overstående og synes, at det lyder som et spændende job for dig, så send os gerne en ansøgning og et CV på nedenstående mail med titlen ”Deltid”.
Skulle du have spørgsmål er du også velkommen til at kontakte HR, Sarah, enten telefonisk eller på mail.
